文件: 计算优化权重后，脚本构建加权复合宽带图像，对其与窄带图像运行所选去星工具，然后在无星图像对上执行连续谱相减。

FILE: Include notes in the list of problems and in the reports: informative messages that are neither errors nor warnings, such as cached results, master frames not found for optional calibration steps, or automatic selections.
文件: 在问题列表与报告中包含备注：既非错误也非警告的信息性消息，如缓存结果、可选校准步骤未找到主帧，或自动选择。

FILE: Send value to parameters. If Transformation type is Generalised Hyperbolic Stretch, Histogram Transformation or Arcsinh, the value will be sent to SP. If transformation type is Linear Stretch the value will be sent to BP.
文件: 把数值送到参数。若变换类型为广义双曲拉伸、直方图变换或反双曲正弦，数值送到 SP；若为线性拉伸，数值送到 BP。

FILE:
Restrict the images to blink to the specified number of images that have the lowest noise estimates.

This option is necessary if you have hundreds of images in order to reduce processing time and memory requirements.
文件:
把参与闪烁对比的图像限制为噪声估计最低的指定数量。

有数百幅图像时，此选项对减少处理时间与内存占用是必要的。

FILE: Rename all open views with identifiers matching the provided regex. By default, it will rename standard WBPP and FBPP output to the filter name. All captured groups are joined with underscores to form the new identifier.
文件: 重命名标识符与所给正则表达式匹配的所有已打开视图。默认把 WBPP 与 FBPP 的标准输出重命名为滤镜名，所有捕获组以下划线连接构成新标识符。

FILE:
This suffix will be appended to each file name when saving the astrometric solution to a new XISF file.

If this suffix is empty and no output directory has been specified, original XISF input files will be overwritten.
文件:
把天文解算结果保存为新的 XISF 文件时，此后缀会追加到每个文件名后。

后缀为空且未指定输出目录时，将覆盖原始 XISF 输入文件。

FILE:
Enable this option to apply dark frame optimization during calibration of flat and light frames.

The dark frame optimization routine computes dark scaling factors to minimize the noise induced by dark subtraction.
文件:
启用此项可在平场与亮场校准期间应用暗场优化。

暗场优化例程计算暗场缩放系数，使减暗场引入的噪声最小。

FILE:
Search radius used to match the reference and target stars. Larger values find more photometric stars but at the risk of matching the wrong star.

You only need to modify this parameter if your images contain distortions.
文件:
用于匹配参考星与目标星的搜索半径。较大值能找到更多测光星点，但有误匹配风险。

仅当图像存在畸变时才需要修改此参数。

FILE:
Creates a new mask image.

The dialog remains open so that a number of mask images can be created. It is often useful to generate masks with a small, medium and large number of stars. Try each mask and compare the results.
文件:
新建蒙版图像。

对话框保持打开，可连续创建多幅蒙版图像。生成星点数少、中、多的蒙版并逐一试用、比较结果通常很有帮助。

FILE:
When selected or deselected, reset all dialogs to have a maximum height of either 768 or 1080 pixels.

If dialogs that display images are resized by the user, the new size will be remembered until this checkbox is modified.
文件:
选中或取消选中时，把所有对话框的最大高度重置为 768 或 1080 像素。

用户调整过显示图像的对话框大小后，新尺寸会一直记住，直到此复选框被改动。

FILE:
The bookmarked image number.

Use the Set bookmark button to set the bookmarked image. As you then navigate through the images, use the bookmark icon button to blink between the current image and the bookmarked image.
文件:
加书签的图像编号。

用 设置书签 按钮设定书签图像；之后浏览图像时，用书签图标按钮在当前图像与书签图像之间闪烁对比。

FILE:
Select the mode for the preview. A small preview will be processed fast while a large preview will show more details but takes more time to be processed.

Hint: Increase the resolution of the preview while sharpening!
文件:
选择预览模式。小预览处理快，大预览显示更多细节但耗时更长。

提示：锐化时请提高预览分辨率！

FILE: This controls the size of the area around the readout point over which the relevant readout statistic is calculated. The area is indicated by the square in the readout reticle. Set this parameter to zero to see readout at a point.
文件: 控制计算读数统计时读数点周围区域的大小，该区域由读数标线中的方框表示。设为零则读取单点的数值。

FILE:
Enable this option to generate a signing keys file for the local signing identity.

The local signing identity is linked to your software license, and can only be used on machines where you have valid PixInsight license files.
文件:
启用此项可为本地签名身份生成签名密钥文件。

本地签名身份与软件许可绑定，只能在持有有效 PixInsight 许可文件的机器上使用。

FILE: Check here to use the inverse form of the transformation equations. Warning: Some transformations can involve clipping and are not truly invertible. Eg, this may apply for L*, Sat and Col options and for Linear Stretch types.
文件: 勾选可使用变换方程的逆形式。警告：某些变换涉及裁切，并非真正可逆，例如 L*、Sat、Col 选项以及线性拉伸类型。

FILE: Flips SCNR into a magenta cleaner - the algebraic equivalent of invert → SCNR green → invert, but the preview stays a normal, non-inverted image. With this enabled, raising the SCNR slider removes magenta instead of green.
文件: 把 SCNR 变为洋红清除器——代数上等价于反转 → SCNR 绿 → 反转，但预览仍保持正常未反转图像。启用后提高 SCNR 滑块去除的是洋红而非绿色。

FILE:
Apply scale and gradient corrections to the target view.

Use the 'Reference' checkbox to blink between the reference image and the corrected target.

Use this checkbox to blink between the uncorrected and corrected target.
文件:
对目标视图应用比例与梯度校正。

用「参考」复选框在参考图像与校正后目标之间闪烁对比。

用此复选框在未校正与校正后目标之间闪烁对比。

FILE: Sets the intensity value represented at the right hand edge of the histogram graph. The left hand edge is always at 0. If you cannot see the histogram try increasing this parameter - the histogram is probably out of view to the right.
文件: 设置直方图右边缘所表示的强度值，左边缘始终为 0。若看不到直方图，可尝试增大此参数——直方图可能偏到右侧视野之外。

FILE:
When checked, generates a new image with cross marks at the positions of the detected stars in the original image.

These control images are useful to compare the results of different values of the detection sensitivity parameter.
文件:
勾选后生成新图像，在原图中检测到的星点位置绘制十字标记。

这些控制图像有助于比较不同检测灵敏度参数值的结果。

FILE: Generate one image window per evaluated field, showing the displacement at each lattice cell as an arrow over the deformed lattice, with a legend above the map stating the peak displacement, the arrow magnification and the white point.
文件: 为每个求值场生成一个图像窗口，把每个网格单元处的位移画为变形网格上的箭头，图上方图例标明峰值位移、箭头放大倍数与白点。

FILE:
(Number of processed images) / (Total number of target images).

Use this to check that you have loaded all of your target images.

If some, but not all, images have been processed, use Continue run to process the rest.
文件:
（已处理图像数）/（目标图像总数）。

用于确认已载入全部目标图像。

若只处理了部分图像，请用 继续运行 处理其余部分。

FILE:
Calculates default values for most of the Sample Generation parameters.

These are calculated from the headers:

  • 'XPIXSZ' (Pixel size, including binning, in microns)
  • 'FOCALLEN' (Focal length in mm).
文件:
为大多数「采样生成」参数计算默认值。

依据以下头信息：

  • XPIXSZ（含合并的像素尺寸，微米）
  • FOCALLEN（焦距，毫米）。

FILE: The format of the observation report. The AAVSO Extended File Format reports one observation per image, with the magnitude of the check star and the airmass. Your observer code and the observation type are set in the Preferences dialog.
文件: 观测报告的格式。AAVSO 扩展文件格式为每幅图像一条观测记录，含校验星星等与大气质量。观测者代码与观测类型在「偏好设置」对话框中设定。

FILE: Clip pixels that are much brighter or darker than all of their neighbors (hot and cold pixels, cosmic ray impacts) before isolating the structures of the images. Defects fixed on the sensor would otherwise correlate at zero displacement.
文件: 在分离图像结构之前，剔除比所有相邻像素都明显更亮或更暗的像素（热/冷像素、宇宙线击中）。否则固定在传感器上的缺陷会在零位移处产生相关。

FILE: Star-core / bright-pixel protection during highlight recovery. 0 = off; each step lowers the protected threshold by 0.01 (1 = 0.99, 10 = 0.90, 50 = 0.50), holding the brightest pixels at their original value as Highlights is pulled down.
文件: 高光恢复期间的星点核心/亮像素保护。0 = 关闭；每增加一步把受保护阈值降低 0.01（1 = 0.99，10 = 0.90，50 = 0.50），在压低高光时把最亮像素保持为原值。

FILE:
Display sample rejection circles and the horizontal / vertical graph lines.

The graph displays the gradient along either the horizontal or vertical line.

Double-click on the image to position the horizontal and vertical lines.
文件:
显示采样剔除圆圈与水平/垂直图形线。

图形显示沿水平线或垂直线的梯度。

在图像上双击可定位水平与垂直线。

FILE:
Display either the image or graph.

The line indicates the join position. The graph displays the gradient along this line.

The circles indicate areas where gradient samples were rejected due to their proximity to a bright star.
文件:
显示图像或图形。

线条表示拼接位置，图形显示沿该线的梯度。

圆圈表示因靠近亮星而被剔除的梯度采样区域。

FILE:
If selected, a gradient correction is applied to the rest of the target image (i.e. outside the overlap region).

If not selected, only the average relative offset is applied.

In most situations, this option should be selected.
文件:
选中时对目标图像的其余部分（即重叠区域之外）应用梯度校正。

未选中时只应用平均相对偏移。

多数情况下应选中此项。

FILE: Select this option to correct all the columns or rows in the images, or unckeck it to correct only specific columns or rows. If you disable this option, you'll need to specify a defect list file in the Partial defects file field.
文件: 选择此项可校正图像中所有列或行；取消勾选则只校正指定的列或行。禁用此项时，需在局部缺陷文件栏指定缺陷列表文件。

FILE:
Generates an image with the predicted star positions (green cross marks) and arrows (red lines) pointing to the actual measured positions on the image.

These control images can be used to analyze the errors of the computed solutions.
文件:
生成带预测星点位置（绿色十字）和指向实际测量位置箭头（红线）的图像。

这些控制图像可用于分析所计算解算结果的误差。

FILE:
When this option is enabled, the WBPP GUI switches to a compact layout.

This option may be useful on small resolution screen in order to selectively expand the controls while reserving the maximum space possible to the groups tables.
文件:
启用此选项时，WBPP 界面切换为紧凑布局。

在低分辨率屏幕上很有用，可选择性展开控件，同时把尽可能多的空间留给分组表格。

FILE: Manually declares the target as linear. Used only when Autodetect Linearity is off. For linear data the auto-mask is computed on an internally auto-stretched copy; the correction is still applied to the original linear pixels.
文件: 手动把目标声明为线性，仅在关闭「自动检测线性」时使用。对线性数据，自动蒙版在内部自动拉伸的副本上计算，校正仍应用到原始线性像素。

FILE:
Select this option to generate the 3D rendition in Scalable Vector Graphics format (SVG). Otherwise the rendition will be generated as a new image window.

* Warning * SVG files can be very large even for relatively small images.
文件:
选择此项以 SVG（可缩放矢量图形）格式生成三维渲染，否则渲染作为新图像窗口生成。

* 警告 * 即使图像较小，SVG 文件也可能非常大。

FILE:
When this option is selected, frame groups will be saved before closing the dialog. They will be reloaded on next launch.

Select this option if you need to close WBPP and later relaunch the script without losing the loaded file groups.
文件:
选择此项时，关闭对话框前会保存帧分组，下次启动时重新载入。

若需关闭 WBPP 之后再次启动脚本而不丢失已载入的文件分组，请选择此项。

FILE: Removes a green color cast using SCNR (average neutral): green is pulled toward the average of red and blue. 0 = off, 1 = full removal. Applies to color images only. Enable 'Inverse - Magenta Removal' below to clean magenta instead of green.
文件: 用 SCNR（平均中性）去除绿色偏色：把绿通道拉向红蓝平均值。0 = 关闭，1 = 完全去除，仅对彩色图像生效。启用下方「反转 - 洋红去除」可改为清除洋红。

FILE:
Configuration of the fuzzy function.

This parameter is used to control the intensity of the fuzzy function globaly. Use beta > 1 to lower respectively beta \< 1 to liftlower the fuzzy function. Values between 1.1 and 1.5 are typical.
文件:
模糊函数的配置。

此参数用于整体控制模糊函数强度：beta > 1 降低、beta < 1 抬升模糊函数。典型值在 1.1 到 1.5 之间。

FILE:
Exclude or re-include the selected frame.

By excluding a frame, we ensure that it is never selected as either the single best reference frame or as part of the frames that will be integrated to generate the normalization reference image.
文件:
剔除或重新纳入所选帧。

剔除某帧可确保它既不会被选为唯一最佳参考帧，也不会进入用于生成归一化参考图像的叠加帧集合。

FILE: Send histogram selection readout to parameters. If Transformation type is Generalised Hyperbolic Stretch, Histogram Transformation or Arcsinh, the value will be sent to SP. If transformation type is Linear Stretch the value will be sent to BP.
文件: 把直方图选区读数送到参数。若变换类型为广义双曲拉伸、直方图变换或反双曲正弦，数值送到 SP；若为线性拉伸，数值送到 BP。

FILE: When checked, the selected region uses a plain solid-white mask - full effect everywhere inside the ellipse, softened only by Sel. feather. Uncheck to shape the region with the luminosity mask set above (Type / Depth / Mode). Per-region.
文件: 勾选后，所选区域使用纯白实心蒙版——椭圆内部处处完全生效，仅靠「选择羽化」柔化。取消勾选则用上方设定的亮度蒙版（类型/深度/模式）塑造区域。按区域分别生效。

FILE: The specified background reference area defines the contrast of the line pattern in the darker areas of the image. The easiest way to set these values is to create a preview and take note of its coordinates with Preview > Modify Preview.
文件: 指定的背景参考区域决定图像较暗区域中条纹图案的对比度。最简单的设定方法是创建一个预览，并用「预览 > 修改预览」记下其坐标。

FILE:
Resets drizzle integration parameters for the selected group.

The default drizzle scale is 1x.
The default drop shrink is 0.9 for grayscale images, 1.0 for CFA images.
The default kernel function is square.
文件:
重置所选分组的 Drizzle 叠加参数。

默认 Drizzle 缩放为 1x。
默认 drop shrink：灰度图像 0.9，CFA 图像 1.0。
默认核函数为 方形。

FILE: Specify the maximim size for the preview readout size slider. The readout area is specified as a square around the specified readout point. The readout area slider sets the size of the sides of this square area measured in pixels of the target image.
文件: 指定预览读数尺寸滑块的最大值。读数区域是以指定读数点为中心的正方形，读数区域滑块设定该方形边长（以目标图像像素计）。

FILE: Restricts the correction to magenta pixels using an internally computed, edge-softened mask derived from the green deficit. When disabled, the correction is applied at full strength everywhere. An explicitly selected mask is always applied in addition.
文件: 用由绿色亏量 internally 计算、边缘柔化的蒙版把校正限制在洋红像素上。禁用时校正以全强度作用于整幅图像；显式选择的蒙版始终会额外叠加应用。

FILE:
Continue the last run. Normalize the unprocessed target images (The Target Images table displays gray circles for unprocessed images).

Use this option after an Abort, File I/O error, PixInsight crash, or after adding an extra set of images.
文件:
继续上次运行，归一化尚未处理的目标图像（目标图像表中未处理图像显示灰色圆圈）。

在中止、文件 I/O 错误、PixInsight 崩溃，或追加一组图像之后使用此选项。

FILE: Sets the maximum radius (in pixels) over which data to repair 'blown' highlights in the H and Sv separations will be collected. Smaller values may be used if the script decides it has enough good data or it runs out of data as the search radius expands.
文件: 设定为修复 H 与 Sv 分离图中「过曝」高光而采集数据的最大半径（像素）。若脚本判定已有足够好数据，或搜索半径扩大后数据用尽，可能采用更小的值。

FILE: Sets the amount (standard deviation, in pixels) of a Gaussian convolution to apply to the mask, to soften hard brush edges. Check "Preview blur" below to see the effect as you adjust this; either way, nothing is applied to the mask until Commit is clicked.
文件: 设定对蒙版应用的高斯卷积量（标准差，像素），用于柔化硬笔刷边缘。勾选下方「预览模糊」可在调整时查看效果；无论哪种方式，点击「提交」前都不会对蒙版实际应用更改。

FILE:
This value is added to the radius for all stars.

Use this control to set the radius for faint stars (use 'Growth rate' for brighter stars).

Should normally be set to a value equal to or greater than the photometry 'Radius add' value + 3.
文件:
此值会加到所有星点的半径上。

用此控件设定暗星的半径（较亮星点请用「增长率」）。

通常应设为不小于测光「半径增量」值 + 3。

FILE: Optional output file where the measured deviations of all matched stars are written in CSV format: image coordinates, celestial coordinates from the solution and from the catalog, G magnitude, and deviations in pixels and arcseconds. Leave empty to disable.
文件: 可选输出文件，以 CSV 格式写出所有匹配星点的测量偏差：图像坐标、由解算与星表给出的天球坐标、G 星等，以及以像素和角秒计的偏差。留空则禁用。

FILE:
The script will solve the image in the active image window.

If the image has no valid astrometric solution, it receives the linear solution computed by the blind solver. Otherwise the existing solution is preserved and compared with the blind solution.
文件:
脚本将解算活动图像窗口中的图像。

若图像没有有效天文解算，则赋予盲解算得到的线性解；否则保留现有解并与盲解结果比较。

FILE:
To save to the relative subdirectory 'dirName', use './dirName'. If the folder does not exist, it will be created.

To use the input file's directory, use './', or leave this field blank.

To specify a specific directory, use the directory browser.
文件:
要保存到相对子目录 dirName，请填 ./dirName，文件夹不存在时会创建。

要使用输入文件所在目录，请填 ./ 或留空。

要指定具体目录，请使用目录浏览器。

FILE:
Configuration of the image segmentation.

With this option selected, the fuzzy parameters of bordering segments with similar characteristics will be harmonized. If this option is not selected, individual fuzzy parameters will be applied to each segment.
文件:
图像分割的配置。

选择此项时，特征相近的相邻分块会协调其模糊参数；未选择时，每个分块分别应用各自的模糊参数。

FILE: Write a report of the analysis: an HTML page, a Markdown document or a PDF document, according to the file type selected. The report includes the run information, the problems found, the operations of each group, the excluded frames and the abnormal results.
文件: 写出分析报告：按所选文件类型生成 HTML 页面、Markdown 文档或 PDF 文档。报告包含运行信息、发现的问题、各组操作、被剔除帧及异常结果。

FILE:
Largest dimension of a map image, in pixels.

A distortion field is a smooth quantity sampled on a coarse lattice, so nothing in it requires one map pixel per image pixel. The arrows and the legend are drawn to scale, so a map looks the same at any size.
文件:
映射图像的最大尺寸（像素）。

畸变场是在粗网格上采样的平滑量，无需一个映射像素对应一个图像像素。箭头与图例按比例绘制，因此任何尺寸下外观一致。

FILE: Increase or decrease the amount of the luminance when it will be combined with your image. This controls the amount of the brilliance to be added. If you increased the contrast you should try to decrease the amount to avoid to dim the darker regions the image.
文件: 增减与图像合并时计入的亮度量，即控制加入的光辉量。若已提高对比度，建议相应减小此量，避免把图像较暗区域压暗。

FILE: Hue range in degrees used when you press any of the above color preset buttons. By default, 60-degree range is used, but can be changed to wider or lower range. Obviously, start and end hue values can be fine-tuned manually with the help of appropriate controls
文件: 按下上方任一色彩预设按钮时所用的色相范围（度）。默认 60 度，可改为更宽或更窄。显然，起止色相值也可用相应控件手动微调

FILE:
Opening a tool box closes the others, so the panel stays short and you do not have to scroll past several open sections to reach an option. The box you open is also scrolled to the top of the panel.

Turn it off to keep as many boxes open at once as you like.
文件:
打开一个工具箱会关闭其他工具箱，使面板保持较短，不必滚过多个展开区块才能找到选项。打开的箱体还会滚动到面板顶部。

关闭此项可同时保持任意多个箱体展开。

FILE: When the metadata of an image state no filter, or a name that is not an alias of any filter, such as the number of a position of a filter wheel, take its filter from its file name with these patterns. A filter assigned to an image in the list of images always wins.
文件: 当图像元数据未给出滤镜，或给出不是任何滤镜别名的名称（如滤镜轮位置编号）时，按这些模式从文件名取滤镜。图像列表中为图像显式指定的滤镜始终优先。

FILE:
Display either reference or target image.

If 'Correct target (scale and gradient)' is checked, the reference check box can be used to blink between the reference image and the corrected target image. Decrease 'Gradient smoothness' until a good match is found.
文件:
显示参考图像或目标图像。

若勾选「校正目标（比例与梯度）」，可用参考复选框在参考图像与校正后目标图像之间闪烁对比。减小「梯度平滑度」直到获得良好匹配。

FILE: Append "_starless" and "_stars" to output file names. With suffixes disabled, starless outputs keep the input file names, so an output directory different from the input directory is required, and star images cannot be generated (both outputs would share one name).
文件: 在输出文件名后追加 _starless 与 _stars。禁用后缀时，无星输出沿用输入文件名，因此必须使用不同于输入目录的输出目录，且无法生成星点图像（两者会共用同一名称）。

FILE: Histogram link Clicking this button will transfer the histogram readout value to this parameter. Shift-click will link the histogram readout value to this parameter, until released by clicking this button. Changing transformation type will also release the link.
文件: 直方图联动 点击此按钮把直方图读数传给该参数。Shift+点击会把直方图读数持续联动到该参数，直到再次点击此按钮解除；更改变换类型也会解除联动。

FILE:
When this option is enabled, the compiler will abort compilation after emitting the first warning message.

By default, this option is disabled and the compiler continues working after showing warning messages. Enabling this option can be useful for debugging purposes.
文件:
启用此选项时，编译器在发出第一条警告消息后即中止编译。

默认情况下此选项禁用，编译器显示警告后继续工作。启用此项有助于调试。

FILE:
If this option is enabled, the PIDoc compiler will apply syntax highlighting to source code blocks specified with \code commands. You can also control syntax highlighting from PIDoc source code using \pragma command parameters.

This option is enabled by default.
文件:
启用此选项时，PIDoc 编译器会对用 \code 命令指定的源码块应用语法高亮。也可在 PIDoc 源码中用 \pragma 命令参数控制语法高亮。

此选项默认启用。

FILE: Clip pixels that are much brighter or darker than all of their neighbors (hot and cold pixels, cosmic ray impacts) before detecting features. Defects fixed on the sensor would otherwise be the strongest features of uncalibrated frames, and would match at zero displacement.
文件: 在检测特征之前，剔除比所有相邻像素都明显更亮或更暗的像素（热/冷像素、宇宙线击中）。否则固定在传感器上的缺陷会成为未校准帧中最强的特征，并在零位移处匹配。

FILE:
Color (chroma) noise reduction strength - smooths color speckle and blotches while keeping luminance detail. 0 = off.

The color is smoothed along the image's own brightness structure, so star and nebula colors stay inside their edges instead of bleeding out or fading.
文件:
色彩（色度）降噪强度——平滑彩色斑点与色块，同时保留亮度细节。0 = 关闭。

颜色沿图像自身的亮度结构平滑，因此星点与星云的颜色保持在其边缘之内，不会外溢或褪色。

FILE: When checked, the astrometric solution will use exclusively stars for which high-quality positions and proper motions are available. This option is only used with local XPSD server catalogs (currently Gaia DR2, EDR3 and DR3). This option is always ignored for online catalogs.
文件: 勾选后，天文解算只使用具有高质量位置与自行的恒星。此选项仅用于本地 XPSD 服务器星表（目前为 Gaia DR2、EDR3 与 DR3），对在线星表始终忽略。

FILE:
Auto selects the candidate that best matches the target: the one with the smallest product of its distance to the target, its difference in magnitude and its difference in color.

Manual: click the crosshair button, and then the star on the reference image.
文件:
自动选择最匹配目标的候选：与目标距离、星等差、色差的乘积最小者。

手动：点击十字准星按钮，然后点击参考图像上的星点。

FILE: When checked, the astrometric solution will use exclusively stars for which high-quality positions and proper motions are available. This option is only used with local XPSD server catalogs (currently Gaia DR2, EDR3, and DR3). This option is always ignored for online catalogs.
文件: 勾选后，天文解算只使用具有高质量位置与自行的恒星。此选项仅用于本地 XPSD 服务器星表（目前为 Gaia DR2、EDR3 与 DR3），对在线星表始终忽略。

FILE: Length of the bias vectors in image pixels per pixel of deviation. For example, with a scale of 100 a deviation of 0.1 px is drawn as a 10 px arrow. Zero selects an automatic scale where the largest bias vector spans 40% of a cell. The scale in use is written on the map legend.
文件: 偏差矢量长度，单位为图像像素/每像素偏差。例如比例为 100 时，0.1 px 的偏差画成 10 px 箭头。设为零则自动选比例，使最大偏差矢量跨越单元格的 40%。所用比例会写在图例中。

FILE:
Perform an in-place contrast enhancement.

With this option selected, the script will replace the target image by the modified image. If this option is not selected, the modified image will be provided as a newly created image window and the target image won't be affected.
文件:
执行就地对比度增强。

选择此项时，脚本用修改后的图像替换目标图像；未选择时，修改后的图像作为新图像窗口提供，目标图像不受影响。

FILE:
Images with no filepath will be skipped with Filepath or Filename mode selected.

PixInsight 1.9.3 brings breaking changes to WBPP/FBPP outputs, requiring the use of one of the file modes instead of identifier mode to access data previously available in the identifier.
文件:
选择 Filepath 或 Filename 模式时，没有文件路径的图像会被跳过。

PixInsight 1.9.3 对 WBPP/FBPP 输出引入破坏性变更，需使用文件模式之一，而不能再用标识符模式读取此前存于标识符中的数据。

FILE:
Telescope focal length in mm.

Don't rely on the FITS header focal length because PixInsight's Registration copies the focal length of the registration reference image to all the registered files' FITS header. Use the focal length from the unprocessed raw FITS file instead.
文件:
望远镜焦距，单位为毫米。

不要依赖 FITS 头中的焦距，因为 PixInsight 的对齐会把参考图像的焦距复制到所有已对齐文件的 FITS 头。请改用未处理原始 FITS 文件中的焦距。

FILE: Find the catalog limit magnitude automatically, as ImageSolver does: the local Gaia database is queried without retrieving sources until the number of catalog stars is approximately 1.5 times the number of detected stars. This narrows the catalog search to the depth of the image.
文件: 像 ImageSolver 那样自动查找星表极限星等：查询本地 Gaia 数据库但不取回源，直到星表星数约为检测星数的 1.5 倍，从而把星表搜索收窄到图像深度。

FILE: Refine the transformation of each image at full resolution: the displacements of patches centered on the matched features are measured by phase correlation with subpixel accuracy, and the transformation is fitted to them with rejection of outliers. Required for subpixel accuracy.
文件: 以全分辨率精化每幅图像的变换：用相位相关以亚像素精度测量以匹配特征为中心的图块位移，并带离群剔除地拟合变换。要达到亚像素精度必须启用。

FILE: If checked the output image will always be an RGB image. If unchecked and a new image is being created, the output image will reflect the PixelMath newImageColorSpace parameter. If unchecked and the target image is being updated the target image colour space will remain unchanged.
文件: 勾选则输出图像始终为 RGB 图像。未勾选且新建图像时，输出图像遵循 PixelMath 的 newImageColorSpace 参数；未勾选且更新目标图像时，目标图像色彩空间保持不变。

FILE: This parameter sets the default increment to zOrder. When creating a new control the zOrder will initially be set to the highest currently used zOrder value plus this step. We recommend setting this value to 100 which makes it easy to create new controls in between existing controls.
文件: 此参数设定 zOrder 的默认增量。新建控件时，其 zOrder 初始设为当前已用最大 zOrder 值加此步长。建议设为 100，便于在已有控件之间插入新控件。

FILE: Global toggle: applies the mask outside the whole selection (the union of every region) instead of inside - everything beyond the shapes is affected, the inside is left untouched. Works with both the luminosity mask and White mask. Inverted regions show cyan ants.
文件: 全局开关：把蒙版应用于整个选区（所有区域的并集）之外而非之内——形状之外的全部受影响，内部不变。对亮度蒙版与白色蒙版均有效，反转区域显示青色蚂蚁线。

FILE:
Displays the photometry graph. For each star, the flux measured in the reference image is plotted against the flux measured in the target image. A best fit line is drawn through these points. The gradient provides the brightness scale factor.

Provides all the photometry controls.
文件:
显示测光图。对每颗星，把参考图像中测得的通量与目标图像中测得的通量作图，并画一条最佳拟合直线；其梯度给出亮度缩放系数。

提供全部测光控件。

FILE: Before submitting your benchmark, you can fill in the following optional fields. Although these items are not required, they are an added value to your benchmark data that can make them more useful to the community of PixInsight users. The following fields are presented by order of relevance.
文件:
提交基准测试之前，可填写以下可选字段。
这些项目虽非必填，但能为基准测试数据增色，使其对 PixInsight 用户社区更有价值。
以下字段按相关程度排列。

FILE:
Swap disks
If possible, write the brand and model of the hard disk(s) where PixInsight stores swap files. Unless you have customized swap file storage via preferences, this is the disk where system temporary files are being stored, which typically is the machine's main system disk.
文件:
交换磁盘
如有可能，请填写 PixInsight 存放交换文件的硬盘品牌与型号。除非通过偏好设置自定义了交换文件位置，否则该盘即存放系统临时文件的磁盘，通常是机器的主系统盘。

FILE: Where to take the luminance coefficients from for a colour stretch. Default: will use equal weights for each channel. Image: will take the luminance coefficients from the target image rgb working space. Manual: will allow you to specify the coefficients to use below.
文件: 彩色拉伸的亮度系数来源。默认：各通道等权。图像：取自目标图像的 RGB 工作空间。手动：可在下方指定系数。

FILE:
When this option is enabled, the PIDoc compiler will render in SVG format all LaTeX equations specified with \equation and \im commands. Note that you can also control equation rendering from PIDoc source code using \pragma command parameters.

This option is enabled by default.
文件:
启用此选项时，PIDoc 编译器会把用 \equation 与 \im 命令指定的所有 LaTeX 公式渲染为 SVG 格式。也可在 PIDoc 源码中用 \pragma 命令参数控制公式渲染。

此选项默认启用。

FILE:
A directory where the comparison and check stars used for each target are recorded, with the parameters that selected them, in a text file named after the target. When a target with a record is analyzed again, its selection is recovered automatically.

Leave it empty to keep no records.
文件:
一个目录，按目标命名以文本文件记录每个目标所用的比较星与校验星，以及选出它们的参数。再次分析有记录的目标时，会自动恢复其选择。

留空则不保存记录。

FILE: The band of each image comes from its filter: from these aliases, or else from the names that state their photometric system, such as V, Rc, g' or Johnson B, which are recognized without aliases. It selects the catalog magnitudes the stars are given, and the band of the image in the table of images.
文件:
每幅图像的波段由其滤镜决定：来自这些别名，或来自标明测光系统的名称（如 V、Rc、g'、Johnson B，这些无需别名即可识别）。
它决定赋予星点的星表星等，以及图像表中该图像的波段。

FILE:
Leave out of the ensemble every star that the AAVSO International Variable Star Index (VSX) lists as a variable or suspected variable star. The index is queried online through VizieR when the data are loaded.

The known variable stars of the field are marked in violet on the reference image.
文件:
把 AAVSO 变星索引（VSX）列为变星或疑似变星的恒星全部排除出集合。载入数据时通过 VizieR 在线查询该索引。

视场中已知变星在参考图像上以紫色标出。

FILE:
This section determines which samples are used to create the relative gradient model that will be used to correct the target image.

The aim is to reject samples that cover any light from bright stars. This includes diffraction spikes, filter halos and the scattered light around bright stars.
文件:
本节决定用哪些采样来建立用于校正目标图像的相对梯度模型。

目标是剔除覆盖亮星任何光线的采样，包括衍射星芒、滤镜光晕以及亮星周围的散射光。

FILE:
Show the image with an automatic screen stretch, computed from the median and the dispersion of each channel, as the AutoStretch function of the ScreenTransferFunction process. The pixel data are not modified.

Preprocessed images are linear: without a stretch, most of them look almost black.
文件:
以自动屏幕拉伸显示图像，按各通道的中值与散布计算，类似 ScreenTransferFunction 进程的 AutoStretch 功能，不修改像素数据。

预处理图像是线性的：不拉伸时多数看起来几乎全黑。

FILE:
Write the measured deviations of all matched stars to a CSV file in the output directory, named after the image (id-residuals.csv).

Unlike the output CSV file, a new file is written for each image, which is useful to generate analysis data for many images in non-interactive executions.
文件:
把所有匹配星点的测量偏差写入输出目录中以图像命名的 CSV 文件（id-residuals.csv）。

与输出 CSV 不同，每幅图像写一个新文件，便于在非交互式执行中为多幅图像生成分析数据。

FILE:
A weight is abnormal when it is greater than the upper quartile of the weights of its group divided by this parameter. The default value of 0.1 identifies weights greater than ten times the upper quartile.

The lower this parameter, the more permissive the protection will be with high weights.
文件:
当某权重大于其所属组权重上四分位数除以此参数时，判为异常。默认值 0.1 表示大于上四分位数十倍的权重会被识别。

此参数越小，对高权重的保护越宽松。

FILE: Define the naming pattern. Use curly braces with index values, eg. {0} or {1} to select regex groups, and dollar signs, eg $FILTER$ to select FITS Header values. Additionally, add formatting flags before the closing symbol to format the inner text. eg. {0-u}, $FILTER-p$ See docs for more details.
文件: 定义命名模式。用带索引值的花括号（如 {0}、{1}）选择正则分组，用美元符号（如 $FILTER$）选择 FITS 头值；还可在结束符前加格式标志来格式化内部文本，如 {0-u}、$FILTER-p$。详见文档。

FILE:
If enabled, the script will write a text file with all catalog objects inside the image, layer by layer, to the specified file.

A file must be specified when this option is enabled. In non-interactive executions, this option is ignored if no file has been specified, with a warning on the console.
文件:
启用时，脚本会把图像内所有星表天体按图层逐一写入指定文本文件。

启用此选项时必须指定文件；非交互式执行中若未指定文件则忽略此选项并在控制台给出警告。

FILE: Specifies a mask that will modify the extent to which the transformation is applied to the image. Note that if a mask is applied it is not practical to generate a predicted histogram in real time. To see the transformed histogram you will need to generate it using the refresh button below he histogram.
文件: 指定一个蒙版，用于调整变换作用于图像的程度。注意：应用蒙版后无法实时生成预测直方图；要查看变换后的直方图，需用直方图下方的刷新按钮生成。

FILE:
Keeps small stars sharp and bright while the luminance noise reduction smooths the grain around them. Stars are found as points that stand well clear of the image's own noise, so noise itself is never protected.

New - untick to compare with the previous behaviour. Only active when Luminance > 0.
文件:
在亮度降噪平滑颗粒的同时保持小星点锐利明亮。星点被识别为明显高于图像自身噪声的点，因此噪声本身永远不会受到保护。

新增功能——取消勾选可与旧行为对比。仅当亮度 > 0 时生效。

FILE: Opacity of the selected region (0 = no effect, 1 = full). Each region has its own strength, so you can make some regions stronger than others. With no region selected it sets the strength for the next region you draw. (The Luminosity Masks Strength above still scales everything as a master.)
文件: 所选区域的不透明度（0 = 无效果，1 = 完全）。每个区域有各自的强度，可让部分区域强于其他区域；未选区域时为下一个绘制的区域设定强度。（上方亮度蒙版的强度仍作为总控缩放一切。）

FILE:
This section determines which samples are used to create the relative gradient model that will be used to correct the rest of the target image.

The aim is to reject samples that cover any light from bright stars. This includes diffraction spikes, filter halos and the scattered light around bright stars.
文件:
本节决定用哪些采样来建立用于校正目标图像其余部分的相对梯度模型。

目标是剔除覆盖亮星任何光线的采样，包括衍射星芒、滤镜光晕以及亮星周围的散射光。

FILE:
Format of the map and graph files.

PNG is a raster image, written at the selected size. SVG is a vector file: the arrows, the lattice and the axes are drawn as vector elements, so it can be enlarged without loss and edited in a drawing program. Maps and graphs are drawn identically in both.
文件:
映射与图形文件的格式。

PNG 为栅格图像，按所选尺寸写出。SVG 为矢量文件：箭头、网格与坐标轴以矢量元素绘制，可无损放大并在绘图程序中编辑。两种格式下映射与图形绘制一致。

FILE: This parameter specifies what to do when undertaking a colour stretch if any channels relating to a specific pixel stretch to a value greater than 1. Clip: will simply clip all channels greater than 1 for that pixel back to 1. Rescale: will scale all three channels for that pixel down by the ratio 1/max(R,G,B).
文件: 此参数指定彩色拉伸时，若某像素相关通道拉伸后超过 1 该如何处理。Clip：把该像素所有大于 1 的通道直接裁回 1。Rescale：按 1/max(R,G,B) 把该像素三个通道一并缩小。

FILE:
Configuration of the fuzzy function.

This parameter is used to control the intensity of the fuzzy function localy. With this option selected, an individual beta will be calculated for each segment. If this option is not selected, a constant value for beta can be chosen, which will be applied to all segments.
文件:
模糊函数的配置。

此参数用于局部控制模糊函数强度。选择此项时，会为每个分块单独计算 beta；未选择时，可指定一个固定 beta 应用于所有分块。

FILE: A valid view id must use only numbers, upper or lower case letters or an underscore. It also cannot start with a number. If no view id is entered or the view id is invalid, the new image will be created with the an id of 'PMUI'. To avoid duplicate ids a sequential number will be added to the view id if necessary.
文件: 有效的视图 id 只能使用数字、大小写字母或下划线，且不能以数字开头。若未输入 id 或 id 无效，新图像将以 PMUI 为 id 创建；为避免重复，必要时会追加序号。

FILE: A valid view id must use only numbers, upper or lower case letters or an underscore. It also cannot start with a number. If no view id is entered or the view id is invalid, the new image will be created with the an id of 'Stars'. To avoid duplicate ids a sequential number will be added to the view id if necessary.
文件: 有效的视图 id 只能使用数字、大小写字母或下划线，且不能以数字开头。若未输入 id 或 id 无效，新图像将以 Stars 为 id 创建；为避免重复，必要时会追加序号。

FILE:
When this option is enabled, the PIDoc compiler will create backup duplicates of all existing output files (e.g. XHTML documents and images). If this option is disabled, all existing files will be overwritten and their original contents will be permanently lost.

This option is disabled by default.
文件:
启用此选项时，PIDoc 编译器会为所有已有输出文件（如 XHTML 文档与图像）创建备份副本。禁用时所有已有文件会被覆盖，其原始内容将永久丢失。

此选项默认禁用。

FILE:
Selects the neutral point toward which the green channel is lifted:

Average Neutral — target = (R + B)/2. Balanced; the default.

Maximum Neutral — target = max(R, B). More aggressive.

Minimum Neutral — target = min(R, B). Gentler; preserves more genuine magenta.
文件:
选择绿通道抬升所趋向的中性点：

平均中性 — 目标 = (R + B)/2，均衡，默认。

最大中性 — 目标 = max(R, B)，更激进。

最小中性 — 目标 = min(R, B)，更温和，保留更多真实洋红。

FILE: A valid view id must use only numbers, upper or lower case letters or an underscore. It also cannot start with a number. If no view id is entered or the view id is invalid, the new image will be created with the an id of 'ghsImage'. To avoid duplicate ids a sequential number will be added to the view id if necessary.
文件: 有效的视图 id 只能使用数字、大小写字母或下划线，且不能以数字开头。若未输入 id 或 id 无效，新图像将以 ghsImage 为 id 创建；为避免重复，必要时会追加序号。

FILE:
Automatically determines if the join line is horizontal or vertical, based on the shape of the overlap.

For example, if the overlap area is taller than it's wide, it assumes a vertical join line.

If the overlap is very large, this assumption may be incorrect. You must then specify 'Horizontal' or 'Vertical'.
文件:
根据重叠区域形状自动判断拼接线是水平还是垂直。

例如重叠区域高于宽时，假定为垂直拼接线。

重叠非常大时该假定可能不正确，此时必须指定「水平」或「垂直」。

FILE: A valid view id must use only numbers, upper or lower case letters or an underscore. It also cannot start with a number. If no view id is entered or the view id is invalid, the new image will be created with the an id of 'ImageBlend'. To avoid duplicate ids a sequential number will be added to the view id if necessary.
文件: 有效的视图 id 只能使用数字、大小写字母或下划线，且不能以数字开头。若未输入 id 或 id 无效，新图像将以 ImageBlend 为 id 创建；为避免重复，必要时会追加序号。

FILE: A valid view id must use only numbers, upper or lower case letters or an underscore. It also cannot start with a number. If no view id is entered or the view id is invalid, the new image will be created with the an id of 'StarReduced'. To avoid duplicate ids a sequential number will be added to the view id if necessary.
文件: 有效的视图 id 只能使用数字、大小写字母或下划线，且不能以数字开头。若未输入 id 或 id 无效，新图像将以 StarReduced 为 id 创建；为避免重复，必要时会追加序号。

FILE:
Configuration of the fuzzy membership function.

The Sigmoid and Gaussian membership functions are not normalized, that means that the pixel values of the resulting image not fully utilize the range from zero to one. With this option selected a normalization will be imposed to achieve a stronger contrast enhancement.
文件:
模糊隶属函数的配置。

Sigmoid 与高斯隶属函数未经归一化，意味着结果图像的像素值不能充分利用 0 到 1 的范围。选择此项会施加归一化以获得更强的对比度增强。

FILE: Optional output file where all computed blind solutions are written in CSV format, one row per image: center coordinates, resolution, rotation, parity, field of view, verification data, and the differences with existing astrometric solutions. Failed images are included with the reason of the failure. Leave empty to disable.
文件: 可选输出文件，以 CSV 格式写出所有计算得到的盲解结果，每幅图像一行：中心坐标、分辨率、旋转、奇偶性、视场、验证数据，以及与现有天文解算的差异。失败图像也会包含并注明原因。留空则禁用。

FILE: Saturation stretch: apply stretch to the HSV saturation channel; pixel values are then adjusted to ensure Lightness is the same as in the original image. Note that when this option is selected the chart will show a histogram of saturation values within the image, not intensity values as graphed for all other options.
文件: 饱和度拉伸：对 HSV 饱和度通道应用拉伸，随后调整像素值以保证明度与原图一致。注意选择此项时，图表显示的是图像内饱和度值的直方图，而非其他选项所绘制的强度值。

FILE:
Save images that show the relative gradient.

If a gradient peak or trough corresponds to a bright star, increase the Star circle growth rate (Sample Generation section).

If a very bright saturated star does not have a rejection circle, use Manual Sample Rejection to add one.
文件:
保存显示相对梯度的图像。

若梯度峰或谷对应一颗亮星，请增大星点圆圈增长率（采样生成区）。

若极亮饱和星没有剔除圆圈，请用「手动采样剔除」添加一个。

FILE:
The cost function convergence threshold.

This threshold defines the absolute percentual increment variation in the gradient direction under which the state is considered converged to an optimum value.

Decrease this value to converge a more optimal solution, the lower the value the slower the convergence will be.
文件:
代价函数的收敛阈值。

此阈值定义梯度方向上绝对百分比增量变化低于多少时，认为状态已收敛到最优值。

减小此值可收敛到更优解，值越小收敛越慢。

FILE:
Add target files from a different telescope or camera.

These images must be registered to an image from the original telescope/camera. This is necessary rather than the other way around because PixInsight's Registration copies the focal length of the registration reference image to all the registered files' FITS header.
文件:
添加来自不同望远镜或相机的目标文件。

这些图像必须对齐到来自原望远镜/相机的某幅图像。必须如此而非反过来，因为 PixInsight 的对齐会把参考图像的焦距复制到所有已对齐文件的 FITS 头。

FILE:
The band the color index is referred to: the color index is the magnitude of the target in the other band minus its magnitude in this one, B-V with V as the reference band. The magnitude limits of the comparison stars apply to this band.

By default, the band of longer wavelength. A color index needs images in two bands.
文件:
色指数所指的波段：色指数为目标在另一波段的星等减去本波段星等，如以 V 为参考波段的 B-V。比较星的星等限值适用于此波段。

默认为波长较长的波段；色指数需要两个波段的图像。

FILE:
Lower bound of the set of background reference pixels, measured in sigma units from the the median of the background reference for each nominal channel. Background reference pixels with values less than or equal to this lower bound will be rejected for calculation of mean background levels.

The default value is -2.8 sigma.
文件:
背景参考像素集合的下界，以各标称通道背景参考中值的 sigma 为单位。小于或等于此下界的背景参考像素在计算平均背景电平时被剔除。

默认值为 -2.8 sigma。

FILE:
Upper bound of the set of background reference pixels, measured in sigma units from the the median of the background reference for each nominal channel. Background reference pixels with values greater than or equal to this upper bound will be rejected for calculation of mean background levels.

The default value is 2.0 sigma.
文件:
背景参考像素集合的上界，以各标称通道背景参考中值的 sigma 为单位。大于或等于此上界的背景参考像素在计算平均背景电平时被剔除。

默认值为 2.0 sigma。

FILE:
Minimum normalized weight required for integration.

Images with normalized weights below the value of this parameter will be excluded for integration. The default value is 0.05, which represents a 5% of the maximum weight in the integrated data set. To disable this automatic image exclusion feature, set this parameter to zero.
文件:
参与叠加所需的最小归一化权重。

归一化权重低于此值的图像将被排除。默认值 0.05，表示叠加数据集中最大权重的 5%。设为零可禁用此自动剔除功能。

FILE:
Exit NSG.

If Image Rejection (available after Run) is selected, display ImageIntegration after exiting NSG. ImageIntegration will be populated with all the target images that have been processed (Processed images are indicated in the Target Images table with a green sphere, or a yellow sphere if it completed with warnings).
文件:
退出 NSG。

若选中「图像剔除（运行后可用）」，退出 NSG 后显示 ImageIntegration，其中载入所有已处理的目标图像（目标图像表中已处理图像用绿色球标示，带警告完成的用黄色球）。

FILE: Refine the transformation of each image at full resolution: the displacements of a grid of tiles are measured with subpixel accuracy and the transformation is fitted to them, with rejection of outliers. Required for subpixel accuracy with binned working images, for affine and projective transformations, and for the distortion correction.
文件: 以全分辨率精化每幅图像的变换：以亚像素精度测量图块网格的位移，并带离群剔除地拟合变换。对合并工作图像、仿射与投影变换以及畸变校正，要达到亚像素精度必须启用。

FILE:
Adjust the 'Trim' controls until the image is eroded back to good data. The image must have a hard edge; the background level must transition from 100% to 0% at the image boundary. See the 'Quick Start Guide' for more details.

The preview is updated every time a trim control edit finishes. Use Undo / Redo to check the level of erosion.
文件:
调整「裁切」控件直到图像被侵蚀回良好数据。图像必须有硬边缘，背景电平必须在图像边界处由 100% 过渡到 0%，详见「快速入门指南」。

每次裁切控件编辑结束都会更新预览，可用撤销/重做检查侵蚀程度。

FILE:
Specifies the percentage of the brightest detected stars that will be used to create the star mask.

0% will produce a solid mask with no stars.
100% will produce a mask that includes all detected stars.

Small faint stars are usually free of artifacts, so normally only a small percentage of the detected stars need to be used.
文件:
指定用于生成星点蒙版的最亮检测星点百分比。

0% 生成不含星点的实心蒙版。
100% 生成包含所有检测星点的蒙版。

小而暗的星点通常没有伪影，因此一般只需使用检测星点中的一小部分。

FILE: The rotation of the mosaic in degrees, counterclockwise from north up. Unchecked, the automatic rotation selected on the right: the mean orientation of the frames (modulo a quarter turn, nearest to the anchor's, so that the frames come out as horizontal or as vertical as they can all at once), the orientation of the anchor image, or north up.
文件: 马赛克的旋转角度（度），从北朝上起逆时针计。不勾选时采用右侧所选的自动旋转：各帧的平均取向（取四分之一圈的模，最接近锚图像取向，使各帧尽可能同时呈水平或垂直）、锚图像取向，或北朝上。

FILE:
Runs the integration of the current best frames to generate a local normalization reference image candidate.

The integration is performed applying the additive+scaling global output normalization.

For pixel rejection, local normalization is applied to the subset of best frames with the single best frame as normalization reference.
文件:
叠加当前最佳帧以生成局部归一化参考图像候选。

叠加采用「加法+缩放」的全局输出归一化。

像素剔除方面，对最佳帧子集应用局部归一化，以单一最佳帧作为归一化参考。

FILE: Choose the anchor image of the mosaic automatically: the image nearest to the center of the field. The anchor defines the way up of the mosaic (with the automatic rotation) and it is the reference of the normalization of the frames. When disabled, the first checked image of the list is the anchor; use the Up and Down buttons to order the list.
文件: 自动选择马赛克的锚图像：取最靠近视场中心的图像。锚图像定义马赛克的朝上方向（配合自动旋转），也是各帧归一化的参考。禁用时列表中第一个勾选图像为锚，可用上移/下移按钮调整顺序。

FILE:
This section determines which samples are used to create the Overlap region's relative gradient model. This determines the gradient correction applied to the Overlap region.

The aim is to reject samples that contain bright stars. It is not necessary to reject samples that only contain filter halos or the scattered light around bright stars.
文件:
本节决定用哪些采样来建立重叠区域的相对梯度模型，从而决定应用于重叠区域的梯度校正。

目标是剔除含亮星的采样；仅含滤镜光晕或亮星周围散射光的采样无需剔除。

FILE:
Auto white balance - one click. Finds the neutral (grey) areas of the subject automatically, balances the colour to remove a cast, and sets Temp / Tint to match.

It's a quick starting point, not perfect: on strongly-coloured subjects (e.g. a red nebula) it may over-correct - just use the Picker or nudge Temp / Tint afterwards.
文件:
自动白平衡——一键完成。自动找出主体的中性（灰色）区域，平衡色彩去除偏色，并设定 Temp / Tint。

这只是快速起点，并不完美：对色彩强烈的主体（如红色星云）可能过度校正——之后用取色器或微调 Temp / Tint 即可。

FILE:
If this option is enabled, the PIDoc compiler will generate output documentation files in HTML 5 or XHTML format, integrated with the specified PIDoc target system. Otherwise, source files will be compiled but no output will be generated. Disabling this option can be useful for syntax verification purposes.

This option is enabled by default.
文件:
启用此选项时，PIDoc 编译器会生成与指定 PIDoc 目标系统集成的 HTML 5 或 XHTML 格式输出文档；否则只编译源文件而不生成输出。禁用此选项可用于语法校验。

此选项默认启用。

FILE:
This section generates samples used to model the relative gradient between the reference and target images.

The image is divided up into a grid of sample squares. A sample's value is the median of the pixels it contains.

Samples are rejected if they contain one or more zero pixels in either image or if they are too close to a bright star.
文件:
本节生成用于建立参考与目标图像之间相对梯度模型的采样。

图像被划分为采样方格网格，采样值为其所含像素的中值。

若采样在任一图像中含一个或多个零像素，或过于靠近亮星，则被剔除。

FILE: Colour stretch: checking this will apply a colour stretch. This is achieved by stretching a 'pseudo' Luminance channel. The RGB coefficients for deriving this Luminance channel are specified in the preferences dialog (no gamma adjustment is applied). Each RGB channel is then stretched by the ratio of the stretched to the unstretched Luminance.
文件: 彩色拉伸：勾选即应用彩色拉伸，通过拉伸一个「伪」亮度通道实现。导出该亮度通道所用的 RGB 系数在偏好设置对话框中指定（不做 gamma 调整），随后各 RGB 通道按拉伸后与未拉伸亮度之比进行拉伸。

FILE:
Compute topocentric positions.

If this option is selected, subsequently calculated geometric, proper, astrometric, apparent and intermediate places will be topocentric, that is, will be referred to the location of the observer with respect to the center of the Earth, as defined by the following geodetic longitude, latitude and height parameters.
文件:
计算地面观测者位置。

选择此项后，随后计算的几何、真、天体测量、视与中间位置均为地面观测者位置，即以观测者相对地心的位置为参考，由下列大地经度、纬度与高度参数定义。

FILE:
Edit the 'Smoothness' parameter and view the gradient along the join.

The vertical axis represents the difference between the two images, the horizontal axis the join's X-Coordinate (horizontal join) or Y-Coordinate (vertical join).

The data points represent samples close to the join's path. The curve indicates the gradient along the join.
文件:
编辑「平滑度」参数并查看沿拼接线的梯度。

纵轴表示两幅图像之差，横轴为拼接线的 X 坐标（水平拼接）或 Y 坐标（垂直拼接）。

数据点表示靠近拼接线路径的采样，曲线表示沿拼接线的梯度。

FILE:
The log file to analyze. WBPP and FBPP write their log files to the logs subdirectory of their output directories, one file for each execution, named after the time of the execution (for example, 20261025114640.log).

Log files being written by a running execution can also be analyzed: the analysis covers the part of the log written so far.
文件:
要分析的日志文件。WBPP 与 FBPP 把日志写到输出目录的 logs 子目录，每次执行一个文件，按执行时间命名（例如 20261025114640.log）。

也可分析正在运行执行所写的日志：分析覆盖目前已写入的部分。

FILE: The graph or chart shown on this page: the light curve, the measurement graph with the quantities of the images that can explain problems of the photometry, the map of the multiplicative gradients of the reference image when they are corrected, or one of the charts. The charts are written to files only when they are enabled on the Measurement Report page.
文件: 本页显示的图形或图表：光变曲线、含可解释测光问题的各图像量的测量图、校正时参考图像的乘性梯度图，或某张图表。图表只有在「测量报告」页启用后才会写入文件。

FILE:
Upload the best benchmark to the server. The best benchmark is the one with the higher total performance index, which corresponds to the first row in the list below.

You must perform at least three benchmarks before submission. This reduces the probability of sending occasional poor results, which improves the reliability of the whole benchmark system.
文件:
把最佳基准测试上传到服务器。最佳基准测试即总性能指数最高者，对应下方列表第一行。

提交前必须至少完成三次基准测试，以降低偶发较差结果被发送的概率，从而提高整个基准测试系统的可靠性。

FILE: If this option is enabled, the script will generate an image with cross marks signaling star pair matches acquired for surface spline generation at each iteration of the distortion correction algorithm. These control images are useful to diagnose algorithm convergence problems as well as to evaluate the suitability of rejection parameters for distorion modeling.
文件: 启用此选项时，脚本会生成图像，用十字标记标出畸变校正算法每次迭代中为生成曲面样条所取得的星点对匹配。这些控制图像有助于诊断算法收敛问题，以及评估剔除参数对畸变建模的适用性。

FILE: Compress the dynamic range of the isolated structures of the binned working images before evaluating the rotation, scale and translation, so that a few bright stars or highlights cannot dominate the evaluation. Recommended for any image with a high dynamic range, which includes most astronomical images. At full resolution the working images are never compressed.
文件: 在评估旋转、缩放与平移之前，压缩合并工作图像中已分离结构的动态范围，使少数亮星或高光无法主导评估。对任何高动态范围图像（包括多数天文图像）都推荐启用。全分辨率下工作图像从不压缩。

FILE:
New Instance. Drag onto the workspace to create a process icon holding the current settings.

If a mixing matrix has been calibrated, the icon stores it too: drag the icon onto another image from the same camera and filter to extract it with that same calibration, without re-fitting. Double-click the icon to reopen this dialog with everything restored.
文件:
新建实例。拖到工作区可创建保存当前设置的进程图标。

若已校准混合矩阵，图标也会保存它：把图标拖到同一相机与滤镜拍摄的另一幅图像上，即可用同一校准提取而无需重新拟合。双击图标可重新打开本对话框并恢复全部内容。

FILE:
The script will solve a list of image files, which are processed concurrently, one file per thread.

For each file without a valid astrometric solution, a new XISF file with the linear solution computed by the blind solver is written to the directory of the file. Files with valid astrometric solutions are not modified, and no output files are written for them.
文件:
脚本会解算一组图像文件，并发处理，每线程一个文件。

对每个没有有效天文解算的文件，在其所在目录写入含盲解线性解的新 XISF 文件；已有有效天文解算的文件不修改，也不为其写输出。

FILE: Generate the histogram data for the current stretch parameters. The script will attempt to predict the post transformation histogram but this is sometimes not possible; for example, where a mask is in place or the transformation type is an image conbination. In this case it is necessary to generate the histogram data from the stretched image by pressing this button.
文件: 为当前拉伸参数生成直方图数据。脚本会尝试预测变换后的直方图，但有时无法做到，例如存在蒙版或变换类型为图像组合时。此时需按此按钮由拉伸后的图像生成直方图数据。

FILE:
You usually don't need to set the results file; it is automatically saved within the NSG settings.

However, there is a small risk that if PixInsight crashed during a run, this setting may be lost. If so, to enable Continue run, select the results file written by the previous run. Example filename:

.../NSG/NsgData/NSG_Results_2023.02.09_15h30m38s.nsg
文件:
通常无需设定结果文件，它会自动保存在 NSG 设置中。

但若 PixInsight 在运行中崩溃，该设置有小概率丢失。此时为启用继续运行，请选择上次运行写出的结果文件，文件名示例：

.../NSG/NsgData/NSG_Results_2023.02.09_15h30m38s.nsg

FILE: Sigma clipping of the measured deviations. Matched stars whose deviation exceeds the median plus this number of robust sigmas (1.4826 times the median absolute deviation) are excluded from the grid tables and deviation maps, which removes wrong correspondences near the matching tolerance. Statistics are reported both before and after rejection. Zero disables rejection.
文件: 对测量偏差做 Sigma 裁剪。偏差超过中值加此数量稳健 sigma（1.4826 倍中值绝对偏差）的匹配星点会被排除出网格表与偏差图，从而去除匹配容差附近的错误对应。剔除前后都会给出统计。设为零则禁用剔除。

FILE:
Generate a new PIDoc system directory tree on the target directory. This option is useful to generate a new documentation system for authoring and testing purposes.

Important: For security reasons, the target directory must be empty for this option to work. If a nonempty directory is specified, the compiler will refuse to work until this option is disabled.
文件:
在目标目录生成新的 PIDoc 系统目录树，此选项适合为编写与测试生成新的文档系统。

重要：出于安全原因，目标目录必须为空才能生效；若指定了非空目录，编译器会拒绝工作直到此选项被禁用。

FILE: If this option is checked, a 'reverse' mtf transformation will be applied to both the target image and the starless image before the stars are extracted to bring then to a pseudo-linear state. After star extraction the inverse of the 'reverse' mtf stetch is applied to return back to the original stretched state. This approach can lead to better preservation of star colour.
文件: 勾选此项时，在提取星点之前会对目标图像与无星图像应用「反向」MTF 变换，使其进入伪线性状态；提取星点后再应用该反向 MTF 拉伸的逆变换回到原拉伸状态。此法可更好地保留星点颜色。

FILE:
Horizontal axis: Image sort order.

Use DATE-OBS to show how conditions changed over time.

Use Weight to match the console summary sort order.

If sky transparency is stable, sorting by Altitude will show how transmission changed with increasing airmass. Note that if the object is at a high altitude, the airmass will be almost constant.
文件:
横轴：图像排序方式。

用 DATE-OBS 观察条件随时间的变化。

用 Weight 与控制台汇总的排序一致。

若天空透明度稳定，按 高度 排序可显示透过率随大气质量增加的变化。注意目标高度很高时，大气质量几乎恒定。

FILE:
The dates of the report and of the light curve, at the middle of each exposure: the UTC date and time (the EXCEL format of the AAVSO report), the Julian date (UTC), the heliocentric Julian date (UTC), or the barycentric Julian date (TDB).

The AAVSO accepts EXCEL, JD and HJD dates; a report with barycentric dates is for other uses, such as the timing of exoplanet transits.
文件:
报告与光变曲线的日期，取每次曝光中点：UTC 日期时间（AAVSO 报告的 EXCEL 格式）、儒略日（UTC）、日心儒略日（UTC）或质心儒略日（TDB）。

AAVSO 接受 EXCEL、JD 与 HJD 日期；质心日期报告用于其他用途，如系外行星凌星计时。

FILE:
The smoothness of the curve fitted to the light curve, from 0 to 1. At 0.5, the default, the curve has the bandwidth that predicts the measurements best. Toward 1 it shows only the variations that the data prove beyond doubt; toward 0, shorter and fainter variations, and more of the noise.

The curve is a guide for the eye: the magnitudes and the report do not depend on it.
文件:
光变曲线拟合曲线的平滑度，范围 0 到 1。默认 0.5 时曲线带宽对测量值的预测最佳；趋近 1 只显示数据确凿无疑的变化，趋近 0 则显示更短更弱的变化以及更多噪声。

曲线仅供目视参考，星等与报告不依赖于它。

FILE: Model the local distortions that the global transformation cannot represent with recursive point surface splines of the tiles measured by the full resolution refinement, such as the distortions introduced by atmospheric seeing between lunar or solar frames. The registered images are resampled with the global transformation plus the splines. Requires the full resolution refinement.
文件: 用由全分辨率精化测得的图块递归点曲面样条，建模全局变换无法表示的局部畸变，例如月面或日面帧之间由大气视宁度引入的畸变。已对齐图像按全局变换加样条重采样。需要启用全分辨率精化。

FILE: Leave out of the ensemble every star that was not measured on all the images of the light curve, so that the ensemble is the same on every image. Otherwise a star measured on 90% of the images is a comparison star: on an image where it is missing, the zero point is the mean offset of the other stars, which can differ from that of the whole ensemble by a few thousandths of a magnitude.
文件: 把未在光变曲线所有图像上都被测到的恒星排除出集合，使每幅图像上的集合相同。否则在 90% 图像上被测到的星仍是比较星：在缺失它的图像上，零点取其他恒星的平均偏移，可能与整个集合相差千分之几个星等。

FILE:
Leave out of the ensemble the stars that disagree with the rest: their mean offset between catalog and instrumental magnitudes is too far from those of the other stars, or their offsets scatter too much from image to image. Saturated and blended stars, variable stars and wrong catalog magnitudes are caught this way.

The rejected stars are marked in orange on the reference image.
文件:
把与其余恒星不一致的星排除出集合：其星表星等与仪器星等之间的平均偏移偏离其他星过远，或偏移在各图像间散布过大。饱和星、重叠星、变星及错误的星表星等都可由此检出。

被剔除的星在参考图像上以橙色标出。

FILE:
A value is abnormal when it deviates from the median of its group by more than this number of robust standard deviations (1.4826 times the median absolute deviation), and by a difference of practical significance (for example, 20% of the median FWHM of the group).

The lower this parameter, the more values are reported as abnormal. Only groups of five or more frames are evaluated.
文件:
当某值偏离本组中位数超过此数量的稳健标准差（1.4826 倍中值绝对偏差），且差值具有实际意义（例如本组中位 FWHM 的 20%）时，判为异常。

此参数越小，被报告为异常的值越多；仅评估含五帧以上的组。

FILE:
Number all tables by default. If this option is enabled, all tables will be numbered unless the \ able[unnumbered] parameter is specified. If this option is disabled, only tables with the \ able[numbered] parameter will be numbered. Note that you can also control default table numbering from PIDoc source code using \pragma command parameters.

This option is enabled by default.
文件:
默认为所有表格编号。启用时，除非指定 \ able[unnumbered] 参数，所有表格都会编号；禁用时，只有带 \ able[numbered] 参数的表格编号。也可在 PIDoc 源码中用 \pragma 命令参数控制默认表格编号。

此选项默认启用。

FILE:
Some catalogs say which of their magnitudes are reliable. Stars whose magnitude in the band of the observation is not validated are left out of the ensemble unless this option is enabled.

The option is only available for measurements made with a catalog queried on VizieR. With a local XPSD database, it is disabled and the stars are used whether or not their magnitudes are validated.
文件:
有些星表会标明其哪些星等可靠。若未启用此选项，观测波段星等未经确认的恒星会被排除出集合。

此选项仅对通过 VizieR 查询星表的测量可用；使用本地 XPSD 数据库时禁用，无论星等是否经过确认都会使用这些星。

FILE: Maximum distance in pixels between the predicted position of a catalog star and a detected star for them to be considered the same object. A catalog star is matched only when exactly one detected star lies within this distance, and the detected star has no other catalog star within the same distance. Deviations larger than this tolerance cannot be measured: they show up as unmatched stars.
文件: 星表星的预测位置与检测星点之间被视为同一天体的最大距离（像素）。仅当该距离内恰好有一个检测星点、且该检测星点在同一距离内没有其他星表星时才匹配。超过此容差的偏差无法测量，会表现为未匹配星点。

FILE:
Reuse the renditions of equations from previous compilations. Every rendered equation is stored in a cache, identified by its LaTeX source code and its size, and an unchanged equation is never rendered again, which makes recompiling a document with many equations much faster. The cache is shared by all documents and all running instances of PixInsight.

This option is enabled by default.
文件:
复用以前编译中已渲染的公式。每个渲染过的公式按 LaTeX 源码与尺寸存入缓存，未改动的公式不再重新渲染，使含大量公式的文档重新编译快得多。缓存由所有文档及所有运行中的 PixInsight 实例共享。

此选项默认启用。

FILE:
Number all figures by default. If this option is enabled, all figures will be numbered unless the \figure[unnumbered] parameter is specified. If this option is disabled, only figures with the \figure[numbered] parameter will be numbered. Note that you can also control default figure numbering from PIDoc source code using \pragma command parameters.

This option is enabled by default.
文件:
默认为所有插图编号。启用时，除非指定 \figure[unnumbered] 参数，所有插图都会编号；禁用时，只有带 \figure[numbered] 参数的插图编号。也可在 PIDoc 源码中用 \pragma 命令参数控制默认插图编号。

此选项默认启用。

FILE:
Set the opacity of the blend image.

If the opacity value is t, this is applied as follows. The result of blending the blend image with the base image is first calculated. Then t times this result is added to (1 - t) times the base image.

For example, if the blend mode is 'Replace' the opacity parameter can be used to create a linear blend between the base image and the blend image.
文件:
设置混合图像的不透明度。

若不透明度为 t，按以下方式应用：先计算混合图像与基础图像的混合结果，再把 t 倍该结果加到 (1 - t) 倍基础图像上。

例如混合模式为「替换」时，不透明度参数可用于在基础图像与混合图像之间做线性混合。

FILE:
Size of the hot pixel removal filter.

This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels will be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can prevent a valid image registration.

To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件:
热像素去除滤波器的尺寸。

这是星点检测器在结构检测阶段前所应用中值滤波器的半径（像素）。中值滤波对去除热像素非常有效；热像素会被误判为星点，数量较多时可能导致图像对齐失败。

设为零可禁用热像素去除。

FILE:
Number of cells along the largest dimension of the image. The distortion is sampled at the center of each cell.

A model field can be sampled as finely as wanted, since it is evaluated rather than measured. A catalog field cannot: the finer the lattice, the fewer stars fall in each cell and the noisier its median becomes. When both are computed they share this lattice, so choose it for the catalog.
文件:
图像最大维度上的单元格数，畸变在每个单元格中心采样。

模型场可按需任意精细采样，因为它是求值而非测量得到的；星表场则不行：网格越细，每个单元格落入的星点越少，其中位数噪声越大。两者同时计算时共用此网格，因此应按星表场来选。

FILE:
Edit the region of interest over the image shown in the preview: drag outside the region to draw a new one, inside it to move it, and on an edge or a corner to resize it. While this option is checked, the image is panned with the middle mouse button. Available while the preview shows an image.

When the stars come from the detection image, the detection image is shown, since the region refers to it.
文件:
在预览所示图像上编辑感兴趣区域：在区域外拖动可画新区域，区域内拖动可移动，在边或角上拖动可缩放。勾选此项时可用鼠标中键平移图像，仅在预览显示图像时可用。

若星点来自检测图像，则显示检测图像，因为该区域是针对它的。

FILE:
Number all equations by default. If this option is enabled, all equations will be numbered unless the \equation[unnumbered] parameter is specified. If this option is disabled, only equations with the \equation[numbered] parameter will be numbered. Note that you can also control default equation numbering from PIDoc source code using \pragma command parameters.

This option is disabled by default.
文件:
默认为所有公式编号。启用时，除非指定 \equation[unnumbered] 参数，所有公式都会编号；禁用时，只有带 \equation[numbered] 参数的公式编号。也可在 PIDoc 源码中用 \pragma 命令参数控制默认公式编号。

此选项默认禁用。

FILE:
Probability of making a type 1 error (false positive) in the generalized ESD rejection algorithm.

This is the significance level of the outlier detection hypothesis test. For example, a significance level of 0.01 means that a 1% chance of being wrong when rejecting the null hypothesis (that there are no outliers in a given pixel stack) is acceptable. The default value is 0.05 (5% significance level).
文件:
广义 ESD 剔除算法中犯第一类错误（假阳性）的概率。

这是离群点检测假设检验的显著性水平。例如显著性水平 0.01 表示：在拒绝原假设（给定像素堆栈中无离群点）时，可接受 1% 的出错概率。默认值 0.05（5% 显著性水平）。

FILE:
The projection of the sky of the mosaic in mosaic frames mode. Unchecked, the projection suited to the extent of the field is selected: gnomonic up to 10 degrees, Mercator up to 90, stereographic up to 180, Hammer-Aitoff beyond. Checked, the selected projection is used; Advanced sets the origin of the projection.

In image matching mode the output geometry is the solution of the reference image.
文件:
马赛克帧模式下的天区投影。不勾选时按视场范围选择合适的投影：10 度以内用日晷投影，90 度以内用墨卡托，180 度以内用球极平面，更大范围用 Hammer-Aitoff。勾选时使用所选投影；高级可设定投影原点。

在图像匹配模式下，输出几何取参考图像的解。

FILE:
Scaling factor used to draw text elements on the annotated image.

This parameter defines the resolution in pixels per typographic point applied to render text on the annotation. A text scale of 1.0 corresponds to a resolution of 72 pixels per inch, or approximately 28.35 pixels per centimeter. The default text scale is 2.0, corresponding to a text resolution of 144 dpi, which is appropriate in most cases.
文件:
在标注图像上绘制文字元素所用的缩放系数。

此参数定义渲染标注文字时的分辨率（每印刷点数像素数）。文字缩放 1.0 对应 72 像素/英寸（约 28.35 像素/厘米）；默认文字缩放 2.0，对应 144 dpi，多数情况下合适。

FILE:
Renders the current mask - the luminosity mask (Lights/Darks, Target/Protect, Depth, Strength), combined with any select area regions - as a new grayscale image window, at the image's full resolution. Use it as a real mask on another process, save it, or just inspect it.

Matches exactly what Apply uses, regardless of what the preview happens to be showing (a crop, a downsampled preview, etc).
文件:
把当前蒙版——亮度蒙版（亮/暗、目标/保护、深度、强度）与任何选区区域组合——按图像全分辨率渲染为新的灰度图像窗口。可把它作为真实蒙版用于其他进程、保存，或仅用于检查。

它与「应用」所用的完全一致，无论预览当前显示的是什么（裁切、降采样预览等）。

FILE:
Displays the image outline.

The line should follow the non-zero outline of the image. Check for gaps between this line and the image.

Gaps indicate 'almost black' areas. It is essential that these areas are removed. Quit this script and use PixelMath to remove them. For example, if the 'almost black' area has a peak value of 0.0003, the required PixelMath expression is:

iif($T < 0.0004 ? 0 : $T)
文件:
显示图像轮廓。

该线应贴合图像的非零轮廓，请检查线与图像之间是否有空隙。

空隙表示存在「几乎全黑」区域，必须去除。请退出本脚本并用 PixelMath 去除。例如「几乎全黑」区域峰值为 0.0003 时，所需表达式为：

iif($T < 0.0004 ? 0 : $T)

FILE:
Create new Instance.

The instance can only be run in view context. The behaviour of the instance icon depends how it is created. If it is created by holding the shift button and dragging this blue triangle to the workspace it will run immediately on the active image. Otherwise, if the shift button is not held, the instance icon will open the PMUI interface with the active image pre-selected as the target image.
文件:
创建新实例。

该实例只能在视图上下文中运行，实例图标的行为取决于创建方式：按住 Shift 把蓝色三角拖到工作区时，会立即在活动图像上运行；不按 Shift 时，实例图标会打开 PMUI 界面并把活动图像预选为目标图像。

FILE:
Measure the series without opening any modal window, so that a long series can run unattended. Errors are reported on the console and written to name-errors.csv, next to the output file, with the time of each error, the index of the image it concerns and its description. The file is only created when there are errors.

The script can also run with no dialog at all, with the non_interactive script parameter.
文件:
不打开任何模态窗口测量序列，使长序列可无人值守运行。错误在控制台报告，并写入输出文件旁的 name-errors.csv，含每次错误的时间、所涉图像索引及描述；仅在有错误时才创建该文件。

脚本也可用 non_interactive 参数完全无对话框运行。

FILE:
Displays the 'Join Size and Position' dialog.

This displays the overlap region. The green line (Overlay mode) shows the path of the mosaic join. The green rectangle (Blend or Average mode) shows the Join Region.

The region on the reference side of the green line/rectangle will be replaced by reference pixels. The other side of the green line/rectangle will taper down to the smoother target image correction.
文件:
显示「拼接尺寸与位置」对话框。

其中显示重叠区域：绿线（叠加模式）表示马赛克拼接路径，绿色矩形（混合或平均模式）表示拼接区域。

绿线/矩形参考侧的区域将被参考像素替换；另一侧渐隐过渡到较平滑的目标图像校正。

FILE:
Mosaic combination mode:

  • Overlay: Ideal if the reference and target images have a similar signal to noise ratio.
  • Blend: Excellent at blending the two sides of the join. This is particularly useful if the two images have very different signal to noise ratios.
  • Average: Increases the signal to noise ratio over the join, although this can also make the join more visible.
文件:
马赛克组合模式：

  • 叠加：适合参考图像与目标图像信噪比相近时。
  • 混合：擅长融合拼接线两侧，两图信噪比差异很大时尤其有用。
  • 平均：提高拼接处信噪比，但也可能让拼接线更明显。

FILE: Equalize the sky background of the frames from their overlaps before blending them: an offset and a gradient per frame and channel, measured where two frames see the same sky, after the rejection of the stars, and solved for all the frames at once relative to the anchor. Without it, the frames keep the offsets of their normalization, which equalize whole-frame statistics: not the sky level where nebulosity fills a frame.
文件: 融合前按各帧重叠区均衡天空背景：在两帧看到同一片天空的位置、剔除星点后，为每帧每通道测出一个偏移与梯度，并相对锚图像一次性求解全部帧。不启用时，各帧保留其归一化带来的偏移，那只能均衡整帧统计量，而非星云铺满画面时的天空电平。

FILE:
Expected maximum fraction of outliers for the generalized ESD rejection algorithm.

For example, a value of 0.2 applied to a stack of 10 pixels means that the ESD algorithm will be limited to detect a maximum of two outlier pixels, or in other words, only 0, 1 or 2 outliers will be detectable in such case. The default value is 0.3, which allows the algorithm to detect up to a 30% of outlier pixels in each pixel stack.
文件:
广义 ESD 剔除算法预期的最大离群点比例。

例如对 10 个像素的堆栈设为 0.2，表示 ESD 算法最多检测 2 个离群像素，即该情况下只能检出 0、1 或 2 个离群点。默认值 0.3，允许算法在每个像素堆栈中检出最多 30% 的离群像素。

FILE:
White balance picker - the one-click way to neutralize a color cast. Click this button, then click a point in the preview that should be neutral grey or white. The R/G/B channels are scaled so their histograms line up at that point (a true per-channel white balance, like Lightroom's eyedropper). Click the button again to cancel.

Fine-tune afterwards with Temp (warm/cool) and Tint (green/magenta).
文件:
白平衡取色器——一键中和偏色。点击此按钮，再点击预览中应为中性灰或白的一点，R/G/B 通道会缩放使其直方图在该点对齐（真正的逐通道白平衡，类似 Lightroom 的吸管）。再次点击按钮可取消。

之后可用 Temp（暖/冷）与 Tint（绿/洋红）微调。

FILE:
The script's output can be:

  • Annotate image: Generates a new RGB image with the annotation drawn over the original data.
  • Generate transparent overlay: Generates a new transparent image (alpha channel) with the annotation. It can be saved e.g. in PNG or TIFF format and be used in other applications.
  • Generate SVG overlay: Generates an SVG file with the annotation.
文件:
脚本的输出可以是：

  • 标注图像：生成新的 RGB 图像，在原始数据上绘制标注。
  • 生成透明叠加层：生成带标注的透明图像（alpha 通道），可保存为 PNG 或 TIFF 供其他应用使用。
  • 生成 SVG 叠加层：生成含标注的 SVG 文件。

FILE: Sets the black point for a linear stretch of the image. Note that any pixel with values less than the blackpoint input will be clipped and the data lost. Contrast gained by performing the linear stretch will be evenly distributed over the image, which will be dimmed. Pixels with values less than the blackpoint will appear black and have 0 value. Updating this parameter will automatically update the low clipping proportion
文件: 设定图像线性拉伸的黑点。注意任何小于黑点输入的像素都会被裁切且数据丢失；线性拉伸获得的对比度会均匀分布于整幅图像，图像整体变暗；小于黑点的像素显示为黑色且值为 0。更新此参数会自动更新低裁切比例

FILE:
Keep and show the weighted composite broadband image after processing. The composite is scaled by the regression factor k so its stellar flux matches the narrowband image. This is useful if you want to apply a different or unsupported star removal process to either image. It is named composite_bb_<nb>.

This can be subtracted from the nb image in PixelMath using <nb> - (composite - med(composite))
文件:
处理后保留并显示加权复合宽带图像。复合图按回归系数 k 缩放，使其恒星通量与窄带图像一致。若想对任一图像应用不同或不受支持的去星进程，此功能很有用，图像命名为 composite_bb_<nb>。

可在 PixelMath 中用 <nb> - (composite - med(composite)) 从窄带图像中减去它

FILE:
This suffix is appended to the name of each image file without a valid astrometric solution to form the name of the output XISF file with the computed linear solution, which is written to the output directory, or to the directory of the image file when no output directory has been specified.

If this suffix is empty and no output directory has been specified, input XISF files without a valid astrometric solution are overwritten.
文件:
此后缀追加到每个没有有效天文解算的图像文件名后，构成含所计算线性解的输出 XISF 文件名，写入输出目录；未指定输出目录时写入该图像文件所在目录。

后缀为空且未指定输出目录时，会覆盖没有有效天文解算的输入 XISF 文件。

FILE:
The number of bits of the analog to digital converter of the camera, which relates the pixel values to its ADU for the gain: the full range of the data is 2bits - 1 ADU.

Cameras with 12 or 14 bit converters usually scale their values to fill the 16 bit range of the files they write: select the bits of the camera for them. Select 16 for 16 bit cameras, and for cameras whose values are written without scaling.
文件:
相机模数转换器的位数，用于按增益把像素值对应到 ADU：数据全范围为 2bits - 1 ADU。

12 位或 14 位相机会把数值缩放到所写文件的 16 位范围，对它们请选择相机位数。16 位相机以及数值未经缩放写入的相机请选择 16。

FILE:
Blink through the Target images to find the best reference image.

Choose a reference image with a small and simple gradient that's not too badly affected by satellite trails.

The images are sorted by NWEIGHT. To make the comparisons fair and meaningful, the target images are corrected for both scale and offset to the reference image. The same stretch is then applied to all images. The gradients are not removed.
文件:
闪烁浏览目标图像以找出最佳参考图像。

请选择梯度小而简单、且不太受卫星轨迹影响的参考图像。

图像按 NWEIGHT 排序。为使比较公平有意义，目标图像会按参考图像同时校正比例与偏移，随后对所有图像应用同一拉伸；梯度不会被去除。

FILE:
Check to inherit an astrometric solution.

If creating a new image the astrometric solution will be copied from the base image to the output image. If the base image has no astrometric solution but the blend image does, the blend image solution will be copied to the output image.

If not creating a new image and the base image has no astrometric solution, any astrometric solution of the blend image will be copied.
文件:
勾选可继承天文解算。

若新建图像，天文解算从基础图像复制到输出图像；若基础图像没有而混合图像有，则复制混合图像的解。

若不新建图像且基础图像没有天文解算，则复制混合图像的任何天文解算。

FILE:
Create a mask of the join. Apply this to the mosaic to see where the join is. Use Ctrl K to show/hide the mask to judge the join's quality.

Mosaic Join Mode: Overlay
The mask is a line that indicates the path of the join.

Mosaic Join Mode: Blend or Average
The mask reveals the Join Region. Within this area the mosaic pixels were either randomly chosen from the reference and target image, or averaged.
文件:
创建拼接蒙版，把它应用到马赛克即可看到拼接位置；用 Ctrl K 显示/隐藏蒙版以判断拼接质量。

马赛克拼接模式：叠加
蒙版为一条表示拼接路径的线。

马赛克拼接模式：混合或平均
蒙版显示拼接区域，该区域内的马赛克像素由参考与目标图像随机选取或取平均得到。

FILE: Sets the white point for a linear stretch of the image. Note that any pixel with value greater than the white-point input will be clipped and the data lost. Contrast gained by performing the linear stretch will be evenly distributed over the image, which will be brightened. Pixels with values greater than the white-point will appear white and have a value of 1.0. Updating this parameter will automatically update the high clipping proportion
文件: 设定图像线性拉伸的白点。注意任何大于白点输入的像素都会被裁切且数据丢失；线性拉伸获得的对比度会均匀分布于整幅图像，图像整体变亮；大于白点的像素显示为白色且值为 1.0。更新此参数会自动更新高裁切比例

FILE: The model fitted to each star. Auto fits Moffat models with beta = 2.5, 4, 6 and 10 and a Gaussian model to each star and keeps the one that fits it best, so each star gets the profile that describes it, with five fits per star instead of one. Moffat with a fixed beta of 4 is a good description of a typical stellar profile and converges reliably; the free Moffat model fits better where the profile is unusual, at the cost of one more free parameter.
文件: 对每颗星拟合的模型。Auto 会对每颗星拟合 beta = 2.5、4、6、10 的 Moffat 模型及一个高斯模型并保留最佳者，因此每颗星得到最描述它的轮廓，代价是每星五次拟合而非一次。固定 beta = 4 的 Moffat 能很好描述典型星点轮廓且收敛可靠；自由 Moffat 在轮廓异常时拟合更好，代价是多一个自由参数。

FILE:
Lower bound for the set of dark optimization pixels, measured in sigma units from the median.

This parameter defines the set of dark frame pixels that will be used to compute dark optimization factors adaptively. By restricting this set to relatively bright pixels, the optimization process can be more robust to readout noise present in the master bias and dark frames. Increase this parameter to remove more dark pixels from the optimization set.
文件:
暗场优化像素集合的下界，以相对中值的 sigma 为单位。

此参数定义用于自适应计算暗场优化系数的暗场像素集合。把集合限制在相对较亮的像素，可使优化过程对主偏置与主暗场中的读出噪声更稳健。增大此参数可从优化集合中剔除更多暗场像素。

FILE:
The minimum relative flux of an image, in percent, for the image to be part of the analysis. The relative flux of an image is the total flux of the comparison stars on it, in percent of its median over the images of its band: the values the light curve shows as the total flux. Images under the minimum, such as those taken through clouds, are left out of the selection of the comparison stars, of the light curve and of the report.

Zero rejects no image.
文件:

设为零则不剔除任何图像。

FILE:
The learning rate represents the scale factor applied to the cost function's gradient to determine the amplitude of the solution increment at each iteration.

Each time the gradient is computed the next weights are computed by performing a descendant step along the gradient direction, the bigger the learning rate the faster the increment.

Increase this parameter to speed up the convergence for a large set of images if the convergence is too slow.
文件:
学习率表示作用于代价函数梯度的缩放因子，用于确定每次迭代解算增量的幅度。

每次计算梯度后，沿梯度方向执行一步下降来得到下一组权重；学习率越大，增量越快。

若图像数量很大且收敛过慢，可增大此参数加快收敛。

Smart naming syntax consists of the sequence:

KEYWORD_value

that defines a keyword name and its associated value. This sequence can be contained in file names or full paths. When this option is enabled, the keyword values found in full paths or file names are used, ignoring the values possibly stored in FITS headers.

智能命名语法由以下序列组成：

KEYWORD_value

它定义关键字名称及其关联值，可出现在文件名或完整路径中。启用此项时，使用在完整路径或文件名中找到的关键字值，忽略可能存于 FITS 头中的值。

FILE: Controls the amount of stretch. D is a variable that independently controls the contrast added (the slope of the stretch transform) at SP, thus adjusting the amount of stretch applied to the rest of the image. D does not change the 'form' of the stretch, simply the amount. D should be used in tandem with b to control the distribution of contrast and brightness. When D is set to zero, the stretch transform will be the identity (y=x) or 'no stretch' transform.

FILE: Radius in pixels for detecting outlier star pair matches during the iterative distortion correction algorithm. Limits the number of samples used to create the surface spline. If the number of samples exceed this limit, they are combined (binned) to create super samples.

A larger number of samples increases the theoretical maximum resolution of the surface spline. However, small unbinned samples are noisier and require more smoothing. The default value is usually a good compromise.

The time required to initialize the surface spline approximately doubles every 1300 samples.

初始化曲面样条所需时间大约每增加 1300 个采样翻一倍。

Sources with measured SNR above this parameter in units of the minimum detection level (as defined by the sensitivity parameter) will always be detected, even if their profiles are too flat for the current peak response. This parameter allows us to force inclusion of relatively bright stars irrespective of their shapes, and also provides finer control on the amount of detectable stars, along with the sensitivity parameter. The default value is 3.0.
