文件:
拼接路径以亮绿色线表示。

在拼接路径的目标侧，重叠区域的精细校正渐隐过渡到应用于目标图像其余部分的较平滑校正。

混合与平均模式：在拼接路径的参考侧、直到深绿色线为止，两幅图像的噪声差异被混合在一起。

尽量把拼接路径保持在采样网格区域内（「显示采样网格」复选框），并避开亮星、图像边角与高对比区域。

FILE:
Apply a label placement optimization algorithm to remove overlappings and conflicts among graphics elements in the annotation, with a minimum distance maximization local optimization criterion. When this option is selected, label text positions specified for each selected layer will be used as a first default option, but the algorithm will move labels as necessary to fulfill its optimization goals.

Excessively crowded annotations, where overlappings cannot be avoided, will be simplified by removing elements as strictly necessary.
文件:
应用标签布局优化算法，按最小距离最大化的局部优化准则，消除标注中图形元素之间的重叠与冲突。选择此项时，各所选图层指定的标签文字位置作为首选默认，但算法会按需移动标签以达成优化目标。

对无法避免重叠的过度拥挤标注，将按严格必需的程度删除元素予以简化。

FILE:
The 'Overlay' mode is ideal if the reference and target images have a similar signal to noise ratio.

Reference pixels are drawn on top of target pixels on the reference side of the join.

On the other side of the join, the detailed correction over the overlap is tapered down to the smoother correction applied to the rest of the target image.

Use the 'Join' button to view and adjust the position of the join. Try to keep it within the sample grid area and, if possible, avoid image corners, bright stars and contrasty areas.
文件:
参考图像与目标图像信噪比相近时，「叠加」模式最为理想。

在拼接的参考侧，参考像素绘制在目标像素之上。

在拼接的另一侧，重叠区的精细校正渐隐过渡到应用于目标图像其余部分的较平滑校正。

用「拼接」按钮查看并调整拼接位置，尽量保持在采样网格区域内，并尽可能避开图像边角、亮星与高对比区域。

FILE:
Compute topocentric positions of solar system objects.

If this option is enabled, positions calculated for planets, asteroids and comets will be topocentric, that is, will be referred to the location of the observer with respect to the center of the Earth, as defined by the following geodetic longitude, latitude, and height parameters.

If this option is disabled, the computed positions will be geocentric, which will lead to inaccurate annotations, especially for objects relatively close to the Earth at the date of observation.
文件:
计算太阳系天体的地面观测者位置。

启用此选项时，行星、小行星与彗星的位置按地面观测者计算，即以观测者相对地心的位置为参考，由下列大地经度、纬度与高度参数定义。

禁用时计算出的位置为地心位置，会导致标注不准确，观测日期距地球较近的天体尤其明显。

FILE:
Measure only the stars inside a rectangle: the field around a variable star or an exoplanet host and its comparison stars, or the part of the field free from the aberrations of the corners. Measuring a few hundred stars instead of tens of thousands makes a long series far faster. The images are still registered with all their stars.

The rectangle is in the coordinates of the detection image when the stars come from it, so the same stars are measured on every image of the series; otherwise it is in the coordinates of each measured image.
文件:
只测量一个矩形内的星点：变星或系外行星宿主及其比较星周围的视场，或不受边角像差影响的那部分视场。测量几百颗星而非数万颗，能让长序列快得多；图像仍用其全部星点对齐。

星点来自检测图像时，矩形采用检测图像的坐标，因此序列中每幅图像测量的都是同一批星点；否则采用各被测图像自身的坐标。

FILE:
Displacement that the continuous magnitude rescales to one, in the reporting units.

Zero means automatic: the largest peak among the fields of the run, so that the maps of one run are comparable with each other — a difference field ten times smaller than the distortion then looks ten times darker, instead of just as bright because it was rescaled to its own peak.

An explicit value makes the maps comparable with those of any other image, which is what is needed to compare instruments or to follow one instrument over time.
文件:
连续幅值重标定为 1 所对应的位移，以报告单位计。

为零表示自动：取本次运行各场中的最大峰值，使同一运行的各图可相互比较 — 比畸变小十倍的差分场看起来就暗十倍，而不会因按自身峰值重标定而显得同样亮。

显式取值可使这些图与任何其他图像的图具有可比性，这正是比较不同仪器或长期跟踪同一仪器所需要的。

FILE:
Displays the generated samples and the stars used to reject samples.

Provides edit sliders for all 'Sample Generation' section parameters.

Samples are rejected if they:

  • Contain one or more zero pixels in either image.
  • Are too close to a star included in the 'Limit stars %' range.
The surviving samples are drawn as squares. The stars used to reject samples are indicated by circles.

A surface spline is constructed from the generated samples to model the relative gradient between the reference and target images.
文件:
显示生成的采样及用于剔除采样的星点。

提供「采样生成」区所有参数的编辑滑块。

采样在以下情况被剔除：

  • 在任一图像中含一个或多个零像素。
  • 过于靠近「限制星点 %」范围内的星点。
保留的采样画为方形，用于剔除采样的星点以圆圈表示。

由生成的采样构建曲面样条，用于建模参考与目标图像之间的相对梯度。

FILE:
If this parameter is disabled, multiple sources that are too close to be separated as individual structures, such as double and multiple stars, won't be detected for relative scale evaluation.

If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects.

In general, sources with several local maxima pose difficulties for the determination of accurate star positions and PSF parameters, although this is usually a minor problem for scale evaluation. For this reason this parameter is enabled by default.
文件:
禁用此参数时，过近而无法分离为单个结构的多重源（如双星、聚星）不会被检测用于相对比例评估。

启用时，不可分离的多重源可作为单个对象自由检测。

一般来说，含多个局部极大值的源难以确定精确的星点位置与 PSF 参数，不过这对比例评估通常只是小问题，因此此参数默认启用。

FILE: In mosaic frames mode, the frames of each filter are composed into a mosaic of their own, and all the mosaics have the same geometry. The filter of an image is the one assigned to it in the list of images, or else the one its metadata states, which stands for a MARS channel when it is one of these aliases, or else the one its file name gives; the images without a filter form a mosaic of their own. Color images ignore their metadata: their channels are R, G and B unless other filters are assigned to them, and the color images of each set of channel filters form a mosaic.
文件:
在马赛克帧模式下，每个滤镜的帧各自合成一幅马赛克，且所有马赛克具有相同几何。
图像的滤镜是图像列表中为它指定的那个，否则是其元数据给出的那个（若为这些别名之一则代表一个 MARS 通道），再否则是其文件名给出的那个；没有滤镜的图像自成一图。
彩色图像忽略其元数据：除非为其指定了其他滤镜，其通道为 R、G、B，且每组通道滤镜的彩色图像各自合成一幅马赛克。

FILE: When this option is enabled, and the initial alignment process fails with a set of catalog sources larger than 2000 stars, an additional attempt to align the image will be performed with a sequence of star matching tries using reduced and larger sets of detected stars. This can be an expensive procedure, especially for wide-field images, but it can help find an initial alignment in some corner cases with overprocessed or poorly focused/calibrated/tracked/exposed images. This option is disabled by default and should not be necessary under normal working conditions.
文件: 启用此选项且初始对齐在超过 2000 颗星表源时失败，会用一系列缩减与扩大的检测星点集合再做一次星点匹配尝试以对齐图像。此过程开销较大，宽视场图像尤其明显，但在过度处理或聚焦/校准/跟踪/曝光不佳等极端情形下有助于找到初始对齐。此选项默认禁用，正常工作条件下应无需启用。

FILE:
The type of radial basis function (RBF) used to model geometric transformations with two-dimensional surface splines.

DDM (Domain Decomposition Method) RBF interpolation/approximation algorithms require O(n^2) time for spline construction, in contrast to standard implementations, which have O(n^3) time complexity. This makes the DDM-RBF algorithms capable of handling large-scale problems with tens of thousands of data points, while standard algorithms are limited to less than about 3000 points with current hardware. The default option is DDM Thin Plate Spline.
文件:
用于以二维曲面样条建模几何变换的径向基函数（RBF）类型。

DDM（域分解法）RBF 插值/近似算法构建样条需 O(n^2) 时间，而标准实现为 O(n^3) 复杂度。这使 DDM-RBF 算法能处理上万个数据点的大规模问题，而标准算法在当前硬件下受限于约 3000 点以内。默认选项为 DDM 薄板样条。

FILE:
This represents the numer of time the learning rate gets halved because of an overshoot occurred.

An overshoot occurs when the cost function gets increased after a gradient descendant step, this occurs when the increment step is too big.When this condition is detected, the optimizer iteratively reduces the learning rate and attempts to find a stable increment by halving the increment size, until the maximum number of halves is reached.

You may need to increase this parameter as long as the learning rate gets increased to converge a slightly better solution.
文件:
表示因发生超调而把学习率减半的次数。

沿梯度下降一步后代价函数反而增大即为超调，通常因增量步长过大。检测到该情况时，优化器迭代减小学习率，通过把增量减半来寻找稳定增量，直到达到最大减半次数。

若希望在学习率被提高时收敛到略优的解，可能需要增大此参数。

FILE:
Model how the zero point varies across the field of each image, and correct the magnitudes of all the stars for it, the variable star included. Errors of the flat field, vignetting, differential extinction across a wide field, passing clouds and an obstructing dome make the zero point vary across the field. The models are fitted to all the good stars of the field, whatever the limits of distance and color, without the 20% bluest and the 20% reddest of them.

Only comparison stars that every enabled correction applies to are used: the others are excluded and listed.
文件:
建模每幅图像视场内零点的变化，并据此校正所有星点（含变星）的星等。平场误差、暗角、宽视场的差分消光、飘过的云与遮挡的圆顶都会让零点在视场内变化。模型拟合到视场中所有良好的星点，不受距离与颜色限制，但排除最蓝的 20% 与最红的 20%。

只使用所有已启用校正都适用的比较星；其余的被排除并列出。

FILE:
This section generates samples used to model the relative gradient between the reference and target images.

The overlap region is divided up into a grid of sample squares. A sample's value is the median of the pixels it contains.

Samples are rejected if they contain one or more zero pixels in either image or if they are too close to a bright star.

Two surface splines are constructed from the generated samples:

  • Overlap model, used to correct the overlap area.
  • Target model, used to correct the rest of the target image.
文件:
本节生成用于建模参考与目标图像之间相对梯度的采样。

重叠区域被划分为采样方格网格，采样值为其所含像素的中值。

若采样在任一图像中含一个或多个零像素，或过于靠近亮星，则被剔除。

由生成的采样构建两条曲面样条：

  • 重叠模型，用于校正重叠区域。
  • 目标模型，用于校正目标图像其余部分。

FILE:
Identify an object of interest—a variable star, an exoplanet host, a blazar—and report it first, under its name, for every image. The object is located on the detection image, which must have an astrometric solution: the star nearest to the given coordinates within the search radius, whose fitted position replaces them. Not finding it is an error.

The object is always measured, whatever the maximum number of stars, and must lie inside the region of interest when there is one. It is never matched with a catalog star, so it never takes part in the calibration of the magnitudes.
文件:
识别一个关注天体——变星、系外行星宿主、耀变体——并在每幅图像的结果中以它的名称列在最前。该天体在检测图像上定位，检测图像必须有天文解算：取搜索半径内距给定坐标最近的星，并用其拟合位置替代给定坐标；找不到即为错误。

无论最大星点数多少，该天体总会被测量，且存在感兴趣区域时必须位于其中。它从不与星表星匹配，因此绝不参与星等校准。

FILE:
When this option is enabled, topocentric places take into account polar motion corrections to compute the geocentric position and velocity of the observer. This involves calculation of CIP coordinates with respect to the ITRS, as well as access to a database of CIP/ITRS positions which is part of the core PixInsight distribution.

Polar motion introduces changes at the mas level for calculation of topocentric coordinates of the Moon. For the rest of objects, the effect of polar motion corrections is completely negligible, although the required computation time is also negligible.
文件:
启用此选项时，地面观测者位置会考虑极移改正以计算观测者的地心位置与速度。这涉及计算 CIP 相对 ITRS 的坐标，并访问作为 PixInsight 核心发行版一部分的 CIP/ITRS 位置数据库。

极移在月球地面观测者坐标计算中引入毫角秒级变化；对其他天体，极移改正的影响完全可忽略，而所需计算时间同样可忽略。

FILE:
If this option is checked, the image registration process will use triangle similarity instead of polygonal descriptors for the star matching routine.

Polygonal descriptors are more robust and accurate, but cannot register images subject to specular transformations (horizontal and vertical mirror). Triangle similarity works well under normal conditions and is able to register mirrored images, so it is the default option in the WBPP script. If you need more control on image registration parameters, check the calibrate only option and align your images manually after calibration.
文件:
勾选此项时，图像对齐进程在星点匹配例程中使用三角形相似而非多边形描述符。

多边形描述符更稳健、更精确，但无法对齐经历镜像变换（水平与垂直镜像）的图像。三角形相似在正常条件下表现良好且能对齐镜像图像，因此是 WBPP 脚本的默认选项。若需更精细地控制对齐参数，请勾选仅校准选项，在校准后手动对齐图像。

FILE:
Filter type.

Blur
Gausian convolution with standard defiation defined by the filter radius.

High pass
Calculated as 0.5 + BlendImage - Blur filtered BlendImage

Hue
A greyscale blend image is colourised in HSV colour space. An RGB blend image is converted to greyscale by extracting the CIELightness channel and then colourised in HSV colour space.

Colour
For greyscale images this is the same as the Hue filter. For colour images each channel is colourised separately based on the HSV colour space. See the documentation for more detail.
文件:
滤镜类型。

模糊
以滤镜半径定义标准差的高斯卷积。

高通
计算为 0.5 + 混合图像 - 模糊后的混合图像

色相
灰度混合图像在 HSV 色彩空间中着色；RGB 混合图像先提取 CIEL 亮度通道转为灰度，再在 HSV 空间中着色。

彩色
对灰度图像与「色相」滤镜相同；对彩色图像，各通道基于 HSV 色彩空间分别着色。详见文档。

FILE:
Star flux tolerance is used to prevent invalid target to reference star matches. Smaller values reject more matches.

Star matches are rejected if the difference in star flux is larger than expected. The algorithm first calculates the average scale difference, and then rejects matches if their brightness ratio is greater than (expected ratio * tolerance) or smaller than (expected ratio / tolerance)

1.0 implies the star flux ratio must exactly match the expected ratio.

2.0 implies that the ratio can be double or half the expected ratio.

You usually don't need to modify this parameter.
文件:
星点通量容差用于防止目标星与参考星的错误匹配，数值越小剔除的匹配越多。

若星点通量差异超出预期，该匹配会被剔除。算法先计算平均比例差，然后剔除亮度比大于（预期比 × 容差）或小于（预期比 / 容差）的匹配

1.0 表示星点通量比必须与预期比完全一致。

2.0 表示该比可为预期比的两倍或一半。

通常无需修改此参数。

FILE:
Estimate the gain of the camera, for the photon noise term of the uncertainty, from the sky background of the images: the variance of the background grows with its level, and the level of the sky changes over a series. The gain is estimated over a grid across the field, and every star is given the gain at its position: after flat fielding, the gain of a vignetted corner is lower than at the center.

The estimate needs a series of at least eight unregistered images over which the sky changes, with the airmass, the Moon or twilight. When it cannot be made, the gain below is used, and the console says why.
文件:
为不确定度的光子噪声项，根据图像天空背景估计相机增益：背景方差随其电平增长，而一个序列中天空电平会变化。增益在横跨视场的网格上估计，每颗星采用其所在位置的增益；平场校正后，暗角处的增益低于中心。

该估计需要至少八幅未对齐、且天空随大气质量、月亮或暮光变化的图像。无法估计时使用下方增益，控制台会说明原因。

FILE:
The Blend and Average modes can produce artifacts around stars. This occurs if target and reference stars have different profiles, or slightly different positions. In these cases, the Average algorithm can result in bloated or 'double' stars. The Blend algorithm can produce speckles around these stars.

This control specifies the percentage of outlier pixels that these algorithms should ignore. The higher the value, the less likely these artifacts become. However, if the value is too high, the join will not blend as effectively.

The default of 2% usually works well, but some images may need much higher values.
文件:
混合与平均模式可能在星点周围产生伪影，原因是目标星与参考星轮廓不同或位置略有偏差。此时平均算法可能产生膨胀或「双」星，混合算法可能在这些星周围产生斑点。

此控件指定这些算法应忽略的离群像素百分比。数值越高，伪影越不易出现；但过高会使拼接融合效果变差。

默认值 2% 通常表现良好，但某些图像可能需要高得多的值。

FILE: If enabled, a surface simplification algorithm will be applied to the lists of control points for surface spline generation. The use of surface simplification greatly improves the efficiency of surface splines by removing all redundant points and keeping only the control points required to define the coordinate transformations accurately. In addition, the applied surface simplification algorithm implements robust PCA fitting and outlier rejection techniques that improve the generated interpolation devices in terms of resilience to noise and invalid data in the underlying astrometric solution. This option should normally be enabled.
文件: 启用时，会对用于生成曲面样条的控制点列表应用曲面简化算法。曲面简化通过去除全部冗余点、只保留精确定义坐标变换所需的控制点，大幅提升曲面样条效率。此外，该算法实现了稳健的 PCA 拟合与离群剔除技术，使生成的插值装置对底层天文解算中的噪声与无效数据更具韧性。此选项通常应启用。

FILE:
Add an elliptical region to the mask. Click this, then drag on the preview to draw an ellipse. Hold Alt for a perfect circle from the center, or hold Ctrl mid-drag to rotate the ellipse - so it can be sized and angled in one go. Click again for each extra region - the mask is the union of them all.

Edit any region on the preview: click inside it to select it, then drag the yellow edge squares to resize, the blue corner circles to rotate, and the center to move. Feather, White mask and Region strength below apply to the selected region. Press Delete or Remove to delete it.
文件:
向蒙版添加一个椭圆区域。点击此按钮后在预览上拖动画出椭圆；按住 Alt 可从中心画正圆，拖动中按住 Ctrl 可旋转椭圆——一次即可确定大小与角度。再点一次可添加更多区域，蒙版为它们全部区域的并集。

在预览上编辑任意区域：点击其内部选中，然后拖动黄色边方块缩放、蓝色角圆圈旋转、中心移动。下方羽化、白色蒙版与区域强度作用于所选区域。按 Delete 或「移除」删除它。

FILE:
Size of the noise reduction filter.

This is the radius in pixels of a Gaussian convolution filter applied to the working image used for calculation of star positions during the star detection phase. Use it only for very low SNR images, where the star detector cannot find reliable stars with default parameters.

Be aware that noise reduction will modify star profiles and hence the way star positions are calculated, resulting in a less accurate image registration. Under extreme low-SNR conditions, however, this is probably better than working with the actual data anyway.

To disable noise reduction, set this parameter to zero.
文件:
降噪滤波器的尺寸。

这是星点检测阶段中用于计算星点位置的工作图像所应用高斯卷积滤波器的半径（像素）。仅用于极低信噪比图像——默认参数下星点检测器无法找到可靠星点时。

注意降噪会改变星点轮廓，从而改变星点位置的计算方式，导致图像对齐精度下降。不过在极低信噪比条件下，这大概仍优于直接使用原始数据。

设为零可禁用降噪。

FILE: Specifies the transformation equations to use for stretching. In most cases this will be the Generalised Hyperbolic Stretch equations designed for this script. Other options include the standard HT/STF and arcsinh functions to which the script brings additional functionality. Set to 'Linear stretch' to set the black-point or white-point levels and conduct a linear stretch to regain contrast. The linear stretch also allows you to increase dynamic range by setting black-point less than zero or white-point above 1. 'Invert Image' inverts the target image which can be useful to work on brighter areas, after which the image can be re-inverted.
文件: 指定拉伸所用的变换方程。多数情况下使用为本脚本设计的广义双曲拉伸方程；其他选项包括标准 HT/STF 与反双曲正弦函数，脚本为其带来额外功能。设为「线性拉伸」可设定黑点或白点电平并进行线性拉伸以恢复对比度；线性拉伸还可通过把黑点设为小于零或白点设为大于 1 来增大动态范围。「反相图像」可反转目标图像，便于处理较亮区域，之后可再反相回来。

FILE:
Reference system of celestial coordinates:

ICRS (International Celestial Reference System). The image solver will use astrometric positions computed from catalog star coordinates and properties. This includes space motion (proper motions, parallax and radial velocity, when available) and gravitational deflection of light.

GCRS (Geocentric Celestial Reference System). The image solver will use proper positions. These include the same transformations applied to compute astrometric positions, plus annual and diurnal aberration (rigorous relativistic model) to obtain the true direction of each source as seen by the observer.
文件:
天球坐标参考系统：

ICRS（国际天球参考系统）。图像解算器使用由星表星点坐标与属性计算的天体测量位置，包含空间运动（可用时的自行、视差与视向速度）及光线引力偏折。

GCRS（地心天球参考系统）。图像解算器使用真位置，即在计算天体测量位置的同样变换之上，加入周年与周日光行差（严格相对论模型），得到观测者所见的每个源的真实方向。

FILE:
Reference system of celestial coordinates.

ICRS (International Celestial Reference System). The image solver will use astrometric positions computed from catalog star coordinates and properties. This includes space motion (proper motions, parallax, and radial velocity, when available) and gravitational deflection of light.

GCRS (Geocentric Celestial Reference System). The image solver will use proper positions. These include the same transformations applied to compute astrometric positions, plus annual and diurnal aberration (rigorous relativistic model) to obtain the true direction of each source as seen by the observer.

FILE:
Use this mode to dissolve the target image into the reference. This is particularly useful if the two images have very different signal to noise ratios.

On the reference side of the join, between the two green lines, pixels are randomly chosen from the reference and target images. The contribution from the target image is tapered from 0% at the reference side to 100% at the target side.

Use the 'Join' button to view and adjust the size and position of this Join Region.

The bright green line indicates the join position. Try to keep it within the sample grid area and, if possible, avoid image corners, bright stars and contrasty areas.
文件:
用此模式把目标图像溶入参考图像，两图信噪比差异很大时尤其有用。

在拼接的参考侧、两条绿线之间，像素从参考与目标图像中随机选取；目标图像的贡献从参考侧的 0% 渐增到目标侧的 100%。

用「拼接」按钮查看并调整此拼接区域的大小与位置。

亮绿色线表示拼接位置，尽量保持在采样网格区域内，并尽可能避开图像边角、亮星与高对比区域。

FILE: Equalize the frames with a tone curve per frame and channel fitted on their overlaps, instead of one exposure gain per channel. Photographs out of a camera differ by exposure, white balance and the tone curve of the camera, so the ratio of two frames depends on the level: one gain, measured at the control points on textured ground, overcorrects a bright sky, where the eye sees the seams. Each curve is the line of the exposure gain of its frame plus a deviation fitted on the matched quantiles of the overlaps, solved for all the frames at once relative to the anchor; the curves include the exposure, so the exposure gains are not used. Enabled by default.
文件: 用按各帧重叠区拟合、每帧每通道一条的色调曲线来均衡各帧，而不是每通道一个曝光增益。相机直出的照片在曝光、白平衡与相机色调曲线上各不相同，因此两帧之比取决于电平：用有纹理地面上的控制点测出的单一增益，会过度校正明亮天空，而人眼恰能看出那里的接缝。每条曲线为其帧曝光增益的直线加上按重叠区匹配分位数拟合的偏差，相对锚图像一次性求解全部帧；曲线已包含曝光，故不再使用曝光增益。默认启用。

FILE:
When this option is enabled, multiple PSF models, including Gaussian and several Moffat functions, will be fitted for each star. The function that best matches the actual image data will be selected. This optimizes PSF fitting adaptively to find the most accurate centroid coordinates for each detected source, but at the cost of a much higher computation time. When this option is disabled only Gaussian PSFs will be fitted.

This option is disabled by default. It can be enabled to achieve the highest possible accuracy in the computed astrometric solution with distortion corrections, although the improvements are usually very small, and often marginal.
文件:
启用此选项时，会为每颗星拟合多种 PSF 模型（含高斯与若干 Moffat 函数），并选择与真实图像数据最匹配者。这能自适应优化 PSF 拟合，为每个检测源找到最精确的质心坐标，代价是计算时间大幅增加。禁用时只拟合高斯 PSF。

此选项默认禁用；可启用以在带畸变校正的天文解算中获得尽可能高的精度，不过提升通常很小，往往只是边际改善。

FILE:
Transmission graph: Plots (Transmission)/(Maximum transmission) for date ordered images.

Weight graph: Plots (Weight/time)/(Maximum weight/time). The weights are divided by exposure time so that, for example, points plotted for a 5 minute and 10 minute exposure taken in identical conditions will be displayed with the same value.

  • Green X: Reference image.
  • Blue X: Rejected due to transmission.
  • Red X: Rejected due to weight.

If the reference image is not included in the target list, it is displayed as image zero.

Left-click on a point to display the filename in the title bar.
文件:
透过率图：按日期排序绘制（透过率）/（最大透过率）。

权重图：绘制（权重/时间）/（最大权重/时间）。权重除以曝光时间，因此相同条件下 5 分钟与 10 分钟曝光的点会显示为相同数值。

  • 绿色 X：参考图像。
  • 蓝色 X：因透过率被剔除。
  • 红色 X：因权重被剔除。

若参考图像不在目标列表中，显示为第 0 幅图像。

左键点击某点可在标题栏显示文件名。

FILE:
Factor in sigma units applied to calculate the maximum threshold for rejection of outlier star pair matches. Iterative surface spline generation is controlled by an adaptive, two-dimensional outlier rejection algorithm that detects pair matches with the potential to degrade the evolution of splines while modeling arbitrary distortions.

This parameter is expressed in units of the dispersion of local sparsity measurements evaluated for the set of star pair matches at each iteration. The larger this parameter, the more tolerant rejection will be applied. Increasing this parameter should only be necessary in challenging cases. The default value is 5 sigmas.
文件:
以 sigma 为单位的因子，用于计算剔除异常星点对匹配的最大阈值。迭代曲面样条生成由自适应二维离群剔除算法控制，该算法在建模任意畸变时检测出可能劣化样条演化的点对匹配。

此参数以每次迭代对星点对匹配集合求得的局部稀疏度测量散布为单位。数值越大，剔除越宽容；仅在棘手情形下才需增大。默认值为 5 sigma。

FILE:
Detect further groups of consistent matches after the main one, such as the layers at different distances of a scene with parallax, and grow the distortion model from all of them. The distortion model interpolates its control points instead of smoothing them, so the boundaries between layers remain sharp; the smoothness parameter is not used. Use it for terrestrial and nightscape images acquired from different positions, where a foreground object and the background are related by distinct transformations.

Leave it disabled for lunar and planetary images, which have no parallax: the interpolation of the control points reproduces their measurement errors.
文件:
在主要一致匹配组之外继续检测其他组，例如有视差场景不同距离上的层，并用全部组扩展畸变模型。该畸变模型对控制点做插值而非平滑，因此层与层之间的边界保持锐利，不使用平滑度参数。适用于从不同位置拍摄的地面与夜景图像，其中前景与背景由不同变换关联。

月面与行星图像没有视差，请保持禁用：插值控制点只会复现其测量误差。

FILE:
Take for seam stars only the stars that stand out from the structures around them. The bright compact features of an extended object composed from several frames, such as craters and peaks on the Moon or lights and details of a landscape, are detected and fitted as stars, but each one taken from a single frame would show the outline of its region. With this option they are blended as the rest of the image, and the regions of the stars stay away from the edges of the frames.

For night landscapes with stars over a bright foreground. Not for deep-sky images: the stars on the bulge of a galaxy or on a bright nebula would be excluded too. Disabled by default.
文件:
只把从周围结构中凸显出来的星点作为接缝星。由多帧合成的延展天体上的亮而紧凑的特征（月面环形山与山峰、地景灯光与细节）会被当作星点检测并拟合，但若每颗只取自单帧，就会显出其区域的轮廓。启用此选项后它们与图像其余部分一样被混合，星点区域远离各帧边缘。

适用于明亮前景上方有星点的夜景，不适用于深空图像：星系核球或亮星云上的星点也会被排除。默认禁用。

FILE:
In the following blend mode definitions we define:
a = Base Image
b = Blend Image

Replace: b
Darken/Min: min(a, b)
Multiply: a*b
Colour burn: 1 - min((1 - a)/b, 1)
Linear burn: a + b - 1
Darker colour: b if BaseImage CIEL* > BlendImage CIEL*, a otherwise
Lighten/Max: max(a, b)
Screen: 1 - (1 - a)*(1 - b)
Colour dodge: min(a/(1 - b), 1)
Linear dodge/Add: min(a + b, 1)
Lighter colour: a if BaseImage CIEL* > BlendImage CIEL*, b otherwise
Overlay: 1 - 2*(1 - a)*(1 - b) if a > 0.5, 2*a*b otherwise
Soft light: (1 - 2*b)*a*a + 2*a*b
文件:
以下混合模式定义中约定：
a = 基础图像
b = 混合图像

替换： b
变暗/最小值： min(a, b)
正片叠底： a*b
颜色加深： 1 - min((1 - a)/b, 1)
线性加深： a + b - 1
深色： 若基础图像 CIEL* > 混合图像 CIEL* 取 b，否则取 a
变亮/最大值： max(a, b)
滤色： 1 - (1 - a)*(1 - b)
颜色减淡： min(a/(1 - b), 1)
线性减淡/相加： min(a + b, 1)
浅色： 若基础图像 CIEL* > 混合图像 CIEL* 取 a，否则取 b
叠加： a > 0.5 时 1 - 2*(1 - a)*(1 - b)，否则 2*a*b
柔光： (1 - 2*b)*a*a + 2*a*b

FILE: Check this option to perform a pixel rejection in the small-scale image, based on the pixel values of the target image before applying any processing. It works by measuring the background area noise and setting a rejection limit in sigma units towards the higher pixel values. In this way all pixels with higher values than the defined limit will be rejected in the small-scale component image, preventing them from altering the statistical properties of the lines. This is useful to reject big areas of bright objects, like a galaxy or a nebula. The rejected pixel values are set to 1 in the small-scale image, so they will be rejected when we calculate the statistics of the line.
文件: 勾选此项可在小尺度图像中执行像素剔除，依据为做任何处理之前目标图像的像素值。其原理是测量背景区域噪声，并以 sigma 为单位向较高像素值方向设定剔除限。这样所有高于该限的像素都会在小尺度分量图像中被剔除，防止它们改变线条的统计特性。这对剔除星系、星云等大面积明亮天体很有用。被剔除像素在小尺度图像中置为 1，计算线条统计时会被排除。

FILE:
When no reference image of the MARS databases contains a frame or a mosaic, compose a reference from the MARS images that cover parts of it: a mosaic of MARS master frames, converted to common flux units, with their background levels equalized in their overlaps. Wide-field mosaics larger than a MARS image cannot be corrected otherwise.

This is a fallback, not a rigorous option. The gradient correction of each MARS master frame has been verified through a strict manual procedure, but a mosaic of adjacent master frames has not been verified, and its accuracy cannot be guaranteed. It is never used when a MARS master frame contains the image.

Disabled by default.
文件:
当 MARS 数据库中没有参考图像包含某帧或某幅马赛克时，用覆盖其各部分的 MARS 图像拼出参考：由 MARS 主帧组成的马赛克，转换为统一通量单位，并在重叠区均衡背景电平。大于单幅 MARS 图像的宽视场马赛克无法用别的方式校正。

这是兜底方案，不是严格选项。每张 MARS 主帧的梯度校正都经严格人工流程验证，但相邻主帧拼成的马赛克未经验证，精度无法保证。若某张 MARS 主帧包含该图像，则绝不会使用此方案。

默认禁用。

FILE:
Show the sample rejection for the target image surface spline model.

  • Blue line: the transition between the detailed overlap correction and the smoother correction applied to the rest of the target image. The smoother target correction is gradually tapered in. The blue line indicates the start of this taper.
  • Blue circles: Star rejection circles. The brighter stars should be completely within these circles. Aim to include their filter halos and scattered light. This prevents local gradients around bright stars affecting the gradient correction across the target image. Rejecting local gradients is particularly important near the blue line.
文件:
显示目标图像曲面样条模型的采样剔除情况。

  • 蓝线：精细重叠校正与应用于目标图像其余部分的较平滑校正之间的过渡，较平滑的目标校正被逐渐引入，蓝线标示该渐隐的起点。
  • 蓝圈：星点剔除圆圈，较亮星点应完全位于圈内，尽量纳入其滤镜光晕与散射光。这可防止亮星周围的局部梯度影响整幅目标图像的梯度校正，蓝线附近剔除局部梯度尤为重要。

FILE:
Displays the generated samples, the stars used to reject samples, and the location of the join between the reference and target images. Provides edit sliders for all 'Sample Generation' section parameters.

Samples are rejected if they:

  • Contain too many zero pixels in either image.
  • Are too close to a star included in the 'Limit stars %' range.
The surviving samples are drawn as squares. The stars used to reject samples are indicated by circles.

Two surface splines are constructed from the generated samples:

  • Overlap model, used to correct the overlap area.
  • Target model, used to correct the rest of the target image.
文件:
显示生成的采样、用于剔除采样的星点，以及参考与目标图像之间拼接的位置。提供「采样生成」区所有参数的编辑滑块。

采样在以下情况被剔除：

  • 在任一图像中含过多零像素。
  • 过于靠近「限制星点 %」范围内的星点。
保留的采样画为方形，用于剔除采样的星点以圆圈表示。

由生成的采样构建两条曲面样条：

  • 重叠模型，用于校正重叠区域。
  • 目标模型，用于校正目标图像其余部分。

FILE:
If this parameter is disabled, a local maxima map will be generated to identify and prevent detection of multiple sources that are too close to be separated as individual structures, such as double and multiple stars. In general, sources with several local maxima pose difficulties for the determination of accurate star positions.

If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects. This can be necessary in special cases where extreme high noise levels and/or distortion of stellar images caused by optical aberrations limit the number of detectable sources excessively, preventing image registration.

The default state is disabled.
文件:
禁用此参数时，会生成局部极大值图，用于识别并阻止检测过近而无法分离为单个结构的多重源（如双星、聚星）。一般来说，含多个局部极大值的源难以确定精确的星点位置。

启用时，不可分离的多重源可作为单个对象自由检测。在极高噪声和/或光学像差造成的星像畸变使可检测源数量过少、以致无法对齐图像的特殊情形下，这样做可能是必需的。

默认状态为禁用。

FILE:
Display the weight graph.

The displayed weight is adjusted for exposure time. These exposure scaled weights represent the sky conditions. We want to reject images that were badly affected by light pollution or clouds, but we don't want to reject images just because they had a shorter exposure.

There are several reasons we reject based on sky conditions. Light pollution usually includes gradients, which may become difficult to remove. High levels of light pollution also tend to reveal flat field errors.

If the only problem with an image is its lower SNR, then it will still improve the final integrated image SNR. This works because NSG uses a very accurate 'SNR squared' weight algorithm.
文件:
显示权重图。

显示的权重已按曝光时间调整，这些按时长缩放的权重代表天空条件。我们希望剔除受光污染或云严重影响变差，不希望仅因曝光较短就剔除图像。

按天空条件剔除有多重理由：光污染通常伴随梯度，可能难以去除；高水平光污染还容易暴露平场误差。

若图像唯一的问题是信噪比偏低，它仍会提高最终叠加图像的信噪比——因为 NSG 使用非常精确的「SNR 平方」权重算法。

FILE:
The filter of the selected grayscale images. The frames of each filter are composed into a mosaic of their own, and all the mosaics have the same geometry, so that they can be combined.

From metadata: the filter the image states, as the XISF Instrument:Filter:Name property or the FILTER keyword, which stands for a filter when it is one of its aliases (see Preferences), or else the filter its file name gives, by the file name patterns of the preferences. Any other filter: assigned to the image, whatever its metadata states, for images whose metadata are wrong or missing.

The images that state no filter form a mosaic of their own, and so do the images of each filter name without an alias.
文件:
所选灰度图像的滤镜。每个滤镜的帧各自合成一幅马赛克，且所有马赛克几何相同，以便合成。

来自元数据：图像所声明的滤镜，即 XISF Instrument:Filter:Name 属性或 FILTER 关键字；若为某滤镜的别名之一（见偏好设置）则代表该滤镜，否则按偏好设置的文件名模式由文件名给出。任何其他滤镜：为元数据错误或缺失的图像直接指定给图像的滤镜，无论其元数据如何声明。

未声明滤镜的图像自成一图，没有别名的每个滤镜名称的图像也各自成图。

FILE:
A script primarily intended to colourise and blend linear mono narrowband images. Constituent layers can be 'pre-stretched' to better match their intensity profiles. RGB colour images can be included in the blended image, colour will not be applied to such layers. Layers can also be modified by multiplcation or addition with other layers. This feature brings considerable flexibility, eg the script can be used for continuum subtraction. The background of the resulting image can be neutralized. If any constituent layer has an astrometric solution this is copied to the final image.

The script has been designed in consultation with Adam Block (www.adamblockstudios.com).

文件:
本脚本主要用于为线性单色窄带图像着色并混合。组成图层可「预拉伸」以更好匹配其强度分布；RGB 彩色图像可纳入混合，但不会对其着色。图层还可通过与其他图层相乘或相加来修改，这带来很大灵活性，例如本脚本可用于连续谱相减。结果图像的背景可中和；若任一组成图层带有天文解算，会复制到最终图像。

本脚本与 Adam Block (www.adamblockstudios.com) 协商设计。

FILE:
Maximum distance in pixels between a detected star and a catalog star for them to be considered the same object.

Stars are matched using the solution being analyzed, so this tolerance has to exceed the residual of that solution, not the distortion being measured. For a solution with a distortion model the residual is a fraction of a pixel and the default is ample.

For a linear solution the two are the same thing. Its residual is the whole uncorrected distortion, so a tolerance smaller than the displacement of the outer regions will fail to match the very stars that carry the most distortion, and the field will be measured only where it is already small. Raise it until the number of matched stars stops growing.
文件:
检测星点与星表星之间被视为同一天体的最大距离（像素）。

星点用正在分析的那个解来匹配，因此此容差必须超过该解的残差，而非正在测量的畸变。对含畸变模型的解，残差只有几分之一个像素，默认值足够宽裕。

对线性解，两者是同一回事。其残差就是全部未校正畸变，因此容差若小于外缘区域的位移，就无法匹配上恰恰携带最多畸变信息的星点，场只能在畸变本已很小处被测量。请增大容差直到匹配星点数不再增长。

FILE:
Demosaiced/interpolated images can be generated as combined RGB color images, as separate RGB channels stored as monochrome images, or applying both options at the same time.

Generation of single RGB color images is the default option.
Separate RGB channel images can be useful for correction of non-isotropic channel misalignments such as those caused by chromatic aberration and atmospheric dispersion, by computing image registration transformations with distortion correction among all color components of a data set. This procedure is compatible with normal image integrations as well as drizzle integrations.

Separate channel file names will carry the _R, _G and _B suffixes, respectively for the red, green and blue components.
文件:
去马赛克/插值后的图像可生成为合成 RGB 彩色图像、作为灰度图像分别存放的 RGB 通道，或同时采用两种方式。

默认生成单幅 RGB 彩色图像。
分离的 RGB 通道图像可用于校正非各向同性的通道错位（如色差与大气色散所致），方法是在数据集所有颜色分量之间计算带畸变校正的图像对齐变换。此流程与普通图像叠加及 Drizzle 叠加均兼容。

分离通道的文件名分别带 _R、_G、_B 后缀，对应红、绿、蓝分量。

FILE:
A CSV output has three parts: a header with the title, the observer, the reference image (the detection image, or else the first image) and, when an object of interest is defined, the object and the observation of it; a table of images, with the observation time of each image (UTC, JD and BJD TDB), its exposure, the location of the observer, the numbers of detected and matched stars, the zero point, the airmass and the filter; and the data table.

Single file writes the three parts to the output file, one after another, separated by an empty line. Separate files writes them to three files named after the output file: name-header.csv, name-images.csv and name-data.csv, each one a plain table for other programs.
文件:
CSV 输出由三部分组成：文件头（标题、观测者、参考图像——检测图像或第一幅图像——以及定义关注天体时的天体与其观测）、图像表（每幅图像的观测时间 UTC、JD 与 BJD TDB，曝光、观测者位置、检测与匹配星点数、零点、大气质量与滤镜），以及数据表。

单文件把三部分依次写入输出文件，以空行分隔。分离文件把它们写到以输出文件命名的三个文件：name-header.csv、name-images.csv 与 name-data.csv，各自为供其他程序读取的纯表格。

FILE:
Minimum size of a detectable star structure in square pixels.

This parameter can be used to prevent detection of small and bright image artifacts as stars. This can be useful to work with uncalibrated or wrongly calibrated data, especially demosaiced CFA frames where hot pixels have generated large bright artifacts that cannot be removed with a median filter (i.e., the Hot pixel removal parameter).

Changing the default zero value of this parameter should not be necessary with correctly acquired and calibrated data. It may help, however, when working with poor quality data such as poorly tracked, poorly focused, wrongly calibrated, low-SNR raw frames, for which our image registration algorithms and tools have not been designed specifically.
文件:
可检测星点结构的最小尺寸（平方像素）。

此参数可防止把小而亮的图像伪影检测为星点，适用于未校准或校准有误的数据，尤其是去马赛克 CFA 帧中热像素生成了无法用中值滤波（即热像素去除参数）消除的大块亮伪影。

对正确采集并校准的数据，通常无需改动默认值零。但处理跟踪不佳、失焦、校准有误、低信噪比原始帧等低质量数据时可能有所帮助——我们的图像对齐算法与工具并非专为这类数据设计。

FILE:
This implementation of background neutralisation uses the "Rescale as needed" working mode. After background neutralisation the image is rescaled so that the pixel values range from 0 to 1.

This works well when the image has bright stars in it so the brightest pixels before neutralisation are close to 1. However, when the image is starless, as is usually the case in this script, it can lead to the image being overly bright.

To avoid this, rescaling can be modified to avoid stretching the brghtest pixels (which may not be very bright!) to a value of 1.

Checking this checkbox represents the standard implementation of "Rescale as needed". If this leaves your image too bright, eg when dealing with starless images, we recommend leaving it unchecked.
文件:
此背景中和实现使用「按需重缩放」工作模式：中和后把图像重缩放，使像素值落在 0 到 1。

图像含亮星、中和前最亮像素接近 1 时效果良好；但本脚本通常处理无星图像，此时会导致图像过亮。

为避免这一点，可修改重缩放，不把最亮像素（可能并不很亮！）拉伸到 1。

勾选此复选框即采用「按需重缩放」的标准实现；若结果过亮（例如处理无星图像），建议取消勾选。

FILE:
Use this mode to seamlessly blend the two sides of the join. This is particularly useful if the two images have very different signal to noise ratios.

On the reference side of the join, between the two green lines, the pixels are a weighted average of the reference and target pixels. The weights taper across the join region, from 100% target at the target side to 100% reference at the reference side. At the centre, each provides a 50% contribution, which improves the signal to noise ratio (which may or may not be desirable).

Use the 'Join' button to view and adjust the size and position of this Join Region.

The bright green line indicates the join position. Try to keep it within the sample grid area and, if possible, avoid image corners, bright stars and contrasty areas.
文件:
用此模式无缝融合拼接线两侧，两图信噪比差异很大时尤其有用。

在拼接的参考侧、两条绿线之间，像素为参考与目标像素的加权平均；权重在拼接区域内渐变，从目标侧的 100% 目标到参考侧的 100% 参考。中央处各占 50%，可提高信噪比（这可能未必是你想要的）。

用「拼接」按钮查看并调整此拼接区域的大小与位置。

亮绿色线表示拼接位置，尽量保持在采样网格区域内，并尽可能避开图像边角、亮星与高对比区域。

FILE:
The blind solver finds the center coordinates and scale of the image from the detected stars alone, without initial approximations, with the astrometric index file configured in the preferences of the Gaia process.

Automatic: The blind solver is used when the image provides no valid center coordinates or image scale and you have not entered them in this dialog, and when the initial alignment fails with the available initial values. Values remembered from previous executions are not trusted in this mode.

Always: The initial center coordinates and image scale are ignored, and the image is always solved blindly.

Disabled: The blind solver is never used. The initial center coordinates and image scale are required.

Automatic is the default and recommended mode.

盲解算器仅从检测到的星点求出图像中心坐标与比例尺，无需初始近似值，使用 Gaia 进程偏好设置中配置的星表索引文件。

自动：当图像没有有效中心坐标或图像比例尺、且你未在本对话框中输入，或用现有初始值做初始对齐失败时，启用盲解算。此模式下不信任上次运行记住的数值。

禁用：从不使用盲解算，必须提供初始中心坐标与图像比例尺。

「自动」为默认且推荐的模式。

FILE:
The sampling region takes the local background from a square around the region the PSF was fitted over, twice as wide, outside the star. That region was found by adaptive median stabilization, so it reaches the background of each star.

An annulus takes it from a ring around the star. The ring follows the size of each star rather than a fixed radius.

In both cases, other stars are rejected first, and the level is a robust estimate of what remains.

Stabilized median takes it by adaptive median stabilization: the median of a square centered on the star, starting at its sampling region and grown a pixel at a time until the median stops decreasing. The star occupies a shrinking fraction of the square, so the median falls to the level of the background and stays there.
文件:
采样区域从 PSF 拟合区域周围、宽度为其两倍、位于星点之外的方形取局部背景。该区域由自适应中值稳定化找出，因此能到达每颗星的 background。

圆环从星点周围的环取背景，环随每颗星的尺寸变化而非固定半径。

两种情况下都会先剔除其他星点，电平为剩余像素的稳健估计。

稳定化中值用自适应中值稳定化取值：以星点为中心的方形中值，从其采样区域开始每次增大一个像素，直到中值不再下降。星点在方形中所占比例不断缩小，中值遂降到背景电平并保持不变。

FILE:
Assign an event script, invoked while the pipeline runs.

The script observes the execution, it does not decide what it contains: use the Pipeline builder for that. It is called at the beginning and at the end of the run, and around every tracked operation, and it may stop the run by calling env.requestInterruption().

Declare one function per event:

function onPipelineStart( env, state ) { ... }
function onOperationStart( env, state ) { ... }
function onOperationDone( env, state ) { ... }
function onPipelineEnd( env, state ) { ... }

env describes the event, state is yours to keep data across events. A script that fails is reported and the run carries on.

See the commented example in the examples folder of the script installation.
文件:
指定一个在流程运行期间调用的事件脚本。

该脚本只观察执行过程，不决定流程内容——那由流程构建器负责。它在运行开始与结束时、以及每个受跟踪操作的周围被调用，并可通过调用 env.requestInterruption() 中止运行。

为每个事件声明一个函数：

function onPipelineStart( env, state ) { ... }
function onOperationStart( env, state ) { ... }
function onOperationDone( env, state ) { ... }
function onPipelineEnd( env, state ) { ... }

env 描述事件，state 由你用来在事件之间保留数据。脚本失败会被报告，运行继续。

参见脚本安装目录 examples 文件夹中带注释的示例。

FILE:
Assign a pipeline builder script to customize the WBPP pipeline.

The pipeline builder, if assigned, is responsible for building the pipeline for the light frames only. WBPP remains responsible for the bias, dark and flat frames, and the generation of the corresponding master files.

To keep the standard processing and just add your own steps, build the default pipeline first and then append to it:

engine.pipelineManager.buildPipelineForLight();
engine.operationQueue.addOperationBlock( myStep );

In case of error, the default pipeline will be used as a fallback. A builder that completes without adding any operation is not an error, so no fallback applies: the light frames are simply left unprocessed.

See the commented example in the examples folder of the script installation.

指定一个流程构建器脚本以自定义 WBPP 流程。

若已指定，构建器只负责为亮场构建流程；偏置、暗场、平场及相应主帧的生成仍由 WBPP 负责。

若想保留标准处理并追加自己的步骤，可先构建默认流程再追加：

engine.pipelineManager.buildPipelineForLight();
engine.operationQueue.addOperationBlock( myStep );

出错时回退到默认流程。构建器执行完成但未添加任何操作不算错误，因此不触发回退：亮场只是保持未处理。

参见脚本安装目录 examples 文件夹中带注释的示例。

FILE:
Point the tools at the mask instead of the image.

While ticked, LR Tools, Curves, Noise Reduction, Sharpening and Wavelet Sharpening change the mask itself and the preview shows it in grayscale (white = full effect, black = none). Raise Contrast or Whites to harden it, pull Blacks to cut the background out, use the curve to shape the transition, Clarity or Texture to follow the detail, Noise Reduction to smooth it.

Untick to go back to editing the image - the sliders jump back to the image's own values, and the refined mask keeps working: every tool now acts through it. Colour tools (white balance, saturation, Selective Color, HSL, SCNR, colour noise) are disabled while editing the mask, because a mask has no colour.

The mask edits stay until Reset mask edits, and are saved with a New Instance.

让工具作用于蒙版而非图像。

勾选期间，局部调整工具、曲线、降噪、锐化与小波锐化修改的是蒙版本身，预览以灰度显示（白 = 完全生效，黑 = 不生效）。提高对比度或白色可使其变硬，压低黑色可切掉背景，用曲线塑造过渡，用清晰度或纹理跟随细节，用降噪使其平滑。

取消勾选即回到编辑图像——滑块会跳回图像自身的数值，而精修后的蒙版继续生效：每个工具现在都透过它起作用。编辑蒙版期间色彩工具（白平衡、饱和度、可选颜色、HSL、SCNR、色彩噪声）会禁用，因为蒙版没有颜色。

蒙版编辑会一直保留到重置蒙版编辑，并随「新建实例」一起保存。

FILE:
Maximum star distortion.

Internally, star distortion is evaluated in units of coverage of a square region circumscribed to each detected structure. The coverage of a perfectly circular star is π/4 (about 0.8). Lower values denote elongated or irregular sources.

To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum distortion, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.

Use this parameter, if necessary, to control inclusion of elongated stars, complex clusters of stars, and nonstellar image features. The default value is 0.6. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.
文件:
最大星点畸变。

内部以每个检测结构外接正方形区域的覆盖率单位来评估星点畸变：完美圆形星点的覆盖率为 π/4（约 0.8），数值越低表示源越拉长或不规则。

为把界面与内部实现隔离，此参数归一化到 [0,1] 范围，0 与 1 分别表示最小与最大畸变。这一抽象让我们能更换星点检测引擎而不破坏依赖它的工具与进程。

必要时用此参数控制是否纳入拉长星点、复杂星团及非恒星图像特征。默认值 0.6；正常工作条件下通常无需改动。

FILE:
Detection on each image measures every star found on each image, numbered as they are measured. Nothing links a star of one image with the same star on another.

A photometric catalog measures the stars found on each image that it identifies within its magnitude limits, and gives them catalog magnitudes, which a zero point can be calibrated against.

A detection image measures the stars of the detection image, fitting their PSFs on every image where they are expected. A star whose fit fails is measured at its expected position with the PSF of the image. This is how a long series of noisy frames, such as those of an exoplanet transit, is measured, and what a light curve needs.

A photometric catalog needs celestial coordinates on every image: an astrometric solution, or else a solved detection image.
文件:
逐图像检测测量每幅图像上找到的每颗星，按测量顺序编号，一幅图像上的星与另一幅上的同一颗星之间没有任何关联。

测光星表测量每幅图像上在其星等限内被识别出的星，赋予星表星等，用于校准零点。

检测图像测量检测图像的星点，在预期出现它们的每幅图像上拟合其 PSF；拟合失败的星按该图像的 PSF 在其预期位置测量。系外行星凌星等长序列低噪帧正是这样测量的，光变曲线也正需要它。

测光星表要求每幅图像都有天球坐标：天文解算，或已解算的检测图像。

When checked, the local normalization reference frame for each group will remain the same as the one selected or generated in the previous execution.

Keeping the reference frame from the previous execution is beneficial when adding new light frames to an existing WBPP group to increase the total integration time. By ensuring the same reference frame is used for each group, WBPP can utilize the previously cached files that are still on disk, avoiding the need to select or generate the local normalization reference again. This way, only the new files will be measured and normalized, preventing the need to reprocess the entire dataset.

The previous reference frames are reused when available: the groups without one (first execution, new groups, deleted files) get a local normalization reference frame selected or generated in the current execution.

勾选后，各组的局部归一化参考帧保持与上次执行所选或所生成的相同。

向已有 WBPP 分组追加新亮场以增加总叠加时间时，沿用上次的参考帧很有好处：确保各组使用同一参考帧后，WBPP 可利用磁盘上仍存在的缓存文件，无需再次选择或生成局部归一化参考。这样只测量并归一化新文件，避免重处理整个数据集。

可用时会复用上次的参考帧：没有参考帧的组（首次执行、新组、文件被删除）在本次执行中选择或生成局部归一化参考帧。

FILE:
How each field is drawn.

  • Vectors — an arrow per lattice cell over the deformed lattice. This is the only form that shows the direction of the distortion.
  • Grayscale — the magnitude as a continuous tone, rescaled to [0,1]. The result is a one channel, 32-bit floating point image with no legend drawn on it: a measurable data product, which can be compared with, and subtracted from, any other map rescaled with the same white point.
  • Vectors over grayscale — the arrows over the continuous magnitude, as a picture.

A field taken from the solution model is rendered from a lattice much finer than the one used for the arrows, because it can be evaluated anywhere at no cost. A measured field is rendered at the resolution at which it was measured, and looks coarser: that difference is real.
文件:
每个场的绘制方式。

  • 矢量 — 在变形网格上每个单元格画一个箭头，这是唯一能显示畸变方向的形式。
  • 灰度 — 把幅值作为连续色调重缩放到 [0,1]。结果为单通道 32 位浮点图像，不绘制图例：是可测量的数据产品，可与任何以相同白点重缩放的图比较或相减。
  • 灰度上叠加矢量 — 把箭头画在连续幅值之上，作为一张图。

取自解模型的场从比箭头所用网格细得多的网格渲染，因为它在任意处求值都无代价；测量场按其测量分辨率渲染，看起来更粗——这种差别是真实的。

FILE:
Model how the zero point of each image depends on the color of the stars, with a straight line fitted to their zero points corrected for gradients against their catalog color index, and correct the magnitudes of all the stars for it, the variable star included, at its own color. Filters that differ from the standard bands, the spectral sensitivity of the camera and the extinction of the atmosphere make stars of different colors give different zero points.

The line is fitted to all the stars of the field with a color index, and applies within the range of colors of the stars the robust fits keep: comparison stars outside it are excluded.

The color of the variable star is its catalog color index with one band, and its measured color with two bands. Without a color for the variable star, or with one outside that range, no color term is applied to any star.

Defines the coordinate origin and orientation convention assumed by the WBPP script for input FITS files.

Global Pref.: Adopt the convention specified by global FITS format preferences.

top-down: All input FITS files follow the top-down coordinate convention. The coordinate origin is at the top left corner of the image, and vertical coordinates grow from top to bottom. This is the convention used by most amateur camera control applications.

bottom-up: All input FITS files follow the bottom-up coordinate convention. The coordinate origin is at the bottom left corner of the image, and vertical coordinates grow from bottom to top.

Note that existing ROWORDER FITS keywords will always take precedence over this setting. Nonstandard ROWORDER keywords have been supported by our FITS format module since PixInsight core version 1.8.8-6.

FILE:
Star detection sensitivity.

Internally, the sensitivity of the star detection algorithm is expressed in signal-to-noise ratio units with respect to the evaluated dispersion of local background pixels for each detected structure. Given a source with estimated brightness s, local background b and local background dispersion n, sensitivity is the minimum value of (s - b)/n necessary to trigger star detection.

To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum sensitivity, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.

Increase this parameter to favor detection of fainter stars. Decrease it to restrict detection to brighter stars. The default value is 0.5.

星点检测灵敏度。

内部以相对每个检测结构局部背景像素评估散布的信噪比单位表示检测算法灵敏度。设某源估计亮度为 s、局部背景为 b、局部背景散布为 n，则灵敏度是触发星点检测所需的 (s - b)/n 最小值。

为把界面与内部实现隔离，此参数归一化到 [0,1] 范围，0 与 1 分别表示最小与最大灵敏度。这一抽象让我们能更换星点检测引擎而不破坏依赖它的工具与进程。

增大此参数有利于检测更暗的星点，减小则只检测较亮的星点。默认值 0.5。

Maximum number of stars allowed for image registration.

With the default <Auto> option, the WBPP script does not impose any restrictions on the maximum number of stars used by the StarAlignment process for image registration. This means that the 2000 brightest stars will be used for each image by default. If you want to speed up the image registration process you can specify a smaller amount for this parameter, say 500 stars for example, which can be sufficient to achieve an accurate alignment for similar images without differential distortions.

If your images suffer from field distortions and the data set includes significantly displaced or rotated frames, such as frames affected by meridian flips for example, then you should enable the distortion correction option. In such case this parameter will be ignored and the StarAlignment tool will select the required stars automatically.

FILE:
Clamping threshold for the bicubic spline and Lanczos interpolation algorithms.

The main drawback of the Lanczos and bicubic spline interpolation algorithms is generation of strong undershoot (ringing) artifacts. This is caused by negative lobes of the interpolation functions falling over high-contrast edges and isolated bright pixels. This usually happens with linear data, such as raw CCD and DSLR images, and rarely with nonlinear or stretched images.

In the current PixInsight/PCL implementations of these algorithms we have included a clamping mechanism that prevents negative interpolated values and ringing artifacts for most images. This parameter represents a threshold value to trigger interpolation clamping. A lower threshold leads to a more aggressive deringing effect; however, too low of a clamping threshold can degrade interpolation performance, especially in terms of aliasing and detail preservation.
文件:
双三次样条与 Lanczos 插值算法的钳位阈值。

Lanczos 与双三次样条插值的主要缺点是产生强烈的下冲（振铃）伪影，原因是插值函数的负瓣落在高对比边缘与孤立亮像素上。这通常发生在 CCD/单反原始图像等线性数据上，非线性或已拉伸图像很少出现。

当前 PixInsight/PCL 实现已加入钳位机制，对多数图像可防止负插值与振铃伪影。此参数为触发插值钳位的阈值：阈值越低去振铃越激进，但过低会降低插值性能，尤其在混叠与细节保持方面。

The maximum number of control points allowed for the generation of surface splines using DDM-RBF algorithms.

When a DDM-RBF is selected, this parameter allows to specify the maximum number of control points (or reference stars) that will be used (after surface simplification) to generate the 2-D interpolating/approximating surface splines that will be used to model coordinate transformations in the astrometric solution. For DDM-RBF types, this parameter can be specified in the range from 1000 to 25000 control points. The default value is 4000 points, usually sufficient for most practical applications. Increase this parameter to achieve more accuracy in the solution at the expense of more computational work. DDM-RBF surface spline generation has O(n^2) time complexity.

For standard RBF types, which require O(n^3) time for spline construction, this parameter is ignored and a maximum of 2100 control points is imposed.

对构建样条需 O(n^3) 的标准 RBF 类型，此参数被忽略，并强制最多 2100 个控制点。

Correct the gradients along the edges of the mosaics at smaller scales, in their gradient correction with MARS (the edge correction of MultiscaleGradientCorrection).

Gradients are often stronger along the edges of an image, where they need a smaller gradient scale than the rest of the image. The gradient models are also computed at half, a quarter and an eighth of the gradient scale, as many as the aggressiveness (never below 128 pixels); each model replaces the previous one on a frame along the edges as wide as its scale, with a smooth transition. On a mosaic, the frames follow the edges of its coverage. The rest of the image is not changed. The scale factors are the same for all scales.

The gradient correction of the frames never uses it: in a mosaic, the edges of a frame are mostly seams, where smaller scales would model as gradients the bright structures that the seams cross.

Disabled by default. The default aggressiveness is 2.

在用 MARS 做梯度校正时（MultiscaleGradientCorrection 的边缘校正），以更小尺度校正马赛克边缘沿线的梯度。

图像边缘处梯度往往更强，需要比图像其余部分更小的梯度尺度。梯度模型还按梯度尺度的二分之一、四分之一与八分之一计算，层数与激进程度相同（绝不低于 128 像素）；每个模型在沿边缘、宽度等于其尺度的条带内以平滑过渡替换前一个。在马赛克上，帧沿其覆盖范围的边缘走；图像其余部分不变，各尺度使用相同比例因子。

对帧的梯度校正从不使用它：在马赛克中帧的边缘多为接缝，更小尺度会把接缝穿过亮结构误建模为梯度。

默认禁用，默认激进程度为 2。

FILE:
Minimum size of a detectable star structure in square pixels.

This parameter can be used to prevent the detection of small and bright image artifacts wrongly as stars. This can be useful to work with uncalibrated or poorly calibrated data, especially demosaiced CFA frames where uncorrected hot pixels have generated large bright artifacts that cannot be removed with a median filter (i.e., the Hot pixel removal parameter), or for rejection of cosmic rays.

This parameter can be used in three ways:

* Automatic mode. A zero value enables an adaptive algorithm to find an optimal minimum structure size using statistical analysis techniques. This is the default option.

* Disabled. A value of one turns off minimum structure size rejection since no detectable star can be represented by less than one pixel.

* Literal value. A value > 1 forces using the specified minimum structure size in square pixels.

可检测星点结构的最小尺寸（平方像素）。

此参数可防止把小而亮的图像伪影误检为星点，适用于未校准或校准不佳的数据，尤其是去马赛克 CFA 帧中未校正热像素生成了无法用中值滤波（即热像素去除参数）消除的大块亮伪影，也可用于剔除宇宙线。

此参数有三种用法：

* 自动模式。为零时启用自适应算法，用统计分析找出最优最小结构尺寸，这是默认选项。

* 禁用。设为 1 时关闭最小结构尺寸剔除，因为没有可检测星点会小于一个像素。

* 字面值。大于 1 时强制使用指定的最小结构尺寸（平方像素）。

Model the local distortions that the global transformation cannot represent with recursive point surface splines of the refined control points: the registered images are resampled with the global transformation plus the splines. Useful for wide fields, images acquired with different instruments, and images across a meridian flip. Requires the full resolution refinement.

The distortion model grows iteratively from the global transformation: the features of both images are matched with their positions predicted by the current model, pairs of anomalous local sparsity are rejected, and the model is fitted again, so it reaches regions of strongly varying distortion. The refinement measures the control points at the pairs of the final model.

In mosaic mode, a distortion model shared by all the frames is fitted to the control points of all their overlaps, as a smooth function of the position on the frame, and each frame gets a model of its own residuals, confined to its overlaps.

Per image fits a smoothing surface spline to the zero points of each image: it follows any smooth gradient, fixed or changing, at the cost of some noise.

Global fits a single surface fixed to the detector to the zero points of all the images: errors of the flat field and vignetting, which follow the detector through dithering and meridian flips. It adds almost no noise, but it cannot follow gradients that change from image to image.

Global + per image, the default, adds to the global surface a smoothing surface spline fitted on each image to the differences between the zero points and the global surface, for the gradients that change, such as those of the differential extinction or of passing clouds.

A local model fitted to fewer than 100 stars is reported: multiplicative gradients are unstable, and so are models of them made from few stars.

The global models need the positions of the stars on the images, which AperturePhotometry writes to its data tables.

全局对所有图像的零点拟合固定于探测器的单一曲面：对应平场误差与暗角，它们会随抖动与中天翻转跟着探测器走。它几乎不增加噪声，但无法跟随逐幅变化的梯度。

Some image acquisition applications store apparent or 'of the date' coordinates in image metadata without providing the necessary metadata items for our knowledge. If the initial alignment task fails and this option is enabled, a second attempt will be initiated, assuming that the center coordinates are apparent.

This feature is helpful for relatively narrow-field images with wrong apparent center coordinates in their metadata. The difference between ICRS/astrometric and apparent coordinates may cause the center coordinates to lie outside image boundaries. In these cases, the initial alignment task cannot succeed, and the plate-solving process will fail.

In cases where this feature allows us to solve the image, a warning message will be written to the console. If you see many such warnings in your logs, please contact the developers of your image acquisition software to let them know about this error. They should fix it by including the necessary metadata to identify apparent coordinates:

XISF property: Observation:CelestialReferenceSystem = "True"
FITS keyword: RADESYS = "GAPPT"

If this field is left blank (or with its default "<integrate...>" value), the compiler output will be integrated with the running PixInsight platform. Note that this requires full read/write access permissions on the 'doc' subdirectory of the running PixInsight distribution. FILE:
Correct the gradients of each mosaic once composed, with MultiscaleGradientCorrection and the MARS database at a large gradient scale. Small residual gradients of the frames accumulate errors in the normalization of their overlaps, especially in wide-field mosaics: this global correction removes them.

Each mosaic is flux calibrated with SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration, and its calibration is stored with it; the scale factors of MARS are fitted automatically. A MARS image must contain the whole mosaic, unless MARS reference mosaics are allowed (a fallback; see below). Before the composition, every flux calibrated frame is checked for MARS reference data, so that a frame without them stops the process early.

Automatic: the gradient scale nearest to a quarter of the smaller side of the mosaic, from 2048 to 8192 pixels.

Requires the MARS database files configured in MultiscaleGradientCorrection and the Gaia DR3/SP database configured in the Gaia process. The MARS databases do not cover the Southern hemisphere yet: correct those mosaics with the MultiscaleGradientCorrection process and a reference image.
文件:
马赛克合成后，用 MultiscaleGradientCorrection 与较大梯度尺度下的 MARS 数据库校正每幅马赛克的梯度。帧的微小残余梯度会在重叠区归一化中累积误差，宽视场马赛克尤甚，此全局校正可将其消除。

每幅马赛克用 SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration 做通量校准，校准结果与它一起保存；MARS 比例因子自动拟合。一张 MARS 图像必须包含整幅马赛克，除非允许 MARS 参考马赛克（兜底方案，见下）。合成前会检查每幅已通量校准的帧是否有 MARS 参考数据，没有则提前中止流程。

自动：取最接近马赛克短边四分之一的梯度尺度，范围 2048 到 8192 像素。

需要在 MultiscaleGradientCorrection 中配置 MARS 数据库文件，并在 Gaia 进程中配置 Gaia DR3/SP 数据库。MARS 数据库目前尚未覆盖南半球：那些马赛克请用 MultiscaleGradientCorrection 进程与参考图像校正。

FILE:
Compute the intersection region between the catalog reference field and the target image in the initial alignment task.

When this option is applied, a special FFT-based algorithm is used to precompute the intersection region between the reference star field and the set of detected stars in the target image during the initial alignment task. Once the intersection has been found, the initial star matching process is restricted to the intersection area. This greatly improves the performance of the RANSAC algorithm by reducing the fraction of outliers (false putative matches) in the initial set of star pair matches. This feature is recommended for images with elongated geometries, especially when the aspect ratio (the quotient between the longest and shortest sides of the image) is approximately greater than two, as well as for problematic images with abnormally scarce detectable stars.

The Never option will turn off intersection computation. Automatic will calculate intersection regions only when the image's aspect ratio is greater than 2:1. Always will force intersection computations in all cases.
文件:
在初始对齐任务中计算星表参考场与目标图像的交集区域。

应用此选项时，会在初始对齐期间用基于 FFT 的专用算法预计算参考星场与目标图像检测星点集合的交集区域；找到交集后，初始星点匹配被限制在该区域内。这通过降低初始星点对匹配集合中离群（错误候选匹配）的比例，大幅提升 RANSAC 算法性能。推荐用于细长几何形状的图像，尤其是长宽比（最长边与最短边之比）约大于 2 时，也适用于可检测星点异常稀少的问题图像。

从不关闭交集计算；自动仅在图像长宽比大于 2:1 时计算交集区域；始终在所有情况下强制计算交集。

FILE:
Derivative order of continuity of variable-order two-dimensional surface splines.

Second-order polyharmonic radial basis functions, also known as thin plate splines, allow for generating extremely adaptable numerical models for images affected by strong field distortions. However, in cases of extremely complex arbitrary distortions, higher-order functions can be necessary to model them accurately.

When a variable-order polyharmonic RBF is selected, the function order can be selected from 2 to 6. High-order surface splines compute interpolation/regularization functions that are continuously differentiable up to the specified order and, hence, can more accurately model complex distortions. However, high-order splines, especially of orders above 4, are numerically more unstable and can lead to errors caused by ill-conditioned linear systems.

The recommended options are:

  • DDM thin plate splines (implicitly of second order) for distortion correction under normal conditions. This is the default option.
  • 3rd order DDM variable-order polyharmonic or 4th order variable-order polyharmonic RBFs for correction

变阶二维曲面样条的连续可微阶数。

二阶多重调和径向基函数（也称薄板样条）能为受强视场畸变影响的图像生成适应性极强的数值模型；但对极其复杂的任意畸变，可能需要更高阶函数才能精确建模。

选择变阶多重调和 RBF 时，函数阶数可取 2 到 6。高阶曲面样条计算的插值/正则化函数可连续可微到指定阶数，因而能更精确建模复杂畸变；但高阶样条（尤其 4 阶以上）数值上更不稳定，可能因病态线性方程组而产生误差。

推荐选项：

  • 正常条件下的畸变校正用 DDM 薄板样条（隐含二阶），这是默认选项。
  • 3 阶 DDM 变阶多重调和或 4 阶变阶多重调和 RBF 用于复杂畸变的校正

FILE:
The region of the fitted PSF measures each star over the elliptical region of its own point spread function, extended by the growth factor. The region adapts to every star: to the seeing, to the position in the field, and to the focus of each frame, so the same fraction of the light of every star is measured. Each region carries the error of its own fit, which a time series measured differentially cannot cancel.

A circular aperture measures over a circle of a fixed radius in pixels, the classical way. It is reproducible by other software and independent of the fit, and the same for every star, which is what the differential photometry of a time series needs.

An automatic circular aperture is computed for each image from the robust mean FWHM of its stars, with the diameter given below, and is the same for every star of the image. It follows the seeing from one image to the next, and needs no radius to be chosen for each instrument or night. This is the default.

In both cases the flux is the sum of the actual pixels over the region, above the local background. The fitted function is never integrated in place of the data.
文件:
拟合 PSF 区域在每颗星自身点扩散函数的椭圆区域（按增长因子扩展）内测量它。区域会适应每颗星——视宁度、视场位置与每帧的焦点，因此每颗星测量的都是相同比例的光。每个区域带有自身拟合的误差，差分测量的时间序列无法将其抵消。

圆形孔径在固定像素半径的圆内测量，是经典方式；可被其他软件复现、不依赖拟合、且对每颗星相同，正是时间序列差分测光所需要的。

自动圆形孔径按每幅图像星点的稳健平均 FWHM 计算，直径由下方给定，对该图像所有星点相同。它随视宁度逐幅变化，无需为每台仪器或每个夜晚选定半径，这是默认选项。

两种情况下通量都是区域内高于局部背景的实际像素之和，绝不用拟合函数叠加替代数据。

FILE:
Peak sensitivity of the star detection device.

Internally, the peak response property of the star detection algorithm is expressed in kurtosis units. For each detected structure, kurtosis is evaluated from all significant pixels with values greater than the estimated mean local background. Peak response is the minimum value of kurtosis necessary to trigger star detection.

To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum peak response, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.

If you decrease this parameter, stars will need to have stronger (or more prominent) peaks to be detected. This is useful to prevent detection of saturated stars, as well as small nonstellar features. By increasing this parameter, the star detection algorithm will be more sensitive to peakedness, and hence more tolerant with relatively flat image features. The default value is 0.5. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.
文件:
星点检测装置的峰值灵敏度。

内部以峰度单位表示检测算法的峰值响应属性：对每个检测结构，用所有大于估计平均局部背景的显著像素评估峰度；峰值响应即触发星点检测所需的最小峰度值。

为把界面与内部实现隔离，此参数归一化到 [0,1] 范围，0 与 1 分别表示最小与最大峰值响应。这一抽象让我们能更换星点检测引擎而不破坏依赖它的工具与进程。

减小此参数时，星点需要更强（更突出）的峰才能被检测到，有助于防止检测饱和星点及小的非恒星特征；增大时算法对尖锐度更敏感，因而更容忍相对平坦的图像特征。默认值 0.5；正常工作条件下通常无需改动。

FILE:
Compute rigid transformations instead of projective transformations (or homographies).

A two-dimensional rigid transformation, or Euclidean transformation, preserves the Euclidean distance between every pair of transformed points. Rigid transformations may include rotations, translations and reflections in any order.

A two-dimensional projective transformation, or homography, is a line-preserving geometric transformation between two sets of points in the plane. Homographies can model translations, rotations, reflections, scale changes and shearing in any order.

By default, StarAlignment computes homographies to model complex linear image registration transformations with the maximum accuracy. However, with only 3 degrees of freedom, rigid transformations can be more robust and faster, requiring fewer RANSAC iterations even when dealing with a high proportion of outliers in the initial set of putative star pair matches.

Note that this option is relevant for all registration models, including linear and nonlinear models with arbitrary distortion correction using surface splines. In the latter case, a linear model is always necessary to build an initial registration transformation before modeling distortions.
文件:
计算刚性变换而非投影变换（单应性）。

二维刚性变换（欧氏变换）保持任意两变换点之间的欧氏距离，可按任意顺序包含旋转、平移与反射。

二维投影变换（单应性）是平面上两组点之间保持直线的几何变换，可按任意顺序建模平移、旋转、反射、尺度变化与剪切。

StarAlignment 默认计算单应性，以最高精度建模复杂的线性图像对齐变换。但刚性变换只有 3 个自由度，可更稳健、更快，即使初始候选星点对集合中离群比例很高，也只需更少的 RANSAC 迭代。

注意此选项适用于所有对齐模型，包括线性模型以及用曲面样条做任意畸变校正的非线性模型；后者在建模畸变之前，始终需要一个线性模型来建立初始对齐变换。

Compute topocentric star places.

When this option is disabled, star positions are computed relative to the geocenter.

Diurnal aberration is caused by the velocity of the observer on or near the surface of the rotating Earth. The effect of diurnal aberration is relatively small (a maximum of about 0.32 arcseconds for an observer at the Equator), but not negligible for astrometric solutions in the GCRS.

计算地面观测者星位置。

启用此选项时，天体测量与真星位置按观测地点相对地球质心计算，使用下方指定的大地坐标：经度、纬度与高度；禁用时星位置相对地心计算。

FILE:
Protect the light frames against abnormally high weights.

Image weights are relative to the best frame of each group. A frame with an abnormally high weight, usually caused by spurious data or wrong metadata, makes the rest of the frames look bad. This can lead to rejecting valuable data, even entire data sets, through the minimum weight parameter.

When this option is enabled, a PSF Signal Weight, PSF SNR or SNR measurement is abnormal when it is greater than the upper quartile of its group divided by the protection threshold parameter. Abnormally weighted frames receive the median weight of their group, unless the reject abnormally weighted frames option is enabled. They are never used as reference frames for registration or local normalization. The integration applies the same protection to each channel of color images.

Abnormal weights are identified in up to one fourth of the frames of a group. Groups where most frames have much lower weights than the best ones, for example frames acquired through clouds, are protected correctly. However, this option assumes that the best frames of a group have similar weights. Disable it to integrate frames whose weights are expected to differ greatly, for example frames of very different exposure times grouped together.
文件:
保护亮场帧免受异常高权重影响。

图像权重相对各组最佳帧而言。异常高的权重（通常由虚假数据或错误元数据造成）会让其余帧显得很差，可能通过最小权重参数剔除有价值的数据，甚至整个数据集。

启用此选项时，PSF 信号权重、PSF SNR 或 SNR 测量值大于本组上四分位数除以保护阈值参数即判为异常。除非启用剔除异常权重帧，异常权重帧取本组权重中位数；它们绝不作为对齐或局部归一化的参考帧。叠加对彩色图像的每个通道应用相同保护。

一组中最多四分之一的帧会被识别为异常权重。多数帧权重远低于最佳帧的组（例如透过云层拍摄的帧）能得到正确保护。不过此选项假定一组的最佳帧权重相近；若要叠加权重预期差异很大的帧（例如把曝光时间相差很大的帧分到一组），请禁用它。

FILE:
Model the coordinate transformations of the astrometric solution with recursive point surface splines through simplified sets of control points.

A recursive surface spline subdivides the image with a quadtree and generates a surface spline for each region and its neighborhood, blending them as a partition of unity into a surface that is continuous up to the second derivative. This allows the solution to use all the matched stars, tens or hundreds of thousands of them, in a fraction of a second, with no limit on the number of control points. The radial basis function and the maximum spline points parameters are not used in this mode; the smoothing factor and the spline order are. When surface simplifiers are enabled, the simplifier's outlier rejection is applied to the control points before the splines are generated, with the specified rejection fraction.

Astrometric solutions are serialized with the standard set of XISF AstrometricSolution properties, which describe the distortion model itself, so the core application restores the solution exactly when the image is loaded, without regeneration. This applies to every solution generated by this version of ImageSolver, with or without this option. Previous versions of PixInsight do not recognize this format and load such images without an astrometric solution.

This option is disabled by default.
文件:
用经过简化的控制点集的递归点曲面样条，建模天文解算的坐标变换。

递归曲面样条用四叉树细分图像，为每个区域及其邻域生成一条曲面样条，再按单位分解把它们混合成二阶连续可微的曲面。这使解能在几分之一秒内使用全部匹配星点（数万到数十万颗），且控制点数无限制。此模式下不使用径向基函数与最大样条点数参数，但仍使用平滑因子与样条阶数。启用曲面简化器时，会在生成样条之前按指定剔除比例对控制点应用简化器的离群剔除。

天文解算按标准的一组 XISF AstrometricSolution 属性序列化，这些属性描述畸变模型本身，因此核心应用在载入图像时无需重新生成即可精确恢复解。本版 ImageSolver 生成的每个解（无论是否启用此选项）都如此；旧版 PixInsight 不识别该格式，载入此类图像时不会带天文解算。

此选项默认禁用。

Pixel interpolation algorithm

The default automatic mode will select the following interpolation algorithms as a function of the rescaling involved in the registration geometrical transformation:

  • Cubic B-spline filter interpolation when the scaling factor is under 0.25 approximately.
  • Mitchell-Netravali filter interpolation for scaling factors between 0.6 and 0.25 approx.
  • Lanczos-3 interpolation in the rest of cases: from moderate size reductions to no rescaling or rescaling up.

Lanczos is, in general, the best interpolation algorithm for image registration of linear images when no large scale changes are required. Lanczos has excellent detail preservation and subpixel registration performance with minimal generation of aliasing effects. Its main drawback is generation of undershoot (ringing) artifacts, but this problem can be fixed in most cases with the implemented clamping mechanism (see the clamping threshold parameter below).

Bicubic spline is an excellent interpolation algorithm in terms of accuracy and execution speed. As Lanczos interpolation, bicubic spline generates ringing artifacts, but the implemented clamping mechanism can usually fix most of them. The main problem with bicubic spline is generation of aliasing effects, such as moire patterns, which can be problematic with noisy images, especially on sky background areas. This is one of the reasons why Lanczos is in general the preferred option.

像素插值算法

默认自动模式按对齐几何变换所涉及的重缩放选择以下插值算法：

  • 缩放系数约小于 0.25 时用三次 B 样条滤波插值。

双三次样条在精度与执行速度方面都很出色；与 Lanczos 一样会产生振铃伪影，但钳位机制通常能修正大部分。其主要问题是产生摩尔纹等混叠效应，对含噪图像（尤其天空背景区域）可能麻烦，这也是一般首选 Lanczos 的原因之一。

Check this option to enable StarAlignment's arbitrary distortion correction algorithm.

Each pixel in a registered image is interpolated from a set of source image pixels mapped by inverse projection. This parameter defines the general method used to compute source pixel coordinates.

If distortion correction is disabled, a linear transformation (either a projective transformation or homography or a rigid transformation, will be used to compute source pixel coordinates. This is appropriate for general image registration tasks with significant overlapping between registered images without differential distortion. This is the default option.

When distortion correction is enabled, two-dimensional surface splines will be used with second-order polyharmonic radial basis functions (also known as thin plates) to compute a distortion model and interpolate source pixel coordinates. Surface splines provide extremely adaptable registration models for registering images affected by differential distortions. Differential distortions arise frequently in the registration of significantly displaced or rotated frames, as usually happens when some frames have been acquired with the field rotated due to a meridian flip.

The standard StarAlignment process provides many more options and parameters to control how distortion corrections are calculated and applied. Although the limited control provided in the WBPP script is more than sufficient in most practical cases, in really complex cases, you may need to turn off image registration in this script and perform the registration task manually after calibration/demosaicing.

Percentile clipping rejection is excellent to integrate reduced sets of images, such as 3 to 6 images. This is a single-pass algorithm that rejects pixels outside a fixed range of values relative to the median of each pixel stack.

Winsorized sigma clipping is similar to the normal sigma clipping algorithm, but uses a special iterative procedure based on Huber's method of robust estimation of parameters through Winsorization. This algorithm can yield superior rejection of outliers with better preservation of significant data for large sets of images.

Linear fit clipping fits each pixel stack to a straight line. The linear fit is optimized in the twofold sense of minimizing average absolute deviation and maximizing inliers. This rejection algorithm is more robust than sigma clipping for large sets of images, especially in presence of additive sky gradients of varying intensity and spatial distribution. For the best performance, use this algorithm for large sets of at least 15 images. Five images is the minimum required.

The Generalized Extreme Studentized Deviate (ESD) rejection algorithm is an implementation of the method described by Bernard Rosner in his 1983 paper Percentage Points for a Generalized ESD Many-Outlier procedure, adapted to the image integration task. The ESD algorithm assumes that each pixel stack, in absence of outliers, follows an approximately normal (Gaussian) distribution. It aims at avoiding masking, a serious issue that occurs when an outlier goes undetected because its value is similar to another outlier. The performance of this algorithm is excellent for data sets of 15 or more

百分位裁剪剔除非常适合叠加少量图像（如 3 到 6 幅）：这是单遍算法，剔除相对每个像素堆栈中值处于固定范围之外的像素。

Winsorized sigma 裁剪与常规 sigma 裁剪类似，但采用基于 Huber 稳健参数估计方法（通过Winsorization）的特殊迭代过程；对大量图像可获得更优的离群剔除，同时更好地保留显著数据。

线性拟合裁剪把每个像素堆栈拟合到一条直线，拟合在最小化平均绝对偏差与最大化内点的双重意义上优化。对大量图像，尤其存在强度与空间分布各异的叠加天空梯度时，此剔除算法比 sigma 裁剪更稳健；要获得最佳性能，请对至少 15 幅图像使用，最低要求 5 幅。

The local signing identity allows you to generate module and script code signatures using your software license to identify you as a local certified developer without needing to become a Certified PixInsight Developer (CPD). Module signatures are mandatory. Script signatures are still optional, but a local signing identity can be helpful for testing purposes when you are writing scripts that require special security entitlements and also when you want to be sure that the code you have written remains unaltered.

Since the local signing identity is linked to your software license, it can only be used on machines where you have activated your PixInsight license (or where you have a valid license file). To use your local signing identity, you need a special signing keys file (with the .xssk extension) that can be generated using the standard SigningKeys script.

Once you have a signing keys file, select it on this dialog and enter its protection password to create a local certified developer. Check the corresponding option below to make this identity persistent across application sessions. With your local developer identity and signing keys file, you can generate code signatures with the standard CodeSign script, with command-line arguments to the PixInsight core application, or directly from JavaScript code using the Security core PJSR object.

FILE: Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In ImageContainer, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded, while output hints modify the way output image files are written.For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "quality 95" output hint to generate JPEG files with a quality parameter of 95 (in the [0,100] range). Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
