FILE: Noise evaluation algorithm. This option selects an algorithm for automatic estimation of the standard deviation of the noise in the calibrated images.The multiresolution support (MRS) noise estimation routine implements the iterative algorithm described by Jean-Luc Starck and Fionn Murtagh in their paper Automatic Noise Estimation from the Multiresolution Support (Publications of the Royal Astronomical Society of the Pacific, vol. 110, pp. 193-199). In our implementation, the standard deviation of the noise is evaluated on the first four wavelet layers, assuming a Gaussian noise distribution. MRS is a remarkably accurate and robust algorithm and the default option for noise evaluation.The iterative k-sigma clipping algorithm can be used as a last-resort option in cases where the MRS algorithm does not converge systematically. This can happen on images with no detectable small-scale noise, but should never happen with uncalibrated data under normal working conditions.The N* robust noise estimator extracts a subset of residual pixels by comparison with a large-scale model of the local background of the image, generated with the multiscale median transform (MMT). Since the MMT is remarkably efficient at isolating image structures, it can be used to detect pixels that cannot contribute to significant structures. N* is an accurate and robust, alternative estimator of the standard deviation of the noise that does not assume or require any particular statistical distribution in the analyzed data.
文件: 噪声评估算法。该选项用于选择自动估计校准图像中噪声标准差的算法。多分辨率支持（MRS）噪声估计例程实现了 Jean-Luc Starck 与 Fionn Murtagh 在其论文 Automatic Noise Estimation from the Multiresolution Support（Publications of the Royal Astronomical Society of the Pacific，第 110 卷，第 193-199 页）中描述的迭代算法。在我们的实现中，噪声标准差在前四个小波层上评估，并假定噪声服从高斯分布。MRS 是一种极为精确且稳健的算法，也是噪声评估的默认选项。迭代 k-sigma 裁剪算法可作为最后手段，用于 MRS 算法系统性地不收敛的情况。这种情形可能出现在没有可检测小尺度噪声的图像上，但在正常工作条件下不应出现在未校准数据中。N* 稳健噪声估计器通过与图像局部背景的大尺度模型对比来提取残差像素子集，该模型由多尺度中值变换（MMT）生成。由于 MMT 在分离图像结构方面极为高效，因此可用它找出对显著结构没有贡献的像素。N* 是一种精确而稳健的替代型噪声标准差估计器，不假定也不要求被分析数据服从任何特定统计分布。

FILE: This parameter defines when to apply the local normalization functions to generate normalized images. This includes newly created image files for global execution, as well as modifying the target image for view execution.This option is set to view execution only by default because local normalization functions, stored in .xnml files, can be used by the ImageIntegration and DrizzleIntegration processes for normalization in the pixel rejection and/or integration output tasks. This means that the normalization functions can be applied internally by these processes, so writing normalized images to disk files is generally not necessary. In addition, the ImageIntegration and DrizzleIntegration processes apply normalization functions internally without any truncation or rescaling of the data, so the entire data set is always integrated without any loss or artificial alteration when local normalization files are used.For view execution, however, inspecting the transformed image is often necessary for testing purposes. Generation of normalized image files during batch execution can also be useful in very difficult cases, for example when the data set includes strong and large artifacts, such as big plane trails. In these cases you may want to inspect locally normalized images manually with analysis tools such as Blink. Normalized images may also be necessary for applications of local normalization different from integration of astronomical images.
文件: 该参数定义何时应用局部归一化函数以生成归一化图像。包括批处理执行时新建的图像文件，以及视图执行时对目标图像的修改。该选项默认设为仅在视图执行时应用，因为存储在 .xnml 文件中的局部归一化函数可被 ImageIntegration 和 DrizzleIntegration 进程用于像素剔除和/或叠加输出任务中的归一化。这意味着这些进程可以在内部应用归一化函数，因此通常不必把归一化图像写入磁盘文件。此外，ImageIntegration 与 DrizzleIntegration 在内部应用归一化函数时不会对数据做任何截断或重标定，因此使用局部归一化文件时，整个数据集始终无损、无人工改动地被叠加。不过在视图执行时，为测试目的常常需要检查变换后的图像。在批处理执行中生成归一化图像文件在极困难的情形下也有用，例如数据集包含强烈而大范围的伪影（如大的飞机轨迹）时。这类情况下你可能会想用 Blink 等分析工具人工检查局部归一化后的图像。当归零归一化的用途不同于天文图像叠加时，归一化图像也可能是必需的。

FILE: The pedestal mode option specifies how to retrieve a (usually small) quantity that is subtracted from input images as the very first calibration step. This quantity is known as pedestal, and must be expressed in the 16-bit unsigned integer range (from 0 to 65535). If present, a pedestal has been added by a previous calibration process to ensure positivity of the result. For example, you might have specified an output pedestal (see the corresponding parameter above) to enforce positivity of previously calibrated master bias, dark and flat frames.Literal value lets you specify a pedestal value that will be subtracted from all target and master calibration frames. You usually don't need this option, except in very special cases.Default FITS keyword is the default mode. When this mode is selected, ImageCalibration will retrieve pedestal values from 'PEDESTAL' FITS keywords, when they are present in the input images. Note that ImageCalibration writes PEDESTAL keywords to calibrated images when a nonzero output pedestal is specified.Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword to retrieve pedestal values, when the specified keyword is present in the input images.
文件: 基座模式选项指定如何获取一个（通常很小的）量值，它作为校准的第一步从输入图像中减去。该量值称为基座，必须以 16 位无符号整数范围（0 到 65535）表示。如果存在，基座是由先前的校准过程添加的，目的是保证结果为正。例如你可能指定过输出基座（见上方对应参数），以确保先前校准的 主偏置帧、暗场帧与平场帧为正。字面值允许你指定一个基座值，将从所有目标帧和主校准帧中减去。除非极特殊的情形，通常不需要该选项。默认 FITS 关键字是默认模式。选用该模式时，只要输入图像中存在 'PEDESTAL' FITS 关键字，ImageCalibration 就会从中读取基座值。注意，当指定了非零输出基座时，ImageCalibration 会把 PEDESTAL 关键字写入校准后的图像。自定义 FITS 关键字允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字名称，当输入图像中存在该关键字时用它读取基座值。

FILE: In this version of the LocalNormalization process we have implemented two different methods for evaluation of the global relative scale of the reference image with respect to each normalization target image: PSF flux evaluation and multiscale analysis.The PSF flux evaluation method detects stars in the images and fits a point spread function model to each detected source. The fitted PSF parameters are then used to guide evaluation of the total flux of each source, and the fluxes of matched pairs of stars in both images are used to compute a robust and precise scale factor. This method is usually the best choice for normalization of deep-sky astronomical images where stars can be detected efficiently.The multiscale analysis method uses wavelet transforms and morphological operations to isolate significant image structures. The pixels gathered on the intersection between significant structures of the reference and target images are then evaluated statistically to estimate the scale factor.
文件: 在本版 LocalNormalization 进程中，我们实现了两种评估参考图像相对于各归一化目标图像的整体相对尺度的方法：PSF 通量评估与多尺度分析。PSF 通量评估方法在图像中检测恒星，并为每颗检测到的源点拟合点扩散函数模型。拟合得到的 PSF 参数随后用于引导评估每颗源点的总通量，两幅图像中匹配恒星对的通量则用于计算稳健而精确的尺度因子。对于能够高效检测到恒星的深空天文图像，该方法通常是最佳选择。多尺度分析方法使用小波变换与形态学运算分离出显著的图像结构，然后对参考图像与目标图像显著结构交集处汇集的像素做统计分析，以估计尺度因子。

FILE: Saturation threshold in the [0,1] range.Detected stars with one or more pixels with values above this threshold will be excluded for relative scale evaluation. Similarly, when the multiscale analysis method of scale evaluation is selected, significant structure pixels above this value will also be excluded.This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).The default saturation threshold is 0.75. For relative scale evaluation this parameter is crucial in order to prevent contamination of the statistical sample of flux ratios by sources with saturated or nonlinear data. Changing the default value should not be necessary under normal conditions.
文件: [0,1] 范围内的饱和阈值。检测到的恒星若有一个或多个像素高于该阈值，将被排除在相对尺度评估之外。同样，当尺度评估选用多尺度分析方法时，高于该值的显著结构像素也会被排除。该参数以 [0,1] 范围表示，既可视为归一化 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素采样值，也可视为相对于被测图像最大像素采样值的比例（见「相对饱和阈值」参数）。默认饱和阈值为 0.75。在相对尺度评估中，该参数对防止饱和或非线性数据污染通量比的统计样本至关重要。正常情况下无需修改默认值。

FILE: Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In LocalNormalization, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats (reference and target image files) are loaded, while output hints modify the way output normalized image files are written.For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "up-bottom" input hint to load input images from FITS files with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 格式提示允许你为特定进程使用的图像文件覆盖全局文件格式设置。在 LocalNormalization 中，输入提示改变某些特定格式的输入图像（参考图像与目标图像文件）的加载方式，输出提示则改变输出归一化图像的写入方式。例如，你可以用「lower-range」和「upper-range」输入提示来加载由其他不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的程序生成的浮点 FITS 和 TIFF 文件。类似地，你可以指定「up-bottom」输入提示，以坐标原点位于左上角的方式从 FITS 文件加载输入图像。多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式支持若干输入和/或输出提示，配合提供格式提示入口的工具可用于不同目的。

FILE: Compute standardized estimates of the signal present in target calibration frames.Our current implementation uses PSF photometry to generate robust and accurate measures of total and mean flux from detected and fitted sources. These estimates, along with estimates of the standard deviation of the noise, can be used for image grading and weighting with the SubframeSelector and ImageIntegration processes.The signal evaluation result will be stored as a set of custom, per-channel XISF properties and FITS header keywords that other processes and scripts can use for specialized image analysis purposes.This option should always be enabled for calibration of deep-sky, non-CFA raw light frames. For CFA data, signal and noise evaluation should be performed by the Debayer process, and hence this option should be disabled in ImageCalibration
文件: 计算目标校准帧中信号的标准化估计值。我们当前的实现使用 PSF 测光，从检测并拟合的源点生成稳健而精确的总通量与平均通量测量值。这些估计值连同噪声标准差的估计，可用于 SubframeSelector 和 ImageIntegration 进程的图像评级与加权。信号评估结果将存储为一组自定义的逐通道 XISF 属性和 FITS 表头关键字，供其他进程和脚本用于专门的图像分析目的。对深空非 CFA 原始亮帧的校准，应始终启用该选项。对于 CFA 数据，信号与噪声评估应由 Debayer 进程完成，因此在 ImageCalibration 中应禁用该选项

FILE: Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In ImageCalibration, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats (target frames and master calibration frames) are read, while output hints modify the way output calibrated images are written.For example, you can use the "raw cfa" input hints to force the RAW format to load pure raw CFA frames without applying any demosaicing, interpolation, white balance, or black point correction. Similarly, you can use the "up-bottom" input hint to load raw images from FITS files with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 格式提示允许你为特定进程使用的图像文件覆盖全局文件格式设置。在 ImageCalibration 中，输入提示改变某些特定格式的输入图像（目标帧与主校准帧）的读取方式，输出提示则改变输出校准图像的写入方式。例如，你可以用「raw cfa」输入提示强制 RAW 格式加载纯原始 CFA 帧，而不做任何去马赛克、插值、白平衡或黑点校正。类似地，你可以用「up-bottom」输入提示，以坐标原点位于左上角的方式从 FITS 文件加载原始图像。多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式支持若干输入和/或输出提示，配合提供格式提示入口的工具可用于不同目的。

FILE: Normalization scale.LocalNormalization implements a multiscale normalization algorithm. This parameter is the size in pixels of the sampling scale for local image normalization. The larger this parameter, the less locally adaptive the local normalization function will be. Smaller values tend to reproduce variations among small-scale structures in the reference image. Larger values tend to reproduce variations among large-scale structures.To better understand the role of this parameter, suppose we applied the algorithm at the scale of one pixel. The result would be an exact copy of the reference image. On the other hand, if we applied the algorithm at a scale similar to the size of the whole image, the result would be a global normalization: a single linear function would be applied for normalization of the entire target image.
文件: 归一化尺度。LocalNormalization 实现的是多尺度归一化算法。该参数是局部图像归一化采样尺度的像素尺寸。该参数越大，局部归一化函数的局部自适应性就越弱；较小的取值倾向于重现参考图像中小尺度结构之间的差异，较大的取值倾向于重现大尺度结构之间的差异。为更好地理解该参数的作用，假设在单个像素的尺度上应用该算法，结果将是参考图像的精确副本；反之，若在与整幅图像尺寸相近的尺度上应用，则相当于全局归一化：用单个线性函数对整幅目标图像做归一化。

FILE: Select the CFA pattern of the camera (such as a DSLR or OSC camera) used to acquire the calibration master and target frames.The Auto option uses view properties that can be available in the master and target frame files. Under normal working conditions, these properties are either generated automatically by the RAW format support module and stored in XISF files, or available as FITS header keywords in the case of raw OSC frames.For non-CFA data acquired with monochrome CCD or CMOS cameras, the Auto option is the correct selection because in these cases the process will detect no CFA pattern automatically.For images acquired with X-Trans sensors this parameter is ignored and CFA patterns are always extracted from existing image properties.
文件: 选择采集主校准帧与目标帧所用相机的 CFA 排列（如单反或 OSC 相机）。「自动」选项使用主帧与目标帧文件中可能存在的视图属性。正常情况下，这些属性要么由 RAW 格式支持模块自动生成并存于 XISF 文件中，要么在原始 OSC 帧的情况下作为 FITS 表头关键字存在。对于用单色 CCD 或 CMOS 相机采集的非 CFA 数据，「自动」是正确选择，因为这类情况下进程检测不到 CFA 排列。对于 X-Trans 传感器采集的图像，该参数被忽略，CFA 排列始终从已有的图像属性中提取。

FILE: Compute per-channel estimates of the standard deviation of the noise and noise scaling factors for each target image, using a multiscale algorithm (MRS noise estimator by default). Noise estimates will be stored as a set of custom XISF properties and FITS header keywords in the output files.These estimates can be used later by several processes and scripts for specialized image analysis purposes, most notably by SubframeSelector and ImageIntegration for image grading and weighting.This option should always be enabled for calibration of non-CFA raw light frames. For CFA data, signal and noise evaluation should be performed by the Debayer process, and hence this option should be disabled in ImageCalibration in such case.
文件: 为每幅目标图像计算逐通道的噪声标准差估计与噪声缩放因子，采用多尺度算法（默认使用 MRS 噪声估计器）。噪声估计将作为一组自定义 XISF 属性和 FITS 表头关键字存入输出文件。这些估计随后可被多个进程和脚本用于专门的图像分析目的，其中最主要的是 SubframeSelector 和 ImageIntegration 的图像评级与加权。对非 CFA 原始亮帧的校准应始终启用该选项。对于 CFA 数据，信号与噪声评估应由 Debayer 进程完成，故此时应在 ImageCalibration 中禁用该选项。

FILE: Low clipping pixel sample value in the [0,1] range.All pixels with values smaller than or equal to the value of this parameter will be replaced with statistically plausible estimates, computed from nearby image regions.Rejection of very low pixels is necessary to prevent generation of large-scale artifacts around large dark structures, such as black borders generated by image registration. Under normal conditions you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter (4.5×10-5). Increase it in the unlikely case that you detect dark artifacts around black borders—which, at any rate, will always denote a defective image calibration that you should fix before normalization.
文件: [0,1] 范围内的低端裁剪像素采样值。所有小于或等于该参数值的像素将被替换为根据邻近图像区域计算出的统计合理估计值。剔除极低像素是必要的，可防止在大面积暗结构周围产生大尺度伪影，例如图像配准产生的黑色边框。正常情况下无需修改该参数的默认值（4.5×10-5）。若你发现黑色边框周围出现暗伪影（这无论如何都说明图像校准有缺陷，应在归一化之前修正），可增大该值。

FILE: Limit for the modified Chauvenet rejection criterion.A modified Robust Chauvenet Rejection (RCR) routine is used internally by this implementation for rejection of outlier relative scale samples. The larger the value of this parameter, the more samples will be rejected by the RCR algorithm.The original Chauvenet rejection criterion is N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5, where N is the number of measurements and P() represents the probability of x being more than z standard deviations from the mean. This parameter modifies the rejection criterion by replacing 0.5 with an arbitrary limit in the [0,1] range, in order to make the algorithm controllable. The default rejection limit is 0.3.
文件: 修正版 Chauvenet 剔除准则的限值。本实现内部使用修正的稳健 Chauvenet 剔除（RCR）例程来剔除相对尺度的离群样本。该参数值越大，RCR 算法剔除的样本越多。原始 Chauvenet 剔除准则为 N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5，其中 N 为测量次数，P() 表示 x 偏离均值超过 z 个标准差的概率。该参数把 0.5 替换为 [0,1] 范围内的任意限值，以便控制算法行为。默认剔除限值为 0.3。

FILE: Saturation threshold in the [0,1] range.Detected stars with one or more pixels with values above this threshold will be excluded for signal evaluation. This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).The default saturation threshold is 1.0. For signal evaluation, the implemented star detection and outlier rejection routines are normally able to avoid contamination from saturated sources, so the default value of this parameter should not be changed under normal conditions.
文件: [0,1] 范围内的饱和阈值。检测到的恒星若有一个或多个像素高于该阈值，将被排除在信号评估之外。该参数以 [0,1] 范围表示，既可按绝对像素采样值给出，也可按相对于被测图像最大像素采样值的比例给出（见「相对饱和阈值」参数）。默认饱和阈值为 1.0。在信号评估中，所实现的星点检测与离群剔除例程通常能避免饱和源点的污染，因此正常情况下不应修改该参数的默认值。

FILE: Minimum signal-to-noise ratio of a detectable star.Given a source with estimated brightness s, local background b and local background dispersion n, SNR is evaluated as (s – b)/n. Stars with measured SNR below the value of this parameter won't be used for relative scale evaluation.This parameter allows limiting star detection to a subset of the brightest sources in the image adaptively. By requiring relatively high SNR levels in the evaluated sources, the accuracy and robustness of the scale evaluation process can be largely improved. The default value is 40, which is quite appropriate in most cases.
文件: 可检测恒星的最低信噪比。设某源点的估计亮度为 s、局部背景为 b、局部背景离散度为 n，则 SNR 按 (s – b)/n 计算。实测 SNR 低于该参数值的恒星不会用于相对尺度评估。该参数可自适应地把恒星检测限制到图像中最亮的一部分源点上。要求在参与评估的源点上具有较高 SNR，可大幅提高尺度评估过程的精度与稳健性。默认值为 40，在多数情况下都相当合适。

FILE: The maximum number of stars that can be measured to compute mean scale estimates.PSF photometry will be performed for no more than the specified number of stars. The subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for normalization of wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of scale evaluation.
文件: 用于计算平均尺度估计的恒星最大测量数量。PSF 测光最多对指定数量的恒星执行。被测恒星子集总是从检测到的恒星集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。默认值给出 24K 颗恒星的宽裕上限。限制测光样本数量可提升广域帧归一化的性能（这类图像中检测到的恒星可能非常多）；但把测量源点缩减太多会损害尺度评估的精度。

FILE: The maximum number of stars that can be measured to compute PSF flux estimates.PSF photometry will be performed for no more than the specified number of stars. The subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for calibration of wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of signal estimation.
文件: 用于计算 PSF 通量估计的恒星最大测量数量。PSF 测光最多对指定数量的恒星执行。被测恒星子集总是从检测到的恒星集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。默认值给出 24K 颗恒星的宽裕上限。限制测光样本数量可提升广域帧校准的性能（这类图像中检测到的恒星可能非常多）；但把测量源点缩减太多会损害信号估计的精度。

FILE: Maximum fraction of negative or insignificant calibrated pixels allowed in automatic pedestal generation mode.This parameter represents a fraction of the total image pixels in the [0,1] range. When the image has more than this fraction of negative or insignificant pixel values after calibration and the output pedestal mode is set to automatic, the process will generate an additive pedestal to ensure that no more than this fraction of negative or insignificant pixels will be present in the calibrated image.The default value is 0.0001, which represents a 0.01% of the total pixels.
文件: 自动基座生成模式下允许的负值或无效校准像素的最大比例。该参数表示占总图像像素的比例，范围 [0,1]。当校准后图像的负值或无效像素比例超过该值，且输出基座模式设为自动时，进程会生成一个附加基座，以确保校准图像中负值或无效像素的比例不超过该值。默认值为 0.0001，即总像素的 0.01%。

FILE: This parameter defines how to calculate and apply output pedestals.Literal value allows you to specify a pedestal value in 16-bit data number units (DN) with the output pedestal parameter.Automatic will apply an automatically calculated pedestal value to frames that have negative, zero or insignificant (to machine epsilon) minimum pixel values after calibration. Automatic pedestals can be used to ensure positivity of the calibrated image with minimal truncation.See also the auto pedestal limit and output pedestal parameters for more information.
文件: 该参数定义如何计算和应用输出基座。字面值允许你配合输出基座参数，以 16 位数据编号（DN）为单位指定基座值。自动会对校准后最小像素值为负、为零或小到无效（达到机器精度极限）的帧应用自动计算的基座值。自动基座可在截断最小的情况下确保校准图像为正。更多信息参见「自动基座限值」和「输出基座」参数。

FILE: High clipping pixel sample value in the [0,1] range.All pixels with values greater than or equal to the value of this parameter will be replaced with statistically plausible estimates, computed from nearby image regions.Rejection of saturated pixels is necessary to prevent generation of large-scale artifacts around large saturated structures, such as bright stars, in local background models. Under normal conditions you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter (0.85). Decrease it in the unlikely case that you detect dark artifacts around large saturated objects.
文件: [0,1] 范围内的高端裁剪像素采样值。所有大于或等于该参数值的像素将被替换为根据邻近图像区域计算出的统计合理估计值。剔除饱和像素是必要的，可防止局部背景模型中在大面积饱和结构（如亮星）周围产生大尺度伪影。正常情况下无需修改该参数的默认值（0.85）。若你发现大面积饱和目标周围出现暗伪影（这种情况很少见），可减小该值。

FILE: Growing factor for expansion/contraction of the PSF flux measurement region for each source, in units of the Full Width at Tenth Maximum (FWTM).A value of 1.0 means that flux will be measured exclusively from pixels within the elliptical region defined at one tenth of the fitted PSF maximum. Increasing this parameter can inprove accuracy of PSF flux measurements for undersampled images, where PSF fitting uncertainty is relatively large. Decreasing it can be beneficial in some cases working with very noisy data to restrict flux evaluation to star cores. The default value is 1.75.
文件: 每颗源点的 PSF 通量测量区域扩张/收缩的放大系数，单位为十分之一峰值全宽（FWTM）。取值为 1.0 表示只对拟合 PSF 峰值十分之一处所定义椭圆区域内的像素测量通量。增大该参数可提高欠采样图像中 PSF 通量测量的精度（这类图像中 PSF 拟合的不确定性相对较大）；在噪声很大的数据中，减小该参数有助于把通量评估限制在星核范围内。默认值为 1.75。

FILE: If this parameter is disabled, multiple sources too close to be separated as individual structures, such as double and multiple stars, won't be detected for signal evaluation.If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects.This parameter is disabled by default. Under normal conditions, it should always be turned off for the flux calibration task since sources with several local maxima pose difficulties in determining accurate star positions and, more importantly, tend to degrade the quality of PSF photometry.
文件: 若禁用该参数，彼此过近而无法分离为独立结构的多重源点（如双星与聚星）将不会被检测用于信号评估。若启用该参数，不可分离的多重源点可以自由地被当作单个目标检测。该参数默认禁用。正常情况下，通量校准任务应始终关闭它，因为具有多个局部极大值的源点难以确定准确的恒星位置，更重要的是往往会降低 PSF 测光的质量。

FILE: The output pedestal is a small quantity expressed in the 16-bit unsigned integer range (from 0 to 65535). It is added at the end of the calibration process and its purpose is to prevent negative values that can occur sometimes as a result of overscan and bias subtraction. Under normal conditions, you should need no pedestal to calibrate science frames because mean sky background levels should be sufficiently high as to avoid negative values. A small pedestal can be necessary sometimes to calibrate individual bias and dark frames. The default value is zero.
文件: 输出基座是以 16 位无符号整数范围（0 到 65535）表示的小量值。它在校准过程末尾加上，目的是防止过扫描与偏置扣除有时产生的负值。正常情况下，校准科学帧不需要基座，因为平均天空背景水平应足够高以避免负值。校准单张偏置帧和暗场帧时有时需要一个小基座。默认值为零。

FILE: If this parameter is disabled, multiple sources that are too close to be separated as individual structures, such as double and multiple stars, won't be detected for relative scale evaluation.If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects.In general, sources with several local maxima pose difficulties for the determination of accurate star positions and PSF parameters, although this is usually a minor problem for scale evaluation. For this reason this parameter is enabled by default.
文件: 若禁用该参数，彼此过近而无法分离为独立结构的多重源点（如双星与聚星）将不会被检测用于相对尺度评估。若启用该参数，不可分离的多重源点可以自由地被当作单个目标检测。一般而言，具有多个局部极大值的源点难以确定准确的恒星位置和 PSF 参数，不过对尺度评估来说这通常只是小问题。因此该参数默认启用。

FILE: Normalization reference image.Local normalization functions will be calculated for each target image with respect to the reference image, which will be acquired either from an image view, or from an existing disk file.Important: For execution in the global context (batch procedure), if the reference image refers to a disk file that will be part of an image integration task, it must also be included in the target images list. Otherwise no .xnml file and/or normalized image will be generated for the reference image.
文件: 归一化参考图像。局部归一化函数将针对每幅目标图像、相对该参考图像计算；参考图像可取自某个图像视图，也可取自已有的磁盘文件。重要提示：在全局上下文（批处理流程）中执行时，若参考图像指向的磁盘文件将参与某个图像叠加任务，则该文件也必须包含在目标图像列表里。否则不会为参考图像生成 .xnml 文件和/或归一化图像。

FILE: Perform outlier rejection for the normalization reference image.If this option is enabled, the target image (either the target view or the first target file available) will be used to perform rejection of outlier pixels on the reference image. This is only necessary when the reference image can contain relatively large outlier structures, such as big plane trails.This option should normally be disabled when the normalization reference image is of good quality and does not have significant outliers.
文件: 对归一化参考图像执行离群剔除。若启用该选项，将使用目标图像（目标视图或第一个可用的目标文件）对参考图像执行离群像素剔除。仅当参考图像可能含有较大尺度的离群结构（如大的飞机轨迹）时才需要这样做。当归一化参考图像质量良好且没有明显离群结构时，通常应禁用该选项。

FILE: Generate XML normalization data files (XNML format, .xnml files) that can be used with the ImageIntegration and DrizzleIntegration processes. .xnml files store normalization parameters, image references and function matrices, among other parameters, that can be used by these processes to generate normalized pixel sample values required for pixel rejection and optimal integration output. For applications of local normalization to integration of astronomical images, this option should always be enabled.
文件: 生成可用于 ImageIntegration 和 DrizzleIntegration 进程的 XML 归一化数据文件（XNML 格式，.xnml 文件）。.xnml 文件存储归一化参数、图像参考和函数矩阵等，这些进程可用它们生成像素剔除与最优叠加输出所需的归一化像素采样值。对于将局部归一化用于天文图像叠加的应用，应始终启用该选项。

FILE: Size of the hot pixel removal filter.This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied for robust outlier rejection. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels, cold pixels, and similar small-scale outlier image structures that can contaminate the local normalization functions, degrading their accuracy, or even introducing artifacts in extreme cases.To disable hot pixel removal (not recommended), set this parameter to zero. The default value is two pixels.
文件: 热像素剔除滤波器的尺寸。这是用于稳健离群剔除的中值滤波半径（像素）。中值滤波去除热像素、冷像素以及类似的小尺度离群结构非常有效——这些结构会污染局部归一化函数、降低其精度，极端情况下甚至会引入伪影。要禁用热像素剔除（不推荐），把该参数设为零。默认值为两个像素。

FILE: Generate floating point images with the computed local background models for the reference and target images. This option is only applicable to execution on views, and is always ignored when LocalNormalization is executed in the global context (that is, as a batch procedure).Analysis of local backgrounds can be important for testing purposes, especially in difficult cases, for example to know how complex gradients are being evaluated, or to judge the quality of outlier rejection.
文件: 生成含参考图像与目标图像所计算局部背景模型的浮点图像。该选项仅适用于在视图上执行；当 LocalNormalization 在全局上下文（即作为批处理流程）执行时总被忽略。分析局部背景对测试目的很重要，尤其在困难情形下，例如了解复杂的渐变是如何被评估的，或判断离群剔除的质量。

FILE: Defect map imageDefectMap uses a defect map image to find defective pixels. In a defect map, black (zero) pixels correspond to bad or defective pixels. Bad pixels will be replaced with new values computed from neighbor pixels.When using convolution replacement operations (Gaussian, mean), non-zero pixel values represent the pixel weights that will be used for convolution. Morphological replacement operations (minimum, maximum, median) use binarized (0/1) map values.
文件: 缺陷图图像。DefectMap 使用缺陷图图像来查找缺陷像素。在缺陷图中，黑色（零）像素对应坏点或缺陷像素。坏点将被替换为根据邻近像素计算出的新值。使用卷积替换操作（高斯、均值）时，非零像素值表示卷积所使用的像素权重；形态学替换操作（最小、最大、中值）使用二值化（0/1）后的图值。

FILE: The multiplicative component of the local normalization function requires an estimate of the global relative scale of the reference image with respect to each target image. The relative scale is defined as the ratio of fluxes measured on significant image structures. We have implemented two different methods for scale evaluation: PSF flux and multiscale analysis. This section includes all relevant parameters available to control the application of these algorithms.
文件: 局部归一化函数的乘性分量需要估计参考图像相对于每幅目标图像的整体相对尺度。相对尺度定义为在显著图像结构上测得的通量之比。我们实现了两种尺度评估方法：PSF 通量和多尺度分析。本节包含控制这些算法应用的所有相关参数。

FILE: Batch execution: the flux calibration of a set of image files, with the Apply Global button (or by dragging the instance to the workspace), instead of the active view.Each enabled target frame is calibrated and written to a new XISF file with all of its metadata and the flux calibration metadata (see Output Files); the target frames are never modified. No graphs or star maps are generated; text files, when enabled, are written next to each output file.
文件: 批处理执行：用「应用全局」按钮（或把实例拖到工作区）对一组图像文件做通量校准，而不是对当前活动视图。每个启用的目标帧都会被校准并写入新的 XISF 文件，含其全部元数据以及通量校准元数据（见输出文件）；目标帧本身永不修改。不会生成图表或星图；启用文本文件时，文本文件写在每个输出文件旁。

FILE: Lower bound for the set of dark optimization pixels, measured in sigma units from the median.This parameter defines the set of dark frame pixels that will be used to compute dark optimization factors adaptively. By restricting this set to relatively bright pixels, the optimization process can be more robust to readout noise present in the master bias and dark frames. Increase this parameter to remove more dark pixels from the optimization set.
文件: 暗场优化像素集合的下界，以相对中值的 sigma 单位表示。该参数定义了用于自适应计算 暗场优化因子的 暗场帧像素集合。把该集合限制在相对明亮的像素上，可使优化过程对主 bias 与 暗场帧中存在的读出噪声更稳健。增大该参数可从优化集合中移除更多 暗场像素。

FILE: Compute global location parameters to be applied after local normalization.For some applications it may be desirable matching the global statistical parameter of location (or central tendency) of the reference image after local normalization. In such cases this option can be enabled to compute the required global normalization parameters, which will be included in generated .xnml files and applied to output normalized images, as appropriate.
文件: 计算局部归一化之后要应用的全局位置参数。某些应用可能希望在局部归一化之后匹配参考图像的全局统计位置参数（即集中趋势）。这类情况下可启用该选项来计算所需的全局归一化参数；这些参数会写入生成的 .xnml 文件，并视情况应用于输出的归一化图像。

FILE: Generate unsigned 8-bit images where nonzero pixel samples correspond to rejected samples in the reference and target images. This option is only applicable to execution on views, and is always ignored when LocalNormalization is executed in the global context (that is, as a batch procedure).Rejection maps are useful for testing purposes, especially in very difficult cases where the images have large outliers such as plane trails.
文件: 生成无符号 8 位图像，其中非零像素样本对应参考图像与目标图像中被剔除的样本。该选项仅适用于在视图上执行；当 LocalNormalization 在全局上下文（即作为批处理流程）执行时总被忽略。剔除贴图对测试目的很有用，尤其在图像含有大尺度离群结构（如飞机轨迹）的极困难情形下。

FILE: Enable this option to support data acquired with digital cameras that generate images mosaiced with a Color Filter Array (CFA). Bayer and X-Trans CFAs are supported. When this option is selected, the CFA pattern can be selected with the CFA mosaic pattern parameter. You normally should leave that parameter with its default Auto selection, which should detect the correct pattern automatically under normal working conditions.
文件: 启用该选项以支持由生成 CFA 马赛克图像的数码相机采集的数据。支持 Bayer 与 X-Trans CFA。选中该选项后，可用「CFA 马赛克排列」参数选择排列方式。正常情况下应让该参数保持默认的「自动」，它会在正常工作条件下自动检测出正确排列。

FILE: Minimum magnitude (G band) of extracted catalog stars. This parameter can be useful in cases where sampling too bright stars can lead to accuracy problems caused by contamination of signal estimates in highly crowded fields. This parameter is also helpful in automatically achieving a good optimal limit magnitude when most stars are saturated below a relatively high magnitude value. These issues often happen with wide-field images.
文件: 提取星表恒星的最小星等（G 波段）。当采样过亮的恒星会因极拥挤视场中信号估计受污染而导致精度问题时，该参数很有用。当大多数恒星在相对较高的星等值以下就已饱和时，该参数也有助于自动获得良好的最优限制星等。这些问题常见于广域图像。

FILE: Stars are detected in the target image and a point spread function model if fitted to each detected source separately in each nominal RGB channel. The fitted PSF parameters are then used to guide evaluation of the total flux of each source, and the RGB fluxes of matched stars in the selected spectrophotometric catalog are used to compute a robust and precise scaling factor based on star spectra and filter transmission functions.
文件: 在目标图像中检测恒星，并在每个标称 RGB 通道上分别对每颗检测到的源点拟合点扩散函数模型。拟合得到的 PSF 参数随后用于引导评估每颗源点的总通量，所选分光测光星表中匹配恒星的 RGB 通量则用于基于恒星光谱与滤镜透射函数计算稳健而精确的缩放因子。

FILE: The directory (or folder) where output text files (in CSV format) will be written, and, in batch executions (see Target Frames), the output images.If this field is left blank (or with its default <system-temp-dir> value), the text files of view executions will be written to the system temporary files directory, and the output images of batch executions, and their text files, to the directory of each target frame.
文件: 输出文本文件（CSV 格式）的写入目录（文件夹），以及批处理执行时（见目标帧）的输出图像。若该字段留空（或保留默认的 <system-temp-dir> 值），视图执行的文本文件将写入系统临时文件目录，批处理执行的输出图像及其文本文件则写入各目标帧所在目录。

FILE: Number of layers for multiscale analysis, with either the multiscale median transform or the starlet transform. A multiscale decomposition, following a dyadic scaling scheme, is used to isolate oriented and large-scale structures in the target image. For normal superbias frame generation, a high number of layers should be used. The default value is 7 (scale of 128 pixels), and the maximum allowed is 10 (1024 pixels).
文件: 多尺度分析的层数，可使用多尺度中值变换或 starlet 变换。按二进缩放方案进行的多尺度分解用于分离目标图像中具有方向性的大尺度结构。对于正常的 superbias 帧生成，应使用较高的层数。默认值为 7（128 像素尺度），最大允许 10（1024 像素）。

FILE: Star detector: Size of the hot pixel removal filter.This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels will be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can prevent a valid signal evaluation.To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 星点检测器：热像素剔除滤波器的尺寸。这是星点检测器在结构检测阶段之前施加的中值滤波半径（像素）。中值滤波去除热像素非常有效。热像素会被识别为假恒星，数量较多时还会妨碍有效的信号评估。要禁用热像素剔除，把该参数设为零。

FILE: Compute only the offset component of the local normalization function, and set the scale component constant equal to one.This option should be disabled under normal working conditions. It can be useful in special cases to limit local normalization to correction of additive gradients exclusively. However, without its multiplicative component the normalization function will be less accurate in general.
文件: 只计算局部归一化函数的偏移分量，并把尺度分量设为常数一。正常工作条件下应禁用该选项。在特殊情形下它可用于把局部归一化限制为仅校正加性渐变；但缺少乘性分量时，归一化函数的总体精度会降低。

FILE: This is the directory (or folder) where all output files will be written. This includes .xnml data files and, if the corresponding option has been enabled, normalized image files.If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the normalization process will fail.
文件: 这是所有输出文件写入的目录（文件夹），包括 .xnml 数据文件，以及（若已启用相应选项）归一化图像文件。若该字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在目录。这种情况下请确保源目录可写，否则归一化过程会失败。

FILE: When this option is enabled and the master flat frame is a single-channel image mosaiced with a Color Filter Array (CFA), such as a Bayer or X-Trans filter pattern, three separate master flat scaling factors are computed for the red, green and blue CFA components, respectively. When this option is disabled, a single scaling factor is computed for the whole master flat frame, ignoring CFA components.
文件: 启用该选项且 主平场帧是用 CFA（如 Bayer 或 X-Trans 滤镜排列）马赛克的单通道图像时，会分别为红、绿、蓝 CFA 分量计算三个独立的 主平场 缩放因子。禁用该选项时，忽略 CFA 分量，为整个 主平场帧计算单个缩放因子。

FILE: Use the multiscale median transform (MMT) instead of the starlet transform (AKA à trous transform) to isolate large-scale structures. The MMT can separate structures much better than linear transforms such as starlet, so it usually can reproduce better large-scale gradients present in most master bias frames. The MMT, despite being computationally intensive, is the default option.
文件: 使用多尺度中值变换（MMT）代替 starlet 变换（又称 à trous 变换）来分离大尺度结构。MMT 比 starlet 等线性变换能更好地分离结构，因此通常能更好地重现多数 主偏置帧中存在的大尺度渐变。MMT 计算量大，但仍是默认选项。

FILE: Generate unsigned 8-bit images where nonzero pixel samples belong to detected significant structures in the reference and target images. This option is only available for the multiscale analysis scale evaluation method, and is only applicable to execution on views. This option is always ignored when LocalNormalization is executed in the global context (that is, as a batch procedure).
文件: 生成无符号 8 位图像，其中非零像素样本属于参考图像与目标图像中检测到的显著结构。该选项仅用于多尺度分析尺度评估方法，且仅适用于在视图上执行。当 LocalNormalization 在全局上下文（即作为批处理流程）执行时，该选项总被忽略。

FILE: The implemented local normalization algorithms are sensitive to differences between the reference and target images caused by spurious image features, such as hot pixels, plane and satellite trails, cosmic rays, etc.Under normal working conditions, this option should be enabled to detect and reject outlier image structures prior to calculation of local normalization functions.
文件: 所实现的局部归一化算法对参考图像与目标图像之间由虚假图像特征（如热像素、飞机与卫星轨迹、宇宙线等）造成的差异很敏感。正常工作条件下应启用该选项，以便在计算局部归一化函数之前检测并剔除离群图像结构。

FILE: Select this option to apply dark frame optimization.The dark frame optimization routine computes a dark scaling factor to minimize the noise induced by dark subtraction. Optimization is carried out separately for each target frame, including the master flat frame, if selected. Dark frame optimization has been implemented using robust linear minimization of variance.
文件: 选中该选项以应用 暗场帧优化。暗场帧优化例程会计算一个 暗场缩放因子，以最小化 暗场扣除引入的噪声。优化对每幅目标帧分别进行，若已选中则还包括 主平场帧。暗场帧优化通过方差的稳健线性最小化实现。

FILE: Size of the noise reduction filter.This is the radius in pixels of a Gaussian convolution filter applied for noise reduction. Noise reduction is disabled by default; it is only necessary for images suffering from severe noise, especially images with clipped histograms and similar artifacts. Increasing this parameter should not be necessary for well calibrated images.
文件: 降噪滤波器的尺寸。这是用于降噪的高斯卷积滤波半径（像素）。降噪默认禁用；仅对噪声严重的图像有必要，尤其是直方图被裁切及有类似伪影的图像。对校准良好的图像无需增大该参数。

FILE: This parameter defines a threshold in sigma units below the median of a high-pass filtered master dark frame. Pixels below this threshold are considered cold pixels and tagged for cosmetic correction during the image calibration task. Decrease the value of this parameter to select more potential cold pixels. The default value is 5 sigma.
文件: 该参数以 sigma 单位定义了高通滤波后 主暗场帧中值以下的阈值。低于该阈值的像素被视为冷像素，在图像校准任务中被标记用于外观校正。减小该参数值可选入更多潜在冷像素。默认值为 5 sigma。

FILE: This parameter defines a threshold in sigma units above the median of a high-pass filtered master dark frame. Pixels above this threshold are considered hot pixels and tagged for cosmetic correction during the image calibration task. Decrease the value of this parameter to select more potential hot pixels. The default value is 10 sigma.
文件: 该参数以 sigma 单位定义了高通滤波后 主暗场帧中值以上的阈值。高于该阈值的像素被视为热像素，在图像校准任务中被标记用于外观校正。减小该参数值可选入更多潜在热像素。默认值为 10 sigma。

FILE: Generate floating point images with the computed local scale correction models for the normalization function. These model images are rescaled linearly to the [0,1] range.This option is only applicable to execution on views, and is always ignored when LocalNormalization is executed in the global context (that is, as a batch procedure).
文件: 生成含归一化函数所计算局部尺度校正模型的浮点图像。这些模型图像会被线性重标定到 [0,1] 范围。该选项仅适用于在视图上执行；当 LocalNormalization 在全局上下文（即作为批处理流程）执行时总被忽略。

FILE: This parameter is the radius in pixels of the local neighborhoods used to calculate plausible values to replace cold and hot pixels. This radius defines a square region of size 1 + 2*radius centered on each defective pixel. The value used for replacement is the median of the pixel values in this region, excluding the corrected pixel.
文件: 该参数是用于计算替换冷、热像素的合理值的局部邻域半径（像素）。该半径定义了以每个缺陷像素为中心、尺寸为 1 + 2*半径 的正方形区域。用于替换的值是该区域内像素值的中值，不含被校正的像素本身。

FILE: Enable the fourth overscan. Each overscan allows you to define arbitrary source and target overscan regions in CCD pixel coordinates. A source overscan region is used to compute an overscan correction value (as the median of all source region pixels) that will be subtracted from all pixels in the corresponding target region.
文件: 启用第四个过扫描。每个过扫描允许你在 CCD 像素坐标中定义任意的源区与目标区过扫描区域。源过扫描区域用于计算过扫描校正值（取源区所有像素的中值），该值将从对应目标区的所有像素中减去。

FILE: Enable the second overscan. Each overscan allows you to define arbitrary source and target overscan regions in CCD pixel coordinates. A source overscan region is used to compute an overscan correction value (as the median of all source region pixels) that will be subtracted from all pixels in the corresponding target region.
文件: 启用第二个过扫描。每个过扫描允许你在 CCD 像素坐标中定义任意的源区与目标区过扫描区域。源过扫描区域用于计算过扫描校正值（取源区所有像素的中值），该值将从对应目标区的所有像素中减去。

FILE: Enable the first overscan. Each overscan allows you to define arbitrary source and target overscan regions in CCD pixel coordinates. A source overscan region is used to compute an overscan correction value (as the median of all source region pixels) that will be subtracted from all pixels in the corresponding target region.
文件: 启用第一个过扫描。每个过扫描允许你在 CCD 像素坐标中定义任意的源区与目标区过扫描区域。源过扫描区域用于计算过扫描校正值（取源区所有像素的中值），该值将从对应目标区的所有像素中减去。

FILE: Enable the third overscan. Each overscan allows you to define arbitrary source and target overscan regions in CCD pixel coordinates. A source overscan region is used to compute an overscan correction value (as the median of all source region pixels) that will be subtracted from all pixels in the corresponding target region.
文件: 启用第三个过扫描。每个过扫描允许你在 CCD 像素坐标中定义任意的源区与目标区过扫描区域。源过扫描区域用于计算过扫描校正值（取源区所有像素的中值），该值将从对应目标区的所有像素中减去。

FILE: A postfix appended to the file name of each target frame to form the name of its output file. The output files are XISF files: the .xisf extension is always added. The default postfix is _spfc. The prefix and postfix cannot both be empty when the output directory is that of the target frames: a target frame is never replaced.
文件: 附加到每个目标帧文件名后面的后缀，用于构成其输出文件名。输出文件为 XISF 文件：始终添加 .xisf 扩展名。默认后缀为 _spfc。当输出目录就是目标帧所在目录时，前缀与后缀不能同时为空：目标帧永远不会被替换。

FILE: Master flat frame scaling factors are computed as robust mean pixel values for each channel or CFA component. This parameter defines the fraction of pixels that will be rejected to compute two-sided, symmetric trimmed means. The default value is 0.05, which rejects a 5% of pixels at both ends of the flat frame distribution.
文件: 主平场帧缩放因子按每个通道或 CFA 分量的稳健平均像素值计算。该参数定义计算双侧对称截尾均值时将被剔除的像素比例。默认值为 0.05，即在 平场帧分布两端各剔除 5% 的像素。

FILE: Select this option to calibrate the master flat frame at the beginning of the batch calibration process. The master flat frame is corrected for overscan, bias-subtracted, and dark-subtracted with optional optimization, when the corresponding overscan regions and master calibration frames have been defined and are enabled.
文件: 选中该选项以在批处理校准过程开始时校准 主平场帧。当相应的过扫描区域与主校准帧已定义并启用时，主平场帧将做过扫描校正、偏置扣除和 暗场扣除（可选优化）。

FILE: Compute first order local scale corrections.If this option is enabled, LocalNormalization will model local scale variations, i.e. multiplicative gradients that cannot be corrected with a single global scale factor.Warning: The implementation of this feature is still experimental.
文件: 计算一阶局部尺度校正。若启用该选项，LocalNormalization 将对局部尺度变化建模，即无法用单个全局缩放因子校正的乘性渐变。警告：该功能的实现仍属实验性质。

FILE: Select this option to calibrate the master dark frame at the beginning of the batch calibration process. The master dark frame is corrected for overscan, when one or more overscan regions have been defined and are enabled, and bias-subtracted, if a master bias frame has been selected and is enabled.
文件: 选中该选项以在批处理校准过程开始时校准 主暗场帧。当已定义一个或多个过扫描区域并启用时，主暗场帧将做过扫描校正；若已选择并启用 主偏置帧，还会做偏置扣除。

FILE: This is the directory (or folder) where all output files will be written.If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the calibration process will fail.
文件: 这是所有输出文件写入的目录（文件夹）。若该字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在目录。这种情况下请确保源目录可写，否则校准过程会失败。

FILE: Normalize the background of the corrected image.If this option is selected, the initial median value of the image will be applied after background model correction. If the background model is subtracted, then the median will be added; if the background model is applied by division, the resulting image will be multiplied by the median. This tends to recover the initial color balance of the background in the corrected image.If this option is not selected (as by default), the above median normalization will not be applied and —if the background model is accurate— the resulting corrected image will tend to have a neutral background.
文件: 归一化校正后图像的背景。选中此选项时，背景模型校正之后会应用图像的初始中值。若背景模型为减除，则加回该中值；若背景模型为除法应用，则结果图像乘以该中值。这有助于恢复校正后图像背景的初始色彩平衡。未选中此选项时（默认情况），不执行上述中值归一化；若背景模型准确，校正后图像的背景会趋于中性。

FILE: Ignore all sample weightsBy selecting this option, all statistical sample weights will be ignored (actually, all of them will be considered as having a value of one, regardless of their actual values). This can be useful in difficult or unusual cases, where DBE's automatic pixel rejection algorithms may fail due to too wild gradients. In such cases, you can manually define a (usually quite reduced) set of samples on strategic locations and tell the background modeling routines that you know what you're doing — if you select this option, they will trust you.
文件: 忽略所有样本权重。选中此选项后，全部统计样本权重都会被忽略（实际上它们都被当作 1，无论其真实值是多少）。这在困难或异常情况下很有用——当 DBE 的自动像素剔除算法因梯度过于剧烈而失效时。此时你可以在关键位置手动定义一组（通常数量很少的）样本，并告诉背景建模程序你知道自己在做什么——只要选中此选项，它们就会信任你。

FILE: This specifies a downsampling ratio for generation of the background model image. For example, a downsampling value of 2 means that the model will be created with one half the sizes of the target image.Background models are by definition extremely smooth functions. For this reason, a background model can usually be generated with downsampling ratios between 2 and 8 without problems, depending on the variations of the sampled background. A downsampled model greatly reduces the required calculation times for background model interpolation.
文件: 指定生成背景模型图像时的降采样比例。例如降采样值为 2 表示模型尺寸为目标图像的一半。背景模型本质上极其平滑，因此视被采样背景的变化程度，通常用 2～8 的降采样比例即可正常生成。降采样模型可大幅减少背景模型插值所需的计算时间。

FILE: Tolerance of the pixel rejection algorithm.This parameter is expressed in sigma units, with respect to the estimated mean background value. Higher tolerance values will allow for more permissive background estimations. Increasing this value favors inclusion of more pixels in the background model, but at the risk of including also pixels that don't pertain to the true background of the image. Decreasing tolerance will cause a more restrictive pixel rejection; however, too low tolerance values lead to poorly sampled background models.
文件: 像素剔除算法的容差。该参数以 sigma 为单位，相对于估计的背景均值。容差值越大，背景估计越宽松。提高该值有利于把更多像素纳入背景模型，但风险是也纳入并不属于图像真实背景的像素。降低容差会使像素剔除更严格；但容差过低会导致背景模型采样不良。

FILE: Background models are extremely smooth images by nature. For this reason, they can be strongly downsampled with respect to the original image, without any loss of accuracy. Note that you can apply a downsampled background model to fix the original image directly with the PixelMath process in PixInsight (for example by subtraction or division), since PixelMath automatically interpolates pixel values as necessary. The same is true if you apply the background correction directly with DBE.
文件: 背景模型本质上极其平滑，因此相对原始图像可以大幅降采样而不损失精度。注意，你可以用 PixelMath 进程直接把降采样背景模型应用于修正原始图像（例如减除或相除），因为 PixelMath 会自动按需插值像素值。直接用 DBE 应用背景校正时也是如此。

FILE: Degree of the interpolation polynomials.ABE uses a linear least squares fitting procedure to compute a set of 2-D polynomials that interpolate the background model. Higher degrees may be necessary to reproduce local background variations, especially in presence of wildly varying sky gradients, but they can also lead to oscillations. In general, the default value (4th degree) is appropriate in most cases. If necessary, this parameter must be adjusted by careful trial-error work.
文件: 插值多项式的阶数。ABE 使用线性最小二乘拟合来计算一组用于插值背景模型的二维多项式。复现局部背景变化（尤其天空梯度剧烈变化时）可能需要更高阶数，但高阶也可能引起振荡。一般情况下默认值（4 阶）适用于大多数情况。必要时须通过仔细的试错来调整该参数。

FILE: Tolerance of global sample rejection, in sigma units.This is the maximum dispersion allowed for background samples, with respect to the median of the target image. By decreasing this value, ABE will be more restrictive to select background samples that differ too much from the mean background of the whole image. This is useful to avoid inclusion of large-scale structures, such as extended nebular regions, in the generated background model.
文件: 全局样本剔除的容差，以 sigma 为单位。这是背景样本相对于目标图像中值所允许的最大离散度。降低该值会使 ABE 在选择背景样本时更严格地排除与整幅图像平均背景差异过大的样本。这有助于避免把大尺度结构（如延展星云区域）纳入生成的背景模型。

FILE: If this option is selected, ABE will draw all background sample boxes on a newly-created 16-bit image, which we call sample boxes image. A sample boxes image is very useful to adjust ABE parameters by controlling the regions of the image that are being used to sample the background.In a sample boxes image, each sample box is drawn with a pixel value proportional to the inverse of the corresponding sampled background value.
文件: 选中此选项时，ABE 会把所有背景样本框绘制到一幅新建的 16 位图像上，我们称之为样本框图像。样本框图像非常有用，可以通过控制图像中用于采样背景的区域来调整 ABE 参数。在样本框图像中，每个样本框的像素值与对应采样背景值的倒数成正比。

FILE: Relaxation factor for rejection of dark background pixels.Increasing this parameter allows for the inclusion of more dark pixels in the generated background model, while more restrictive criteria can be applied to reject bright pixels (as specified by the tolerance parameter). This helps to achieve a better sky background modelization without inclusion of relatively bright and large objects, as extended nebulas.
文件: 暗背景像素剔除的松弛因子。增大该参数可以把更多暗像素纳入生成的背景模型，同时对亮像素仍可施加更严格的准则（由容差参数指定）。这有助于在不纳入较亮的大尺度目标（如延展星云）的前提下，更好地对天空背景建模。

FILE: Smoothing factor for 2-D surface spline generation.Controls the adaptability of the 2-D surface modeling algorithm used to build the background model. With a smoothness value of 0, a pure interpolating surface spline will be used, which will reproduce the values of all DBE samples exactly at their locations. Moderate smoothness values are usually desirable; excessive smoothness can lead to erroneous modelization.
文件: 二维曲面样条生成的平滑因子。控制用于构建背景模型的二维曲面建模算法的适应性。平滑值为 0 时使用纯插值曲面样条，会在各样本位置精确复现全部 DBE 样本的值。通常宜取适度的平滑值；过大的平滑度会导致建模错误。

FILE: A weight value of one means that the current sample is fully representative of the image background at the sample's location. A value of zero indicates that the sample will be ignored to model the background, since it has no pixels pertaining to the background. Intermediate weights correspond to the probability of a sample to represent the background of the image at its current location.
文件: 权重为 1 表示当前样本完全代表样本所在位置的图像背景。权重为 0 表示该样本将被忽略、不参与背景建模，因为它不含属于背景的像素。中间权重对应样本在其当前位置代表图像背景的概率。

FILE: Tolerance of local sample rejection, in sigma units.This is the maximum dispersion allowed for background sample pixels. By decreasing this value, background samples will reject more outlier pixels with respect to the median of each sample box. This is useful to make background samples immune to noise and small-scale bright structures, such as relatively small stars.
文件: 局部样本剔除的容差，以 sigma 为单位。这是背景样本像素所允许的最大离散度。降低该值会使背景样本在每个样本框内相对于其中值剔除更多离群像素。这有助于使背景样本不受噪声和小尺度亮结构（如较小的恒星）的影响。

FILE: When the model comparison feature is enabled, ABE generates a 16-bit image that you can use to quickly evaluate the suitability of the computed background model. The comparison image is a copy of the target image to which the model is applied by subtraction. This parameter is a multiplying factor applied to exaggerate the irregularities in the resulting comparison image.
文件: 启用模型比较功能时，ABE 会生成一幅 16 位图像，可用于快速评估所计算背景模型的适用性。比较图像是目标图像的副本，并按减除方式应用了该模型。本参数是一个放大倍数，用于夸大比较图像中的不规则性。

FILE: This is the distance in pixels between two adjacent background sample boxes.This parameter is useful to control the density of generated sample boxes. A relatively sparse sample distribution can be helpful to make the background model less dependent on strong local variations. The number of samples can also have a strong repercussion over computation times.
文件: 相邻两个背景样本框之间的像素距离。该参数用于控制生成样本框的密度。样本分布相对稀疏有助于让背景模型更少受强烈局部变化的影响。样本数量也会显著影响计算时间。

FILE: Derivative order of continuity for the 2-D surface spline generator.Higher continuity orders can yield more accurate models (accuracy here means adaptability to local variations). However, higher orders also may lead to instabilities and rippling effects. The recommended value is 2; you usually should not need to change this parameter.
文件: 二维曲面样条生成器的连续性导数阶数。更高的连续性阶数可以得到更精确的模型（此处的精确指对局部变化的适应性）。但高阶也可能导致不稳定和波纹效应。推荐值为 2；通常无需修改此参数。

FILE: The generated background model can be applied to produce a corrected version of the target image. The background model must be subtracted to correct for additive effects, such as gradients caused by light pollution or by the Moon. Multiplicative phenomena, such as vignetting or differential atmospheric absorption for example, must be corrected by division.
文件: 生成的背景模型可用于产生目标图像的校正版本。要校正加性效应（如光污染或月光造成的梯度），必须减除背景模型。乘性效应（例如渐晕或大气差分吸收）必须用除法校正。

FILE: If this option is selected, ABE will stop after extracting the set of background samples, just before generating the background model. Normally you'll want to select this option along with the draw sample boxes option. In this way ABE will create a sample boxes image that you can use to evaluate the suitability of the current ABE parameters.
文件: 选中此选项时，ABE 在提取完背景样本后即停止，不再生成背景模型。通常你会希望同时选中「绘制样本框」选项。这样 ABE 会生成一幅样本框图像，你可用来评估当前 ABE 参数是否合适。

FILE: Perform an in-place background correction. With this option selected, the process will replace the target image with the corrected image. When this option is not selected, the corrected image is provided as a newly created image window, and the target view is not modified in any way. The latter is the default state of this option.
文件: 就地执行背景校正。选中此选项时，进程会用校正后的图像替换目标图像。未选中时，校正后的图像作为新建图像窗口提供，目标视图不受任何修改。后者是该选项的默认状态。

FILE: Shadows relaxation factor.This parameter multiplies the deviation parameter when used to evaluate dispersion of dark pixels (i.e., pixels below the global median of the target image). This allows to include more dark pixels in the generated background model, while more restrictive criteria are used to reject bright pixels.
文件: 阴影松弛因子。该参数用于乘以评估暗像素（即低于目标图像全局中值的像素）离散度时使用的偏差参数。这样可以把更多暗像素纳入生成的背景模型，同时对亮像素使用更严格的剔除准则。

FILE: Less than three samples were generated. This is often a consequence of too restrictive model parameters or sample generation parameters.You can try one or more of the following:Increasing ToleranceDecreasing Minimum sample weightIncreasing Shadows relaxation
文件: 生成的样本少于三个。这通常是模型参数或样本生成参数过于严格所致。你可以尝试以下一项或多项：增大容差、减小最小样本权重、增大阴影松弛。

FILE: Minimum fraction of nonrejected pixels in a valid DBE sample.No sample with less than the specified fraction of background pixels will be generated. Set to zero to take into account all samples regardless of their calculated representativeness of the background.
文件: 有效 DBE 样本中未被剔除像素的最小比例。低于该比例的样本不会生成。设为 0 则不论其计算出的背景代表性如何，所有样本都会被纳入考虑。

FILE: Background models are extremely smooth functions that cannot be properly rendered as 8-bit integer imagesUsing 8-bit background models may lead to posterization artifacts.Are you sure you want to generate an 8-bit background model ?
文件: 背景模型是极其平滑的函数，无法正确渲染为 8 位整数图像。使用 8 位背景模型可能产生色调分离伪影。确定要生成 8 位背景模型吗？

FILE: This is the length in pixels of a background sample box.Too large sample boxes can be inadequate to reproduce local background variations. Too small sample boxes can be too dependent on small-scale variations, such as noise and stars.
文件: 背景样本框的边长，单位为像素。样本框过大会难以复现局部背景变化；样本框过小则过于依赖小尺度变化，如噪声和恒星。

FILE: Sample symmetries can be useful to deal with illumination irregularities that possess symmetric distributions. For example, vignetting usually can be fixed very efficiently taking advantage of its radial symmetric distribution.
文件: 样本对称性可用于处理具有对称分布的光照不规则性。例如，渐晕通常可以利用其径向对称分布高效修正。

FILE: Minimum statistical weight for generated DBE samples.This parameter only applies to automatically generated DBE samples. No samples will be generated with statistical weights below the specified value.
文件: 生成的 DBE 样本的最小统计权重。该参数仅适用于自动生成的 DBE 样本。统计权重低于指定值的样本不会生成。

FILE: Fixed sample valueEnable this option to force a constant value for the current DBE sample. The fixed value will be taken as the median of the sample pixel values for each channel of the image.
文件: 固定样本值。启用此选项可强制当前 DBE 样本取常数值。该固定值将取各通道样本像素值的中值。

FILE: Dispose the background model after correction of the target image. If this option is left unselected, the generated background model will be provided as a newly created image window.
文件: 校正目标图像后丢弃背景模型。若未选中此选项，生成的背景模型将作为一幅新建图像窗口提供。

FILE: Minimun fraction of accepted pixels in a valid sample.By decreasing this value ABE will be more restrictive to accept valid background samples.
文件: 有效样本中被接受像素的最小比例。降低该值会使 ABE 在判定有效背景样本时更严格。

FILE: Sample grid too dense.Please reduce the number of samples per row and/or the default sample radius.
文件: 样本网格过密。请减少每行样本数和/或减小默认样本半径。

FILE: Maximum value of background pixels, when the brightness limits option is enabled.
文件: 启用亮度限制选项时，背景像素的最大值。

FILE: Minimum value of background pixels, when the brightness limits option is enabled.
文件: 启用亮度限制选项时，背景像素的最小值。

FILE: Horizontal position of the current sample's center in image coordinates.
文件: 当前样本中心在图像坐标中的水平位置。

FILE: Vertical position of the current sample's center in image coordinates.

FILE: Reset the default sample radius to an automatically guessed value.
文件: 将默认样本半径重置为自动推测的值。

文件: 将水平对称轴重置到图像中心。

FILE: Select a background neutralization mode.In target background mode, BackgroundNeutralization will force the target image to have the specified mean background value (see the target background parameter below) for the three RGB channels. In this mode, any resulting out-of-range values after neutralization will be truncated. There can be some (usually negligible) data clipping, but only additive transformations are applied to the data.In rescale mode, the target image will always be rescaled after neutralization. In this mode there are no data clippings, and the neutralized image maximizes dynamic range usage. However, in this mode you have no control over the resulting mean background value, and the rescaling operation is a multiplicative transformation that redistributes all pixel values throughout the available dynamic range.The rescale as needed mode is similar to rescale, but the target image is only rescaled if there are out-of-range-values after neutralization. This is the default mode.In truncate mode all resulting out-of-range pixels after neutralization will be truncated, which usually results in severely clipped data. This mode is useful to perform a background subtraction to a working image used for an intermediate analysis or processing step.
文件: 选择背景中和模式。在目标背景模式下，BackgroundNeutralization 会强制目标图像的三个 RGB 通道具有指定的平均背景值（见下方的目标背景参数）。该模式下中和后出现的任何越界值都会被截断。可能会有一些（通常可忽略的）数据削波，但只对数据施加加性变换。在重缩放模式下，目标图像在中和后总会被重缩放。该模式不会产生数据削波，中和后的图像能最大化动态范围的利用率；但该模式下你无法控制中和后的平均背景值，且重缩放是乘性变换，会把所有像素值重新分布到整个可用动态范围内。按需重缩放模式与重缩放类似，但仅当存在越界值时才重缩放目标图像，这是默认模式。在截断模式下，中和后所有越界的像素都会被截断，通常会导致严重的数据削波；该模式适合对用于中间分析或处理步骤的工作图像做背景减除。

Decreasing it can be beneficial in some cases working with very noisy data to restrict flux evaluation to star cores. The default value is 1.25.

文件: 在评估色彩校准系数之前先检测小尺度上的显著结构。选中此选项时，ColorCalibration 会使用基于小波的多尺度结构检测例程，在指定的尺度范围（见接下来的两个参数）内分离出明亮的图像结构。该功能可用于基于白参考图像中记录的恒星执行色彩校准。

FILE: PCC detects stars in the target image and fits a point spread function model to each detected source separately in each nominal RGB channel. The fitted PSF parameters are then used to guide evaluation of the total flux of each source, and the RGB fluxes of matched stars in the selected photometric catalog are used to compute a robust and precise white balance factor based on catalog star magnitudes measured through different filters.
文件: PCC 会在目标图像中检测恒星，并在每个标称 RGB 通道中分别为每个检测到的源拟合点扩散函数模型。随后用拟合得到的 PSF 参数引导评估每个源的总通量，并用所选测光星表中匹配恒星的 RGB 通量与经由不同滤光片测得的星等，计算出稳健而精确的白平衡系数。

FILE: SPCC detects stars in the target image and fits a point spread function model to each detected source separately in each nominal RGB channel. The fitted PSF parameters are then used to guide evaluation of the total flux of each source, and the RGB fluxes of matched stars in the selected spectrophotometric catalog are used to compute a robust and precise white balance factor based on star spectra and filter transmission functions.
文件: SPCC 会在目标图像中检测恒星，并在每个标称 RGB 通道中分别为每个检测到的源拟合点扩散函数模型。随后用拟合得到的 PSF 参数引导评估每个源的总通量，并用所选分光光度星表中匹配恒星的 RGB 通量、结合恒星光谱与滤光片透射函数，计算出稳健而精确的白平衡系数。

FILE: Upper bound of the set of white reference pixels. White reference pixels greater than or equal to this value will be rejected for calculation of color correction factors. This parameter allows you to reject saturated pixels, or pixels with very high values pertaining to the nonlinear regions of most CCD response curves. Note that since the maximum allowed value for this parameter is 1, white pixels are always rejected.
文件: 白参考像素集合的上界。大于或等于该值的白参考像素将在计算色彩校正系数时被剔除。该参数可用于剔除饱和像素，或落在多数 CCD 响应曲线非线性区的高值像素。注意由于该参数允许的最大值为 1，白像素始终会被剔除。

FILE: Reference object to calculate white balance functions.Hot (blue) references, such as B and A stars, tend to induce a red color cast. Cold (red) references, such as K and M stars, tend to cause a blue color cast.The default average spiral galaxy reference is, in our opinion, truly representative of the deep space, and hence the most plausible white reference for most applications.
文件: 用于计算白平衡函数的参考对象。热（蓝）参考如 B 型和 A 型恒星往往引入偏红的色偏；冷（红）参考如 K 型和 M 型恒星往往导致偏蓝的色偏。我们认为默认的平均旋涡星系参考确实能代表深空，因而对多数应用而言是最合理的白参考。

FILE: You should define a rectangular region of interest (ROI) to restrict background evaluation to pixels within a region that represents the true background of the target image. If no ROI is defined, background evaluation will be performed on the entire target image, which can be inaccurate, especially for images with few free sky background regions.
文件: 你应定义一个矩形感兴趣区域（ROI），把背景评估限制在能代表目标图像真实背景的区域内。若未定义 ROI，背景评估将在整幅目标图像上进行，这可能并不准确，对于自由天空背景区域很少的图像尤其如此。

FILE: Upper bound of the set of background reference pixels, measured in sigma units from the the median of the background reference for each nominal channel. Background reference pixels with values greater than or equal to this upper bound will be rejected for calculation of mean background levels.The default value is +2.0 sigma.
文件: 背景参考像素集合的上界，以各标称通道背景参考的中位数为基准、按 sigma 为单位度量。大于或等于该上界的背景参考像素将在计算平均背景水平时被剔除。默认值为 +2.0 sigma。

FILE: Lower bound of the set of background reference pixels, measured in sigma units from the the median of the background reference for each nominal channel. Background reference pixels with values less than or equal to this lower bound will be rejected for calculation of mean background levels.The default value is -2.8 sigma.
文件: 背景参考像素集合的下界，以各标称通道背景参考的中位数为基准、按 sigma 为单位度量。小于或等于该下界的背景参考像素将在计算平均背景水平时被剔除。默认值为 -2.8 sigma。

FILE: White reference image.ColorCalibration will use pixels read from this image to compute a set of three color calibration factors, one for each channel. If you leave this field blank (or with its default <target image> value), the target image will be also the white reference image during the calibration process.
文件: 白参考图像。ColorCalibration 将使用从该图像读取的像素计算一组三个色彩校准系数，每个通道一个。若将本字段留空（或保持默认的 <target image> 值），在校准过程中目标图像同时充当白参考图像。

FILE: Lower bound of the set of background pixels. Background reference pixels with values less than or equal to this value will be rejected for calculation of mean background levels. Note that since the minimum allowed value for this parameter is zero, black pixels are never taken into account.
文件: 背景像素集合的下界。小于或等于该值的背景参考像素将在计算平均背景水平时被剔除。注意由于该参数允许的最小值为零，黑色像素从不计入。

FILE: Perform a manual white balance by specifying the three color correction factors literally.If you select this option, no automatic color calibration routine will be applied, and you'll be allowed to enter the correction factors for red, green and blue, as the next three parameters.
文件: 通过直接指定三个色彩校正系数来执行手动白平衡。若选择此选项，将不应用任何自动色彩校准例程，你可以输入红、绿、蓝三个通道的校正系数（即接下来的三个参数）。

FILE: LinearFit computes linear fitting functions to match the mean background and signal levels of its target image to the corresponding values of the reference image. The reference image must be a main view or a complete preview (partial previews are not allowed as reference images).
文件: LinearFit 会计算线性拟合函数，把目标图像的平均背景和信号水平匹配到参考图像的对应值。参考图像必须是主视图或完整预览（部分预览不可作为参考图像）。

FILE: Number of wavelet layers used for noise reduction.Noise reduction prevents detection of bright noise structures, including hot pixels and cosmic rays. This parameter can also be used to control the sizes of the smallest detected stars (increase to exclude more stars).
文件: 用于降噪的小波层数。降噪可防止把明亮的噪声结构（包括热像素和宇宙线）检测为结构。该参数也可用于控制被检测到的最小恒星尺寸（增大可排除更多恒星）。

FILE: In the target background working mode, this is the final mean background level that will be imposed to the three RGB channels of the target image.In the rest of modes (rescale, rescale as needed and truncate) this parameter is not used.
文件: 在目标背景工作模式下，这是将施加到目标图像三个 RGB 通道的最终平均背景水平。在其余模式（重缩放、按需重缩放和截断）下不使用该参数。

FILE: Lower bound of the set of white reference pixels. White reference pixels less than or equal to this value will be rejected for calculation of color correction factors. Note that since the minimum allowed value for this parameter is 0, black pixels are always rejected.
文件: 白参考像素集合的下界。小于或等于该值的白参考像素将在计算色彩校正系数时被剔除。注意由于该参数允许的最小值为 0，黑色像素始终会被剔除。

FILE: This parameter controls the point from which normalization starts in the dimmer regions of the image. This is an interpolation between the minimum and median image values. So a Shadow point of 0 will apply the normalization for all pixel intensity values, ie it starts at the minimum image value. A value of 1 will do the same but starts the normalization from the median image value. Values between 0 and 1 will interpolate between these points. This feature helps allow fainter signals to be normalized but this can introduce more noise.
文件: 该参数控制归一化从图像较暗区域中的哪个位置开始。它是在图像最小值与中值之间做插值。因此阴影点取 0 时，归一化会应用于所有像素强度值，即从图像最小值开始；取 1 时同样生效，但从图像中值开始归一化。0 到 1 之间的取值则在这些点之间插值。该功能有助于让更暗弱的信号也获得归一化，但可能引入更多噪声。

FILE: There are three Blend modes offered to create the synthetic green channel using the Ha and OIII data. The proportions of each are controled by the Blend amount parameter.Mode1: uses Ha as a base and blends the Blend amount of normalized OIII.Mode2: uses the the normalised OIII data as a base and blends the Blend amount of original OIII data.Mode3: uses the Ha as a base and blends the Blend amount of original OIII data.
文件: 提供三种混合模式，用 Ha 与 OIII 数据生成合成绿色通道，各成分的比例由「混合量」参数控制。模式 1：以 Ha 为基底，混入「混合量」比例的归一化 OIII。模式 2：以归一化 OIII 数据为基底，混入「混合量」比例的原始 OIII 数据。模式 3：以 Ha 为基底，混入「混合量」比例的原始 OIII 数据。

FILE: This feature will perform a reverse Midtones Transfer Function stretch focused on the highlights. For example, the Rosette nebula has a bright core. You can increase this value to greater than 1 to help reduce the highlights while protecting the shadows. This method can also work in reverse, i.e. you can reduce this value to increase highlights.
文件: 该功能会执行以高光为目标的逆向中间调转移函数拉伸。例如玫瑰星云有一个明亮的核心。你可以把该值增大到大于 1，以压低高光同时保护阴影。该方法也可反向使用，即减小该值来提亮高光。

FILE: This feature will perform a Midtones Transfer Function stretch to increase overall brightness of the image with a value greater than 1. A value less than 1 will reduce brightness but should not be used to recover clipping, that should be done using the Highlight recovery feature.
文件: 该功能会执行中间调转移函数拉伸，值大于 1 时可提升图像整体亮度。值小于 1 会降低亮度，但不应借此恢复削波，恢复削波应使用「高光恢复」功能。

文件: 亮度仅应用于非线性图像。亮度调整在归一化处理完成后施加。图像会被转换到 CIEL*a*b* 色彩空间，并按该参数指定的方式替换 L* 通道。

文件: SCNR 控件会对图像的绿色通道施加减性色噪声抑制（SCNR），使用「平均中性」保护方法（即 green = min(green, (red+blue)/2)）。该参数控制所施加的 SCNR 强度。

FILE: This feature allows you to boost or reduce more OIII signal into your image. a value greater than 1 will boost and a value less than 1 will reduce.

FILE: Copy an existing astrometric solution to the combined image.This option is only applicable to global execution, that is, when ChannelCombination creates a new combined image, or to execution on main views. This option is always ignored when ChannelCombination is executed on previews.When this option is enabled, a valid astrometric solution is inherited if it exists in the green, CIE Y, CIE L*, V or I source image, depending on the target color space. If a valid solution does not exist in that image, the process looks for a valid astrometric solution in one of the other source channel images. If no valid astrometric solution can be found, this option is silently ignored.
文件: 将已有的天体测量解复制到合成图像。此选项仅适用于全局执行，即 ChannelCombination 创建新的合成图像时，或对主视图执行时。在预览上执行 ChannelCombination 时，此选项始终被忽略。启用此选项后，若绿色通道、CIE Y、CIE L*、V 或 I 源图像中存在有效的天体测量解，则按目标色彩空间继承该解。若该图像中没有有效解，进程会在其他源通道图像中查找有效的天体测量解。若找不到任何有效的天体测量解，此选项被静默忽略。

FILE: Copy an existing astrometric solution to the combined image.This option is only applicable to global execution, that is, when LRGBCombination creates a new combined image, or to execution on main views. This option is always ignored when LRGBCombination is executed on previews.When this option is enabled, a valid astrometric solution is inherited if it exists in the L (lightness) source image. If a valid solution does not exist in the L image, or if the L image is disabled, the process looks for a valid astrometric solution in one of the other enabled source images. If no valid astrometric solution can be found, this option is silently ignored.
文件: 将已有的天体测量解复制到合成图像。此选项仅适用于全局执行，即 LRGBCombination 创建新的合成图像时，或对主视图执行时。在预览上执行 LRGBCombination 时，此选项始终被忽略。启用此选项后，若 L（明度）源图像中存在有效的天体测量解，则继承该解。若 L 图像中没有有效解，或 L 图像被禁用，进程会在其他已启用的源图像中查找有效的天体测量解。若找不到任何有效的天体测量解，此选项被静默忽略。

FILE: Copy an existing astrometric solution to the newly generated channel images.This option is only applicable when the target image is either a main view or a complete preview. It is always ignored when the process is executed on a partial preview.When this option is enabled, a valid astrometric solution is inherited if it exists in the target image, that is, in the image where the ChannelExtraction process is executed. The astrometric solution is copied to each extracted channel image and regenerated.
文件: 将已有的天体测量解复制到新生成的各通道图像。此选项仅在目标图像为主视图或完整预览时适用。在局部预览上执行进程时，此选项始终被忽略。启用此选项后，若目标图像（即执行 ChannelExtraction 的图像）中存在有效的天体测量解，则继承该解。该解会被复制到每个提取出的通道图像，并重新生成。

FILE: A rendering intent is a method to map existing out-of-gamut colors in the image color space to the color space of the target ICC profile.The relative colorimetric rendering intent matches the white point in the image color space to the white point in the target color space. For example, if the target ICC profile characterizes a printing device, this means that pure white will not be printed at all (no ink), but will be represented by the white of the paper. Out-of-gamut colors are replaced by the nearest in-gamut colors. Relative colorimetric is in general the best balanced option for the sake of color accuracy in both the numerical and perceptual senses.The absolute colorimetric intent also replaces out-of-gamut colors by their nearest matches in the output color space, but it doesn't try to match the white points. If the white points in the image and target color spaces don't match, you'll get a color cast in the highlights. However, since this intent doesn't alter any in-gamut colors, it is the best option in terms of numeric color accuracy.The perceptual intent maps all colors in the image space to the target space. With the perceptual intent, no out-of-gamut color is clipped, as happens with the colorimetric intents, but all colors can be altered, and the changes can be significant if the image space is much wider than the output space. In general, relative colorimetric is preferred, but perceptual can yield more vibrant results that may be desirable in some cases.Finally, the saturation intent tries to maximize color saturation in the output, at the cost of sacrifying color accuracy, when necessary. This intent can be a good option for synthetic graphics and illustrations, but not for reproduction of photographic images.

FILE: A rendering intent is a method to map out-of-gamut colors to the color space of the output device being used, such as a monitor or a printer/paper combination. Device gamuts are characterized by the color profiles associated with each device involved in a color management transformation.The relative colorimetric rendering intent is the default option for printers and proofing devices. It matches the white point in the image color space to the white point in the output device color space, which means that pure white is not printed at all (no ink), but represented by the white of the paper. Out-of-gamut colors are replaced by the nearest in-gamut colors. Relative colorimetric is in general the best balanced option for the sake of color accuracy in both the numerical and perceptual senses.The absolute colorimetric intent also replaces out-of-gamut colors by their nearest matches in the output color space, but it doesn't try to match white points. If the white points in the image and output device spaces don't match, you'll get a color cast in the highlights. However, since this intent doesn't alter any in-gamut colors, it is the best option in terms of numeric color accuracy.The perceptual intent maps all colors in the image space to the output device space. This is the default option for monitors. With the perceptual intent, no out-of-gamut color is clipped, as happens with colorimetric intents, but all colors can be altered, and the changes can be significant if the image space is much wider than the output space. In general, relative colorimetric is preferred for printed media, but perceptual can yield more vibrant results that may be desirable in some cases.Finally, the saturation intent tries to maximize color saturation in the represented image, at the cost of sacrifying color accuracy, if necessary. This intent can be a good option for synthetic graphics and illustrations, but not for reproduction of photographic images.

文件: 这是背景样本像素允许的最大离散度。减小该值会使背景样本剔除更多相对各样本框中位数的离群像素，有助于让背景样本不受噪声和相对较小的恒星等小尺度亮结构的影响。

文件: 背景模型按定义是极其平滑的函数，因此通常可以用 2 到 8 之间的降采样比例生成，具体取决于被采样背景的变化程度。降采样模型能大幅缩短背景模型插值所需的计算时间。

FILE: Increasing this parameter allows for the inclusion of more dark pixels in the generated background model, while more restrictive criteria can be applied to reject bright pixels (as specified by the tolerance parameter). 文件: 增大此参数可在生成的背景模型中纳入更多暗像素，同时可按容差参数指定的更严格标准剔除亮像素。这样能在不纳入弥散星云等相对明亮的大尺度天体的情况下，获得更好的天空背景模型。

FILE: Controls the adaptability of the 2-D surface modeling algorithm used to build the background model. 文件: 控制用于构建背景模型的二维曲面建模算法的适应能力。平滑度为 0 时使用纯插值曲面样条，在各 DBE 样本位置上精确重现其数值。通常取适中的平滑度较理想，过度平滑会导致建模错误。

FILE: This is the maximum dispersion allowed for background samples, with respect to the median of the target image. By decreasing this value, ABE will be more restrictive to select background samples that differ too much from the mean background of the whole image. This is useful to avoid inclusion of large-scale structures, such as extended nebular regions, in the generated background model.
文件: 这是背景样本相对目标图像中位数允许的最大离散度。减小该值会使 ABE 更严格地排除与整幅图像平均背景差异过大的背景样本，有助于避免把弥散星云区等大尺度结构纳入生成的背景模型。
