文件: 这是应用于恒星检测工作图像的高斯卷积滤波半径（像素）。仅在信噪比极低的图像上使用，此类图像中恒星检测器无法用默认参数找到可靠的恒星。将参数设为零即关闭降噪。

FILE: The default saturation threshold is 0.75. For signal evaluation this parameter plays an imortant role to prevent contamination of the statistical sample of flux ratios by sources with saturated or nonlinear data. Changing the default value should not be necessary under normal conditions.
文件: 饱和阈值默认为 0.75。在信号评估中，该参数对防止饱和或非线性数据的源污染通量比统计样本起着重要作用。正常情况下无需改动默认值。

FILE: ColorCalibration will use pixels read from this image to compute a set of three color calibration factors, one for each channel. If you leave this field blank (or with its default <target image> value), the target image will be also the white reference image during the calibration process.
文件: ColorCalibration 将从该图像读取的像素计算三个色彩校准系数，每个通道一个。若此字段留空（或保持默认的 <target image> 值），则在校准过程中目标图像同时充当白参考图像。

FILE: The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for calibration of wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of signal evaluation.
文件: 默认值给出 24K 颗恒星这一相当宽松的上限。限制测光样本数量可提升广域视场帧的校准性能——这类图像检测到的恒星数量往往极大。但把参与测量的源削减过多会损害信号评估的精度。

FILE: Noise reduction prevents detection of bright noise structures as false stars, including hot pixels and cosmic rays. This parameter can also be used to control the sizes of the smallest detected stars (increase to exclude more stars), although the minimum structure size parameter can be more efficient for this purpose.
文件: 降噪可防止把热像素、宇宙线等亮噪声结构误检为假恒星。此参数也可用于控制检测到的最小恒星尺寸（增大该值可排除更多恒星），不过用最小结构尺寸参数控制这一点更高效。

FILE: A white reference mask is white for pixels in the white reference image that have been used to calculate color correction factors, black anywhere else. You can use this mask to check whether the White pixels and Saturation point parameters are doing a good job selecting the pixels that you intend to use as a white reference.
文件: 白参考蒙版的含义是：在白参考图像中参与了色彩校正系数计算的像素为白色，其余位置为黑色。可用此蒙版检查“白色像素”与“饱和点”两个参数的选点是否符合你的预期。

FILE: This parameter allows limiting star detection to a subset of the brightest sources in the image adaptively. By requiring relatively high SNR levels in the evaluated sources, the accuracy and robustness of the signal evaluation process can be largely improved. The default value is 40, which is quite appropriate in most cases.
文件: 此参数可将恒星检测自适应地限制在图像中最亮的一部分源上。通过在参与评估的源上要求较高的信噪比，可显著提升信号评估的精度与稳健性。默认值为 40，在多数情况下相当合适。

FILE: Hot (blue) references, such as B and A stars, tend to induce a red color cast. Cold (red) references, such as K and M stars, tend to cause a blue color cast.The default average spiral galaxy reference is, in our opinion, truly representative of the deep space, and hence the most plausible white reference for most applications.
文件: 偏热的（蓝）参考，例如 B 型和 A 型星，容易引入偏红的色偏；偏冷的（红）参考，例如 K 型和 M 型星，容易引入偏蓝的色偏。我们认为，默认的平均旋涡星系参考是深空天体的真实代表，因而是多数应用中最合理的白参考。

FILE: When this option is selected, ColorCalibration uses a multiscale, wavelet-based structure detection routine to isolate bright image structures within a specified range of dimensional scales (see the next two parameters). This feature can be used to perform a color calibration based on the stars recorded in the white reference image.
文件: 选中此选项后，ColorCalibration 会使用基于小波的多尺度结构检测流程，在指定的尺度范围内分离出图像中的亮结构（见随后的两个参数）。该功能可用于基于白参考图像中记录的恒星执行色彩校准。

FILE: A background reference mask is white for pixels in the background reference image that have been used to calculate mean background levels, black anywhere else. You can use this mask to check whether the Lower limit and Upper limit parameters define a suitable range of values to select the pixels that you intend to use as background reference.
文件: 背景参考蒙版的含义是：在背景参考图像中参与了平均背景水平计算的像素为白色，其余位置为黑色。可用此蒙版检查“下限”与“上限”两个参数设定的取值范围是否合适，能否选出你打算用作背景参考的像素。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels can be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can prevent a valid signal evaluation.To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 这是恒星检测器在结构检测阶段之前执行的中值滤波半径（像素）。中值滤波对去除热像素非常有效。热像素会被误判为恒星，若数量较多则会导致信号评估无法得到有效结果。将参数设为零即关闭热像素去除。

FILE: If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects.In general, sources with several local maxima pose difficulties for the determination of accurate star positions and PSF parameters, although this is usually a minor problem for signal evaluation. For this reason this parameter is enabled by default.
文件: 启用此参数后，无法分离的多个源也能作为独立对象被自由检测。一般来说，含多个局部极大值的源会给恒星位置与 PSF 参数的精确测定带来困难，不过对信号评估而言这通常影响不大。因此该参数默认启用。

FILE: You should specify a view that represents the true background of the image. In most cases this means that you must select a view whose pixels are strongly dominated by the sky background, as it is being represented on the target image. A typical example involves defining a small preview over a free sky area of the target image, and selecting it here as the background reference image.
文件: 你应指定一个能代表图像真实背景的视图。多数情况下这意味着必须选择一个像素以天空背景为主的视图，与目标图像上所呈现的一致。典型做法是在目标图像的无天体天区定义一个小的预览，并在此处选为背景参考图像。

FILE: Finally, the saturation intent tries to maximize color saturation in the output, at the cost of sacrifying color accuracy, when necessary. This intent can be a good option for synthetic graphics and illustrations, but not for reproduction of photographic images.
文件: 最后是饱和度意图：它力求最大化输出的色彩饱和度，必要时牺牲色彩准确性。该意图适合合成图形和插画，但不适合照片类图像的复制。

FILE: When this option is disabled, 16-bit integer arithmetics will be used for 8-bit and 16-bit integer images. Floating point will always be used for the rest of images, irrespective of the state of this option, in order to preserve numerical accuracy. This option is enabled by default
文件: 禁用此选项时，8 位与 16 位整数图像将使用 16 位整数运算。其余类型的图像无论该选项状态如何，一律使用浮点运算，以保证数值精度。此选项默认启用。

FILE: When this option is enabled, a valid astrometric solution is inherited if it exists in the target image, that is, in the image where the ChannelExtraction process is executed. The astrometric solution is copied to each extracted channel image and regenerated.
文件: 启用此选项后，若目标图像（即执行 ChannelExtraction 进程的图像）存在有效天文测量解，该解会被继承。该解将复制到每个分离出的通道图像并重新生成。

FILE: When this option is enabled, a valid astrometric solution is inherited if it exists in the L (lightness) source image. If a valid solution does not exist in the L image, or if the L image is disabled, the process looks for a valid astrometric solution in one of the other enabled source images. If no valid astrometric solution can be found, this option is silently ignored.
文件: 启用此选项后，若 L（明度）源图像存在有效天文测量解，该解会被继承。若 L 图像不存在有效解，或 L 图像被禁用，进程会在其他已启用的源图像中查找有效解。若找不到任何有效天文测量解，此选项将被静默忽略。

FILE: When this option is enabled, a valid astrometric solution is inherited if it exists in the green, CIE Y, CIE L*, V or I source image, depending on the target color space. If a valid solution does not exist in that image, the process looks for a valid astrometric solution in one of the other source channel images. If no valid astrometric solution can be found, this option is silently ignored.
文件: 启用此选项后，会按照目标色彩空间在绿色、CIE Y、CIE L*、V 或 I 源图像中查找并继承有效的天文测量解。若该图像不存在有效解，进程会在其他源通道图像中查找。若找不到任何有效天文测量解，此选项将被静默忽略。

FILE: Open or bring the first image to front.Click on the comet to acquire centroid coordinates of the nucleus. Use Ctrl+Click to disable automatic centroid detection.
文件: 打开第一个图像或将其置于前台。单击彗星以获取彗核的质心坐标。用 Ctrl+单击可关闭自动质心检测。

FILE: Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz suffix. Normally you should select .xdrz files generated by the StarAlignment process for the same files that you are using with this tool.
文件: drizzle 数据文件使用 .xdrz 后缀。通常应选择 StarAlignment 进程为你正在使用的那批文件所生成的 .xdrz 文件。

FILE: If this option is disabled, comet coordinates will be interpolated linearly from fixed frame positions, or only from the initial and final frame positions if no intermediate frame positions have been defined.
文件: 禁用此选项时，彗星坐标将按固定帧位置线性插值得到；若未定义任何中间帧位置，则仅由首帧与末帧位置插值。

FILE: When drizzle data files (.xdrz) are added and a subtraction operand image is selected, a new, unaligned drizzle-integrable image will be written (either a stars-only or a comet-only image), along with new .xdrz files.
文件: 当加入 drizzle 数据文件（.xdrz）并选定相减操作数图像后，会写出一个新的、未对齐的可 drizzle 积分图像（仅恒星或仅彗星的图像），并同时生成新的 .xdrz 文件。

FILE: If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the CometAlignment process will fail.
文件: 若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则 CometAlignment 进程会失败。

FILE: Associate existing drizzle data files with input images.Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz suffix. Normally you should select .xdrz files generated by the StarAlignment process for the same files that you are using with this tool.
文件: 将已有的 drizzle 数据文件与输入图像关联。drizzle 数据文件使用 .xdrz 后缀。通常应选择 StarAlignment 进程为你正在使用的那批文件所生成的 .xdrz 文件。

FILE: If this option is selected, CometAlignment will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.** Warning: Enable this option at your own risk.
文件: 选中此选项后，CometAlignment 会覆盖与生成的输出文件同名的已有文件。这很危险，被覆盖文件的原始内容将永久丢失。** 警告：启用此选项风险自负。

FILE: Generate a new image window with a representation of the comet's path from positions measured on the set of input frames. This image is generated with a white background and black center marks and lines, so it is ready to be used as a mask on any of the input frames.
文件: 根据在整组输入帧上测得的位置，生成一个描绘彗星轨迹的新图像窗口。该图像为白底、黑色中心标记与轨迹线，可直接作为任一输入帧的蒙版使用。

FILE: This is the directory (or folder) where all output files will be written.If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the CometAlignment process will fail.
文件: 这是所有输出文件的写入目录（或文件夹）。若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则 CometAlignment 进程会失败。

FILE: Compute comet nucleus centroids by fitting a PSF for each target frame during process execution. This option should normally be enabled for optimal registration accuracy.If this option is disabled, comet coordinates will be interpolated linearly from fixed frame positions, or only from the initial and final frame positions if no intermediate frame positions have been defined.
文件: 在进程执行过程中对每个目标帧拟合 PSF，以此计算彗核质心。为获得最佳配准精度，通常应启用此选项。若禁用此选项，彗星坐标将按固定帧位置线性插值得到；若未定义任何中间帧位置，则仅由首帧与末帧位置插值。

FILE: RGB/K Applies the wavelet transform to the three RGB components of a target color image, or to the gray component of a grayscale image. This is the default mode.
文件: RGB/K：对目标彩色图像的三个 RGB 分量、或灰度图像的灰度分量施加小波变换。这是默认模式。

FILE: Apply a soft thresholding of wavelet coefficients instead of a hard thresholding. In general, soft thresholding is more accurate and less prone to artifact generation.
文件: 对小波系数采用软阈值处理，而不是硬阈值处理。一般来说软阈值更精确，也更不容易产生伪影。

FILE: Dynamic range extension, dark pixels. Increasing this parameter extends the output dynamic range to prevent saturation (i.e., truncation to black) of pixels with negative values.
文件: 动态范围扩展（暗像素）。增大此参数可扩展输出动态范围，防止负值像素被饱和（即截断为黑）。

FILE: Strength of the attenuation applied to thresholded wavelet coefficients. The default amount value of one will set to zero all wavelet coefficients below the k*sigma threshold value.
文件: 施加于阈值化小波系数的衰减强度。默认值 1 会把所有低于 k*sigma 阈值的小波系数置零。

FILE: Dynamic range extension, bright pixels. Increasing this parameter extends the output dynamic range to prevent saturation (i.e., truncation to white) of pixels with values greater than one.
文件: 动态范围扩展（亮像素）。增大此参数可扩展输出动态范围，防止数值大于 1 的像素被饱和（即截断为白）。

FILE: Peaked/small scaling functions (such as linear interpolation) work better to isolate small-scale structures.Smooth/large scaling functions (such as cubic B-spline) work better to isolate larger scales.
文件: 尖锐/小型尺度函数（如线性插值）更利于分离小尺度结构；平滑/大型尺度函数（如三次 B 样条）更利于分离较大的尺度。

FILE: By defining an amount parameter value less than one and two or more iterations, the noise reduction process can be more controllable. Multiple iterations can also be used to apply a stronger noise reduction effect.
文件: 把 amount 参数设为小于 1 的值并迭代两次或更多次，可让降噪过程更可控。多次迭代也可用于获得更强的降噪效果。

FILE: Enable or disable a wavelet layer to include or remove it, respectively, from the reconstructed image. For example, in some cases (very few, actually) you can just disable the first wavelet layer to remove small-scale noise.
文件: 启用或禁用某个小波层，即可把它纳入或排除在重建图像之外。例如某些情况（实际很少）下，仅禁用第一小波层就能去除小尺度噪声。

FILE: Wavelet scaling function.Peaked/small scaling functions (such as linear interpolation) work better to isolate small-scale structures.Smooth/large scaling functions (such as cubic B-spline) work better to isolate larger scales.
文件: 小波尺度函数。尖锐/小型尺度函数（如线性插值）更利于分离小尺度结构；平滑/大型尺度函数（如三次 B 样条）更利于分离较大的尺度。

FILE: Defines the degree of attenuation applied to noise wavelet coefficients in the current layer. Noise coefficients are those below the threshold parameter (see above). An amount value of one will remove all noise coefficients completely.
文件: 定义当前层噪声小波系数的衰减程度。噪声系数即低于阈值参数（见上）的系数。amount 取值为 1 会把所有噪声系数完全去除。

FILE: Large-scale functions apply nonlinear mathematical functions to the residual layer of the wavelet transform. The purpose of these transformations is to control or redistribute the large-scale illumination profile in the processed image.
文件: 大尺度函数会对小波变换的残差层施加非线性数学函数。这类变换的目的是控制或重新分布处理后图像中的大尺度照度分布。

FILE: Number of noise reduction iterationsBy defining an amount parameter value less than one and two or more iterations, the noise reduction process can be more controllable. Multiple iterations can also be used to apply a stronger noise reduction effect.
文件: 降噪迭代次数。把 amount 参数设为小于 1 的值并迭代两次或更多次，可让降噪过程更可控。多次迭代也可用于获得更强的降噪效果。

FILE: Defines a multiplier in sigma units (the k in the k-sigma method) for noise thresholding. All wavelet coefficients below the k*sigma threshold will be attenuated by applying a hard or a soft thresholding procedure (see the soft thresholding parameter).
文件: 以 sigma 为单位（k-sigma 方法中的 k）定义噪声阈值乘数。所有低于 k*sigma 阈值的小波系数都会通过硬阈值或软阈值处理被衰减（见软阈值参数）。

FILE: Increasing Pixels visualizes positive wavelet coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to wavelet coefficient values.Decreasing Pixels visualizes negative wavelet coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to the absolute values of wavelet coefficients.
文件: “增大像素值”用于可视化正的小波系数，输出像素值与小波系数值成正比。“减小像素值”用于可视化负的小波系数，输出像素值与小波系数的绝对值成正比。

FILE: In general, k-sigma thresholding should not be used for noise reduction purposes, since the implemented per-layer noise reduction routine is much more accurate and controllable. This procedure can be useful for auxiliary image processing tasks, such as mask generation or feature detection.
文件: 一般来说 k-sigma 阈值处理不应用于降噪，因为已实现的逐层降噪流程精度更高、更可控。该处理可用于辅助性图像任务，例如生成蒙版或特征检测。

FILE: Generate a new image window for each deringing map image. In a deringing map, pixel values are proportional to the amount of ringing detected in the processed image.New image windows will be created for the dark and bright deringing maps, if the corresponding amount parameters are nonzero.
文件: 为每幅去环图生成一个新的图像窗口。去环图中像素值与处理后图像检测到的振铃量成正比。若对应的暗/亮去环强度参数非零，则暗去环图与亮去环图都会创建新图像窗口。

FILE: Use the multiresolution support to compute the standard deviation of the noise in the target image. This is a reference value that will drive the whole k-sigma thresholding process. If this option is disabled, a simpler and faster (but less accurate) method will be used for noise estimation.
文件: 使用多分辨率支撑集计算目标图像的噪声标准差。该参考值将驱动整个 k-sigma 阈值处理过程。若禁用此选项，则改用更简单快速（但精度较低）的方法估计噪声。

FILE: Increase this parameter to fix dark ringing artifacts around bright image features (stars, small nebulae, etc.). Try to find the smallest value that can fix the generated ringing. Too large of a dark deringing amount will lead to overcorrection, generating bright artifacts around bright image features.
文件: 增大此参数可消除亮图像特征（恒星、小星云等）周围的暗振铃伪影。请尽量选取能消除振铃的最小值。暗去环强度过大会导致过度校正，在亮特征周围产生亮伪影。

FILE: Deringing amount, dark ringing.Increase this parameter to fix dark ringing artifacts around bright image features (stars, small nebulae, etc.). Try to find the smallest value that can fix the generated ringing. Too large of a dark deringing amount will lead to overcorrection, generating bright artifacts around bright image features.
文件: 去环强度（暗振铃）。增大此参数可消除亮图像特征（恒星、小星云等）周围的暗振铃伪影。请尽量选取能消除振铃的最小值。暗去环强度过大会导致过度校正，在亮特征周围产生亮伪影。

FILE: Deringing routines have been designed to fix dark and bright artifacts generated around jump discontinuities, such as stars and edges, as a result of the Gibbs phenomenon. This happens when one or more wavelet layers are biased. In astronomical images, the most common artifacts are the well-known dark rings around stars and other bright, small-scale structures.
文件: 去环流程用于消除跳跃不连续处（如恒星与边缘）因吉布斯现象而产生的暗、亮伪影，其成因是一个或多个小波层被偏置。在天文图像中最常见的就是恒星和其他明亮小尺度结构周围的暗环。

FILE: Increase this parameter to fix bright ringing artifacts around dark image features. This type of ringing doesn't usually occur in astronomical images; they are more common in daylight images. Try to find the smallest value that can fix the generated ringing. Too large of a bright deringing amount will lead to overcorrection, generating dark artifacts around dark image features.
文件: 增大此参数可消除暗图像特征周围的亮振铃伪影。此类振铃在天文图像中并不常见，在日光图像中更普遍。请尽量选取能消除振铃的最小值。亮去环强度过大会导致过度校正，在暗特征周围产生暗伪影。

FILE: The bias parameter defines a multiplicative factor applied to a whole wavelet layer. Increase the bias parameter to enhance all the structures supported by a specific layer. Note that this includes the whole layer contents, that is both significant structures and noise. Typically bias can be increased at scales from 2 to 4 pixels for local contrast enhancement purposes (aka sharpening).
文件: 偏置参数定义施加于整个小波层的乘性因子。增大偏置 可增强该层所承载的所有结构。注意这包含该层的全部内容，既有显著结构也有噪声。通常可对 2 到 4 像素的尺度提高偏置，以实现局部对比度增强（即锐化）。

FILE: Edit the currently selected filter.To create a new filter based on the current one, change the filter name.Changes will be permanently saved to the current library file.
文件: 编辑当前选定的滤波器。若想以当前滤波器为基础新建一个，请修改滤波器名称。改动会永久保存到当前库文件。

FILE: Generate an image window for each deringing map image. New image windows will be created for the dark and bright deringing maps, if the corresponding amount parameters are nonzero.
文件: 为每幅去环图生成一个图像窗口。若对应的暗/亮去环强度参数非零，则暗去环图与亮去环图都会创建新图像窗口。

FILE: Thumbnail preview of the current convolution filter.Positive or zero filter coefficients are rendered as grayscale pixels on the thumbnail. Negative filter coefficients are rendered as red pixels.
文件: 当前卷积滤波器的缩略图预览。系数为正或零时在缩略图中显示为灰度像素，系数为负时显示为红色像素。

FILE: Standard deviation of the parametric low-pass filter in pixels.By increasing this parameter the parametric filter will be larger, and hence the convolution process will act at larger dimensional scales.
文件: 参数化低通滤波器的标准差（像素）。增大此参数会使参数化滤波器变大，卷积过程因此作用于更大的空间尺度。

FILE: Enable this option if the image has been mosaiced with a Color Filter Array (CFA) or Bayer matrix (OSC CCD, DSLR camera).Disable if the image comes from a monochrome imager or has already been deBayered.
文件: 若图像是以彩色滤镜阵列（CFA）或 Bayer 矩阵镶嵌采集（OSC CCD、单反相机），请启用此选项；若图像来自单色相机，或已完成去马赛克，请禁用。

FILE: If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the CosmeticCorrection process will fail.
文件: 若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则 CosmeticCorrection 进程会失败。

FILE: If this option is selected, CosmeticCorrection will p_overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.Enable this option at your own risk.
文件: 选中此选项后，CosmeticCorrection 会覆盖与生成的输出文件同名的已有文件。这很危险，被覆盖文件的原始内容将永久丢失。启用此选项风险自负。

FILE: This is the directory (or folder) where all output files will be written.If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the CosmeticCorrection process will fail.
文件: 这是所有输出文件的写入目录（或文件夹）。若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则 CosmeticCorrection 进程会失败。

FILE: The rest of options select a fixed PSF type for all detected sources, which improves execution times at the cost of a less adaptive, and hence potentially less accurate, signal estimation process.
文件: 其余选项为所有检测到的源指定固定的 PSF 类型，可缩短执行时间，但信号估计过程的自适应能力会下降，精度可能因此降低。

FILE: If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the demosaicing process will fail.
文件: 若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则去马赛克进程会失败。

FILE: If this option is selected, Debayer will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.Enable this option at your own risk.
文件: 选中此选项后，Debayer 会覆盖与生成的输出文件同名的已有文件。这很危险，被覆盖文件的原始内容将永久丢失。启用此选项风险自负。

FILE: The default saturation threshold is 1.0. For signal evaluation, the implemented star detection and outlier rejection routines are normally able to avoid contamination from saturated sources, so the default value of this parameter should not be changed under normal conditions.
文件: 饱和阈值默认为 1.0。在信号评估中，已实现的恒星检测与离群剔除流程通常能避免饱和源的污染，因此正常情况下不应改动此参数的默认值。

FILE: The signal evaluation result will be stored as a set of custom, per-channel XISF properties and FITS header keywords that other processes and scripts can use for specialized image analysis purposes.This option should always be enabled for demosaicing of deep-sky raw light frames.
文件: 信号评估结果会保存为一组自定义的逐通道 XISF 属性和 FITS 头关键字，供其他进程和脚本做专门的图像分析。对深空原始亮帧做去马赛克时，此选项应始终启用。

FILE: This is the directory (or folder) where all output demosaiced files will be written.If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the demosaicing process will fail.
文件: 这是所有去马赛克输出文件的写入目录（或文件夹）。若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则去马赛克进程会失败。

FILE: The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of signal estimation.
文件: 默认值给出 24K 颗恒星这一相当宽松的上限。限制测光样本数量可提升广域视场帧的性能——这类图像检测到的恒星数量往往极大。但把参与测量的源削减过多会损害信号估计的精度。

FILE: The Auto option requires view properties available in the target view. These properties are normally generated by the RAW format support module and stored in XISF files.For images acquired with X-Trans sensors this parameter is ignored and CFA patterns are always extracted from existing image properties.
文件: “自动”选项需要目标视图具备相应的视图属性。这些属性通常由 RAW 格式支持模块生成并存入 XISF 文件。对 X-Trans 传感器采集的图像，此参数被忽略，CFA 排列一律从已有的图像属性中提取。

FILE: Noise reduction prevents detection of bright noise structures as false stars, including hot pixels and cosmic rays. This parameter can also be used to control the sizes of the smallest detected stars (increase it to exclude more stars), although the minimum structure size parameter can be more efficient for this purpose.
文件: 降噪可防止把热像素、宇宙线等亮噪声结构误检为假恒星。此参数也可用于控制检测到的最小恒星尺寸（增大该值可排除更多恒星），不过用最小结构尺寸参数控制这一点更高效。

FILE: Select the demosaicing algorithm. SuperPixel is fast and creates a good quality, half-sized image. The remaining methods create a full sized image, increasing in quality and computational overhead.For images acquired with X-Trans sensors this parameter is ignored and a special X-Trans interpolation algorithm is always applied.
文件: 选择去马赛克算法。SuperPixel 速度快，生成质量不错的半尺寸图像。其余方法生成全尺寸图像，质量与计算开销依次上升。对 X-Trans 传感器采集的图像，此参数被忽略，一律使用专门的 X-Trans 插值算法。

FILE: These estimates can be used later by several processes and scripts for specialized image analysis purposes, most notably by SubframeSelector and ImageIntegration for image grading and weighting. Noise estimates will always be computed from uninterpolated, raw calibrated data.This option should always be enabled under normal working conditions.
文件: 这些估计值随后可供多个进程和脚本用于专门的图像分析，最典型的是 SubframeSelector 与 ImageIntegration，用于图像评级与加权。噪声估计始终从未经插值的原始校准数据计算。正常工作条件下此选项应始终启用。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. If not removed, hot pixels will be identified as stars, and if present in large amounts, can prevent a valid signal evaluation.To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 这是恒星检测器在结构检测阶段之前执行的中值滤波半径（像素）。中值滤波对去除热像素非常有效。若不去除，热像素会被识别为恒星，数量较多时会导致信号评估无法得到有效结果。将参数设为零即关闭热像素去除。

FILE: Select the CFA pattern of the camera (DSLR or OSC) used to acquire the target image.The Auto option requires view properties available in the target view. These properties are normally generated by the RAW format support module and stored in XISF files.For images acquired with X-Trans sensors this parameter is ignored and CFA patterns are always extracted from existing image properties.
文件: 选择采集目标图像所用相机（单反或 OSC）的 CFA 排列。“自动”选项需要目标视图具备相应的视图属性，这些属性通常由 RAW 格式支持模块生成并存入 XISF 文件。对 X-Trans 传感器采集的图像，此参数被忽略，CFA 排列一律从已有的图像属性中提取。

FILE: This value will multiply the deringing support image (internally only; the support image is not modified at all). In this way you can modulate the local deringing effect.
文件: 该值会乘到去环支撑图像上（仅在内部进行，支撑图像本身完全不被修改）。这样就能调节局部的去环效果。

FILE: Standard deviation of the parametric PSF function.By increasing this parameter the PSF will be larger, and hence the deconvolution process will act at larger dimensional scales.
文件: 参数化 PSF 函数的标准差。增大此参数会使 PSF 变大，反卷积过程因此作用于更大的空间尺度。

FILE: Local deringing regularization strength.This value will multiply the deringing support image (internally only; the support image is not modified at all). In this way you can modulate the local deringing effect.
文件: 局部去环正则化强度。该值会乘到去环支撑图像上（仅在内部进行，支撑图像本身完全不被修改）。这样就能调节局部的去环效果。

FILE: The deringing support is optional; if you don't specify it, the global deringing algorithm will be applied uniformly to the whole image. The deringing support allows you to use a star mask to drive a local deringing algorithm that can enhance protection of stars and other high-contrast, small-scale image structures.
文件: 去环支撑是可选的；若不指定，则对整个图像统一应用全局去环算法。去环支撑允许你用一个星蒙版来驱动局部去环算法，从而更好地保护恒星和其他高对比度的小尺度图像结构。

FILE: The date (in the TDB timescale) at which the specified initial coordinates or orbital elements are valid. This date will be the starting time for numerical integration of orbital motion.
文件: 指定的初始坐标或轨道根数所对应的日期（TDB 时标）。该日期将作为轨道运动数值积分的起始时刻。

FILE: For integration of orbits for objects defined in a database, you can specify a local database file in several standard plain text formats; see the database file parameter for more information.
文件: 对数据库中定义的天体做轨道积分时，可以指定一个使用若干标准纯文本格式的本地数据库文件；详情见数据库文件参数。

FILE: The XEPH file providing fundamental solar system ephemerides.If this field is left blank (or with its default <core default> value), the default core fundamental ephemerides file will be used.
文件: 提供太阳系基础星历的 XEPH 文件。若此字段留空（或保持默认的 <core default> 值），将使用默认的核心基础星历文件。

FILE: Retrieve data for the first object found in the specified database, then populate the state vectors or orbital elements (depending on database contents), as well as photometric and physical object properties.
文件: 从指定数据库中取回所找到的第一个天体的数据，并填充状态矢量或轨道根数（取决于数据库内容），以及测光与物理属性。

FILE: Include massive Kuiper belt objects (KBOs) as individual perturber bodies.In current versions of PixInsight this includes the 30 most massive KBOs used for the numerical integration of JPL's DE440 ephemerides.
文件: 把大质量柯伊伯带天体（KBO）作为单独的摄动体纳入。在当前版本的 PixInsight 中，这包括用于 JPL DE440 星历数值积分的 30 个最大质量 KBO。

FILE: Include the most massive asteroids as individual perturber bodies.In current versions of PixInsight this includes the complete set of 343 asteroids used for the numerical integration of JPL's DE430 ephemerides.
文件: 把质量最大的小行星作为单独的摄动体纳入。在当前版本的 PixInsight 中，这包括用于 JPL DE430 星历数值积分的全部 343 颗小行星。

FILE: If this option is disabled, the contents of the Search tokens parameter is a comma-separated list of literal search tokens and/or asteroid identifier ranges; see the documentation for that parameter for more information.
文件: 若禁用此选项，“搜索词”参数的内容是一个以逗号分隔的列表，元素为字面搜索词和/或小行星编号范围；详情见该参数的文档。

FILE: If this option is selected, EphemerisGenerator will overwrite existing .xeph files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.Enable this option at your own risk.
文件: 选中此选项后，EphemerisGenerator 会覆盖与生成的输出文件同名的已有 .xeph 文件。这很危险，被覆盖文件的原始内容将永久丢失。启用此选项风险自负。

FILE: If disabled, a combined Earth-Moon perturber with Earth-Moon barycenter coordinates and combined mass parameter will be used instead.Under normal working conditions this option should always be enabled for the sake of accuracy in computed ephemerides. It can be disabled for testing purposes.
文件: 若禁用此选项，则改用一个合并的地月摄动体，以地月质心坐标与合并质量参数表示。为保星历计算精度，正常工作条件下此选项应始终启用；仅为测试目的时才可以禁用。

FILE: Bulirsch-Stoer is the adaptive Bulirsch-Stoer extrapolation method with dense output implemented by the Boost.Odeint library, controlled by absolute and relative tolerances derived from the floating point precision of the integration. This was the only integrator available in previous versions of this tool.
文件: Bulirsch-Stoer 是 Boost.Odeint 库实现的自适应 Bulirsch-Stoer 外推法（带密集输出），由积分所用浮点精度推导出的绝对与相对容差控制。在此工具的早期版本中，它是唯一可用的积分器。

FILE: Currently we support plain text databases in a variety of formats, including well-known public databases of asteroid and comet orbital elements available from Lowell Observatory, MPC and JPL, as well as several CSV and tabular formats generated by our scripts and tools. See the database format parameter below.
文件: 目前支持多种纯文本数据库格式，包括 Lowell 天文台、MPC 与 JPL 公开的小行星和彗星轨道根数数据库，以及我们的脚本与工具生成的若干 CSV 和表格格式。详见下方的数据库格式参数。

FILE: Exclude asteroids with identifiers found in core ephemerides XEPH files from database search results. For example, if this option is enabled, '1 Ceres' would not be included in any search result under normal conditions.This option is useful to avoid duplicating already available objects in newly generated XEPH files.
文件: 从数据库搜索结果中排除编号已见于核心星历 XEPH 文件的小行星。例如启用此选项后，正常情况下“1 Ceres”不会出现在任何搜索结果中。该选项有助于避免在新生成的 XEPH 文件中重复收录已可用的天体。

FILE: Compute direct acceleration perturbation terms caused by oblateness. Zonal harmonics J2 are computed for Sun, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.Under normal working conditions this option should always be enabled for the sake of accuracy in computed ephemerides. It can be disabled for testing purposes.
文件: 计算由扁率引起的直接加速度摄动项。对太阳、地球、火星、木星、土星、天王星和海王星计算带谐项 J2。为保星历计算精度，正常工作条件下此选项应始终启用；仅为测试目的时才可以禁用。

FILE: Supported plain text database formats are described in a special XML file included in the standard PixInsight distribution. This means that new formats can be added easily without needing to release a new version of the EphemerisGenerator process. Please feel free to let us know about additional databases that you'd like us to implement.
文件: 支持的纯文本数据库格式在一个随标准 PixInsight 分发的专门 XML 文件中描述。这意味着无需发布 EphemerisGenerator 进程的新版本就能方便地添加新格式。若希望我们支持其他数据库，欢迎告知。

FILE: Consider Earth and Moon as two separate perturber bodies.If disabled, a combined Earth-Moon perturber with Earth-Moon barycenter coordinates and combined mass parameter will be used instead.Under normal working conditions this option should always be enabled for the sake of accuracy in computed ephemerides. It can be disabled for testing purposes.
文件: 把地球与月球视为两个独立的摄动体。若禁用，则改用一个合并的地月摄动体，以地月质心坐标与合并质量参数表示。为保星历计算精度，正常工作条件下此选项应始终启用；仅为测试目的时才可以禁用。

FILE: When the Regular expressions option is disabled and a search token does not specify a search range, it will be interpreted as a case-insensitive substring that will be searched for literally in object identifiers and names. For example, the following search tokens:shoemaker-levy 9would select all fragments of comet D/1993 F2 Shoemaker-Levy 9 (21 objects).
文件: 当“正则表达式”选项被禁用、且某个搜索词未指定搜索范围时，该词会被当作不区分大小写的子串，在对象编号与名称中按字面搜索。例如以下搜索词：shoemaker-levy 9 会选出 D/1993 F2 Shoemaker-Levy 9 彗星的全部分裂碎片（21 个对象）。

FILE: Literal Search TokensWhen the Regular expressions option is disabled and a search token does not specify a search range, it will be interpreted as a case-insensitive substring that will be searched for literally in object identifiers and names. For example, the following search tokens:shoemaker-levy 9would select all fragments of comet D/1993 F2 Shoemaker-Levy 9 (21 objects).
文件: 字面搜索词。当“正则表达式”选项被禁用、且某个搜索词未指定搜索范围时，该词会被当作不区分大小写的子串，在对象编号与名称中按字面搜索。例如以下搜索词：shoemaker-levy 9 会选出 D/1993 F2 Shoemaker-Levy 9 彗星的全部分裂碎片（21 个对象）。

FILE: Custom XEPH files generated with this tool can be used to compute ephemerides for a wide range of applications on the PixInsight PCL/PJSR platforms. For example, you can use them with the AnnotateImage script to find and annotate asteroids and comets in your images, or with the Ephemerides script to compute positional and visibility data in a variety of formats and conditions.
文件: 用此工具生成的自定义 XEPH 文件可在 PixInsight 的 PCL/PJSR 平台上用于多种用途。例如可配合 AnnotateImage 脚本在图像中查找并标注小行星与彗星，或配合 Ephemerides 脚本按多种格式与条件计算位置和可见性数据。

FILE: See also the Use ROWORDER keywords option below for a de-facto standard that we support in the hope that it will solve most practical issues caused by this FITS orientation ambiguity.
文件: 关于我们为消除这种 FITS 朝向歧义所支持的既成标准，另见下方的“使用 ROWORDER 关键字”选项，希望它能解决大部分实际问题。

FILE: The nonstandard ROWORDER keyword is generated by a number of image acquisition applications. By supporting it, hopefully we'll be able to solve most practical FITS orientation issues.
文件: 非标准的 ROWORDER 关键字由不少图像采集软件生成。支持它有望解决大部分 FITS 朝向方面的实际问题。

FILE: ** Important ** If the 'Ignore' option is selected for 'Action' (see below), this option will be ignored (not applied). Please read the tooltip information provided for the 'Action' combo box below.
文件: ** 重要 ** 若“操作”选择了“忽略”选项（见下），则此选项会被忽略（不生效）。请阅读下方“操作”组合框的提示信息。

FILE: This parameter specifies how to proceed when pixel values in a read FITS image exceed the default input range.** Important ** If the 'Ignore' option is selected for 'Action' (see below), this option will be ignored (not applied). Please read the tooltip information provided for the 'Action' combo box below.
文件: 此参数指定读入的 FITS 图像像素值超出默认输入范围时如何处理。** 重要 ** 若“操作”选择了“忽略”选项（见下），则此选项会被忽略（不生效）。请阅读下方“操作”组合框的提示信息。

FILE: ** Warning ** If you select the 'Ignore' option, out-of-range pixel values will not be fixed. Images with out-of-range pixels will not be rendered correctly on the screen and may cause problems with some tools.If you select this option, platform stability is not guaranteed. Use this option at your own risk.
文件: ** 警告 ** 若选择“忽略”选项，越界像素值不会被修正。含越界像素的图像在屏幕上无法正确渲染，并可能给某些工具带来问题。若选择此选项，不保证平台稳定。使用风险自负。

FILE: Note that if you write signed integer FITS images with PixInsight (which is discouraged for the sake of compatibility), the whole available numeric range will always be used. This means that if this option is enabled, signed FITS files written by PixInsight will not be loaded correctly. This option is disabled by default.
文件: 注意：若用 PixInsight 写出有符号整数 FITS 图像（出于兼容性考虑并不推荐），可用的整个数值范围总会被用满。这意味着启用此选项后，PixInsight 写出的有符号 FITS 文件将无法被正确加载。此选项默认禁用。

FILE: Please specify a range of values to correctly interpret existing pixel values in this image. The lower and upper range bounds below correspond to the limits of the available dynamic range in the context of this FITS image. PixInsight will use these limits to scale pixel values to the normalized [0,1] range, where zero represents black and one represents white.
文件: 请指定一个数值范围，以正确解释该图像中已有的像素值。下方的范围上下界对应此 FITS 图像可用的动态范围极限。PixInsight 会用这两个极限把像素值缩放到归一化的 [0,1] 范围，其中零表示黑、一表示白。

FILE: When this option is selected, the BZERO=0 and BSCALE=1 keywords will also be written to the headers of signed integer FITS images. Although these keywords are not necessary to define the default range and scaling ratio of signed integer data, they can improve compatibility with other imaging applications that seem to need them. This option is enabled by default.
文件: 选中此选项后，BZERO=0 与 BSCALE=1 两个关键字也会写入有符号整数 FITS 图像的头中。虽然定义有符号整数数据的默认范围与缩放比例并不需要这两个关键字，但它们能改善与某些看似需要它们的其他图像软件的兼容性。此选项默认启用。

FILE: The upper left origin and top-down orientation are coherent with the rest of image file formats and are the conventions used by most CCD camera control and image processing software applications by default.See also the Use ROWORDER keywords option below for a de-facto standard that we support in the hope that it will solve most practical issues caused by this FITS orientation ambiguity.
文件: 左上角原点与自上而下的朝向与其他图像文件格式一致，也是多数 CCD 相机控制和图像处理软件默认采用的约定。关于我们为消除这种 FITS 朝向歧义所支持的既成标准，另见下方的“使用 ROWORDER 关键字”选项。

FILE: Generate log files to trace thread executions and frame results. This option should only be used in exceptional cases where an execution issue needs to be investigated.
文件: 生成日志文件，记录线程执行过程与各帧结果。此选项只应在需要排查执行问题的特殊情况下使用。

FILE: This is the directory (or folder) where all output files will be written.This field is mandatory in case the registered images and/or the drizzle files have to be written.
文件: 这是所有输出文件的写入目录（或文件夹）。若需要写出配准后的图像和/或 drizzle 文件，此字段为必填。

FILE: A value of zero is appropriate for fields that are not overly crowded. Increase this value if the starfield is densely populated, and you must include more reference stars.
文件: 取值零适合恒星不太密集的视场。若星场密集，需要纳入更多参考星，请增大此值。

FILE: Generate a CSV plain text file containing the weights assigned to each frame.This option can be used to inspect how FastIntegration weighted the frames during its execution.
文件: 生成一个 CSV 纯文本文件，记录各帧被赋予的权重。可用此选项检查 FastIntegration 在执行过程中是如何给各帧加权的。

FILE: The maximum median error of reference star centroids. If the median error is higher than this value, then the fast solution won't be accepted and the frame will be discarded.
文件: 参考星质心的最大中位误差。若中位误差高于此值，快速解将不被接受，该帧会被丢弃。

FILE: The number of frames to be integrated on each batch.The integration process is organized in batches; each integration batch is performed when enough frames have been registered.
文件: 每批参与叠加的帧数。叠加过程按批组织；每当配准完成的帧数足够，就执行一批叠加。

FILE: The reference image will not be modified during the registration process. Moreover, it is only used as a reference for the alignment and it will not be integrated in the final image.
文件: 配准过程中参考图像不会被修改。此外它仅用于对齐参考，不会被纳入最终图像的叠加。

FILE: Increase this parameter to make the search operations more robust against strong tracking drifts. Decrease this parameter to slightly gain speed if the tracking has no significant drift.
文件: 增大此参数可使搜索操作对强烈跟踪漂移更稳健。若跟踪无明显漂移，可减小此参数以略微提速。

FILE: Tune this parameter to balance the parallelization of I/O operations with respect to CPU worker threads. Increasing this value may increase the disk throughput at the cost of more RAM memory required.
文件: 调节此参数以平衡 I/O 操作相对 CPU 工作线程的并行程度。增大该值可能提高磁盘吞吐，但会占用更多内存。

FILE: Stars with peak values larger than this value won't be detected. This can be useful to reject all stars brighter than a fixed level systematically. To effectively disable this feature, set this parameter to one.
文件: 峰值高于此值的恒星不会被检测到。可用于系统性地剔除所有亮于某个固定水平的恒星。将参数设为一即实际关闭此功能。

FILE: This option is enabled by default, but you may disable it for the only purpose of increasing the execution speed at the cost of rejecting more frames when the fast alignment method does not respect the given tolerance.
文件: 此选项默认启用；你也可以禁用它，唯一目的是提升执行速度，代价是在快速对齐方法不满足给定容差时会剔除更多帧。

FILE: Upper star detection limit.Stars with peak values larger than this value won't be detected. This can be useful to reject all stars brighter than a fixed level systematically. To effectively disable this feature, set this parameter to one.
文件: 恒星检测上限。峰值高于此值的恒星不会被检测到。可用于系统性地剔除所有亮于某个固定水平的恒星。将参数设为一即实际关闭此功能。

FILE: If this option is selected, FastIntegration will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.Enable this option at your own risk.
文件: 选中此选项后，FastIntegration 会覆盖与生成的输出文件同名的已有文件。这很危险，被覆盖文件的原始内容将永久丢失。启用此选项风险自负。

FILE: Increase this parameter to favor detection of fainter stars. Decrease it to restrict detection to brighter stars. The default value is 0.5. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.
文件: 增大此参数有利于检测更暗的恒星，减小则把检测限制在更亮的恒星上。默认值为 0.5。正常工作条件下一般无需改动此参数的默认值。

FILE: The Resolution algorithm is a good option to achieve finer details in the final image. This algorithm maximizes the ratio between the star's flux and its size, a trade-off between maximizing the signal and minimizing the area over which the signal is distributed.
文件: Resolution 算法是让最终图像获得更精细细节的合适选择。它最大化恒星通量与其尺寸之比，在最大化信号与最小化信号散布面积之间取得平衡。

FILE: The maximum number of frames to read in advance while the current batch is in progress.Tune this parameter to balance the parallelization of I/O operations with respect to CPU worker threads. Increasing this value may increase the disk throughput at the cost of more RAM memory required.
文件: 当前批次执行期间预先读取的最大帧数。调节此参数以平衡 I/O 操作相对 CPU 工作线程的并行程度。增大该值可能提高磁盘吞吐，但会占用更多内存。

FILE: Registered images will be transformed (translated, scaled and rotated) to align them with respect to the reference image.The reference image will not be modified during the registration process. Moreover, it is only used as a reference for the alignment and it will not be integrated in the final image.
文件: 配准后的图像会被变换（平移、缩放、旋转）以与参考图像对齐。配准过程中参考图像不会被修改。此外它仅用于对齐参考，不会被纳入最终图像的叠加。

FILE: Each time a reference star is not found in the current searching area a new iteration is performed, extending the search area by a fixed amount to increase the chances of finding the reference star.This parameter determines the maximum number of iterations performed before considering a reference star as not found.
文件: 每当在当前搜索区域内找不到某颗参考星，就进行一次新的迭代，按固定增量扩大搜索区域以提高找到该参考星的机会。此参数决定在判定参考星未找到之前最多执行多少次迭代。

FILE: Be aware that noise reduction will modify star profiles and hence the way star positions are calculated, resulting in a less accurate image registration. Under extreme low-SNR conditions, however, this is probably better than working with the actual data anyway.To disable noise reduction, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 请注意降噪会改变恒星轮廓，从而影响恒星位置的计算方式，导致图像配准精度下降。不过在信噪比极低的条件下，这样做通常仍比直接用原始数据要好。将参数设为零即关闭降噪。

FILE: Winsorized sigma clipping is similar to the normal sigma clipping algorithm, but uses a special iterative procedure based on Huber's method of robust estimation of parameters through Winsorization. This algorithm can yield superior rejection of outliers with better preservation of significant data for large sets of images.
文件: Winsorized sigma clipping 与普通 sigma clipping 类似，但采用一种特殊的迭代流程，基于 Huber 通过缩尾处理进行参数稳健估计的方法。对大批图像而言，该算法能以更好的显著数据保留能力获得更优的离群剔除效果。

FILE: Registration reference image.Registered images will be transformed (translated, scaled and rotated) to align them with respect to the reference image.The reference image will not be modified during the registration process. Moreover, it is only used as a reference for the alignment and it will not be integrated in the final image.
文件: 配准参考图像。配准后的图像会被变换（平移、缩放、旋转）以与参考图像对齐。配准过程中参考图像不会被修改。此外它仅用于对齐参考，不会被纳入最终图像的叠加。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels will be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can prevent a valid image registration.To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 这是恒星检测器在结构检测阶段之前执行的中值滤波半径（像素）。中值滤波对去除热像素非常有效。热像素会被识别为假恒星，数量较多时会导致图像配准无法得到有效结果。将参数设为零即关闭热像素去除。

FILE: This approach effectively improves the details in the surroundings of a specific area of the master light. Use this option if you have a relatively small target in the image you want to enhance, like a small planetary nebula or a galaxy.If the goal is to have a good alignment across the entire frame, then the precise alignment should remain disabled.
文件: 这种方式能有效改善主亮帧某一区域周边的细节。若图像中的目标相对较小、你想强化它（例如小行星状星云或星系），可使用此选项。若目标是整幅画面对齐良好，则应保持精确对齐为禁用。

FILE: Drizzle data files contain geometrical projection parameters, pixel rejection and statistical data for the DrizzleIntegration tool. FastIntegration creates drizzle data files with CFA pattern information (when available) and projection data, and the ImageIntegration tool appends rejection and statistical data to the same files. Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz file suffix.
文件: drizzle 数据文件包含供 DrizzleIntegration 工具使用的几何投影参数、像素剔除与统计数据。FastIntegration 生成含 CFA 排列信息（若可用）与投影数据的 drizzle 数据文件，ImageIntegration 工具则向同一批文件追加剔除与统计数据。drizzle 数据文件使用 .xdrz 后缀。

FILE: The full alignment is also used as a fallback attempt to align a frame using more stars than the ones used by the fast alignment in case the tolerance is not met.This option is enabled by default, but you may disable it for the only purpose of increasing the execution speed at the cost of rejecting more frames when the fast alignment method does not respect the given tolerance.
文件: 当容差未被满足时，完整对齐还会作为后备手段，用比快速对齐更多的恒星来配准该帧。此选项默认启用；你也可以禁用它，唯一目的是提升执行速度，代价是在快速对齐方法不满足给定容差时会剔除更多帧。

FILE: The maximum number of iterations performed while searching a star.Each time a reference star is not found in the current searching area a new iteration is performed, extending the search area by a fixed amount to increase the chances of finding the reference star.This parameter determines the maximum number of iterations performed before considering a reference star as not found.
文件: 搜索单颗恒星时执行的最大迭代次数。每当在当前搜索区域内找不到某颗参考星，就进行一次新的迭代，按固定增量扩大搜索区域以提高找到它的机会。此参数决定判定参考星未找到之前最多执行多少次迭代。

FILE: Size of the hot pixel removal filter.This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels will be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can prevent a valid image registration.To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 热像素去除滤波器尺寸。这是恒星检测器在结构检测阶段之前执行的中值滤波半径（像素）。中值滤波对去除热像素非常有效。热像素会被识别为假恒星，数量较多时会导致图像配准无法得到有效结果。将参数设为零即关闭热像素去除。

FILE: A region of interest (ROI) defines a rectangular subset of the image to perform the fast integration task. This is useful because the task's execution time (and also its memory space consumption) grows quadratically with the dimensions of the output integrated image. By defining a small ROI one can speed up the process even more, which can be very helpful to test the process repeatedly.
文件: 感兴趣区域（ROI）定义图像中执行快速积分任务的矩形子集。这很有用，因为任务的执行时间（以及内存占用）随输出积分图像的尺寸呈平方增长。定义较小的 ROI 可以进一步提速，在反复测试该进程时非常方便。

FILE: Magnitude of the dimmest stars rendered on the finding chart.We recommend to enable the automatic limit magnitude option, which will calculate an optimal value automatically, based on the field of view of the target image and the chart resolution.
文件: 寻星图上绘制的最暗恒星星等。建议启用自动极限星等选项，它会根据目标图像的视场和图表分辨率自动算出最优值。

FILE: The chart resolution in arcseconds per pixel.This parameter determines the scale of the generated chart as projected on the celestial sphere. We recommend to enable the automatic chart resolution option, which will calculate an optimal value automatically, based on the field of view of the target image.
文件: 图表分辨率，单位为角秒/像素。此参数决定生成图表投影在天球上的比例。建议启用自动图表分辨率选项，它会根据目标图像的视场自动算出最优值。

FILE: When this option is selected, B3E generates a binary mask where white pixels correspond to out-of-range flux values in the output synthetic image. Out-of-range flux values are those above the maximum flux estimated from the input images.
文件: 选中此选项后，B3E 会生成一幅二值蒙版，其中白色像素对应输出合成图像中越界的通量值。越界通量即高于由输入图像估计出的最大通量的值。

FILE: Working flux units. Pixel values in the input and output images can represent either photons or energy per units of wavelength (nm) or frequency (THz). Energy can be expressed in any suitable units, with the condition that the same units are used for both input images. These will be also the units of the output synthetic image.
文件: 工作通量单位。输入与输出图像的像素值可以表示光子数，也可以表示单位波长（nm）或单位频率（THz）上的能量。能量可用任意合适的单位，但要求两幅输入图像使用相同单位。输出合成图像也沿用这一单位。

FILE: B3E uses the laws of blackbody radiation to generate a synthetic image, which is an estimate of flux at the specified effective output wavelength or frequency, and a thermal map as an estimate of temperature. Flux estimates are in the same units as input images, and thermal maps are unsigned 16-bit integer images whose pixels represent blackbody temperature in degrees Kelvin.
文件: B3E 依据黑体辐射定律生成合成图像，它是指定有效输出波长或频率上通量的估计；同时生成热图，作为温度的估计。通量估计与输入图像同单位；热图为无符号 16 位整数图像，像素值表示以开尔文为单位的黑体温度。

FILE: First component of the discrete Fourier transform.The inverse transform can be computed either from complex (real and imaginary) components, or from polar (magnitude and phase) components.
文件: 离散傅里叶变换的第一个分量。逆变换既可以由复数（实部与虚部）分量计算，也可以由极坐标（幅度与相位）分量计算。

FILE: Second component of the discrete Fourier transform.The inverse transform can be computed either from complex (real and imaginary) components, or from polar (magnitude and phase) components.
文件: 离散傅里叶变换的第二个分量。逆变换既可以由复数（实部与虚部）分量计算，也可以由极坐标（幅度与相位）分量计算。

FILE: Rescale will rescale the resulting image to the [0,1] range only if there are out-of-range values. In this mode all the output data are preserved, but the dynamics of the original image may change after the inverse Fourier transform.
文件: “重新缩放”仅在存在越界值时才把结果图像缩放到 [0,1] 范围。此模式下全部输出数据得以保留，但逆傅里叶变换后原图像的动态范围可能发生变化。

FILE: Truncate will truncate any out-of-range values to the [0,1] range. In this mode the original dynamics of the image are preserved. This is the default working mode.Rescale will rescale the resulting image to the [0,1] range only if there are out-of-range values. In this mode all the output data are preserved, but the dynamics of the original image may change after the inverse Fourier transform.
文件: “截断”会把所有越界值截断到 [0,1] 范围。此模式下图像原有的动态范围得以保留，这是默认工作模式。“重新缩放”仅在存在越界值时才把结果图像缩放到 [0,1] 范围；此模式下全部输出数据得以保留，但逆傅里叶变换后原图像的动态范围可能发生变化。

FILE: Note that enabling this option will cause the process to ignore the state of the Generate text output parameter. In other words, generation of output binary files always takes precedence and implicitly disables generation of text files. See the process documentation for information on the format used by Gaia output binary files.
文件: 注意：启用此选项后，进程将忽略“生成文本输出”参数的状态。也就是说，生成输出二进制文件始终优先，并隐含地禁用文本文件的生成。Gaia 输出二进制文件所用格式的说明请参阅进程文档。

FILE: Check here to use the inverse form of the transformation equations. Warning: Some transformations can involve clipping and are not truly invertible. See the documentation for more detail.
文件: 勾选此处以使用变换方程的逆形式。警告：某些变换涉及截断，并非真正可逆。详情请参阅文档。

FILE: Big zoom inThe zoom will be left justified unless a readout value is active and visible in the histogram display (yellow line), in which case the zoom will be centred on the readout value.
文件: 大幅放大。除非直方图显示中有活动的读出值可见（黄线），否则缩放以左端对齐；若有，则缩放以该读出值为中心。

FILE: Big zoom outThe zoom will be left justified unless a readout value is active and visible in the histogram display (yellow line), in which case the zoom will be centred on the readout value.
文件: 大幅缩小。除非直方图显示中有活动的读出值可见（黄线），否则缩放以左端对齐；若有，则缩放以该读出值为中心。

FILE: For SP, LP or HP, check to adjust the 6th decimal place, leave unchecked to adjust the 4th decimal place. For D and b this is disabled and fine adjustment is always at the 3rd decimal place.
文件: 对 SP、LP 或 HP，勾选可按第 6 位小数调整，不勾选则按第 4 位小数调整。对 D 与 b 此项不可用，微调始终在第 3 位小数进行。

FILE: Check here to use coefficients from the RGB working space of the active image to derive the RGB weighted average for a colour stretch. If unchecked then equal weighted coefficients will be used.
文件: 勾选此处以使用活动图像 RGB 工作空间的系数来推导彩色拉伸所需的 RGB 加权平均；不勾选则使用等权系数。

FILE: Set the readout statistic by adjusting the Readout/Calculation Mode in the PixInsight Readout Options. The channel(s) reflect the currently selected colour mode in the Non-linear Parameters panel.
文件: 在 PixInsight 的“读出选项”中调整读出/计算模式即可设定读出统计量。通道取决于“非线性参数”面板中当前选择的颜色模式。

FILE: Histogram horizontal zoomThe zoom will be left justified unless a readout value is active and visible in the histogram display (yellow line), in which case the zoom will be centred on the readout value.
文件: 直方图水平缩放。除非直方图显示中有活动的读出值可见（黄线），否则缩放以左端对齐；若有，则缩放以该读出值为中心。

FILE: Set the readout area size by adjusting the probe size in the PixInsight Readout Options. You may also wish to adjust the preview size and preview zoom in the PixInsight Readout Options to set the preview callout to your own preference.
文件: 在 PixInsight 的“读出选项”中调整探针尺寸即可设定读出区域大小。你也可以在其中调整预览尺寸与预览缩放，把预览标注设成自己习惯的样子。

FILE: When using the colour stretch method this parameter will blend a proportion of a standard RGB stretch. This will mute the colour saturation for a strong initial data stretch. A value of 1 will not add any RGB stretch, a value of 0 is equivalent to a normal RGB stretch.
文件: 使用彩色拉伸方式时，此参数会混入一部分标准 RGB 拉伸，从而在初始数据拉伸较强时压低色彩饱和度。取值 1 表示不混入 RGB 拉伸，取值 0 等同于普通 RGB 拉伸。

FILE: Specifies the transformation equations to use. In most cases this will be the Generalised Hyperbolic Stretch equations designed for this module. Other options include the midtone transfer function used in the Histogram Transformation process, and the arcsinh and power law functions. To each of these the module brings additional functionality. Alternatively a linear stretch can be selected.
文件: 指定要使用的变换方程。多数情况下是本模块专门设计的广义双曲拉伸（GHS）方程。其他选项包括直方图变换进程所用的中间调转移函数，以及 arcsinh 和幂律函数；模块为它们各自增加了额外功能。此外也可选择线性拉伸。

FILE: Interpolate pixel sample values with gamma correction. In general, this option should be enabled to scale nonlinear images, i.e. images whose pixel values have been stretched nonlinearly. The applied transformations (gamma exponent or sRGB gamma function) depend on the RGB working space of the target image.
文件: 带伽马校正的像素采样插值。通常缩放非线性图像（即像素值已被非线性拉伸的图像）时应启用此选项。所施加的变换（伽马指数或 sRGB 伽马函数）取决于目标图像的 RGB 工作空间。

FILE: Interpolate pixel sample values with gamma correction. In general, this option should be enabled to rotate nonlinear images, i.e. images whose pixel values have been stretched nonlinearly. The applied transformations (gamma exponent or sRGB gamma function) depend on the RGB working space of the target image.
文件: 带伽马校正的像素采样插值。通常旋转非线性图像（即像素值已被非线性拉伸的图像）时应启用此选项。所施加的变换（伽马指数或 sRGB 伽马函数）取决于目标图像的 RGB 工作空间。

FILE: Interpolate pixel sample values with gamma correction. In general, this option should be enabled to rotate and/or scale nonlinear images, i.e. images whose pixel values have been stretched nonlinearly. The applied transformations (gamma exponent or sRGB gamma function) depend on the RGB working space of the target image.
文件: 带伽马校正的像素采样插值。通常旋转和/或缩放非线性图像（即像素值已被非线性拉伸的图像）时应启用此选项。所施加的变换（伽马指数或 sRGB 伽马函数）取决于目标图像的 RGB 工作空间。

FILE: * Warning * Specifying an invalid style sheet file may yield an unusable core application. DO NOT change this parameter if you are not sure of what you are doing.
文件: * 警告 * 指定无效的样式表文件可能导致核心程序无法使用。若不确定自己在做什么，请勿改动此参数。

FILE: Show the Recently Used tree item on Process Explorer, where the most recently launched processes and executed scripts are gathered as a list sorted chronologically.
文件: 在进程浏览器中显示“最近使用”树项，最近启动的进程与执行的脚本会按时间顺序汇总在该列表中。

FILE: Allow execution of scripts without code signature files.Important: Execution of scripts with invalid code signatures is always forbidden, regardless of this option.
文件: 允许执行没有代码签名文件的脚本。重要：无论此选项如何，签名无效的脚本一律禁止执行。

FILE: Important: To ease adoption of the new security system, for now this option is disabled by default. This option will be enabled by default in a future version of PixInsight.
文件: 重要：为便于新安全机制的推广，此选项目前默认禁用。在 PixInsight 的未来版本中，此选项将默认启用。

FILE: When this option is enabled, PixInsight uses the common dialogs of Windows and macOS. On FreeBSD and Linux this option is not supported at present and should be left disabled.
文件: 启用此选项后，PixInsight 使用 Windows 与 macOS 的通用对话框。在 FreeBSD 与 Linux 上目前不支持此选项，应保持禁用。

FILE: As of writing this documentation, the standard asteroid ephemerides file provides the complete set of 343 asteroids used for the numerical integration of JPL DE440 ephemerides.
文件: 撰写本文档时，标准小行星星历文件提供用于 JPL DE440 星历数值积分的全部 343 颗小行星。

FILE: Workspace wallpaper images are only loaded upon application startup, so if you change any items in this list, changes will not take effect until the next time PixInsight is started.
文件: 工作区壁纸图像仅在程序启动时加载，因此若改动此列表中的任何项，需等到下次启动 PixInsight 才会生效。

FILE: Allow downloading update packages from update repositories that don't provide signatures.Important: Downloading update packages from repositories with invalid signatures is always forbidden, regardless of this option.
文件: 允许从不对更新包提供签名的更新仓库下载更新包。重要：无论此选项如何，从签名无效的仓库下载更新包一律禁止。

FILE: If this option is disabled, PixInsight will use only a single processor for all tasks, regardless of the states of other specific settings.* Warning * Disabling this option may degrade overall performance dramatically.
文件: 若禁用此选项，PixInsight 将只使用单个处理器执行所有任务，无论其他相关设置的状态如何。* 警告 * 禁用此选项可能严重削弱整体性能。

FILE: Minimum size in megapixels to trigger usage of the fast interpolation algorithm for screen image renditions, when fast renditions are enabled (See the Use fast screen renditions option). The default value is 6 megapixels.

文件: Delta AT 即 TAI 与 UTC 之差（秒）。在当前版本的 PixInsight 中，Delta AT 数据库是一个纯文本文件，其中的数值取自 IERS 快速服务/预报中心提供的参考数据。

文件: 为 PixInsight 核心程序执行的图像渲染启用多线程。* 警告 * 若禁用此选项，PixInsight 图形界面可能出现明显性能下降。

FILE: This is the maximum distance in pixels for the mouse cursor to trigger an action when it is clicked close to a sensitive point. For example, this is used to change cursor shapes when you place the mouse near preview rectangle edges.
文件: 这是鼠标在敏感点附近单击时触发动作的最大距离（像素）。例如，当鼠标靠近预览矩形边缘时，用它来改变光标形状。

FILE: * Warning * Replacing standard core resources with invalid ones may yield an unusable core application, and/or cause problems with distributed modules and scripts. DO NOT change this parameter if you are not sure of what you are doing.

FILE: Path to the global asteroid ephemerides file (XEPH format).As of writing this documentation, the standard asteroid ephemerides file provides the complete set of 343 asteroids used for the numerical integration of JPL DE440 ephemerides.
文件: 全局小行星星历文件（XEPH 格式）的路径。撰写本文档时，标准小行星星历文件提供用于 JPL DE440 星历数值积分的全部 343 颗小行星。

文件: 启用自动生成图像标识符时，覆盖图像元数据中已有的标识符。若禁用此选项，则使用已有标识符，而不用基于标识符模板新生成的标识符。

文件: 超出 1657 年至当前年份这一区间时，PixInsight/PCL 的实现改用取自 Fred Espenak 与 Jean Meeus 所著《Five Millennium Canon of Solar Eclipses》（NASA/TP-2006-214141，修订版 1.0，2007）的多项式表达式。

FILE: Emit console warning messages on format specific issues, including the use of deprecated file formats, inaccurate data reading, lost metadata, and insufficient format capabilities during file write operations, among other potential problems.
文件: 在格式相关问题上输出控制台警告信息，包括使用已弃用的文件格式、数据读取不精确、元数据丢失、写文件时格式能力不足，以及其他潜在问题。

文件: 此选项可提升屏幕渲染性能，代价是精度下降。它在配有大尺寸显示器的较慢机器上可能有用，但正常情况下不推荐使用，除非确实需要加快屏幕显示速度。

文件: 允许安装没有代码签名文件的模块。重要：无论此选项如何，代码签名无效的模块一律禁止安装。注意：自 PixInsight 核心 1.9.0 版起，模块签名成为必需。

文件: 用于基于 XISF 文件中已有元数据自动生成图像标识符的标识符模板。标识符模板及其在自动生成图像标识符中的用法，详见参考文档。

文件: 全局基础星历文件（XEPH 格式）的路径。撰写本文档时，标准基础星历文件提供完整的 JPL DE440/LE440 星历。章动、天平和时间差并不包含在标准 .xeph 文件中。

文件: 严格模式下，若修改过的图像以有损生成方案（例如 JPEG 压缩）保存到磁盘，其“已修改”状态不会被清除，关联的文件路径也不会改为新位置。原因是写入磁盘的内容并不精确代表现有图像数据。

文件: 执行无代码签名的脚本时，向用户询问授权，并在执行未签名脚本时向控制台输出相应的警告信息。重要：为便于新安全机制的推广，此选项目前默认禁用，在 PixInsight 的未来版本中将默认启用。

FILE: This is the time interval in seconds between PSM auto-save events. Set it to zero to disable the PSM AutoSave feature.* Warning * Ensure that you have a good reason to disable PSM AutoSave, or to enter a large interval here, because PSM AutoSave has virtually zero impact on performance and can save your work in the event of a system crash.
文件: 这是 PSM 自动保存事件之间的时间间隔（秒）。设为零即关闭 PSM 自动保存功能。* 警告 * 请确认你有充分理由禁用 PSM 自动保存或填入很大的间隔，因为 PSM 自动保存对性能几乎没有影响，却能在系统崩溃时挽救你的工作。

FILE: Disable this option if a network share, an external drive or another file system works badly or becomes slow with file change notifications. 文件: 启用此选项可把窗口标题栏按钮（最小化、最大化、关闭等）放到左侧，禁用则放到右侧。此选项默认仅在 macOS 上启用。已存在的窗口无法应用对此选项的改动，所选按钮布局将在下次运行 PixInsight 时完全生效。

FILE: Note The state of this setting is only fetched upon application startup. 文件: 注意：此设置的状态仅在程序启动时读取。改动此设置需重启 PixInsight 核心程序才能生效。注意：目前此选项仅在 Linux 与 Windows 平台上有效，在 macOS 与 FreeBSD 上无效。对全部平台的支持将在 PixInsight 的未来版本中实现。

FILE: This is the time elapsed (in milliseconds) before the Process Console window is shown when a process is executed and the console is hidden. Set this value to zero to disable the delayed console feature. Note that this setting has no effect if the console has been floated as a top-level window; it only affects to the console when it is docked as an AutoHide window.
文件: 这是进程执行且控制台处于隐藏状态时，进程控制台窗口显示之前的等待时间（毫秒）。把此值设为零即关闭延迟显示控制台功能。注意：若控制台已浮动为顶层窗口，此设置无效；它只影响控制台作为自动隐藏窗口停靠时的情况。

FILE: For most linear images and all stretched (nonlinear) images, 16-bit LUTs are normally sufficient. Enable the 24-bit LUT feature for deep linear data that cause posterization artifacts on screen renditions, such as HDR compositions. Note that you can enable or disable this feature on a per view basis; this setting refers to the default state for newly created images.
文件: 对多数线性图像和所有已拉伸（非线性）图像而言，16 位 LUT 通常已足够。对会在屏幕显示上产生色调分离伪影的深层线性数据（例如 HDR 合成），请启用 24 位 LUT 功能。注意此功能可按视图分别启用或禁用，此项设置指的是新建图像的默认状态。

FILE: * Note * This option only applies to core network operations, such as files downloaded with the File > Open Location menu item, the open command, and the update system, among others. It does not apply to the integrated web browser component.* Warning * Enabling this option is potentially dangerous. DO NOT enable it if you are not absolutely sure of what you are doing.
文件: * 注意 * 此选项仅作用于核心网络操作，例如通过“文件 > 打开位置”菜单项下载的文件、open 命令、更新系统等，不作用于集成的浏览器组件。* 警告 * 启用此选项有潜在风险。若非十分确定自己在做什么，请勿启用。

FILE: When this option is enabled, the PixInsight core application generates a visible alert when a running process completes its execution. On Windows and most X11 (UNIX/Linux) desktops, an alert causes the application icon to flash intermittently on the task bar. On macOS, an alert causes the application icon to start bouncing on the dock. This option is disabled by default.
文件: 启用此选项后，正在运行的进程执行完毕时，PixInsight 核心程序会发出可见提示。在 Windows 和多数 X11（UNIX/Linux）桌面上，提示表现为任务栏上程序图标间歇闪烁；在 macOS 上表现为程序坞中图标开始跳动。此选项默认禁用。

FILE: When this option is enabled, menu bar items will be written in uppercase characters (FILE, EDIT, ...). When disabled, only the first letter of each menu bar item will be uppercase (File, Edit, ...), following more traditional UI criteria. Note that this option does not apply to native menu bars on macOS. Changing this option requires an application restart to take effect.
文件: 启用此选项后，菜单栏各项会用大写字母书写（FILE、EDIT……）；禁用则只首字母大写（File、Edit……），更符合传统界面习惯。注意此选项不作用于 macOS 的原生菜单栏。改动此选项需重启程序才能生效。

FILE: Use a fast pixel interpolation algorithm to generate reduced screen renditions of images for zoom ratios below 1:2. With this option enabled, screen renditions can be significantly faster, although slightly less accurate. Fast renditions are enabled by default. Use the fast rendition threshold option to control the minimum size of an image that triggers fast interpolation.
文件: 对低于 1:2 的缩放比例，使用快速像素插值算法生成图像的缩小屏幕渲染。启用此选项后，屏幕渲染可明显加快，但精度略降。快速渲染默认启用。用快速渲染阈值选项控制触发快速插值的最小图像尺寸。

FILE: Core resource files are only loaded upon application startup. Changes to this parameter will take place the next time PixInsight is executed.* Warning * Replacing standard core resources with invalid ones may yield an unusable core application, and/or cause problems with distributed modules and scripts. DO NOT change this parameter if you are not sure of what you are doing.
文件: 核心资源文件仅在程序启动时加载。对此参数的改动将在下次运行 PixInsight 时生效。* 警告 * 用无效文件替换标准核心资源可能导致核心程序无法使用，和/或给分发的模块与脚本带来问题。若不确定自己在做什么，请勿改动此参数。

FILE: If enabled: zoom in/out at mouse position. If disabled: zoom in/out preserving the current center coordinates.Pressing the Shift key always exchanges these modes. For example, if this option is enabled, zooming with the Shift key pressed will zoom at the center of the viewport, and vice-versa, if this option is disabled the Shift key will force zooming at cursor coordinates.
文件: 启用：在鼠标位置放大或缩小。禁用：放大或缩小并保持当前中心坐标。按住 Shift 键总会交换这两种模式。例如若启用此选项，按住 Shift 缩放时将在视口中心缩放；反之若禁用，按住 Shift 会强制在光标坐标处缩放。

FILE: This is the maximum number of processors (physical and logical) that PixInsight is allowed to use. Selecting just one processor will effectively disable parallel processing globally.* Warning * Reducing the maximum number of allowed processors too much will degrade processing and interface performance dramatically. Change this value only if you are sure of what you are doing.
文件: 这是 PixInsight 允许使用的最大处理器数（物理与逻辑）。只选一个处理器实际上会全局关闭并行处理。* 警告 * 把允许使用的最大处理器数降得过低会严重削弱处理与界面性能。只有确认自己在做什么时才改动此值。

FILE: This mode is the default on all platforms, and is always used on Wayland, where applications cannot place their own windows. On the other platforms it can be disabled to use separate windows on the desktop. Changing this option takes effect the next time the PixInsight core application starts. The --contained-windows and --no-contained-windows command-line arguments change it as well.
文件: 此模式是所有平台上的默认模式，在 Wayland 上始终使用——那里程序无法自行放置窗口。在其他平台上可禁用它，改为在桌面上使用独立窗口。改动此选项在下次启动 PixInsight 核心程序时生效。命令行参数 --contained-windows 与 --no-contained-windows 也可改变它。

FILE: * Note * This option only applies to core network operations, such as files downloaded with the File > Open Location menu item, the open command, and the update system, among others. It does not apply to the integrated web browser component.* Warning * Be aware that sensitive information, including user passwords and IP addresses, can be written to stdout as part of the generated reports.
文件: * 注意 * 此选项仅作用于核心网络操作，例如通过“文件 > 打开位置”菜单项下载的文件、open 命令、更新系统等，不作用于集成的浏览器组件。* 警告 * 请注意，用户密码和 IP 地址等敏感信息可能作为生成的报告内容被写入标准输出。

FILE: Current directory shows the current working directory followed by '>', as in ~/images>Simple prompt shows just a '>' character. This is the default option.Instance slot shows the slot number of the running PixInsight instance, from 1 to 256, followed by '>', as in 1>. This identifies the instance when several are running.The prompt style can also be selected with the prompt console command.
文件: “当前目录”显示当前工作目录，后面跟 '>'，例如 ~/images>。“简单提示符”只显示一个 '>' 字符，这是默认选项。“实例槽位”显示正在运行的 PixInsight 实例编号（1 到 256），后面跟 '>'，例如 1>；多个实例同时运行时，以此区分。提示符样式也可通过 prompt 控制台命令选择。

FILE: Authenticity of downloaded update packages cannot be guaranteed when insecure connections are used, which is a serious security risk. The HTTPS and FTPS protocols are strongly recommended and will be mandatory in a future version of PixInsight. Use of insecure connections is still allowed, but at your own risk.If this option is disabled, only the secure HTTPS and FTPS protocols will be allowed.
文件: 使用不安全连接时无法保证下载的更新包的真实性，这是严重的安全风险。强烈建议使用 HTTPS 与 FTPS 协议，在 PixInsight 的未来版本中二者将成为强制要求。目前仍允许使用不安全连接，但风险自负。若禁用此选项，则只允许安全的 HTTPS 与 FTPS 协议。

FILE: * Note * This option only applies to core network operations, such as files downloaded with the File > Open Location menu item, the open command, and the update system, among others. It does not apply to the integrated web browser component.* Warning * Ensure that there is enough free space on the storage device that supports this directory on the local filesystem, or download operations may fail.
文件: * 注意 * 此选项仅作用于核心网络操作，例如通过“文件 > 打开位置”菜单项下载的文件、open 命令、更新系统等，不作用于集成的浏览器组件。* 警告 * 请确认本地文件系统中承载该目录的存储设备有足够可用空间，否则下载操作可能失败。

FILE: Along with the model generation scale, this parameter provides fine control on the degree of smoothness of local variations represented in the computed gradient model. The default value is 0.4.
文件: 与模型生成尺度配合，此参数可精细控制所计算梯度模型中局部变化的平滑程度。默认值为 0.4。

FILE: GradientCorrection implements a mechanism to prevent overcorrection of gradients on significant image structures. This section includes the process parameters governing this structure protection functionality.
文件: GradientCorrection 实现了一套机制，用于防止对图像中显著结构处的梯度做过度校正。本节包含控制该结构保护功能的进程参数。

FILE: Model smoothness.Along with the model generation scale, this parameter provides fine control on the degree of smoothness of local variations represented in the computed gradient model. The default value is 0.4.
文件: 模型平滑度。与模型生成尺度配合，此参数可精细控制所计算梯度模型中局部变化的平滑程度。默认值为 0.4。

FILE: Threshold for inclusion of bright image structures. By increasing the value of this parameter, the computed gradient model will include more relatively bright image structures at the model generation scale. The default value is 0.05.
文件: 纳入亮图像结构的阈值。增大此参数，所计算的梯度模型在模型生成尺度上会纳入更多相对明亮的图像结构。默认值为 0.05。

FILE: Threshold for inclusion of dark image structures. By increasing the value of this parameter, more structures belonging to the local background of the image will contribute to the computed gradient model at the model generation scale. The default value is 0.2.
文件: 纳入暗图像结构的阈值。增大此参数，会有更多属于图像局部背景的结构在模型生成尺度上参与所计算的梯度模型。默认值为 0.2。

FILE: Turn on this option to generate images with the internal masks used for structure protection. The masks are black where image structures are protected and white where no protection is applied. A new mask image will be generated at each iteration if the automatic convergence option is enabled.
文件: 启用此选项可生成带结构保护内部蒙版的图像。蒙版在受保护的图像结构处为黑，在未施加保护处为白。若启用自动收敛选项，每次迭代都会生成一个新的蒙版图像。

FILE: Tolerance for the preservation of dark image structures. This parameter controls how relatively dark image structures contribute to the computed gradient model. Lower or higher parameter values tend to penalize or favor, respectively, the contribution of dark structures to the computed gradient model. The default value is 0.5.
文件: 暗图像结构的保留容差。此参数控制相对较暗的图像结构如何参与所计算的梯度模型。参数值越低或越高，分别倾向于抑制或促进暗结构对梯度模型的贡献。默认值为 0.5。

FILE: Tolerance for the preservation of bright image structures. This parameter controls how relatively bright image structures contribute to the computed gradient model. Lower or higher parameter values tend to penalize or favor, respectively, the contribution of bright structures to the computed gradient model. The default value is zero.
文件: 亮图像结构的保留容差。此参数控制相对较亮的图像结构如何参与所计算的梯度模型。参数值越低或越高，分别倾向于抑制或促进亮结构对梯度模型的贡献。默认值为零。

FILE: Decrease the value of this parameter to prevent overcorrection on dimmer image structures. Increase it to relax overcorrection protection by restricting it to brighter structures. Too large values can lead to overcorrection. Too low values may cause inaccurate gradient correction or overprotection artifacts. The default value is 0.1.
文件: 减小此参数可防止对较暗图像结构过度校正，增大则把过度校正保护限制在更亮的结构上从而放松保护。取值过大会导致过度校正，取值过小可能造成梯度校正不准确或过度保护伪影。默认值为 0.1。

FILE: Enable this option to compute and apply multiple gradient models iteratively until the difference between two successive models is smaller than a prescribed limit. Gradient models usually converge after 3 to 6 iterations. This feature is turned off by default, but it can lead to a more accurate and efficient gradient correction, even when a single application gives acceptable results.
文件: 启用此选项后，会迭代计算并施加多个梯度模型，直至前后两个模型之差小于规定限值。梯度模型通常迭代 3 到 6 次后收敛。此功能默认关闭，但它能带来更精确、更高效的梯度校正，即使单次施加已可接受。

FILE: GradientCorrection implements a multiscale gradient modeling algorithm. This parameter controls the relative scale at which the gradient model will be generated. Higher parameter values generate smooth models best suited to represent large-scale brightness variations. Lower values allow for the generation of more complex gradients representing more local variations. The default value is 5.0.
文件: GradientCorrection 实现的是多尺度梯度建模算法。此参数控制梯度模型生成的相对尺度。参数值越高，生成的模型越平滑，最适合表达大尺度亮度变化；取值越低，则可生成更复杂的梯度以表达更多局部变化。默认值为 5.0。

FILE: Check to keep the result in the logarithmic scale, which is better for visualization. Uncheck to get a more or less linear result, which is better for further processing.
文件: 勾选以把结果保留在对数尺度，更利于观察；不勾选则得到大致线性的结果，更利于后续处理。

FILE: Gradients are transformed via sign(gradient)*pow(gradient,value). Lower values increase the effect, since the value of small abs(gradients) is moved closer to 1.0. Applied after the other two filters.
文件: 梯度按 sign(gradient)*pow(gradient,value) 变换。取值越低效果越强，因为较小的 |gradient| 会被推近 1.0。此变换在其他两个滤波器之后施加。

FILE: Smooth the border of each contributing image using a convolution of the specified radius. This is useful to reduce artifacts caused by stars located on the image border, or to smooth transitions in patterns.
文件: 用指定半径的卷积平滑每幅参与图像的边缘。这有助于减少图像边缘处恒星造成的伪影，也能平滑图案中的过渡。

FILE: Gradients with abs(gradient)>pow(10,value) are clipped to zero. This may be useful for noise reduction, but also leads to posterization. Higher is stronger. Smallest value switches off this kind of filtering.
文件: |gradient| 大于 pow(10,value) 的梯度会被截断为零。这对降噪可能有用，但也会造成色调分离。取值越大越强，取最小值即关闭此类滤波。

FILE: Reduce image areas of each contributing image by erosions with a mask of the selected radius. This is useful to get rid of border regions that slowly fade into the background, for instance due to aliasing during alignment.
文件: 用指定半径的蒙版做腐蚀，缩小每幅参与图像的有效区域。这有助于去掉那些缓慢淡入背景的边缘区域，例如配准过程中混叠所造成的。

FILE: Check to generate two masks showing the contributions of each image to horizontal and vertical gradients. Each pixel identifies the image that contributed to the respective gradient. 0 means no image. The masks are rescaled before displaying.
文件: 勾选以生成两幅蒙版，显示各图像对水平与垂直梯度的贡献。每个像素标识对相应梯度作出贡献的图像，0 表示没有图像。蒙版在显示前会重新缩放。

FILE: Check to generate a mask showing how the image is composed. The mask indicates in a bitwise fashion which images contribute to each pixel: image 1 has value 2**(n-1), image 2 has value 2**(n-2), ...,image n has value 1. All values are added, and the resulting image is rescaled before presentation.
文件: 勾选以生成一幅显示图像合成方式的蒙版。该蒙版以按位方式表示每幅图像对各像素的贡献：图像 1 取值为 2**(n-1)，图像 2 为 2**(n-2)，……，图像 n 为 1。所有取值相加，结果图像在显示前会重新缩放。

FILE: Select the image combination method. For the overlay mode, the later images are displayed on top of the already loaded images. In this case, the order of the images in the list box is important. For the average mode, the average of all overlapping images is used. In this case, the order of loaded images in irrelevant.
文件: 选择图像合成方式。“叠加”模式下，后加入的图像显示在已加载图像之上，此时列表框中图像顺序很重要。“平均”模式下，使用所有重叠图像的平均值，此时加载顺序无关紧要。

FILE: Logarithm of the star detection sensitivity. Increase this parameter to detect less stars. The default value of -1 is normally appropriate for most linear images.
文件: 恒星检测灵敏度的对数值。增大此参数会检测到更少的恒星。默认值 -1 通常适合多数线性图像。

FILE: Predefined slew rates, in ascending speed order: Guide, Centering, Find, Maximum.There might be more device-specific slew rates, which can be selected with Indigo Device Controller.
文件: 预定义回转速率，按速度递增排列：导星、定心、寻星、最大。可能还有更多设备特定的回转速率，可用 Indigo Device Controller 选择。

FILE: If enabled, compute and apply a single adaptive STF for all nominal channels of each acquired color image.If disabled, compute a separate adaptive STF for each nominal color channel.
文件: 若启用，对每幅采集到的彩色图像的全部标称通道计算并施加单一的 adaptive STF；若禁用，则为每个标称颜色通道分别计算 adaptive STF。

FILE: If enabled, the target image will be solved even if it contains a valid astrometric solution, which will be replaced with a newly computed one. See also the Ignore existing metadata option.
文件: 若启用，即使目标图像已含有效天文测量解也会重新解算，并用新算出的解替换旧解。另见“忽略已有元数据”选项。

FILE: You are about to point your telescope at the Sun.THIS IS EXTREMELY DANGEROUS - BY DOING THIS YOU CAN CAUSE IRREVERSIBLE DAMAGE TO YOUR EYES AND/OR TO YOUR EQUIPMENT.Do you really want to do this?
文件: 你即将把望远镜指向太阳。这极其危险——这样做可能对你的眼睛和/或设备造成不可逆的损伤。确定要这样做吗？

FILE: Note that for this option to take effect the image must be solved astrometrically, either because the Force plate solving option is enabled, or because the image has no valid astrometric solution.
文件: 注意：此选项要生效，图像必须具备天文测量解，即要么启用了“强制解板”选项，要么该图像本来没有有效天文测量解。

FILE: If enabled, compute the distance of the target coordinates from the actual image center and apply a correction to compensate this deviation.Requires an astrometric solution of the active image view.
文件: 若启用，计算目标坐标与实际图像中心的距离，并施加校正以补偿这一偏差。需要活动图像视图具备天文测量解。

FILE: For example, the default template %f_B%b_E%e_%n would produce the following file name:LIGHT_B2x2_E300.00_002.fitsfor the second light frame of a series with exposure time of 300 seconds at binning 2x2.
文件: 例如，默认模板 %f_B%b_E%e_%n 会生成如下文件名：LIGHT_B2x2_E300.00_002.fits，对应一组以 2x2 合并、曝光 300 秒拍摄的亮帧中的第二帧。

FILE: The directory where newly acquired frames will be stored on the local filesystem.If you leave this parameter empty, new files will be created on the current downloads directory, as defined by global settings.
文件: 新采集的帧在本地文件系统上的存放目录。若此参数留空，新文件将写入当前下载目录，由全局设置定义。

FILE: When this option is enabled, PhotometricColorCalibration will select an optimal astrometric catalog for the field of view of the target image.Enabling this option is recommended under normal working conditions.
文件: 启用此选项后，PhotometricColorCalibration 会为目标图像的视场选择最优的天体测量星表。正常工作条件下建议启用。

FILE: Name of the main astronomical object or subject in the acquired images. The specified text will be the value of Observation:Object:Name standard XISF properties and OBJECT FITS keywords in newly created light frames.
文件: 所采集图像中主要天体或拍摄对象的名称。所填文本会作为新建亮帧中标准 XISF 属性 Observation:Object:Name 和 FITS 关键字 OBJECT 的值。

FILE: If this option is selected, IndigoCCDFrame will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.Enable this option at your own risk.
文件: 选中此选项后，IndigoCCDFrame 会覆盖与生成的输出文件同名的已有文件。这很危险，被覆盖文件的原始内容将永久丢失。启用此选项风险自负。

FILE: Creating models for each pier side can dramatically improve the accuracy of pointing model, since some pointing error sources depend on the position and balance of the mounted devices.Note that two pointing model need twice as many sync points.
文件: 为每个转台侧分别建模可显著提升指向模型的精度，因为部分指向误差来源与所装设备的位置和平衡有关。注意：两套指向模型需要两倍的同步点。

FILE: When this option is enabled, PhotometricColorCalibration will select an optimal limit magnitude for plate solving based on the field of view and center coordinates of the target image. Enabling this option is recommended under normal working conditions.
文件: 启用此选项后，PhotometricColorCalibration 会根据目标图像的视场与中心坐标，为解板选择最优的极限星等。正常工作条件下建议启用。

FILE: Some images have so much noise that the star detection algorithm can mistake noise for stars. This parameter removes noise from the image in order to improve star detection. This value is the number of wavelet layers that will be removed for noise reduction. Use 0 for no noise reduction.
文件: 有些图像噪声过大，恒星检测算法会把噪声误当恒星。此参数先对图像去噪以改善恒星检测，取值表示用于降噪而去除的小波层数。填 0 表示不做降噪。

FILE: Upload to server: The frame will be stored on the file system of the Indigo server. The server upload directory and file name template can be specified. The frame will not be uploaded to the client.Upload both: The frame will be stored on the server's file system, then uploaded to the client and displayed.
文件: “上传到服务器”：帧将存储在 Indigo 服务器的文件系统中，可指定服务器上传目录与文件名模板，帧不会上传到客户端。“两者都上传”：帧先存储在服务器文件系统，再上传到客户端并显示。

FILE: This is normally not necessary, since scripts manage their own configuration settings internally. However, sometimes there are configuration parameters that may become wrong or corrupted for a variety of reasons. Use this option to initialize all working parameters of the ImageSolver script to factory-default values.
文件: 通常并不需要这样做，因为脚本在内部自行管理配置设置。但有时某些配置参数会因各种原因变得错误或损坏，可用此选项把 ImageSolver 脚本的全部工作参数恢复为出厂默认值。

FILE: The algorithmic device used for star matching during the initial image registration step. Triangle similarity works for most images and supports specular transformations, that is, images mirrored horizontally or vertically. Polygon matching is much more robust and tolerant of distortions, but does not support mirrored images.
文件: 初始图像配准阶段用于星点匹配的算法设备。三角形相似法适用于多数图像，并支持镜面变换，即水平或垂直镜像的图像。多边形匹配更稳健、更容忍畸变，但不支持镜像图像。

FILE: This option enables a distortion correction algorithm based on 2-D surface splines, also known as thin plates.
