This option should always be selected when the target image suffers from significant distortions, or if it deviates significantly from an ideal projected image, which usually happens in images taken with focal lengths shorter than 400 mm.
文件: 此选项启用基于二维曲面样条（又称薄板样条）的畸变校正算法。当目标图像存在明显畸变，或明显偏离理想投影图像时应始终选中此选项——这在焦距短于 400 mm 拍摄的图像中很常见。

FILE: Create a model for each side of the pier. This is useful for mounts that perform a meridian flip when objects cross the meridian.Creating models for each pier side can dramatically improve the accuracy of pointing model, since some pointing error sources depend on the position and balance of the mounted devices.Note that two pointing model need twice as many sync points.
文件: 为转台每一侧分别建立模型。对天体过中天时会执行子午线翻转的赤道仪很有用。为每个转台侧分别建模可显著提升指向模型的精度，因为部分指向误差来源与所装设备的位置和平衡有关。注意：两套指向模型需要两倍的同步点。

FILE: Reset configuration settings for the ImageSolver script.This is normally not necessary, since scripts manage their own configuration settings internally. However, sometimes there are configuration parameters that may become wrong or corrupted for a variety of reasons. Use this option to initialize all working parameters of the ImageSolver script to factory-default values.
文件: 重置 ImageSolver 脚本的配置设置。通常并不需要这样做，因为脚本在内部自行管理配置设置。但有时某些配置参数会因各种原因变得错误或损坏，可用此选项把脚本的全部工作参数恢复为出厂默认值。

FILE: When nonzero, this parameter causes the distortion correction algorithm to use approximating instead of interpolating surface splines (thin plates). Approximating surface splines are robust to outliers in the distortion correction model, including uncertainty in star detection, moving asteroids and other varying image features that can be accidentally interpreted and matched as stars.
文件: 取非零值时，此参数会让畸变校正算法使用逼近型（而非插值型）曲面样条（薄板样条）。逼近型曲面样条对畸变校正模型中的离群值更稳健，包括恒星检测的不确定性、移动的小行星，以及其他可能被误识别并误匹配为恒星的变化图像特征。

FILE: Export a synthetic PSF function as a new image window. The synthetic PSF will be computed as the normalized average of the fitted functions for the selected star(s).
文件: 把一个合成 PSF 函数导出为新的图像窗口。合成 PSF 按所选恒星拟合函数的归一化平均值计算。

FILE: If disabled, new keyword names must follow FITS standard rules: no more than eight characters containing only letters, decimal digits, and an underscore or minus sign.
文件: 若禁用，新关键字名称必须遵循 FITS 标准规则：不超过八个字符，只能包含字母、十进制数字以及下划线或减号。

FILE: literal value allows you to specify directly the image scale in arcseconds per pixel.Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword whose value is the image scale in arcseconds per pixel.
文件: “字面值”允许你直接指定图像比例（角秒/像素）。“自定义 FITS 关键字”允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字的名称，其取值为图像比例（角秒/像素）。

FILE: By default, the Statistics tool computes statistics for the subset of pixel sample values within the (0,1) normalized range, that is, excluding pure black and white pixels. Enable this option to compute statistics for the unclipped [0,1] range.
文件: 默认情况下，统计工具只对归一化 (0,1) 范围内的像素采样值子集计算统计量，即排除纯黑与纯白像素。启用此选项则对未截断的 [0,1] 范围计算统计量。

FILE: Only Gaussian and Moffat model functions are used by default. If you enable the Automatic VarShape fits option, variable shape model functions will also be fitted and selected when they minimize residuals among PSF models and sampled image data.
文件: 默认只使用高斯与 Moffat 模型函数。若启用“自动变形状拟合”选项，变形状模型函数也会参与拟合，并在使 PSF 模型与采样图像数据之间残差最小时被选用。

FILE: If enabled, keyword names can have more than eight characters, and the whole ASCII character set is permitted.If disabled, new keyword names must follow FITS standard rules: no more than eight characters containing only letters, decimal digits, and an underscore or minus sign.
文件: 若启用，关键字名称可超过八个字符，且允许使用整个 ASCII 字符集。若禁用，新关键字名称必须遵循 FITS 标准规则：不超过八个字符，只能包含字母、十进制数字以及下划线或减号。

FILE: Find the PSF model function that best approximates actual image data.Only Gaussian and Moffat model functions are used by default. If you enable the Automatic VarShape fits option, variable shape model functions will also be fitted and selected when they minimize residuals among PSF models and sampled image data.
文件: 找出最接近实际图像数据的 PSF 模型函数。默认只使用高斯与 Moffat 模型函数。若启用“自动变形状拟合”选项，变形状模型函数也会参与拟合，并在使 PSF 模型与采样图像数据之间残差最小时被选用。

FILE: Enables the HIERARCH convention to edit FITS keyword names.If enabled, keyword names can have more than eight characters, and the whole ASCII character set is permitted.If disabled, new keyword names must follow FITS standard rules: no more than eight characters containing only letters, decimal digits, and an underscore or minus sign.
文件: 启用 HIERARCH 约定以编辑 FITS 关键字名称。若启用，关键字名称可超过八个字符，且允许使用整个 ASCII 字符集。若禁用，新关键字名称必须遵循 FITS 标准规则：不超过八个字符，只能包含字母、十进制数字以及下划线或减号。

FILE: If these properties are not available, then the following FITS header keywords will be used, if available: FOCALLEN, XPIXSZ, and YPIXSZ.literal value allows you to specify directly the image scale in arcseconds per pixel.Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword whose value is the image scale in arcseconds per pixel.
文件: 若这些属性不可用，则改用以下 FITS 头关键字（若存在）：FOCALLEN、XPIXSZ 与 YPIXSZ。“字面值”允许你直接指定图像比例（角秒/像素）。“自定义 FITS 关键字”允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字的名称，其取值为图像比例（角秒/像素）。

FILE: In many cases, variable shape model functions will lead to optimal PSF fits in terms of minimization of absolute deviation between fitted point spread functions and source image pixel samples for each selected object. Since variable shape PSF models are nonstandard and relatively experimental, they are not included in automatic optimal fits by default.
文件: 很多情况下，就每个所选对象拟合点扩散函数与源图像像素采样之间的绝对偏差最小化而言，变形状模型函数能得到最优的 PSF 拟合。由于变形状 PSF 模型属非标准且相对试验性，默认不纳入自动最优拟合。

FILE: This parameter determines the size in pixels of the initial search box used to detect stars when you clic on the image. Increase it to favor detection of larger stars. Decrease it to facilitate selection of smaller stars. For example, a smaller search radius may be necessary to deal with dense star fields.The default value of eight pixels is quite appropriate in most cases.
文件: 此参数决定在图像上单击检测恒星时初始搜索框的边长（像素）。增大它有利于检测较大的恒星，减小它便于选中小恒星。例如在密集星场中可能需要更小的搜索半径。默认值八像素在多数情况下相当合适。

FILE: Locked frames keep their approval states: the approval expression does not change them. Unlocked frames are approved or rejected by the approval expression again.
文件: 锁定帧保持其通过状态：通过表达式不会改变它们。未锁定的帧会由通过表达式重新判定为通过或拒绝。

FILE: Draw a line through the points of each series. Without lines, the graphs show only the markers, whatever the line widths of the graph style.This option is stored in process instances.
文件: 为每组的点连成折线。不连线时，无论图形样式的线宽如何，图上只显示标记点。此选项保存在进程实例中。

FILE: Lock or unlock the selected frames.Locked frames keep their approval states: the approval expression does not change them. Unlocked frames are approved or rejected by the approval expression again.
文件: 锁定或解锁所选帧。锁定帧保持其通过状态：通过表达式不会改变它们。未锁定的帧会由通过表达式重新判定为通过或拒绝。

FILE: Order, show and hide the columns of the measurements table. The first columns (frame index, approval and lock states) are always visible.The order and the hidden columns are stored in process instances.
文件: 调整测量表列的顺序、显示与隐藏。最前面的列（帧序号、通过状态与锁定状态）始终可见。列顺序与被隐藏的列保存在进程实例中。

FILE: Star detection preview: Show the structure map and the detected stars of the frame selected in the frames list (the first one of a multiple selection), or of the first enabled frame if no frame is selected.
文件: 恒星检测预览：显示帧列表中所选帧（多选时为第一个）的结构图和检测到的恒星；若未选帧，则显示第一个已启用帧的结果。

FILE: Auto fits Moffat functions with beta = 2.5, 4, 6 and 10, and a Gaussian function, to each star, and keeps the fit with the lowest mean absolute deviation, as the PSF fitting of other tools does in its Auto mode.
文件: 对每颗恒星自动拟合 beta = 2.5、4、6、10 的 Moffat 函数与一个高斯函数，保留平均绝对偏差最小的拟合，与其他工具的 PSF 拟合“自动”模式相同。

FILE: For each property X: X (value of the frame), XZ (robust z-score of the frame in the set), XMin, XMax and XMean (set statistics).Robust means are biweight location estimates; robust sigmas are Qn scale estimates.
文件: 对每个属性 X：X（该帧的值）、XZ（该帧在集合中的稳健 z 分数）、XMin、XMax 与 XMean（集合统计量）。稳健均值采用双权位置估计，稳健 sigma 采用 Qn 尺度估计。

FILE: Columns of the measurements table, in their order. Uncheck a column to hide it. Move the selected column with the buttons on the right side.The first columns (frame index, approval and lock states) are always visible and cannot be moved.
文件: 测量表各列及其顺序。取消勾选某列即可隐藏它，用右侧按钮移动所选列。最前面的列（帧序号、通过状态与锁定状态）始终可见且不可移动。

FILE: Measure background gradients, row and column banding, and trails (satellites, aircraft, meteors). These are the most expensive measurements: disable this option for faster measurements when you don't need them. All other measurements are always computed.
文件: 测量背景梯度、行与列条带以及拖尾（卫星、飞机、流星）。这些是开销最大的测量项：不需要时可禁用此选项以加快测量。其余测量项始终会计算。

FILE: Point spread function fitted to the detected stars.Auto fits Moffat functions with beta = 2.5, 4, 6 and 10, and a Gaussian function, to each star, and keeps the fit with the lowest mean absolute deviation, as the PSF fitting of other tools does in its Auto mode.
文件: 拟合到检测到的恒星的点扩散函数。对每颗恒星自动拟合 beta = 2.5、4、6、10 的 Moffat 函数与一个高斯函数，保留平均绝对偏差最小的拟合，与其他工具的 PSF 拟合“自动”模式相同。

FILE: Draw the frames of the graphs in the order of the measurements table, as selected with Sort by, when the X axis is the frame index. Each frame is drawn at its row position; the tool tips of the points keep the frame indices.This option is stored in process instances.
文件: 当 X 轴为帧序号时，按“排序依据”所选定的测量表顺序绘制图形中的帧。每帧绘制在其行位置上；数据点的工具提示仍保留帧序号。此选项保存在进程实例中。

FILE: JavaScript expression that gives the weight of each frame, written to output frames as the PCL:ImageWeight XISF property, which ImageIntegration reads with its Standard properties weighting mode. Example: PSFSignalWeightWeight identifiers are not available in this expression.
文件: 给出每帧权重的 JavaScript 表达式，会以 PCL:ImageWeight XISF 属性写入输出帧，ImageIntegration 在其“标准属性”加权模式下读取该属性。示例：PSFSignalWeight 此表达式中不能使用权重标识符。

FILE: Persistent file cache items can be automatically removed after a specified period without accessing the corresponding files. Enter the desired period in days (120 days maximum), or specify zero to disable this automatic purge feature, so that existing file cache items will never be removed automatically.
文件: 持久文件缓存条目可在指定时间内未访问对应文件后被自动清除。以天为单位填入所需时长（最多 120 天），或填零以关闭自动清理，使已有缓存条目永不被自动删除。

FILE: Horizontal axis of all graphs: the frame index, the observation time, or any measured property. With a property, the graphs are scatter graphs of their series against it, for example FWHM against FocuserTemperature, or RelativeExtinction against Airmass. Frames where the property is undefined are not shown.
文件: 所有图形的横轴：帧序号、观测时间，或任一已测属性。选择属性时，图形为该属性与各序列的散点图，例如 FWHM 对调焦器温度，或相对消光对大气质量。该属性未定义的帧不显示。

FILE: Apply the approval expression: approve the measured frames where it is true and reject the rest. Locked frames keep their state. Weight identifiers refer to the current weights.Simple limits of the expression, such as FWHM < 4 or EccentricityZ < 2, are shown in the graphs of their properties, with the excluded region shaded.
文件: 应用通过表达式：对测得为真的帧判为通过，其余判为拒绝。锁定帧保持其状态。权重标识符指当前权重。表达式的简单限值（如 FWHM < 4 或 EccentricityZ < 2）会在相应属性的图形中显示，被排除的区域会加阴影。

FILE: Output approved frames: Write the approved frames to the output directory, with their weights in the PCL:ImageWeight XISF property.Star detection preview: Show the structure map and the detected stars of the frame selected in the frames list (the first one of a multiple selection), or of the first enabled frame if no frame is selected.
文件: 输出通过的帧：把通过的帧写入输出目录，并在 PCL:ImageWeight XISF 属性中带上其权重。恒星检测预览：显示帧列表中所选帧（多选时为第一个）的结构图和检测到的恒星；若未选帧，则显示第一个已启用帧的结果。

FILE: JavaScript expression evaluated for each frame. Frames where it is true are approved, unless they are locked. Example: FWHMZ < 2 && EccentricityZ < 2 && Altitude > 30For each property X: X (value of the frame), XZ (robust z-score of the frame in the set), XMin, XMax and XMean (set statistics).Robust means are biweight location estimates; robust sigmas are Qn scale estimates.
文件: 对每帧求值的 JavaScript 表达式。结果为真的帧判为通过，除非它们被锁定。示例：FWHMZ < 2 && EccentricityZ < 2 && Altitude > 30 对每个属性 X：X（该帧的值）、XZ（该帧在集合中的稳健 z 分数）、XMin、XMax 与 XMean（集合统计量）。稳健均值采用双权位置估计，稳健 sigma 采用 Qn 尺度估计。

FILE: Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword to retrieve pedestal values, when the specified keyword is present in the input images.
文件: “自定义 FITS 关键字”允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字的名称，用于在输入图像含该关键字时读取基座值。

FILE: Under normal working conditions, this option should be enabled to detect and reject outlier image structures prior to calculation of local normalization functions.
文件: 正常工作条件下应启用此选项，以便在计算局部归一化函数之前检测并剔除离群的图像结构。

FILE: This option is only applicable to execution on views, and is always ignored when LocalNormalization is executed in the global context (that is, as a batch procedure).
文件: 此选项仅适用于在视图上执行；当 LocalNormalization 在全局上下文中执行（即作为批处理流程）时始终被忽略。

FILE: Number of wavelet layers used for structure detection.With more wavelet layers, larger stars and significant structures will be detected and used for relative scale evaluation.
文件: 用于结构检测的小波层数。小波层数越多，越大的恒星和显著结构会被检测到并用于相对尺度评估。

FILE: The graphs are interactive: move the mouse over a star to see its values, drag a rectangle to zoom in, Shift+drag to pan a zoomed graph, and double-click to restore the full view.
文件: 图表可交互操作：将鼠标移到某颗恒星上可查看其数值，拖动矩形框可放大，Shift+拖动可平移已放大的图，双击可恢复完整视图。

FILE: The image region defines a rectangular area of the CCD frame that will be cropped after overscan correction. It usually corresponds to the true science image without any overscan regions.
文件: 图像区域定义 CCD 帧中在过扫描校正之后将被裁剪的矩形区域。它通常对应不含任何过扫描区域的真实科学图像。

FILE: The output files of batch executions (see Target Frames). They are written to the output directory (see System Parameters), or to the directory of each target frame when it is not specified.
文件: 批处理的输出文件（见“目标帧”）。它们写入输出目录（见“系统参数”），未指定时写入各目标帧所在目录。

FILE: Superbias works by isolating pixel-level structures oriented either vertically (columns) or horizontally (rows). For normal superbias frame generation, the columns orientation should be used.
文件: Superbias 通过分离呈垂直（列）或水平（行）走向的像素级结构来工作。生成普通 superbias 帧时应采用列方向。

FILE: Remove large-scale multiscale layers from the working images used internally to compute column (or row) mean values. This improves isolation of purely oriented structures (either vertically or horizontally).
文件: 从内部用于计算列（或行）均值的工图像中移除大尺度多分辨率层。这有助于更好地分离纯定向结构（垂直或水平）。

FILE: Analysis of local backgrounds can be important for testing purposes, especially in difficult cases, for example to know how complex gradients are being evaluated, or to judge the quality of outlier rejection.
文件: 局部背景分析对测试很有价值，尤其在疑难情况下，例如想了解复杂梯度是如何被评估的，或判断离群剔除的质量。

FILE: If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the calibration process will fail.
文件: 若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则校准进程会失败。

FILE: Select this option to calibrate the master bias frame at the beginning of the batch calibration process. Bias frames are only corrected for overscan, when one or more overscan regions have been defined and are enabled.
文件: 选中此选项可在批处理校准过程开始时先校准 主偏置帧。偏置帧只做过扫描校正——前提是已定义并启用了一个或多个过扫描区域。

FILE: If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the normalization process will fail.
文件: 若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则归一化进程会失败。

FILE: Specify the shape of a structural element used to apply a convolution or morphological transformation for bad pixel replacement. The structural element defines which neighbor pixels will be used to compute replacement values.
文件: 指定用于坏像素替换的卷积或形态学变换所采用的结构元形状。结构元定义哪些相邻像素参与替换值的计算。

FILE: If this option is enabled, LocalNormalization will model local scale variations, i.e. multiplicative gradients that cannot be corrected with a single global scale factor.Warning: The implementation of this feature is still experimental.
文件: 若启用此选项，LocalNormalization 会对局部尺度变化建模，即无法用单一全局尺度因子校正的乘性梯度。警告：该功能的实现仍属试验性质。

FILE: This option should always be enabled for calibration of deep-sky, non-CFA raw light frames. For CFA data, signal and noise evaluation should be performed by the Debayer process, and hence this option should be disabled in ImageCalibration
文件: 校准深空非 CFA 原始亮帧时应始终启用此选项。对 CFA 数据，信号与噪声评估应由 Debayer 进程完成，因此在 ImageCalibration 中应禁用此选项。

FILE: Generate the map of detected cold/hot pixels as a new image window, then stop ImageCalibration execution. When this option is enabled, only the tasks strictly necessary for the statistical analysis of the master dark frame will be executed.
文件: 把检测到的冷/热像素图生成为新的图像窗口，然后停止 ImageCalibration 的执行。启用此选项时，只执行 主暗场帧统计分析所必需的任务。

FILE: Target image: minimum difference in units of the standard deviation of the noise over the local background for detection of outlier structures. Increasing this parameter will tend to relax outlier detection. The default value is 3.2 sigmas.
文件: 目标图像：以局部背景噪声标准差为单位，判定离群结构所需的最小差异。增大此参数会趋于放松离群检测。默认值为 3.2 sigma。

FILE: Reference image: maximum difference in units of the standard deviation of the noise over the local background for detection of outlier structures. Increasing this parameter will tend to relax outlier detection. The default value is 3 sigmas.
文件: 参考图像：以局部背景噪声标准差为单位，判定离群结构所需的最大差异。增大此参数会趋于放松离群检测。默认值为 3 sigma。

FILE: This option should always be enabled for calibration of non-CFA raw light frames. For CFA data, signal and noise evaluation should be performed by the Debayer process, and hence this option should be disabled in ImageCalibration in such case.
文件: 校准非 CFA 原始亮帧时应始终启用此选项。对 CFA 数据，信号与噪声评估应由 Debayer 进程完成，此种情况下应在 ImageCalibration 中禁用此选项。

FILE: Structural elementSpecify the shape of a structural element used to apply a convolution or morphological transformation for bad pixel replacement. The structural element defines which neighbor pixels will be used to compute replacement values.
文件: 结构元。指定用于坏像素替换的卷积或形态学变换所采用的结构元形状。结构元定义哪些相邻像素参与替换值的计算。

FILE: When using convolution replacement operations (Gaussian, mean), non-zero pixel values represent the pixel weights that will be used for convolution. Morphological replacement operations (minimum, maximum, median) use binarized (0/1) map values.
文件: 使用卷积替换操作（高斯、均值）时，非零像素值代表用于卷积的像素权重。形态学替换操作（最小、最大、中位数）则使用二值化（0/1）的映射值。

FILE: If this option is selected, ImageCalibration will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.Enable this option at your own risk.
文件: 选中此选项后，ImageCalibration 会覆盖与生成的输出文件同名的已有文件。这很危险，被覆盖文件的原始内容将永久丢失。启用此选项风险自负。

FILE: Specify the convolution or morphological operation used to replace bad pixels with new pixels computed from neighbor values. Mean and Gaussian will be applied by convolution; minimum, maximum and median will be applied as morphological operators.
文件: 指定用于坏像素的卷积或形态学操作：用邻近像素值计算出的新值替换坏像素。均值与高斯按卷积处理；最小、最大与中位数按形态学算子处理。

FILE: If this option is selected, LocalNormalization will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.Enable this option at your own risk.
文件: 选中此选项后，LocalNormalization 会覆盖与生成的输出文件同名的已有文件。这很危险，被覆盖文件的原始内容将永久丢失。启用此选项风险自负。

FILE: In general, sources with several local maxima pose difficulties for the determination of accurate star positions and PSF parameters, although this is usually a minor problem for scale evaluation. For this reason this parameter is enabled by default.
文件: 一般来说，含多个局部极大值的源会给恒星位置与 PSF 参数的精确测定带来困难，不过对尺度评估而言这通常影响不大。因此该参数默认启用。

FILE: When this option is enabled, the process will select an optimal limit magnitude for catalog search operations based on the field of view and center coordinates of the target image. Enabling this option is recommended under normal working conditions.
文件: 启用此选项后，进程会根据目标图像的视场与中心坐标，为星表搜索操作选择最优的极限星等。正常工作条件下建议启用。

FILE: Cosmetic correction detects pixels with abnormally high or low values in the master dark frame using statistical analysis techniques. These pixels are then replaced with plausible values calculated from their local neighborhoods during the image calibration task.
文件: 修饰校正在 主暗场帧中用统计分析技术检测数值异常偏高或偏低的像素，随后在图像校准任务中把这些像素替换为由其邻域计算出的合理值。

FILE: The saturation threshold parameter can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image.The relative saturation threshold option is disabled by default.
文件: 饱和阈值参数既可以作为归一化 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素采样值，也可以作为相对于被测图像最大像素采样值的数值。“相对饱和阈值”选项默认禁用。

FILE: If this field is left blank (or with its default <system-temp-dir> value), the text files of view executions will be written to the system temporary files directory, and the output images of batch executions, and their text files, to the directory of each target frame.
文件: 若此字段留空（或保持默认的 <system-temp-dir> 值），视图执行的文本文件将写入系统临时文件目录，批处理的输出图像及其文本文件则写入各目标帧所在目录。

FILE: Bad pixel replacement operationSpecify the convolution or morphological operation used to replace bad pixels with new pixels computed from neighbor values. Mean and Gaussian will be applied by convolution; minimum, maximum and median will be applied as morphological operators.
文件: 坏像素替换操作。指定用于坏像素的卷积或形态学操作：用邻近像素值计算出的新值替换坏像素。均值与高斯按卷积处理；最小、最大与中位数按形态学算子处理。

FILE: This option should be disabled under normal working conditions. It can be useful in special cases to limit local normalization to correction of additive gradients exclusively. However, without its multiplicative component the normalization function will be less accurate in general.
文件: 正常工作条件下应禁用此选项。在特殊情况下可用它把局部归一化限制为仅校正加性梯度。但没有乘性分量时，归一化函数整体上精度会下降。

FILE: Each enabled target frame is calibrated and written to a new XISF file with all of its metadata and the flux calibration metadata (see Output Files); the target frames are never modified. No graphs or star maps are generated; text files, when enabled, are written next to each output file.
文件: 每个已启用的目标帧都会被校准，并以新 XISF 文件写出，带上其全部元数据与通量校准元数据（见“输出文件”）；目标帧本身永不被修改。不生成图形或星图；若启用了文本文件，则写在各输出文件旁边。

FILE: This parameter is disabled by default. Under normal conditions, it should always be turned off for the flux calibration task since sources with several local maxima pose difficulties in determining accurate star positions and, more importantly, tend to degrade the quality of PSF photometry.
文件: 此参数默认禁用。正常情况下通量校准任务应始终关闭它，因为含多个局部极大值的源会给恒星位置的精确测定带来困难，更重要的是会降低 PSF 测光质量。

FILE: The multiscale analysis method uses wavelet transforms and morphological operations to isolate significant image structures. The pixels gathered on the intersection between significant structures of the reference and target images are then evaluated statistically to estimate the scale factor.
文件: 多尺度分析方法使用小波变换与形态学操作分离显著的图像结构，然后对参考图像与目标图像显著结构交集处收集的像素做统计评估，以估计尺度因子。

FILE: The default saturation threshold is 0.75. For relative scale evaluation this parameter is crucial in order to prevent contamination of the statistical sample of flux ratios by sources with saturated or nonlinear data. Changing the default value should not be necessary under normal conditions.
文件: 饱和阈值默认为 0.75。在相对尺度评估中，该参数对防止饱和或非线性数据的源污染通量比统计样本至关重要。正常情况下无需改动默认值。

FILE: Important: For execution in the global context (batch procedure), if the reference image refers to a disk file that will be part of an image integration task, it must also be included in the target images list. Otherwise no .xnml file and/or normalized image will be generated for the reference image.
文件: 重要：在全局上下文中执行（批处理流程）时，若参考图像指向一个将参与图像叠加的磁盘文件，该文件也必须列入目标图像列表。否则不会为参考图像生成 .xnml 文件和/或归一化图像。

FILE: For non-CFA data acquired with monochrome CCD or CMOS cameras, the Auto option is the correct selection because in these cases the process will detect no CFA pattern automatically.For images acquired with X-Trans sensors this parameter is ignored and CFA patterns are always extracted from existing image properties.
文件: 对单色 CCD 或 CMOS 相机采集的非 CFA 数据，“自动”是正确选择，因为这类情况下进程会自动检测到没有 CFA 排列。对 X-Trans 传感器采集的图像，此参数被忽略，CFA 排列一律从已有的图像属性中提取。

FILE: The dark frame optimization routine computes a dark scaling factor to minimize the noise induced by dark subtraction. Optimization is carried out separately for each target frame, including the master flat frame, if selected. Dark frame optimization has been implemented using robust linear minimization of variance.
文件: 暗帧优化流程计算暗场缩放因子，以最小化暗场扣除引入的噪声。优化对每个目标帧分别进行，若选中也包含 主平场帧。暗帧优化采用基于方差的稳健线性最小化实现。

FILE: The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for calibration of wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of signal estimation.
文件: 默认值给出 24K 颗恒星这一相当宽松的上限。限制测光样本数量可提升广域视场帧的校准性能——这类图像检测到的恒星数量往往极大。但把参与测量的源削减过多会损害信号估计的精度。

FILE: The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for normalization of wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of scale evaluation.
文件: 默认值给出 24K 颗恒星这一相当宽松的上限。限制测光样本数量可提升广域视场帧的归一化性能——这类图像检测到的恒星数量往往极大。但把参与测量的源削减过多会损害尺度评估的精度。

FILE: This parameter allows limiting star detection to a subset of the brightest sources in the image adaptively. By requiring relatively high SNR levels in the evaluated sources, the accuracy and robustness of the scale evaluation process can be largely improved. The default value is 40, which is quite appropriate in most cases.
文件: 此参数可将恒星检测自适应地限制在图像中最亮的一部分源上。通过在参与评估的源上要求较高的信噪比，可显著提升尺度评估过程的精度与稳健性。默认值为 40，在多数情况下相当合适。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a Gaussian convolution filter applied for noise reduction. Noise reduction is disabled by default; it is only necessary for images suffering from severe noise, especially images with clipped histograms and similar artifacts. Increasing this parameter should not be necessary for well calibrated images.
文件: 这是用于降噪的高斯卷积滤波半径（像素）。降噪默认禁用，只有噪声严重的图像才需要，尤其是直方图被削顶及类似伪影的图像。校准良好的图像通常无需增大此参数。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels will be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can prevent a valid signal evaluation.To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 这是恒星检测器在结构检测阶段之前执行的中值滤波半径（像素）。中值滤波对去除热像素非常有效。热像素会被识别为假恒星，数量较多时会导致信号评估无法得到有效结果。将参数设为零即关闭热像素去除。

FILE: This parameter defines the set of dark frame pixels that will be used to compute dark optimization factors adaptively. By restricting this set to relatively bright pixels, the optimization process can be more robust to readout noise present in the master bias and dark frames. Increase this parameter to remove more dark pixels from the optimization set.
文件: 此参数定义参与自适应计算暗帧优化因子的暗帧像素集合。把该集合限制在相对较亮的像素上，可使优化过程对 主偏置帧与暗场帧中的读出噪声更稳健。增大此参数会从优化集合中剔除更多暗像素。

FILE: If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects.In general, sources with several local maxima pose difficulties for the determination of accurate star positions and PSF parameters, although this is usually a minor problem for scale evaluation. For this reason this parameter is enabled by default.
文件: 启用此参数后，无法分离的多个源也能作为独立对象被自由检测。一般来说，含多个局部极大值的源会给恒星位置与 PSF 参数的精确测定带来困难，不过对尺度评估而言这通常影响不大。因此该参数默认启用。

FILE: Automatic will apply an automatically calculated pedestal value to frames that have negative, zero or insignificant (to machine epsilon) minimum pixel values after calibration. Automatic pedestals can be used to ensure positivity of the calibrated image with minimal truncation.See also the auto pedestal limit and output pedestal parameters for more information.
文件: “自动”会对校准后最小像素值为负、为零或无意义（低至机器 epsilon）的帧施加自动算出的基座值。自动基座可用来在尽量少截断的前提下保证校准图像为正。更多信息见自动基座限值与输出基座参数。

FILE: Rejection of saturated pixels is necessary to prevent generation of large-scale artifacts around large saturated structures, such as bright stars, in local background models. Under normal conditions you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter (0.85). Decrease it in the unlikely case that you detect dark artifacts around large saturated objects.
文件: 剔除饱和像素是必要的，可防止局部背景模型中在亮星等大面积饱和结构周围生成大尺度伪影。正常情况下无需改动此参数默认值（0.85）。若发现大面积饱和天体周围出现暗伪影（罕见），请减小它。

FILE: For some applications it may be desirable matching the global statistical parameter of location (or central tendency) of the reference image after local normalization. In such cases this option can be enabled to compute the required global normalization parameters, which will be included in generated .xnml files and applied to output normalized images, as appropriate.
文件: 某些应用可能希望局部归一化后参考图像的全局统计位置参数（或集中趋势）保持一致。此时可启用此选项以计算所需的全局归一化参数，这些参数会按需写入生成的 .xnml 文件并施加到输出的归一化图像上。

FILE: Use the multiscale median transform (MMT) instead of the starlet transform (AKA à trous transform) to isolate large-scale structures. The MMT can separate structures much better than linear transforms such as starlet, so it usually can reproduce better large-scale gradients present in most master bias frames. The MMT, despite being computationally intensive, is the default option.
文件: 用多尺度中值变换（MMT）而非 starlet 变换（又称 à trous 变换）来分离大尺度结构。MMT 分离结构的能力远强于 starlet 这类线性变换，因此通常能更好地重现多数 主偏置帧中存在的大尺度梯度。MMT 计算量大，但它是默认选项。

FILE: The original Chauvenet rejection criterion is N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5, where N is the number of measurements and P() represents the probability of x being more than z standard deviations from the mean. This parameter modifies the rejection criterion by replacing 0.5 with an arbitrary limit in the [0,1] range, in order to make the algorithm controllable. The default rejection limit is 0.3.
文件: 原始 Chauvenet 剔除判据为 N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5，其中 N 为测量次数，P() 表示 x 偏离均值超过 z 个标准差的概率。此参数把判据中的 0.5 换成 [0,1] 区间内的任意限值，从而让算法可控。默认剔除限值为 0.3。

FILE: If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects.This parameter is disabled by default. Under normal conditions, it should always be turned off for the flux calibration task since sources with several local maxima pose difficulties in determining accurate star positions and, more importantly, tend to degrade the quality of PSF photometry.
文件: 启用此参数后，无法分离的多个源也能作为独立对象被自由检测。此参数默认禁用。正常情况下通量校准任务应始终关闭它，因为含多个局部极大值的源会给恒星位置的精确测定带来困难，更重要的是会降低 PSF 测光质量。

FILE: Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz suffix. Normally you should select .xdrz files generated by the StarAlignment tool for the same files that you are integrating.
文件: drizzle 数据文件使用 .xdrz 后缀。通常应选择 StarAlignment 工具为你正在叠加的这批文件所生成的 .xdrz 文件。

FILE: Remove all local normalization data files currently associated with input images.This removes just file associations, not the actual local normalization data files.
文件: 移除当前与输入图像关联的全部局部归一化数据文件。此操作只移除文件关联，不删除实际的局部归一化数据文件。

FILE: High rejection range. If the clip high range option is enabled, all pixels with values greater than or equal to this high rejection range parameter will be rejected.
文件: 高值剔除范围。若启用了“截断高值范围”选项，所有数值大于或等于此高值剔除范围参数的像素都会被剔除。

FILE: Remove all local normalization data files currently associated with drizzle input images.This removes just file associations, not the actual local normalization data files.
文件: 移除当前与 drizzle 输入图像关联的全部局部归一化数据文件。此操作只移除文件关联，不删除实际的局部归一化数据文件。

FILE: Enabling LUTs significantly increases the execution speed at the price of negligible error in the calculation of droplet overlapping areas. This option is generally recommended.
文件: 启用 LUT 可显著提升执行速度，代价是液滴重叠面积计算中出现可忽略的误差。一般推荐启用此选项。

FILE: Local normalization data files carry the .xnml suffix. Normally you should select .xnml files generated by the LocalNormalization tool for the same files that you are integrating.
文件: 局部归一化数据文件使用 .xnml 后缀。通常应选择 LocalNormalization 工具为你正在叠加的这批文件所生成的 .xnml 文件。

FILE: If this option is selected, ImageIntegration will generate a 64-bit floating point result image. Otherwise the integration result will be generated as a 32-bit floating point image.
文件: 选中此选项后，ImageIntegration 会生成 64 位浮点结果图像；否则叠加结果生成为 32 位浮点图像。

FILE: In each line of a CSV weights file, the first field must be the full path to an image being integrated, followed by per-channel image weights specified as floating point real numbers.
文件: CSV 权重文件的每一行中，第一个字段必须是被叠加图像的完整路径，其后是以浮点实数给出的逐通道图像权重。

FILE: The file cache can also be persistent across PixInsight core application executions. The persistent cache and its options can be controlled with the ImageIntegration Preferences dialog.
文件: 文件缓存也可以跨 PixInsight 核心程序的多次运行持久保留。持久缓存及其选项可在 ImageIntegration 首选项对话框中控制。

FILE: Enable rejection of low pixels. Low pixels have values below the median of a pixel stack.If this option is disabled, rejection algorithms can only reject high pixels, i.e. pixels above the median.
文件: 启用低值像素剔除。低值像素指数值低于像素堆栈中位数的像素。若禁用此选项，剔除算法只能剔除高值像素，即高于中位数的像素。

FILE: Enable rejection of high pixels. High pixels have values above the median of a pixel stack.If this option is disabled, rejection algorithms can only reject low pixels, i.e. pixels below the median.
文件: 启用高值像素剔除。高值像素指数值高于像素堆栈中位数的像素。若禁用此选项，剔除算法只能剔除低值像素，即低于中位数的像素。

FILE: Custom FITS keyword to retrieve image weights.This is the name of a FITS keyword that will be used to retrieve image weights, if the FITS keyword option has been selected as the weighting criterion.
文件: 用于读取图像权重的自定义 FITS 关键字。当加权标准选择了“FITS 关键字”选项时，将用此关键字名称读取图像权重。

FILE: For input drizzle files that have been associated with local normalization data files (.xnml files), apply local normalization for output instead of the default scale + zero offset global normalization.
文件: 对已关联局部归一化数据文件（.xnml 文件）的输入 drizzle 文件，输出时施加局部归一化，而不用默认的“尺度 + 零偏移”全局归一化。

FILE: When enabled, the fitting rectangle must define a nonempty subset of the input images. When the fitting region is disabled (the default option), the whole image is used to compute linear fitting functions.
文件: 启用时，拟合矩形必须定义输入图像的一个非空子集。禁用拟合区域时（默认选项），用整幅图像计算线性拟合函数。

FILE: Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz suffix. Normally you should select .xdrz files generated by the StarAlignment and ImageIntegration tools for the images that you want to integrate with DrizzleIntegration.
文件: drizzle 数据文件使用 .xdrz 后缀。通常应选择 StarAlignment 与 ImageIntegration 工具为你打算用 DrizzleIntegration 叠加的图像所生成的 .xdrz 文件。

FILE: Select the default Auto option to retrieve CFA patterns automatically from input .xdrz files, or select one of the supported CFA patterns to force it, overriding the information that may be provided by .xdrz files.
文件: 选择默认的“自动”选项可从输入 .xdrz 文件自动读取 CFA 排列；也可选择某个受支持的 CFA 排列强制指定，覆盖 .xdrz 文件可能给出的信息。

FILE: If one of the supported CFA patterns is selected, such as RGGB, BGGR, etc, the process will assume the selected pattern even if it overrides data provided by .xdrz files (warning messages will be shown in such cases).
文件: 若选择了某个受支持的 CFA 排列（如 RGGB、BGGR 等），即使它覆盖了 .xdrz 文件提供的数据，进程也会采用所选排列（此时会显示警告信息）。

FILE: Associate existing drizzle data files with input images.Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz suffix. Normally you should select .xdrz files generated by the StarAlignment tool for the same files that you are integrating.
文件: 将已有的 drizzle 数据文件与输入图像关联。drizzle 数据文件使用 .xdrz 后缀。通常应选择 StarAlignment 工具为你正在叠加的这批文件所生成的 .xdrz 文件。

FILE: Note that the words 'small' and 'large' here don't refer to the number of images in an HDR composition, but to the length of the required numeric range to represent the whole set of tonal values in the final HDR result.
文件: 注意此处的“小”与“大”并非指 HDR 合成中图像的数量，而是指表示最终 HDR 结果中整套色调值所需的数值范围的跨度。

FILE: Defines the amount of low-pass filtering applied to smooth the edges of HDR combination masks.Low-pass filtering is necessary to avoid artifacts caused by hard transitions on the regions where successive images are combined.
文件: 定义用于平滑 HDR 合成蒙版边缘的低通滤波强度。低通滤波是必要的，可避免相邻图像合成区域上硬过渡所造成的伪影。

FILE: If this option is selected, HDRComposition will generate a new image window with the HDR composition mask applied to combine each pair of successive input images. These masks allow tight control over the HDR composition process.
文件: 选中此选项后，HDRComposition 会生成一个新的图像窗口，显示用于合成每对相邻输入图像的 HDR 合成蒙版。这些蒙版可对 HDR 合成过程做严密控制。

FILE: Mask growth can be useful to repair highly saturated areas, especially when these areas are surrounded by artifacts. For example, this option is particularly useful to fix bloomings, as they are often surrounded by dark artifacts.
文件: 蒙版增长有助于修复高度饱和区域，尤其是这些区域被伪影包围时。例如该选项对修复溢出（blooming）特别有用，因为溢出往往被暗伪影环绕。

FILE: The reference image is the first one in the list of images to integrate. Its statistical properties will be taken as the basis to calculate normalization parameters and relative combination weights for the rest of integrated images.
文件: 参考图像是待叠加图像列表中的第一幅。它的统计特性将作为基准，用于计算其余被叠加图像的归一化参数与相对合成权重。

FILE: If you select the CSV weights file option, you must select a plain text file in CSV format with full file paths of integrated images and their corresponding per-channel image weights. See the CSV weights file parameter for more information.
文件: 若选择“CSV 权重文件”选项，必须选择一个 CSV 格式的纯文本文件，其中包含被叠加图像的完整路径及其对应的逐通道图像权重。更多信息见 CSV 权重文件参数。

FILE: Select this option to close existing integration and rejection map images before running a new integration process. This is useful to avoid accumulation of multiple results on the workspace, when the same integration is being tested repeatedly.
文件: 选中此选项可在运行新的叠加过程前关闭已有的叠加图与剔除图。当反复测试同一次叠加时，这有助于避免工作区上堆积多份结果。

FILE: Select this option to close existing drizzle integration and weight images before running a new integration process. This is useful to avoid accumulation of multiple results on the workspace, when the same integration is being tested repeatedly.
文件: 选中此选项可在运行新的叠加过程前关闭已有的 drizzle 叠加图与权重图。当反复测试同一次叠加时，这有助于避免工作区上堆积多份结果。

FILE: Select this option to close existing HDR and composition mask images before running a new HDR composition process. This is useful to avoid accumulation of multiple results on the workspace, when the same HDR composition is being tested repeatedly.
文件: 选中此选项可在运行新的 HDR 合成过程前关闭已有的 HDR 图与合成蒙版。当反复测试同一次 HDR 合成时，这有助于避免工作区上堆积多份结果。

FILE: Associate existing local normalization data files with input images.Local normalization data files carry the .xnml suffix. Normally you should select .xnml files generated by the LocalNormalization tool for the same files that you are integrating.
文件: 将已有的局部归一化数据文件与输入图像关联。局部归一化数据文件使用 .xnml 后缀。通常应选择 LocalNormalization 工具为你正在叠加的这批文件所生成的 .xnml 文件。

FILE: Associate existing local normalization data files with drizzle input images.Local normalization data files carry the .xnml suffix. Normally you should select .xnml files generated by the LocalNormalization tool for the same files that you are integrating.
文件: 将已有的局部归一化数据文件与 drizzle 输入图像关联。局部归一化数据文件使用 .xnml 后缀。通常应选择 LocalNormalization 工具为你正在叠加的这批文件所生成的 .xnml 文件。

FILE: Increasing this parameter tends to cause the ESD algorithm to reject more pixels in each stack. Increasing this parameter has an effect similar to reducing the threshold of a sigma-clipping algorithm, although the underlying mechanisms are very different.
文件: 增大此参数往往会使 ESD 算法在每个像素堆栈中剔除更多像素。其效果类似于降低 sigma 裁剪算法的阈值，尽管两者的底层机制差别很大。

FILE: This option is useful to compare the results of different integration procedures. For example, by comparing SNR and PSF Signal Weight estimates you can know which image normalization and weighting criteria lead to the best results in terms of image quality.
文件: 此选项便于比较不同叠加流程的结果。例如对比 SNR 与 PSF 信号权重估计，就能知道哪种图像归一化与加权标准在图像质量上效果最好。

FILE: If this option is selected, HDRComposition will ignore black pixels to perform HDR compositions, and hence black pixels will never replace saturated pixels, or pixels above the binarizing threshold. This option should normally be enabled, as it is by default.
文件: 选中此选项后，HDRComposition 在做 HDR 合成时会忽略黑色像素，因此黑像素永远不会替换饱和像素或高于二值化阈值的像素。此选项通常应启用，默认即已启用。

FILE: Decrease this parameter if you experience out-of-memory errors during integration. This may be necessary for integration of large image sets on systems with low memory resources. The minimum value is zero, which will use a single row of pixels per input image.
文件: 若叠加过程中出现内存不足错误，请减小此参数。在内存资源较少的系统上叠加大批图像时可能需要这样做。最小值为零，表示每幅输入图像一次只处理一行像素。

FILE: Too high of a binarizing threshold may prevent appropriate repairing of saturated regions with the corresponding pixels from unsaturated images. A too low threshold may cause the opposite effect, leading to a result with insufficient contributions of large exposures.
文件: 二值化阈值过高可能导致无法用未饱和图像中的对应像素恰当修复饱和区域；阈值过低则可能造成相反效果，使结果中大曝光图像的贡献不足。

FILE: Add existing drizzle data files to the list of input data files.Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz suffix. Normally you should select .xdrz files generated by the StarAlignment and ImageIntegration tools for the images that you want to integrate with DrizzleIntegration.
文件: 把已有的 drizzle 数据文件加入输入数据文件列表。drizzle 数据文件使用 .xdrz 后缀。通常应选择 StarAlignment 与 ImageIntegration 工具为你打算用 DrizzleIntegration 叠加的图像所生成的 .xdrz 文件。

FILE: Images with normalized weights below the value of this parameter will be excluded for integration. The default value is 0.005, which represents a 0.5% of the maximum weight in the integrated data set. To disable this automatic image exclusion feature, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 归一化权重低于此参数取值的图像将被排除在叠加之外。默认值为 0.005，即被叠加数据集中最大权重的 0.5%。将参数设为零即关闭此自动排除功能。

FILE: Select this option to compute the overlapping areas of each drizzle droplet using LUTs (Look Up Tables).Enabling LUTs significantly increases the execution speed at the price of negligible error in the calculation of droplet overlapping areas. This option is generally recommended.
文件: 选中此选项以使用 LUT（查找表）计算各 drizzle 液滴的重叠面积。启用 LUT 可显著提升执行速度，代价是液滴重叠面积计算中出现可忽略的误差。一般推荐启用此选项。

FILE: By setting this parameter to an integer greater than zero, the HDR combination process will tend to ignore large-scale structures in short-exposure images. Along with mask growth, this parameter can be particularly useful to fix bloomings and other small-scale, high-contrast bright artifacts.
文件: 把此参数设为大于零的整数后，HDR 合成过程会倾向于忽略短曝光图像中的大尺度结构。与蒙版增长配合，此参数对修复溢出及其他小尺度高对比亮伪影特别有用。

FILE: Make the currently selected file on the list the reference image.The reference image is the first one in the list of images to integrate. Its statistical properties will be taken as the basis to calculate normalization parameters and relative combination weights for the rest of integrated images.
文件: 把列表中当前选定的文件设为参考图像。参考图像是待叠加图像列表中的第一幅，它的统计特性将作为基准，用于计算其余被叠加图像的归一化参数与相对合成权重。

FILE: All pixel samples with absolute differences from the median larger than this parameter will be set equal to the median of the pixel stack in the first rejection iteration. This replaces extreme outliers, such as cosmics, hot and cold pixels, with plausible values instead of their nearest neighbors.
文件: 第一次剔除迭代中，与中位数之差绝对值大于此参数的像素采样都会被设为该像素堆栈的中位数。这样就把宇宙线、热像素与冷像素等极端离群值替换为合理值，而不是用最邻近像素填补。

FILE: This feature assumes a homogeneous data set, where the best images are expected to have similar weights. For example, in a data set that mixes exposures of very different durations, valid weights can be more than ten times greater than those of most images. Don't enable this option for such data sets.
文件: 此功能假定数据集同质，即最好的图像预期具有相近的权重。例如在混合了曝光时长差异极大的数据集里，有效权重可能比多数图像大十倍以上。此类数据集不要启用此选项。

FILE: HDR combination masks can be expanded by applying a special dilation filter.Mask growth can be useful to repair highly saturated areas, especially when these areas are surrounded by artifacts. For example, this option is particularly useful to fix bloomings, as they are often surrounded by dark artifacts.
文件: 可通过施加专门的膨胀滤波来扩展 HDR 合成蒙版。蒙版增长有助于修复高度饱和区域，尤其是这些区域被伪影包围时。例如该选项对修复溢出特别有用，因为溢出往往被暗伪影环绕。

FILE: Gaussian and variable shape drizzle kernels (the latter providing finer control on function profiles) can be used to improve resolution of the integrated image. However, these functions tend to require much more and much better dithered data than the standard square and circular kernels to achieve optimal results.
文件: 高斯核与变形状 drizzle 核（后者可更精细地控制函数轮廓）可用于提升叠加图像的分辨率。但要达到最佳效果，这些核通常比标准方形核和圆形核要求更多、质量更好的抖动数据。

FILE: This option should also be disabled for integration of raw bias and dark frames, since in these cases existing PEDESTAL keywords should be preserved in the generated master bias and dark frames. These pedestals will be subtracted automatically by the ImageCalibration process for calibration of flat and light frames.
文件: 叠加原始偏置帧与暗帧时也应禁用此选项，因为这些情况下生成的 主偏置帧与主暗场帧中应保留已有的 PEDESTAL 关键字。这些基座会在 ImageCalibration 校准平场与亮帧时被自动扣除。

FILE: CFA (Color Filter Array) pattern used for CFA drizzle, when the enable CFA drizzle option (see above) is checked.Select the default Auto option to retrieve CFA patterns automatically from input .xdrz files, or select one of the supported CFA patterns to force it, overriding the information that may be provided by .xdrz files.
文件: 勾选“启用 CFA drizzle”选项（见上）时，用于 CFA drizzle 的 CFA（彩色滤镜阵列）排列。选择默认的“自动”选项可从输入 .xdrz 文件自动读取 CFA 排列；也可选择某个受支持的排列强制指定，覆盖 .xdrz 文件可能给出的信息。

FILE: Minimum normalized weight required for integration.Images with normalized weights below the value of this parameter will be excluded for integration. The default value is 0.005, which represents a 0.5% of the maximum weight in the integrated data set. To disable this automatic image exclusion feature, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 叠加所需的最小归一化权重。归一化权重低于此参数取值的图像将被排除在叠加之外。默认值为 0.005，即被叠加数据集中最大权重的 0.5%。将参数设为零即关闭此自动排除功能。

FILE: Drizzle data files contain geometrical projection parameters, pixel rejection maps, statistical data and metadata for the DrizzleIntegration tool. StarAlignment creates drizzle files with projection data, and the ImageIntegration tool appends rejection and statistical data to the same files. Drizzle files carry the .xdrz file suffix.
文件: drizzle 数据文件包含供 DrizzleIntegration 工具使用的几何投影参数、像素剔除图、统计数据与元数据。StarAlignment 生成含投影数据的 drizzle 文件，ImageIntegration 工具则向同一批文件追加剔除与统计数据。drizzle 文件使用 .xdrz 后缀。

FILE: Note that the coordinates and dimensions of the ROI are expressed in input reference pixels, not in output pixels. You can define ROI coordinates on an integrated image generated by the ImageIntegration tool, or on a registered image created by StarAlignment, for example by defining a preview and clicking the from preview button below.
文件: 注意 ROI 的坐标与尺寸以输入参考像素表示，而非输出像素。你可以在 ImageIntegration 工具生成的叠加图像上定义 ROI 坐标，也可以在 StarAlignment 生成的配准图像上定义，例如先画一个预览，再点击下方的“由预览”按钮。

FILE: For example, a value of 0.2 applied to a stack of 10 pixels means that the ESD algorithm will be limited to detecting a maximum of two outlier pixels; in other words, only 0, 1, or 2 outliers will be detectable in that case. The default value is 0.3, which allows the algorithm to detect up to a 30% of outlier pixels in each pixel stack.
文件: 例如，对 10 个像素的堆栈取 0.2，意味着 ESD 算法最多只能检测到两个离群像素；也就是说这种情形下只可能检测出 0、1 或 2 个离群值。默认值为 0.3，允许算法在每个像素堆栈中检测出最多 30% 的离群像素。

FILE: Rejection maps have pixel values proportional to the number of rejected pixels for each output pixel. Low and high rejected pixels are represented as two separate rejection maps, which are generated as 32-bit floating point images.Use rejection maps along with console rejection statistics to evaluate performance of pixel rejection parameters.
文件: 剔除图中像素值与每个输出像素被剔除的像素数量成正比。低值剔除与高值剔除分别表示为两幅独立的剔除图，均生成为 32 位浮点图像。请将剔除图与控制台剔除统计一起用于评估像素剔除参数的表现。

FILE: With the per image method, a weight is abnormal when it is greater than the upper quartile of the weights divided by this parameter. With the quantile limit method, protection is triggered when the median normalized weight is smaller than this parameter.The lower this parameter, the more permissive the integration will be to allow high weights.
文件: “逐图像”方法下，当某权重大于权重上四分位数除以本参数时即视为异常；“分位限值”方法下，当归一化权重中位数小于本参数时触发保护。本参数越小，叠加对高权重的容许度越大。

FILE: The full path to an existing local plain text file in CSV format containing image weights, when the CSV weights file option has been selected as the weighting criterion.In each line of a CSV weights file, the first field must be the full path to an image being integrated, followed by per-channel image weights specified as floating point real numbers.
文件: 当加权标准选择了“CSV 权重文件”选项时，此处填一个已有的 CSV 格式本地纯文本文件的完整路径，其中包含图像权重。CSV 权重文件的每一行中，第一个字段必须是被叠加图像的完整路径，其后是以浮点实数给出的逐通道图像权重。

FILE: The min/max method can be used to ensure rejection of extreme values. Min/max performs an unconditional rejection of a fixed number of pixels from each stack, without any statistical basis. Rejection methods based on robust statistics, such as percentile, Winsorized sigma clipping, linear fitting and averaged sigma clipping are in general preferable.
文件: min/max 方法可用于确保剔除极端值。min/max 从每个堆栈中无条件剔除固定数量的像素，没有任何统计依据。基于稳健统计的剔除方法一般更可取，例如百分位、Winsorized sigma clipping、线性拟合与平均 sigma 裁剪。

FILE: Growth of large-scale pixel rejection structures. Increase to extend rejection to more adjacent pixels. Excessive growth will reject too many pixels unnecessarily around large-scale structures, such as plane trails. Insufficient growth will leave unrejected pixels on high-uncertainty regions. The default value of two pixels is generally a good option.
文件: 大尺度像素剔除结构的增长量。增大可把剔除扩展到更多相邻像素。增长过大会在大尺度结构（如飞机拖尾）周围不必要地剔除过多像素，增长不足则会在高不确定区域留下未剔除的像素。默认值两像素通常是好选择。

FILE: Usually this is the best option to optimize image integration performance, but be aware that for large data sets and low-memory machines (relative to the total size of the data) the process may use too many system resources. If you want finer control on system resources usage, disable this option and tweak the values of the buffer size and stack size parameters.
文件: 通常这是优化图像叠加性能的最佳选项，但要注意：对大数据集和内存较小的机器（相对于数据总大小而言），进程可能占用过多系统资源。若想更精细地控制资源占用，请禁用此选项并调整缓冲区大小与堆栈大小参数。

FILE: Drizzle output scale, or subsampling ratio. This is the factor that multiplies input image dimensions (width, height) to compute the dimensions in pixels of the output integrated image. For example, to perform a 'drizzle x2' integration, the corresponding drizzle scale is 2 and the output image will have four times the area of the input reference image in square pixels.
文件: drizzle 输出尺度，即亚采样比。该因子乘到输入图像的尺寸（宽、高）上，得到输出叠加图像的像素尺寸。例如要做“drizzle x2”叠加，对应的 drizzle 尺度为 2，输出图像按平方像素计的面积将是输入参考图像的四倍。

FILE: Biweight location combination: the deviation from the estimate, in sigma units of the noise of each image, beyond which a pixel receives no weight and is rejected implicitly. Within three sigma every pixel has its full weight. The default value of 6 sigma rejects outliers such as cosmic rays, satellite trails and hot pixels with a negligible loss of signal-to-noise ratio.
文件: 双权位置合成：以各图像噪声的 sigma 为单位，偏离估计值超过该阈值的像素不获得权重并被隐含剔除。三 sigma 以内每个像素都保留全部权重。默认值 6 sigma 可剔除宇宙线、卫星拖尾与热像素等离群值，信噪比损失可忽略。

FILE: When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for flux measurement. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.
文件: 选择“自动”选项时，会为每个源拟合一系列不同的 PSF，取函数值与采样像素值之间绝对差最小的拟合用于通量测量。这一特殊自动模式目前测试以下函数：beta 形状参数为 2.5、4、6 和 10 的 Moffat 函数。

FILE: When this happens, the best option for integration of light or science frames is a linear rescaling, which preserves all of the integrated data. However, in some cases altering all pixel values is not admissible, so a rescaling operation is not applicable. In such cases truncation is the only option available to preserve the correct illumination profile in the integrated result.
文件: 出现这种情况时，叠加亮帧或科学帧的最佳选择是线性重新缩放，它能保留全部被叠加数据。但在某些情况下不允许改动所有像素值，重新缩放便不适用。此时截断是唯一可用的选项，能保住叠加结果中正确的照度分布。

FILE: Note that this may require a large amount of RAM available for relatively large image sets. As an example, the default stack size of 1024 (1 GiB) is sufficient to integrate 20 2048x2048 monochrome images optimally with the default buffer size of 16 MiB. With a stack size of 4 GiB and a buffer size of 64 MiB you could integrate 20 4Kx4K monochrome images with optimum performance.
文件: 注意对相对较大的图像集而言，这可能占用大量内存。举例来说，默认堆栈大小 1024（1 GiB）配合默认缓冲区 16 MiB，足以最优地叠加 20 幅 2048x2048 单色图像。若堆栈大小取 4 GiB、缓冲区取 64 MiB，则可以最优性能叠加 20 幅 4Kx4K 单色图像。

FILE: Cutoff point for the Winsorized sigma clipping rejection algorithm, in sigma units.All pixel samples with absolute differences from the median larger than this parameter will be set equal to the median of the pixel stack in the first rejection iteration. This replaces extreme outliers, such as cosmics, hot and cold pixels, with plausible values instead of their nearest neighbors.
文件: Winsorized sigma clipping 剔除算法的截断点，以 sigma 为单位。第一次剔除迭代中，与中位数之差绝对值大于此参数的像素采样都会被设为该像素堆栈的中位数。这样就把宇宙线、热像素与冷像素等极端离群值替换为合理值，而不是用最邻近像素填补。

FILE: Number of large-scale multiscale layers replaced in source images at each HDR combination step.By setting this parameter to an integer greater than zero, the HDR combination process will tend to ignore large-scale structures in short-exposure images. Along with mask growth, this parameter can be particularly useful to fix bloomings and other small-scale, high-contrast bright artifacts.
文件: 每次 HDR 合成步骤中，在源图像里被替换的大尺度多分辨率层数。把此参数设为大于零的整数后，HDR 合成过程会倾向于忽略短曝光图像中的大尺度结构。与蒙版增长配合，此参数对修复溢出及其他小尺度高对比亮伪影特别有用。

FILE: Number of small-scale layers that will be excluded from large-scale low pixel rejection maps. Increase this value to detect larger groups of contiguous rejected pixels. Excluding too few layers may lead to excessive (unnecessary) large-scale rejection. Excluding too many layers may lead to insufficient large-scale rejection. The default value of two layers is generally a good compromise.
文件: 从大尺度低值剔除图中排除的小尺度层数。增大此值可检测到更大的连续被剔除像素团。排除层数太少可能导致过度（不必要）的大尺度剔除；排除层数太多则可能导致大尺度剔除不足。默认两层通常是较好的折中。

FILE: Number of small-scale layers that will be excluded from large-scale high pixel rejection maps. Increase this value to detect larger groups of contiguous rejected pixels. Excluding too few layers may lead to excessive (unnecessary) large-scale rejection. Excluding too many layers may lead to insufficient large-scale rejection. The default value of two layers is generally a good compromise.
文件: 从大尺度高值剔除图中排除的小尺度层数。增大此值可检测到更大的连续被剔除像素团。排除层数太少可能导致过度（不必要）的大尺度剔除；排除层数太多则可能导致大尺度剔除不足。默认两层通常是较好的折中。

FILE: Generate an XML drizzle data file for each integrated image.Drizzle data files contain geometrical projection parameters, pixel rejection maps, statistical data and metadata for the DrizzleIntegration tool. StarAlignment creates drizzle files with projection data, and the ImageIntegration tool appends rejection and statistical data to the same files. Drizzle files carry the .xdrz file suffix.
文件: 为每幅被叠加图像生成一个 XML drizzle 数据文件。drizzle 数据文件包含供 DrizzleIntegration 工具使用的几何投影参数、像素剔除图、统计数据与元数据。StarAlignment 生成含投影数据的 drizzle 文件，ImageIntegration 工具则向同一批文件追加剔除与统计数据。drizzle 文件使用 .xdrz 后缀。

FILE: If an existing directory is specified, it will override the directories specified in all input drizzle data files. This is useful when one is going to execute an instance of DrizzleIntegration that has been generated on a different machine or filesystem; for example, if you borrow a process icon from a friend, quite likely the same images will be stored on different locations of your hard disk.
文件: 若指定了一个已存在的目录，它将覆盖所有输入 drizzle 数据文件中指定的目录。这在要执行在另一台机器或另一个文件系统上生成的 DrizzleIntegration 实例时很有用；例如你从朋友那里借来一个进程图标，那些相同的图像多半存放在你硬盘上的其他位置。

FILE: Disable this option if for some reason you don't want to use the cache. This will force recalculation of all statistical data required for normalization, which involves loading all integrated image files from disk.The file cache can also be persistent across PixInsight core application executions. The persistent cache and its options can be controlled with the ImageIntegration Preferences dialog.
文件: 若因某种原因不想使用缓存，请禁用此选项。这会强制重新计算归一化所需的全部统计数据，即从磁盘重新加载所有被叠加的图像文件。文件缓存也可以跨 PixInsight 核心程序的多次运行持久保留，持久缓存及其选项可在 ImageIntegration 首选项对话框中控制。

FILE: Half-size of the currently selected alignment reference in the source image. This value is computed automatically by DynamicAlignment's star detection/modeling algorithm.
文件: 源图像中当前所选对齐参考的半边长。此值由 DynamicAlignment 的恒星检测/建模算法自动计算。

FILE: Half-size of the currently selected alignment reference in the target image. This value is computed automatically by DynamicAlignment's star detection/modeling algorithm.
文件: 目标图像中当前所选对齐参考的半边长。此值由 DynamicAlignment 的恒星检测/建模算法自动计算。

FILE: Source star radius.Half-size of the currently selected alignment reference in the source image. This value is computed automatically by DynamicAlignment's star detection/modeling algorithm.
文件: 源恒星半径。源图像中当前所选对齐参考的半边长，此值由 DynamicAlignment 的恒星检测/建模算法自动计算。

FILE: Target star radius.Half-size of the currently selected alignment reference in the target image. This value is computed automatically by DynamicAlignment's star detection/modeling algorithm.
文件: 目标恒星半径。目标图像中当前所选对齐参考的半边长，此值由 DynamicAlignment 的恒星检测/建模算法自动计算。

FILE: Registered images will be transformed (translated, scaled and rotated) to align them with respect to the reference image. The reference image will not be modified during the registration process.
文件: 配准后的图像会被变换（平移、缩放、旋转）以与参考图像对齐。配准过程中参考图像不会被修改。

FILE: With the recursive surface splines registration model, this parameter is the order of the polyharmonic splines generated for all regions of the image. The default order 2 generates thin plate splines.
文件: 采用递归曲面样条配准模型时，此参数是为图像所有区域生成的多调和样条的阶数。默认阶数 2 生成薄板样条。

FILE: To force a new prediction of coordinates for any existing reference, just select and move it slightly with the mouse. In this way the alignment reference will be recalculated, including its predicted coordinates.
文件: 若想为任何已有参考强制重新预测坐标，只需用鼠标选中它并轻微移动一下。这样该对齐参考就会被重新计算，其预测坐标也一并更新。

FILE: To force a new prediction of coordinates for any existing reference, just select and move it slightly with the mouse. In this way the alignment reference will be recalculated, along with its predicted coordinates.
文件: 若想为任何已有参考强制重新预测坐标，只需用鼠标选中它并轻微移动一下。这样该对齐参考连同其预测坐标都会被重新计算。

FILE: Make sure the DynamicAlignment interface is open, then select the source and target alignment images manually by clicking on them. With both images selected, you'll be able to launch and edit DynamicAlignment instances.
文件: 请确认 DynamicAlignment 界面已打开，然后分别单击源对齐图像与目标对齐图像以手动选定它们。两幅图像都选定后，就能启动和编辑 DynamicAlignment 实例。

FILE: If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the registration process will fail.
文件: 若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则配准进程会失败。

FILE: Registration reference image.Registered images will be transformed (translated, scaled and rotated) to align them with respect to the reference image. The reference image will not be modified during the registration process.
文件: 配准参考图像。配准后的图像会被变换（平移、缩放、旋转）以与参考图像对齐。配准过程中参考图像不会被修改。

FILE: With this option disabled, you have the freedom to place alignment references at arbitrary locations on the source and target images. Simply place an alignment reference and move it manually where you want to set an alignment point.
文件: 禁用此选项后，你可以把对齐参考放在源图像与目标图像的任意位置。只需放置一个对齐参考，再手动把它移到你想设为对齐点的位置。

FILE: Noise reduction prevents detection of bright noise structures as false stars, including hot pixels and cosmic rays. This parameter can also be used to control the sizes of the smallest detected stars (increase to exclude more stars).
文件: 降噪可防止把热像素、宇宙线等亮噪声结构误检为假恒星。此参数也可用于控制检测到的最小恒星尺寸（增大该值可排除更多恒星）。

FILE: If this option is selected, StarAlignment will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.Enable this option at your own risk.
文件: 选中此选项后，StarAlignment 会覆盖与生成的输出文件同名的已有文件。这很危险，被覆盖文件的原始内容将永久丢失。启用此选项风险自负。

FILE: This is the difference in pixels between the vertical coordinates of the target and source positions for the current reference. It measures the vertical displacement of the target image with respect to the source image for the current alignment reference.
文件: 当前参考在目标位置与源位置之间的垂直坐标差（像素）。它衡量在当前对齐参考下，目标图像相对源图像的垂直位移。

FILE: This is the difference in pixels between the horizontal coordinates of the target and source positions for the current reference. It measures the horizontal displacement of the target image with respect to the source image for the current alignment reference.
文件: 当前参考在目标位置与源位置之间的水平坐标差（像素）。它衡量在当前对齐参考下，目标图像相对源图像的水平位移。

FILE: Use this parameter, if necessary, to control inclusion of elongated stars, complex clusters of stars, and nonstellar image features. The default value is 0.6. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.
文件: 必要时可用此参数控制拉长恒星、复杂星团以及非恒星图像特征的纳入。默认值为 0.6。正常工作条件下一般无需改动此参数的默认值。

FILE: A copy of the target image will be transformed (translated, scaled, rotated, warped and distorted), as necessary to achieve pixel-by-pixel alignment with respect to the source image. Note that neither source nor target images will be modified in any way by DynamicAlignment.
文件: 将按需对目标图像的副本做变换（平移、缩放、旋转、扭曲与畸变），以实现与源图像的逐像素对齐。注意 DynamicAlignment 不会以任何方式修改源图像或目标图像。

FILE: Number of wavelet layers used for noise reduction.Noise reduction prevents detection of bright noise structures as false stars, including hot pixels and cosmic rays. This parameter can also be used to control the sizes of the smallest detected stars (increase to exclude more stars).
文件: 用于降噪的小波层数。降噪可防止把热像素、宇宙线等亮噪声结构误检为假恒星。此参数也可用于控制检测到的最小恒星尺寸（增大该值可排除更多恒星）。

FILE: DynamicAlignment was unable to select a source image automatically.Make sure the DynamicAlignment interface is open, then select the source and target alignment images manually by clicking on them. With both images selected, you'll be able to launch and edit DynamicAlignment instances.
文件: DynamicAlignment 无法自动选定源图像。请确认 DynamicAlignment 界面已打开，然后分别单击源对齐图像与目标对齐图像以手动选定它们。两幅图像都选定后，就能启动和编辑 DynamicAlignment 实例。

FILE: A registration mask is an 8-bit grayscale image whose pixels are white only where the registered image contains pixels from the corresponding target image; black anywhere else. These masks are very useful to apply selective corrections to registered pixels, especially in mosaic images.
文件: 配准蒙版是一幅 8 位灰度图像，仅在配准图像含对应目标图像像素的位置为白，其余为黑。这类蒙版对配准像素做选择性校正非常有用，尤其在马赛克图像中。

FILE: This parameter determines the size in pixels of the initial search box used to detect valid alignment references on the source image. Increase it to favor detection of larger structures. Decrease to facilitate finding relatively small features; for example to deal with dense star fields.
文件: 此参数决定在源图像上检测有效对齐参考时初始搜索框的边长（像素）。增大它有利于检测较大的结构，减小它便于找到相对较小的特征，例如应对密集星场。

FILE: This parameter determines the size in pixels of the initial search box used to detect valid alignment references on the target image. Increase it to favor detection of larger structures. Decrease to facilitate finding relatively small features; for example to deal with dense star fields.
文件: 此参数决定在目标图像上检测有效对齐参考时初始搜索框的边长（像素）。增大它有利于检测较大的结构，减小它便于找到相对较小的特征，例如应对密集星场。

FILE: Note that this option is relevant for all registration models, including linear and nonlinear models with arbitrary distortion correction using surface splines. In the latter case, a linear model is always necessary to build an initial registration transformation before modeling distortions.
文件: 注意此选项对所有配准模型都相关，包括线性模型以及用曲面样条做任意畸变校正的非线性模型。对后者，在建模畸变之前总需要先用线性模型建立初始配准变换。

FILE: This is the directory (or folder) where all output files will be written.If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the registration process will fail.
文件: 这是所有输出文件的写入目录（或文件夹）。若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则配准进程会失败。

FILE: For standard RBF types, which require O(n^3) time for spline construction, this parameter is ignored and a maximum of 2100 control points is always imposed.This parameter is not used with the recursive surface splines registration model, which uses all star pair matches after outlier rejection.
文件: 对样条构建需 O(n^3) 时间的标准 RBF 类型，此参数被忽略，始终强制最多 2100 个控制点。递归曲面样条配准模型不使用此参数，它在剔除离群值后使用全部星对匹配。

FILE: Drizzle data files are written in XDRZ format version 1.1, which stores surface spline distortion models, for both the two-dimensional surface splines and recursive surface splines registration models, as compressed binary data. Version 1.1 files cannot be read by previous versions of PixInsight.
文件: drizzle 数据文件以 XDRZ 1.1 版格式写出，会把二维曲面样条与递归曲面样条两种配准模型的曲面样条畸变模型保存为压缩二进制数据。1.1 版文件无法被旧版 PixInsight 读取。

FILE: Registration target image.A copy of the target image will be transformed (translated, scaled, rotated, warped and distorted), as necessary to achieve pixel-by-pixel alignment with respect to the source image. Note that neither source nor target images will be modified in any way by DynamicAlignment.
文件: 配准目标图像。将按需对目标图像的副本做变换（平移、缩放、旋转、扭曲与畸变），以实现与源图像的逐像素对齐。注意 DynamicAlignment 不会以任何方式修改源图像或目标图像。

FILE: Registration reference image.A copy of the target image will be transformed (translated, scaled, rotated, warped and distorted), as necessary to achieve pixel-by-pixel alignment with respect to the source image. Note that neither source nor target images will be modified in any way by DynamicAlignment.
文件: 配准参考图像。将按需对目标图像的副本做变换（平移、缩放、旋转、扭曲与畸变），以实现与源图像的逐像素对齐。注意 DynamicAlignment 不会以任何方式修改源图像或目标图像。

FILE: Differential star position (target-source), Y-axis.This is the difference in pixels between the vertical coordinates of the target and source positions for the current reference. It measures the vertical displacement of the target image with respect to the source image for the current alignment reference.
文件: 恒星位置差（目标减源），Y 轴。这是当前参考在目标位置与源位置之间的垂直坐标差（像素），衡量在当前对齐参考下目标图像相对源图像的垂直位移。

FILE: The Register/Union - Separate mode is similar to the register/union mosaic mode, but each mosaic frame generates a separate image with the canvas size of the whole mosaic. Separate mosaic frames can then be composed into a single mosaic by means of a maximum combination (e.g., with PixelMath's max function).
文件: “配准/合并 - 分离”模式与配准/合并马赛克模式类似，但每个马赛克帧都生成一幅独立图像，画布尺寸为整个马赛克的大小。分离出的马赛克帧随后可通过最大值合成（例如用 PixelMath 的 max 函数）拼成整幅马赛克。

FILE: Differential star position (target-source), X-axis.This is the difference in pixels between the horizontal coordinates of the target and source positions for the current reference. It measures the horizontal displacement of the target image with respect to the source image for the current alignment reference.
文件: 恒星位置差（目标减源），X 轴。这是当前参考在目标位置与源位置之间的水平坐标差（像素），衡量在当前对齐参考下目标图像相对源图像的水平位移。

FILE: DynamicAlignment cannot select a target image automatically because there are more than two images open.Make sure the DynamicAlignment interface is open, then select the source and target alignment images manually by clicking on them. With both images selected, you'll be able to launch and edit DynamicAlignment instances.
文件: 由于打开的图像超过两幅，DynamicAlignment 无法自动选定目标图像。请确认 DynamicAlignment 界面已打开，然后分别单击源对齐图像与目标对齐图像以手动选定它们。两幅图像都选定后，就能启动和编辑 DynamicAlignment 实例。

FILE: Initial search radius, source image.This parameter determines the size in pixels of the initial search box used to detect valid alignment references on the source image. Increase it to favor detection of larger structures. Decrease to facilitate finding relatively small features; for example to deal with dense star fields.
文件: 初始搜索半径（源图像）。此参数决定在源图像上检测有效对齐参考时初始搜索框的边长（像素）。增大它有利于检测较大的结构，减小它便于找到相对较小的特征，例如应对密集星场。

FILE: Initial search radius, target image.This parameter determines the size in pixels of the initial search box used to detect valid alignment references on the target image. Increase it to favor detection of larger structures. Decrease to facilitate finding relatively small features; for example to deal with dense star fields.
文件: 初始搜索半径（目标图像）。此参数决定在目标图像上检测有效对齐参考时初始搜索框的边长（像素）。增大它有利于检测较大的结构，减小它便于找到相对较小的特征，例如应对密集星场。

FILE: Generate a registration mask for each registered image.A registration mask is an 8-bit grayscale image whose pixels are white only where the registered image contains pixels from the corresponding target image; black anywhere else. These masks are very useful to apply selective corrections to registered pixels, especially in mosaic images.
文件: 为每幅配准图像生成一个配准蒙版。配准蒙版是一幅 8 位灰度图像，仅在配准图像含对应目标图像像素的位置为白，其余为黑。这类蒙版对配准像素做选择性校正非常有用，尤其在马赛克图像中。

FILE: In distortion maps, each distortion measurement is represented as a mark consisting of a circle and a line. Circles correspond to alignment positions calculated with a linear transformation, and lines point to the corresponding positions given by the spline-based transformation. Without distortions, all marks should be circles without visible lines.
文件: 畸变图中每个畸变量表示为由圆圈和线段构成的标记。圆圈对应按线性变换算出的对齐位置，线段指向样条变换给出的相应位置。没有畸变时，所有标记都应是看不到线段的圆圈。

FILE: More descriptors will always increase the probability of finding more putative star pair matches, but at the cost of more computing time. A value between 10 and 100 is appropriate in most cases. In difficult cases a value up to 200 may be necessary for this parameter. Be aware that higher values will increase the required computing time exponentially.
文件: 描述子越多，找到更多假定星对匹配的概率越高，但计算时间也随之增加。多数情况下取 10 到 100 较为合适；疑难情况下可能需要取到 200。请注意取值越高，所需计算时间呈指数增长。

FILE: If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects. This can be necessary in special cases where extreme high noise levels and/or distortion of stellar images caused by optical aberrations limit the number of detectable sources excessively, preventing image registration.The default state is disabled.
文件: 启用此参数后，无法分离的多个源也能作为独立对象被自由检测。在极端高噪声和/或光学像差导致恒星像严重畸变、可检测源数量过少以致无法配准的特殊情况下，这可能是必要的。默认状态为禁用。

FILE: Number of wavelet layers used for noise reduction.Noise reduction prevents detection of bright noise structures as false stars, including hot pixels and cosmic rays. This parameter can also be used to control the sizes of the smallest detected stars (increase to exclude more stars), although the minimum structure size parameter can be more efficient for this purpose.
文件: 用于降噪的小波层数。降噪可防止把热像素、宇宙线等亮噪声结构误检为假恒星。此参数也可用于控制检测到的最小恒星尺寸（增大该值可排除更多恒星），不过用最小结构尺寸参数控制这一点更高效。

FILE: The result of DynamicAlignment execution is a newly created, registered image; here you can specify a valid view identifier that will be assigned to its main view. If this parameter is left blank, DynamicAlignment will automatically assign an identifier consisting of the target image's identifier plus a predefined suffix (by default, the appended suffix is _registered).
文件: DynamicAlignment 执行的结果是一幅新建的配准图像；此处可指定一个有效的视图标识符赋给它的主视图。若此参数留空，DynamicAlignment 会自动分配一个标识符，由目标图像的标识符加一个预定义后缀构成（默认追加的后缀为 _registered）。

FILE: Normal (noninverted) DA references look for bright stars over a dark background. An inverted reference behaves just the opposite way: dark star over a bright background. By inverting references you can select arbitrary image structures, not only stars, as alignment features. For example, you can select dark alignment features on lunar and planetary images using this option.
文件: 普通（非反转）DA 参考在暗背景上寻找亮星；反转参考正好相反，在亮背景上寻找暗星。通过反转参考，你可以把任意图像结构（而不仅是恒星）选作对齐特征。例如用此选项可在月面与行星图像上选取暗的对齐特征。

FILE: In this mode the rescaling range is taken as the existing minimum and maximum values among all nominal channels in the target image, which preserves color balance.
文件: 此模式下，重新缩放范围取目标图像全部标称通道中现有的最小值和最大值，从而保持色彩平衡。

FILE: Plot the computed AdaptiveStretch curve on an auxiliary window during real-time preview operations. Uncheck this option to close the graph window, if it is visible.
文件: 实时预览操作期间，在辅助窗口中绘制计算出的 AdaptiveStretch 曲线。若不想看该图形窗口，取消勾选此选项即可关闭（若它可见）。

FILE: Important &mdash If the target image is linear, this rescaling operation will break linearity, as CIE L* is a nonlinear function of the R, G and B sample values for each pixel.
文件: 重要 &mdash 若目标图像是线性的，此重新缩放操作会破坏线性，因为对每个像素而言 CIE L* 是 R、G、B 采样值的非线性函数。

FILE: The contrast protection parameter limits the increase of contrast on very bright and dark areas. Increasing this parameter can help control excessive intensification of highlights and darkening of shadows.
文件: 对比度保护参数限制很亮与很暗区域上对比度的增强。增大此参数有助于控制高光的过度强化与暗部的过度压暗。

FILE: Apply a rescaling operation in the RGB/gray color space.In this mode the rescaling range is taken as the existing minimum and maximum values among all nominal channels in the target image, which preserves color balance.
文件: 在 RGB/灰度色彩空间中施加重新缩放操作。此模式下，重新缩放范围取目标图像全部标称通道中现有的最小值和最大值，从而保持色彩平衡。

FILE: Mean background in the normalized range [0,1]. ScreenTransferFunction will calculate the required nonlinear midtones balance to achieve the specified mean background level on the screen representation of the target image.
文件: 归一化范围 [0,1] 内的平均背景。ScreenTransferFunction 会计算所需的非线性中间调平衡，以在目标图像的屏幕显示上达到指定的平均背景水平。

FILE: Important &mdash The CIE Y component is a linear combination of the R, G and B sample values for each pixel. However, if the target image is linear, a linear RGB working space should be used (gamma=1) to preserve linearity.
文件: 重要 &mdash 对每个像素而言，CIE Y 分量是 R、G、B 采样值的线性组合。但若目标图像是线性的，应使用线性 RGB 工作空间（gamma=1）以保持线性。

FILE: Two options are available: the intensity (I) component of the HSI color ordering system, and the value (V) component of HSV.For grayscale images the mask is always generated from a duplicate of the image at each iteration, and hence this parameter is not used.
文件: 有两个选项：HSI 颜色排序系统的强度（I）分量，以及 HSV 的明度（V）分量。对灰度图像，蒙版始终由每次迭代时图像的副本生成，因此不使用此参数。

FILE: The CIE L* component (lightness) is extracted, rescaled, and then reinserted in the target RGB image.Important &mdash If the target image is linear, this rescaling operation will break linearity, as CIE L* is a nonlinear function of the R, G and B sample values for each pixel.
文件: 提取 CIE L* 分量（明度），重新缩放后再写回目标 RGB 图像。重要 &mdash 若目标图像是线性的，此重新缩放操作会破坏线性，因为对每个像素而言 CIE L* 是 R、G、B 采样值的非线性函数。

FILE: Lower bound of the set of background pixels. Background reference pixels with values less than or equal to this limit will be rejected for calculation of the initial mean background. Note that since the minimum allowed value for this parameter is zero, black pixels are never taken into account.
文件: 背景像素集合的下界。数值小于或等于此限值的背景参考像素将被排除在初始平均背景的计算之外。注意此参数允许的最小值为零，因此纯黑像素永远不会被计入。

FILE: Rescale the CIE L* component.The CIE L* component (lightness) is extracted, rescaled, and then reinserted in the target RGB image.Important &mdash If the target image is linear, this rescaling operation will break linearity, as CIE L* is a nonlinear function of the R, G and B sample values for each pixel.
文件: 重新缩放 CIE L* 分量。提取 CIE L* 分量（明度），重新缩放后再写回目标 RGB 图像。重要 &mdash 若目标图像是线性的，此重新缩放操作会破坏线性，因为对每个像素而言 CIE L* 是 R、G、B 采样值的非线性函数。

FILE: Type of the mask used to protect the highlights of color images.Two options are available: the intensity (I) component of the HSI color ordering system, and the value (V) component of HSV.For grayscale images the mask is always generated from a duplicate of the image at each iteration, and hence this parameter is not used.
文件: 用于保护彩色图像高光的蒙版类型。有两个选项：HSI 颜色排序系统的强度（I）分量，以及 HSV 的明度（V）分量。对灰度图像，蒙版始终由每次迭代时图像的副本生成，因此不使用此参数。

FILE: For optimal results, the masked stretch algorithm requires full coverage of the dynamic range at the shadows, that is, no unused section at the left side of the main histogram peak. This is the fraction of dark pixels that will be clipped before the masked stretch process. Specify zero to disable the shadows auto clipping feature.
文件: 为获得最佳效果，蒙版拉伸算法要求暗部完整覆盖动态范围，即主直方图峰左侧没有未使用的区段。此参数是在蒙版拉伸过程之前将被截断的暗像素比例。填零即关闭暗部自动截断功能。

FILE: The CIE Y component (relative luminance) is extracted, rescaled, and then reinserted in the target RGB image.Important &mdash The CIE Y component is a linear combination of the R, G and B sample values for each pixel. However, if the target image is linear, a linear RGB working space should be used (gamma=1) to preserve linearity.
文件: 提取 CIE Y 分量（相对亮度），重新缩放后再写回目标 RGB 图像。重要 &mdash 对每个像素而言，CIE Y 分量是 R、G、B 采样值的线性组合。但若目标图像是线性的，应使用线性 RGB 工作空间（gamma=1）以保持线性。

FILE: By default, the AdaptiveStretch process analyzes pairwise pixel brightness differences on the whole target image. When necessary, a region of interest (ROI) can be defined to restrict the analysis to a rectangular region of the image. This may help find an optimal transformation for image structures that are not dominant on the entire image.
文件: 默认情况下，AdaptiveStretch 进程会分析整幅目标图像上的成对像素亮度差。必要时可定义感兴趣区域（ROI），把分析限制在图像的某个矩形区域，这有助于为在整幅图上并非主导的图像结构找到最优变换。

FILE: Increasing this parameter can improve the result for very rich floating point and 32-bit integer images, usually resulting from deep HDR compositions. Keep in mind that large curves will increase computation times considerably, so they should only be used when actually required. In most cases, the default value of this parameter is quite appropriate.
文件: 增大此参数可改善极丰富浮点与 32 位整数图像（通常来自深度 HDR 合成）的结果。请记住曲线越长计算时间越长，因此只在确实需要时才用。多数情况下此参数的默认值已相当合适。

FILE: Rescale the CIE Y component.The CIE Y component (relative luminance) is extracted, rescaled, and then reinserted in the target RGB image.Important &mdash The CIE Y component is a linear combination of the R, G and B sample values for each pixel. However, if the target image is linear, a linear RGB working space should be used (gamma=1) to preserve linearity.
文件: 重新缩放 CIE Y 分量。提取 CIE Y 分量（相对亮度），重新缩放后再写回目标 RGB 图像。重要 &mdash 对每个像素而言，CIE Y 分量是 R、G、B 采样值的线性组合。但若目标图像是线性的，应使用线性 RGB 工作空间（gamma=1）以保持线性。

FILE: By default, MaskedStretch analyzes the entire background reference image to compute an initial mean background level. When necessary, a region of interest (ROI) can be defined to restrict the analysis to a rectangular region of the background reference image. This may help to find an optimal transformation by excluding image structures that are not relevant for the current stretching task.
文件: 默认情况下，MaskedStretch 会分析整幅背景参考图像以计算初始平均背景水平。必要时可定义感兴趣区域（ROI），把分析限制在背景参考图像的某个矩形区域。这有助于排除与当前拉伸任务无关的图像结构，从而找到最优变换。

FILE: Compression quality for lossy compression: higher values give better quality and larger files. A quality of 90 is visually lossless (a Butteraugli distance of 1).The default value is 90.
文件: 有损压缩的压缩质量：取值越高，质量越好、文件越大。质量 90 为视觉无损（Butteraugli 距离为 1）。默认值为 90。

FILE: The radius (in pixels) of the circular or square kernel in which the local histogram is evaluated.For most images, values between 50 and 200 give the best result.
文件: 评估局部直方图所用的圆形或方形核半径（像素）。对多数图像，取值在 50 到 200 之间效果最好。

FILE: The resolution of the histogram used to evaluate contrast transfer function. Usually 8-bit resolution is enough. For large kernel size, you may try higher resolutions to improve precision, but the computation will be slower.
文件: 用于评估对比度转移函数的直方图分辨率。通常 8 位分辨率已足够。核尺寸较大时，可尝试更高分辨率以提升精度，但计算会更慢。

FILE: Amount of the local histogram equalization. This parameter is used to blend processed image with original one. For example value of 0.75 means that resulting image is blend of 1/4 of the original with 3/4 of the processed image.
文件: 局部直方图均衡的强度。此参数用于把处理后的图像与原图混合，例如取 0.75 表示结果图像由 1/4 原图与 3/4 处理后图像混合而成。

FILE: The maximal allowed slope of the local contrast transfer function. Value of 1 does not change original image at all. Higher values make an effect stronger. Too high values strenghten the noise in the image. Typical values are 1.5-3.0.
文件: 局部对比度转移函数允许的最大斜率。取 1 完全不改变原图，取值越高效果越强，取值过高会强化图像中的噪声。典型取值为 1.5 到 3.0。

FILE: The precision is fixed when the inference session is created, so each setting keeps its own loaded model: the first execution after changing this option reloads the model.This option has no effect on CPU inference, which is always performed in full precision.
文件: 精度在推理会话创建时即固定，因此每种设置各自保留已加载的模型：改动此选项后首次执行会重新加载模型。此选项对 CPU 推理无影响，CPU 推理总以全精度执行。

FILE: The noise reduction mask will be delinearized to achieve the specified mean background level in the [0,1] range. Higher values increase protection in the highlights. Lower values allow more noise reduction over bright image structures. The default value is 0.25.
文件: 降噪蒙版会被去线性化，以在 [0,1] 范围内达到指定的平均背景水平。取值越高，高光处的保护越强；取值越低，亮图像结构上可施加更多降噪。默认值为 0.25。
