FILE: Normalized mean background level.The noise reduction mask will be delinearized to achieve the specified mean background level in the [0,1] range. Higher values increase protection in the highlights. Lower values allow more noise reduction over bright image structures. The default value is 0.25.
文件: 归一化平均背景水平。降噪蒙版会被去线性化，以在 [0,1] 范围内达到指定的平均背景水平。取值越高，高光处的保护越强；取值越低，亮图像结构上可施加更多降噪。默认值为 0.25。

FILE: Strength of the denoising effect. Each output pixel is a linear blend between the original and the denoised result: (1 − amount)×original + amount×denoised.1.00 applies the full denoise; 0.00 leaves the image unchanged; intermediate values keep part of the original noise. The default value is 0.90.
文件: 降噪效果的强度。每个输出像素是原图与降噪结果的线性混合：(1 − amount)×原图 + amount×降噪结果。1.00 施加完全降噪；0.00 保持图像不变；中间值保留部分原始噪声。默认值为 0.90。

FILE: This value is expressed as a distance in robust sigma units from the image's median. Negative values locate the mask clipping point to the left of the main histogram peak. Positive values tend to clip the bulk of the background pixels, which is more aggressive at reducing noise in sky background regions.
文件: 该值以相对图像中位数的稳健 sigma 单位表示距离。取负值会把蒙版截断点定位在主直方图峰左侧；取正值倾向于截断主体背景像素，对降低天空背景区域的噪声更激进。

FILE: Preview the noise reduction mask. This is a special control mode that you should use to evaluate how the mask will protect the high-signal regions of the image. Black mask pixels will block noise reduction completely, while white mask pixels will allow full noise reduction at the currently selected amount. Gray mask values define intermediate protection levels.
文件: 预览降噪蒙版。这是一种特殊的控制模式，用于评估蒙版将如何保护图像的高信号区域。蒙版为黑的像素会完全阻止降噪，为白的像素会在当前所选强度下允许完全降噪，灰色取值表示中间保护程度。

FILE: Low clipping point parameter for mask generation, expressed in sigma units.This value is expressed as a distance in robust sigma units from the image's median. Negative values locate the mask clipping point to the left of the main histogram peak. Positive values tend to clip the bulk of the background pixels, which is more aggressive at reducing noise in sky background regions.
文件: 用于生成蒙版的低截断点参数，以 sigma 为单位。该值以相对图像中位数的稳健 sigma 单位表示距离。取负值会把蒙版截断点定位在主直方图峰左侧；取正值倾向于截断主体背景像素，对降低天空背景区域的噪声更激进。

FILE: This value will multiply the mask, so it can be used to impose a maximum mask value. If mask inversion has been enabled, multiplication will take place prior to inversion.
文件: 该值会乘到蒙版上，可用于设定蒙版的最大值。若已启用蒙版反转，乘法在反转之前进行。

FILE: Extract structure contours.Enable this option to build a mask based on structure contours. This option involves implicit binarization of all structures prior to contour detection.
文件: 提取结构轮廓。启用此选项可基于结构轮廓构建蒙版。此选项会在轮廓检测之前对所有结构做隐含的二值化。

FILE: Mask upper limitThis value will multiply the mask, so it can be used to impose a maximum mask value. If mask inversion has been enabled, multiplication will take place prior to inversion.
文件: 蒙版上限。该值会乘到蒙版上，可用于设定蒙版的最大值。若已启用蒙版反转，乘法在反转之前进行。

FILE: When this option is disabled, structures have initial values proportional to their relevance in the multiscale pyramid. Structures that are supported by more wavelet layers will be brighter.
文件: 禁用此选项时，结构的初始值与其在多尺度金字塔中的重要性成正比。由更多小波层支撑的结构会更亮。

FILE: The star mask mode generates a directly usable mask image.The structure detection mode helps you to identify detected objects.Overlay images help you in evaluating the suitability of generated masks.
文件: 星蒙版模式生成可直接使用的蒙版图像；结构检测模式帮助你识别检测到的对象；叠加图像帮助你评估所生成蒙版的适用性。

FILE: Mask generation modeThe star mask mode generates a directly usable mask image.The structure detection mode helps you to identify detected objects.Overlay images help you in evaluating the suitability of generated masks.
文件: 蒙版生成模式。星蒙版模式生成可直接使用的蒙版图像；结构检测模式帮助你识别检测到的对象；叠加图像帮助你评估所生成蒙版的适用性。

FILE: Enable this option to generate a mask where structures are gathered by summing their representations on all wavelet layers. This leads to structures whose initial values are more proportional to the relevance of their support in the multiscale pyramid.
文件: 启用此选项可生成这样一幅蒙版：结构通过累加其在所有小波层上的表示来汇聚。这样结构的初始值更与其在多尺度金字塔中支撑的重要性成正比。

FILE: Gather structures by aggregation instead of superposition.Enable this option to generate a mask where structures are gathered by summing their representations on all wavelet layers. This leads to structures whose initial values are more proportional to the relevance of their support in the multiscale pyramid.
文件: 按聚合而非叠加汇聚结构。启用此选项可生成这样一幅蒙版：结构通过累加其在所有小波层上的表示来汇聚。这样结构的初始值更与其在多尺度金字塔中支撑的重要性成正比。

FILE: Import ROI coordinates from an existing preview.Or much easier, drag a preview selector to this button and the corresponding coordinates will be imported automatically.
文件: 从已有预览导入 ROI 坐标。更简单的做法是：把预览选择器拖到此按钮上，相应坐标会自动导入。

FILE: Adjust the scale so that this preview does not contain any structures whose contrast you want to recover. Any detail visible here will not benefit from contrast recovery.
文件: 调整尺度，使该预览中不包含任何你想恢复对比度的结构。此处可见的任何细节都不会从对比度恢复中受益。

FILE: At 1.0 (default), the transformation is fully applied. At values less than one, the effect is diminished proportionally. This parameter provides fine control over contrast recovery at the selected scale.
文件: 取 1.0（默认）时变换完全施加；取值小于 1 时效果按比例减弱。此参数可对所选尺度上的对比度恢复做精细控制。

FILE: Controls the black point clipping for the autostretch. Higher values result in more aggressive clipping of the shadows, which can help remove sky glow but may also clip faint details. The default value is 0.70.
文件: 控制自动拉伸的黑点截断。取值越高，暗部截断越激进，有助于去除天空辉光，但也可能截掉暗弱细节。默认值为 0.70。

FILE: When disabled: Uses a robust mean background estimator for the entire image. This automatic method works well for most images.Tip: Drag a preview selector onto this section to set ROI coordinates automatically.
文件: 禁用时：对整幅图像使用稳健的平均背景估计。这一自动方法对多数图像效果良好。提示：把预览选择器拖到本区域上即可自动设定 ROI 坐标。

FILE: Controls which color saturation values receive the most enhancement. Higher values target lower saturation levels (useful for faint nebular colors), while lower values affect a broader range of color saturation values.
文件: 控制哪些色彩饱和度数值获得最多增强。取值越高，目标越偏向较低的饱和度（适合暗弱的星云颜色）；取值越低，影响的饱和度范围越宽。

FILE: Main stretch parameters that control the overall tonal transformation of the image. These settings determine how the linear data is mapped to a nonlinear representation suitable for visualization and further processing.
文件: 主拉伸参数，控制图像整体的色调变换。这些设置决定线性数据如何映射为便于观察和后续处理的非线性表示。

FILE: Lower values (e.g., 8-128) protect only the finest details like stars and nebular filaments. Higher values (e.g., 512-1024) also protect larger structures like galaxy arms and extended nebulosity. The default value of 1024 pixels works well for most images.
文件: 取值较低（例如 8–128）时只保护恒星和星云细丝等最精细的细节；取值较高（例如 512–1024）时还会保护星系旋臂和弥散星云等较大结构。默认值 1024 像素对多数图像效果良好。

FILE: Sets the target mean background level after the autostretch. This parameter controls where the mean background of the image will be placed after stretching. Lower values result in darker backgrounds, higher values in brighter backgrounds. The default value is 0.15.
文件: 设定自动拉伸后的目标平均背景水平。此参数控制拉伸后图像平均背景所处的位置：取值越低背景越暗，越高背景越亮。默认值为 0.15。

FILE: Controls the overall intensity of saturation enhancement. At 0, colors remain unchanged. At 1, the maximum saturation boost is applied. Values in between provide proportionally reduced enhancement. Start with lower values and increase gradually to avoid oversaturation.
文件: 控制饱和度增强的整体强度。取 0 时颜色不变，取 1 时施加最大饱和度提升，中间取值按比例减弱。建议从小值开始逐步增大，以免过度饱和。

FILE: Enable multiscale contrast recovery. When enabled, the algorithm uses a variation of the multiscale median transform to analyze and preserve small-scale detail while applying the stretch. This helps maintain local contrast that might otherwise be lost in the stretching process.
文件: 启用多尺度对比度恢复。启用后，算法会用多尺度中值变换的一种变体，在施加拉伸的同时分析并保留小尺度细节，有助于维持那些在拉伸过程中可能丢失的局部对比度。

FILE: Controls the overall strength of the multiscale contrast recovery transformation.At 1.0 (default), the transformation is fully applied. At values less than one, the effect is diminished proportionally. This parameter provides fine control over contrast recovery at the selected scale.
文件: 控制多尺度对比度恢复变换的整体强度。取 1.0（默认）时变换完全施加；取值小于 1 时效果按比例减弱。此参数可对所选尺度上的对比度恢复做精细控制。

FILE: Enable color saturation enhancement for color images. This feature boosts color intensity while accurately preserving color balance and avoiding oversaturation artifacts. It is particularly effective for bringing out faint nebular colors and enhancing the natural hues of stars and galaxies.
文件: 为彩色图像启用色彩饱和度增强。该功能提升色彩强度，同时准确保持色彩平衡、避免过度饱和伪影。它对显现暗弱的星云颜色、强化恒星与星系的自然色调尤其有效。

FILE: When enabled, the color saturation enhancement is masked by the image lightness. Brighter areas receive more saturation enhancement, while darker areas retain their original color saturation. This helps prevent oversaturation of faint background regions while allowing stronger enhancement of brighter features.
文件: 启用后，色彩饱和度增强会被图像明度所遮蔽：较亮区域获得更多饱和度增强，较暗区域保持原有色彩饱和度。这有助于防止暗弱背景区域过度饱和，同时允许较亮特征获得更强增强。

FILE: Controls how highlights are rendered in the stretched image. Higher values compress the dynamic range, producing softer highlights with more visible detail. Lower values preserve stronger contrast in bright areas but may lose subtle highlight detail. The default value of 0.40 provides a good balance for most astronomical images.
文件: 控制拉伸后图像中高光的呈现方式。取值越高，动态范围压缩越强，高光更柔和、细节更可见；取值越低，亮区对比度保留得越强，但可能丢失细微的高光细节。默认值 0.40 对多数天文图像是良好平衡。

FILE: Analysis of gradient models can be important for testing purposes, especially in difficult cases, to know how complex gradients are being evaluated and corrected.
文件: 梯度模型分析对测试很有价值，尤其在疑难情况下，可了解复杂梯度是如何被评估和校正的。

FILE: Increase this parameter to increase the amount of dynamic range compression applied with a given set of parameters. This gives you finer control over the final result.
文件: 增大此参数可在给定参数组下增加动态范围压缩的程度，从而对最终结果做更精细的控制。

FILE: Apply a soft thresholding of transform coefficients instead of a hard thresholding. In general, soft thresholding is more accurate and less prone to artifact generation.
文件: 对变换系数采用软阈值处理，而不是硬阈值处理。一般来说软阈值更精确，也更不容易产生伪影。

FILE: Strength of the attenuation applied to thresholded transform coefficients. The default amount value of one will set to zero all coefficients below the k*sigma threshold value.
文件: 施加于阈值化变换系数的衰减强度。默认值 1 会把所有低于 k*sigma 阈值的系数置零。

FILE: The directory (or folder) where the output files are written. If this field is left blank, the output file of each target frame is written to the directory of the target frame.
文件: 输出文件的写入目录（或文件夹）。若此字段留空，各目标帧的输出文件写入该目标帧所在目录。

FILE: One of the advantages of the multiscale median transform is that the scaling sequence is arbitrary, in contrast to the wavelet transform, where only the dyadic sequence is strictly valid.
文件: 多尺度中值变换的优点之一是尺度序列可任意选取，而小波变换严格来说只有二进序列有效。

FILE: The scale factors are the same for all scales. At the 128-pixel scale, two additional iterations of the multiscale transform are applied, to prevent artifacts around high-contrast structures.
文件: 所有尺度使用相同的尺度因子。在 128 像素尺度上会额外施加两次多尺度变换迭代，以防止高对比结构周围出现伪影。

FILE: Enable or disable a multiscale layer to include or remove it, respectively, from the reconstructed image. For example, in some cases you can just disable the first layer to remove small-scale noise.
文件: 启用或禁用某个多尺度层，即可把它纳入或排除在重建图像之外。例如某些情况下仅禁用第一层就能去除小尺度噪声。

FILE: In general, dynamic range compression is mostly needed on the brightest image structures. Protecting the sky background in deep-sky images prevents visible ringing artifacts with wavelet-based transforms.
文件: 一般来说动态范围压缩主要用于最亮的图像结构。在深空图像中保护天空背景，可避免基于小波的变换产生可见的振铃伪影。

FILE: Enable or disable a layer to include or remove it, respectively, from the reconstructed image. For example, in some cases (very few, actually) you can just disable the first layer to remove small-scale noise.
文件: 启用或禁用某个层，即可把它纳入或排除在重建图像之外。例如某些情况（实际很少）下，仅禁用第一层就能去除小尺度噪声。

FILE: Apply HDRMT only to the CIE L* component (lightness) of color images.This option allows you to apply a multiscale transformation in a colorimetrically-defined color space that you can control with RGB working space parameters.
文件: 仅对彩色图像的 CIE L* 分量（明度）施加 HDRMT。此选项允许你在一个可由 RGB 工作空间参数控制的、按色度学定义的色彩空间中施加多尺度变换。

FILE: Defines the degree of attenuation applied to noise coefficients in the current layer. Noise coefficients are those below the threshold parameter (see above). An amount value of one will remove all noise coefficients completely.
文件: 定义当前层噪声系数的衰减程度。噪声系数即低于阈值参数（见上）的系数。amount 取值为 1 会把所有噪声系数完全去除。

FILE: At 1.0 (default), the HDR transform is fully applied. At values less than one, the effect is diminished proportionally. This parameter provides fine control over the dynamic range compression with the selected process parameters.
文件: 取 1.0（默认）时 HDR 变换完全施加；取值小于 1 时效果按比例减弱。此参数可结合所选进程参数对动态范围压缩做精细控制。

FILE: Linear masks can be very efficient for noise reduction of linear images with a strong correlation between signal-to-noise ratio and illumination. This condition holds for most raw astronomical images, especially for raw deep-sky images.
文件: 线性蒙版对信噪比与照度强相关的线性图像降噪非常高效。多数原始天文图像（尤其是原始深空图像）都满足这一条件。

FILE: Large-scale functions apply nonlinear mathematical functions to the residual layer of the multiscale transform. The purpose of these transformations is to control or redistribute the large-scale illumination profile in the processed image.
文件: 大尺度函数会对多尺度变换的残差层施加非线性数学函数。这类变换的目的是控制或重新分布处理后图像中的大尺度照度分布。

FILE: Increasing Pixels visualizes positive layer coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to coefficient values.Decreasing Pixels visualizes negative layer coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to coefficient absolute values.
文件: “增大像素值”用于可视化正层系数，输出像素值与系数值成正比。“减小像素值”用于可视化负层系数，输出像素值与系数绝对值成正比。

FILE: Generate a floating point image with the computed gradient model for the target image.Analysis of gradient models can be important for testing purposes, especially in difficult cases, to know how complex gradients are being evaluated and corrected.
文件: 生成一幅含目标图像所计算梯度模型的浮点图像。梯度模型分析对测试很有价值，尤其在疑难情况下，可了解复杂梯度是如何被评估和校正的。

FILE: Defines a multiplier that will be applied to all layer coefficients below the specified threshold (see the preceding parameter). The actual multiplier is one minus amount, so the default amount value of one will remove noise coefficients completely.
文件: 定义一个乘数，施加于所有低于指定阈值的层系数（见上一个参数）。实际乘数为 1 减 amount，因此默认 amount 值 1 会完全去除噪声系数。

FILE: Enabling this option usually results in a significant increase in color saturation. However, it must be used with care, as it can cause severe loss of relevant color information, especially in images with large dynamic ranges, such as HDR combinations.
文件: 启用此选项通常会使色彩饱和度显著提升。但必须谨慎使用，因为它可能造成相关色彩信息严重丢失，尤其是在动态范围很大的图像（如 HDR 合成）中。

FILE: Defines a multiplier in sigma units (the k in the k-sigma method) for noise thresholding. All transform coefficients below the k*sigma threshold will be attenuated by applying a hard or soft thresholding procedure (see the soft thresholding parameter).
文件: 以 sigma 为单位（k-sigma 方法中的 k）定义噪声阈值乘数。所有低于 k*sigma 阈值的变换系数都会通过硬阈值或软阈值处理被衰减（见软阈值参数）。

FILE: Use a lightness mask to protect dark background regions.In general, dynamic range compression is mostly needed on the brightest image structures. Protecting the sky background in deep-sky images prevents visible ringing artifacts with wavelet-based transforms.
文件: 用明度蒙版保护暗背景区域。一般来说动态范围压缩主要用于最亮的图像结构。在深空图像中保护天空背景，可避免基于小波的变换产生可见的振铃伪影。

FILE: Peaked/small scaling functions (such as linear interpolation) work better to isolate small-scale structures.Smooth/large scaling functions (such as cubic B-spline) work better to isolate larger scales.This parameter is ignored for the multiscale linear transform.
文件: 尖锐/小型尺度函数（如线性插值）更利于分离小尺度结构；平滑/大型尺度函数（如三次 B 样条）更利于分离较大的尺度。多尺度线性变换忽略此参数。

FILE: Increasing Pixels visualizes positive transform coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to the coefficient values.Decreasing Pixels visualizes negative transform coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to the absolute values of the coefficients.
文件: “增大像素值”用于可视化正的变换系数，输出像素值与系数值成正比。“减小像素值”用于可视化负的变换系数，输出像素值与系数绝对值成正比。

FILE: Defines (indirectly) an exponential factor that will be applied to boost the dynamic range compression.Increase this parameter to increase the amount of dynamic range compression applied with a given set of parameters. This gives you finer control over the final result.
文件: （间接）定义一个用于增强动态范围压缩的指数因子。增大此参数可在给定参数组下增加动态范围压缩的程度，从而对最终结果做更精细的控制。

FILE: Wavelet scaling function. This parameter is unavailable for median-based transforms.Peaked/small scaling functions (such as linear interpolation) work better to isolate small-scale structures.Smooth/large scaling functions (such as cubic B-spline) work better to isolate larger scales.
文件: 小波尺度函数。此参数对基于中值的变换不可用。尖锐/小型尺度函数（如线性插值）更利于分离小尺度结构；平滑/大型尺度函数（如三次 B 样条）更利于分离较大的尺度。

FILE: Controls the overall strength of the HDR multiscale transform.At 1.0 (default), the HDR transform is fully applied. At values less than one, the effect is diminished proportionally. This parameter provides fine control over the dynamic range compression with the selected process parameters.
文件: 控制 HDR 多尺度变换的整体强度。取 1.0（默认）时 HDR 变换完全施加；取值小于 1 时效果按比例减弱。此参数可结合所选进程参数对动态范围压缩做精细控制。

FILE: The number of edge scales: 1, 2 or 3 for half, a quarter and an eighth of the gradient scale, respectively, never smaller than 128 pixels. For example, with a gradient scale of 1024 pixels and an aggressiveness of 3, the edges are corrected at 512, 256 and 128 pixels. The default value is 2.
文件: 边缘尺度数：1、2 或 3 分别对应梯度尺度的二分之一、四分之一和八分之一，且不小于 128 像素。例如梯度尺度为 1024 像素、激进程度为 3 时，边缘分别在 512、256 和 128 像素处校正。默认值为 2。

FILE: This parameter controls the degree of deringing applied to small-scale ringing artifacts, such as those generated around stars. Try to find the smallest value that fixes ringing. Too large of an amount value will lead to overcorrection, generating bright deringing artifacts in the output image.
文件: 此参数控制对小尺度振铃伪影（例如恒星周围产生的那些）施加的去环程度。请尽量选取能消除振铃的最小值。amount 取值过大会导致过度校正，在输出图像中产生亮的去环伪影。

FILE: Generate a new image window for each deringing map image. In a deringing map, pixel values are proportional to the amount of ringing detected in the processed image.New image windows will be created for the small-scale and large-scale deringing maps, if the corresponding amount parameters are nonzero.
文件: 为每幅去环图生成一个新的图像窗口。去环图中像素值与处理后图像检测到的振铃量成正比。若对应的小尺度/大尺度去环强度参数非零，则两种去环图都会创建新图像窗口。

FILE: Use a linear mask as a local support for noise reduction of linear images.Linear masks can be very efficient for noise reduction of linear images with a strong correlation between signal-to-noise ratio and illumination. This condition holds for most raw astronomical images, especially for raw deep-sky images.
文件: 用线性蒙版作为线性图像降噪的局部支撑。线性蒙版对信噪比与照度强相关的线性图像降噪非常高效。多数原始天文图像（尤其是原始深空图像）都满足这一条件。

FILE: Wavelet scaling function for the starlet transform.Peaked/small scaling functions (such as linear interpolation) work better to isolate small-scale structures.Smooth/large scaling functions (such as cubic B-spline) work better to isolate larger scales.This parameter is ignored for the multiscale linear transform.
文件: starlet 变换的小波尺度函数。尖锐/小型尺度函数（如线性插值）更利于分离小尺度结构；平滑/大型尺度函数（如三次 B 样条）更利于分离较大的尺度。多尺度线性变换忽略此参数。

FILE: Apply HDRMT only to the HSI I component (intensity) of color images.Enabling this option usually results in a significant increase in color saturation. However, it must be used with care, as it can cause severe loss of relevant color information, especially in images with large dynamic ranges, such as HDR combinations.
文件: 仅对彩色图像的 HSI I 分量（强度）施加 HDRMT。启用此选项通常会使色彩饱和度显著提升。但必须谨慎使用，因为它可能造成相关色彩信息严重丢失，尤其是在动态范围很大的图像（如 HDR 合成）中。

FILE: The optimal scale factors are computed as with the Automatic option and replace the current values, which can then be adjusted manually. The reference image and the large-scale structures computed for the selected image are cached, so applying the process to the same image afterwards does not repeat these calculations.
文件: 最优尺度因子按“自动”选项的方式计算，并替换当前取值，之后可手动调整。参考图像以及为所选图像计算的大尺度结构会被缓存，因此随后对同一图像施加该进程时不会重复这些计算。

FILE: This parameter controls the degree of deringing applied to large-scale ringing artifacts, such as those generated around bright and large diffuse objects. Try to find the smallest value that fixes ringing. Too large of an amount value will lead to overcorrection, generating bright deringing artifacts in the output image.
文件: 此参数控制对大尺度振铃伪影（例如明亮的大面积弥散天体周围产生的那些）施加的去环程度。请尽量选取能消除振铃的最小值。amount 取值过大会导致过度校正，在输出图像中产生亮的去环伪影。

FILE: A postfix appended to the file name of each target frame to form the name of its output file. The output files are XISF files: the .xisf extension is always added. The default postfix is _mgc. The prefix and postfix cannot both be empty when the output directory is that of the target frames: a target frame is never replaced.
文件: 附加到各目标帧文件名之后、用于构成其输出文件名的后缀。输出文件为 XISF 文件，始终会加上 .xisf 扩展名。默认后缀为 _mgc。当输出目录就是目标帧所在目录时，前缀与后缀不能同时为空：目标帧永远不会被替换。

FILE: Deringing amount, small-scale structuresThis parameter controls the degree of deringing applied to small-scale ringing artifacts, such as those generated around stars. Try to find the smallest value that fixes ringing. Too large of an amount value will lead to overcorrection, generating bright deringing artifacts in the output image.
文件: 去环强度（小尺度结构）。此参数控制对小尺度振铃伪影（例如恒星周围产生的那些）施加的去环程度。请尽量选取能消除振铃的最小值。amount 取值过大会导致过度校正，在输出图像中产生亮的去环伪影。

FILE: Preview the noise reduction linear mask. This is a special control mode that you should use to evaluate how the linear mask will protect the high-signal regions of the image. Black mask pixels will block noise reduction completely, while white mask pixels will allow full noise reduction. Gray mask values define intermediate protection levels.
文件: 预览降噪线性蒙版。这是一种特殊的控制模式，用于评估线性蒙版将如何保护图像的高信号区域。蒙版为黑的像素会完全阻止降噪，为白的像素允许完全降噪，灰色取值表示中间保护程度。

FILE: MultiscaleGradientCorrection uses a cache of precomputed data to accelerate the process of testing scale factors and gradient generation parameters on the same image. By clearing this cache, memory will be released but the reference image and gradient model generation tasks will need to be redone completely the next time you execute the process.
文件: MultiscaleGradientCorrection 使用预计算数据缓存，以加速在同一图像上测试尺度因子与梯度生成参数的过程。清除此缓存可释放内存，但下次执行该进程时，参考图像与梯度模型生成任务需要完全重做。

FILE: This is a multiplier factor applied to compute the size of a Gaussian filter used to convolve the large-scale components after the multiscale decomposition. Increasing the value of this parameter tends to generate smoother gradient models. Decreasing this parameter leads to gradient models representing more large-scale edges and jump discontinuities.
文件: 这是用于计算多尺度分解后对大尺度分量做卷积的高斯滤波器尺寸的乘数。增大此参数往往生成更平滑的梯度模型；减小它则使梯度模型包含更多大尺度边缘与跳跃不连续。

FILE: Deringing amount, large-scale structuresThis parameter controls the degree of deringing applied to large-scale ringing artifacts, such as those generated around bright and large diffuse objects. Try to find the smallest value that fixes ringing. Too large of an amount value will lead to overcorrection, generating bright deringing artifacts in the output image.
文件: 去环强度（大尺度结构）。此参数控制对大尺度振铃伪影（例如明亮的大面积弥散天体周围产生的那些）施加的去环程度。请尽量选取能消除振铃的最小值。amount 取值过大会导致过度校正，在输出图像中产生亮的去环伪影。

FILE: The deringing routines have been designed to fix dark and bright artifacts generated around jump discontinuities, such as stars and edges, as a result of the Gibbs phenomenon. This happens when one or more transform layers are biased. In astronomical images, the most common artifacts are the well-known dark rings around stars and other bright, small-scale structures.
文件: 去环流程用于消除跳跃不连续处（如恒星与边缘）因吉布斯现象而产生的暗、亮伪影，其成因是一个或多个变换层被偏置。在天文图像中最常见的就是恒星和其他明亮小尺度结构周围的暗环。

FILE: Calculate optimal scale factors for a selected image.The optimal scale factors are computed as with the Automatic option and replace the current values, which can then be adjusted manually. The reference image and the large-scale structures computed for the selected image are cached, so applying the process to the same image afterwards does not repeat these calculations.
文件: 为所选图像计算最优尺度因子。最优尺度因子按“自动”选项的方式计算，并替换当前取值，之后可手动调整。参考图像以及为所选图像计算的大尺度结构会被缓存，因此随后对同一图像施加该进程时不会重复这些计算。

FILE: Deringing routines have been designed to fix dark and bright artifacts generated around jump discontinuities, such as stars and edges, as a result of the Gibbs phenomenon. These artifacts are generated mainly by wavelet-based HDR transforms. In astronomical images, the most common artifacts are the well-known dark rings around stars and other bright, small-scale structures.
文件: 去环流程用于消除跳跃不连续处（如恒星与边缘）因吉布斯现象而产生的暗、亮伪影，这些伪影主要由基于小波的 HDR 变换产生。在天文图像中最常见的就是恒星和其他明亮小尺度结构周围的暗环。

FILE: Amplification factor for linear mask generation. This parameter is just an integer factor that multiplies a working duplicate of the target image. The more amplification, the strongest protection will be achieved on high-signal regions. The appropriate value depends on the strength of the image; it usually varies between 50 and 200, but must be found using the mask preview mode.
文件: 线性蒙版生成的放大因子。此参数只是一个整数因子，乘到目标图像的工作副本上。放大越强，高信号区域获得的保护越强。合适取值取决于图像强度，通常在 50 到 200 之间，但必须借助蒙版预览模式确定。

FILE: If this option is enabled the linear mask will be inverted. For noise reduction of normal (positive) images, the linear mask should always be inverted because we want to protect (black mask) bright regions and allow more noise reduction (white mask) on low-signal areas. Disable this option if you are applying this process to an inverted image with black objects over a bright background.
文件: 启用此选项后线性蒙版会被反转。对普通（正值）图像降噪时应始终反转线性蒙版，因为我们想保护（黑色蒙版）亮区而在低信号区允许更多降噪（白色蒙版）。若把该进程用于亮背景上有黑色天体的反转图像，请禁用此选项。

FILE: The bias parameter defines a multiplicative factor applied to a whole layer. Increase the bias parameter to enhance all the structures supported by a specific layer. Note that this includes the whole layer contents, that is, both significant structures and the noise. Typically the bias can be increased at scales from 2 to 4 pixels for local contrast enhancement purposes (aka sharpening).
文件: 偏置参数定义施加于整个层的乘性因子。增大偏置 可增强该层所承载的所有结构。注意这包含该层的全部内容，既有显著结构也有噪声。通常可对 2 到 4 像素的尺度提高偏置，以实现局部对比度增强（即锐化）。

FILE: The bias parameter defines a multiplicative factor applied to a whole transform layer. Increase the bias parameter to enhance all the structures supported by a specific layer. Note that this includes the whole layer contents, that is both significant structures and noise. Typically bias can be increased at scales from 2 to 4 pixels for local contrast enhancement purposes (aka sharpening).
文件: 偏置参数定义施加于整个变换层的乘性因子。增大偏置 可增强该层所承载的所有结构。注意这包含该层的全部内容，既有显著结构也有噪声。通常可对 2 到 4 像素的尺度提高偏置，以实现局部对比度增强（即锐化）。

文件: 指令必须在任何可执行表达式之前给出，且不能与可执行表达式混用。实际含义是：指令只能出现在一组 PixelMath 表达式的最前面。

FILE: Function Call.The optional expressions expr1[, expr2[, ...]] are evaluated in sequence from left to right and passed as arguments in a call to function func. The resulting expression evaluates to the return value of func.
文件: 函数调用。可选表达式 expr1[, expr2[, ...]] 从左到右依次求值，并作为参数传入对函数 func 的调用。整个表达式求值为 func 的返回值。

FILE: Channel Selector.A channel of the specified image, whose index is c, is referenced. The channel index c must be an integer literal ≥ 0.If the specified channel does not exist in the specified image, a runtime error occurs.
文件: 通道选择器。引用指定图像中索引为 c 的通道。通道索引 c 必须是 ≥ 0 的整数字面量。若指定图像中不存在该通道，会引发运行时错误。

FILE: x constrained to the [a,b] range:Returns x if x ≥ a and x ≤ bReturns a if x < aReturns b if x > bInvariant subexpression: When each of the three arguments is either an immediate numeric value or an invariant subexpression.
文件: x 被约束在 [a,b] 范围内：若 x ≥ a 且 x ≤ b 返回 x；若 x < a 返回 a；若 x > b 返回 b。不变子表达式：当三个参数均为立即数值或不变子表达式时成立。

FILE: Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the overlay operation is defined by the following expression: 1 - (1 - 2*(a - 0.5)) * (1 - b) if a > 0.5 2*a*b otherwiseInvariant subexpression: always.
文件: 给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，叠加运算定义如下：若 a > 0.5 则为 1 - (1 - 2*(a - 0.5)) * (1 - b)，否则为 2*a*b。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the pin light operation is defined by the following expression: max( a, 2*(b - 0.5) ) if b > 0.5 min( a, 2*b ) otherwiseInvariant subexpression: always.
文件: 给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，点光运算定义如下：若 b > 0.5 则为 max( a, 2*(b - 0.5) )，否则为 min( a, 2*b )。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: Assignment / Logical OR operator.The expression expr is evaluated, its resulting value is then logically-ORed with the current value of the variable var, and the result of the logical OR (either 1 or 0) is assigned to var.
文件: 赋值/逻辑或运算符。先对表达式 expr 求值，再把该结果与变量 var 的当前值做逻辑或，并把逻辑或的结果（1 或 0）赋给 var。

FILE: Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the hard light operation is defined by the following expression: 1 - (1 - a)*(1 - 2*(b - 0.5)) if b > 0.5 2*a*b otherwiseInvariant subexpression: always.
文件: 给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，强光运算定义如下：若 b > 0.5 则为 1 - (1 - a)*(1 - 2*(b - 0.5))，否则为 2*a*b。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: Rotation of an image by the specified angle in degrees, with center of rotation located at (cx,cy) image coordinates.If no center coordinates are specified, the default center of rotation is the geometric center of the image.
文件: 把图像按指定角度（度）旋转，旋转中心位于图像坐标 (cx,cy)。若未指定中心坐标，默认旋转中心为图像的几何中心。

FILE: Assignment / Logical AND operator.The expression expr is evaluated, its resulting value is then logically-ANDed with the current value of the variable var, and the result of the logical AND (either 1 or 0) is assigned to var.
文件: 赋值/逻辑与运算符。先对表达式 expr 求值，再把该结果与变量 var 的当前值做逻辑与，并把逻辑与的结果（1 或 0）赋给 var。

FILE: Bitwise OR operator.Evaluates to the bitwise OR operation applied to both operands truncated to integer values. For each pair of corresponding bits in both operands, the result is 0 if both bits are equal to 0, or 1 otherwise.
文件: 按位或运算符。求值为把两个操作数截断为整数后的按位或运算。对两个操作数中每一对相应位，若两位都为 0 则结果为 0，否则为 1。

FILE: Bitwise AND operator.Evaluates to the bitwise AND operation applied to both operands truncated to integer values. For each pair of corresponding bits in both operands, the result is 1 if both bits are equal to 1, or 0 otherwise.
文件: 按位与运算符。求值为把两个操作数截断为整数后的按位与运算。对两个操作数中每一对相应位，若两位都为 1 则结果为 1，否则为 0。

FILE: Bitwise NOR operator.Evaluates to the bitwise NOR operation applied to both operands truncated to integer values. For each pair of corresponding bits in both operands, the result is 1 if both bits are equal to 0, or 0 otherwise.
文件: 按位或非（NOR）运算符。求值为把两个操作数截断为整数后的按位或非运算。对两个操作数中每一对相应位，若两位都为 0 则结果为 1，否则为 0。

FILE: Bitwise NAND operator.Evaluates to the bitwise NAND operation applied to both operands truncated to integer values. For each pair of corresponding bits in both operands, the result is 0 if both bits are equal to 1, or 1 otherwise.
文件: 按位与非（NAND）运算符。求值为把两个操作数截断为整数后的按位与非运算。对两个操作数中每一对相应位，若两位都为 1 则结果为 0，否则为 1。

FILE: Bitwise XOR operator.Evaluates to the bitwise XOR operation applied to both operands truncated to integer values. For each pair of corresponding bits in both operands, the result is 0 if both bits have equal values, or 1 otherwise.
文件: 按位异或运算符。求值为把两个操作数截断为整数后的按位异或运算。对两个操作数中每一对相应位，若两位取值相同则结果为 0，否则为 1。

FILE: Bitwise XNOR operator.Evaluates to the bitwise XNOR operation applied to both operands truncated to integer values. For each pair of corresponding bits in both operands, the result is 1 if both bits have equal values, or 0 otherwise.
文件: 按位同或（XNOR）运算符。求值为把两个操作数截断为整数后的按位同或运算。对两个操作数中每一对相应位，若两位取值相同则结果为 1，否则为 0。

FILE: For example, a diagonal structure of size 5 is defined as follows: x . . . x . x . x . . . x . . . x . x . x . . . xwhere existing elements are marked as 'x' and nonexisting elements are denoted as '.'.Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 例如，尺寸为 5 的对角结构元定义如下：x . . . x . x . x . . . x . . . x . x . x . . . x 其中已存在的元素标记为 'x'，不存在的元素记为 '.'。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: For example, an orthogonal structure of size 5 is defined as follows: . . x . . . . x . . x x x x x . . x . . . . x . .where existing elements are marked as 'x' and nonexisting elements are denoted as '.'.Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 例如，尺寸为 5 的正交结构元定义如下：. . x . . . . x . . x x x x x . . x . . . . x . . 其中已存在的元素标记为 'x'，不存在的元素记为 '.'。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: If t is not specified, the threshold is the midpoint between the minimum and maximum sample values of the image, (min + max)/2.For each pixel sample v, the corresponding binarized sample value v' is given by: v' = 0 if v < t v' = 1 if v ≥ t
文件: 若未指定 t，阈值取图像最小与最大采样值的中点 (min + max)/2。对每个像素采样 v，对应的二值化采样值 v' 为：若 v < t 则 v' = 0；若 v ≥ t 则 v' = 1。

FILE: Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the vivid light operation is defined by the following expression: max( 0, 1 - (1 - a)/(2*b) ) if b < 0.5 min( 1, a/(2*(1 - b)) ) otherwiseInvariant subexpression: always.
文件: 给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，亮光运算定义如下：若 b < 0.5 则为 max( 0, 1 - (1 - a)/(2*b) )，否则为 min( 1, a/(2*(1 - b)) )。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: Local variance maps are always generated as 64-bit floating point images. This ensures that no truncation or roundoff errors will degrade their ability to represent subtle intensity variations, which is especially important for linear images.
文件: 局部方差图始终生成为 64 位浮点图像。这确保不会因截断或舍入误差削弱其表达细微强度变化的能力，这对线性图像尤其重要。

FILE: Represents a pixel wise linear burn operation for the combine() generator.Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the linear burn operation is defined by the following expression: a + b - 1Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 为 combine() 生成器表示逐像素的线性加深运算。给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，线性加深运算定义如下：a + b - 1 不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: Represents a pixel wise screen operation for the combine() generator.Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the screen operation is defined by the following expression: 1 - (1 - a)*(1 - b)Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 为 combine() 生成器表示逐像素的滤色运算。给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，滤色运算定义如下：1 - (1 - a)*(1 - b) 不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: If no explicit initial value is specified, additive global variables are initialized to zero and multiplicative global variables are initialized to one. The final values of all global variables are reported on the process console after PixelMath execution.
文件: 若未显式给出初始值，加性全局变量初始化为零，乘性全局变量初始化为一。PixelMath 执行后，所有全局变量的最终值会在进程控制台上报告。

FILE: The symbol value will be either one, if the specified environment variable is currently defined for the running process with a non-empty value, or zero otherwise.Environment variable names are case-sensitive on Linux/UNIX platforms, case-insensitive on Windows.
文件: 若当前为运行进程定义了该环境变量且取值非空，符号取值为一；否则为零。环境变量名称在 Linux/UNIX 平台上区分大小写，在 Windows 上不区分。

FILE: Represents a pixel wise color dodge operation for the combine() generator.Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the color dodge operation is defined by the following expression: min( a/(1 - b), 1 )Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 为 combine() 生成器表示逐像素的颜色减淡运算。给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，颜色减淡运算定义如下：min( a/(1 - b), 1 ) 不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: Represents a pixel wise soft light operation for the combine() generator.Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the soft light operation is defined by the following expression: (1 - 2*b)*a*a + 2*a*bInvariant subexpression: always.
文件: 为 combine() 生成器表示逐像素的柔光运算。给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，柔光运算定义如下：(1 - 2*b)*a*a + 2*a*b 不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: Conditional function (or inline if function):Returns expr_true if cond evaluates to nonzero.Returns expr_false if cond evaluates to zero.Invariant subexpression: When each of the three arguments is either an immediate numeric value or an invariant subexpression.
文件: 条件函数（即内联 if 函数）：cond 求值非零时返回 expr_true；cond 求值为零时返回 expr_false。不变子表达式：当三个参数均为立即数值或不变子表达式时成立。

FILE: Represents a pixel wise color burn operation for the combine() generator.Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the color burn operation is defined by the following expression: 1 - min( (1 - a)/b, 1 )Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 为 combine() 生成器表示逐像素的颜色加深运算。给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，颜色加深运算定义如下：1 - min( (1 - a)/b, 1 ) 不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: Represents a pixel wise exclusion operation for the combine() generator.Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the exclusion operation is defined by the following expression: 0.5 - 2*(a - 0.5)*(b - 0.5)Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 为 combine() 生成器表示逐像素的排除运算。给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，排除运算定义如下：0.5 - 2*(a - 0.5)*(b - 0.5) 不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: The returned value is Sn multiplied by 1.1926 in order to make the scale estimate consistent with the standard deviation of a normal distribution.Invariant subexpression: When the first argument is an image reference with optional scalar ROI coordinates (second form).
文件: 返回值是 Sn 乘以 1.1926，以使该尺度估计与正态分布的标准差一致。不变子表达式：当第一个参数为带可选标量 ROI 坐标的图像引用时（第二种形式）。

FILE: The returned value is Qn multiplied by 2.2191 in order to make the scale estimate consistent with the standard deviation of a normal distribution.Invariant subexpression: When the first argument is an image reference with optional scalar ROI coordinates (second form).
文件: 返回值是 Qn 乘以 2.2191，以使该尺度估计与正态分布的标准差一致。不变子表达式：当第一个参数为带可选标量 ROI 坐标的图像引用时（第二种形式）。

FILE: Combination of two source operand images image1 and image2 with the specified binary operation op. Returns the result of image1 op image2, which is a dynamically generated image.See the family of op_xxx() symbolic functions for the set of available binary image operators.
文件: 用指定的二元运算 op 合成两幅源操作数图像 image1 与 image2。返回 image1 op image2 的结果，该结果为一幅动态生成的图像。可用的二元图像运算集合见 op_xxx() 系列符号函数。

FILE: The returned value is the MAD multiplied by 1.4826 in order to make the scale estimate consistent with the standard deviation of a normal distribution.Invariant subexpression: When the first argument is an image reference with optional scalar ROI coordinates (second form).
文件: 返回值是 MAD 乘以 1.4826，以使该尺度估计与正态分布的标准差一致。不变子表达式：当第一个参数为带可选标量 ROI 坐标的图像引用时（第二种形式）。

FILE: The returned value is the ADEV multiplied by 1.2533 in order to make the scale estimate consistent with the standard deviation of a normal distribution.Invariant subexpression: When the first argument is an image reference with optional scalar ROI coordinates (second form).
文件: 返回值是 ADEV 乘以 1.2533，以使该尺度估计与正态分布的标准差一致。不变子表达式：当第一个参数为带可选标量 ROI 坐标的图像引用时（第二种形式）。

FILE: Represents a pixel wise linear light operation for the combine() generator.Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the linear light operation is defined by the following expression: min( max( 0, a + 2*b - 1 ), 1 )Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 为 combine() 生成器表示逐像素的线性光运算。给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，线性光运算定义如下：min( max( 0, a + 2*b - 1 ), 1 ) 不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: For example, a star structure of size 7 is defined as follows: . . . x . . . . x . x . x . . . x x x . . x x x x x x x . . x x x . . . x . x . x . . . . x . . .where existing elements are marked as 'x' and nonexisting elements are denoted as '.'.Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 例如，尺寸为 7 的星形结构元定义如下：. . . x . . . . x . x . x . . . x x x . . x x x x x x x . . x x x . . . x . x . x . . . . x . . . 其中已存在的元素标记为 'x'，不存在的元素记为 '.'。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: This function requires a valid astrometric solution available in the specified image.Note: Use of this function can lead to poor performance when executed on large images with spline-based astrometric solutions (for distortion correction) and slow machines with few processor cores.
文件: 此函数要求指定图像具备有效的天文测量解。注意：对带基于样条的天文测量解（用于畸变校正）的大图像，在处理器核心数少的慢机器上执行此函数可能导致性能不佳。

FILE: A typical application of this function to add normal distributed noise to the target image is:$T + k*mdev( $T )*gauss()where the median absolute deviation from the median (MAD), multiplied by an optional amplitude parameter k, defines the standard deviation of additive noise adaptively.
文件: 用此函数为目标图像加入正态分布噪声的典型用法是：$T + k*mdev( $T )*gauss() 其中把相对中位数的中位绝对偏差（MAD）乘以可选的幅度参数 k，自适应地定义加性噪声的标准差。

FILE: Evaluates to the floating-point remainder of the x/y division, such that x = i×y + f, where i is an integer, f has the same sign as x, and the absolute value of f is less than the absolute value of y.If y evaluates to zero or to an insignificant value, the result is zero conventionally.
文件: 求值为 x/y 除法的浮点余数，满足 x = i×y + f，其中 i 为整数，f 与 x 同号，且 f 的绝对值小于 y 的绝对值。若 y 求值为零或无意义的值，按惯例结果为零。

FILE: Random Poisson deviate for the specified pixel sample value x, which is expected to be in DN units.A typical application of this function is:poisson( 65535*$T )/65535which will generate Poisson noise for the current pixel value in the [0,1] range, simulating a 16-bit detector with unit gain.
文件: 为指定像素采样值 x（预期以 DN 为单位）返回随机泊松偏差。此函数的典型用法是：poisson( 65535*$T )/65535 它会为当前像素值在 [0,1] 范围内生成泊松噪声，模拟单位增益的 16 位探测器。

FILE: Represents a pixel wise overlay operation for the combine() generator.Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the overlay operation is defined by the following expression: 1 - (1 - 2*(a - 0.5)) * (1 - b) if a > 0.5 2*a*b otherwiseInvariant subexpression: always.
文件: 为 combine() 生成器表示逐像素的叠加运算。给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，叠加运算定义如下：若 a > 0.5 则为 1 - (1 - 2*(a - 0.5)) * (1 - b)，否则为 2*a*b。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: For example, the standard circular structure of size 7 is defined as follows: . . x x x . . . x x x x x . x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x . x x x x x . . . x x x . .where existing elements are marked as 'x' and nonexisting elements are denoted as '.'.Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 例如，尺寸为 7 的标准圆形结构元定义如下：. . x x x . . . x x x x x . x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x . x x x x x . . . x x x . . 其中已存在的元素标记为 'x'，不存在的元素记为 '.'。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: Create an alpha channel in the output image, when the create new image option is selected. This option should be enabled when an alpha channel PixelMath expression has been defined and the process is being executed on the global context. Otherwise the alpha channel expression will be ignored.
文件: 选中“创建新图像”选项时，在输出图像中创建 alpha 通道。若已定义 alpha 通道的 PixelMath 表达式，且该进程在全局上下文中执行，则应启用此选项；否则 alpha 通道表达式会被忽略。

FILE: Represents a pixel wise pin light operation for the combine() generator.Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the pin light operation is defined by the following expression: max( a, 2*(b - 0.5) ) if b > 0.5 min( a, 2*b ) otherwiseInvariant subexpression: always.
文件: 为 combine() 生成器表示逐像素的点光运算。给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，点光运算定义如下：若 b > 0.5 则为 max( a, 2*(b - 0.5) )，否则为 min( a, 2*b )。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: The $T (or $target) metasymbol represents the target image when PixelMath is being executed in a view context.$T is illegal when PixelMath is executed as a global process, i.e. when a new image is being generated instead of replacing an existing one, since in these cases no target image exists.
文件: $T（或 $target）元符号表示视图上下文中执行 PixelMath 时的目标图像。当 PixelMath 作为全局进程执行时 $T 不合法，即生成新图像而非替换已有图像时，因为这些情况下不存在目标图像。

FILE: Represents a pixel wise hard light operation for the combine() generator.Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the hard light operation is defined by the following expression: 1 - (1 - a)*(1 - 2*(b - 0.5)) if b > 0.5 2*a*b otherwiseInvariant subexpression: always.
文件: 为 combine() 生成器表示逐像素的强光运算。给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，强光运算定义如下：若 b > 0.5 则为 1 - (1 - a)*(1 - 2*(b - 0.5))，否则为 2*a*b。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: The specified image with its pixel sample values scaled linearly to the range [a,b].For each pixel sample v, the corresponding normalized value v' is given by: v' = a + (b - a)×(v - m)/(M - m)where m and M are, respectively, the minimum and maximum pixel sample values in the image before normalization.
文件: 指定图像的像素采样值被线性缩放到 [a,b] 范围。对每个像素采样 v，对应的归一化值 v' 为：v' = a + (b - a)×(v - m)/(M - m) 其中 m 与 M 分别为归一化前图像的最小与最大像素采样值。

FILE: Modulus operator.Evaluates to the floating-point remainder of the x/y division, such that x = i×y + f, where i is an integer, f has the same sign as x, and the absolute value of f is less than the absolute value of y.If y evaluates to zero or to an insignificant value, the result is zero conventionally.
文件: 取模运算符。求值为 x/y 除法的浮点余数，满足 x = i×y + f，其中 i 为整数，f 与 x 同号，且 f 的绝对值小于 y 的绝对值。若 y 求值为零或无意义的值，按惯例结果为零。

FILE: Three-way structures lead to ranking operations where data from different spatial directions are ranked separately. When used to apply morphological operators, standard three-way structures can preserve edges better than box structures, especially when applied recursively.Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 三向结构元会导致分级运算，即来自不同空间方向的数据被分别排序。用于施加形态学算子时，标准三向结构元比盒式结构元更能保住边缘，递归施加时尤其明显。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: The expression expr is evaluated, then the current value of the variable var is divided by the evaluation result, and the remainder of the division is assigned to var.If expr evaluates to zero or to an insignificant value, var is assigned with zero conventionally.See also the modulus arithmetic operator.

FILE: Returns the minimum distance in pixels from the current coordinates to the specified rectangle given by its top-left corner coordinates (x0,y0), width and height in pixels, when the current position is interior to the rectangular region. Returns −1 if the current position is exterior to the rectangular region.
文件: 当当前位置位于矩形区域内部时，返回当前坐标到指定矩形（由左上角坐标 (x0,y0) 以及宽、高（像素）给定）的最小距离（像素）。若当前位置在该矩形区域之外，返回 −1。

FILE: Returns the maximum distance in pixels from the current coordinates to the specified rectangle given by its top-left corner coordinates (x0,y0), width and height in pixels, when the current position is interior to the rectangular region. Returns −1 if the current position is exterior to the rectangular region.
文件: 当当前位置位于矩形区域内部时，返回当前坐标到指定矩形（由左上角坐标 (x0,y0) 以及宽、高（像素）给定）的最大距离（像素）。若当前位置在该矩形区域之外，返回 −1。

FILE: Represents a pixel wise vivid light operation for the combine() generator.Given two images a and b with pixel sample values in the [0,1] range, the vivid light operation is defined by the following expression: max( 0, 1 - (1 - a)/(2*b) ) if b < 0.5 min( 1, a/(2*(1 - b)) ) otherwiseInvariant subexpression: always.
文件: 为 combine() 生成器表示逐像素的亮光运算。给定像素采样值位于 [0,1] 范围内的两幅图像 a 与 b，亮光运算定义如下：若 b < 0.5 则为 max( 0, 1 - (1 - a)/(2*b) )，否则为 min( 1, a/(2*(1 - b)) )。不变子表达式：始终成立。

FILE: The $M (or $mask) metasymbol represents the mask image currently selected for the target image, when PixelMath is being executed in a view context.$M is illegal when PixelMath is being executed as a global process, for the same reason $T is also illegal in this case: no target image exists for execution in the global context.
文件: $M（或 $mask）元符号表示视图上下文中执行 PixelMath 时目标图像当前选定的蒙版图像。当 PixelMath 作为全局进程执行时 $M 不合法，原因与此时 $T 也不合法相同：全局上下文中执行时不存在目标图像。

FILE: Assignment / Modulus operator.The expression expr is evaluated, then the current value of the variable var is divided by the evaluation result, and the remainder of the division is assigned to var.If expr evaluates to zero or to an insignificant value, var is assigned with zero conventionally.See also the modulus arithmetic operator.
文件: 赋值/取模运算符。先对表达式 expr 求值，再把变量 var 的当前值除以该结果，并把除法的余数赋给 var。若 expr 求值为零或无意义的值，按惯例把 var 赋为零。另见取模算术运算符。

FILE: The specified image with its pixel sample values binarized with respect to the threshold value t.If t is not specified, the threshold is the midpoint between the minimum and maximum sample values of the image, (min + max)/2.For each pixel sample v, the corresponding binarized sample value v' is given by: v' = 0 if v < t v' = 1 if v ≥ t
文件: 指定图像的像素采样值按阈值 t 二值化。若未指定 t，阈值取图像最小与最大采样值的中点 (min + max)/2。对每个像素采样 v，对应的二值化采样值 v' 为：若 v < t 则 v' = 0；若 v ≥ t 则 v' = 1。

FILE: x rescaled linearly from the [a,b] range to [0,1]:Returns 0 if x < a or b − a is zero or insignificant.Returns 1 if x > bReturns (x − a)/(b − a) if x ≥ a and x ≤ bIf b < a, a and b are exchanged prior to evaluation.Invariant subexpression: When each of the three arguments is either an immediate numeric value or an invariant subexpression.
文件: x 从 [a,b] 范围线性重缩放到 [0,1]：若 x < a 或 b − a 为零或无意义，返回 0；若 x > b 返回 1；若 x ≥ a 且 x ≤ b 返回 (x − a)/(b − a)。若 b < a，则在求值前交换 a 与 b。不变子表达式：当三个参数均为立即数值或不变子表达式时成立。

FILE: The expression expr is evaluated, then the current value of the variable var is divided by the evaluation result, and the result of the division is assigned to var.If expr evaluates to zero or to an insignificant value, var is assigned conventionally with the maximum representable finite 64-bit floating-point value, with the same sign as var.
文件: 先对表达式 expr 求值，再把变量 var 的当前值除以该结果，并把除法的结果赋给 var。若 expr 求值为零或无意义的值，则按惯例把 var 赋为可表示的最大有限 64 位浮点值，符号与 var 相同。

FILE: Target mask image.The $M (or $mask) metasymbol represents the mask image currently selected for the target image, when PixelMath is being executed in a view context.$M is illegal when PixelMath is being executed as a global process, for the same reason $T is also illegal in this case: no target image exists for execution in the global context.

FILE: Represents a square structuring element in a morphological transformation, such as the medfilt(), erosion() or dilation() generators.A square structure defines all of its elements. FILE: An unclipped rotation preserves the entire image without clipping any pixels. Unclipped rotations always rotate images with respect to their geometric centers. To accommodate all rotated pixels in the generated image, the unclipped rotated image can be smaller than the original one in PixelMath, except for the trivial cases of rotations by 0 and 180 degrees.
文件: 不裁剪旋转会保留整幅图像而不裁剪任何像素。不裁剪旋转始终以图像的几何中心为旋转中心。为在生成图像中容纳所有被旋转的像素，在 PixelMath 中不裁剪旋转后的图像可能小于原图，旋转 0 度与 180 度这类平凡情形除外。

FILE: Multiple symbol definitions can be specified as a comma (,) separated list. 文件: 多个符号定义可用逗号（,）分隔的列表给出。symbols 指令必须以表达式分隔符（；）结尾。指令必须在任何可执行表达式之前给出，且不能与可执行表达式混用。实际含义是：指令只能出现在一组 PixelMath 表达式的最前面。

FILE: The arguments kij are filter kernel elements specified in row-major order. The minimum kernel size is 3×3, hence at least 9 elements must be defined. For the smallest 3×3 kernel we have the following filter configuration: k11 k12 k13 k21 k22 k23 k31 k32 k33Filter kernels must be square matrices with odd dimensions, so valid kernel sizes are 3×3, 5×5, 7×7, etc.
文件: 参数 kij 为按行主序给出的滤波核元素。最小核尺寸为 3×3，因此至少需定义 9 个元素。最小的 3×3 核对应如下滤波配置：k11 k12 k13 k21 k22 k23 k31 k32 k33 滤波核必须是奇数维方阵，因此有效的核尺寸为 3×3、5×5、7×7 等。

FILE: Normal (Gaussian) random deviate with zero mean and unit standard deviation.A typical application of this function to add normal distributed noise to the target image is:$T + k*mdev( $T )*gauss()where the median absolute deviation from the median (MAD), multiplied by an optional amplitude parameter k, defines the standard deviation of additive noise adaptively.
文件: 均值零、单位标准差的正态（高斯）随机偏差。用此函数为目标图像加入正态分布噪声的典型用法是：$T + k*mdev( $T )*gauss() 其中把相对中位数的中位绝对偏差（MAD）乘以可选的幅度参数 k，自适应地定义加性噪声的标准差。

The generated image will be in 64-bit floating point format.Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 会生成这样一幅图像：每个像素等于 y/x 的反正切（弧度），取值范围为 [−π,+π]，其中 y 与 x 分别为 Y 图像与 X 图像中对应的像素。各参数的符号用于确定结果所处的象限。生成的图像将为 64 位浮点格式。不变子表达式：始终成立。

文件: 块注释。注释会被 PixelMath 编译器忽略。它们可用于为 PixelMath 源代码作说明，提供关于表达式用途及其实现的可读信息。块注释由 '/*' 与 '*/' 两个记号及其间的任意文本构成。与行注释不同，块注释可以跨多行文本。

FILE: Represents a orthogonal structuring element in a morphological transformation, such as the medfilt(), erosion() or dilation() generators.For example, an orthogonal structure of size 5 is defined as follows: . . x . . . . x . . x x x x x . . x . . . . x . .where existing elements are marked as 'x' and nonexisting elements are denoted as '.'.Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 表示形态学变换（如 medfilt()、erosion() 或 dilation() 生成器）中的正交结构元。例如尺寸为 5 的正交结构元定义如下：. . x . . . . x . . x x x x x . . x . . . . x . . 其中已存在的元素标记为 'x'，不存在的元素记为 '.'。不变子表达式：始终成立。

文件: 赋值/除法运算符。先对表达式 expr 求值，再把变量 var 的当前值除以该结果，并把除法的结果赋给 var。若 expr 求值为零或无意义的值，则按惯例把 var 赋为可表示的最大有限 64 位浮点值，符号与 var 相同。

FILE: If this option is selected, PixelMath will use 64-bit floating point working images to store the results of the expressions before rescaling or truncation and conversion to the output sample format.When this option is disabled, PixelMath uses 32-bit floating point working images.Expressions are always evaluated in 64-bit floating point arithmetic, irrespective of this option.
文件: 若选中此选项，PixelMath 会使用 64 位浮点工作图像，在重新缩放或截断并转换为输出采样格式之前存储表达式结果。禁用此选项时，PixelMath 使用 32 位浮点工作图像。无论此选项如何，表达式总按 64 位浮点运算求值。

FILE: Line comment.Comments are ignored by the PixelMath compiler. They can be used to document PixelMath source code, providing human-readable information on the purpose of a PixelMath expression and its implementation.A line comment consists of the token '//' and all the subsequent text up to either the end of the current line, or to the end of the source code, whichever happens first.
文件: 行注释。注释会被 PixelMath 编译器忽略。它们可用于为 PixelMath 源代码作说明，提供关于表达式用途及其实现的可读信息。行注释由记号 '//' 以及其后的全部文本组成，直到当前行末尾或源代码末尾，以先到者为准。

FILE: You can disable both rescaling and truncation by creating a PixelMath process icon and editing its instance source code. If you set both 'rescale' and 'truncate' instance properties to false, the resulting image will be left intact upon PixelMath execution termination.Warning: Platform stability is not guaranteed if out-of-range pixel sample values propagate after process execution.
文件: 你可以通过创建 PixelMath 进程图标并编辑其实例源代码来同时关闭重新缩放与截断。若把 'rescale' 与 'truncate' 两个实例属性都设为 false，PixelMath 执行结束时结果图像将保持原样。警告：若越界像素采样值在进程执行后传播开来，不保证平台稳定。

When used to apply morphological operators, standard three-way structures can preserve edges better than box structures, especially when applied recursively.Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 其中已存在的元素标记为 'x'，不存在的元素记为 '.'。三向结构元会导致分级运算，即来自不同空间方向的数据被分别排序。用于施加形态学算子时，标准三向结构元比盒式结构元更能保住边缘，递归施加时尤其明显。不变子表达式：始终成立。

The pragma directive must end with an expression separator (;).Directives must be specified before any executable expression and cannot be mixed with executable expressions.
