文件: no-alpha 关闭 alpha 通道选项。多个参数可用逗号（,）分隔的列表给出。pragma 指令必须以表达式分隔符（；）结尾。指令必须在任何可执行表达式之前给出，且不能与可执行表达式混用。实际含义是：指令只能出现在一组 PixelMath 表达式的最前面。

FILE: Do not flip the output image. If you disable this option, the flip operation specified by the camera (0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees) will be applied to the output image.
文件: 不对输出图像做翻转。若禁用此选项，将按相机指定的翻转（0、90、180 或 270 度）施加到输出图像上。

FILE: This option creates an RGB color image from the CFA matrix as is. No interpolation is done and each pixel is either red, green or blue, as defined by the CFA pattern.
文件: 此选项按 CFA 矩阵原样生成 RGB 彩色图像。不做任何插值，每个像素按 CFA 排列定义为红、绿或蓝。

FILE: This option creates a grayscale image from the CFA matrix as is. No interpolation is done and the output is a monochrome image reproducing the CFA pattern, as stored in the device.
文件: 此选项按 CFA 矩阵原样生成灰度图像。不做任何插值，输出是重现设备中存储的 CFA 排列的单色图像。

FILE: When this option is enabled, highlights will be left unclipped resulting in various shades of pink. With this option disabled, highlights will be clipped automatically to solid white.
文件: 启用此选项时，高光不做截断，会呈现各种深浅的粉色。禁用此选项时，高光被自动截断为纯白。

FILE: A parameter value of zero will disable FBDD noise reduction. A value of one will apply the algorithm to the raw image. A value of two will apply an additional noise reduction step to the chroma components.
文件: 参数取零即关闭 FBDD 降噪；取一即对原始图像施加该算法；取二还会对色度分量施加一步额外降噪。

FILE: This option generates a demosaiced RGB color image with half the dimensions of the original raw frame. It is the fastest option available (twice as fast as bilinear) and is useful to load quick image previews.
文件: 此选项生成去马赛克的 RGB 彩色图像，尺寸为原始帧的一半。它是最快的选项（比双线性快一倍），适合快速加载图像预览。

FILE: When this option is enabled, no black point correction is applied to raw images to remove darkness level pedestals. This option must be enabled to load all raw images referred to a fixed zero black point value.
文件: 启用此选项时，不对原始图像施加黑点校正以去除暗电平基座。加载所有以固定零黑点为基准的原始图像时必须启用此选项。

FILE: Apply a wavelet-based noise reduction. The optimal noise threshold depends on the camera and the ISO speed used, but should normally be somewhere between 100 and 1000.Set this parameter to zero to disable noise reduction.
文件: 施加基于小波的降噪。最优噪声阈值取决于相机与所用 ISO，但通常应在 100 到 1000 之间。将参数设为零即关闭降噪。

FILE: This option uses the Bayer matrix to create one super-pixel from each group of four pixels (for example, RGGB) without interpolation. The dimensions of the resulting image are thus divided by two.This option is ignored for frames acquired with X-Trans sensors.
文件: 此选项用 Bayer 矩阵把每四个像素一组（例如 RGGB）合成一个超级像素，不做插值，因此结果图像的尺寸减半。对 X-Trans 传感器采集的帧，此选项被忽略。

FILE: Do not crop unused areas of raw frames. If you enable this option, the dimensions of the output image will be the width and height of the whole raw frame stored in the device, including unused margins. This option is always disabled by default, and can only be applied when no interpolation is selected. When this option is enabled, no white balancing can be applied.
文件: 不裁剪原始帧中未使用的区域。若启用此选项，输出图像的尺寸将是设备中存储的整个原始帧的宽高，包含未使用的边距。此选项默认始终禁用，且只有未选择插值时才可应用。启用此选项时无法施加白平衡。

FILE: If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the SplitCFA process will fail.
文件: 若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则 SplitCFA 进程会失败。

FILE: If this option is selected, SplitCFA will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.Enable this option at your own risk.
文件: 选中此选项后，SplitCFA 会覆盖与生成的输出文件同名的已有文件。这很危险，被覆盖文件的原始内容将永久丢失。启用此选项风险自负。

FILE: This is the directory (or folder) where all output files will be written.If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the SplitCFA process will fail.
文件: 这是所有输出文件的写入目录（或文件夹）。若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自目标文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则 SplitCFA 进程会失败。

FILE: If checked, SplitCFA will create a new directory tree structure to replicate the selected input folders. All subfolders will be created under the output directory, and output files will populate them at the same relative locations as their input counterparts.If unchecked, SplitCFA will write all output files on a single dirrectory.
文件: 若勾选，SplitCFA 会新建一套目录树来复刻所选的输入文件夹：所有子文件夹都在输出目录下创建，输出文件会填入与其输入对应项相同的相对位置。若不勾选，SplitCFA 会把所有输出文件写在同一个目录中。

FILE: Changes to this option will come into play the next time you associate .xdrz and/or .xnml files with input subframes. Existing file associations are not affected.
文件: 对此选项的改动将在你下次为输入子帧关联 .xdrz 和/或 .xnml 文件时生效。已有的文件关联不受影响。

FILE: Remove all local normalization data files currently associated with input subframes.This removes just file associations, not the actual local normalization data files.
文件: 移除当前与输入子帧关联的全部局部归一化数据文件。此操作只移除文件关联，不删除实际的局部归一化数据文件。

FILE: Each property (excluding Index) also has a Sigma version, e.g. PSFSignalSigma, where the value is represented in sigma units of the mean absolute deviation from the median.
文件: 每个属性（Index 除外）还有一个 Sigma 版本，例如 PSFSignalSigma，其取值以相对中位数的平均绝对偏差的 sigma 单位表示。

FILE: Local normalization data files carry the .xnml suffix. Normally you should select .xnml files generated by the LocalNormalization tool for the same files that you are measuring.
文件: 局部归一化数据文件使用 .xnml 后缀。通常应选择 LocalNormalization 工具为你正在测量的这批文件所生成的 .xnml 文件。

FILE: The PSF can be either a Gaussian or a Moffat function with a prescribed shape parameter.The default option is a Moffat PSF with beta=4, which is fast and quite accurate in most cases.
文件: PSF 可以是高斯函数，也可以是带指定形状参数的 Moffat 函数。默认选项是 beta=4 的 Moffat PSF，速度快，多数情况下相当准确。

FILE: This parameter and the value of the FITS keyword DATE-OBS (if available) are used to identify sequences of subframe observations that occurred during the same night for data presentation purposes.
文件: 此参数与 FITS 关键字 DATE-OBS 的值（若存在）用于识别同一夜内发生的子帧观测序列，以便呈现数据。

FILE: When this parameter imposes a limit on the number of PSF fits, the subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.
文件: 当此参数对 PSF 拟合数量施加限制时，参与测量的恒星子集总是从检测到的恒星序列开头取起，该序列按亮度降序排列。

FILE: Enable this option to fit circular point spread functions. Disable it to fit elliptical functions.Circular functions can provide more robust and useful results in cases of strong undersampling or high noise levels.
文件: 启用此选项以拟合圆形点扩散函数，禁用则拟合椭圆函数。在严重欠采样或高噪声的情况下，圆形函数能给出更稳健、更有用的结果。

FILE: If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding subframe files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the output process will fail.
文件: 若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自子帧文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则输出进程会失败。

FILE: Output Subframes: Uses Approval and Weighting information to output subframes.Star Detection Preview: Outputs a Structure Map from the Star Detector for the first subframe. Useful for tweaking Star Detector parameters.
文件: 输出子帧：使用通过状态与加权信息输出子帧。恒星检测预览：为第一个子帧输出恒星检测器的结构图，便于调整恒星检测器参数。

FILE: Associate existing drizzle data files with input subframes.Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz suffix. Normally you should select .xdrz files generated by the StarAlignment tool for the same files that you are measuring.
文件: 将已有的 drizzle 数据文件与输入子帧关联。drizzle 数据文件使用 .xdrz 后缀。通常应选择 StarAlignment 工具为你正在测量的这批文件所生成的 .xdrz 文件。

FILE: Associate existing local normalization data files with input subframes.Local normalization data files carry the .xnml suffix. Normally you should select .xnml files generated by the LocalNormalization tool for the same files that you are measuring.
文件: 将已有的局部归一化数据文件与输入子帧关联。局部归一化数据文件使用 .xnml 后缀。通常应选择 LocalNormalization 工具为你正在测量的这批文件所生成的 .xnml 文件。

FILE: If this option is selected, SubframeSelector will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.Warning: Enable this option at your own risk.
文件: 选中此选项后，SubframeSelector 会覆盖与生成的输出文件同名的已有文件。这很危险，被覆盖文件的原始内容将永久丢失。警告：启用此选项风险自负。

FILE: Enable this option to skip measuring subframes that have already been measured and are in the file cache. Each time a subframe is measured, its file cache entry is created or overwritten.When changes to process parameters affect measurements, the file cache will not use older items.
文件: 启用此选项可跳过对已测量过、且已在文件缓存中的子帧的测量。每次测量子帧时都会创建或覆盖其文件缓存条目。当进程参数的改动影响测量结果时，文件缓存不会使用旧条目。

FILE: This is the directory (or folder) where all output files will be written.If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding subframe files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the output process will fail.
文件: 这是所有输出文件的写入目录（或文件夹）。若此字段留空，输出文件将写入各自子帧文件所在的目录。此时请确认源目录可写，否则输出进程会失败。

FILE: This parameter specifies the type of point spread function (PSF) used to fit star image models numerically.The PSF can be either a Gaussian or a Moffat function with a prescribed shape parameter.The default option is a Moffat PSF with beta=4, which is fast and quite accurate in most cases.
文件: 此参数指定用于数值拟合恒星像模型的点扩散函数（PSF）类型。PSF 可以是高斯函数，也可以是带指定形状参数的 Moffat 函数。默认选项是 beta=4 的 Moffat PSF，速度快，多数情况下相当准确。

FILE: Each property (excluding Index) also has a Median, Min, and Max version, e.g. FWHMMin, which are computed across all subframes.Each property (excluding Index) also has a Sigma version, e.g. PSFSignalSigma, where the value is represented in sigma units of the mean absolute deviation from the median.
文件: 每个属性（Index 除外）还有一个 Median、Min 与 Max 版本，例如 FWHMMin，它们在所有子帧上计算。每个属性（Index 除外）还有一个 Sigma 版本，例如 PSFSignalSigma，其取值以相对中位数的平均绝对偏差的 sigma 单位表示。

FILE: Be aware that noise reduction will modify star profiles and hence the way star positions are calculated, resulting in a less accurate PSF fitting. Under extreme low-SNR conditions, however, this is probably better than working with the actual data anyway.To disable noise reduction, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 请注意降噪会改变恒星轮廓，从而影响恒星位置的计算方式，导致 PSF 拟合精度下降。不过在信噪比极低的条件下，这样做通常仍比直接用原始数据要好。将参数设为零即关闭降噪。

FILE: Measure Subframes: Measures subframe parameters and displays them for Approval and Weighting.Output Subframes: Uses Approval and Weighting information to output subframes.Star Detection Preview: Outputs a Structure Map from the Star Detector for the first subframe. Useful for tweaking Star Detector parameters.
文件: 测量子帧：测量子帧参数并显示出来，供通过状态与加权使用。输出子帧：使用通过状态与加权信息输出子帧。恒星检测预览：为第一个子帧输出恒星检测器的结构图，便于调整恒星检测器参数。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels will be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can lead to wrong PSF parameters.To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 这是恒星检测器在结构检测阶段之前执行的中值滤波半径（像素）。中值滤波对去除热像素非常有效。热像素会被识别为假恒星，数量较多时会导致 PSF 参数错误。将参数设为零即关闭热像素去除。

FILE: Default FITS keyword is the default mode. When this mode is selected, SubframeSelector will retrieve pedestal values from 'PEDESTAL' FITS keywords, when they are present in the input images.Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword to retrieve pedestal values, when the specified keyword is present in the input images.
文件: “默认 FITS 关键字”是默认模式。选择此模式时，SubframeSelector 会在输入图像含 PEDESTAL FITS 关键字时从中读取基座值。“自定义 FITS 关键字”允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字的名称，用于在输入图像含该关键字时读取基座值。

FILE: Size of the hot pixel removal filter.This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels will be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can lead to wrong PSF parameters.To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 热像素去除滤波器尺寸。这是恒星检测器在结构检测阶段之前执行的中值滤波半径（像素）。中值滤波对去除热像素非常有效。热像素会被识别为假恒星，数量较多时会导致 PSF 参数错误。将参数设为零即关闭热像素去除。

FILE: Local support is a deep-sky feature: both mask modes are defined relative to a sky background, so the section is disabled when the Deep-Sky Image section is disabled.
文件: 局部支撑是深空图像专用功能：两种蒙版模式都相对天空背景定义，因此当“深空图像”一节被禁用时，本节也随之禁用。

FILE: This option assumes a deep-sky image: structure finer than the PSF is meaningful in planetary, lunar and daylight images, so it is not applied when the Deep-Sky Image section is disabled.
文件: 此选项假定是深空图像：比 PSF 更细的结构在行星、月面和日光图像中是有意义的，因此当“深空图像”一节被禁用时它不会被施加。

FILE: Convergence tolerance: the iterations stop when the change of the solution per iteration, in units of the noise, falls below this value. Smaller values need more iterations and yield more accurate solutions.
文件: 收敛容差：当每次迭代解的相对变化（以噪声为单位）低于此值时迭代停止。取值越小需要越多迭代，解也更精确。

FILE: Fraction of the noise reduction applied to the image: the result is a mix of the denoised and the original images, computed in the original domain. Values smaller than one preserve part of the original noise while keeping the structure of the noise-reduced image.
文件: 施加于图像的降噪比例：结果是降噪图像与原图在原域中混合而成。取值小于一时保留部分原始噪声，同时保持降噪图像的结构。

FILE: Significance mode: width of the logarithmic ramp over which the protection grows from none, at the threshold, to complete, in the normalized [0,1] range: 0 completes the protection at twice the threshold, nearly a hard selection; 0.5 at 100 times; 1 at 5000 times, the softest, most graded mask.
文件: 显著性模式：对数过渡带的宽度，保护强度在该带内从阈值处的无保护增长到完全保护，范围按归一化的 [0,1] 计：取 0 时在两倍阈值处即达完全保护，近乎硬选择；取 0.5 时为 100 倍；取 1 时为 5000 倍，最柔和、过渡最平滑的蒙版。

FILE: The second scale removes the fine mottle left by the full-resolution pass and is safe on any image. Deeper scales are recommended for images with large-scale noise, typical of one-shot color and DSLR data; on images without it they can smooth real structure of the same size. Each additional scale costs about a quarter of the previous one.
文件: 第二尺度用于去除全分辨率那一遍留下的细密斑驳，对任何图像都安全。对大尺度噪声明显的图像（典型如单次彩色与单反数据）建议用更深的尺度；若图像没有这类噪声，更深的尺度可能把同样尺寸的真实结构抹平。每增加一个尺度，开销约为上一个的四分之一。

FILE: Strength of the chrominance noise reduction relative to the luminance. Color images are processed as one coupled luminance/chrominance problem, so color and brightness edges remain aligned. With the default value of 0.5, color noise is reduced more strongly than luminance noise; zero leaves the chrominance without additional smoothing. Ignored for grayscale images.
文件: 色度降噪相对亮度降噪的强度。彩色图像作为一个亮度/色度耦合问题处理，因此颜色边缘与亮度边缘保持对齐。默认值 0.5 时色度噪声比亮度噪声压制得更强；取零则色度不做额外平滑。灰度图像忽略此参数。

FILE: Significance mode: standard deviation in pixels of the Gaussian smoothing applied to the luminance before its excess over the background is measured. The threshold is a significance level of this measurement, so it adapts to the scale: larger values ignore structures smaller than the scale and give a smoother mask; the default of 2 protects small-scale structures, and 1 the smallest.
文件: 显著性模式：在测量超出背景的量之前，对亮度施加的高斯平滑的标准差（像素）。阈值是该测量的显著性水平，因此会随尺度自适应：取值越大越忽略小于该尺度的结构，蒙版越平滑；默认值 2 保护小尺度结构，取 1 时保护最细小的结构。

FILE: Balance between the first and second order terms of the total generalized variation. The default (0.5) corresponds to the classic TGVDenoise default ratio of 2: flat regions with sharp transitions, which keeps faint structure and stars visible. Smaller values favor smooth gradients, with a softer look and weaker noise removal at the same strength; larger values approach plain total variation.
文件: 总广义变分一阶项与二阶项之间的平衡。默认值 0.5 对应经典 TGVDenoise 的默认比例 2：平坦区域加锐利过渡，可让暗弱结构与恒星保持可见。取值更小偏向平滑梯度，观感更柔和但在同等强度下降噪更弱；取值更大则趋近普通全变分。

FILE: Write XMP metadata (PCL:XMP property) and text tags (PCL:TIFF:<tag> properties). The image description, copyright and software description below are always written.
文件: 写出 XMP 元数据（PCL:XMP 属性）与文本标签（PCL:TIFF:<tag> 属性）。下方的图像说明、版权与软件说明始终会写出。

FILE: Write a BigTIFF file. BigTIFF uses 64-bit file offsets, which removes the 4 GiB size limit of the classic TIFF format, but some applications cannot read BigTIFF files.When this option is disabled, a BigTIFF file is still written if the image is too large for the classic TIFF format.
文件: 写出 BigTIFF 文件。BigTIFF 使用 64 位文件偏移，取消了经典 TIFF 格式 4 GiB 的大小限制，但有些程序无法读取 BigTIFF 文件。禁用此选项时，若图像对经典 TIFF 格式而言过大，仍会写出 BigTIFF 文件。

FILE: This parameter specifies how to proceed when pixel values in a read TIFF image exceed the default input range.** Important ** If the 'Ignore' option is selected for 'Action' (see below), this option will be ignored (not applied). Please read the tooltip information provided for the 'Action' combo box below.
文件: 此参数指定读入的 TIFF 图像像素值超出默认输入范围时如何处理。** 重要 ** 若“操作”选择了“忽略”选项（见下），则此选项会被忽略（不生效）。请阅读下方“操作”组合框的提示信息。

FILE: Please specify a range of values to correctly interpret existing pixel values in this image. The lower and upper range bounds below correspond to the limits of the available dynamic range in the context of this TIFF image. PixInsight will use these limits to scale pixel values to the normalized [0,1] range, where zero represents black and one represents white.
文件: 请指定一个数值范围，以正确解释该图像中已有的像素值。下方的范围上下界对应此 TIFF 图像可用的动态范围极限。PixInsight 会用这两个极限把像素值缩放到归一化的 [0,1] 范围，其中零表示黑、一表示白。

FILE: Near-lossless preprocessing for lossless compression: 0 = maximum preprocessing, 100 = disabled. Values smaller than 100 modify pixel values slightly to improve compression. The default value is 100.
文件: 无损压缩的近似无损预处理：0 表示最大预处理，100 表示关闭。取值小于 100 时会轻微改动像素值以提升压缩率。默认值为 100。

FILE: For lossy compression, the compression quality: higher values give better quality and larger files.For lossless compression, the compression effort: higher values give smaller files at the cost of slower compression.The default value is 75.
文件: 有损压缩时该项为压缩质量：取值越高，质量越好、文件越大。无损压缩时该项为压缩强度：取值越高文件越小，但压缩更慢。默认值为 75。

FILE: Import FITS header keywords from XISF files as view properties.FITS header keywords are imported as Boolean, IsoString or Float64 properties with the 'FITS:' prefix.
文件: 从 XISF 文件导入 FITS 头关键字作为视图属性。FITS 头关键字会被导入为带 'FITS:' 前缀的 Boolean、IsoString 或 Float64 属性。

FILE: Format conformance warnings are never generated when warning messages are disabled (no-warnings format hint), or at the zero verbosity level. This option is enabled by default.
文件: 当警告信息被禁用（no-warnings 格式提示）或详细级别为零时，不会生成格式一致性警告。此选项默认启用。

FILE: The default value is 3072 bytes. This is coherent with the default block alignment size of 4096 bytes, since base64 encoding requires 4/3 of the original data size (4096 = 3072*4/3).
文件: 默认值为 3072 字节。这与默认的 4096 字节块对齐尺寸相协调，因为 base64 编码需要原始数据大小的 4/3（4096 = 3072*4/3）。

FILE: When this option is disabled, nonconforming data are read and written unchanged, and the generated XISF files may not conform to the XISF specification. This option is enabled by default.
文件: 禁用此选项时，不符合规范的数据会被原样读写，生成的 XISF 文件可能不符合 XISF 规范。此选项默认启用。

FILE: The XISF format allows serialization of FITS header keywords for compatibility with data stored as FITS files and tools that depend on FITS metadata. You normally should leave this option enabled.
文件: XISF 格式允许序列化 FITS 头关键字，以兼容以 FITS 文件存储的数据以及依赖 FITS 元数据的工具。通常应保持此选项启用。

FILE: For normal operation, this option should always be disabled. Beware that enabling this option may cause problems if some tools in your workflow depend on the presence of specific FITS header keywords in your images.
文件: 正常使用时此选项应始终禁用。请注意，若你的工作流程中有工具依赖图像中特定 FITS 头关键字的存在，启用此选项可能带来问题。

FILE: Store existing FITS keywords in XISF files.The XISF format allows serialization of FITS header keywords for compatibility with data stored as FITS files and tools that depend on FITS metadata. You normally should leave this option enabled.
文件: 把已有的 FITS 关键字存入 XISF 文件。XISF 格式允许序列化 FITS 头关键字，以兼容以 FITS 文件存储的数据以及依赖 FITS 元数据的工具。通常应保持此选项启用。

FILE: You can use the compression level parameter to tune compression speed versus compression ratio, or leave the auto option checked to select the best tradeoff setting for each compression codec automatically. See also the byte shuffling option.
文件: 可用压缩级别参数在压缩速度与压缩比之间权衡，也可以保持“自动”选项勾选，让每种压缩编解码器自动选取最佳折中设置。另见字节重排选项。

FILE: Do not load FITS keywords from XISF files.For normal operation, this option should always be disabled. Beware that enabling this option may cause problems if some tools in your workflow depend on the presence of specific FITS header keywords in your images.
文件: 不从 XISF 文件加载 FITS 关键字。正常使用时此选项应始终禁用。请注意，若你的工作流程中有工具依赖图像中特定 FITS 头关键字的存在，启用此选项可能带来问题。

FILE: Generate warning messages for format conformance issues, whether they have been fixed or not.Format conformance warnings are never generated when warning messages are disabled (no-warnings format hint), or at the zero verbosity level. This option is enabled by default.
文件: 对格式一致性问题生成警告信息，无论是否已被修正。当警告信息被禁用（no-warnings 格式提示）或详细级别为零时，不会生成格式一致性警告。此选项默认启用。

FILE: If properly configured, block alignment can improve read performance at the expense of some wasted disk space. The default value is 4096 bytes. Set a block size of one byte to disable the XISF block alignment feature.Block alignment is automatically disabled for compressed files.
文件: 若配置得当，块对齐可在浪费部分磁盘空间的前提下提升读取性能。默认值为 4096 字节。把块大小设为 1 字节即关闭 XISF 块对齐功能。压缩文件会自动关闭块对齐。

FILE: Maximum size in bytes of a data block stored as inline XML contents. Inline data blocks are encoded as base64.The default value is 3072 bytes. This is coherent with the default block alignment size of 4096 bytes, since base64 encoding requires 4/3 of the original data size (4096 = 3072*4/3).
文件: 以 inline XML 内容存储的数据块的最大字节数。内联数据块以 base64 编码。默认值为 3072 字节，这与默认的 4096 字节块对齐尺寸相协调，因为 base64 编码需要原始数据大小的 4/3（4096 = 3072*4/3）。

FILE: Compression level. Lower values provide faster compression, while higher values give better compression ratios at the expense of more computation time. If this parameter is set to zero, the XISF module will automatically select a good compromise between speed and compression efficiency for the selected compression codec.
文件: 压缩级别。取值越低压缩越快，取值越高压缩比更好但计算时间更长。若此参数设为零，XISF 模块会为所选压缩编解码器自动选取速度与压缩效率之间的良好折中。

FILE: This implementation supports the SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA3-256 and SHA3-512 algorithms. These algorithms compute checksums of 20, 32, 64, 32 and 64 bytes, respectively. SHA-1 is the recommended general-purpose algorithm, and the one supported by all XISF decoders that verify checksums.Checksums are verified when data blocks are accessed, providing data integrity protection.
文件: 本实现支持 SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512、SHA3-256 与 SHA3-512 算法，它们分别计算 20、32、64、32 与 64 字节的校验和。SHA-1 是推荐的通用水准算法，也是所有验证校验和的 XISF 解码器都支持的算法。访问数据块时会验证校验和，从而提供数据完整性保护。

FILE: Zstandard (or "zstd") is a fast lossless compression algorithm targeting real-time compression at zlib-level and better compression ratios.You can use the compression level parameter to tune compression speed versus compression ratio, or leave the auto option checked to select the best tradeoff setting for each compression codec automatically. See also the byte shuffling option.
文件: Zstandard（或称 "zstd"）是一种快速无损压缩算法，目标是在 zlib 级别的压缩比上实现更好的实时压缩效果。可用压缩级别参数在压缩速度与压缩比之间权衡，也可以保持“自动”选项勾选，让每种压缩编解码器自动选取最佳折中设置。另见字节重排选项。

FILE: Integrates images of different exposures into a combined image using a gradient domain method. Useful for creating HDR images.(c) 2011 Georg Viehoever, published under LGPL 2.1. With important contributions in terms of tests, test data, code and ideas by Carlos Milovic, Harry Page and Alejandro Tombolini.
文件: 用梯度域方法把不同曝光的图像合成为一幅组合图像，适合创建 HDR 图像。(c) 2011 Georg Viehoever, 依 LGPL 2.1 发布。 在测试、测试数据、代码与思路方面有重要贡献的有 Carlos Milovic、Harry Page 与 Alejandro Tombolini。

FILE: Merges together previously aligned images, usually successfully hiding any seams.(c) 2011 Georg Viehoever, published under LGPL 2.1. With important contributions in terms of tests, test data, code and ideas by Juan Conejero, Carlos Milovic, Harry Page, David Raphael, Geert Vanhauwaert, Zbynek Vrastil, and others.
文件: 把此前已配准的图像拼接在一起，通常能有效掩盖接缝。(c) 2011 Georg Viehoever, 依 LGPL 2.1 发布。 在测试、测试数据、代码与思路方面有重要贡献的有 Juan Conejero、Carlos Milovic、Harry Page、David Raphael、Geert Vanhauwaert、Zbynek Vrastil 等人。

FILE: CSV will generate standard comma-separated files (CSV format).Tabular formats can be selected to write coordinates either as scalars in degrees, or using compound angular representations where right ascension is represented as separate hours, minutes and seconds, and declination as degrees, arcminutes and arcseconds.In all cases output text files can contain optional headers, which you can control with the Text headers option below.
文件: CSV 会生成标准的逗号分隔文件（CSV 格式）。选择表格式格式时，坐标既可以写成以度为单位的标量，也可以使用复合角度表示法：赤经拆分为时、分、秒，赤纬拆分为度、角分、角秒。无论哪种情况，输出文本文件都可以包含可选的文件头，由下方的「文本头」选项控制。

FILE: You can write an explicit declination coordinate as a space-separated list of degrees, arcminutes and arcseconds. The arcminutes and arcseconds items are optional, and you can specify a fractional part for the last item. A plus or minus sign character is optional before the first degrees item, and obviously necessary for Southern declinations. Alternatively, you can search for object coordinates online by clicking the Search Coordinates button.
文件: 你可以把赤纬坐标显式写成由度、角分、角秒组成的空格分隔列表。角分与角秒两项为可选项，并且可以为最后一项指定小数部分。第一个度数值前可加正号或负号，对南天赤纬则必须加。另一种方式是按「搜索坐标」按钮在线查询目标坐标。

FILE: When enabled, the search operation will generate an output binary file including available data for all sources fulfilling the specified search criteria.Note that enabling this option will cause the process to ignore the state of the Generate text output parameter. In other words, generation of output binary files always takes precedence and implicitly disables generation of text files. See the process documentation for information on the format used by APASS output binary files.
文件: 启用后，搜索操作会生成一个输出二进制文件，其中包含满足指定搜索条件的全部源的可用数据。注意启用此选项会使进程忽略「生成文本输出」参数的状态。换言之，生成输出二进制文件总是优先，并隐含地禁用文本文件生成。APASS 输出二进制文件所用的格式请参阅进程文档。

FILE: ABE uses a linear least squares fitting procedure to compute a set of 2-D polynomials that interpolate the background model. Higher degrees may be necessary to reproduce local background variations, especially in presence of wildly varying sky gradients, but they can also lead to oscillations. In general, the default value (4th degree) is appropriate in most cases. If necessary, this parameter must be adjusted by careful trial-error work.
文件: ABE 使用线性最小二乘拟合程序计算一组二维多项式，用来插值背景模型。要重现局部背景变化可能需要更高的阶数，尤其是在天空梯度剧烈变化的情况下，但高阶也可能引起振荡。一般来说，默认值（4 阶）在多数情况下都是合适的。如有必要，必须通过仔细的试错来调整此参数。

FILE: This parameter is expressed in sigma units, with respect to the estimated mean background value. Higher tolerance values will allow for more permissive background estimations. Increasing this value favors inclusion of more pixels in the background model, but at the risk of including also pixels that don't pertain to the true background of the image. Decreasing tolerance will cause a more restrictive pixel rejection; however, too low tolerance values lead to poorly sampled background models.
文件: 此参数以 sigma 为单位，相对于估计的平均背景值。容差越大，背景估计越宽松。提高此值有利于把更多像素纳入背景模型，但风险是把并不属于图像真实背景的像素也包含进来。降低容差会带来更严格的像素剔除；但容差过低会导致背景模型的采样不足。

FILE: By selecting this option, all statistical sample weights will be ignored (actually, all of them will be considered as having a value of one, regardless of their actual values). This can be useful in difficult or unusual cases, where DBE's automatic pixel rejection algorithms may fail due to too wild gradients. In such cases, you can manually define a (usually quite reduced) set of samples on strategic locations and tell the background modeling routines that you know what you're doing — if you select this option, they will trust you.
文件: 选中此选项后，所有统计样本权重都会被忽略（实际上全部按值为 1 处理，无论其真实值是多少）。在困难或异常的情况下这很有用，因为梯度过于剧烈时 DBE 的自动像素剔除算法可能失效。这种情况下，你可以在关键位置手动定义一组（通常相当少的）样本，并告诉背景建模程序你知道自己在做什么 —— 选中此选项，它们就会信任你。

FILE: If this option is selected, the initial median value of the image will be applied after background model correction. If the background model is subtracted, then the median will be added; if the background model is applied by division, the resulting image will be multiplied by the median. This tends to recover the initial color balance of the background in the corrected image.If this option is not selected (as by default), the above median normalization will not be applied and —if the background model is accurate— the resulting corrected image will tend to have a neutral background.
文件: 如果选中此选项，图像初始的中值会在背景模型校正之后施加。若背景模型是被减去的，则加上该中值；若背景模型是以除法施加的，则结果图像会乘以该中值。这有助于在校正后的图像中恢复背景原有的色彩平衡。如果未选中此选项（默认情况），则不会施加上述中值归一化，而且——若背景模型准确——校正后的图像会趋于中性背景。

FILE: * Automatic mode. A zero value enables an adaptive algorithm to find an optimal minimum structure size using statistical analysis techniques. This is the default option.* Disabled. A value of one turns off minimum structure size rejection since no detectable star can be represented by less than one pixel.* Literal value. A value > 1 forces using the specified minimum structure size in square pixels.
文件: * 自动模式。值为零时启用自适应算法，用统计分析技术寻找最佳的最小结构尺寸。这是默认选项。* 禁用。值为一时关闭最小结构尺寸剔除，因为任何可检测到的恒星都不可能小于一个像素。* 字面值。值大于一时强制使用指定的最小结构尺寸，单位为平方像素。

FILE: Note that you should always use local databases (in XPSD format) for the APASS photometric catalog required by this process, so this option should not be necessary. The APASS processes can be configured with XPSD database files implementing the APASS DR9 and DR10 catalogs. In this way the PhotometricColorCalibration tool does not require any online service, and hence does not need or use an active Internet connection.
文件: 注意，本进程所需的 APASS 测光星表应始终使用本地数据库（XPSD 格式），因此此选项通常不应需要。APASS 系列进程可以配置为使用实现 APASS DR9 与 DR10 星表的 XPSD 数据库文件。这样一来，PhotometricColorCalibration 工具就无需任何在线服务，因而也不需要或使用有效的互联网连接。

FILE: The rescale as needed mode is similar to rescale, but the target image is only rescaled if there are out-of-range-values after neutralization. This is the default mode.In truncate mode all resulting out-of-range pixels after neutralization will be truncated, which usually results in severely clipped data. This mode is useful to perform a background subtraction to a working image used for an intermediate analysis or processing step.
文件: 「按需重标定」模式与「重标定」类似，但只有当中和之后出现超出范围的值时才重标定目标图像。这是默认模式。在「截断」模式下，中和之后所有超出范围的结果像素都会被截断，这通常会导致数据被严重裁剪。此模式适用于对一张工作图像做背景减除，供中间分析或处理步骤使用。

FILE: The default value of this parameter is 1.0, meaning that flux is measured exclusively for pixels within the elliptical region defined at one tenth of the fitted PSF maximum. Increasing this parameter can inprove accuracy of PSF flux measurements for undersampled images, where PSF fitting uncertainty is relatively large. Decreasing it can be beneficial in some cases working with very noisy data to restrict flux evaluation to star cores.
文件: 此参数的默认值为 1.0，表示仅对拟合 PSF 最大值十分之一处所定义的椭圆区域内的像素测量通量。提高此参数可以改善欠采样图像中 PSF 通量测量的精度，因为这类图像的 PSF 拟合不确定度相对较大。降低此参数在某些情况下有利于处理噪声很大的数据，把通量评估限制在恒星核心。

FILE: A value of 1.0 means that flux will be measured exclusively from pixels within the elliptical region defined at one tenth of the fitted PSF maximum. Increasing this parameter can inprove accuracy of PSF flux measurements for undersampled images, where PSF fitting uncertainty is relatively large. Decreasing it can be beneficial in some cases working with very noisy data to restrict flux evaluation to star cores. The default value is 1.25.
文件: 值为 1.0 表示仅对拟合 PSF 最大值十分之一处所定义的椭圆区域内的像素测量通量。提高此参数可以改善欠采样图像中 PSF 通量测量的精度，因为这类图像的 PSF 拟合不确定度相对较大。降低此参数在某些情况下有利于处理噪声很大的数据，把通量评估限制在恒星核心。默认值为 1.25。

FILE: This parameter can be used in three ways:* Automatic mode. A zero value enables an adaptive algorithm to find an optimal minimum structure size using statistical analysis techniques. This is the default option.* Disabled. A value of one turns off minimum structure size rejection since no detectable star can be represented by less than one pixel.* Literal value. A value > 1 forces using the specified minimum structure size in square pixels.
文件: 此参数有三种用法：* 自动模式。值为零时启用自适应算法，用统计分析技术寻找最佳的最小结构尺寸。这是默认选项。* 禁用。值为一时关闭最小结构尺寸剔除，因为任何可检测到的恒星都不可能小于一个像素。* 字面值。值大于一时强制使用指定的最小结构尺寸，单位为平方像素。

FILE: You should specify a view that represents the true background of the image. In most cases this means that you must select a view whose pixels are strongly dominated by the sky background, as it is being represented on the target image. A typical example involves defining a small preview over a free sky area of the target image, and selecting it here as the background reference image.You can also drag a view selector to this control, and the corresponding view will be selected.
文件: 你应指定一个能代表图像真实背景的视图。多数情况下这意味着必须选择一个像素以天空背景为主的视图，与目标图像上所呈现的一致。典型做法是在目标图像的无天体天区定义一个小的预览，并在此处选为背景参考图像。也可以把视图选择器拖到此控件上，对应的视图即会被选中。

FILE: As of releasing this version of the PhotometricColorCalibration tool, the only catalog providing enough data for the implemented algorithms is the AAVSO Photometric All-Sky Survey (APASS). Future versions will support more catalogs as they become available and we manage to analyze them and adapt our algorithms as necessary.Under normal working conditions, you should enable the Automatic catalog option to use an optimal APASS catalog implementation selected as a function of database availability.
文件: 在发布此版本 PhotometricColorCalibration 工具时，唯一能为所实现算法提供足够数据的星表是 AAVSO 全天测光巡天（APASS）。后续版本将支持更多可用的星表，前提是我们完成对其的分析并按需调整算法。在正常工作条件下，应启用「自动星表」选项，以便根据数据库可用性选择最优的 APASS 星表实现。

FILE: PSF photometry will be performed for no more than the specified number of stars. The subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for calibration of wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of signal evaluation.
文件: PSF 测光最多对指定数量的恒星执行。被测量的恒星子集总是从检测到的恒星集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。默认值设为 24K 颗这一宽松上限。限制测光样本数量可以提升大视场画幅的校准性能，因为这类画幅检测到的恒星数量可能非常多。但把被测源集合削减过多会损害信号评估的准确性。

FILE: Given a source with estimated brightness s, local background b and local background dispersion n, SNR is evaluated as (s – b)/n. Stars with measured SNR below the value of this parameter won't be used for signal evaluation.This parameter allows limiting star detection to a subset of the brightest sources in the image adaptively. By requiring relatively high SNR levels in the evaluated sources, the accuracy and robustness of the signal evaluation process can be largely improved. The default value is 40, which is quite appropriate in most cases.
文件: 对于估计亮度为 s、局部背景为 b、局部背景离散度为 n 的源，SNR 按 (s – b)/n 计算。实测 SNR 低于此参数值的恒星不会用于信号评估。此参数可以自适应地把恒星检测限制在图像中最亮的一部分源上。通过在受评估的源上要求相对较高的 SNR 水平，可以大幅提升信号评估过程的准确性与稳健性。默认值为 40，在多数情况下相当合适。

FILE: This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).The default saturation threshold is 0.75. For signal evaluation this parameter plays an imortant role to prevent contamination of the statistical sample of flux ratios by sources with saturated or nonlinear data. Changing the default value should not be necessary under normal conditions.
文件: 此参数以 [0,1] 范围表示。它可以按归一化 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素样本值施加，也可以按相对于被测图像最大像素样本值的相对值施加（参见「相对饱和阈值」参数）。默认饱和阈值为 0.75。在信号评估中此参数起重要作用，可防止饱和或非线性数据污染通量比的统计样本。正常情况下不应需要更改默认值。

FILE: When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for scale estimation. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.The rest of options select a fixed PSF type for all detected sources, which improves execution times at the cost of a less adaptive, and hence potentially less accurate, relative scale measurement process.
文件: 选中「自动」选项时，会为每个源拟合一系列不同的 PSF，并采用函数值与采样像素值之间绝对差最小的拟合结果做尺度估计。目前此特殊自动模式测试以下函数：beta 形状参数分别等于 2.5、4、6、10 的 Moffat 函数。其余选项为所有检测到的源选择固定的 PSF 类型，这能缩短执行时间，代价是相对尺度测量过程的自适应性变差，因而可能不够准确。

FILE: Outlier stars can be easily identified as dots that depart considerably from the fitted linear function. The more grouped all dots are around the fitted line the better, but the implemented linear fitting routines have been designed to be very robust and resilient to outliers, so these cannot degrade the quality of the color calibration process under normal working conditions.The graphs are interactive: move the mouse over a star to see its values (the star is highlighted on both graphs), drag a rectangle to zoom in, Shift+drag to pan a zoomed graph, and double-click to restore the full view.
文件: 离群恒星很容易识别：表现为明显偏离拟合直线的点。所有点越集中在拟合直线附近越好，但所实现的线性拟合程序已设计得非常稳健、对离群点不敏感，因此在正常工作条件下它们不会降低色彩校准的质量。图形是可交互的：把鼠标移到某颗恒星上可看到其数值（两颗图上的该星会同时高亮），拖拽矩形可放大，按住 Shift 拖拽可平移已放大的图形，双击可恢复完整视图。

FILE: Detected stars with one or more pixels with values above this threshold will be excluded for signal evaluation.This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).The default saturation threshold is 0.75. For signal evaluation this parameter plays an imortant role to prevent contamination of the statistical sample of flux ratios by sources with saturated or nonlinear data. Changing the default value should not be necessary under normal conditions.
文件: 有一个或多个像素值高于此阈值的已检测星点将被排除在信号评估之外。此参数以 [0,1] 范围表示。它可以按归一化 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素样本值施加，也可以按相对于被测图像最大像素样本值的相对值施加（参见「相对饱和阈值」参数）。默认饱和阈值为 0.75。在信号评估中此参数起重要作用，可防止饱和或非线性数据污染通量比的统计样本。正常情况下不应需要更改默认值。

FILE: ColorCalibration will use pixels read from this image to compute an initial mean background level for each color channel. If you leave this field blank (or with its default <target image> value), the target image will be also the background reference image during the color calibration process.You should specify a view that represents the true background of the image. In most cases this means that you must select a view whose pixels are strongly dominated by the sky background, as it is being represented on the target image. A typical example involves defining a small preview over a free sky area of the target image, and selecting it here as the background reference image.
文件: ColorCalibration 将使用从该图像读取的像素，为每个彩色通道计算初始平均背景水平。若将本字段留空（或保持默认的 <target image> 值），则在校准过程中目标图像同时充当背景参考图像。你应指定一个能代表图像真实背景的视图。多数情况下这意味着必须选择一个像素以天空背景为主的视图，与目标图像上所呈现的一致。典型做法是在目标图像的无天体天区定义一个小的预览，并在此处选为背景参考图像。

FILE: This parameter can be used to prevent the detection of small and bright image artifacts wrongly as stars, when such artifacts cannot be removed with a median filter (i.e., the Hot pixel removal parameter), or for rejection of cosmic rays.This parameter can be used in three ways:* Automatic mode. A zero value enables an adaptive algorithm to find an optimal minimum structure size using statistical analysis techniques. This is the default option.* Disabled. A value of one turns off minimum structure size rejection since no detectable star can be represented by less than one pixel.* Literal value. A value > 1 forces using the specified minimum structure size in square pixels.
文件: 此参数可用于避免把微小而明亮的图像伪影错误检测为恒星（这类伪影无法用中值滤波去除，即「热像素去除」参数），也可用于剔除宇宙线。此参数有三种用法：* 自动模式。值为零时启用自适应算法，用统计分析技术寻找最佳的最小结构尺寸。这是默认选项。* 禁用。值为一时关闭最小结构尺寸剔除，因为任何可检测到的恒星都不可能小于一个像素。* 字面值。值大于一时强制使用指定的最小结构尺寸，单位为平方像素。

FILE: In all cases elliptical functions are fitted to detected star structures, and PSF sampling regions are defined adaptively using a median stabilization algorithm.When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for scale estimation. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.The rest of options select a fixed PSF type for all detected sources, which improves execution times at the cost of a less adaptive, and hence potentially less accurate, relative scale measurement process.
文件: 在所有情况下都会对检测到的恒星结构拟合椭圆函数，并用中值稳定化算法自适应地定义 PSF 采样区域。选中「自动」选项时，会为每个源拟合一系列不同的 PSF，并采用函数值与采样像素值之间绝对差最小的拟合结果做尺度估计。目前此特殊自动模式测试以下函数：beta 形状参数分别等于 2.5、4、6、10 的 Moffat 函数。其余选项为所有检测到的源选择固定的 PSF 类型，这能缩短执行时间，代价是相对尺度测量过程的自适应性变差，因而可能不够准确。

FILE: In all cases elliptical functions are fitted to detected star structures, and PSF sampling regions are defined adaptively using a robust median stabilization algorithm.When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for scale estimation. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.The rest of options select a fixed PSF type for all detected sources, which improves execution times at the cost of a less adaptive, and hence potentially less accurate, relative scale measurement process.
文件: 在所有情况下都会对检测到的恒星结构拟合椭圆函数，并用稳健的中值稳定化算法自适应地定义 PSF 采样区域。选中「自动」选项时，会为每个源拟合一系列不同的 PSF，并采用函数值与采样像素值之间绝对差最小的拟合结果做尺度估计。目前此特殊自动模式测试以下函数：beta 形状参数分别等于 2.5、4、6、10 的 Moffat 函数。其余选项为所有检测到的源选择固定的 PSF 类型，这能缩短执行时间，代价是相对尺度测量过程的自适应性变差，因而可能不够准确。

FILE: PCC will use pixels read from this image to compute a mean background level for each color channel. If you leave this field blank (or with its default <target-image> value), the target image will be also the background reference image during the color calibration process.You should specify a view that represents the true background of the image. In most cases this means that you must select a view whose pixels are strongly dominated by the sky background, as it is being represented on the target image. A typical example involves defining a small preview over a free sky area of the target image, and selecting it here as the background reference image.You can also drag a view selector to this control, and the corresponding view will be selected.

FILE: In rescale mode, the target image will always be rescaled after neutralization. In this mode there are no data clippings, and the neutralized image maximizes dynamic range usage. However, in this mode you have no control over the resulting mean background value, and the rescaling operation is a multiplicative transformation that redistributes all pixel values throughout the available dynamic range.The rescale as needed mode is similar to rescale, but the target image is only rescaled if there are out-of-range-values after neutralization. This is the default mode.In truncate mode all resulting out-of-range pixels after neutralization will be truncated, which usually results in severely clipped data. This mode is useful to perform a background subtraction to a working image used for an intermediate analysis or processing step.
文件: 在「重标定」模式下，目标图像会在中和之后总是被重标定。此模式下不会有数据裁剪，中和后的图像能最大化动态范围的利用。但在此模式下你无法控制结果的背景均值，而且重标定是一种乘法变换，会把所有像素值重新分布到整个可用动态范围内。「按需重标定」模式与「重标定」类似，但只有当中和之后出现超出范围的值时才重标定目标图像。这是默认模式。在「截断」模式下，中和之后所有超出范围的结果像素都会被截断，这通常会导致数据被严重裁剪。此模式适用于对一张工作图像做背景减除，供中间分析或处理步骤使用。

FILE: The perceptual intent maps all colors in the image space to the target space. With the perceptual intent, no out-of-gamut color is clipped, as happens with the colorimetric intents, but all colors can be altered, and the changes can be significant if the image space is much wider than the output space. In general, relative colorimetric is preferred, but perceptual can yield more vibrant results that may be desirable in some cases.Finally, the saturation intent tries to maximize color saturation in the output, at the cost of sacrifying color accuracy, when necessary. This intent can be a good option for synthetic graphics and illustrations, but not for reproduction of photographic images.
文件: 感知意图把图像空间中的所有颜色映射到目标空间。使用感知意图时不会有任何超色域颜色被裁剪（色度意图则会发生裁剪），但所有颜色都可能被改变，若图像空间比输出空间宽得多，变化可能相当显著。一般来说更推荐相对色度，但感知有时能给出更鲜艳的结果，在某些场景下可能正是想要的。最后，饱和度意图在必要时会牺牲色彩准确性来尽量提高输出的色彩饱和度。此意图适合合成图形与插画，但不适合摄影图像的复制。

FILE: This option is only applicable when the target image is either a main view or a complete preview. It is always ignored when the process is executed on a partial preview.When this option is enabled, a valid astrometric solution is inherited if it exists in the target image, that is, in the image where the ChannelExtraction process is executed. The astrometric solution is copied to each extracted channel image and regenerated.
文件: 此选项仅在目标图像是主视图或完整预览时适用。当进程在部分预览上执行时，此选项总是被忽略。启用此选项后，若目标图像（即执行 ChannelExtraction 进程的图像）中存在有效的天体测量解，该解会被继承。天体测量解会被复制到每个提取出的通道图像并重新生成。

FILE: Nearest neighbor is the simplest possible pixel interpolation method. It always produces the worst results, especially in terms of registration accuracy (no subpixel registration is possible), and discontinuities due to the simplistic interpolation scheme. However, in absence of scaling and rotation nearest neighbor preserves the original noise distribution in the registered images, a property that can be useful in some image analysis applications.
文件: 最近邻是最简单的像素插值方法。它总是给出最差的结果，尤其是在配准精度方面（无法做到亚像素配准），以及由于插值方案过于简单而产生的间断。但在没有缩放与旋转的情况下，最近邻能保留配准图像中原有的噪声分布，这一特性在某些图像分析应用中很有用。

FILE: Note: When drizzle data files (.xdrz) are added, the module uses the original calibrated frames instead of the registered images for all manipulations. 文件: 注意：当添加 drizzle 数据文件（.xdrz）后，模块在所有操作中都使用原始校准帧而不是已配准的图像。这样可以直接从未配准的原始帧生成彗星对齐图像，避免二次配准/插值。此外，若添加了 drizzle 数据文件并选择了用于减除的操作数图像，模块会写出新的未配准原始帧，适合用于 drizzle 叠加。

FILE: In the current PixInsight/PCL implementations of these algorithms we have included a clamping mechanism that prevents negative interpolated values and ringing artifacts for most images. This parameter represents a threshold value to trigger interpolation clamping. A lower threshold leads to a more aggressive deringing effect; however, too low of a clamping threshold can degrade interpolation performance, especially in terms of aliasing and detail preservation.
文件: 在目前 PixInsight/PCL 对这些算法的实现中，我们加入了钳制机制，可防止大多数图像出现负的插值值和振铃伪影。此参数表示触发插值钳制的阈值。阈值越低，去环效果越激进；但钳制阈值过低会降低插值性能，尤其是在混叠与细节保留方面。

FILE: For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.

FILE: Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In CometAlignment, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded, while output hints modify the way output registered image files are written.For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "up-bottom" output hint to write all registered images (in FITS format) with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.

FILE: The main drawback of the Lanczos and bicubic spline interpolation algorithms is generation of strong undershooting (ringing) artifacts. This is caused by negative lobes of the interpolation functions falling over high-contrast edges and isolated bright pixels. This usually happens with linear data, such as raw CCD and DSLR images, and rarely with nonlinear or stretched images.In the current PixInsight/PCL implementations of these algorithms we have included a clamping mechanism that prevents negative interpolated values and ringing artifacts for most images. This parameter represents a threshold value to trigger interpolation clamping. A lower threshold leads to a more aggressive deringing effect; however, too low of a clamping threshold can degrade interpolation performance, especially in terms of aliasing and detail preservation.
文件: Lanczos 与双三次样条插值算法的主要缺点是会生成强烈的下冲（振铃）伪影。这是由插值函数的负瓣落在高对比边缘和孤立亮像素上造成的。这通常发生在呈线性的数据上，例如原始 CCD 与单反图像，在非线性或已拉伸的图像上很少见。在目前 PixInsight/PCL 对这些算法的实现中，我们加入了钳制机制，可防止大多数图像出现负的插值值和振铃伪影。此参数表示触发插值钳制的阈值。阈值越低，去环效果越激进；但钳制阈值过低会降低插值性能，尤其是在混叠与细节保留方面。

In this way we can create a comet-aligned image directly from unregistered originals to avoid a double registration/interpolation. 文件: 所选图像会从每个目标图像中减去。选中「彗星对齐」时：所选操作数图像（通常是纯彗星图像）会对齐到每个目标帧中彗星的位置，并从该帧中减去。选中「恒星对齐」时：所选操作数图像（通常是纯星场）会从每个目标帧中减去，结果就是对齐到参考帧中彗星位置的彗星图像。注意：当添加 drizzle 数据文件（.xdrz）后，模块在所有操作中都使用原始校准帧而不是已配准的图像。这样可以直接从未配准的原始帧生成彗星对齐图像，避免二次配准/插值。此外，若添加了 drizzle 数据文件并选择了用于减除的操作数图像，模块会写出新的未配准原始帧，适合用于 drizzle 叠加。

FILE: Clamping threshold for the bicubic spline and Lanczos interpolation algorithms.The main drawback of the Lanczos and bicubic spline interpolation algorithms is generation of strong undershooting (ringing) artifacts. This is caused by negative lobes of the interpolation functions falling over high-contrast edges and isolated bright pixels. This usually happens with linear data, such as raw CCD and DSLR images, and rarely with nonlinear or stretched images.In the current PixInsight/PCL implementations of these algorithms we have included a clamping mechanism that prevents negative interpolated values and ringing artifacts for most images. This parameter represents a threshold value to trigger interpolation clamping. A lower threshold leads to a more aggressive deringing effect; however, too low of a clamping threshold can degrade interpolation performance, especially in terms of aliasing and detail preservation.
文件: 双三次样条与 Lanczos 插值算法的钳制阈值。Lanczos 与双三次样条插值算法的主要缺点是会生成强烈的下冲（振铃）伪影。这是由插值函数的负瓣落在高对比边缘和孤立亮像素上造成的。这通常发生在呈线性的数据上，例如原始 CCD 与单反图像，在非线性或已拉伸的图像上很少见。在目前 PixInsight/PCL 对这些算法的实现中，我们加入了钳制机制，可防止大多数图像出现负的插值值和振铃伪影。此参数表示触发插值钳制的阈值。阈值越低，去环效果越激进；但钳制阈值过低会降低插值性能，尤其是在混叠与细节保留方面。

FILE: Chrominance applies the wavelet transform to the RGB components of a color target image, but restores the CIE Y component after the transformation. This effectively applies the wavelet transform to the chroma components without altering the luminance.RGB/K Applies the wavelet transform to the three RGB components of a target color image, or to the gray component of a grayscale image. This is the default mode.
文件: 色度：对彩色目标图像的 RGB 分量应用小波变换，但在变换后恢复 CIE Y 分量。这样实际上只对色度分量施加小波变换而不改变亮度。RGB/K：对目标彩色图像的三个 RGB 分量应用小波变换，或对灰度图像的灰度分量应用。这是默认模式。

FILE: Deringing amount, bright ringing.Increase this parameter to fix bright ringing artifacts around dark image features. This type of ringing doesn't usually occur in astronomical images; they are more common in daylight images. Try to find the smallest value that can fix the generated ringing. Too large of a bright deringing amount will lead to overcorrection, generating dark artifacts around dark image features.
文件: 去环量，亮环。提高此参数可修正暗部特征周围的亮环伪影。这类振铃在天文图像中通常不会出现，更常见于日光图像。请尝试找到能修正所生成振铃的最小值。亮环去环量过大会造成过度校正，在暗部特征周围生成暗色伪影。

FILE: All Changes visualizes all nonzero wavelet coefficients in the current layer. Output pixel values are proportional to the absolute values of the corresponding wavelet coefficients.Increasing Pixels visualizes positive wavelet coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to wavelet coefficient values.Decreasing Pixels visualizes negative wavelet coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to the absolute values of wavelet coefficients.
文件: 全部变化：显示当前层中所有非零小波系数。输出像素值与对应小波系数的绝对值成正比。增加像素：显示正的小波系数。输出像素值与小波系数值成正比。减少像素：显示负的小波系数。输出像素值与小波系数的绝对值成正比。

FILE: Increase threshold to remove more structures. Typically, a value around 3 sigma is appropriate for the first wavelet layer. Successive layers normally require smaller thresholds (the larger the layer scale, the smaller threshold is usually required), but the actual values depend on the properties and distribution of the noise in the image. Too large of a threshold will damage significant structures. Try to adjust this parameter to the smallest value able to remove the noise as you wish on each wavelet layer.
文件: 提高阈值可去除更多结构。通常第一小波层取约 3 sigma 较为合适。后续层通常需要更小的阈值（层尺度越大，通常需要的阈值越小），但实际取值取决于图像中噪声的性质与分布。阈值过大会损害重要结构。请把此参数调整到每一小波层上刚好能去除噪声的最小值。

FILE: Luminance applies the wavelet transform to the CIE Y component (in the CIE XYZ space) of a linear color target image.Chrominance applies the wavelet transform to the RGB components of a color target image, but restores the CIE Y component after the transformation. This effectively applies the wavelet transform to the chroma components without altering the luminance.RGB/K Applies the wavelet transform to the three RGB components of a target color image, or to the gray component of a grayscale image. This is the default mode.
文件: 亮度：对线性彩色目标图像的 CIE Y 分量（在 CIE XYZ 空间中）应用小波变换。色度：对彩色目标图像的 RGB 分量应用小波变换，但在变换后恢复 CIE Y 分量。这样实际上只对色度分量施加小波变换而不改变亮度。RGB/K：对目标彩色图像的三个 RGB 分量应用小波变换，或对灰度图像的灰度分量应用。这是默认模式。

FILE: The a trous wavelet transform algorithm is only defined to use the dyadic scaling sequence 2j, so using a linear sequence produces an invalid transform. However, for small-scale layers (say up to scales of 8 pixels or so) the errors introduced by a linear sequence are usually negligible. A linear sequence can provide more control over small-scale image structures, which can be useful for lunar, planetary and daylight images. The linear scaling sequence applied to large-scale layers will generate visible artifacts due to accumulated errors in the wavelet transform.
文件: à trous 小波变换算法只定义使用二进位缩放序列 2j，因此使用线性序列会产生无效变换。不过对于小尺度层（比如约 8 像素以内的尺度），线性序列引入的误差通常可以忽略。线性序列能对小尺度图像结构提供更细致的控制，这对月球、行星与日光图像有用。把线性缩放序列用于大尺度层会因小波变换中的误差累积而产生可见伪影。

FILE: Increase/decrease bias to increase/decrease the relative weight of a wavelet layer in the reconstructed image. A zero bias value does not change the relative weight of a wavelet layer.The bias parameter defines a multiplicative factor applied to a whole wavelet layer. Increase the bias parameter to enhance all the structures supported by a specific layer. Note that this includes the whole layer contents, that is both significant structures and noise. Typically bias can be increased at scales from 2 to 4 pixels for local contrast enhancement purposes (aka sharpening).
文件: 提高/降低偏置可增加/减少某小波层在重建图像中的相对权重。偏置为零不会改变小波层的相对权重。偏置参数定义施加于整个小波层的乘性因子。提高偏置参数可增强某个特定层所支撑的全部结构。注意这包括该层的全部内容，即显著结构与噪声。通常可在 2 到 4 像素的尺度上提高偏置以获得局部对比度增强（即锐化）。

FILE: Hyperbolic applies a hyperbolic function to the residual wavelet layer. This has a similar effect to the classical digital development processing (DDP) technique; however, this multiscale implementation is much better than the classical DDP because the transformation is applied just where it is needed: on the large-scale illumination profile, without affecting the rest of image structures. The curve break point parameter must be used to control the shape of the applied hyperbolic curve.Base-10 Logarithm and natural Logarithm apply these functions to the large-scale residual wavelet layer.
文件: 双曲：对残差小波层施加双曲函数。效果类似经典的数字冲洗处理（DDP）技术；但这种多尺度实现远优于经典 DDP，因为变换只施加在需要的地方：大尺度照明轮廓上，不影响其余图像结构。「曲线折点」参数必须用来控制所施加双曲曲线的形状。常用对数与自然对数则把这些函数施加到大尺度残差小波层。

FILE: These controls allow you to extend the effective dynamic range of the transformed image. Applying a wavelet transform with biased wavelet layers can result in some pixels having out-of-range values. Normally these out-of-range values are truncated to the normalized [0,1] range, which leads to saturated pixels, that is either completely white or completely black pixels. By extending the output dynamic range, some out-of-range pixels can be accomodated in the resulting image without truncation. The price to pay for preserving data in this way is a loss of overall contrast in the processed image.
文件: 这些控件可以扩展变换后图像的有效动态范围。用带偏置的小波层做小波变换可能使部分像素出现超范围值。通常这些超范围值会被截断到归一化 [0,1] 范围，导致饱和像素，即完全白或完全黑的像素。通过扩展输出动态范围，部分超范围像素可以在结果图像中被容纳而不被截断。以这种方式保留数据的代价是处理后图像的整体对比度下降。

FILE: No layer preview is the normal transformation mode. In this mode no layer preview is obtained and the current transformation is effectively applied to the target image.All Changes visualizes all nonzero wavelet coefficients in the current layer. Output pixel values are proportional to the absolute values of the corresponding wavelet coefficients.Increasing Pixels visualizes positive wavelet coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to wavelet coefficient values.Decreasing Pixels visualizes negative wavelet coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to the absolute values of wavelet coefficients.

FILE: The k-sigma thresholding method can be used to attenuate or remove all wavelet coefficients below a prescribed value in all layers of the wavelet transform. These weights are functions of the employed wavelet scaling function and have been hard-coded in the ATrousWaveletTransform tool.In general, k-sigma thresholding should not be used for noise reduction purposes, since the implemented per-layer noise reduction routine is much more accurate and controllable. This procedure can be useful for auxiliary image processing tasks, such as mask generation or feature detection.
文件: k-sigma 阈值法可用于削弱或去除小波变换所有层中低于规定值的全部小波系数。此方法假设噪声服从高斯分布，并考虑高斯噪声在每一小波层中的相对权重。这些权重是所采用小波缩放函数的函数，已硬编码在 ATrousWaveletTransform 工具中。一般来说，k-sigma 阈值不应被用于降噪目的，因为所实现的逐层降噪例程更精确、更可控。此过程可用于辅助性图像处理任务，例如生成蒙版或特征检测。
