FILE: Selects a linear scaling sequence. Wavelet layers will be generated at dimensional scales following the sequence 1 + d*j, j >= 0 (1,1+d,1+2d,1+3d,...), where d is the scaling distance specified with this control.The a trous wavelet transform algorithm is only defined to use the dyadic scaling sequence 2j, so using a linear sequence produces an invalid transform. However, for small-scale layers (say up to scales of 8 pixels or so) the errors introduced by a linear sequence are usually negligible. A linear sequence can provide more control over small-scale image structures, which can be useful for lunar, planetary and daylight images. The linear scaling sequence applied to large-scale layers will generate visible artifacts due to accumulated errors in the wavelet transform.
文件: 选择线性缩放序列。小波层将按 1 + d*j（j >= 0）的序列（1、1+d、1+2d、1+3d、……）在维度尺度上生成，其中 d 是用此控件指定的缩放距离。à trous 小波变换算法只定义使用二进位缩放序列 2j，因此使用线性序列会产生无效变换。不过对于小尺度层（比如约 8 像素以内的尺度），线性序列引入的误差通常可以忽略。线性序列能对小尺度图像结构提供更细致的控制，这对月球、行星与日光图像有用。把线性缩放序列用于大尺度层会因小波变换中的误差累积而产生可见伪影。

FILE: Defines a threshold in sigma units for removal of wavelet coefficients in the current layer. All wavelet coefficients with absolute values below this threshold will be attenuated by a process known as soft thresholding when the noise reduction feature is enabled for a particular wavelet layer. The amount parameter defines the strength of this attenuation.Increase threshold to remove more structures. Typically, a value around 3 sigma is appropriate for the first wavelet layer. Successive layers normally require smaller thresholds (the larger the layer scale, the smaller threshold is usually required), but the actual values depend on the properties and distribution of the noise in the image. Too large of a threshold will damage significant structures. Try to adjust this parameter to the smallest value able to remove the noise as you wish on each wavelet layer.
文件: 定义以 sigma 为单位的阈值，用于去除当前层的小波系数。当某个小波层启用了降噪功能时，绝对值低于此阈值的所有小波系数都会被一种称为软阈值的过程削弱。「强度」参数定义这种削弱的力度。提高阈值可去除更多结构。通常第一小波层取约 3 sigma 较为合适。后续层通常需要更小的阈值（层尺度越大，通常需要的阈值越小），但实际取值取决于图像中噪声的性质与分布。阈值过大会损害重要结构。请把此参数调整到每一小波层上刚好能去除噪声的最小值。

FILE: This parameter controls the kurtosis of the filter function distribution. When shape = 2 the filter distribution is Gaussian (also known as normal distribution). When shape < 2 the distribution is leptokurtic, leading to a peaked filter that can be used, for example, to approximate the shape of a diffraction pattern. When shape > 2 the distribution is platykurtic and the filter has a comparatively flat profile, resembling a truncated (or saturated) PSF.
文件: 此参数控制滤波器函数分布的峰度。当 shape = 2 时滤波器分布为高斯分布（也称正态分布）。当 shape < 2 时分布为尖峰态，得到尖峰滤波器，可用于例如近似衍射图案的形状。当 shape > 2 时分布为平峰态，滤波器轮廓相对平坦，类似截断（或饱和）的 PSF。

FILE: Shape of the filter function.This parameter controls the kurtosis of the filter function distribution. When shape = 2 the filter distribution is Gaussian (also known as normal distribution). When shape < 2 the distribution is leptokurtic, leading to a peaked filter that can be used, for example, to approximate the shape of a diffraction pattern. When shape > 2 the distribution is platykurtic and the filter has a comparatively flat profile, resembling a truncated (or saturated) PSF.
文件: 滤波器函数的形状。此参数控制滤波器函数分布的峰度。当 shape = 2 时滤波器分布为高斯分布（也称正态分布）。当 shape < 2 时分布为尖峰态，得到尖峰滤波器，可用于例如近似衍射图案的形状。当 shape > 2 时分布为平峰态，滤波器轮廓相对平坦，类似截断（或饱和）的 PSF。

FILE: A high-pass filter has negative coefficients. As a result, some pixels in the convolved image may have negative values. Saturated pixels (values above one) can also result, depending on the filter coefficients. The standard behavior is to truncate out-of-range pixel values to the [0,1] range, which preserves the dynamics of the convolved image, so high-pass rescaling is disabled by default. When high-pass rescaling is enabled, the resulting image is normalized (that is, rescaled to [0,1] only if there are out-of-range values) and hence all the data after convolution are preserved at the cost of reducing the overall contrast of the image.
文件: 高通滤波器具有负系数。因此卷积后图像中部分像素可能为负值。依滤波器系数的不同，也可能出现饱和像素（值大于一）。标准做法是把超范围像素值截断到 [0,1] 范围，这样可保留卷积后图像的动态范围，因此高通重标定默认被禁用。启用高通重标定后，结果图像会被归一化（即仅当存在超范围值时才重标定到 [0,1]），因而卷积后的全部数据都被保留，代价是图像整体对比度下降。

FILE: Rescale out-of-range values for normalization of images after convolution with a high-pass filter.A high-pass filter has negative coefficients. As a result, some pixels in the convolved image may have negative values. Saturated pixels (values above one) can also result, depending on the filter coefficients. The standard behavior is to truncate out-of-range pixel values to the [0,1] range, which preserves the dynamics of the convolved image, so high-pass rescaling is disabled by default. When high-pass rescaling is enabled, the resulting image is normalized (that is, rescaled to [0,1] only if there are out-of-range values) and hence all the data after convolution are preserved at the cost of reducing the overall contrast of the image.
文件: 对高通滤波卷积后的图像做归一化时重标定超范围值。高通滤波器具有负系数。因此卷积后图像中部分像素可能为负值。依滤波器系数的不同，也可能出现饱和像素（值大于一）。标准做法是把超范围像素值截断到 [0,1] 范围，这样可保留卷积后图像的动态范围，因此高通重标定默认被禁用。启用高通重标定后，结果图像会被归一化（即仅当存在超范围值时才重标定到 [0,1]），因而卷积后的全部数据都被保留，代价是图像整体对比度下降。

FILE: PSF photometry will be performed for no more than the specified number of stars. The subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of signal estimation.
文件: PSF 测光最多对指定数量的恒星执行。被测量的恒星子集总是从检测到的恒星集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。默认值设为 24K 颗这一宽松上限。限制测光样本数量可以提升大视场画幅的性能，因为这类画幅检测到的恒星数量可能非常多。但把被测源集合削减过多会损害信号估计的准确性。

FILE: The N* robust noise estimator extracts a subset of residual pixels by comparison with a large-scale model of the local background of the image, generated with the multiscale median transform (MMT). Since the MMT is remarkably efficient at isolating image structures, it can be used to detect pixels that cannot contribute to significant structures. N* is an accurate and robust, alternative estimator of the standard deviation of the noise that does not assume or require any particular statistical distribution in the analyzed data.
文件: N* 稳健噪声估计器通过与图像局部背景的大尺度模型（用多尺度中值变换 MMT 生成）比较，提取一部分残差像素。由于 MMT 在分离图像结构方面效率极高，可用它检测出无法构成显著结构的像素。N* 是一种精确而稳健的标准差替代估计器，不假设也不要求被测数据服从任何特定统计分布。

FILE: For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "up-bottom" output hint to write all normalized images (in FITS format) with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 例如，可以用 "lower-range" 和 "upper-range" 输入提示来载入其他程序生成的、不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。类似地，可以指定 "up-bottom" 输出提示，把所有归一化图像（FITS 格式）写成坐标原点位于左上角。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式都支持若干输入和/或输出提示，可在提供格式提示访问的工具中用于不同目的。

FILE: Generation of single RGB color images is the default option. Separate RGB channel images can be useful for correction of non-isotropic channel misalignments, such as those caused by chromatic aberration and atmospheric dispersion, by computing image registration transformations with distortion correction among all color components of a data set. This procedure is compatible with normal image integrations as well as drizzle integrations.Separate channel file names will carry the _R, _G and _B suffixes, respectively for the red, green and blue components.
文件: 生成单个 RGB 彩色图像是默认选项。单独的 RGB 通道图像可用于校正非各向同性的通道失配（例如色差与大气色散造成的失配），方法是计算数据集所有彩色分量之间带畸变校正的图像配准变换。此过程与普通图像叠加以及 drizzle 叠加都兼容。分离的通道文件名将分别带 _R、_G、_B 后缀，对应红、绿、蓝分量。

FILE: When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for flux measurement. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.The rest of options select a fixed PSF type for all detected sources, which improves execution times at the cost of a less adaptive, and hence potentially less accurate, signal estimation process.
文件: 选中「自动」选项时，会为每个源拟合一系列不同的 PSF，并采用函数值与采样像素值之间绝对差最小的拟合结果做通量测量。目前此特殊自动模式测试以下函数：beta 形状参数分别等于 2.5、4、6、10 的 Moffat 函数。其余选项为所有检测到的源选择固定的 PSF 类型，这能缩短执行时间，代价是信号估计过程的自适应性变差，因而可能不够准确。

FILE: The maximum number of stars that can be measured to compute mean signal estimates.PSF photometry will be performed for no more than the specified number of stars. The subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of signal estimation.
文件: 可用于计算平均信号估计的最大恒星数量。PSF 测光最多对指定数量的恒星执行。被测量的恒星子集总是从检测到的恒星集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。默认值设为 24K 颗这一宽松上限。限制测光样本数量可以提升大视场画幅的性能，因为这类画幅检测到的恒星数量可能非常多。但把被测源集合削减过多会损害信号估计的准确性。

FILE: Our current implementation uses PSF photometry to generate robust and accurate measures of total and mean flux from detected and fitted sources. These estimates, along with estimates of the standard deviation of the noise, can be used for image grading and weighting with the SubframeSelector and ImageIntegration processes.The signal evaluation result will be stored as a set of custom, per-channel XISF properties and FITS header keywords that other processes and scripts can use for specialized image analysis purposes.This option should always be enabled for demosaicing of deep-sky raw light frames.
文件: 我们目前的实现使用 PSF 测光，从检测并拟合的源中生成稳健而精确的总通量与平均通量测量值。这些估计值连同噪声标准差的估计，可用于 SubframeSelector 与 ImageIntegration 进程做图像评级与加权。信号评估结果会存为一组自定义的逐通道 XISF 属性与 FITS 文件头关键字，其他进程与脚本可将其用于专门的图像分析。对深空原始亮帧做去马赛克时应始终启用此选项。

FILE: Compute per-channel estimates of the standard deviation of the noise and noise scaling factors for each target image, using a selected multiscale algorithm (MRS noise estimator by default). Noise estimates will be stored as a set of custom XISF properties and FITS header keywords in the output files.These estimates can be used later by several processes and scripts for specialized image analysis purposes, most notably by SubframeSelector and ImageIntegration for image grading and weighting. Noise estimates will always be computed from uninterpolated, raw calibrated data.This option should always be enabled under normal working conditions.
文件: 使用选定的多尺度算法（默认 MRS 噪声估计器）为每个目标图像计算逐通道的噪声标准差估计与噪声缩放因子。噪声估计会存为输出文件中的一组自定义 XISF 属性与 FITS 文件头关键字。这些估计随后可被多个进程与脚本用于专门的图像分析，尤其是 SubframeSelector 与 ImageIntegration 的评级与加权。噪声估计始终从未经插值的原始校准数据计算。正常工作条件下应始终启用此选项。

FILE: Detected stars with one or more pixels with values above this threshold will be excluded for signal evaluation. This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).The default saturation threshold is 1.0. For signal evaluation, the implemented star detection and outlier rejection routines are normally able to avoid contamination from saturated sources, so the default value of this parameter should not be changed under normal conditions.
文件: 有一个或多个像素值高于此阈值的已检测星点将被排除在信号评估之外。此参数以 [0,1] 范围表示。它可以按归一化 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素样本值施加，也可以按相对于被测图像最大像素样本值的相对值施加（参见「相对饱和阈值」参数）。默认饱和阈值为 1.0。在信号评估中，所实现的星点检测与离群剔除例程通常能避免饱和源的污染，因此正常情况下不应更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: Compute standardized estimates of the signal present in target frames.Our current implementation uses PSF photometry to generate robust and accurate measures of total and mean flux from detected and fitted sources. These estimates, along with estimates of the standard deviation of the noise, can be used for image grading and weighting with the SubframeSelector and ImageIntegration processes.The signal evaluation result will be stored as a set of custom, per-channel XISF properties and FITS header keywords that other processes and scripts can use for specialized image analysis purposes.This option should always be enabled for demosaicing of deep-sky raw light frames.
文件: 计算目标帧中信号的标准化估计。我们目前的实现使用 PSF 测光，从检测并拟合的源中生成稳健而精确的总通量与平均通量测量值。这些估计值连同噪声标准差的估计，可用于 SubframeSelector 与 ImageIntegration 进程做图像评级与加权。信号评估结果会存为一组自定义的逐通道 XISF 属性与 FITS 文件头关键字，其他进程与脚本可将其用于专门的图像分析。对深空原始亮帧做去马赛克时应始终启用此选项。

FILE: Saturation threshold in the [0,1] range.Detected stars with one or more pixels with values above this threshold will be excluded for signal evaluation. This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).The default saturation threshold is 1.0. For signal evaluation, the implemented star detection and outlier rejection routines are normally able to avoid contamination from saturated sources, so the default value of this parameter should not be changed under normal conditions.
文件: [0,1] 范围内的饱和阈值。有一个或多个像素值高于此阈值的已检测恒星将被排除在信号评估之外。此参数以 [0,1] 范围表示。它可以按归一化 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素样本值施加，也可以按相对于被测图像最大像素样本值的相对值施加（参见「相对饱和阈值」参数）。默认饱和阈值为 1.0。在信号评估中，所实现的恒星检测与离群剔除例程通常能避免饱和源的污染，因此正常情况下不应更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: Demosaiced/interpolated images can be generated as combined RGB color images, as separate RGB channels stored as monochrome images, or applying both options at the same time.Generation of single RGB color images is the default option. Separate RGB channel images can be useful for correction of non-isotropic channel misalignments, such as those caused by chromatic aberration and atmospheric dispersion, by computing image registration transformations with distortion correction among all color components of a data set. This procedure is compatible with normal image integrations as well as drizzle integrations.Separate channel file names will carry the _R, _G and _B suffixes, respectively for the red, green and blue components.
文件: 去马赛克/插值后的图像可以生成为合成的 RGB 彩色图像、存为单色图像的分离 RGB 通道，或同时应用这两种选项。生成单个 RGB 彩色图像是默认选项。单独的 RGB 通道图像可用于校正非各向同性的通道失配（例如色差与大气色散造成的失配），方法是计算数据集所有彩色分量之间带畸变校正的图像配准变换。此过程与普通图像叠加以及 drizzle 叠加都兼容。分离的通道文件名将分别带 _R、_G、_B 后缀，对应红、绿、蓝分量。

FILE: In all cases elliptical functions are fitted to detected star structures, and PSF sampling regions are defined adaptively using a median stabilization algorithm.When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for flux measurement. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.The rest of options select a fixed PSF type for all detected sources, which improves execution times at the cost of a less adaptive, and hence potentially less accurate, signal estimation process.
文件: 在所有情况下都会对检测到的恒星结构拟合椭圆函数，并用中值稳定化算法自适应地定义 PSF 采样区域。选中「自动」选项时，会为每个源拟合一系列不同的 PSF，并采用函数值与采样像素值之间绝对差最小的拟合结果做通量测量。目前此特殊自动模式测试以下函数：beta 形状参数分别等于 2.5、4、6、10 的 Moffat 函数。其余选项为所有检测到的源选择固定的 PSF 类型，这能缩短执行时间，代价是信号估计过程的自适应性变差，因而可能不够准确。

FILE: Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In Debayer, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded, while output hints modify the way output demosaiced image files are written.For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "up-bottom" output hint to write all normalized images (in FITS format) with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 格式提示可以覆盖特定进程所用图像文件的全局文件格式设置。在 Debayer 中，输入提示改变某些特定格式输入图像的载入方式，输出提示改变输出经去马赛克图像文件的写出方式。例如，可以用 "lower-range" 和 "upper-range" 输入提示来载入其他程序生成的、不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。类似地，可以指定 "up-bottom" 输出提示，把所有归一化图像（FITS 格式）写成坐标原点位于左上角。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式都支持若干输入和/或输出提示，可在提供格式提示访问的工具中用于不同目的。

FILE: The iterative k-sigma clipping algorithm can be used as a last-resort option in cases where the MRS algorithm does not converge systematically. This can happen on images with no detectable small-scale noise; for example, images that have been smoothed as a result of bilinear demosaicing interpolation.The N* robust noise estimator extracts a subset of residual pixels by comparison with a large-scale model of the local background of the image, generated with the multiscale median transform (MMT). Since the MMT is remarkably efficient at isolating image structures, it can be used to detect pixels that cannot contribute to significant structures. N* is an accurate and robust, alternative estimator of the standard deviation of the noise that does not assume or require any particular statistical distribution in the analyzed data.
文件: 在 MRS 算法系统性不收敛的情况下，可把迭代 k-sigma 裁剪算法作为最后手段。这可能发生在没有可检测小尺度噪声的图像上；例如因双线性去马赛克插值而被平滑过的图像。N* 稳健噪声估计器通过与图像局部背景的大尺度模型（用多尺度中值变换 MMT 生成）比较，提取一部分残差像素。由于 MMT 在分离图像结构方面效率极高，可用它检测出无法构成显著结构的像素。N* 是一种精确而稳健的标准差替代估计器，不假设也不要求被测数据服从任何特定统计分布。

FILE: This parameter controls the kurtosis of the PSF function distribution. When shape = 2 the function distribution is Gaussian (also known as normal distribution). When shape < 2 the distribution is leptokurtic, leading to a peaked PSF that can be used, for example, to approximate the shape of a diffraction pattern. When shape > 2 the distribution is platykurtic and the PSF has a comparatively flat profile.
文件: 此参数控制 PSF 函数分布的峰度。当 shape = 2 时函数分布为高斯分布（也称正态分布）。当 shape < 2 时分布为尖峰态，得到尖峰 PSF，可用于例如近似衍射图案的形状。当 shape > 2 时分布为平峰态，PSF 轮廓相对平坦。

FILE: Overall shape of the PSF function.This parameter controls the kurtosis of the PSF function distribution. When shape = 2 the function distribution is Gaussian (also known as normal distribution). When shape < 2 the distribution is leptokurtic, leading to a peaked PSF that can be used, for example, to approximate the shape of a diffraction pattern. When shape > 2 the distribution is platykurtic and the PSF has a comparatively flat profile.
文件: PSF 函数的整体形状。此参数控制 PSF 函数分布的峰度。当 shape = 2 时函数分布为高斯分布（也称正态分布）。当 shape < 2 时分布为尖峰态，得到尖峰 PSF，可用于例如近似衍射图案的形状。当 shape > 2 时分布为平峰态，PSF 轮廓相对平坦。

FILE: Specify the identifier of an existing view to be used as the deringing support image. Must be a grayscale image with the same dimensions as the target image.The deringing support is optional; if you don't specify it, the global deringing algorithm will be applied uniformly to the whole image. The deringing support allows you to use a star mask to drive a local deringing algorithm that can enhance protection of stars and other high-contrast, small-scale image structures.
文件: 指定一个现有视图的标识符，用作去环支撑图像。必须是尺寸与目标图像相同的灰度图像。去环支撑是可选的；若不指定，全局去环算法会均匀作用于整幅图像。去环支撑允许用星点蒙版驱动局部去环算法，从而加强对恒星及其他高对比、小尺度图像结构的保护。

FILE: Important: If you are integrating the orbit of an asteroid already included in the selected asteroid ephemerides file, you should specify its identifier or name in that file. In this way the numerical integration process will be able to exclude the object as a perturber body. Otherwise the integration will detect a collision between the object being integrated and the same object being used as a perturber.
文件: 重要：若你正在积分的小行星已包含在所选小行星星历文件中，你应在该文件中指定其标识符或名称。这样数值积分过程才能把该天体作为摄动体排除在外。否则积分会检测到正在积分的天体与作为摄动体的同一天体发生碰撞。

FILE: The path to the output XEPH file.Custom XEPH files generated with this tool can be used to compute ephemerides for a wide range of applications on the PixInsight PCL/PJSR platforms. For example, you can use them with the AnnotateImage script to find and annotate asteroids and comets in your images, or with the Ephemerides script to compute positional and visibility data in a variety of formats and conditions.
文件: 输出 XEPH 文件的路径。用本工具生成的自定义 XEPH 文件可在 PixInsight PCL/PJSR 平台上用于广泛的应用中计算星历。例如，可配合 AnnotateImage 脚本在图像中查找并标注小行星与彗星，或配合 Ephemerides 脚本以多种格式和条件计算位置与可见性数据。

FILE: Path to a database file of orbital elements or state vectors, where database search operations will be performed.Currently we support plain text databases in a variety of formats, including well-known public databases of asteroid and comet orbital elements available from Lowell Observatory, MPC and JPL, as well as several CSV and tabular formats generated by our scripts and tools. See the database format parameter below.
文件: 轨道根数或状态向量数据库文件的路径，数据库搜索操作将在此文件中执行。目前我们支持多种格式的纯文本数据库，包括来自 Lowell 天文台、MPC 与 JPL 的著名小行星与彗星轨道根数公开数据库，以及由我们的脚本与工具生成的若干 CSV 与表格式格式。数据库格式见下方「数据库格式」参数。

FILE: will select the numbered asteroids from 125 to 500 and from 1000 to 1500.Literal Search TokensWhen the Regular expressions option is disabled and a search token does not specify a search range, it will be interpreted as a case-insensitive substring that will be searched for literally in object identifiers and names. For example, the following search tokens:shoemaker-levy 9would select all fragments of comet D/1993 F2 Shoemaker-Levy 9 (21 objects).
文件: 将选取编号 125 到 500 以及 1000 到 1500 的小行星。字面搜索词：当「正则表达式」选项被禁用且搜索词未指定搜索范围时，它会被解释为不区分大小写的子串，在目标标识符与名称中按字面搜索。例如，下面的搜索词：shoemaker-levy 9 将选取彗星 D/1993 F2 Shoemaker-Levy 9 的全部碎片（21 个天体）。

FILE: Compute relativistic perturbations. We implement the parametrized post-Newtonian (PPN) n-body metric used in JPL's DE440 ephemerides for the point-mass accelerations induced by all planets, Moon, Pluto and the five most massive asteroids. If this option is disabled, only Newtonian accelerations will be computed.Under normal working conditions this option should always be enabled for the sake of accuracy in computed ephemerides. It can be disabled for testing purposes.
文件: 计算相对论摄动。我们实现的是 JPL DE440 星历中所用的参数化后牛顿（PPN）n 体度规，用于所有行星、月球、冥王星以及五颗质量最大的小行星所引起的点质量加速度。若禁用此选项，则只计算牛顿加速度。在正常工作条件下，为保证所计算星历的精度，应始终启用此选项。可在测试时禁用它。

FILE: This file will only be used (and required) when the Asteroid perturbers option is selected.Important: The selected fundamental and asteroid ephemerides files must be coherent, that is, both must be referred to the same dynamical solar system model. For example, you should not mix DE440 fundamental ephemerides with asteroids referred to DE430 barycentric solar positions. Under normal working conditions, this will never be a problem if the default core ephemerides files are selected.
文件: 此文件仅在选中「小行星摄动体」选项时才会被使用（且必需）。重要：所选的基本星历文件与小行星星历文件必须一致，即两者必须参照同一个动力学太阳系模型。例如，不应把 DE440 基本星历与参照 DE430 质心太阳位置的小行星混用。在正常工作条件下，若选用默认的核心星历文件，这从来不会是问题。

FILE: Identifier of the object. For example, an asteroid number such as '5' for 5 Astraea.Important: If you are integrating the orbit of an asteroid already included in the selected asteroid ephemerides file, you should specify its identifier or name in that file. In this way the numerical integration process will be able to exclude the object as a perturber body. Otherwise the integration will detect a collision between the object being integrated and the same object being used as a perturber.
文件: 天体的标识符。例如小行星编号，如 5 Astraea 的 '5'。重要：若你正在积分的小行星已包含在所选小行星星历文件中，你应在该文件中指定其标识符或名称。这样数值积分过程才能把该天体作为摄动体排除在外。否则积分会检测到正在积分的天体与作为摄动体的同一天体发生碰撞。

FILE: In the single object case, you specify the initial conditions as either six state vectors (position and velocity vectors), or equivalently, as a set of osculating orbital elements (semimajor axis, eccentricity, inclination, etc). In both cases the initial conditions must be valid at the specified epoch.For integration of orbits for objects defined in a database, you can specify a local database file in several standard plain text formats; see the database file parameter for more information.
文件: 在单体情况下，初始条件可以指定为六个状态向量（位置与速度向量），或等价地指定为一组密切轨道根数（半长轴、偏心率、倾角等）。两种情况下的初始条件都必须在指定的历元处有效。对于数据库中定义的对象的轨道积分，你可以按若干标准纯文本格式指定本地数据库文件；详见「数据库文件」参数。

FILE: If checked, the Search tokens parameter will be interpreted as a comma-separated list of regular expressions (ECMAScript format, case-insensitive). Only objects with identifiers or names that match one of the specified regular expressions will be included in the search result.If this option is disabled, the contents of the Search tokens parameter is a comma-separated list of literal search tokens and/or asteroid identifier ranges; see the documentation for that parameter for more information.
文件: 若勾选，「搜索词」参数会被解释为以逗号分隔的正则表达式列表（ECMAScript 格式，不区分大小写）。只有标识符或名称匹配其中某个正则表达式的对象才会被纳入搜索结果。若禁用此选项，「搜索词」参数的内容是以逗号分隔的字面搜索词和/或小行星编号范围的列表；详见该参数的文档。

FILE: Compute non-gravitational perturbations when the required data are available. This option normally applies only to comets with available non-gravitational acceleration parameters A1, A2, A3 and DT (see the Non-Gravitational Perturbations section). We implement the standard asymmetric model of D.K. Yeomans and P.W. Chodas (Astron. J. 98 (3), 1989).Under normal working conditions this option should always be enabled for the sake of accuracy in computed ephemerides. It can be disabled for testing purposes.
文件: 在所需数据可用时计算非引力摄动。此选项通常只适用于具有可用非引力加速度参数 A1、A2、A3 与 DT 的彗星（参见「非引力摄动」一节）。我们实现的是 D.K. Yeomans 与 P.W. Chodas 的标准非对称模型（Astron. J. 98 (3), 1989）。在正常工作条件下，为保证所计算星历的精度，应始终启用此选项。可在测试时禁用它。

FILE: Name of the object. For example, an asteroid name such as 'Astraea' for 5 Astraea, the designation of an unnumbered minor planet such as '2006 QH181', or a comet name such as '1/P Halley'.Important: If you are integrating the orbit of an asteroid already included in the selected asteroid ephemerides file, you should specify its identifier or name in that file. In this way the numerical integration process will be able to exclude the object as a perturber body. Otherwise the integration will detect a collision between the object being integrated and the same object being used as a perturber.
文件: 天体的名称。例如小行星名，如 5 Astraea 的 'Astraea'；未编号小行星的临时编号，如 '2006 QH181'；或彗星名，如 '1/P Halley'。重要：若你正在积分的小行星已包含在所选小行星星历文件中，你应在该文件中指定其标识符或名称。这样数值积分过程才能把该天体作为摄动体排除在外。否则积分会检测到正在积分的天体与作为摄动体的同一天体发生碰撞。

FILE: where n1 and n2 are two integer numbers. Only the set of asteroids with numbers within the range [n1,n2] will be selected. FILE: IAS15 is a 15th-order implicit integrator based on Gauss-Radau quadrature with adaptive time stepping (H. Rein and D. S. Spiegel, MNRAS 446, 1424 (2015)). It keeps the truncation error of the scheme well below floating point round-off, and makes round-off errors unbiased through compensated summation, so that the accumulated error follows Brouwer's law over very long integrations. It handles close encounters, highly eccentric orbits, and velocity-dependent forces such as relativistic and non-gravitational perturbations. This is the default and recommended option.Bulirsch-Stoer is the adaptive Bulirsch-Stoer extrapolation method with dense output implemented by the Boost.Odeint library, controlled by absolute and relative tolerances derived from the floating point precision of the integration. This was the only integrator available in previous versions of this tool.

Spiegel，MNRAS 446, 1424 (2015)）。它使方案的截断误差远低于浮点舍入，并通过补偿求和使舍入误差保持无偏，因此在极长的积分中累积误差遵循 Brouwer 定律。它能处理近距离交会、高偏心率轨道以及依赖速度的力，例如相对论摄动与非引力摄动。这是默认且推荐的选项。Bulirsch-Stoer 是 Boost.Odeint 库实现的自适应 Bulirsch-Stoer 外推法（带密集输出），由根据积分浮点精度导出的绝对容差与相对容差控制。这是本工具早期版本中唯一可用的积分器。

XISF is subject to intense development as an initiative to create a free, modern, efficient and interoperable format for storage, management and interchange of digital images and associated data. For up-to-date information on XISF, please visit:https://pixinsight.com/xisf/

FILE: This parameter specifies the default growing direction of vertical coordinates when reading and writing FITS images. The FITS standard does not define an unambiguous orientation of pixel data stored in image arrays. Data acquired with most professional instruments (HST, Gemini, Subaru, etc.) and some high-end CCD camera control software packages normally follow the lower left origin and bottom-up orientation conventions.The upper left origin and top-down orientation are coherent with the rest of image file formats and are the conventions used by most CCD camera control and image processing software applications by default.See also the Use ROWORDER keywords option below for a de-facto standard that we support in the hope that it will solve most practical issues caused by this FITS orientation ambiguity.
文件: 此参数指定读写 FITS 图像时垂直坐标的默认增长方向。FITS 标准并未明确界定图像数组中像素数据的方向。多数专业仪器（HST、Gemini、Subaru 等）以及一些高端 CCD 相机控制软件采集的数据通常遵循左下原点、自下而上的约定。左上原点、自上而下的方向与其余图像文件格式一致，也是多数 CCD 相机控制与图像处理软件默认采用的约定。另请参见下方的「使用 ROWORDER 关键字」选项，这是我们支持的一项事实标准，希望它能解决这一 FITS 方向歧义造成的大多数实际问题。

FILE: The FITS standard allows only printable ASCII characters in header keywords (ISO/IEC 8859-1 code points from 0x20 to 0x7E). Some applications write illegal characters to FITS keyword comments and values. For example, the degree sign, whose code is 0xB0 (decimal 176), is written by some applications to represent temperature values and angles in FITS keyword comments. These nonstandard FITS files can be loaded in PixInsight, but we'll never allow writing them unless the illegal characters are either removed or replaced with legal ASCII values.If this option is enabled, any illegal characters in the header keywords of a FITS file will be replaced by their best legal counterparts before writing the file to disk. For example, an illegal character 0xC0 (Latin capital letter A with grave, À) will be replaced by 0x41, or a Latin capital letter A. Similarly, an illegal copyright sign (0xA9, ©) will be replaced by the standard three-character sequence '(C)'. This option is disabled by default.
文件: FITS 标准只允许文件头关键字中出现可打印 ASCII 字符（ISO/IEC 8859-1 码位 0x20 至 0x7E）。有些程序会向 FITS 关键字注释与值中写入非法字符。例如，某些程序会写入码为 0xB0（十进制 176）的度符号，用来在 FITS 关键字注释中表示温度值与角度。这些非标准 FITS 文件可以在 PixInsight 中载入，但我们绝不允许写出它们，除非非法字符被删除或替换为合法 ASCII 值。若启用此选项，FITS 文件头关键字中的任何非法字符都会在写入磁盘之前被替换为最接近的合法字符。例如，非法字符 0xC0（带上重音的拉丁大写字母 A，À）会被替换为 0x41，即拉丁大写字母 A。类似地，非法版权符号（0xA9，©）会被替换为标准的三字符序列 '(C)'。此选项默认禁用。

FILE: Nearest neighbor is the simplest possible pixel interpolation method. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.

FILE: The PSF SNR algorithm is a good option for achieving a higher SNR in the final image. This algorithm maximizes the PSF-SNR, estimated as the ratio between the star's flux and the square of the noise measured in the star's local background.The Resolution algorithm is a good option to achieve finer details in the final image. This algorithm maximizes the ratio between the star's flux and its size, a trade-off between maximizing the signal and minimizing the area over which the signal is distributed.

FILE: For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.

FILE: To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum sensitivity, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.Increase this parameter to favor detection of fainter stars. Decrease it to restrict detection to brighter stars. The default value is 0.5. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.

FILE: Increasing the amount of reference stars is in general not necessary, and it usually just slows down the image registration process with no improvement in registration accuracy. However, when registering images with little overlapping (mosaics, or images with large scale differences), it may be necessary using a reduced or expanded set of reference stars, depending on a variety of working scenarios. In these cases, the automatic probing sequence usually works very well, so you normally should not need to change the default value of this parameter.
文件: 增加参考星数量一般来说没有必要，通常只会拖慢图像配准过程而不会提升配准精度。但在配准重叠很少的图像（马赛克，或尺度差异很大的图像）时，依各种工作场景可能需要使用缩减或扩大的参考星集合。在这些情况下，自动探测序列通常效果很好，因此正常不需要更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a Gaussian convolution filter applied to the working image used for calculation of star positions during the star detection phase. Use it only for very low SNR images, where the star detector cannot find reliable stars with default parameters.Be aware that noise reduction will modify star profiles and hence the way star positions are calculated, resulting in a less accurate image registration. Under extreme low-SNR conditions, however, this is probably better than working with the actual data anyway.To disable noise reduction, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 这是施加于工作图像的高斯卷积滤波器的半径（像素），该工作图像用于在恒星检测阶段计算恒星位置。仅用于 SNR 极低的图像，即恒星检测器用默认参数找不到可靠恒星的图像。请注意，降噪会改变恒星轮廓，从而改变恒星位置的计算方式，导致图像配准不够精确。不过在极端低 SNR 条件下，这大概还是比直接用实际数据要好。要禁用降噪，请把此参数设为零。

FILE: The iterative sigma clipping algorithm is usually a good option to integrate more than 10 or 15 images. Keep in mind that for sigma clipping to work, the standard deviation must be a good estimator of dispersion, which requires a sufficient number of pixels per stack (the more images the better).Winsorized sigma clipping is similar to the normal sigma clipping algorithm, but uses a special iterative procedure based on Huber's method of robust estimation of parameters through Winsorization. This algorithm can yield superior rejection of outliers with better preservation of significant data for large sets of images.
文件: 迭代 sigma 裁剪算法通常是叠加 10 到 15 张以上图像的好选择。请记住，sigma 裁剪要有效，标准差必须是离散度的良好估计量，这要求每个堆栈有足够的像素（图像越多越好）。Winsor 化 sigma 裁剪与普通 sigma 裁剪算法类似，但使用基于 Huber 通过 Winsor 化稳健估计参数方法的特殊迭代过程。对于大批图像，此算法能更好地剔除离群值，同时更好地保留重要数据。

FILE: Polygon descriptors such as quadrilaterals (also known as "quads") and pentagons are more flexible and robust than triangle similarity. Their lack of support for specular transformations is of little practical importance. However, polygons are more computationally intensive and require more memory. Triangle similarity works reliably for normal image registration tasks of similar images, but more complex tasks such as registration of dissimilar images, registration under large scale differences, arbitrary distortions and mosaics, usually require more robust descriptors like quads, pentagons, or hexagons. Pentagon descriptors are used by default.
文件: 四边形（也称 "quads"）与五边形等多边形描述符比三角形相似性更灵活、更稳健。它们不支持镜面变换这一点在实际中几乎不重要。不过多边形计算量更大，也需要更多内存。三角形相似性对相似图像的普通配准任务可靠有效，但更复杂的任务，例如不相似图像的配准、大尺度差异下的配准、任意畸变与马赛克，通常需要四边形、五边形或六边形这类更稳健的描述符。默认使用五边形描述符。

FILE: Enabling precise alignment guarantees that a specific image region will be registered at the sub-pixel level. When the alignment solution is found on each frame, a final sub-pixel translation will be applied to match the centroids of the selected star and the corresponding star on the aligned image.This approach effectively improves the details in the surroundings of a specific area of the master light. Use this option if you have a relatively small target in the image you want to enhance, like a small planetary nebula or a galaxy.If the goal is to have a good alignment across the entire frame, then the precise alignment should remain disabled.
文件: 启用精确对齐可保证特定图像区域以亚像素级别完成配准。当每帧上找到对齐解后，会施加最终的亚像素平移，使所选恒星的质心与对齐图像上对应恒星的质心相匹配。这种方法能有效改善主亮帧中特定区域周边的细节。若你想增强的图像中目标相对较小，例如小的行星状星云或星系，请使用此选项。若目标是整幅画幅都良好对齐，则应保持精确对齐禁用。

文件: 启用精确对齐时，你在参考帧中手动选择一颗将被精确对齐的恒星。启用精确对齐可保证特定图像区域以亚像素级别完成配准。当每帧上找到对齐解后，会施加最终的亚像素平移，使所选恒星的质心与对齐图像上对应恒星的质心相匹配。这种方法能有效改善主亮帧中特定区域周边的细节。若你想增强的图像中目标相对较小，例如小的行星状星云或星系，请使用此选项。若目标是整幅画幅都良好对齐，则应保持精确对齐禁用。

FILE: To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum peak response, respectively. FILE: A reference star must be significantly brighter than any star within its search area. This parameter defines the maximum allowable flux ratio between any star in the search box and the flux of the reference star at its center. To qualify as a reference star, the flux of any other star must be lower than that of the reference star, as specified by this ratio.Decrease this value to prefer reference stars with fewer fainter neighboring stars, down to zero if you require a reference star with no neighboring stars in its search box. Increase this value to be more lenient and allow the presence of more fainter stars in the search box.A value of zero is appropriate for fields that are not overly crowded. Increase this value if the starfield is densely populated, and you must include more reference stars.
文件: 参考星必须明显亮于其搜索区域内的任何恒星。此参数定义搜索框内任何恒星的通量与中心处参考星通量之间允许的最大比值。要成为合格的参考星，其它任何恒星的通量必须低于参考星通量的这一比值。降低此值可优先选择邻近暗星较少的参考星，若你要求参考星搜索框内没有任何邻近恒星，可降到零。提高此值更宽松，允许搜索框内存在更多暗星。值为零适用于不特别拥挤的星场。若星场星点密集、需要纳入更多参考星，则提高此值。

FILE: Enabling the full alignment is fundamental if a discontinuity in the framing is expected in one or more points of the sequence. When the first frame with a significantly different framing has to be aligned, fast integration will fail because the reference stars will not be found in a neigborhood of their expected location; in this case the full alignment may generate a new reference solution that can be propagated to the subsequent frames.The full alignment is also used as a fallback attempt to align a frame using more stars than the ones used by the fast alignment in case the tolerance is not met.This option is enabled by default, but you may disable it for the only purpose of increasing the execution speed at the cost of rejecting more frames when the fast alignment method does not respect the given tolerance.
文件: 若预计序列中一处或多处出现取景不连续，启用完全对齐是必要的。当第一帧取景明显不同的帧需要对齐时，快速叠加会失败，因为在其预期位置附近找不到参考星；此时完全对齐可能生成一个新的参考解，并可传播到后续帧。完全对齐也用作回退尝试：在容差不满足时，用比快速对齐更多的恒星来对齐该帧。此选项默认启用，但你也可以仅为了提升执行速度而禁用它，代价是当快速对齐方法不满足给定容差时会拒绝更多帧。

FILE: In the default automatic mode, FastIntegration will perform a series of tries using a predefined sequence of star counts if the initial attempt to register the images fails. This is the recommended setting. 文件: 在默认的自动模式下，若初次尝试配准图像失败，FastIntegration 会按预定义的恒星数量序列进行一系列尝试。这是推荐设置。要选择自动模式，请把此参数的值指定为零。增加参考星数量一般来说没有必要，通常只会拖慢图像配准过程而不会提升配准精度。但在配准重叠很少的图像（马赛克，或尺度差异很大的图像）时，依各种工作场景可能需要使用缩减或扩大的参考星集合。在这些情况下，自动探测序列通常效果很好，因此正常不需要更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: This parameter can be used to prevent the detection of small and bright image artifacts wrongly as stars. A zero value enables an adaptive algorithm to find an optimal minimum structure size using statistical analysis techniques. This is the default option.* Disabled. A value of one turns off minimum structure size rejection since no detectable star can be represented by less than one pixel.* Literal value. A value > 1 forces using the specified minimum structure size in square pixels.
文件: 此参数可用于避免把微小而明亮的图像伪影错误检测为恒星。处理未校准或校准不良的数据时这很有用，尤其是去马赛克后的 CFA 帧：未校正的热像素会生成中值滤波（即「热像素去除」参数）无法去掉的大块亮伪影；也可用于剔除宇宙线。此参数有三种用法：* 自动模式。值为零时启用自适应算法，用统计分析技术寻找最佳的最小结构尺寸。这是默认选项。* 禁用。值为一时关闭最小结构尺寸剔除，因为任何可检测到的恒星都不可能小于一个像素。* 字面值。值大于一时强制使用指定的最小结构尺寸，单位为平方像素。

FILE: The main drawback of the Lanczos and bicubic spline interpolation algorithms is generation of strong undershoot (ringing) artifacts. This is caused by negative lobes of the interpolation functions falling over high-contrast edges and isolated bright pixels. This usually happens with linear data, such as raw CCD and DSLR images, and rarely with nonlinear or stretched images.In the current PixInsight/PCL implementations of these algorithms we have included a clamping mechanism that prevents negative interpolated values and ringing artifacts for most images. This parameter represents a threshold value to trigger interpolation clamping. A lower threshold leads to a more aggressive deringing effect; however, too low of a clamping threshold can degrade interpolation performance, especially in terms of aliasing and detail preservation.
文件: Lanczos 与双三次样条插值算法的主要缺点是会生成强烈的下冲（振铃）伪影。这是由插值函数的负瓣落在高对比边缘和孤立亮像素上造成的。这通常发生在呈线性的数据上，例如原始 CCD 与单反图像，在非线性或已拉伸的图像上很少见。在目前 PixInsight/PCL 对这些算法的实现中，我们加入了钳制机制，可防止大多数图像出现负的插值值和振铃伪影。此参数表示触发插值钳制的阈值。阈值越低，去环效果越激进；但钳制阈值过低会降低插值性能，尤其是在混叠与细节保留方面。

FILE: Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In FastIntegration, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats (reference and target image files) are loaded, while output hints modify the way output registered image files are written.For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "up-bottom" input hint to load input images from FITS files with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 格式提示可以覆盖特定进程所用图像文件的全局文件格式设置。在 FastIntegration 中，输入提示改变某些特定格式输入图像（参考图像与目标图像文件）的载入方式，输出提示改变输出配准图像文件的写出方式。例如，可以用 "lower-range" 和 "upper-range" 输入提示来载入其他程序生成的、不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。类似地，可以指定 "up-bottom" 输入提示，从坐标原点位于左上角的 FITS 文件载入输入图像。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式都支持若干输入和/或输出提示，可在提供格式提示访问的工具中用于不同目的。

FILE: Internally, the sensitivity of the star detection algorithm is expressed in signal-to-noise ratio units with respect to the evaluated dispersion of local background pixels for each detected structure.
