This is the default working mode.Rescale will rescale the resulting image to the [0,1] range only if there are out-of-range values. In this mode all the output data are preserved, but the dynamics of the original image may change after the inverse Fourier transform.
文件: 忽略：不修改超范围值。此模式下结果图像可能包含无效像素值。除非你知道自己在做什么，否则不要使用此模式。截断：把任何超范围值截断到 [0,1] 范围。此模式下保留图像原有动态范围。这是默认工作模式。重标定：仅当存在超范围值时才把结果图像重标定到 [0,1] 范围。此模式下保留全部输出数据，但逆傅里叶变换后原有动态范围可能改变。

FILE: When the DFT components are modified (for example, to implement a filtering procedure in the frequency domain), sample values outside the normalized [0,1] range can be generated in the resulting image after the inverse Fourier transform. You can handle these out-of-range values in three ways:Don't care will leave out-of-range values unmodified. In this mode, the resulting image may contain invalid pixel values. Do not use this mode unless you know what you are doing.Truncate will truncate any out-of-range values to the [0,1] range. In this mode the original dynamics of the image are preserved. This is the default working mode.Rescale will rescale the resulting image to the [0,1] range only if there are out-of-range values. In this mode all the output data are preserved, but the dynamics of the original image may change after the inverse Fourier transform.
文件: 当 DFT 分量被修改（例如在频域实现滤波过程）后，逆傅里叶变换后的结果图像中可能产生超出归一化 [0,1] 范围的样本值。可以用三种方式处理这些超范围值：忽略：不修改超范围值。此模式下结果图像可能包含无效像素值。除非你知道自己在做什么，否则不要使用此模式。截断：把任何超范围值截断到 [0,1] 范围。此模式下保留图像原有动态范围。这是默认工作模式。重标定：仅当存在超范围值时才把结果图像重标定到 [0,1] 范围。此模式下保留全部输出数据，但逆傅里叶变换后原有动态范围可能改变。

FILE: Specify how to handle out-of-range results after the inverse Fourier transform.When the DFT components are modified (for example, to implement a filtering procedure in the frequency domain), sample values outside the normalized [0,1] range can be generated in the resulting image after the inverse Fourier transform. You can handle these out-of-range values in three ways:Don't care will leave out-of-range values unmodified. In this mode, the resulting image may contain invalid pixel values. Do not use this mode unless you know what you are doing.Truncate will truncate any out-of-range values to the [0,1] range. In this mode the original dynamics of the image are preserved. This is the default working mode.Rescale will rescale the resulting image to the [0,1] range only if there are out-of-range values. In this mode all the output data are preserved, but the dynamics of the original image may change after the inverse Fourier transform.
文件: 指定如何处逆傅里叶变换后的超范围结果。当 DFT 分量被修改（例如在频域实现滤波过程）后，逆傅里叶变换后的结果图像中可能产生超出归一化 [0,1] 范围的样本值。可以用三种方式处理这些超范围值：忽略：不修改超范围值。此模式下结果图像可能包含无效像素值。除非你知道自己在做什么，否则不要使用此模式。截断：把任何超范围值截断到 [0,1] 范围。此模式下保留图像原有动态范围。这是默认工作模式。重标定：仅当存在超范围值时才把结果图像重标定到 [0,1] 范围。此模式下保留全部输出数据，但逆傅里叶变换后原有动态范围可能改变。

FILE: Controls the amount of stretch. D is a variable that independently controls the contrast added (the slope of the stretch transform) at SP, thus adjusting the amount of stretch applied to the rest of the image. D does not change the 'form' of the stretch, simply the amount. D should be used in tandem with b to control the distribution of contrast and brightness. When D is set to zero, the stretch transform will be the identity (y=x) or 'no stretch' transform.
文件: 控制拉伸量。D 是一个独立控制 SP 处所增加对比度（拉伸变换的斜率）的变量，从而调整施加到图像其余部分的拉伸量。D 不改变拉伸的「形式」，只改变量。D 应与 b 配合使用，以控制对比度与亮度分布。当 D 设为零时，拉伸变换就是恒等变换（y=x），即「不拉伸」。

FILE: Sets the Blackpoint for a linear stretch of the image. Note that any pixel with values less than the Blackpoint input will be clipped and the data lost. Contrast gained by performing the linear stretch will be evenly distributed over the image, which will be dimmed. Pixels with values less than the Blackpoint will appear black and have 0 value. Updating this parameter will automatically update the low clipping proportion. Setting this parameter to a value less than 0 will extend the dynamic range at the low end.
文件: 设置图像线性拉伸的黑点。注意任何值小于黑点输入的像素都会被裁剪，数据丢失。线性拉伸所获得的对比度会均匀分布到整幅图像上，图像会变暗。值小于黑点的像素呈黑色，值为 0。更新此参数会自动更新低端裁剪比例。把此参数设为小于 0 的值会扩展低端动态范围。

FILE: Sets the Whitepoint for a linear stretch of the image. Note that any pixel with value greater than the Whitepoint input will be clipped and the data lost. Contrast gained by performing the linear stretch will be evenly distributed over the image, which will be brightened. Pixels with values greater than the Whitepoint will appear white and have a value of 1.0. Updating this parameter will automatically update the high clipping proportion. Setting this parameter to a value greater than 1 will extend the dynamic range at the high end.
文件: 设置图像线性拉伸的白点。注意任何值大于白点输入的像素都会被裁剪，数据丢失。线性拉伸所获得的对比度会均匀分布到整幅图像上，图像会变亮。值大于白点的像素呈白色，值为 1.0。更新此参数会自动更新高端裁剪比例。把此参数设为大于 1 的值会扩展高端动态范围。

FILE: Sets the clipping level for linear stretch of the image. Updating this parameter will automatically update the Blackpoint parameter in such a way that LCP is the maximum fraction of pixels clipped in any channel and set to zero in the linear stretch. Note that any pixel with values less than the Blackpoint input will be clipped and the data lost. Contrast gained by performing the linear stretch will be evenly distributed over the image, which will be dimmed. Pixels with values less than the Blackpoint will appear black and have 0 value.
文件: 设置图像线性拉伸的裁剪水平。更新此参数会自动调整黑点参数，使 LCP 成为线性拉伸中任何通道被裁剪并置零的像素最大比例。注意任何值小于黑点输入的像素都会被裁剪，数据丢失。线性拉伸所获得的对比度会均匀分布到整幅图像上，图像会变暗。值小于黑点的像素呈黑色，值为 0。

FILE: Sets the focus point around which the stretch is applied - contrast will be distributed symmetrically about SP. While 'b' provides the degree of focus of the stretch, SP determines where that focus is applied. SP should generally be placed within a histogram peak so that the stretch will widen and lower the peak by adding the most contrast in the stretch at that point. Pixel values will move away from the SP location. This parameter must be greater than or equal to the Shadow protection parameter and less than or equal to the Highlight protection parameter.
文件: 设置施加拉伸所围绕的焦点 —— 对比度会以 SP 为中心对称分布。b 给出拉伸的聚焦程度，SP 则决定这一聚焦施加在何处。SP 一般应放在直方图峰值内，这样拉伸会在该点增加最多对比度，从而展宽并压低峰值。像素值会向远离 SP 的位置移动。此参数必须大于或等于「暗部保护」参数，且小于或等于「高光保护」参数。

FILE: Sets the upper clipping level for linear stretch of the image. Updating this parameter will automatically update the Whitepoint parameter in such a way that HCP is the maximum fraction of pixels clipped in any channel and set to 1.0 in the linear stretch. Note that any pixel with value greater than the Whitepoint input will be clipped and the data lost. Contrast gained by performing the linear stretch will be evenly distributed over the image, which will be brightened. Pixels with values greater than the Whitepoint will appear white and have a value of 1.0.
文件: 设置图像线性拉伸的上端裁剪水平。更新此参数会自动调整白点参数，使 HCP 成为线性拉伸中任何通道被裁剪并置为 1.0 的像素最大比例。注意任何值大于白点输入的像素都会被裁剪，数据丢失。线性拉伸所获得的对比度会均匀分布到整幅图像上，图像会变亮。值大于白点的像素呈白色，值为 1.0。

FILE: This parameter specifies how the transformation is to be applied to colour images. Colour ImagesThe transformation can be applied to one of the R, G or B channels alone, or to all three. It can also be applied to the CIE Lightness channel or the Saturation. The final Colour option will stretch all three RGB channels by the same factor calculated by reference to the weighted average of the RGB values. This reflects the approach used in the standard arcsinh process.Greyscale ImagesThis parameter, along with all the other colour option parameters, is ignored when the process is applied to a greyscale image.
文件: 此参数指定变换如何施加到彩色图像。彩色图像：变换可以只施加到 R、G、B 中的一个通道，也可以施加到全部三个通道。还可以施加到 CIE 明度通道或饱和度。最后的「彩色」选项会按 RGB 值的加权平均算出的同一因子拉伸全部三个 RGB 通道，这与标准 arcsinh 进程所采用的做法一致。灰度图像：当进程作用于灰度图像时，此参数以及其它所有彩色选项参数都会被忽略。

FILE: This parameter specifies what to do when undertaking a colour stretch if any channels relating to a specific pixel stretch to a value greater than 1. Clip: will simply clip all channels greater than 1 for that pixel back to 1. Rescale: will scale all three channels for that pixel down by the ratio 1/max(R,G,B). RGBBlend will blend in sufficient of an RGB stretch into that pixel to ensure all channels are not greater than 1. RescaleGlobal will find the maximum transformed R, G or B value across all pixels in the image, maxValue say, then all sample values across the entire image will be rescaled by 1/maxValue.
文件: 此参数指定在彩色拉伸中，若某像素相关的任何通道被拉伸到大于 1 的值时如何处理。裁剪：把该像素所有大于 1 的通道直接裁剪回 1。重标定：把该像素的三个通道全部按 1/max(R,G,B) 的比例缩小。RGBBlend：向该像素混入足够的 RGB 拉伸量，以确保所有通道都不大于 1。全局重标定：先找出整幅图像中变换后 R、G、B 的最大值（记为 maxValue），然后把整幅图像所有样本值按 1/maxValue 重标定。

FILE: Sets a value above which the stretch is modified to preserve contrast in the highlights/stars. This is done by performing a linear stretch of the data above the 'HP' level by reserving contrast from the rest of the image. Moving the HP level towards the current setting of SP increases both the scope (range) and the amount of this contrast reservation, the net effect is to push the overal stretch to lower brightness levels while keeping the contrast and definition in the highlights. The amount of contrast reserved for the highlights is such that the continuity of the stretch is preserved. This parameter must be less than or equal to 1 and not less than the Symmetry point.
文件: 设置一个值，高于它的拉伸会被修改以保留高光/恒星中的对比度。做法是对高于 'HP' 水平的数据做线性拉伸，从图像其余部分预留对比度。把 HP 水平移向当前的 SP 设置，会同时增大这种对比度预留的范围与数量，净效果是把整体拉伸推向更低的亮度水平，同时保持高光的对比度与清晰度。为高光预留的对比度数量以保持拉伸连续性为准。此参数必须小于或等于 1，且不小于对称点。

FILE: Sets a value below which the stretch is modified to preserve contrast in the shadows/lowlights. This is done by performing a linear stretch of the data below the 'LP' level by reserving contrast from the rest of the image. Moving the LP level towards the current setting of SP changes both the scope (range) and the amount of this contrast reservation, the net effect is to push the overal stretch to higher brightness levels while keeping the contrast and definition in the background. The amount of contrast reserved for the lowlights is such that the continuity of the stretch is preserved. This parameter must be greater than or equal to 0 and not greater than the Symmetry point.
文件: 设置一个值，低于它的拉伸会被修改以保留暗部/低光中的对比度。做法是对低于 'LP' 水平的数据做线性拉伸，从图像其余部分预留对比度。把 LP 水平移向当前的 SP 设置，会同时改变这种对比度预留的范围与数量，净效果是把整体拉伸推向更高的亮度水平，同时保持背景的对比度与清晰度。为低光预留的对比度数量以保持拉伸连续性为准。此参数必须大于或等于 0，且不大于对称点。

FILE: Controls how tightly focused the stretch is around the Symetry point by changing the form of the transform itself. For concentrated stretches (such as initial stretches on linear images) a large +ve b factor should be employed to focus a stretch within a histogram peak while de-focusing the stretch away from the histogram peak (such as bright stars). For adjustment of non-linear images, lower or -ve b (and/or lower D) parameters should be employed to distribute contrast and brightness more evenly. Large positive values of 'b' can be thought of as a histogram widener, ie spreading the histogram wider about the focus point, SP. By contrast, lower and -ve values of b tend to shift the histogram to a brighter (or dimmer) position without affecting its width too greatly. As a general rule, the level of b employed will decrease as a stretch sequence nears completion, although larger +ve b values (with small D) can still be employed for precise placement of additional contrast.
文件: 通过改变变换本身的形式，控制拉伸围绕对称点的聚焦紧密程度。对于集中式拉伸（例如线性图像上的初始拉伸），应使用较大的正 b 因子，使拉伸聚焦在直方图峰值内，而在远离直方图峰值处（例如亮星）失去聚焦。对于非线性图像的调整，应使用较小或负的 b（和/或较小的 D）参数，让对比度与亮度分布更均匀。可以把较大的正 b 值理解为直方图展宽器，即在焦点 SP 周围把直方图摊得更宽。相反，较小与负的 b 值倾向于把直方图整体移到更亮（或更暗）的位置而不会大幅改变其宽度。总体规则是：随着拉伸序列接近完成，所用的 b 水平会下降，不过仍可用较大的正 b 值（配合较小的 D）来精确放置额外的对比度。

FILE: This is the time interval in seconds between settings auto-save events. Set it to zero to turn off the settings auto-save feature.The settings auto-save feature minimizes the risk of losing important changes to preferences, module and script settings in case of a system or software crash. This feature only writes disk files when settings properties are modified and has virtually zero impact on performance.
文件: 这是设置自动保存事件之间的时间间隔，单位为秒。设为零可关闭设置自动保存功能。设置自动保存功能可最大限度降低系统或软件崩溃时丢失首选项、模块与脚本设置重要更改的风险。此功能只在设置属性被修改时写磁盘文件，对性能几乎没有影响。

FILE: http://doc.qt.io/qt-5/resources.htmlCore resource files are only loaded upon application startup. Changes to this parameter will take place the next time PixInsight is executed.* Warning * Replacing standard core resources with invalid ones may yield an unusable core application, and/or cause problems with distributed modules and scripts. DO NOT change this parameter if you are not sure of what you are doing.
文件: http://doc.qt.io/qt-5/resources.html 核心资源文件只在应用程序启动时载入。对此参数的更改会在下次运行 PixInsight 时生效。* 警告 * 用无效资源替换标准核心资源可能导致核心应用程序无法使用，和/或引起分发模块与脚本的问题。若不确定自己在做什么，请勿更改此参数。

FILE: When the automatic UI scaling option is disabled, you can specify a manual scaling factor in the range [1,4].Core UI scaling parameters are only fetched upon application startup. Changes to this parameter will take place the next time PixInsight is executed.* Warning * Specifying a wrong scaling factor may yield an unusable core application. DO NOT change this parameter if you are not sure of what you are doing.
文件: 当自动 UI 缩放选项被禁用时，可以指定 [1,4] 范围内的人工缩放因子。核心 UI 缩放参数只在应用程序启动时获取。对此参数的更改会在下次运行 PixInsight 时生效。* 警告 * 指定错误的缩放因子可能导致核心应用程序无法使用。若不确定自己在做什么，请勿更改此参数。

FILE: When this option is enabled, XML settings files will be generated without superfluous whitespace and newline characters, making the XML source code significantly smaller and marginally more efficient for encoding/decoding operations. With minification disabled, XML tags will be separated with newline characters and indented with spaces, making the source code readable and easily editable for maintenance purposes.
文件: 启用此选项后，生成的 XML 设置文件会去掉多余的空格与换行字符，使 XML 源码显著更小，编码/解码操作效率略有提升。禁用压缩时，XML 标签之间以换行分隔并用空格缩进，源码便于阅读和编辑维护。

FILE: Enable this option to allow PixInsight to use multiple threads and processors for all tasks. This is a global setting; to enable/disable multiple threads for specific tasks, see the following options.If this option is disabled, PixInsight will use only a single processor for all tasks, regardless of the states of other specific settings.* Warning * Disabling this option may degrade overall performance dramatically.
文件: 启用此选项可允许 PixInsight 在所有任务中使用多线程与多处理器。这是全局设置；要为特定任务启用/禁用多线程，请见下面的选项。若禁用此选项，PixInsight 会在所有任务中只使用单个处理器，无论其它具体设置的状态如何。* 警告 * 禁用此选项可能严重降低整体性能。

FILE: Generate image identifiers automatically using the identifier template. See the reference documentation for complete information on identifier templates and their use in automatic generation of image identifiers.When this option is enabled, and the identifier template is valid, automatic identifier generation takes precedence over other options for image identifier generation, such as Use file names as image identifiers.
文件: 使用标识符模板自动生成图像标识符。标识符模板及其在自动生成图像标识符中的用法详见参考文档。启用此选项且模板有效时，自动生成标识符优先于其它图像标识符生成选项，例如「使用文件名作为图像标识符」。

FILE: When this option is enabled, PixInsight gathers process and script execution statistics automatically. This includes, among other items, the total number of times a process or featured script has been executed, the date and time of the last execution, and the total execution time. This option must be enabled for the Recently Used and Most Used tree items to be shown on Process Explorer. This option is enabled by default.
文件: 启用此选项后，PixInsight 会自动收集进程与脚本的执行统计。其中包括进程或特色脚本被执行的总次数、最后执行的日期与时间以及总执行时间等。要「进程资源管理器」显示「最近使用」与「最常使用」树项，必须启用此选项。此选项默认启用。

FILE: Enable this option to compress image swap files. In the current versions of PixInsight, swap files are compressed using a multithreaded implementation of the LZ4 fast lossless compression algorithm with byte shuffling. This allows for real-time compression/decompression of swap data for moderately sized images. Swap file compression can provide significant disk space savings with minimal impact on I/O throughoutput in most cases.
文件: 启用此选项可压缩图像交换文件。在目前版本的 PixInsight 中，交换文件使用多线程实现的 LZ4 快速无损压缩算法（带字节混洗）压缩。这样对中等尺寸图像可以实时压缩/解压交换数据。交换文件压缩在多数情况下能显著节省磁盘空间，而对 I/O 吞吐量影响极小。

FILE: The prompt of the Process Console command line.Current directory shows the current working directory followed by '>', as in ~/images>Simple prompt shows just a '>' character. This is the default option.Instance slot shows the slot number of the running PixInsight instance, from 1 to 256, followed by '>', as in 1>. This identifies the instance when several are running.The prompt style can also be selected with the prompt console command.
文件: 进程控制台命令行的提示符。「当前目录」显示当前工作目录后跟 '>'，如 ~/images>。「简单提示符」只显示一个 '>' 字符。这是默认选项。「实例槽位」显示运行中 PixInsight 实例的槽位编号（1 到 256）后跟 '>'，如 1>。多个实例运行时可用它区分。提示符样式也可以用 prompt 控制台命令选择。

FILE: When this option is enabled, PixInsight gathers process launch statistics automatically. A process is launched when one of its associated interfaces is opened. Launch statistics include, among other items, the total number of times a process has been launched and the date and time of the last launch. This option must be enabled for the Recently Used and Most Used tree items to be shown on Process Explorer. This option is enabled by default.
文件: 启用此选项后，PixInsight 会自动收集进程启动统计。当某个进程的任一关联界面被打开时，即视为该进程被启动。启动统计包括进程被启动的总次数与最后启动的日期和时间等。要「进程资源管理器」显示「最近使用」与「最常使用」树项，必须启用此选项。此选项默认启用。

FILE: Export XML filters database. Writes the current filter definitions to the specified output file in XSPD format.Export CSV filter definitions. Writes current filter definitions as individual CSV files (with .csv extension) on the specified output directory.Merge with default filters. Merge current filter definitions with the factory default filter set.Set default filters. Reset current filter definitions back to the factory default filter set.
文件: 导出 XML 滤镜数据库。把当前滤镜定义以 XSPD 格式写入指定的输出文件。导出 CSV 滤镜定义。把当前滤镜定义以单个 CSV 文件（扩展名 .csv）写入指定的输出目录。与默认滤镜合并。把当前滤镜定义与出厂默认滤镜集合合并。设为默认滤镜。把当前滤镜定义重置回出厂默认滤镜集合。

FILE: Enable acceleration with GPU devices when available. This applies to all image processing, image analysis, numerical computation and image rendition tasks performed by the PixInsight core application and all installed modules, as applicable.This option is only operational on Linux and Windows. It is always ignored on FreeBSD and macOS, where GPU acceleration is not available.Note: GPU acceleration still not available - coming soon... stay tuned!
文件: 在有可用 GPU 设备时启用 GPU 加速。这适用于 PixInsight 核心应用程序及所有已安装模块所执行的全部图像处理、图像分析、数值计算与图像渲染任务（视适用情况而定）。此选项仅在 Linux 与 Windows 上有效。在 FreeBSD 与 macOS 上总被忽略，因为那里没有 GPU 加速可用。注：GPU 加速仍不可用 —— 即将推出……敬请期待！

FILE: Perform an initialization of the GPU compute runtime upon application startup. This includes scanning for all CUDA-capable GPU devices available, device selection based on performance criteria, and an initial device warm up kernel execution.This option is only operational on Linux and Windows. It is always ignored on FreeBSD and macOS, where GPU acceleration is not available.Note: GPU acceleration still not available - coming soon... stay tuned!
文件: 在应用程序启动时对 GPU 计算运行时做初始化。包括扫描所有可用的支持 CUDA 的 GPU 设备、按性能标准选择设备，以及初始的设备预热内核执行。此选项仅在 Linux 与 Windows 上有效。在 FreeBSD 与 macOS 上总被忽略，因为那里没有 GPU 加速可用。注：GPU 加速仍不可用 —— 即将推出……敬请期待！

FILE: Keep normally persistent data in volatile memory when using the integrated web browser component, leaving no trace on disk. This includes cookies, the HTTP cache (documents, images, etc), and the browsing history.Changes to this option will be applied to subsequently created web browser windows. Existing WebView controls and the browsers integrated with the Process Explorer and Object Explorer windows will require an application restart for changes to take effect.
文件: 使用集成网页浏览器组件时，把通常持久化的数据保存在易失内存中，不在磁盘留痕。这包括 cookies、HTTP 缓存（文档、图像等）以及浏览历史。对此选项的更改会应用于随后创建的浏览器窗口。已存在的 WebView 控件以及与进程资源管理器、对象资源管理器窗口集成的浏览器需要重启应用程序后更改才会生效。

FILE: Allow update repositories using insecure network protocols (HTTP or FTP).Authenticity of downloaded update packages cannot be guaranteed when insecure connections are used, which is a serious security risk. The HTTPS and FTPS protocols are strongly recommended and will be mandatory in a future version of PixInsight. Use of insecure connections is still allowed, but at your own risk.If this option is disabled, only the secure HTTPS and FTPS protocols will be allowed.
文件: 允许使用不安全网络协议（HTTP 或 FTP）的更新仓库。使用不安全连接时，下载的更新包的真实性无法保证，这是严重的安全风险。强烈推荐 HTTPS 与 FTPS 协议，它们将在 PixInsight 的未来版本中成为强制要求。目前仍允许使用不安全连接，但风险自负。若禁用此选项，则只允许安全的 HTTPS 与 FTPS 协议。

FILE: The position of the Celestial Intermediate Pole (CIP) in the International Terrestrial Reference System (ITRS) is necessary to compute polar motion corrections applied to topocentric coordinates of solar system bodies. These corrections are relevant for the topocentric position of the Moon at the milliarcsecond level.In current versions of PixInsight the CIP_ITRS database is a plain text file generated with values provided by the IERS Rapid Service/Prediction Center.
文件: 天体中间极（CIP）在国际地球参考系统（ITRS）中的位置，是计算施加于太阳系天体站心坐标的极移改正所必需的。这些改正对月球站心位置的毫角秒级精度有影响。在目前版本的 PixInsight 中，CIP_ITRS 数据库是一个纯文本文件，其中的数值由 IERS 快速服务/预报中心提供。

FILE: This is the directory where PixInsight will store all downloaded files.* Note * This option only applies to core network operations, such as files downloaded with the File > Open Location menu item, the open command, and the update system, among others. It does not apply to the integrated web browser component.* Warning * Ensure that there is enough free space on the storage device that supports this directory on the local filesystem, or download operations may fail.
文件: 这是 PixInsight 存储所有已下载文件的目录。* 注 * 此选项只适用于核心网络操作，例如用「文件 > 打开位置」菜单项、open 命令以及更新系统等下载的文件。不适用于集成网页浏览器组件。* 警告 * 请确保本地文件系统中承载此目录的存储设备有足够可用空间，否则下载操作可能失败。

FILE: Since core version 1.9.3 Lockhart, this option is disabled by default and its use is discouraged. Meaningful identifiers should be automatically generated from existing metadata using templates, or the default identifiers defined by our standard tools and preprocessing scripts should be used. When no identifiers are available, you should define them manually. Identifiers are embedded as image properties in XISF files and loaded automatically when the images are opened.
文件: 自核心版本 1.9.3 Lockhart 起，此选项默认禁用，且不鼓励使用。有意义的标识符应使用模板从已有元数据自动生成，或使用我们的标准工具与预处理脚本定义的默认标识符。若没有可用标识符，则应手动定义。标识符作为图像属性嵌入 XISF 文件中，并在图像打开时自动载入。

FILE: Generate wallpaper images using high-quality SVG rendering routines with antialiased graphics and diffusion dithering applied to gradients. If you disable this feature, wallpapers generated from SVG documents may show strong posterization artifacts. This option is enabled by default.This option is only applicable to wallpapers generated from SVG files. Raster graphics are always rendered directly without manipulation, besides the necessary scaling to fill the primary screen.
文件: 使用高质量 SVG 渲染例程生成壁纸图像，带抗锯齿图形并对渐变施加扩散抖动。若禁用此功能，由 SVG 文档生成的壁纸可能出现强烈的色调分离伪影。此选项默认启用。此选项仅适用于由 SVG 文件生成的壁纸。光栅图形总是直接渲染而不做处理，只做填充主屏幕所需的缩放。

FILE: For information on the Qt resource system, please refer to the following document:http://doc.qt.io/qt-5/resources.htmlCore resource files are only loaded upon application startup. Changes to this parameter will take place the next time PixInsight is executed.* Warning * Replacing standard core resources with invalid ones may yield an unusable core application, and/or cause problems with distributed modules and scripts. DO NOT change this parameter if you are not sure of what you are doing.
文件: 关于 Qt 资源系统的信息，请参阅以下文档：http://doc.qt.io/qt-5/resources.html 核心资源文件只在应用程序启动时载入。对此参数的更改会在下次运行 PixInsight 时生效。* 警告 * 用无效资源替换标准核心资源可能导致核心应用程序无法使用，和/或引起分发模块与脚本的问题。若不确定自己在做什么，请勿更改此参数。

FILE: Enabling this option on macOS with capable hardware may slow down screen image renditions, since the volume of the generated pixel data is four times the volume required when working with logical pixels. Furthermore, when this option is enabled, certain optimizations that can yield faster screen renditions have to be disabled. If you experience slow screen performance working with big images, especially on slow machines, you can turn off this option to improve speed at the expense of representation quality.
文件: 在硬件支持的 macOS 上启用此选项可能拖慢屏幕图像渲染，因为生成的像素数据量是使用逻辑像素时的四倍。此外启用此选项后，某些能加快屏幕渲染的优化必须被禁用。若你在处理大图像时遇到屏幕性能变慢，尤其是在较慢的机器上，可以关闭此选项以提升速度，代价是显示质量下降。

FILE: * Important * Many critical operations depend on fast sequential access to very large files on the PixInsight platform. For this reason, a highly fragmented filesystem may degrade performance. Under MS Windows (both FAT and NTFS filesystems), it is very important to avoid heavy disk fragmentation by running the defrag utility (or equivalent) on a regular basis. Under UNIX/Linux and macOS, there are no fragmentation problems because the native filesystems on these platforms prevent fragmentation automatically.
文件: * 重要 * PixInsight 平台上的许多关键操作依赖于对超大文件的快速顺序访问。因此，碎片严重的文件系统可能降低性能。在 MS Windows（FAT 与 NTFS 文件系统）下，定期运行碎片整理工具（或等效工具）以避免磁盘严重碎片非常重要。在 UNIX/Linux 与 macOS 下不存在碎片问题，因为这些平台上的原生文件系统会自动防止碎片。

FILE: The default value of 8 threads is usually a good starting point for most SSD units. The optimal value depends on specific hardware and software conditions and should be found through benchmarks. It is usually in the range from 4 to 32 threads.For rotational hard disk drives (HDD) parallel file I/O operations may incur in severe performance penalties. If you are using one of these obsolete devices with PixInsight (which is not recommended) you normally should set this parameter to its minimum value of one thread.
文件: 默认值 8 个线程对多数 SSD 通常是个不错的起点。最优值取决于具体硬件与软件条件，应通过基准测试确定。通常落在 4 到 32 个线程之间。对于旋转式机械硬盘（HDD），并行文件 I/O 操作可能造成严重的性能损失。若你在 PixInsight 中使用这类过时设备（不推荐），通常应把此参数设为其最小值一个线程。

FILE: Enable this option to allow PixInsight to follow HTTP redirections, even if they point to a different server than the one specified in the original URL.* Note * This option only applies to core network operations, such as files downloaded with the File > Open Location menu item, the open command, and the update system, among others. It does not apply to the integrated web browser component.* Warning * Enabling this option is potentially dangerous. DO NOT enable it if you are not absolutely sure of what you are doing.
文件: 启用此选项可允许 PixInsight 跟随 HTTP 重定向，即使它们指向与原始 URL 中指定的服务器不同的服务器。* 注 * 此选项只适用于核心网络操作，例如用「文件 > 打开位置」菜单项、open 命令以及更新系统等下载的文件。不适用于集成网页浏览器组件。* 警告 * 启用此选项有潜在危险。若不确定自己在做什么，请勿启用。

FILE: Mask rendering modes define how masked pixels are represented on bitmap renditions of images. The traditional mode used by PixInsight has always been Multiply, which simply multiplies each pixel of a screen rendition by its mask image counterpart.Since PixInsight version 1.5.5, an additional set of overlay mask rendering modes is available, providing more accurate representations in several user-selectable colors. A new Replace mode has also been implemented to facilitate blinking comparisons between images and masks.
文件: 蒙版渲染模式定义被蒙版像素在图像位图渲染中的表示方式。PixInsight 一直使用的传统模式是「相乘」，即把屏幕渲染的每个像素简单乘以其蒙版图像的对应像素。自 PixInsight 1.5.5 起，另有一组叠加蒙版渲染模式可用，可用几种用户可选的颜色提供更准确的表示。还实现了新的「替换」模式，便于在图像与蒙版之间做闪烁比较。

FILE: Enable this option to obtain information about network operations on PixInsight's stdout. Currently this only works under UNIX/Linux and macOS.* Note * This option only applies to core network operations, such as files downloaded with the File > Open Location menu item, the open command, and the update system, among others. It does not apply to the integrated web browser component.* Warning * Be aware that sensitive information, including user passwords and IP addresses, can be written to stdout as part of the generated reports.
文件: 启用此选项可在 PixInsight 的 stdout 上获取网络操作信息。目前这仅在 UNIX/Linux 与 macOS 下有效。* 注 * 此选项只适用于核心网络操作，例如用「文件 > 打开位置」菜单项、open 命令以及更新系统等下载的文件。不适用于集成网页浏览器组件。* 警告 * 请注意，敏感信息（包括用户密码与 IP 地址）可能作为所生成报告的一部分被写入 stdout。

FILE: Delta T is the difference TT-UT1 in seconds. In current versions of PixInsight the Delta T database is a plain text file generated with values taken from reference data provided by the IERS Rapid Service/Prediction Center for the period from 1657 to the current year (plus a few extrapolated values).Outside of the period from 1657 to the current year, the PixInsight/PCL implementation uses polynomial expressions taken from Five Millennium Canon of Solar Eclipses, by Fred Espenak and Jean Meeus (NASA/TP-2006-214141, Revision 1.0, 2007).
文件: Delta T 是 TT-UT1 的差，单位为秒。在目前版本的 PixInsight 中，Delta T 数据库是一个纯文本文件，其中的数值取自 IERS 快速服务/预报中心提供的参考数据，覆盖 1657 年到当年（外加若干外推值）。在 1657 年到当年之外的时间段，PixInsight/PCL 实现使用取自 Fred Espenak 与 Jean Meeus 所著《Five Millennium Canon of Solar Eclipses》（NASA/TP-2006-214141，修订版 1.0，2007）的多项式表达式。

FILE: Maximum number of text lines that can be stored by the process console. When the number of text lines in the console exceeds from this limit, old lines are removed from the beginning of the console before writing new ones. This greatly improves efficiency of console text output, especially during long batch processes, and also improves normal processes after a long time without clearing the console.Specify a value of zero to disable this limit and allow an unlimited number of text lines in the console. The default value is 1000 lines.
文件: 进程控制台可存储的最大文本行数。当控制台中的文本行数超过此限制时，在写入新行之前会从控制台开头移除旧行。这能极大提升控制台文本输出的效率，尤其是在长时间批处理过程中，也能改善长时间未清空控制台后的普通进程表现。把此值指定为零可禁用此限制，允许控制台存储不限数量的文本行。默认值为 1000 行。

FILE: Contain all workspace windows, including process interface windows and dialogs, in the main window, instead of showing them as separate windows on the desktop.This mode is the default on all platforms, and is always used on Wayland, where applications cannot place their own windows. On the other platforms it can be disabled to use separate windows on the desktop. Changing this option takes effect the next time the PixInsight core application starts. The --contained-windows and --no-contained-windows command-line arguments change it as well.
文件: 把所有工作区窗口（包括进程界面窗口与对话框）包含在主窗口内，而不是把它们作为独立窗口显示在桌面上。此模式是所有平台的默认设置，并且在 Wayland 上总是使用（那里应用程序无法自行放置窗口）。在其它平台上可以禁用它，以在桌面上使用独立窗口。更改此选项会在 PixInsight 核心应用程序下次启动时生效。--contained-windows 与 --no-contained-windows 命令行参数也会改变它。

FILE: Path to the global database file of CIP positions referred to the ITRS (plain text).The position of the Celestial Intermediate Pole (CIP) in the International Terrestrial Reference System (ITRS) is necessary to compute polar motion corrections applied to topocentric coordinates of solar system bodies. These corrections are relevant for the topocentric position of the Moon at the milliarcsecond level.In current versions of PixInsight the CIP_ITRS database is a plain text file generated with values provided by the IERS Rapid Service/Prediction Center.
文件: 参照 ITRS 的 CIP 位置全局数据库文件（纯文本）的路径。天体中间极（CIP）在国际地球参考系统（ITRS）中的位置，是计算施加于太阳系天体站心坐标的极移改正所必需的。这些改正对月球站心位置的毫角秒级精度有影响。在目前版本的 PixInsight 中，CIP_ITRS 数据库是一个纯文本文件，其中的数值由 IERS 快速服务/预报中心提供。

FILE: Watch the folders shown by file dialogs and the File Explorer, and the files open in the Script Editor, so that changes made by other applications are shown at once. File dialogs only watch their folders while they are open.Disable this option if a network share, an external drive or another file system works badly or becomes slow with file change notifications. Without file watching, file dialogs list their folders again each time they are opened, and the Reload command (F5) shows later changes.This option does not apply to the FileWatcher objects of scripts.
文件: 监视文件对话框与文件浏览器所显示的文件夹，以及脚本编辑器中打开的文件，使其它应用程序所做的更改立即显示。文件对话框只在打开期间监视其文件夹。若某个网络共享、外部驱动器或其它文件系统在文件变更通知下表现异常或变慢，请禁用此选项。不监视文件时，文件对话框每次打开都会重新列出其文件夹，而「重新载入」命令（F5）可显示后续更改。此选项不适用于脚本的 FileWatcher 对象。

FILE: The Default option applies a logical order where the first button always corresponds to the least potentially dangerous choice. For example, on a message box where the user has to answer a question like Do you really want to lose all changes?, the order of buttons would be No and Yes. The order would be Yes and No for a question such as Save the modified image?. This is the default behavior of message boxes in PixInsight since core version 1.8.9-2. This behavior assumes the user reads questions and button labels before making decisions.The Yes/No and No/Yes options force the specified button orders.
文件: 「默认」选项采用逻辑顺序：第一个按钮总是对应潜在危险最小的选择。例如，在一个要求用户回答「确定要放弃所有更改吗？」这类问题的消息框中，按钮顺序会是「否」和「是」。而对于「是否保存修改后的图像？」这类问题，顺序则是「是」和「否」。这是自核心版本 1.8.9-2 起 PixInsight 消息框的默认行为。此行为假设用户在做出决定前会阅读问题与按钮标签。「是/否」与「否/是」选项则强制指定按钮顺序。

FILE: Path to the global database file of observed Delta T values (plain text).Delta T is the difference TT-UT1 in seconds. In current versions of PixInsight the Delta T database is a plain text file generated with values taken from reference data provided by the IERS Rapid Service/Prediction Center for the period from 1657 to the current year (plus a few extrapolated values).Outside of the period from 1657 to the current year, the PixInsight/PCL implementation uses polynomial expressions taken from Five Millennium Canon of Solar Eclipses, by Fred Espenak and Jean Meeus (NASA/TP-2006-214141, Revision 1.0, 2007).
文件: 观测 Delta T 值的全局数据库文件（纯文本）的路径。Delta T 是 TT-UT1 的差，单位为秒。在目前版本的 PixInsight 中，Delta T 数据库是一个纯文本文件，其中的数值取自 IERS 快速服务/预报中心提供的参考数据，覆盖 1657 年到当年（外加若干外推值）。在 1657 年到当年之外的时间段，PixInsight/PCL 实现使用取自 Fred Espenak 与 Jean Meeus 所著《Five Millennium Canon of Solar Eclipses》（NASA/TP-2006-214141，修订版 1.0，2007）的多项式表达式。

FILE: Resolution in dots per inch (dpi) for automatic conversion of point dimensions to scaled pixel dimensions. This parameter will be applied for automatic scaling of core font resources in a platform-independent way. This parameter can be useful to fine tune core font rendering. The default value is 100 dpi.Core UI scaling parameters are only fetched upon application startup. Changes to this parameter will take place the next time PixInsight is executed.* Warning * Specifying wrong UI scaling settings may yield an unusable core application. DO NOT change this parameter if you are not sure of what you are doing.
文件: 用于把点尺寸自动换算为缩放像素尺寸的分辨率，单位为 dpi。此参数会以平台无关的方式应用于核心字体资源的自动缩放。此参数可用于微调核心字体渲染。默认值为 100 dpi。核心 UI 缩放参数只在应用程序启动时获取。对此参数的更改会在下次运行 PixInsight 时生效。* 警告 * 指定错误的 UI 缩放设置可能导致核心应用程序无法使用。若不确定自己在做什么，请勿更改此参数。

FILE: With style sheets, you can literally transform the whole PixInsight platform to adapt it to your needs and taste, giving it a personal look and feel of your choice. For full information on Qt style sheets and their syntax, we recommend the following section of the official Qt reference documentation:http://doc.qt.io/qt-5/stylesheet.htmlThe core style sheet file is only loaded upon application startup. Changes to this parameter will take place the next time PixInsight is executed.* Warning * Specifying an invalid style sheet file may yield an unusable core application. DO NOT change this parameter if you are not sure of what you are doing.
文件: 借助样式表，你可以真正地改造整个 PixInsight 平台，使其符合你的需求与品味，赋予它你想要的个人外观与感觉。关于 Qt 样式表及其语法的完整信息，我们推荐官方 Qt 参考文档的以下章节：http://doc.qt.io/qt-5/stylesheet.html 核心样式表文件只在应用程序启动时载入。对此参数的更改会在下次运行 PixInsight 时生效。* 警告 * 指定无效的样式表文件可能导致核心应用程序无法使用。若不确定自己在做什么，请勿更改此参数。

FILE: Use 24-bit lookup tables (LUT) to apply screen transfer functions (STF) by default, instead of 16-bit LUTs. Linear HDR images usually require larger LUTs to discretize nonlinear STFs without posterization, especially on dark areas, where the STF applies more aggressive transformations.For most linear images and all stretched (nonlinear) images, 16-bit LUTs are normally sufficient. Enable the 24-bit LUT feature for deep linear data that cause posterization artifacts on screen renditions, such as HDR compositions. Note that you can enable or disable this feature on a per view basis; this setting refers to the default state for newly created images.
文件: 默认使用 24 位查找表（LUT）而非 16 位 LUT 来施加屏幕传递函数（STF）。线性 HDR 图像通常需要更大的 LUT，才能在不出现色调分离的情况下离散化非线性 STF，尤其是在 STF 施加更激进变换的暗部。对多数线性图像和所有已拉伸（非线性）图像而言，16 位 LUT 通常足够。对会在屏幕渲染上造成色调分离伪影的深线性数据（例如 HDR 合成），请启用 24 位 LUT 功能。注意可以按视图启用或禁用此功能；此设置指的是新建图像的默认状态。

FILE: When this option is disabled (the default), PixInsight uses its own file dialogs for all file open, file save and directory selection operations, on all platforms. They share the components of the File Explorer: places with your own folders, an address bar with history, details and thumbnail views, name filters with wildcards or regular expressions, previews with image information, statistics and properties, and file operations with the same safety rules as the File Explorer.When this option is enabled, PixInsight uses the common dialogs of Windows and macOS. On FreeBSD and Linux this option is not supported at present and should be left disabled.
文件: 当此选项被禁用（默认）时，PixInsight 在所有平台的所有文件打开、文件保存与目录选择操作中都使用自己的文件对话框。它们与文件浏览器共享组件：带自有文件夹的位置栏、带历史记录的地址栏、详细信息与缩略图视图、支持通配符或正则表达式的名称过滤器、带图像信息/统计/属性的预览，以及与文件浏览器相同安全规则的文件操作。启用此选项时，PixInsight 使用 Windows 与 macOS 的通用对话框。在 FreeBSD 与 Linux 上目前不支持此选项，应保持禁用。

FILE: This is the maximum thread priority allowed for threads created by external modules. Time critical will enable modules to create real-time priority threads, which are seldomly used, but sometimes necessary to carry out performance-critical operations. Lowest priority will force all installed modules to use very low-priority threads, which may strongly impact processing performance.The default value of this parameter is platform-dependent. Currently, it is Time-Critical on Linux and macOS and Normal on Windows.* Warning * Forcing low thread priorities will degrade processing performance. You should only change this value if you know what you are doing.
文件: 这是外部模块所创建线程允许的最大线程优先级。「时间关键」会让模块可以创建实时优先级线程，这类线程很少使用，但有时对执行性能关键操作是必要的。「最低优先级」会强制所有已安装模块使用极低优先级线程，可能严重影响处理性能。此参数的默认值依平台而定。目前 Linux 与 macOS 上为「时间关键」，Windows 上为「普通」。* 警告 * 强制低线程优先级会降低处理性能。只有在你知道自己在做什么时才应更改此值。

FILE: The order of Yes and No buttons represented on message boxes.The Default option applies a logical order where the first button always corresponds to the least potentially dangerous choice. For example, on a message box where the user has to answer a question like Do you really want to lose all changes?, the order of buttons would be No and Yes. The order would be Yes and No for a question such as Save the modified image?. This is the default behavior of message boxes in PixInsight since core version 1.8.9-2. This behavior assumes the user reads questions and button labels before making decisions.The Yes/No and No/Yes options force the specified button orders.
文件: 消息框中「是」与「否」按钮的显示顺序。「默认」选项采用逻辑顺序：第一个按钮总是对应潜在危险最小的选择。例如，在一个要求用户回答「确定要放弃所有更改吗？」这类问题的消息框中，按钮顺序会是「否」和「是」。而对于「是否保存修改后的图像？」这类问题，顺序则是「是」和「否」。这是自核心版本 1.8.9-2 起 PixInsight 消息框的默认行为。此行为假设用户在做出决定前会阅读问题与按钮标签。「是/否」与「否/是」选项则强制指定按钮顺序。

FILE: This is a list of up to 10 local image files that will be used by the PixInsight core application as workspace wallpaper images. The SVG, PNG, JPEG, TIFF and BMP formats are supported. SVG is recommended because, being a scalable image format, the quality of wallpaper renditions is resolution-independent. Bitmap images will be rescaled as necessary to fill the largest screen available. The existing aspect ratio of each wallpaper image is always preserved, so you should select images of the appropriate dimensions for your monitor.Workspace wallpaper images are only loaded upon application startup, so if you change any items in this list, changes will not take effect until the next time PixInsight is started.
文件: 这是最多 10 个本地图像文件的列表，PixInsight 核心应用程序会把它们用作工作区壁纸图像。支持 SVG、PNG、JPEG、TIFF 与 BMP 格式。推荐 SVG，因为它是可缩放图像格式，壁纸渲染的质量与分辨率无关。位图图像会按需重新缩放以填满可用的最大屏幕。每张壁纸图像的现有宽高比总是被保留，因此你应为自己的显示器选择合适尺寸的图像。工作区壁纸图像只在应用程序启动时载入，所以若你更改此列表中的任何项目，更改要等下次启动 PixInsight 才生效。

FILE: The affinity of a thread defines the set of logical processors on which the thread is eligible to run. Thread affinity allows to improve execution speed by restricting each thread to run on a separate processor. This prevents the performance cost caused by the cache invalidation that occurs when a process ceases to execute on a processor and then restarts execution on a different one.Note The state of this setting is only fetched upon application startup. Changes to this setting require a restart of the PixInsight core application to take effect.Note Currently this option only works on Linux and Windows platforms. It does not work on macOS and FreeBSD. Support for all platforms will be implemented in a future version of PixInsight.
文件: 线程的亲和性定义了该线程有资格运行的一组逻辑处理器。线程亲和性可以通过把每个线程限制在单独的处理器上运行来提升执行速度。这避免了进程停止在某处理器上执行、随后又在另一个处理器上重新开始执行时，缓存失效所造成的性能损失。注：此设置的状态只在应用程序启动时获取。更改此设置需要重启 PixInsight 核心应用程序才生效。注：目前此选项仅在 Linux 与 Windows 平台有效。在 macOS 与 FreeBSD 上无效。对所有平台的支持将在 PixInsight 的未来版本中实现。

FILE: Use the native file dialogs of the operating system instead of PixInsight's own file dialogs.When this option is disabled (the default), PixInsight uses its own file dialogs for all file open, file save and directory selection operations, on all platforms. They share the components of the File Explorer: places with your own folders, an address bar with history, details and thumbnail views, name filters with wildcards or regular expressions, previews with image information, statistics and properties, and file operations with the same safety rules as the File Explorer.When this option is enabled, PixInsight uses the common dialogs of Windows and macOS. On FreeBSD and Linux this option is not supported at present and should be left disabled.
文件: 使用操作系统的原生文件对话框，而不是 PixInsight 自己的文件对话框。当此选项被禁用（默认）时，PixInsight 在所有平台的所有文件打开、文件保存与目录选择操作中都使用自己的文件对话框。它们与文件浏览器共享组件：带自有文件夹的位置栏、带历史记录的地址栏、详细信息与缩略图视图、支持通配符或正则表达式的名称过滤器、带图像信息/统计/属性的预览，以及与文件浏览器相同安全规则的文件操作。启用此选项时，PixInsight 使用 Windows 与 macOS 的通用对话框。在 FreeBSD 与 Linux 上目前不支持此选项，应保持禁用。

FILE: The perceptual intent maps all colors in the image space to the output device space. This is the default option for monitors. With the perceptual intent, no out-of-gamut color is clipped, as happens with colorimetric intents, but all colors can be altered, and the changes can be significant if the image space is much wider than the output space. In general, relative colorimetric is preferred for printed media, but perceptual can yield more vibrant results that may be desirable in some cases.Finally, the saturation intent tries to maximize color saturation in the represented image, at the cost of sacrifying color accuracy, if necessary. This intent can be a good option for synthetic graphics and illustrations, but not for reproduction of photographic images.
文件: 感知意图把图像空间中的所有颜色映射到输出设备空间。这是显示器的默认选项。使用感知意图时不会有任何超色域颜色被裁剪（色度意图则会发生裁剪），但所有颜色都可能被改变，若图像空间比输出空间宽得多，变化可能相当显著。一般来说，印刷介质更推荐相对色度，但感知有时能给出更鲜艳的结果，在某些场景下可能正是想要的。最后，饱和度意图会尽量提高所表示图像的色彩饱和度，必要时牺牲色彩准确性。此意图适合合成图形与插画，但不适合摄影图像的复制。

FILE: Keep in mind that automatic display characterization is not always feasible or accurate. For example, some X11 desktop managers don't support high-dpi monitors adequately, especially with multiple monitors working at different resolutions. Virtualized operating systems can also have problems for automatic detection of monitor dimensions. In these cases, you can disable this option to specify the correct scaling factor manually (see the UI scaling factor parameter below).Core UI scaling parameters are only fetched upon application startup. Changes to this parameter will take place the next time PixInsight is executed.* Warning * Specifying wrong UI scaling settings may yield an unusable core application. DO NOT change this parameter if you are not sure of what you are doing.
文件: 请记住，自动显示特性描述并不总是可行或准确的。例如，某些 X11 桌面管理器不能很好地支持高 dpi 显示器，尤其是多台分辨率不同的显示器同时工作时。虚拟化的操作系统在自动检测显示器尺寸时也可能有问题。在这些情况下，你可以禁用此选项，手动指定正确的缩放因子（见下面的「UI 缩放因子」参数）。核心 UI 缩放参数只在应用程序启动时获取。对此参数的更改会在下次运行 PixInsight 时生效。* 警告 * 指定错误的 UI 缩放设置可能导致核心应用程序无法使用。若不确定自己在做什么，请勿更改此参数。

FILE: Automatic image identifiers generated from templates take precedence over this option. When both automatic identifiers and this option are disabled, image identifiers are retrieved from XISF files, if available. When no identifier is available, the default image prefix is used to generate unique image identifiers.Since core version 1.9.3 Lockhart, this option is disabled by default and its use is discouraged. Meaningful identifiers should be automatically generated from existing metadata using templates, or the default identifiers defined by our standard tools and preprocessing scripts should be used. When no identifiers are available, you should define them manually. Identifiers are embedded as image properties in XISF files and loaded automatically when the images are opened.
文件: 由模板自动生成的图像标识符优先于此选项。当自动标识符与此选项都被禁用时，会从 XISF 文件（若可用）中获取图像标识符。若没有可用标识符，则使用默认图像前缀生成唯一的图像标识符。自核心版本 1.9.3 Lockhart 起，此选项默认禁用且不鼓励使用。有意义的标识符应使用模板从已有元数据自动生成，或使用我们的标准工具与预处理脚本定义的默认标识符。若没有可用标识符，则应手动定义。标识符作为图像属性嵌入 XISF 文件中，并在图像打开时自动载入。

FILE: * Warning * Ensure that there is enough free space on the storage device(s) that support these directories on the local filesystem. Insufficient swap disk space may compromise system stability. For normal CCD or DSLR imaging production, a minimum of 100 GB is strongly recommended.* Important * Many critical operations depend on fast sequential access to very large files on the PixInsight platform. For this reason, a highly fragmented filesystem may degrade performance. Under MS Windows (both FAT and NTFS filesystems), it is very important to avoid heavy disk fragmentation by running the defrag utility (or equivalent) on a regular basis. Under UNIX/Linux and macOS, there are no fragmentation problems because the native filesystems on these platforms prevent fragmentation automatically.
文件: * 警告 * 请确保本地文件系统中承载这些目录的存储设备有足够可用空间。交换磁盘空间不足可能危及系统稳定性。对于普通 CCD 或单反成像生产，强烈建议至少 100 GB。* 重要 * PixInsight 平台上的许多关键操作依赖于对超大文件的快速顺序访问。因此，碎片严重的文件系统可能降低性能。在 MS Windows（FAT 与 NTFS 文件系统）下，定期运行碎片整理工具（或等效工具）以避免磁盘严重碎片非常重要。在 UNIX/Linux 与 macOS 下不存在碎片问题，因为这些平台上的原生文件系统会自动防止碎片。

FILE: This is the maximum number of threads allowed for concurrent file reading operations. Tasks that perform heavy file I/O operations, such as ImageCalibration, ImageIntegration or StarAlignment for example, can work more efficiently on solid-state drives (SSD) when parallel file access is allowed.The default value of 8 threads is usually a good starting point for most SSD units. The optimal value depends on specific hardware and software conditions and should be found through benchmarks. It is usually in the range from 4 to 32 threads.For rotational hard disk drives (HDD) parallel file I/O operations may incur in severe performance penalties. If you are using one of these obsolete devices with PixInsight (which is not recommended) you normally should set this parameter to its minimum value of one thread.
文件: 这是并发文件读取操作允许的最大线程数。执行大量文件 I/O 的任务（例如 ImageCalibration、ImageIntegration 或 StarAlignment）在允许并行文件访问时，在固态硬盘（SSD）上能更高效地工作。默认值 8 个线程对多数 SSD 通常是个不错的起点。最优值取决于具体硬件与软件条件，应通过基准测试确定。通常落在 4 到 32 个线程之间。对于旋转式机械硬盘（HDD），并行文件 I/O 操作可能造成严重的性能损失。若你在 PixInsight 中使用这类过时设备（不推荐），通常应把此参数设为其最小值一个线程。

FILE: This is the maximum number of threads allowed for concurrent file writing operations. If you are using one of these obsolete devices with PixInsight (which is not recommended) you normally should set this parameter to its minimum value of one thread.
文件: 这是并发文件写入操作允许的最大线程数。执行大量文件 I/O 的任务（例如 ImageCalibration、ImageIntegration 或 StarAlignment）在允许并行文件访问时，在固态硬盘（SSD）上能更高效地工作。默认值 8 个线程对多数 SSD 通常是个不错的起点。最优值取决于具体硬件与软件条件，应通过基准测试确定。通常落在 4 到 32 个线程之间。对于旋转式机械硬盘（HDD），并行文件 I/O 操作可能造成严重的性能损失。若你在 PixInsight 中使用这类过时设备（不推荐），通常应把此参数设为其最小值一个线程。

文件: Qt 样式表可对基于 Qt 的应用程序中所有控件提供详尽的自定义。Qt 样式表在概念与语法上类似 HTML 层叠样式表（CSS），但针对图形用户界面世界做了调整。借助样式表，你可以真正地改造整个 PixInsight 平台，使其符合你的需求与品味，赋予它你想要的个人外观与感觉。关于 Qt 样式表及其语法的完整信息，我们推荐官方 Qt 参考文档的以下章节：http://doc.qt.io/qt-5/stylesheet.html 核心样式表文件只在应用程序启动时载入。对此参数的更改会在下次运行 PixInsight 时生效。* 警告 * 指定无效的样式表文件可能导致核心应用程序无法使用。若不确定自己在做什么，请勿更改此参数。

FILE: Allow setting the CPU affinity of running threads. This is a global flag that affects threads created by the core application as well as all external modules.The affinity of a thread defines the set of logical processors on which the thread is eligible to run. Thread affinity allows to improve execution speed by restricting each thread to run on a separate processor. This prevents the performance cost caused by the cache invalidation that occurs when a process ceases to execute on a processor and then restarts execution on a different one.Note The state of this setting is only fetched upon application startup. Changes to this setting require a restart of the PixInsight core application to take effect.Note Currently this option only works on Linux and Windows platforms. It does not work on macOS and FreeBSD. Support for all platforms will be implemented in a future version of PixInsight.
文件: 允许设置运行中线程的 CPU 亲和性。这是一个全局标志，影响核心应用程序以及所有外部模块所创建的线程。线程的亲和性定义了该线程有资格运行的一组逻辑处理器。线程亲和性可以通过把每个线程限制在单独的处理器上运行来提升执行速度。这避免了进程停止在某处理器上执行、随后又在另一个处理器上重新开始执行时，缓存失效所造成的性能损失。注：此设置的状态只在应用程序启动时获取。更改此设置需要重启 PixInsight 核心应用程序才生效。注：目前此选项仅在 Linux 与 Windows 平台有效。在 macOS 与 FreeBSD 上无效。对所有平台的支持将在 PixInsight 的未来版本中实现。

FILE: The proxy host that will be used for core network operations. This can be specified either as a host name or as a dotted numerical IP address. A numerical IPv6 address must be written within square brackets. To specify the port number (strongly recommended), append :<port> to the host name. The proxy host may be prefixed with <scheme>:// to specify the type of proxy to be used. If no scheme is specified, http:// will be assumed by default. Finally, the host can include an embedded user/password specification, but be aware that passwords specified this way won't be stored securely and will be visible as plain text on this interface.To disable the use of a proxy server, leave this parameter empty as it is by default.* Note * This option only applies to core network operations, such as files downloaded with the File > Open Location menu item, the open command, and the update system, among others. It does not apply to the integrated web browser component.
文件: 将用于核心网络操作的代理主机。可以指定为主机名或点分数字 IP 地址。数字 IPv6 地址必须写在方括号内。要指定端口号（强烈推荐），在主机名后追加 :<port>。代理主机可以加 <scheme>:// 前缀来指定要使用的代理类型。若未指定 scheme，默认假定为 http://。最后，主机可以内含用户/密码，但请注意以这种方式指定的密码不会被安全存储，会在此界面上以纯文本可见。要禁用代理服务器，请把此参数留空（默认即如此）。* 注 * 此选项只适用于核心网络操作，例如用「文件 > 打开位置」菜单项、open 命令以及更新系统等下载的文件。不适用于集成网页浏览器组件。

文件: 这是本地 Qt 样式表文件（.qss）的路径，它控制整个 PixInsight 平台的外观。Qt 样式表可对基于 Qt 的应用程序中所有控件提供详尽的自定义。Qt 样式表在概念与语法上类似 HTML 层叠样式表（CSS），但针对图形用户界面世界做了调整。借助样式表，你可以真正地改造整个 PixInsight 平台，使其符合你的需求与品味，赋予它你想要的个人外观与感觉。关于 Qt 样式表及其语法的完整信息，我们推荐官方 Qt 参考文档的以下章节：http://doc.qt.io/qt-5/stylesheet.html 核心样式表文件只在应用程序启动时载入。对此参数的更改会在下次运行 PixInsight 时生效。* 警告 * 指定无效的样式表文件可能导致核心应用程序无法使用。若不确定自己在做什么，请勿更改此参数。

FILE: Model generation scale.GradientCorrection implements a multiscale gradient modeling algorithm. This parameter controls the relative scale at which the gradient model will be generated. Higher parameter values generate smooth models best suited to represent large-scale brightness variations. Lower values allow for the generation of more complex gradients representing more local variations. The default value is 5.0.
文件: 模型生成尺度。GradientCorrection 实现多尺度梯度建模算法。此参数控制生成梯度模型时的相对尺度。参数值越高，生成的模型越平滑，最适合表示大尺度亮度变化。较低的值允许生成更复杂的梯度，表示更局部的变化。默认值为 5.0。

FILE: This feature can be helpful when dealing with very bright and complex gradients, where the gradients may have similar or even higher values than the objects of interest in the image. In these cases, an initial simplification can often improve the performance of the gradient modeling and correction algorithm, making it more efficient and controllable. However, this feature can be counterproductive for images with large and bright objects, where it can lead to overcorrection. This option is turned off by default.
文件: 处理非常明亮而复杂的梯度时，此功能会有帮助 —— 这类梯度的值可能与图像中的目标相当甚至更高。在这些情况下，先做一次简化往往能改善梯度建模与校正算法的性能，使其更高效、更可控。但对于包含大而明亮天体的图像，此功能可能适得其反，导致过度校正。此选项默认关闭。

FILE: When the Simplified Model option is enabled, this parameter defines the degree of two-dimensional interpolation polynomials used to compute a simplified gradient model during the initial preprocessing task. This simplified model will be subtracted from the image before applying the rest of the multiscale gradient modeling and correction algorithm. High-degree models are more adaptive to local variations and potentially more accurate but can lead to overcorrection or oscillations. The default value is one, which corresponds to a linear simplified model.
文件: 启用「简化模型」选项时，此参数定义在初始预处理任务中用于计算简化梯度模型的二维插值多项式的阶数。在施加其余多尺度梯度建模与校正算法之前，会先从此图像中减去该简化模型。高阶模型对局部变化适应性更强、可能更准确，但也可能导致过度校正或振荡。默认值为一，对应线性的简化模型。

FILE: Enhances small gradients in the luminance of an image, thus sometimes revealing surprising details otherwise hidden in large contrasts. Note: Gradients are in the range of [-1,1]. The method works on the absolute gradient values (abs(gradient)), later restoring the sign.(c) 2011 Georg Viehoever, published under LGPL 2.1. With important contributions in terms of code and test data by Carlos Milovic, Harry Page and Vicent Peris.
文件: 增强图像亮度中的小幅梯度，从而有时能揭示原本隐藏在大对比度中的惊人细节。注意：梯度范围为 [-1,1]。该方法作用于梯度的绝对值（abs(gradient)），之后再恢复符号。(c) 2011 Georg Viehoever，依据 LGPL 2.1 发布。Carlos Milovic、Harry Page 与 Vicent Peris 在代码与测试数据方面做出了重要贡献。

FILE: Most images can be solved using the default Gnomonic projection, since it can approximate how most optical systems project an image on the focal plane. However, some images, especially very wide-field images (focal lengths less than 10-15 mm), usually require different projections to find a consistent solution. Several projections are provided besides Gnomonic, which can be more suitable for wide angle images.
文件: 多数图像可用默认的球心投影解算，因为它能近似多数光学系统在焦平面上的投影方式。不过有些图像，尤其是超广视场图像（焦距小于 10-15 mm），通常需要不同的投影才能找到一致解。除球心投影外还提供若干投影，它们可能更适合广角图像。

FILE: This parameter limits the number of stars extracted from the catalog to those with magnitude smaller than this value. This limit magnitude should be similar to the magnitude of the dimmest stars in the image. If this value is too low, the plate solving algorithm may not have enough stars to compare, but if the value is too high, it will try to match catalog stars that are not visible on the image. This will slow down the process, and could prevent the algorithm from finding a valid solution in extreme cases.
文件: 此参数把从星表中提取的恒星限制为星等小于此值的那些。此极限星等应与图像中最暗恒星的星等相近。若此值太低，解算算法可能没有足够的恒星可供比较；但若此值太高，它会尝试匹配星表中在图像上并不可见的恒星。这会拖慢进程，极端情况下还可能使算法无法找到有效解。

FILE: If enabled, existing metadata will be ignored and the values set by the running instance, that is, on this interface, will be used instead. This includes the right ascension and declination coordinates of the center of the image, the focal length, pixel size and observation date. If disabled, existing metadata will take precedence over the values defined by this instance.Note that for this option to take effect the image must be solved astrometrically, either because the Force plate solving option is enabled, or because the image has no valid astrometric solution.
文件: 若启用，将忽略已有元数据，改用运行实例（即此界面上）设置的值。这包括图像中心的赤经赤纬坐标、焦距、像素尺寸与观测日期。若禁用，已有元数据优先于此实例定义的值。注意此选项要生效，图像必须已完成天体测量解算，即要么启用了「强制解算」选项，要么图像没有有效天体测量解。

FILE: When using a manually selected catalog, you should select the appropriate catalog for your image. For example, for very wide field images (focal lengths smaller than 25 mm), you should use the Bright Stars catalog because it provides enough stars and the queries are fast for large fields. Gaia and PPMXL are useful for very deep images because they include very dim stars; however, online queries in these two catalogs can be slow for relatively large fields.If you have a Gaia XPSD server configured with local database files, you should use it in all cases except when the Bright Stars catalog is applicable.
文件: 使用手动选择的星表时，你应为自己的图像选择合适的星表。例如，对于超广视场图像（焦距小于 25 mm），应使用亮星星表，因为它提供足够的恒星且对大视场查询速度快。Gaia 与 PPMXL 对极深图像很有用，因为它们包含很暗的恒星；不过在相对大的视场上，这两个星表的在线查询可能较慢。若你配置了带本地数据库文件的 Gaia XPSD 服务器，除亮星星表适用的情形外，其它情况都应使用它。

FILE: When a telescope device is available, it is used to retrieve its current EOD (epoch of date) coordinates, just before starting each light frame exposure. These are apparent coordinates, which are reduced to mean positions referred to the mean equinox and equator of J2000.0 (ICRS) by an accurate inverse transformation, including corrections for precession, nutation and stellar aberration. The computed coordinates are directly comparable to standard catalog positions, irrespective of the date of acquisition. Once these coordinates are computed for each acquired image, they are stored as standard XISF properties (Observation:Center:RA and Observation:Center:Dec). For compatibility with legacy applications, the same coordinates replace the OBJCTRA and OBJCTDEC FITS keywords provided by the Indigo server.
文件: 有可用望远镜设备时，会在每次开始亮帧曝光之前用它获取当前的 EOD（当日历元）坐标。这些是视坐标，会通过精确的逆变换（包括岁差、章动与恒星视差改正）归算为参照 J2000.0 平春分点与平赤道的平位置（ICRS）。所计算的坐标可直接与标准星表位置比较，与采集日期无关。对每张采集图像计算完这些坐标后，会把它们存为标准 XISF 属性（Observation:Center:RA 与 Observation:Center:Dec）。为与旧版程序兼容，同样的坐标会替换 Indigo 服务器提供的 OBJCTRA 与 OBJCTDEC FITS 关键字。

FILE: In general, elliptical functions are preferable because they provide more information about the true shapes and orientations of the fitted PSFs. Sometimes, however, circular functions may be preferable. For example, strongly undersampled images usually don't provide enough data to fit elliptical functions reliably. Uncertainty due to high noise levels also affect complex function fittings adversely. In such cases a circular function can provide more robust results.Elliptical PSF functions are fitted by default.
文件: 一般来说椭圆函数更好，因为它们提供更多关于所拟合 PSF 真实形状与方向的信息。不过有时圆形函数可能更好。例如，严重欠采样的图像通常没有足够数据可靠地拟合椭圆函数。高噪声水平带来的不确定度也会对复杂函数拟合产生不利影响。在这种情况下圆形函数可以给出更稳健的结果。默认拟合椭圆 PSF 函数。

FILE: When the Auto PSF model is selected, include variable shape functions to search for optimal PSF fits. If this option is disabled, only Gaussian and Moffat functions will be used when Auto is selected.In many cases, variable shape model functions will lead to optimal PSF fits in terms of minimization of absolute deviation between fitted point spread functions and source image pixel samples for each selected object. Since variable shape PSF models are nonstandard and relatively experimental, they are not included in automatic optimal fits by default.
文件: 选中自动 PSF 模型时，包含可变形状函数以搜索最佳 PSF 拟合。若禁用此选项，选择「自动」时只会使用高斯与 Moffat 函数。在许多情况下，就可变形状模型函数而言，按每个所选目标的拟合点扩散函数与源图像像素样本之间绝对偏差最小化来看，它们能得到最佳 PSF 拟合。由于可变形状 PSF 模型是非标准的、相对实验性的，默认不纳入自动最优拟合。

FILE: This value is used by the object detection routine to classify sampled pixels into two disjoint sets: pixels belonging to the local background, and pixels belonging to the object being detected. A smaller threshold value makes the star detection routine less sensitive. This can be useful to avoid detection of very faint objects. On the other hand, a higher threshold allows you to isolate very small and faint objects, which may or may not be desirable, depending on what you want to do.The default value of one sigma is normally appropriate in most cases.
文件: 物体检测例程用此值把采样像素分为两个不相交的集合：属于局部背景的像素，以及属于被检测物体的像素。阈值越小，恒星检测例程越不敏感。这有助于避免检测到极暗的物体。反之，阈值越高越能分离出很小很暗的物体，这是否可取取决于你想做什么。默认值一个 sigma 在多数情况下是合适的。

文件: 「标准元数据」会尝试用从目标图像读取的以下 XISF 标准属性计算图像尺度（角秒/像素）：Instrument:Telescope:FocalLength、Instrument:Sensor:XPixelSize、Instrument:Sensor:YPixelSize。若这些属性不可用，则会使用以下 FITS 头关键字（若有）：FOCALLEN、XPIXSZ 与 YPIXSZ。「字面值」允许你直接指定图像尺度（角秒/像素）。「自定义 FITS 关键字」允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字的名称，其值为图像尺度（角秒/像素）。

FILE: Threshold value for rejection of background pixels, in sigma units.This value is used by the object detection routine to classify sampled pixels into two disjoint sets: pixels belonging to the local background, and pixels belonging to the object being detected. A smaller threshold value makes the star detection routine less sensitive. This can be useful to avoid detection of very faint objects. On the other hand, a higher threshold allows you to isolate very small and faint objects, which may or may not be desirable, depending on what you want to do.The default value of one sigma is normally appropriate in most cases.
文件: 用于剔除背景像素的阈值，单位为 sigma。物体检测例程用此值把采样像素分为两个不相交的集合：属于局部背景的像素，以及属于被检测物体的像素。阈值越小，恒星检测例程越不敏感。这有助于避免检测到极暗的物体。反之，阈值越高越能分离出很小很暗的物体，这是否可取取决于你想做什么。默认值一个 sigma 在多数情况下是合适的。

FILE: Each star is fitted to a PSF function inside a rectangular sampling region. If the sampling region is too small, the local background cannot be determined accurately, and hence the PSF fit will be less accurate. If the sampling region is too large, pixels from nearby objects can contaminate the sample, and computation times grow unnecessarily. The automatic aperture feature of DynamicPSF implements a robust algorithm to find the smallest sampling region necessary to minimize uncertainty in the evaluation of the local background.This option is enabled by default. Disabling it is not recommended under normal working conditions.
文件: 每颗恒星都在一个矩形采样区域内拟合 PSF 函数。若采样区域太小，无法准确确定局部背景，PSF 拟合也就不够准确。若采样区域太大，邻近物体的像素会污染样本，计算时间也会无谓增长。DynamicPSF 的自动孔径功能实现了稳健算法，可找出把局部背景评估不确定度降到最低所需的最小采样区域。此选项默认启用。正常工作条件下不建议禁用它。

FILE: Enable this option to fit circular PSF functions. Disable it to fit elliptical functions. An elliptical function provides two separate axes and a rotation angle.In general, elliptical functions are preferable because they provide more information about the true shapes and orientations of the fitted PSFs. Sometimes, however, circular functions may be preferable. For example, strongly undersampled images usually don't provide enough data to fit elliptical functions reliably. Uncertainty due to high noise levels also affect complex function fittings adversely. In such cases a circular function can provide more robust results.Elliptical PSF functions are fitted by default.
文件: 启用此选项以拟合圆形 PSF 函数，禁用以拟合椭圆函数。椭圆函数提供两条不同的轴与一个旋转角。一般来说椭圆函数更好，因为它们提供更多关于所拟合 PSF 真实形状与方向的信息。不过有时圆形函数可能更好。例如，严重欠采样的图像通常没有足够数据可靠地拟合椭圆函数。高噪声水平带来的不确定度也会对复杂函数拟合产生不利影响。在这种情况下圆形函数可以给出更稳健的结果。默认拟合椭圆 PSF 函数。

FILE: Pixels will ignore image scale and show FWHM in pixel units. This is the default option.Standard metadata will try to use the following XISF standard properties read from the target image to compute the scale of the image in arcseconds per pixel:Instrument:Telescope:FocalLengthInstrument:Sensor:XPixelSizeInstrument:Sensor:YPixelSizeIf these properties are not available, then the following FITS header keywords will be used, if available: FOCALLEN, XPIXSZ, and YPIXSZ.literal value allows you to specify directly the image scale in arcseconds per pixel.Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword whose value is the image scale in arcseconds per pixel.
文件: 「像素」将忽略图像尺度，以像素为单位显示 FWHM。这是默认选项。「标准元数据」会尝试用从目标图像读取的以下 XISF 标准属性计算图像尺度（角秒/像素）：Instrument:Telescope:FocalLength、Instrument:Sensor:XPixelSize、Instrument:Sensor:YPixelSize。若这些属性不可用，则会使用以下 FITS 头关键字（若有）：FOCALLEN、XPIXSZ 与 YPIXSZ。「字面值」允许你直接指定图像尺度（角秒/像素）。「自定义 FITS 关键字」允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字的名称，其值为图像尺度（角秒/像素）。

FILE: Compute optimal sampling dimensions adaptively for each fitted star.Each star is fitted to a PSF function inside a rectangular sampling region. If the sampling region is too small, the local background cannot be determined accurately, and hence the PSF fit will be less accurate. If the sampling region is too large, pixels from nearby objects can contaminate the sample, and computation times grow unnecessarily. The automatic aperture feature of DynamicPSF implements a robust algorithm to find the smallest sampling region necessary to minimize uncertainty in the evaluation of the local background.This option is enabled by default. Disabling it is not recommended under normal working conditions.
文件: 为每颗被拟合恒星自适应地计算最佳采样尺寸。每颗恒星都在一个矩形采样区域内拟合 PSF 函数。若采样区域太小，无法准确确定局部背景，PSF 拟合也就不够准确。若采样区域太大，邻近物体的像素会污染样本，计算时间也会无谓增长。DynamicPSF 的自动孔径功能实现了稳健算法，可找出把局部背景评估不确定度降到最低所需的最小采样区域。此选项默认启用。正常工作条件下不建议禁用它。

FILE: Signed angles are useful to prevent ambiguities introduced by small rotations around zero degrees. These 'oscillatory' rotations occur frequently due to uncertainty in fitting rotation angles for nearly circular stars. For example, imagine a set of PSF fits where we have two subsets with rotations around zero and 180 degrees. If we compute average PSF parameters, the resulting average rotation would be around 90 degrees. This may be incorrect if both subsets are actually due to dispersion caused by fitting uncertainty, in which case the correct average rotation would be a value close to zero degrees.This option is enabled by default, so rotation angles are represented as signed quantities in the (-90°,+90°] range.
文件: 带符号角度有助于避免绕零度的小幅旋转所带来的歧义。由于近圆形恒星拟合旋转角存在不确定度，这类「振荡式」旋转经常出现。例如，设想一组 PSF 拟合中有两个子集，旋转分别围绕零度与 180 度。若计算平均 PSF 参数，得出的平均旋转会在 90 度左右。若两个子集实际都只是拟合不确定度造成的离散，这就可能是错的 —— 那种情况下正确的平均旋转应接近零度。此选项默认启用，因此旋转角以 (-90°,+90°] 范围内的带符号量表示。

FILE: This parameter tells DynamicPSF how to compute the image scale to show full width at half maximum (FWHM) values:Pixels will ignore image scale and show FWHM in pixel units. This is the default option.Standard metadata will try to use the following XISF standard properties read from the target image to compute the scale of the image in arcseconds per pixel:Instrument:Telescope:FocalLengthInstrument:Sensor:XPixelSizeInstrument:Sensor:YPixelSizeIf these properties are not available, then the following FITS header keywords will be used, if available: FOCALLEN, XPIXSZ, and YPIXSZ.literal value allows you to specify directly the image scale in arcseconds per pixel.Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword whose value is the image scale in arcseconds per pixel.
文件: 此参数告诉 DynamicPSF 如何计算图像尺度以显示半高全宽（FWHM）值：「像素」将忽略图像尺度，以像素为单位显示 FWHM。这是默认选项。「标准元数据」会尝试用从目标图像读取的以下 XISF 标准属性计算图像尺度（角秒/像素）：Instrument:Telescope:FocalLength、Instrument:Sensor:XPixelSize、Instrument:Sensor:YPixelSize。若这些属性不可用，则会使用以下 FITS 头关键字（若有）：FOCALLEN、XPIXSZ 与 YPIXSZ。「字面值」允许你直接指定图像尺度（角秒/像素）。「自定义 FITS 关键字」允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字的名称，其值为图像尺度（角秒/像素）。

FILE: When this option is enabled, rotation angles are shown in the [-90°,+90°] range. When this option is disabled, rotation angles are shown in the [0°,180°) range.Signed angles are useful to prevent ambiguities introduced by small rotations around zero degrees. These 'oscillatory' rotations occur frequently due to uncertainty in fitting rotation angles for nearly circular stars. For example, imagine a set of PSF fits where we have two subsets with rotations around zero and 180 degrees. If we compute average PSF parameters, the resulting average rotation would be around 90 degrees. This may be incorrect if both subsets are actually due to dispersion caused by fitting uncertainty, in which case the correct average rotation would be a value close to zero degrees.This option is enabled by default, so rotation angles are represented as signed quantities in the (-90°,+90°] range.
文件: 启用此选项时，旋转角以 [-90°,+90°] 范围显示。禁用时，旋转角以 [0°,180°) 范围显示。带符号角度有助于避免绕零度的小幅旋转所带来的歧义。由于近圆形恒星拟合旋转角存在不确定度，这类「振荡式」旋转经常出现。例如，设想一组 PSF 拟合中有两个子集，旋转分别围绕零度与 180 度。若计算平均 PSF 参数，得出的平均旋转会在 90 度左右。若两个子集实际都只是拟合不确定度造成的离散，这就可能是错的 —— 那种情况下正确的平均旋转应接近零度。此选项默认启用，因此旋转角以 (-90°,+90°] 范围内的带符号量表示。

FILE: A persistent cache is kept across PixInsight sessions. If you disable this option, the file cache will still be used, but only during the current session; as soon as you exit the PixInsight core application, all the newly cached information will be lost. With the persistent cache option enabled, cached data generated during this session will be stored as a disk file and will be available the next time you run PixInsight.
文件: 一个持久缓存会跨 PixInsight 会话保留。若禁用此选项，文件缓存仍会被使用，但只在当前会话期间；一旦退出 PixInsight 核心应用程序，所有新缓存的信息都会丢失。启用持久缓存选项后，本次会话期间生成的缓存数据会存为磁盘文件，下次运行 PixInsight 时可用。

FILE: Measure: Measure the enabled frames and evaluate the approval and weighting expressions.Output approved frames: Write the approved frames to the output directory, with their weights in the PCL:ImageWeight XISF property.Star detection preview: Show the structure map and the detected stars of the frame selected in the frames list (the first one of a multiple selection), or of the first enabled frame if no frame is selected.
文件: 测量：测量已启用的帧并评估通过条件表达式与加权表达式。输出通过的帧：把通过的帧写入输出目录，其权重写在 PCL:ImageWeight XISF 属性中。恒星检测预览：显示帧列表中所选帧（多选时取第一个）或第一个已启用帧（未选择任何帧时）的结构图与检测到的恒星。

FILE: The signal evaluation result will be stored as a set of custom, per-channel XISF properties and FITS header keywords that other processes and scripts can use for specialized image analysis purposes.This option should always be enabled for calibration of deep-sky, non-CFA raw light frames. For CFA data, signal and noise evaluation should be performed by the Debayer process, and hence this option should be disabled in ImageCalibration
文件: 信号评估结果会存为一组自定义的逐通道 XISF 属性与 FITS 文件头关键字，其他进程与脚本可将其用于专门的图像分析。对深空非 CFA 原始亮帧的校准应始终启用此选项。对于 CFA 数据，信号与噪声评估应由 Debayer 进程执行，因此在 ImageCalibration 中应禁用此选项。

FILE: These estimates can be used later by several processes and scripts for specialized image analysis purposes, most notably by SubframeSelector and ImageIntegration for image grading and weighting.This option should always be enabled for calibration of non-CFA raw light frames. For CFA data, signal and noise evaluation should be performed by the Debayer process, and hence this option should be disabled in ImageCalibration in such case.
文件: 这些估计随后可被多个进程与脚本用于专门的图像分析，尤其是 SubframeSelector 与 ImageIntegration 的评级与加权。对非 CFA 原始亮帧的校准应始终启用此选项。对于 CFA 数据，信号与噪声评估应由 Debayer 进程执行，因此这种情况下在 ImageCalibration 中应禁用此选项。

FILE: If this option is enabled, the target image (either the target view or the first target file available) will be used to perform rejection of outlier pixels on the reference image. This is only necessary when the reference image can contain relatively large outlier structures, such as big plane trails.This option should normally be disabled when the normalization reference image is of good quality and does not have significant outliers.
文件: 若启用此选项，会用目标图像（目标视图或可用的第一个目标文件）对参考图像执行离群像素剔除。仅当参考图像可能包含相对较大的离群结构（例如大块飞机轨迹）时才需要。当归一化参考图像质量良好、没有显著离群值时，通常应禁用此选项。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied for robust outlier rejection. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels, cold pixels, and similar small-scale outlier image structures that can contaminate the local normalization functions, degrading their accuracy, or even introducing artifacts in extreme cases.To disable hot pixel removal (not recommended), set this parameter to zero. The default value is two pixels.
文件: 这是用于稳健离群剔除的中值滤波器的半径（像素）。中值滤波在去除热像素、冷像素以及类似的小尺度离群图像结构方面非常高效 —— 这些东西会污染局部归一化函数、降低其精度，极端情况下甚至引入伪影。要禁用热像素去除（不推荐），把此参数设为零。默认值为两个像素。

FILE: A value of 1.0 means that flux will be measured exclusively from pixels within the elliptical region defined at one tenth of the fitted PSF maximum. Increasing this parameter can inprove accuracy of PSF flux measurements for undersampled images, where PSF fitting uncertainty is relatively large. Decreasing it can be beneficial in some cases working with very noisy data to restrict flux evaluation to star cores. The default value is 1.75.
文件: 值为 1.0 表示仅对拟合 PSF 最大值十分之一处所定义的椭圆区域内的像素测量通量。提高此参数可以改善欠采样图像中 PSF 通量测量的精度，因为这类图像的 PSF 拟合不确定度相对较大。降低此参数在某些情况下有利于处理噪声很大的数据，把通量评估限制在恒星核心。默认值为 1.75。

FILE: DefectMap uses a defect map image to find defective pixels. In a defect map, black (zero) pixels correspond to bad or defective pixels. Bad pixels will be replaced with new values computed from neighbor pixels.When using convolution replacement operations (Gaussian, mean), non-zero pixel values represent the pixel weights that will be used for convolution. Morphological replacement operations (minimum, maximum, median) use binarized (0/1) map values.
文件: DefectMap 使用缺陷图图像找出缺陷像素。在缺陷图中，黑色（零）像素对应坏像素或缺陷像素。坏像素会用邻域像素计算出的新值替换。使用卷积替换操作（高斯、均值）时，非零像素值代表卷积所用的像素权重。形态学替换操作（最小、最大、中值）使用二值化（0/1）的图值。

FILE: Rejection of very low pixels is necessary to prevent generation of large-scale artifacts around large dark structures, such as black borders generated by image registration. Under normal conditions you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter (4.5×10-5). Increase it in the unlikely case that you detect dark artifacts around black borders—which, at any rate, will always denote a defective image calibration that you should fix before normalization.
文件: 剔除极低像素是必要的，可防止在大块暗结构（例如图像配准产生的黑边）周围生成大尺度伪影。正常情况下不应需要更改此参数的默认值（4.5×10-5）。若你在黑边周围发现暗色伪影（这无论如何都表明校准有缺陷，应在归一化之前先修正），可提高此值。

FILE: Default FITS keyword is the default mode. When this mode is selected, ImageCalibration will retrieve pedestal values from 'PEDESTAL' FITS keywords, when they are present in the input images. Note that ImageCalibration writes PEDESTAL keywords to calibrated images when a nonzero output pedestal is specified.Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword to retrieve pedestal values, when the specified keyword is present in the input images.
文件: 「默认 FITS 关键字」是默认模式。选择此模式时，ImageCalibration 会在输入图像中存在 'PEDESTAL' FITS 关键字时从中获取基座值。注意当指定了非零输出基座时，ImageCalibration 会把 PEDESTAL 关键字写入已校准图像。「自定义 FITS 关键字」允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字的名称，在输入图像中存在该关键字时从中获取基座值。

FILE: This parameter represents a fraction of the total image pixels in the [0,1] range. When the image has more than this fraction of negative or insignificant pixel values after calibration and the output pedestal mode is set to automatic, the process will generate an additive pedestal to ensure that no more than this fraction of negative or insignificant pixels will be present in the calibrated image.The default value is 0.0001, which represents a 0.01% of the total pixels.
文件: 此参数表示 [0,1] 范围内占图像总像素的比例。当校准后图像中负值或可忽略像素值的比例超过此值，且输出基座模式设为自动时，进程会生成一个附加基座，以确保校准后图像中负值或可忽略像素不超过此比例。默认值为 0.0001，即总像素的 0.01%。

FILE: Literal value allows you to specify a pedestal value in 16-bit data number units (DN) with the output pedestal parameter.Automatic will apply an automatically calculated pedestal value to frames that have negative, zero or insignificant (to machine epsilon) minimum pixel values after calibration. Automatic pedestals can be used to ensure positivity of the calibrated image with minimal truncation.See also the auto pedestal limit and output pedestal parameters for more information.
文件: 「字面值」允许你配合输出基座参数以 16 位数据编号（DN）为单位指定基座值。「自动」会对校准后最小像素值为负、为零或可忽略（相对于机器 epsilon）的帧施加自动计算的基座值。自动基座可用于以最小截断确保校准后图像为正。另请参见自动基座上限与输出基座参数以获取更多信息。

FILE: Local normalization functions will be calculated for each target image with respect to the reference image, which will be acquired either from an image view, or from an existing disk file.Important: For execution in the global context (batch procedure), if the reference image refers to a disk file that will be part of an image integration task, it must also be included in the target images list. Otherwise no .xnml file and/or normalized image will be generated for the reference image.
文件: 局部归一化函数会针对参考图像为每个目标图像计算，参考图像可取自图像视图或既有磁盘文件。重要：在全局上下文（批处理过程）中执行时，若参考图像指向的是将参与图像叠加任务的磁盘文件，该文件也必须包含在目标图像列表中。否则不会为参考图像生成 .xnml 文件和/或归一化图像。

FILE: For example, you can use the "raw cfa" input hints to force the RAW format to load pure raw CFA frames without applying any demosaicing, interpolation, white balance, or black point correction. Similarly, you can use the "up-bottom" input hint to load raw images from FITS files with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 例如，可以用 "raw cfa" 输入提示强制 RAW 格式载入纯原始 CFA 帧，不施加任何去马赛克、插值、白平衡或黑点校正。类似地，可以用 "up-bottom" 输入提示从坐标原点位于左上角的 FITS 文件载入原始图像。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式都支持若干输入和/或输出提示，可在提供格式提示访问的工具中用于不同目的。

FILE: PSF photometry will be performed for no more than the specified number of stars. The subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for calibration of wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of signal estimation.
文件: PSF 测光最多对指定数量的恒星执行。被测量的恒星子集总是从检测到的恒星集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。默认值设为 24K 颗这一宽松上限。限制测光样本数量可以提升大视场画幅的校准性能，因为这类画幅检测到的恒星数量可能非常多。但把被测源集合削减过多会损害信号估计的准确性。

FILE: PSF photometry will be performed for no more than the specified number of stars. The subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for normalization of wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of scale evaluation.
文件: PSF 测光最多对指定数量的恒星执行。被测量的恒星子集总是从检测到的恒星集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。默认值设为 24K 颗这一宽松上限。限制测光样本数量可以提升大视场画幅的归一化性能，因为这类画幅检测到的恒星数量可能非常多。但把被测源集合削减过多会损害尺度评估的准确性。

FILE: All pixels with values greater than or equal to the value of this parameter will be replaced with statistically plausible estimates, computed from nearby image regions.Rejection of saturated pixels is necessary to prevent generation of large-scale artifacts around large saturated structures, such as bright stars, in local background models. Under normal conditions you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter (0.85). Decrease it in the unlikely case that you detect dark artifacts around large saturated objects.
文件: 所有值大于或等于此参数值的像素都会用从邻近图像区域计算出的统计上合理的估计值替换。剔除饱和像素是必要的，可防止在局部背景模型中围绕大块饱和结构（例如亮星）生成大尺度伪影。正常情况下不应需要更改此参数的默认值（0.85）。若你在大块饱和天体周围发现暗色伪影（可能性不大），可降低此值。

FILE: For view execution, however, inspecting the transformed image is often necessary for testing purposes. Generation of normalized image files during batch execution can also be useful in very difficult cases, for example when the data set includes strong and large artifacts, such as big plane trails. In these cases you may want to inspect locally normalized images manually with analysis tools such as Blink. Normalized images may also be necessary for applications of local normalization different from integration of astronomical images.
文件: 不过对于视图执行，为测试目的检查变换后的图像往往是必要的。在批处理执行期间生成归一化图像文件，在非常困难的情况下也可能有用，例如数据集包含强烈而大块的伪影（如大块飞机轨迹）时。这些情况你可能想用 Blink 之类的分析工具手动检查局部归一化后的图像。对于不用于天文图像叠加的局部归一化应用，归一化图像也可能是必需的。

FILE: Given a source with estimated brightness s, local background b and local background dispersion n, SNR is evaluated as (s – b)/n. Stars with measured SNR below the value of this parameter won't be used for relative scale evaluation.This parameter allows limiting star detection to a subset of the brightest sources in the image adaptively. By requiring relatively high SNR levels in the evaluated sources, the accuracy and robustness of the scale evaluation process can be largely improved. The default value is 40, which is quite appropriate in most cases.
文件: 对于估计亮度为 s、局部背景为 b、局部背景离散度为 n 的源，SNR 按 (s – b)/n 计算。实测 SNR 低于此参数值的恒星不会用于相对尺度评估。此参数可以自适应地把恒星检测限制在图像中最亮的一部分源上。通过在受评估的源上要求相对较高的 SNR 水平，可以大幅提升尺度评估过程的准确性与稳健性。默认值为 40，在多数情况下相当合适。

FILE: This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).The default saturation threshold is 0.75. For relative scale evaluation this parameter is crucial in order to prevent contamination of the statistical sample of flux ratios by sources with saturated or nonlinear data. Changing the default value should not be necessary under normal conditions.
文件: 此参数以 [0,1] 范围表示。它可以按归一化 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素样本值施加，也可以按相对于被测图像最大像素样本值的相对值施加（参见「相对饱和阈值」参数）。默认饱和阈值为 0.75。对于相对尺度评估，此参数至关重要，可防止饱和或非线性数据污染通量比的统计样本。正常情况下不应需要更改默认值。

FILE: The Auto option uses view properties that can be available in the master and target frame files.
