Under normal working conditions, these properties are either generated automatically by the RAW format support module and stored in XISF files, or available as FITS header keywords in the case of raw OSC frames.For non-CFA data acquired with monochrome CCD or CMOS cameras, the Auto option is the correct selection because in these cases the process will detect no CFA pattern automatically.For images acquired with X-Trans sensors this parameter is ignored and CFA patterns are always extracted from existing image properties.
文件: 「自动」选项会使用主帧与目标帧文件中可能提供的视图属性。在正常工作条件下，这些属性要么由 RAW 格式支持模块自动生成并存入 XISF 文件，要么对原始 OSC 帧来说以 FITS 头关键字的形式提供。对于用单色 CCD 或 CMOS 相机采集的非 CFA 数据，「自动」选项是正确的选择，因为这种情况下进程会自动检测不到 CFA 图案。对于 X-Trans 传感器采集的图像，此参数被忽略，CFA 图案总是从已有图像属性提取。

FILE: Detected stars with one or more pixels with values above this threshold will be excluded for signal evaluation. This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).The default saturation threshold is 1.0. For signal evaluation, the implemented star detection and outlier rejection routines are normally able to avoid contamination from saturated sources, so the default value of this parameter should not be changed under normal conditions.
文件: 有一个或多个像素值高于此阈值的已检测星点将被排除在信号评估之外。此参数以 [0,1] 范围表示。它可以按绝对像素样本值施加，也可以按相对于被测图像最大像素样本值的相对值施加（参见「相对饱和阈值」参数）。默认饱和阈值为 1.0。在信号评估中，所实现的星点检测与离群剔除例程通常能避免饱和源的污染，因此正常情况下不应更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: A modified Robust Chauvenet Rejection (RCR) routine is used internally by this implementation for rejection of outlier relative scale samples. The larger the value of this parameter, the more samples will be rejected by the RCR algorithm.The original Chauvenet rejection criterion is N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5, where N is the number of measurements and P() represents the probability of x being more than z standard deviations from the mean. This parameter modifies the rejection criterion by replacing 0.5 with an arbitrary limit in the [0,1] range, in order to make the algorithm controllable. The default rejection limit is 0.3.
文件: 此实现内部使用改进的稳健 Chauvenet 剔除（RCR）例程来剔除离群相对尺度样本。此参数值越大，RCR 算法剔除的样本越多。原始 Chauvenet 剔除准则是 N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5，其中 N 是测量次数，P() 表示 x 偏离均值超过 z 个标准差的概率。此参数把准则中的 0.5 替换为 [0,1] 范围内的任意限值，使算法可控。默认剔除限值为 0.3。

FILE: All pixels with values smaller than or equal to the value of this parameter will be replaced with statistically plausible estimates, computed from nearby image regions.Rejection of very low pixels is necessary to prevent generation of large-scale artifacts around large dark structures, such as black borders generated by image registration. Under normal conditions you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter (4.5×10-5). Increase it in the unlikely case that you detect dark artifacts around black borders—which, at any rate, will always denote a defective image calibration that you should fix before normalization.
文件: 所有值小于或等于此参数值的像素都会用从邻近图像区域计算出的统计上合理的估计值替换。剔除极低像素是必要的，可防止在大块暗结构（例如图像配准产生的黑边）周围生成大尺度伪影。正常情况下不应需要更改此参数的默认值（4.5×10-5）。若你在黑边周围发现暗色伪影（这无论如何都表明校准有缺陷，应在归一化之前先修正），可提高此值。

FILE: Literal value lets you specify a pedestal value that will be subtracted from all target and master calibration frames. You usually don't need this option, except in very special cases.Default FITS keyword is the default mode. When this mode is selected, ImageCalibration will retrieve pedestal values from 'PEDESTAL' FITS keywords, when they are present in the input images. Note that ImageCalibration writes PEDESTAL keywords to calibrated images when a nonzero output pedestal is specified.Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword to retrieve pedestal values, when the specified keyword is present in the input images.
文件: 「字面值」让你指定一个会从所有目标帧与主校准帧中减去的基座值。除非常特殊的情况，通常不需要此选项。「默认 FITS 关键字」是默认模式。选择此模式时，ImageCalibration 会在输入图像中存在 'PEDESTAL' FITS 关键字时从中获取基座值。注意当指定了非零输出基座时，ImageCalibration 会把 PEDESTAL 关键字写入已校准图像。「自定义 FITS 关键字」允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字的名称，在输入图像中存在该关键字时从中获取基座值。

FILE: Low clipping pixel sample value in the [0,1] range.All pixels with values smaller than or equal to the value of this parameter will be replaced with statistically plausible estimates, computed from nearby image regions.Rejection of very low pixels is necessary to prevent generation of large-scale artifacts around large dark structures, such as black borders generated by image registration. Under normal conditions you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter (4.5×10-5). Increase it in the unlikely case that you detect dark artifacts around black borders—which, at any rate, will always denote a defective image calibration that you should fix before normalization.
文件: [0,1] 范围内的低端裁剪像素样本值。所有值小于或等于此参数值的像素都会用从邻近图像区域计算出的统计上合理的估计值替换。剔除极低像素是必要的，可防止在大块暗结构（例如图像配准产生的黑边）周围生成大尺度伪影。正常情况下不应需要更改此参数的默认值（4.5×10-5）。若你在黑边周围发现暗色伪影（这无论如何都表明校准有缺陷，应在归一化之前先修正），可提高此值。

FILE: The PSF flux evaluation method detects stars in the images and fits a point spread function model to each detected source. The fitted PSF parameters are then used to guide evaluation of the total flux of each source, and the fluxes of matched pairs of stars in both images are used to compute a robust and precise scale factor. This method is usually the best choice for normalization of deep-sky astronomical images where stars can be detected efficiently.The multiscale analysis method uses wavelet transforms and morphological operations to isolate significant image structures. The pixels gathered on the intersection between significant structures of the reference and target images are then evaluated statistically to estimate the scale factor.
文件: PSF 通量评估方法会在图像中检测恒星，并对每个检测到的源拟合点扩散函数模型。然后用拟合的 PSF 参数指导评估每个源的总通量，并用两幅图像中匹配星对的通量计算稳健而精确的尺度因子。对恒星能被高效检测的深空天文图像，此方法通常是归一化的最佳选择。多尺度分析方法使用小波变换与形态学操作分离出显著图像结构，然后对参考图像与目标图像显著结构交集上汇集到的像素做统计评估，从而估计尺度因子。

FILE: Our current implementation uses PSF photometry to generate robust and accurate measures of total and mean flux from detected and fitted sources. These estimates, along with estimates of the standard deviation of the noise, can be used for image grading and weighting with the SubframeSelector and ImageIntegration processes.The signal evaluation result will be stored as a set of custom, per-channel XISF properties and FITS header keywords that other processes and scripts can use for specialized image analysis purposes.This option should always be enabled for calibration of deep-sky, non-CFA raw light frames. For CFA data, signal and noise evaluation should be performed by the Debayer process, and hence this option should be disabled in ImageCalibration
文件: 我们目前的实现使用 PSF 测光，从检测并拟合的源中生成稳健而精确的总通量与平均通量测量值。这些估计值连同噪声标准差的估计，可用于 SubframeSelector 与 ImageIntegration 进程做图像评级与加权。信号评估结果会存为一组自定义的逐通道 XISF 属性与 FITS 文件头关键字，其他进程与脚本可将其用于专门的图像分析。对深空非 CFA 原始亮帧的校准应始终启用此选项。对于 CFA 数据，信号与噪声评估应由 Debayer 进程执行，因此在 ImageCalibration 中应禁用此选项。

FILE: Each dot in these graphs corresponds to a measured star. The X-axis corresponds to the catalog source index, and the Y-axis represents scale factors calculated using photometry from image pixel values and integrated spectral flux from catalog data. The horizontal lines represent the estimated scale factors of the image in each channel, and the shaded bands represent the estimated dispersion of these measurements. Ideally, all samples should be distributed on a horizontal straight line. The straighter and more horizontal the distribution and the narrower the dispersion band, the lower the uncertainty in the estimated scale factor.The graphs are interactive: move the mouse over a star to see its values, drag a rectangle to zoom in, Shift+drag to pan a zoomed graph, and double-click to restore the full view.
文件: 这些图中的每个点对应一颗被测恒星。X 轴对应星表源索引，Y 轴表示用图像像素值的测光结果与星表数据的叠加光谱通量计算出的尺度因子。水平线表示各通道中图像的估计尺度因子，阴影带表示这些测量的估计离散度。理想情况下所有样本应分布在一条水平直线上。分布越直越水平、离散带越窄，估计尺度因子的不确定度就越低。图形是可交互的：把鼠标移到某颗恒星上可看到其数值，拖拽矩形可放大，按住 Shift 拖拽可平移已放大的图形，双击可恢复完整视图。

FILE: The iterative k-sigma clipping algorithm can be used as a last-resort option in cases where the MRS algorithm does not converge systematically. This can happen on images with no detectable small-scale noise, but should never happen with uncalibrated data under normal working conditions.The N* robust noise estimator extracts a subset of residual pixels by comparison with a large-scale model of the local background of the image, generated with the multiscale median transform (MMT). Since the MMT is remarkably efficient at isolating image structures, it can be used to detect pixels that cannot contribute to significant structures. N* is an accurate and robust, alternative estimator of the standard deviation of the noise that does not assume or require any particular statistical distribution in the analyzed data.
文件: 在 MRS 算法系统性不收敛的情况下，可把迭代 k-sigma 裁剪算法作为最后手段。这可能发生在没有可检测小尺度噪声的图像上，但在正常工作条件下，未校准数据绝不应出现这种情况。N* 稳健噪声估计器通过与图像局部背景的大尺度模型（用多尺度中值变换 MMT 生成）比较，提取一部分残差像素。由于 MMT 在分离图像结构方面效率极高，可用它检测出无法构成显著结构的像素。N* 是一种精确而稳健的标准差替代估计器，不假设也不要求被测数据服从任何特定统计分布。

FILE: Detected stars with one or more pixels with values above this threshold will be excluded for relative scale evaluation. Similarly, when the multiscale analysis method of scale evaluation is selected, significant structure pixels above this value will also be excluded.This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).The default saturation threshold is 0.75. For relative scale evaluation this parameter is crucial in order to prevent contamination of the statistical sample of flux ratios by sources with saturated or nonlinear data. Changing the default value should not be necessary under normal conditions.
文件: 有一个或多个像素值高于此阈值的已检测星点将被排除在相对尺度评估之外。类似地，当选用的尺度评估方法为多尺度分析时，高于此值的显著结构像素也会被排除。此参数以 [0,1] 范围表示。它可以按归一化 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素样本值施加，也可以按相对于被测图像最大像素样本值的相对值施加（参见「相对饱和阈值」参数）。默认饱和阈值为 0.75。对于相对尺度评估，此参数至关重要，可防止饱和或非线性数据污染通量比的统计样本。正常情况下不应需要更改默认值。

FILE: This option should be enabled for normal use. If you disable it, the integrated image won't be generated at the end of the process. You can disable this option to save a relatively modest amount of computation time and resources while you are trying out rejection parameters. To evaluate the quality of pixel rejection, you normally are only interested in rejection pixel counts and/or rejection maps.
文件: 正常使用时应启用此选项。若禁用它，进程结束时不会生成叠加图像。在试调剔除参数时，可以禁用此选项以节省相对有限的运算时间与资源。要评估像素剔除质量，你通常只关心剔除像素计数和/或剔除图。

FILE: Local normalization applies per-pixel linear normalization functions previously calculated and stored in XNML files (.xnml file name suffix) by the LocalNormalization process. To apply this option, existing XNML files must be associated with input integration files. This option should normally be used when local normalization is also used for pixel rejection.The default option is additive normalization with scaling.
文件: 局部归一化会施加先前由 LocalNormalization 进程计算并存入 XNML 文件（后缀 .xnml）的逐像素线性归一化函数。要应用此选项，必须有 XNML 文件与输入叠加文件关联。通常在像素剔除也使用局部归一化时应使用此选项。默认选项是带缩放的可加性归一化。

FILE: Expected maximum fraction of outliers for the generalized ESD rejection algorithm.For example, a value of 0.2 applied to a stack of 10 pixels means that the ESD algorithm will be limited to detecting a maximum of two outlier pixels; in other words, only 0, 1, or 2 outliers will be detectable in that case. The default value is 0.3, which allows the algorithm to detect up to a 30% of outlier pixels in each pixel stack.
文件: 广义 ESD 剔除算法预期的最大离群比例。例如，对 10 个像素的堆栈取值 0.2，意味着 ESD 算法最多只能检测出两个离群像素；换言之，那种情况下只能检测出 0、1 或 2 个离群值。默认值为 0.3，允许算法在每个像素堆栈中检测最多 30% 的离群像素。

FILE: This option is enabled by default, as automatic exposure evaluation is a very fast and robust process that should never fail under normal conditions. Note that the automatic exposure evaluation routine does not depend on existing image metadata, as FITS headers or EXIF data (which are simply ignored by this tool). The computed relative exposures depend exclusively on actual pixel values and their statistical properties.
文件: 此选项默认启用，因为自动曝光评估是非常快速而稳健的过程，正常工作条件下绝不应失败。注意自动曝光评估例程不依赖已有图像元数据，例如 FITS 头或 EXIF 数据（本工具会直接忽略它们）。所计算的相对曝光完全取决于实际像素值及其统计特性。

FILE: When the input drizzle files include pixel rejection data, use them. Pixel rejection data are generated by the ImageIntegration tool, which you should have used with the generate drizzle data option enabled after StarAlignment and before the DrizzleIntegration tool. If this option is disabled, existing pixel rejection data will be ignored and hence no pixel rejection will be performed to generate the output integrated image.
文件: 当输入 drizzle 文件包含像素剔除数据时，使用它们。像素剔除数据由 ImageIntegration 工具生成 —— 你应在 StarAlignment 之后、DrizzleIntegration 工具之前启用「生成 drizzle 数据」选项运行它。若禁用此选项，已有像素剔除数据会被忽略，因而不会对生成输出叠加图像执行任何像素剔除。

FILE: Quantile limit is triggered when the median normalized weight is smaller than the protection threshold parameter. Then all weights greater than the quantile defined by the protection limit parameter are abnormal. This method always modifies a fixed fraction of the highest weights (5% by default), and cannot protect the integration when abnormal weights are more frequent. It is available for compatibility with previous versions.
文件: 当中值归一化权重小于保护阈值参数时，会触发分位数限制。此时所有大于保护上限参数所定义分位数的权重都属异常。此方法总是修改固定比例的最高权重（默认 5%），在异常权重更频繁时无法保护叠加。提供它是为了与早期版本兼容。

FILE: When this happens, the best option for integration of light or science frames is a linear rescaling, which preserves all of the integrated data. However, in some cases altering all pixel values is not admissible, so a rescaling operation is not applicable. This is the case for integration of flat frames, where truncation is the only option available to preserve the correct illumination profile in the integrated master flat frame.
文件: 出现这种情况时，亮帧或科学帧叠加的最佳选择是线性重标定，它能保留全部叠加数据。不过在某些情况下不允许改动所有像素值，因而重标定操作不适用。平场帧叠加就是这种情况：要保留叠加后主平场中正确的照明轮廓，截断是唯一可用的选项。

FILE: When Gaussian and variable shape drizzle kernel functions are used, this parameter defines the number of discrete function values computed to approximate the double integral of the kernel surface function. More function evaluations improve the accuracy of numerical integration at the cost of more computational work. The default value of this parameter is 16, meaning that 16*16=256 function values are computed to integrate drizzle kernel functions.
文件: 使用高斯与可变形状 drizzle 核函数时，此参数定义用于近似核表面函数二重积分的离散函数值数量。更多函数求值能提升数值积分的精度，代价是更多计算量。此参数默认值为 16，意味着用 16*16=256 个函数值来积分 drizzle 核函数。

FILE: This feature is very efficient to improve rejection of plane and satellite trails and flashes. With large-scale high pixel rejection enabled, you can be sure these artifacts will be correctly rejected without needing to reduce clipping factors, which in turn allows for more accurate rejection with inclusion of more signal in the integrated result. Large-scale low rejection may be useful to remove dust motes and other relatively large dark artifacts.
文件: 此功能在改善对飞机与卫星轨迹及闪光的剔除方面非常高效。启用大尺度高端像素剔除后，可以确保这些伪影被正确剔除而不必降低裁剪因子，这又使得剔除更准确，并在叠加结果中纳入更多信号。大尺度低端剔除可用于去除灰尘斑点及其它相对较大的暗色伪影。

FILE: If you select the FITS keyword option, please specify the name of a FITS keyword to retrieve image weights. The specified keyword must be present in all input images and its value must be of numeric type and positive.If you select the CSV weights file option, you must select a plain text file in CSV format with full file paths of integrated images and their corresponding per-channel image weights. See the CSV weights file parameter for more information.
文件: 若选择 FITS 关键字选项，请指定一个用于获取图像权重的 FITS 关键字名称。指定的关键字必须存在于所有输入图像中，其值必须是数值类型且为正。若选择 CSV 权重文件选项，你必须选择一个 CSV 格式的纯文本文件，其中包含被叠加图像的完整文件路径及其对应的逐通道图像权重。详见「CSV 权重文件」参数。

FILE: Biweight location combination: the number of rejected pixels the guard requires, besides the guard fraction of the total weight, before the estimate starts blending into the weighted average, which it does fully with one more rejected pixel. In small stacks with uneven image weights, a single artifact in an image with a large weight can carry more than the guard fraction of the total weight; such isolated outliers must still be rejected. The default value is 2.
文件: 双权位置组合：在估计开始向加权平均混合之前（再多一个被剔除像素就完全混合），除总权重的保护比例之外，保护机制还要求的被剔除像素数量。在图像权重不均的小堆栈中，高权重图像中的单个伪影就可能超过总权重的保护比例；这类孤立离群值仍必须被剔除。默认值为 2。

FILE: Generate the result of the integration process as a new image window.This option should be enabled for normal use. If you disable it, the integrated image won't be generated at the end of the process. You can disable this option to save a relatively modest amount of computation time and resources while you are trying out rejection parameters. To evaluate the quality of pixel rejection, you normally are only interested in rejection pixel counts and/or rejection maps.
文件: 把叠加过程的结果生成为新图像窗口。正常使用时应启用此选项。若禁用它，进程结束时不会生成叠加图像。在试调剔除参数时，可以禁用此选项以节省相对有限的运算时间与资源。要评估像素剔除质量，你通常只关心剔除像素计数和/或剔除图。

FILE: Drizzle drop shrink factor. This is a reduction factor applied to input image pixels. Smaller input pixels or drops tend to yield sharper results because the integrated image is formed by convolution with a smaller PSF. However, smaller input pixels are more prone to dry (uncovered) output pixels, visible patterns caused by partial sampling, and overall decreased SNR. Low shrink factors require more and better dithered input images. The default drop shrink factor is 0.9.
文件: drizzle drop 收缩因子。这是施加于输入图像像素的缩小因子。输入像素或 drop 越小，结果越锐利，因为叠加图像是以更小的 PSF 卷积形成的。但输入像素越小，输出像素越容易出现「干」像素（未被覆盖）、由部分采样引起的可见图案，以及整体 SNR 下降。小的收缩因子需要更多、抖动更好的输入图像。默认 drop 收缩因子为 0.9。

FILE: For example, a significance level of 0.01 means that a 1% chance of being wrong when rejecting the null hypothesis (that there are no outliers in a pixel stack) is acceptable. The default value is 0.05 (5% significance level).Increasing this parameter tends to cause the ESD algorithm to reject more pixels in each stack. Increasing this parameter has an effect similar to reducing the threshold of a sigma-clipping algorithm, although the underlying mechanisms are very different.
文件: 例如，显著性水平 0.01 意味着在拒绝原假设（像素堆栈中没有离群值）时可接受 1% 的出错概率。默认值为 0.05（5% 显著性水平）。提高此参数倾向于让 ESD 算法在每个堆栈中剔除更多像素。提高此参数的效果类似于降低 sigma 裁剪算法的阈值，尽管底层机制很不相同。

FILE: This parameter defines a quantile (in the [0,1] range) to acquire the maximum allowed image weight in the data set. All weights greater than the value determined by this quantile will be replaced with either the median weight or zero if the remove abnormally weighted images option is enabled. This effectively protects the integration process from degradation caused by incorrect metadata or quality and noise estimates.This parameter is only used by the quantile limit protection method.
文件: 此参数定义 [0,1] 范围内的一个分位数，用于获取数据集中允许的最大图像权重。所有大于由此分位数确定的值的权重都会被替换为中值权重；若启用了「移除异常加权图像」选项则替换为零。这有效保护叠加过程不被错误元数据或质量/噪声估计所劣化。此参数只用于分位数限制保护方法。

FILE: If the input drizzle files include surface splines for image registration, use them. Registration splines are generated by the StarAlignment tool with its two-dimensional surface splines or recursive surface splines registration models. Drizzle files of XDRZ format versions 1.0 and 1.1 are supported. If this option is disabled, projective transformations will always be used. This can be useful to save time during tests, since surface splines require additional slow computations for each input image.
文件: 若输入 drizzle 文件包含用于图像配准的表面样条，使用它们。配准样条由 StarAlignment 工具用其二维表面样条或递归表面样条配准模型生成。支持 XDRZ 格式 1.0 与 1.1 版本的 drizzle 文件。若禁用此选项，则总是使用投影变换。这在测试期间可用来节省时间，因为表面样条需要对每张输入图像做额外的慢速计算。

FILE: Use the largest possible buffer and stack sizes, calculated automatically from the amount of physical memory currently available to PixInsight.Usually this is the best option to optimize image integration performance, but be aware that for large data sets and low-memory machines (relative to the total size of the data) the process may use too many system resources. If you want finer control on system resources usage, disable this option and tweak the values of the buffer size and stack size parameters.
文件: 使用尽可能大的缓冲区与堆栈尺寸，由当前可供 PixInsight 使用的物理内存量自动计算。通常这是优化图像叠加性能的最佳选项，但要注意对大数据集和内存较小的机器（相对于数据总大小），进程可能占用过多系统资源。若想更细致地控制系统资源使用，请禁用此选项并调整「缓冲区大小」与「堆栈大小」参数的值。

FILE: If the default Auto option is selected for the CFA pattern parameter (see below), DrizzleIntegration will retrieve CFA patterns from input .xdrz files. These patterns are gathered by the Debayer process and generated in .xdrz files by image registration processes such as StarAlignment or CometAlignment.If one of the supported CFA patterns is selected, such as RGGB, BGGR, etc, the process will assume the selected pattern even if it overrides data provided by .xdrz files (warning messages will be shown in such cases).
文件: 若 CFA 图案参数选择了默认的「自动」选项（见下），DrizzleIntegration 会从输入 .xdrz 文件中获取 CFA 图案。这些图案由 Debayer 进程收集，并由 StarAlignment 或 CometAlignment 等图像配准进程生成到 .xdrz 文件中。若选择了某个受支持的 CFA 图案（例如 RGGB、BGGR 等），进程会假定使用所选图案，即使它覆盖 .xdrz 文件提供的数据（这种情况会显示警告信息）。

FILE: Biweight location combination: the tolerance of bright structures, relative to their signal above the background. The pixels of stars and other bright structures differ from frame to frame because of seeing, tracking and transparency, much more than their noise allows; these differences are not outliers, and rejecting them would bias the integrated flux. The cutoff of a pixel grows with epsilon times its signal. The default value of 0.5 preserves the flux of bright structures. Set it to zero for the plain biweight location.
文件: 双权位置组合：亮结构的容差，相对于它们高于背景的信号。恒星及其它亮结构的像素会因视宁度、跟踪与透明度而在帧间变化，其幅度远超其噪声所允许的范围；这些差异不是离群值，剔除它们会使叠加通量产生偏差。像素的截断值随其信号乘以 epsilon 而增大。默认值 0.5 可保留亮结构的通量。设为 0 即为普通双权位置。

FILE: In all cases elliptical functions are fitted to detected star structures, and PSF sampling regions are defined adaptively using a median stabilization algorithm.When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for flux measurement. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.
文件: 在所有情况下都会对检测到的恒星结构拟合椭圆函数，并用中值稳定化算法自适应地定义 PSF 采样区域。选中「自动」选项时，会为每个源拟合一系列不同的 PSF，并采用函数值与采样像素值之间绝对差最小的拟合结果做通量测量。目前此特殊自动模式测试以下函数：beta 形状参数分别等于 2.5、4、6、10 的 Moffat 函数。

FILE: This parameter defines the size of the working buffers used to read pixel rows. There is an independent buffer per input image. A reasonably large buffer size will improve performance by minimizing disk reading operations. The default value of 16 MiB is usually quite appropriate.Decrease this parameter if you experience out-of-memory errors during integration. This may be necessary for integration of large image sets on systems with low memory resources. The minimum value is zero, which will use a single row of pixels per input image.
文件: 此参数定义用于读取像素行的工作缓冲区大小。每张输入图像有独立的缓冲区。合理较大的缓冲区尺寸能通过最小化磁盘读取操作来提升性能。默认值 16 MiB 通常相当合适。若在叠加期间遇到内存不足错误，请降低此参数。在内存资源较少的系统上叠加大批图像时可能需要这样做。最小值为零，表示每张输入图像只使用一行像素。

FILE: This option should always be disabled if local normalization is used, since subtracting pedestals invalidates local normalization functions. Local normalization already compensates for differing additive components among integrated frames.This option should also be disabled for integration of raw bias and dark frames, since in these cases existing PEDESTAL keywords should be preserved in the generated master bias and dark frames. These pedestals will be subtracted automatically by the ImageCalibration process for calibration of flat and light frames.
文件: 若使用局部归一化，应始终禁用此选项，因为减去基座会使局部归一化函数失效。局部归一化已经补偿了被叠加帧之间不同的可加分量。叠加原始偏置帧与暗帧时也应禁用此选项，因为这些情况下既有的 PEDESTAL 关键字应保留在生成的主偏置与主暗帧中。这些基座会被 ImageCalibration 进程在校准平场与亮帧时自动减去。

FILE: If this field is left blank, input images will be loaded from the directories specified in their corresponding drizzle data files. This is the default behavior.If an existing directory is specified, it will override the directories specified in all input drizzle data files. This is useful when one is going to execute an instance of DrizzleIntegration that has been generated on a different machine or filesystem; for example, if you borrow a process icon from a friend, quite likely the same images will be stored on different locations of your hard disk.
文件: 若此字段留空，输入图像会从其对应 drizzle 数据文件中指定的目录载入。这是默认行为。若指定了某个已存在的目录，它会覆盖所有输入 drizzle 数据文件中指定的目录。当要执行在另一台机器或文件系统上生成的 DrizzleIntegration 实例时，这很有用；例如你从朋友那里借来一个进程图标，那些图像很可能存在你硬盘的不同位置。

FILE: When the weight overshoot protection feature is enabled, this parameter defines which weights are abnormal, to prevent contamination of the integrated result by spurious data associated with abnormally high weights.With the per image method, a weight is abnormal when it is greater than the upper quartile of the weights divided by this parameter. With the quantile limit method, protection is triggered when the median normalized weight is smaller than this parameter.The lower this parameter, the more permissive the integration will be to allow high weights.
文件: 启用权重超限保护功能时，此参数定义哪些权重属于异常，以防异常高权重相关的虚假数据污染叠加结果。用「逐图像」方法时，权重大于权重的上四分位数除以此参数所得值时即属异常。用「分位数限制」方法时，当中值归一化权重小于此参数时触发保护。此参数越低，叠加对高权重越宽容。

FILE: For example, you can use the "raw" hint to force the DSLR_RAW format to load pure raw images without applying any deBayering, interpolation, white balance or black point correction. You can also specify the "lower-range" and "upper-range" hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 例如，可以用 "raw" 提示强制 DSLR_RAW 格式载入纯原始图像，不施加任何去马赛克、插值、白平衡或黑点校正。也可以指定 "lower-range" 与 "upper-range" 提示来载入其他程序生成的、不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式都支持若干输入和/或输出提示，可在提供格式提示访问的工具中用于不同目的。

FILE: For example, you can use the "raw cfa" hints to force the RAW format to load pure raw images without applying any demosaicing, interpolation, white balance, or black point correction. You can also specify the "lower-range" and "upper-range" hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 例如，可以用 "raw cfa" 提示强制 RAW 格式载入纯原始图像，不施加任何去马赛克、插值、白平衡或黑点校正。也可以指定 "lower-range" 与 "upper-range" 提示来载入其他程序生成的、不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式都支持若干输入和/或输出提示，可在提供格式提示访问的工具中用于不同目的。

FILE: The HDR composition process performs a masked combination of each successive pair of images, in decreasing order of relative exposure. For each pair of combined images, the binarizing threshold defines the regions of the long-exposure image that will be replaced with pixels from the short-exposure image.Too high of a binarizing threshold may prevent appropriate repairing of saturated regions with the corresponding pixels from unsaturated images. A too low threshold may cause the opposite effect, leading to a result with insufficient contributions of large exposures.
文件: HDR 合成过程会按相对曝光递减的顺序，对每对相邻图像执行带蒙版的组合。对每对组合图像，二值化阈值定义长曝光图像中将被短曝光图像像素替换的区域。二值化阈值过高可能无法用未饱和图像的对应像素恰当修复饱和区域。阈值过低则可能产生相反效果，导致结果中大曝光图像的贡献不足。

FILE: The original Chauvenet rejection criterion is N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5, where N is the number of measurements and P() represents the probability of x being more than z standard deviations from the mean. This parameter modifies the rejection criterion by replacing 0.5 with an arbitrary limit in the [0,1] range, in order to make the algorithm controllable. The default value is 0.1, which usually works well with most deep-sky images. Note that a single limit parameter is applied for rejection of both low and high pixels, since the implemented iterative rejection method is symmetrical.
文件: 原始 Chauvenet 剔除准则是 N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5，其中 N 是测量次数，P() 表示 x 偏离均值超过 z 个标准差的概率。此参数把准则中的 0.5 替换为 [0,1] 范围内的任意限值，使算法可控。默认值为 0.1，对多数深空图像通常效果良好。注意低端与高端像素剔除使用同一个限值参数，因为所实现的迭代剔除方法是对称的。

FILE: Generate separate rejection maps for the pixels rejected implicitly by the biweight location combination: the pixels beyond their cutoffs, which have no weight in the estimate. The standard rejection maps include both explicit and implicit rejection; these maps show the biweight location rejection alone, so its efficiency can be evaluated when it works combined with a rejection algorithm. As with the standard maps, low and high rejected pixels are mapped when the clip low and clip high options are enabled, respectively. The total implicit rejection counts are shown on the console.
文件: 为被双权位置组合隐式剔除的像素生成单独的剔除图：即超出其截断值、在估计中权重为零的像素。标准剔除图同时包含显式与隐式剔除；这些图只显示双权位置剔除，因此可以评估它在与某个剔除算法配合工作时的效率。与标准图一样，当分别启用「裁剪低端」与「裁剪高端」选项时会映射低端与高端被剔除像素。隐式剔除总数会显示在控制台上。

FILE: Point spread function type used for PSF fitting and photometry.In all cases elliptical functions are fitted to detected star structures, and PSF sampling regions are defined adaptively using a median stabilization algorithm.When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for flux measurement. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.
文件: 用于 PSF 拟合与测光的点扩散函数类型。在所有情况下都会对检测到的恒星结构拟合椭圆函数，并用中值稳定化算法自适应地定义 PSF 采样区域。选中「自动」选项时，会为每个源拟合一系列不同的 PSF，并采用函数值与采样像素值之间绝对差最小的拟合结果做通量测量。目前此特殊自动模式测试以下函数：beta 形状参数分别等于 2.5、4、6、10 的 Moffat 函数。

FILE: Override the directories of input image files.If this field is left blank, input images will be loaded from the directories specified in their corresponding drizzle data files. This is the default behavior.If an existing directory is specified, it will override the directories specified in all input drizzle data files. This is useful when one is going to execute an instance of DrizzleIntegration that has been generated on a different machine or filesystem; for example, if you borrow a process icon from a friend, quite likely the same images will be stored on different locations of your hard disk.
文件: 覆盖输入图像文件的目录。若此字段留空，输入图像会从其对应 drizzle 数据文件中指定的目录载入。这是默认行为。若指定了某个已存在的目录，它会覆盖所有输入 drizzle 数据文件中指定的目录。当要执行在另一台机器或文件系统上生成的 DrizzleIntegration 实例时，这很有用；例如你从朋友那里借来一个进程图标，那些图像很可能存在你硬盘的不同位置。

FILE: When the input drizzle files include image weighting data, use them. Image weights are generated by the ImageIntegration tool, which you should have used with the generate drizzle data option enabled after StarAlignment and before the DrizzleIntegration tool. If this option is disabled, existing image weighting data will be ignored and hence all input images will contribute equally to the output integrated image. In general, image weights based on robust image quality and SNR estimators, such as PSF Signal Weight, PSF SNR and PSF Scale SNR, should always be used to achieve an optimal integrated image.
文件: 当输入 drizzle 文件包含图像加权数据时，使用它们。图像权重由 ImageIntegration 工具生成 —— 你应在 StarAlignment 之后、DrizzleIntegration 工具之前启用「生成 drizzle 数据」选项运行它。若禁用此选项，已有图像加权数据会被忽略，因而所有输入图像对输出叠加图像的贡献均等。一般来说，基于稳健图像质量与 SNR 估计器（例如 PSF Signal Weight、PSF SNR 与 PSF Scale SNR）的图像权重应始终被使用，以获得最优的叠加图像。

FILE: Biweight location combination: the fraction of the total weight of a pixel stack lost to the cutoffs beyond which the estimate blends progressively into the weighted average, which it reaches at twice this fraction. A group of pixels carrying a large fraction of the weight is signal, not outliers: stars whose shapes vary between sessions, such as the comatic wings of corner stars imaged with different camera angles, are present in some sessions and absent in others, and rejecting them would leave dark notches in the stars. The default value is 0.1. Set it to 0.5 to practically disable this protection.
文件: 双权位置组合：像素堆栈总权重中被截断值损失的比例，超过此值后估计会逐渐向加权平均混合，达到此比例的两倍时完全混合。携带大比例权重的一组像素是信号而非离群值：形状在不同观测夜之间变化的恒星（例如不同相机角度拍摄时画幅角落恒星的彗形翼）有时出现有时不出现，剔除它们会在恒星上留下暗色缺口。默认值为 0.1。设为 0.5 实际上就关闭了这一保护。

FILE: Scaling matches dispersion. This works as a sort of automatic weighting to combine the input images, and tends to improve the SNR of the result, especially for images with different overall illumination.Local normalization applies per-pixel linear normalization functions previously calculated and stored in XNML files (.xnml file name suffix) by the LocalNormalization process. To apply this option, existing XNML files must be associated with input integration files. This option should normally be used when local normalization is also used for pixel rejection.The default option is additive normalization with scaling.
文件: 「缩放匹配离散度」。它起到一种自动加权的作用来组合输入图像，往往能提升结果的 SNR，尤其对于整体照明不同的图像。局部归一化会施加先前由 LocalNormalization 进程计算并存入 XNML 文件（后缀 .xnml）的逐像素线性归一化函数。要应用此选项，必须有 XNML 文件与输入叠加文件关联。通常在像素剔除也使用局部归一化时应使用此选项。默认选项是带缩放的可加性归一化。

FILE: When this option is enabled, the selected noise evaluation algorithm (MRS by default) will be used to compute the standard deviation of the noise in the integrated result. These estimates are typically to within 1% accuracy. Besides noise estimates, a final report will be generated with per-channel robust descriptive statistics, SNR and PSF Signal Weight estimates.This option is useful to compare the results of different integration procedures. For example, by comparing SNR and PSF Signal Weight estimates you can know which image normalization and weighting criteria lead to the best results in terms of image quality.
文件: 启用此选项时，会用所选噪声评估算法（默认 MRS）计算叠加结果中噪声的标准差。这些估计的精度通常在 1% 以内。除噪声估计外，还会生成一份最终报告，包含逐通道的稳健描述性统计、SNR 与 PSF Signal Weight 估计。此选项可用于比较不同叠加过程的结果。例如，比较 SNR 与 PSF Signal Weight 估计，就能知道哪种图像归一化与加权准则在图像质量方面能得到最佳结果。

FILE: A 32-bit floating point image is sufficient to represent HDR compositions of small or moderate size. Keep in mind that a 32-bit image provides room for a maximum of about 107 discrete sample values, or approximately 153 times the range of a 16-bit image. Very large HDR images may easily exceed that limit and hence require a 64-bit floating point result, which provides a huge space of 1015 discrete values.Note that the words 'small' and 'large' here don't refer to the number of images in an HDR composition, but to the length of the required numeric range to represent the whole set of tonal values in the final HDR result.
文件: 32 位浮点图像足以表示小型或中等规模的 HDR 合成。请记住，32 位图像最多提供约 10^7 个离散样本值的空间，约为 16 位图像范围的 153 倍。非常大的 HDR 图像很容易超出这一限制，因而需要 64 位浮点结果，它提供 10^15 个离散值的巨大空间。注意这里的「小」与「大」不是指 HDR 合成中的图像数量，而是指表示最终 HDR 结果中全部色调值所需的数值范围长度。

FILE: If the integrated data set has been reviewed to ensure the validity of images and metadata, this feature is not necessary. However, when the necessary checks cannot be implemented, or data validity cannot be guaranteed, using this feature can achieve acceptable results by automatically removing the influence of spurious data and metadata.This feature assumes a homogeneous data set, where the best images are expected to have similar weights. For example, in a data set that mixes exposures of very different durations, valid weights can be more than ten times greater than those of most images. Don't enable this option for such data sets.
文件: 若已审查叠加数据集以确保图像与元数据有效，此功能就不必要。但在无法实施必要检查、或无法保证数据有效时，使用此功能可通过自动消除虚假数据与元数据的影响来获得可接受的结果。此功能假定数据集是同质的，即最好的图像预期具有相近的权重。例如，在混有差异极大的曝光时长的数据集中，有效权重可能比多数图像的权重大十倍以上。这类数据集不要启用此选项。

FILE: No out-of-range values should occur after integration of a well-calibrated data set under normal conditions. However, sometimes saturated pixels may lead to out-of-range values after output normalization, depending on the frame selected as integration reference.When this happens, the best option for integration of light or science frames is a linear rescaling, which preserves all of the integrated data. However, in some cases altering all pixel values is not admissible, so a rescaling operation is not applicable. In such cases truncation is the only option available to preserve the correct illumination profile in the integrated result.
文件: 正常情况下，叠加良好校准的数据集后不应出现超范围值。不过有时饱和像素会在输出归一化后导致超范围值，这取决于选作叠加参考的帧。出现这种情况时，亮帧或科学帧叠加的最佳选择是线性重标定，它能保留全部叠加数据。不过在某些情况下不允许改动所有像素值，因而重标定操作不适用。这些情况下截断是唯一可用的选项，用于在叠加结果中保留正确的照明轮廓。

FILE: Significance level of the outlier detection hypothesis test. This is the probability of making a Type I error (false positive) in the generalized ESD rejection algorithm.For example, a significance level of 0.01 means that a 1% chance of being wrong when rejecting the null hypothesis (that there are no outliers in a pixel stack) is acceptable. The default value is 0.05 (5% significance level).Increasing this parameter tends to cause the ESD algorithm to reject more pixels in each stack. Increasing this parameter has an effect similar to reducing the threshold of a sigma-clipping algorithm, although the underlying mechanisms are very different.
文件: 离群检测假设检验的显著性水平。这是广义 ESD 剔除算法中犯第一类错误（假阳性）的概率。例如，显著性水平 0.01 意味着在拒绝原假设（像素堆栈中没有离群值）时可接受 1% 的出错概率。默认值为 0.05（5% 显著性水平）。提高此参数倾向于让 ESD 算法在每个堆栈中剔除更多像素。提高此参数的效果类似于降低 sigma 裁剪算法的阈值，尽管底层机制很不相同。

FILE: Averaged iterative sigma clipping is intended for sets of 10 or more images. This algorithm tries to derive the gain of an ideal CCD detector from existing pixel data, assuming zero readout noise, then uses a Poisson noise model to perform rejection. For large sets of images however, sigma clipping tends to be superior.The min/max method can be used to ensure rejection of extreme values. Min/max performs an unconditional rejection of a fixed number of pixels from each stack, without any statistical basis. Rejection methods based on robust statistics, such as percentile, Winsorized sigma clipping, linear fitting and averaged sigma clipping are in general preferable.
文件: 平均迭代 sigma 裁剪适用于 10 张以上图像的数据集。此算法尝试从现有像素数据推导理想 CCD 探测器的增益（假定读出噪声为零），然后用泊松噪声模型执行剔除。不过对大批图像，sigma 裁剪往往更优。最小/最大法可用于确保剔除极端值。最小/最大法对每个堆栈无条件剔除固定数量的像素，没有任何统计依据。基于稳健统计的剔除方法，例如百分位、Winsor 化 sigma 裁剪、线性拟合与平均 sigma 裁剪，一般更可取。

FILE: No out-of-range values should occur after integration of a well-calibrated data set under normal conditions. However, sometimes saturated pixels may lead to out-of-range values after output normalization, depending on the frame selected as integration reference.When this happens, the best option for integration of light or science frames is a linear rescaling, which preserves all of the integrated data. However, in some cases altering all pixel values is not admissible, so a rescaling operation is not applicable. This is the case for integration of flat frames, where truncation is the only option available to preserve the correct illumination profile in the integrated master flat frame.
文件: 正常情况下，叠加良好校准的数据集后不应出现超范围值。不过有时饱和像素会在输出归一化后导致超范围值，这取决于选作叠加参考的帧。出现这种情况时，亮帧或科学帧叠加的最佳选择是线性重标定，它能保留全部叠加数据。不过在某些情况下不允许改动所有像素值，因而重标定操作不适用。平场帧叠加就是这种情况：要保留叠加后主平场中正确的照明轮廓，截断是唯一可用的选项。

FILE: By default, ImageIntegration generates and uses a dynamic cache of working image parameters, including pixel statistics and normalization data. This cache greatly improves performance when the same images are being integrated several times, for example to find optimal pixel rejection parameters.Disable this option if for some reason you don't want to use the cache. This will force recalculation of all statistical data required for normalization, which involves loading all integrated image files from disk.The file cache can also be persistent across PixInsight core application executions. The persistent cache and its options can be controlled with the ImageIntegration Preferences dialog.
文件: 默认情况下，ImageIntegration 会生成并使用工作图像参数的动态缓存，包括像素统计与归一化数据。对同一批图像反复叠加时（例如寻找最优像素剔除参数），此缓存能极大提升性能。若因某种原因不想使用缓存，请禁用此选项。这会强制重新计算归一化所需的全部统计数据，涉及从磁盘载入所有叠加图像文件。文件缓存也可以跨 PixInsight 核心应用程序执行持久化。持久缓存及其选项可用 ImageIntegration 首选项对话框控制。

FILE: The larger the value of this parameter, the more pixels will be rejected by the Robust Chauvenet Rejection algorithm.The original Chauvenet rejection criterion is N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5, where N is the number of measurements and P() represents the probability of x being more than z standard deviations from the mean. This parameter modifies the rejection criterion by replacing 0.5 with an arbitrary limit in the [0,1] range, in order to make the algorithm controllable. The default value is 0.1, which usually works well with most deep-sky images. Note that a single limit parameter is applied for rejection of both low and high pixels, since the implemented iterative rejection method is symmetrical.
文件: 此参数值越大，稳健 Chauvenet 剔除算法剔除的像素越多。原始 Chauvenet 剔除准则是 N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5，其中 N 是测量次数，P() 表示 x 偏离均值超过 z 个标准差的概率。此参数把准则中的 0.5 替换为 [0,1] 范围内的任意限值，使算法可控。默认值为 0.1，对多数深空图像通常效果良好。注意低端与高端像素剔除使用同一个限值参数，因为所实现的迭代剔除方法是对称的。

FILE: Generate noise, SNR and PSF Signal Weight estimates for the final integrated image.When this option is enabled, the selected noise evaluation algorithm (MRS by default) will be used to compute the standard deviation of the noise in the integrated result. These estimates are typically to within 1% accuracy. Besides noise estimates, a final report will be generated with per-channel robust descriptive statistics, SNR and PSF Signal Weight estimates.This option is useful to compare the results of different integration procedures. For example, by comparing SNR and PSF Signal Weight estimates you can know which image normalization and weighting criteria lead to the best results in terms of image quality.
文件: 为最终叠加图像生成噪声、SNR 与 PSF Signal Weight 估计。启用此选项时，会用所选噪声评估算法（默认 MRS）计算叠加结果中噪声的标准差。这些估计的精度通常在 1% 以内。除噪声估计外，还会生成一份最终报告，包含逐通道的稳健描述性统计、SNR 与 PSF Signal Weight 估计。此选项可用于比较不同叠加过程的结果。例如，比较 SNR 与 PSF Signal Weight 估计，就能知道哪种图像归一化与加权准则在图像质量方面能得到最佳结果。

FILE: Large-scale pixel rejection uses multiscale analysis techniques to detect structures of rejected pixels. These structures are grown to cover borderline regions where high uncertainty may lead to insufficient rejection by statistical pixel rejection algorithms.This feature is very efficient to improve rejection of plane and satellite trails and flashes. With large-scale high pixel rejection enabled, you can be sure these artifacts will be correctly rejected without needing to reduce clipping factors, which in turn allows for more accurate rejection with inclusion of more signal in the integrated result. Large-scale low rejection may be useful to remove dust motes and other relatively large dark artifacts.
文件: 大尺度像素剔除使用多尺度分析技术检测被剔除像素的结构。这些结构会被扩展以覆盖边界区域 —— 那里的高不确定度可能导致统计像素剔除算法剔除不足。此功能在改善对飞机与卫星轨迹及闪光的剔除方面非常高效。启用大尺度高端像素剔除后，可以确保这些伪影被正确剔除而不必降低裁剪因子，这又使得剔除更准确，并在叠加结果中纳入更多信号。大尺度低端剔除可用于去除灰尘斑点及其它相对较大的暗色伪影。

FILE: Biweight location combination is a weighted Tukey's biweight location estimate of each pixel stack. It provides implicit robust rejection of outliers with practically the SNR improvement of average combination. Like the average, it applies the image weights, and can be used with or without pixel rejection. The deviation of each pixel is measured in units of the noise of its image. When the samples beyond the cutoffs carry a large fraction of the total weight of a pixel stack, the estimate blends progressively into the weighted average: such large groups of samples are signal, as in stars whose shapes vary between sessions, not outliers. The parameters of the biweight location are in the Pixel Rejection (3) section.
文件: 双权位置组合是对每个像素堆栈的加权 Tukey 双权位置估计。它提供对离群值的隐式稳健剔除，同时几乎具有平均组合的 SNR 提升效果。与平均一样，它会施加图像权重，并且可配合像素剔除使用，也可不配合。每个像素的偏差以其图像噪声为单位度量。当截断值之外的样本携带像素堆栈总权重的较大比例时，估计会逐渐向加权平均混合：这样的大样本组是信号（例如形状在不同观测夜之间变化的恒星），而非离群值。双权位置的参数在「像素剔除 (3)」一节。

FILE: When assigning local normalization data files to drizzle input images, take into account full file paths stored in .xdrz and .xnml files. This allows you to integrate images with duplicate file names on different directories. However, by enabling this option your data set gets tied to specific locations on the local filesystem. When this option is disabled (the default state), only file names are used to associate .xdrz and .xnml files, which allows you to move your images freely throughout the filesystem, including the possibility to migrate them to different machines.Changes to this option will come into play the next time you associate .xnml files with drizzle input images. Existing file associations are not affected.
文件: 为 drizzle 输入图像分配局部归一化数据文件时，考虑 .xdrz 与 .xnml 文件中存储的完整文件路径。这样你可以叠加不同目录中文件名重复的图像。不过启用此选项后，你的数据集就会与本地文件系统上的特定位置绑定。禁用此选项时（默认状态），只用文件名关联 .xdrz 与 .xnml 文件，这让你可以在文件系统中自由移动图像，包括迁移到不同机器。对此选项的更改会在下次为 drizzle 输入图像关联 .xnml 文件时生效。已有文件关联不受影响。

FILE: A region of interest (ROI) defines a rectangular subset of the image to perform the drizzle integration task. This is useful because the task's execution time (and also its memory space consumption) grows quadratically with the dimensions of the output integrated image. By defining a small ROI one can speed up the process significantly, which can be very helpful to test the drizzle process repeatedly.Note that the coordinates and dimensions of the ROI are expressed in input reference pixels, not in output pixels. You can define ROI coordinates on an integrated image generated by the ImageIntegration tool, or on a registered image created by StarAlignment, for example by defining a preview and clicking the from preview button below.
文件: 感兴趣区域（ROI）定义执行 drizzle 叠加任务的图像矩形子集。这很有用，因为任务的执行时间（以及内存占用）会随输出叠加图像尺寸的平方增长。定义较小的 ROI 可以显著加快进程，这对反复测试 drizzle 过程非常有帮助。注意 ROI 的坐标与尺寸以输入参考像素表示，而非输出像素。你可以在 ImageIntegration 工具生成的叠加图像或 StarAlignment 创建的已配准图像上定义 ROI 坐标，例如定义一个预览后点击下方的「从预览」按钮。

FILE: Limit for the modified Chauvenet rejection criterion.The larger the value of this parameter, the more pixels will be rejected by the Robust Chauvenet Rejection algorithm.The original Chauvenet rejection criterion is N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5, where N is the number of measurements and P() represents the probability of x being more than z standard deviations from the mean. This parameter modifies the rejection criterion by replacing 0.5 with an arbitrary limit in the [0,1] range, in order to make the algorithm controllable. The default value is 0.1, which usually works well with most deep-sky images. Note that a single limit parameter is applied for rejection of both low and high pixels, since the implemented iterative rejection method is symmetrical.
文件: 改进 Chauvenet 剔除准则的限值。此参数值越大，稳健 Chauvenet 剔除算法剔除的像素越多。原始 Chauvenet 剔除准则是 N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5，其中 N 是测量次数，P() 表示 x 偏离均值超过 z 个标准差的概率。此参数把准则中的 0.5 替换为 [0,1] 范围内的任意限值，使算法可控。默认值为 0.1，对多数深空图像通常效果良好。注意低端与高端像素剔除使用同一个限值参数，因为所实现的迭代剔除方法是对称的。

FILE: When assigning drizzle and/or local normalization data files to target images, take into account full file paths stored in .xdrz and .xnml files. This allows you to integrate images with duplicate file names on different directories. However, by enabling this option your data set gets tied to specific locations on the local filesystem. When this option is disabled (the default state), only file names are used to associate target images with .xdrz and .xnml files, which allows you to move your images freely throughout the filesystem, including the possibility to migrate them to different machines.Changes to this option will come into play the next time you associate .xdrz and/or .xnml files with target images. Existing file associations are not affected.
文件: 为目标图像分配 drizzle 和/或局部归一化数据文件时，考虑 .xdrz 与 .xnml 文件中存储的完整文件路径。这样你可以叠加不同目录中文件名重复的图像。不过启用此选项后，你的数据集就会与本地文件系统上的特定位置绑定。禁用此选项时（默认状态），只用文件名把目标图像与 .xdrz 和 .xnml 文件关联，这让你可以在文件系统中自由移动图像，包括迁移到不同机器。对此选项的更改会在下次为目标图像关联 .xdrz 和/或 .xnml 文件时生效。已有文件关联不受影响。

FILE: HDRComposition performs a linear fit to match the tonal ranges of each pair of combined images. Linear fitting can be restricted to a user-defined rectangular region of interest, which has two main advantages: (1) linear fitting is a relatively expensive process and restricting it to a smaller region improves performance, and (2) by restricting the region of pixels used to compute linear fitting functions, accuracy can be improved in case there are small flat fielding errors (nonuniform illumination) near the edges of the images, which is a frequent problem.When enabled, the fitting rectangle must define a nonempty subset of the input images. When the fitting region is disabled (the default option), the whole image is used to compute linear fitting functions.
文件: HDRComposition 会做线性拟合以匹配每对组合图像的色调范围。线性拟合可以限制在用户定义的矩形感兴趣区域内，这有两个主要优点：(1) 线性拟合是相对昂贵的运算，限制在更小区域能提升性能；(2) 通过限制用于计算线性拟合函数的像素区域，在图像边缘附近存在轻微平场误差（照明不均）时能提升精度 —— 这是个常见问题。启用时，拟合矩形必须界定输入图像的非空子集。禁用拟合区域时（默认选项），使用整幅图像计算线性拟合函数。

FILE: Local normalization applies per-pixel linear normalization functions previously calculated and stored in XNML files (.xnml file name suffix), e.g. by the LocalNormalization process. To apply this option, existing XNML files must be associated with input integration files. Local normalization is the most accurate and robust option for rejection normalization of data sets with large variations, such as those caused by varying acquisition conditions, strong gradients with different orientations and intensities, or data acquired with different instruments. In that cases, global normalization techniques based on statistical properties of the whole image may be unable to make the data statistically compatible with the required locality, leading to inaccurate pixel rejection.
文件: 局部归一化会施加先前计算并存入 XNML 文件（后缀 .xnml）的逐像素线性归一化函数，例如由 LocalNormalization 进程生成。要应用此选项，必须有 XNML 文件与输入叠加文件关联。对于变化很大的数据集（例如采集条件变化、方向与强度不同的强梯度、或用不同仪器采集的数据），局部归一化是剔除归一化中最准确、最稳健的选项。这些情况下，基于整幅图像统计特性的全局归一化技术可能无法让数据在所需局部性上统计兼容，导致像素剔除不准确。

FILE: If the output integrated image has saturated pixel samples out of the nominal [0,1] range, truncate them instead of rescaling the whole image.No out-of-range values should occur after integration of a well-calibrated data set under normal conditions. However, sometimes saturated pixels may lead to out-of-range values after output normalization, depending on the frame selected as integration reference.When this happens, the best option for integration of light or science frames is a linear rescaling, which preserves all of the integrated data. However, in some cases altering all pixel values is not admissible, so a rescaling operation is not applicable. In such cases truncation is the only option available to preserve the correct illumination profile in the integrated result.
文件: 若输出叠加图像存在超出标称 [0,1] 范围的饱和像素样本，截断它们而不是重标定整幅图像。正常情况下，叠加良好校准的数据集后不应出现超范围值。不过有时饱和像素会在输出归一化后导致超范围值，这取决于选作叠加参考的帧。出现这种情况时，亮帧或科学帧叠加的最佳选择是线性重标定，它能保留全部叠加数据。不过在某些情况下不允许改动所有像素值，因而重标定操作不适用。这些情况下截断是唯一可用的选项，用于在叠加结果中保留正确的照明轮廓。

FILE: Perform a drizzle integration process to generate an RGB color image from monochrome raw frames mosaiced with color filter arrays (CFA). This process is also known as Bayer drizzle, although this implementation also supports XTrans CFA frames, besides Bayer patterns.If the default Auto option is selected for the CFA pattern parameter (see below), DrizzleIntegration will retrieve CFA patterns from input .xdrz files. These patterns are gathered by the Debayer process and generated in .xdrz files by image registration processes such as StarAlignment or CometAlignment.If one of the supported CFA patterns is selected, such as RGGB, BGGR, etc, the process will assume the selected pattern even if it overrides data provided by .xdrz files (warning messages will be shown in such cases).
文件: 执行 drizzle 叠加过程，从用彩色滤光阵列（CFA）马赛克的单色原始帧生成 RGB 彩色图像。此过程也称 Bayer drizzle，不过本实现除 Bayer 图案外还支持 XTrans CFA 帧。若 CFA 图案参数选择了默认的「自动」选项（见下），DrizzleIntegration 会从输入 .xdrz 文件中获取 CFA 图案。这些图案由 Debayer 进程收集，并由 StarAlignment 或 CometAlignment 等图像配准进程生成到 .xdrz 文件中。若选择了某个受支持的 CFA 图案（例如 RGGB、BGGR 等），进程会假定使用所选图案，即使它覆盖 .xdrz 文件提供的数据（这种情况会显示警告信息）。

FILE: In general, this option should only be enabled for integration of calibrated light frames with PEDESTAL keywords when a global normalization method (such as additive with scaling) is used for pixel rejection and/or integration output.This option should always be disabled if local normalization is used, since subtracting pedestals invalidates local normalization functions. Local normalization already compensates for differing additive components among integrated frames.This option should also be disabled for integration of raw bias and dark frames, since in these cases existing PEDESTAL keywords should be preserved in the generated master bias and dark frames. These pedestals will be subtracted automatically by the ImageCalibration process for calibration of flat and light frames.
文件: 一般来说，此选项只应在对带 PEDESTAL 关键字的已校准亮帧做叠加、且像素剔除和/或叠加输出使用全局归一化方法（例如带缩放的可加性）时启用。若使用局部归一化应始终禁用此选项，因为减去基座会使局部归一化函数失效。局部归一化已经补偿了被叠加帧之间不同的可加分量。叠加原始偏置帧与暗帧时也应禁用此选项，因为这些情况下既有的 PEDESTAL 关键字应保留在生成的主偏置与主暗帧中。这些基座会被 ImageCalibration 进程在校准平场与亮帧时自动减去。

FILE: Drizzle drop kernel function. This parameter defines the shape of an input drop as a two-dimensional surface function. Square and circular kernels are applied by computing the area of the intersection between each drop and the projected output pixel. Gaussian and variable shape kernels are applied by computing the double integral of the surface function over the intersection between the drop and the projected output pixel on the XY plane. Square kernels are used by default.Gaussian and variable shape drizzle kernels (the latter providing finer control on function profiles) can be used to improve resolution of the integrated image. However, these functions tend to require much more and much better dithered data than the standard square and circular kernels to achieve optimal results.
文件: drizzle drop 核函数。此参数把输入 drop 的形状定义为二维表面函数。方形与圆形核通过计算每个 drop 与投影输出像素之间交集面积施加。高斯与可变形状核通过计算表面函数在 drop 与投影输出像素于 XY 平面上交集区域上的二重积分施加。默认使用方形核。高斯与可变形状 drizzle 核（后者对函数轮廓提供更细致的控制）可用于提升叠加图像的分辨率。不过要取得最佳结果，这些函数往往需要比标准方形与圆形核多得多、好得多的抖动数据。

FILE: If this option is selected, HDRComposition will generate a 64-bit floating point result image. Otherwise the HDR composition result will be generated as a 32-bit floating point image.A 32-bit floating point image is sufficient to represent HDR compositions of small or moderate size. Keep in mind that a 32-bit image provides room for a maximum of about 107 discrete sample values, or approximately 153 times the range of a 16-bit image. Very large HDR images may easily exceed that limit and hence require a 64-bit floating point result, which provides a huge space of 1015 discrete values.Note that the words 'small' and 'large' here don't refer to the number of images in an HDR composition, but to the length of the required numeric range to represent the whole set of tonal values in the final HDR result.
文件: 若选中此选项，HDRComposition 会生成 64 位浮点结果图像，否则 HDR 合成结果生成为 32 位浮点图像。32 位浮点图像足以表示小型或中等规模的 HDR 合成。请记住，32 位图像最多提供约 10^7 个离散样本值的空间，约为 16 位图像范围的 153 倍。非常大的 HDR 图像很容易超出这一限制，因而需要 64 位浮点结果，它提供 10^15 个离散值的巨大空间。注意这里的「小」与「大」不是指 HDR 合成中的图像数量，而是指表示最终 HDR 结果中全部色调值所需的数值范围长度。

FILE: The iterative k-sigma clipping algorithm can be used as a last-resort option in cases where the MRS algorithm does not converge systematically. This can happen on images with no detectable small-scale noise, but should never happen with integrated images under normal working conditions.The N* robust noise estimator extracts a subset of residual pixels by comparison with a large-scale model of the local background of the image, generated with the multiscale median transform (MMT). Since the MMT is remarkably efficient at isolating image structures, it can be used to detect pixels that cannot contribute to significant structures. N* is an accurate and robust, alternative estimator of the standard deviation of the noise that does not assume or require any particular statistical distribution in the analyzed data.
文件: 在 MRS 算法系统性不收敛的情况下，可把迭代 k-sigma 裁剪算法作为最后手段。这可能发生在没有可检测小尺度噪声的图像上，但在正常工作条件下，叠加图像绝不应出现这种情况。N* 稳健噪声估计器通过与图像局部背景的大尺度模型（用多尺度中值变换 MMT 生成）比较，提取一部分残差像素。由于 MMT 在分离图像结构方面效率极高，可用它检测出无法构成显著结构的像素。N* 是一种精确而稳健的标准差替代估计器，不假设也不要求被测数据服从任何特定统计分布。

FILE: If this option is enabled, HDRComposition will sort its input images automatically by their computed relative exposures. If this option is disabled, the list of input images must be sorted by decreasing exposure order (the most exposed image at the top of the list). If the images are not correctly sorted by decreasing exposure, the HDR composition process will either fail or yield an erroneous result.This option is enabled by default, as automatic exposure evaluation is a very fast and robust process that should never fail under normal conditions. Note that the automatic exposure evaluation routine does not depend on existing image metadata, as FITS headers or EXIF data (which are simply ignored by this tool). The computed relative exposures depend exclusively on actual pixel values and their statistical properties.
文件: 若启用此选项，HDRComposition 会按计算出的相对曝光自动排序输入图像。若禁用此选项，输入图像列表必须按曝光递减顺序排列（曝光最多的图像在列表顶部）。若图像未正确按曝光递减排序，HDR 合成过程会失败或给出错误结果。此选项默认启用，因为自动曝光评估是非常快速而稳健的过程，正常工作条件下绝不应失败。注意自动曝光评估例程不依赖已有图像元数据，例如 FITS 头或 EXIF 数据（本工具会直接忽略它们）。所计算的相对曝光完全取决于实际像素值及其统计特性。

FILE: If the output integrated image has saturated pixel samples out of the nominal [0,1] range, truncate them instead of rescaling the whole image.No out-of-range values should occur after integration of a well-calibrated data set under normal conditions. However, sometimes saturated pixels may lead to out-of-range values after output normalization, depending on the frame selected as integration reference.When this happens, the best option for integration of light or science frames is a linear rescaling, which preserves all of the integrated data. However, in some cases altering all pixel values is not admissible, so a rescaling operation is not applicable. This is the case for integration of flat frames, where truncation is the only option available to preserve the correct illumination profile in the integrated master flat frame.
文件: 若输出叠加图像存在超出标称 [0,1] 范围的饱和像素样本，截断它们而不是重标定整幅图像。正常情况下，叠加良好校准的数据集后不应出现超范围值。不过有时饱和像素会在输出归一化后导致超范围值，这取决于选作叠加参考的帧。出现这种情况时，亮帧或科学帧叠加的最佳选择是线性重标定，它能保留全部叠加数据。不过在某些情况下不允许改动所有像素值，因而重标定操作不适用。平场帧叠加就是这种情况：要保留叠加后主平场中正确的照明轮廓，截断是唯一可用的选项。

FILE: Median combination provides implicit robust rejection of outliers at the cost of a smaller SNR improvement (approximately a 20% less compared to average combination).Biweight location combination is a weighted Tukey's biweight location estimate of each pixel stack. It provides implicit robust rejection of outliers with practically the SNR improvement of average combination. Like the average, it applies the image weights, and can be used with or without pixel rejection. The deviation of each pixel is measured in units of the noise of its image. When the samples beyond the cutoffs carry a large fraction of the total weight of a pixel stack, the estimate blends progressively into the weighted average: such large groups of samples are signal, as in stars whose shapes vary between sessions, not outliers. The parameters of the biweight location are in the Pixel Rejection (3) section.
文件: 中值组合提供对离群值的隐式稳健剔除，代价是 SNR 提升较小（相比平均组合约少 20%）。双权位置组合是对每个像素堆栈的加权 Tukey 双权位置估计。它提供对离群值的隐式稳健剔除，同时几乎具有平均组合的 SNR 提升效果。与平均一样，它会施加图像权重，并且可配合像素剔除使用，也可不配合。每个像素的偏差以其图像噪声为单位度量。当截断值之外的样本携带像素堆栈总权重的较大比例时，估计会逐渐向加权平均混合：这样的大样本组是信号（例如形状在不同观测夜之间变化的恒星），而非离群值。双权位置的参数在「像素剔除 (3)」一节。

FILE: Percentile clipping rejection is excellent to integrate reduced sets of images, such as 3 to 6 images. This is a single-pass algorithm that rejects pixels outside a fixed range of values relative to the median of each pixel stack.Averaged iterative sigma clipping is intended for sets of 10 or more images. This algorithm tries to derive the gain of an ideal CCD detector from existing pixel data, assuming zero readout noise, then uses a Poisson noise model to perform rejection. For large sets of images however, sigma clipping tends to be superior.The min/max method can be used to ensure rejection of extreme values. Min/max performs an unconditional rejection of a fixed number of pixels from each stack, without any statistical basis. Rejection methods based on robust statistics, such as percentile, Winsorized sigma clipping, linear fitting and averaged sigma clipping are in general preferable.
文件: 百分位裁剪剔除非常适合叠加缩减后的图像集，例如 3 到 6 张图像。这是单遍算法，把相对于每个像素堆栈中值固定取值范围之外的像素剔除。平均迭代 sigma 裁剪适用于 10 张以上图像的数据集。此算法尝试从现有像素数据推导理想 CCD 探测器的增益（假定读出噪声为零），然后用泊松噪声模型执行剔除。不过对大批图像，sigma 裁剪往往更优。最小/最大法可用于确保剔除极端值。最小/最大法对每个堆栈无条件剔除固定数量的像素，没有任何统计依据。基于稳健统计的剔除方法，例如百分位、Winsor 化 sigma 裁剪、线性拟合与平均 sigma 裁剪，一般更可取。

FILE: The Standard properties option uses the image weights stored in the PCL:ImageWeight XISF property of each image, as written by the ImageAnalysis process. The property is a vector of per-channel weights; a vector with a single component applies its weight to all channels, for example to the three nominal channels of an RGB color image. Images without this property are integrated with unit weight, and a warning message is written to the console.If you select the FITS keyword option, please specify the name of a FITS keyword to retrieve image weights. The specified keyword must be present in all input images and its value must be of numeric type and positive.If you select the CSV weights file option, you must select a plain text file in CSV format with full file paths of integrated images and their corresponding per-channel image weights. See the CSV weights file parameter for more information.
文件: 「标准属性」选项使用存储在各图像 PCL:ImageWeight XISF 属性中的图像权重，由 ImageAnalysis 进程写入。该属性是逐通道权重的向量；只有一个分量的向量会把其权重施加到所有通道，例如 RGB 彩色图像的三个标称通道。没有此属性的图像按单位权重叠加，并会向控制台写入警告信息。若选择 FITS 关键字选项，请指定一个用于获取图像权重的 FITS 关键字名称。指定的关键字必须存在于所有输入图像中，其值必须是数值类型且为正。若选择 CSV 权重文件选项，你必须选择一个 CSV 格式的纯文本文件，其中包含被叠加图像的完整文件路径及其对应的逐通道图像权重。详见「CSV 权重文件」参数。

FILE: Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In HDRComposition, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded during the integration process. There are no output hints in HDRComposition since this process does not write images to disk files.For example, you can use the "raw" hint to force the DSLR_RAW format to load pure raw images without applying any deBayering, interpolation, white balance or black point correction. You can also specify the "lower-range" and "upper-range" hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 格式提示可以覆盖特定进程所用图像文件的全局文件格式设置。在 HDRComposition 中，输入提示改变叠加过程中某些特定格式输入图像的载入方式。HDRComposition 没有输出提示，因为此进程不把图像写入磁盘文件。例如，可以用 "raw" 提示强制 DSLR_RAW 格式载入纯原始图像，不施加任何去马赛克、插值、白平衡或黑点校正。也可以指定 "lower-range" 与 "upper-range" 提示来载入其他程序生成的、不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式都支持若干输入和/或输出提示，可在提供格式提示访问的工具中用于不同目的。

FILE: Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In ImageIntegration, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded during the integration process. There are no output hints in ImageIntegration since this process does not write images to disk files.For example, you can use the "raw cfa" hints to force the RAW format to load pure raw images without applying any demosaicing, interpolation, white balance, or black point correction. You can also specify the "lower-range" and "upper-range" hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 格式提示可以覆盖特定进程所用图像文件的全局文件格式设置。在 ImageIntegration 中，输入提示改变叠加过程中某些特定格式输入图像的载入方式。ImageIntegration 没有输出提示，因为此进程不把图像写入磁盘文件。例如，可以用 "raw cfa" 提示强制 RAW 格式载入纯原始图像，不施加任何去马赛克、插值、白平衡或黑点校正。也可以指定 "lower-range" 与 "upper-range" 提示来载入其他程序生成的、不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式都支持若干输入和/或输出提示，可在提供格式提示访问的工具中用于不同目的。

FILE: Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In DrizzleIntegration, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded during the integration process. There are no output hints in DrizzleIntegration since this process does not write images to disk files.For example, you can use the "raw cfa" hints to force the RAW format to load pure raw images without applying any demosaicing, interpolation, white balance, or black point correction. You can also specify the "lower-range" and "upper-range" hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 格式提示可以覆盖特定进程所用图像文件的全局文件格式设置。在 DrizzleIntegration 中，输入提示改变叠加过程中某些特定格式输入图像的载入方式。DrizzleIntegration 没有输出提示，因为此进程不把图像写入磁盘文件。例如，可以用 "raw cfa" 提示强制 RAW 格式载入纯原始图像，不施加任何去马赛克、插值、白平衡或黑点校正。也可以指定 "lower-range" 与 "upper-range" 提示来载入其他程序生成的、不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式都支持若干输入和/或输出提示，可在提供格式提示访问的工具中用于不同目的。

FILE: The best performance is achieved when the whole set of integrated pixels can be loaded at once in the integration stack. For this to happen, the following conditions must be true:Buffer size must be large enough as to allow loading an input file in 32-bit floating point format completely with a single file read operation.Stack size must be larger than or equal to W*H*(12*N + 4), where W and H are the image width and height in pixels, respectively, and N is the number of integrated images. For linear fit clipping rejection, replace 4 with 8 in the above equation.Note that this may require a large amount of RAM available for relatively large image sets. As an example, the default stack size of 1024 (1 GiB) is sufficient to integrate 20 2048x2048 monochrome images optimally with the default buffer size of 16 MiB. With a stack size of 4 GiB and a buffer size of 64 MiB you could integrate 20 4Kx4K monochrome images with optimum performance.
文件: 当叠加堆栈能一次装下全部被叠加像素时性能最佳。要做到这一点，必须满足以下条件：缓冲区大小必须足够大，以便用单次文件读取操作完整载入一个 32 位浮点格式的输入文件。堆栈大小必须大于或等于 W*H*(12*N + 4)，其中 W 与 H 分别是图像宽度与高度（像素），N 是被叠加图像的数量。对于线性拟合裁剪剔除，把上式的 4 换成 8。注意对相对较大的图像集，这可能需要大量可用内存。举例来说，默认堆栈大小 1024（1 GiB）配合默认缓冲区 16 MiB，足以最优地叠加 20 张 2048x2048 单色图像。用 4 GiB 堆栈与 64 MiB 缓冲区，就能以最佳性能叠加 20 张 4Kx4K 单色图像。

FILE: Normalization matches mean background values. This can be done either as an additive or as a multiplicative process. In general, both ways lead to very similar results, but multiplicative normalization should be used to integrate images that are to be further combined or applied by multiplication or division, such as flat fields.Scaling matches dispersion. This works as a sort of automatic weighting to combine the input images, and tends to improve the SNR of the result, especially for images with different overall illumination.Local normalization applies per-pixel linear normalization functions previously calculated and stored in XNML files (.xnml file name suffix) by the LocalNormalization process. To apply this option, existing XNML files must be associated with input integration files. This option should normally be used when local normalization is also used for pixel rejection.The default option is additive normalization with scaling.
文件: 「归一化」匹配平均背景值。它既可以做可加性过程，也可以做乘性过程。一般来说两种方式结果非常接近，但若要叠加的图像后续还要被乘法或除法组合/施加（例如平场），则应使用乘性归一化。「缩放匹配离散度」。它起到一种自动加权的作用来组合输入图像，往往能提升结果的 SNR，尤其对于整体照明不同的图像。局部归一化会施加先前由 LocalNormalization 进程计算并存入 XNML 文件（后缀 .xnml）的逐像素线性归一化函数。要应用此选项，必须有 XNML 文件与输入叠加文件关联。通常在像素剔除也使用局部归一化时应使用此选项。默认选项是带缩放的可加性归一化。

FILE: Average combination provides the best signal-to-noise ratio in the integrated result.Median combination provides implicit robust rejection of outliers at the cost of a smaller SNR improvement (approximately a 20% less compared to average combination).Biweight location combination is a weighted Tukey's biweight location estimate of each pixel stack. It provides implicit robust rejection of outliers with practically the SNR improvement of average combination. Like the average, it applies the image weights, and can be used with or without pixel rejection. The deviation of each pixel is measured in units of the noise of its image. When the samples beyond the cutoffs carry a large fraction of the total weight of a pixel stack, the estimate blends progressively into the weighted average: such large groups of samples are signal, as in stars whose shapes vary between sessions, not outliers. The parameters of the biweight location are in the Pixel Rejection (3) section.
文件: 平均组合在叠加结果中提供最佳信噪比。中值组合提供对离群值的隐式稳健剔除，代价是 SNR 提升较小（相比平均组合约少 20%）。双权位置组合是对每个像素堆栈的加权 Tukey 双权位置估计。它提供对离群值的隐式稳健剔除，同时几乎具有平均组合的 SNR 提升效果。与平均一样，它会施加图像权重，并且可配合像素剔除使用，也可不配合。每个像素的偏差以其图像噪声为单位度量。当截断值之外的样本携带像素堆栈总权重的较大比例时，估计会逐渐向加权平均混合：这样的大样本组是信号（例如形状在不同观测夜之间变化的恒星），而非离群值。双权位置的参数在「像素剔除 (3)」一节。

FILE: Per image tests each image weight individually. A weight is abnormal when it is greater than the upper quartile of the weights of the data set divided by the protection threshold parameter. With the default threshold of 0.1, weights greater than ten times the upper quartile are abnormal. This method can identify abnormal weights in up to one fourth of the data set, and never modifies normal weights. It also tolerates data sets where most images have much lower weights than the best ones, for example images acquired through clouds. This is the default method.Quantile limit is triggered when the median normalized weight is smaller than the protection threshold parameter. Then all weights greater than the quantile defined by the protection limit parameter are abnormal. This method always modifies a fixed fraction of the highest weights (5% by default), and cannot protect the integration when abnormal weights are more frequent. It is available for compatibility with previous versions.
文件: 「逐图像」逐个检验每个图像权重。当权重大于数据集权重的上四分位数除以保护阈值参数时，该权重属异常。用默认阈值 0.1 时，权重大于上四分位数十倍的属异常。此方法最多能识别数据集四分之一的异常权重，且从不修改正常权重。它也能容许多数图像权重远低于最佳图像的数据集，例如穿过云层采集的图像。这是默认方法。分位数限制会在中值归一化权重小于保护阈值参数时触发。此时所有大于保护上限参数所定义分位数的权重都属异常。此方法总是修改固定比例的最高权重（默认 5%），在异常权重更频繁时无法保护叠加。提供它是为了与早期版本兼容。

FILE: Identifier of the registered image.The result of DynamicAlignment execution is a newly created, registered image; here you can specify a valid view identifier that will be assigned to its main view. If this parameter is left blank, DynamicAlignment will automatically assign an identifier consisting of the target image's identifier plus a predefined suffix (by default, the appended suffix is _registered).
文件: 已配准图像的标识符。DynamicAlignment 执行的结果是新创建的一张已配准图像；这里可以指定一个有效视图标识符分配给它主视图。若此参数留空，DynamicAlignment 会自动分配一个由目标图像标识符加预定义后缀组成的标识符（默认追加的后缀是 _registered）。

FILE: If defined, the distortion model will be applied to the coordinates of all detected stars prior to star matching. This allows for accurate registration of images subject to differential geometrical distortions, as happens with dithered wide field images and mosaics.When a distortion model is used, the registration model will always use thin plate splines, irrespective of the registration model parameter.
文件: 若定义，畸变模型会在星点匹配之前施加到所有已检测恒星的坐标上。这样可对受差分几何畸变影响的图像做精确配准，抖动广视场图像与马赛克就是这种情况。使用畸变模型时，无论「配准模型」参数如何，配准模型都会使用薄板样条。

FILE: Invert the current alignment reference.Normal (noninverted) DA references look for bright stars over a dark background. An inverted reference behaves just the opposite way: dark star over a bright background. By inverting references you can select arbitrary image structures, not only stars, as alignment features. For example, you can select dark alignment features on lunar and planetary images using this option.
文件: 反转当前对齐参考。正常（未反转）的 DA 参考在暗背景上寻找亮星。反转参考的行为正好相反：在亮背景上寻找暗星。通过反转参考，你可以选择任意图像结构而不只是恒星作为对齐特征。例如，此选项可用于在月球与行星图像上选择暗色对齐特征。

FILE: Minimum number of descriptors per star used by the star matching algorithm.More descriptors will always increase the probability of finding more putative star pair matches, but at the cost of more computing time. A value between 10 and 100 is appropriate in most cases. In difficult cases a value up to 200 may be necessary for this parameter. Be aware that higher values will increase the required computing time exponentially.
文件: 星点匹配算法每颗恒星所用的最少描述符数量。更多描述符总会提高找到更多可能星对匹配的概率，代价是更多计算时间。多数情况下 10 到 100 之间的值较为合适。困难情况下此参数可能需要高到 200。请注意，更高的值会以指数方式增加所需计算时间。

FILE: The disabled option will disable intersection computation. Mosaic modes only will perform computation of intersection regions only when a mosaic construction mode has been selected (union/mosaic or separate mosaic), and always will force intersection computations in all working modes. Normally, this option is only necessary to build mosaics, because in these tasks the overlapped regions between mosaic frames are usually small.
文件: 「禁用」选项会关闭交集计算。「仅马赛克模式」只在选择了马赛克构建模式（合并/马赛克或分离马赛克）时计算交集区域，而「总是」会在所有工作模式中强制计算交集。通常只有构建马赛克时才需要此选项，因为这类任务中马赛克帧之间的重叠区域通常很小。

FILE: Select this option to take into account brightness relations between stars for comparisons performed by the star matching algorithm. This feature further improves the robustness of the star matching algorithm and hence can be helpful in difficult cases. In seldom cases however, trying to match brightness relations may cause problems to register images acquired through different filters; e.g. individual channels of an RGB image.
文件: 选中此选项以让星点匹配算法在做比较时考虑恒星之间的亮度关系。此功能进一步提升星点匹配算法的稳健性，因而在困难情况下会有帮助。不过在少数情况下，试图匹配亮度关系可能导致无法配准用不同滤镜采集的图像，例如 RGB 图像的各个通道。

FILE: * Important: Inherited solutions can be less accurate than solutions computed directly on the registered images. The differences can be significant for solutions with distortion corrections if the applied image registration task does not model existing distortions accurately. For maximum accuracy (including mosaic generation), we recommend recomputing astrometric solutions on the registered images, using the inherited solution as a starting point.
文件: * 重要：继承的解可能不如直接在已配准图像上计算的解精确。若所施加的图像配准任务未能准确建模已有畸变，带畸变校正的解的差异可能很显著。为获得最高精度（包括生成马赛克），我们建议在已配准图像上重新计算天体测量解，并以继承的解作为起点。

FILE: The recommended options are:DDM thin plate splines (implicitly of second order) for distortion correction under normal conditions. This is the default option.3rd or 4th order DDM variable-order polyharmonic RBFs for correction of complex distortions with maximum accuracy.With the recursive surface splines registration model, this parameter is the order of the polyharmonic splines generated for all regions of the image. The default order 2 generates thin plate splines.
文件: 推荐的选项是：常规条件下的畸变校正用 DDM 薄板样条（隐含二阶）。这是默认选项。校正复杂畸变并追求最高精度时，用三阶或四阶 DDM 变阶多调和径向基函数。使用递归表面样条配准模型时，此参数是为图像所有区域生成的多调和样条的阶数。默认阶数 2 生成薄板样条。

FILE: Use brightness relations between alignment stars.Select this option to take into account brightness relations between stars for comparisons performed by the star matching algorithm. This feature further improves the robustness of the star matching algorithm and hence can be helpful in difficult cases. In seldom cases however, trying to match brightness relations may cause problems to register images acquired through different filters; e.g. individual channels of an RGB image.
文件: 使用对齐恒星之间的亮度关系。选中此选项以让星点匹配算法在做比较时考虑恒星之间的亮度关系。此功能进一步提升星点匹配算法的稳健性，因而在困难情况下会有帮助。不过在少数情况下，试图匹配亮度关系可能导致无法配准用不同滤镜采集的图像，例如 RGB 图像的各个通道。

FILE: This parameter is only used when the use scale differences option is enabled. The value of this parameter is the maximum allowed difference in scale between two descriptors formed with putative star pair matches. This improves robustness of the star matching algorithm, especially in presence of a large number of outliers (false putative star pair matches), but also imposes an upper limit on the difference in scale between two registered images. Using scale differences can be very helpful to build mosaics with little overlapping.
文件: 此参数仅在启用「使用尺度差异」选项时使用。其值是两两可能星对匹配所形成两个描述符之间允许的最大尺度差异。这能提升星点匹配算法的稳健性，尤其是在存在大量离群值（错误的可能星对匹配）时，但同时也对两张已配准图像之间的尺度差异施加了上限。使用尺度差异对构建重叠很少的马赛克非常有帮助。

FILE: To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum distortion, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.Use this parameter, if necessary, to control inclusion of elongated stars, complex clusters of stars, and nonstellar image features. The default value is 0.6. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.
文件: 为了把此界面与内部实现隔离，此参数被归一化到 [0,1] 范围，其中 0 与 1 分别代表最小与最大畸变。这种抽象让我们能在不破坏依赖它的工具与进程的前提下更换恒星检测引擎。如有必要，用此参数控制是否纳入拉长的恒星、复杂的星团以及非恒星图像特征。默认值为 0.6。一般来说，正常工作条件下不应需要更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: When this option is enabled, DynamicAlignment finds valid alignment image features automatically when new alignment references are created (e.g., by clicking with the mouse), or when existing references are moved. (e.g., by clicking a reference and dragging it). This is the default mode, which is intended to find stars and similar small features automatically.With this option disabled, you have the freedom to place alignment references at arbitrary locations on the source and target images. Simply place an alignment reference and move it manually where you want to set an alignment point.
文件: 启用此选项时，DynamicAlignment 在创建新的对齐参考时（例如用鼠标点击），或在移动已有参考时（例如点击某个参考并拖动），会自动寻找有效的对齐图像特征。这是默认模式，意在自动找到恒星及类似的小特征。禁用此选项后，你可以自由地把对齐参考放在源图像与目标图像的任意位置。只需放置一个对齐参考，然后手动把它移到你想设定对齐点的位置。

FILE: DDM (Domain Decomposition Method) RBF interpolation/approximation algorithms require O(n^2) time for spline construction, in contrast to standard implementations, which have O(n^3) time complexity. The default option is DDM Thin Plate Spline.This parameter is not used with the recursive surface splines registration model, which always uses polyharmonic splines of the specified spline order.
