FILE: This is a limiting value, expressed in sigma units, below which image pixels will be considered as part of the sky background. For each selected alignment reference, DynamicAlignment calculates the dispersion—also known as sigma—of the set of pixels inside the reference search box (see the search radii parameters above). All pixels whose values are smaller than the computed sigma are considered as belonging to the sky background, and hence are rejected to gather pixels belonging to the reference star.When the alignment reference is inverted (see the reference inversion parameter), background pixels are those above the computed sigma.
文件: 这是一个以 sigma 为单位的限值，低于它的图像像素会被视为天空背景的一部分。对每个所选对齐参考，DynamicAlignment 会计算参考搜索框内（见上面的搜索半径参数）像素集合的离散度 —— 也称 sigma。所有值小于所计算 sigma 的像素都被视为属于天空背景，因而被剔除，以汇集属于参考星的像素。当对齐参考被反转时（见参考反转参数），背景像素则是那些高于所计算 sigma 的像素。

FILE: By default, StarAlignment computes homographies to model complex linear image registration transformations with the maximum accuracy. However, with only 3 degrees of freedom, rigid transformations can be more robust and faster, requiring fewer RANSAC iterations even when dealing with a high proportion of outliers in the initial set of putative star pair matches.Note that this option is relevant for all registration models, including linear and nonlinear models with arbitrary distortion correction using surface splines. In the latter case, a linear model is always necessary to build an initial registration transformation before modeling distortions.
文件: 默认情况下，StarAlignment 会计算单应变换，以最高精度对复杂线性图像配准变换建模。不过刚性变换只有 3 个自由度，可以更稳健、更快，即便初始可能星对匹配中离群比例很高，也只需更少的 RANSAC 迭代。注意此选项对所有配准模型都相关，包括用表面样条做任意畸变校正的线性与非线性模型。后者情况下，总是需要一个线性模型来构建初始配准变换，然后再建模畸变。

FILE: Drizzle data files contain geometrical projection parameters, pixel rejection and statistical data for the DrizzleIntegration tool. Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz file suffix.Drizzle data files are written in XDRZ format version 1.1, which stores surface spline distortion models, for both the two-dimensional surface splines and recursive surface splines registration models, as compressed binary data. Version 1.1 files cannot be read by previous versions of PixInsight.

FILE: If this parameter is disabled, a local maxima map will be generated to identify and prevent detection of multiple sources that are too close to be separated as individual structures, such as double and multiple stars. This can be necessary in special cases where extreme high noise levels and/or distortion of stellar images caused by optical aberrations limit the number of detectable sources excessively, preventing image registration.The default state is disabled.
文件: 若禁用此参数，会生成局部极大值图，用来识别并防止把靠得太近、无法分离为独立结构的多重源（例如双星与聚星）检测出来。一般来说，有多个局部极大值的源会给精确定位恒星位置带来困难。若启用此参数，不可分离的多重源会被自由地当作单个物体检测。在极端高噪声水平和/或光学像差造成的恒星图像畸变把可检测源数量限制得过分、导致无法配准图像的特殊情况下，这可能是必要的。默认状态为禁用。

FILE: This option only works in the Register/Match Images working mode if the reference image is either a disk file or a main view (not a preview). For target image windows, astrometric solutions are regenerated after propagating astrometric metadata.* Important: Inherited solutions can be less accurate than solutions computed directly on the registered images. The differences can be significant for solutions with distortion corrections if the applied image registration task does not model existing distortions accurately. For maximum accuracy (including mosaic generation), we recommend recomputing astrometric solutions on the registered images, using the inherited solution as a starting point.
文件: 此选项仅在「配准/匹配图像」工作模式下有效，且参考图像必须是磁盘文件或主视图（不是预览）。对于目标图像窗口，会在传播天体测量元数据后重新生成天体测量解。* 重要：继承的解可能不如直接在已配准图像上计算的解精确。若所施加的图像配准任务未能准确建模已有畸变，带畸变校正的解的差异可能很显著。为获得最高精度（包括生成马赛克），我们建议在已配准图像上重新计算天体测量解，并以继承的解作为起点。

FILE: Select this option to take into account differences in scale (size) between the descriptors used to match pairs of stars. You must also define a scale tolerance when this option is enabled (see the scale tolerance parameter below). When scale differences are taken into account, the star matching algorithm is able to find more true star pair matches in presence of a large number of false putative matches. This feature is useful to improve registration of images with little overlapping, as often happens when building mosaics. However, take into account that enabling this option will prevent registration of images with scale differences larger than the value of the scale tolerance parameter.
文件: 选中此选项以考虑用于星对匹配的描述符之间的尺度（尺寸）差异。启用时还必须定义尺度容差（见下方尺度容差参数）。考虑尺度差异后，在存在大量错误可能匹配时，星点匹配算法能找到更多真实星对匹配。此功能有助于改善重叠很少的图像的配准，构建马赛克时经常如此。不过要注意，启用此选项会阻止配准尺度差异大于尺度容差参数值的图像。

FILE: Difference in pixels between the vertical coordinates of the computed and predicted star barycenter in the target image. When two or more alignment references are defined, DynamicAlignment predicts target star positions for each newly selected star. Coordinate prediction is performed building an image registration model on the fly, based on all existing alignment references except the new one. You can use prediction errors to evaluate the quality of the image registration model being defined.To force a new prediction of coordinates for any existing reference, just select and move it slightly with the mouse. In this way the alignment reference will be recalculated, including its predicted coordinates.
文件: 目标图像中计算所得与预测的恒星质心在垂直坐标上的差异（像素）。当定义了两个或更多对齐参考时，DynamicAlignment 会为每颗新选择的恒星预测目标位置。坐标预测通过即时构建图像配准模型完成，该模型基于除新参考之外的所有已有对齐参考。你可以用预测误差来评估正在定义的图像配准模型的质量。要强制为任何已有参考重新预测坐标，只需用鼠标选中并轻微移动它。这样对齐参考会被重新计算，包括其预测坐标。

FILE: A distortion model file is a sequence of {x,y,dx,dy} nodes in standard CSV format. Each node defines a local distortion vector, where {x,y} are the image coordinates of the vector's origin, and {dx,dy} are the corresponding distortion components in pixels (e.g., if dx=dy=0, no distortion exists at x,y coordinates).If defined, the distortion model will be applied to the coordinates of all detected stars prior to star matching. This allows for accurate registration of images subject to differential geometrical distortions, as happens with dithered wide field images and mosaics.When a distortion model is used, the registration model will always use thin plate splines, irrespective of the registration model parameter.

FILE: In Register/Union - Mosaic mode, StarAlignment will create a new image including both the reference and target images. The target image will be registered to match the reference image by superposition, and the reference image will not be interpolated (just copied in place). This forms a two-frame mosaic over a black canvas with the smallest possible dimensions to include the reference and registered target images completely.The Register/Union - Separate mode is similar to the register/union mosaic mode, but each mosaic frame generates a separate image with the canvas size of the whole mosaic. Separate mosaic frames can then be composed into a single mosaic by means of a maximum combination (e.g., with PixelMath's max function).

Each node defines a local distortion vector, where {x,y} are the image coordinates of the vector's origin, and {dx,dy} are the corresponding distortion components in pixels (e.g., if dx=dy=0, no distortion exists at x,y coordinates).If defined, the distortion model will be applied to the coordinates of all detected stars prior to star matching. This allows for accurate registration of images subject to differential geometrical distortions, as happens with dithered wide field images and mosaics.When a distortion model is used, the registration model will always use thin plate splines, irrespective of the registration model parameter.
文件: 畸变模型文件的本地路径。畸变模型文件是按标准 CSV 格式排列的一串 {x,y,dx,dy} 节点。每个节点定义一个局部畸变向量，其中 {x,y} 是该向量起点的图像坐标，{dx,dy} 是对应的畸变分量（像素），例如 dx=dy=0 表示 x,y 坐标处不存在畸变。若定义，畸变模型会在星点匹配之前施加到所有已检测恒星的坐标上。这样可对受差分几何畸变影响的图像做精确配准，抖动广视场图像与马赛克就是这种情况。使用畸变模型时，无论「配准模型」参数如何，配准模型都会使用薄板样条。

FILE: This option can be useful for mosaic construction in extremely difficult cases, when automatic intersection computation (see above) fails. In general, this only happens for images with minimal overlapping. To use this option, you must define previews covering (roughly) the overlapped areas between the reference and target images, then execute StarAlignment on the target image with this option enabled. In this way StarAlignment will limit the star matching process to the areas covered by the previews, which greatly improves the performance of the RANSAC algorithm by reducing the fraction of outliers (false putative matches) in the initial set of star pair matches. With the help of this feature, one can build mosaics of any practical size and complexity.
文件: 在自动交集计算（见上）失败的极端困难情况下，此选项对构建马赛克很有用。一般来说这只会发生在重叠极少的图像上。要使用此选项，你必须定义大致覆盖参考图像与目标图像重叠区域的预览，然后对此目标图像启用此选项执行 StarAlignment。这样 StarAlignment 会把星点匹配过程限制在预览覆盖的区域内，通过减少初始星对匹配集合中的离群比例（错误可能匹配）大幅提升 RANSAC 算法的性能。借助此功能，可以构建任意实际尺寸与复杂度的马赛克。

FILE: Error in the last predicted target position, X-axis.Difference in pixels between the horizontal coordinates of the computed and predicted star barycenter in the target image. When two or more alignment references are defined, DynamicAlignment predicts target star positions for each newly selected star. Coordinate prediction is performed building an image registration model on the fly, based on all existing alignment references except the new one. You can use prediction errors to evaluate the quality of the image registration model being defined.To force a new prediction of coordinates for any existing reference, just select and move it slightly with the mouse. In this way the alignment reference will be recalculated, along with its predicted coordinates.
文件: 上次预测目标位置的误差，X 轴。目标图像中计算所得与预测的恒星质心在水平坐标上的差异（像素）。当定义了两个或更多对齐参考时，DynamicAlignment 会为每颗新选择的恒星预测目标位置。坐标预测通过即时构建图像配准模型完成，该模型基于除新参考之外的所有已有对齐参考。你可以用预测误差来评估正在定义的图像配准模型的质量。要强制为任何已有参考重新预测坐标，只需用鼠标选中并轻微移动它。这样对齐参考会被重新计算，包括其预测坐标。

FILE: When this option is selected, StarAlignment computes and applies a linear fitting function between each target image and the reference image. The linear fit is of the general form y = a + bx, where a and b are the two fitting parameters. The linear function is computed from all overlapping pixels between the target and reference images. The a parameter acts like a pedestal to compensate for different background illumination, and the b parameter works like a scaling function to equalize signal levels between both images. Frame adaptation is very useful to create seamless mosaics. Bear in mind, however, that the linear fit assumes that (1) both images are strictly linear, and (2) both images have flat illumination profiles, i.e., that both images have been accurately calibrated.
文件: 选中此选项时，StarAlignment 会为每张目标图像与参考图像之间计算并施加线性拟合函数。线性拟合的一般形式为 y = a + bx，其中 a 与 b 是两个拟合参数。线性函数由目标图像与参考图像之间所有重叠像素计算得出。a 参数起基座作用，用于补偿不同的背景照明；b 参数起缩放作用，用于均衡两幅图像之间的信号水平。帧适配对生成无缝马赛克非常有用。但要记住，线性拟合假定 (1) 两幅图像严格线性，(2) 两幅图像照明轮廓平坦，即都已精确校准。

FILE: Internally, star distortion is evaluated in units of coverage of a square region circumscribed to each detected structure. The coverage of a perfectly circular star is π/4 (about 0.8). Lower values denote elongated or irregular sources.To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum distortion, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.Use this parameter, if necessary, to control inclusion of elongated stars, complex clusters of stars, and nonstellar image features. The default value is 0.6. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.
文件: 在内部，恒星畸变以每个被检测结构外接正方形区域的覆盖率单位评估。完美圆形恒星的覆盖率为 π/4（约 0.8）。更低的值表示拉长或不规则的源。为了把此界面与内部实现隔离，此参数被归一化到 [0,1] 范围，其中 0 与 1 分别代表最小与最大畸变。这种抽象让我们能在不破坏依赖它的工具与进程的前提下更换恒星检测引擎。如有必要，用此参数控制是否纳入拉长的恒星、复杂的星团以及非恒星图像特征。默认值为 0.6。一般来说，正常工作条件下不应需要更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: Maximum star distortion.Internally, star distortion is evaluated in units of coverage of a square region circumscribed to each detected structure. The coverage of a perfectly circular star is π/4 (about 0.8). Lower values denote elongated or irregular sources.To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum distortion, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.Use this parameter, if necessary, to control inclusion of elongated stars, complex clusters of stars, and nonstellar image features. The default value is 0.6. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.
文件: 最大恒星畸变。在内部，恒星畸变以每个被检测结构外接正方形区域的覆盖率单位评估。完美圆形恒星的覆盖率为 π/4（约 0.8）。更低的值表示拉长或不规则的源。为了把此界面与内部实现隔离，此参数被归一化到 [0,1] 范围，其中 0 与 1 分别代表最小与最大畸变。这种抽象让我们能在不破坏依赖它的工具与进程的前提下更换恒星检测引擎。如有必要，用此参数控制是否纳入拉长的恒星、复杂的星团以及非恒星图像特征。默认值为 0.6。一般来说，正常工作条件下不应需要更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: In the default automatic mode, StarAlignment will perform a series of tries using a predefined sequence of star counts if the initial attempt to register the images fails. This is the recommended setting. To select the automatic mode, specify zero as the value of this parameter.Increasing the amount of reference stars is in general not necessary, and it usually just slows down the image registration process with no improvement in registration accuracy. However, when registering images with little overlapping (mosaics, or images with large scale differences), it may be necessary using a reduced or expanded set of reference stars, depending on a variety of working scenarios. In these cases, the automatic probing sequence usually works very well, so you normally should not need to change the default value of this parameter.
文件: 在默认的自动模式下，若初次尝试配准图像失败，StarAlignment 会按预定义的恒星数量序列进行一系列尝试。这是推荐设置。要选择自动模式，请把此参数的值指定为零。增加参考星数量一般来说没有必要，通常只会拖慢图像配准过程而不会提升配准精度。但在配准重叠很少的图像（马赛克，或尺度差异很大的图像）时，依各种工作场景可能需要使用缩减或扩大的参考星集合。在这些情况下，自动探测序列通常效果很好，因此正常不需要更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In StarAlignment, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats (reference and target image files) are loaded, while output hints modify the way output registered image files are written.For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "up-bottom" input hint to load input images from FITS files with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件: 格式提示可以覆盖特定进程所用图像文件的全局文件格式设置。在 StarAlignment 中，输入提示改变某些特定格式输入图像（参考图像与目标图像文件）的载入方式，输出提示改变输出配准图像文件的写出方式。例如，可以用 "lower-range" 和 "upper-range" 输入提示来载入其他程序生成的、不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。类似地，可以指定 "up-bottom" 输入提示，从坐标原点位于左上角的 FITS 文件载入输入图像。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式都支持若干输入和/或输出提示，可在提供格式提示访问的工具中用于不同目的。

FILE: When this option is enabled, and one of the two-dimensional surface splines or recursive surface splines registration models is selected, a distortion map image will be generated for each registered target image. A distortion map is a graphical representation of the difference in pixels between the applied registration model and a linear model based on a projective or rigid transformation, or in other words, a representation of local distortion measured on the image at regular intervals in both coordinates.In distortion maps, each distortion measurement is represented as a mark consisting of a circle and a line. Circles correspond to alignment positions calculated with a linear transformation, and lines point to the corresponding positions given by the spline-based transformation. Without distortions, all marks should be circles without visible lines.
文件: 启用此选项且选择了二维表面样条或递归表面样条配准模型之一时，会为每张已配准目标图像生成一张畸变图。畸变图是所施加配准模型与基于投影或刚性变换的线性模型之间像素差异的图形表示，换言之，是以两个坐标上的规则间隔在图像上测得的局部畸变的表示。在畸变图中，每个畸变测量表示为一个由圆圈与线段组成的标记。圆圈对应用线性变换计算的对齐位置，线段指向基于样条变换给出的对应位置。若无畸变，所有标记都应是看不到线段的圆圈。

FILE: Maximum number of stars allowed.In the default automatic mode, StarAlignment will perform a series of tries using a predefined sequence of star counts if the initial attempt to register the images fails. This is the recommended setting. To select the automatic mode, specify zero as the value of this parameter.Increasing the amount of reference stars is in general not necessary, and it usually just slows down the image registration process with no improvement in registration accuracy. However, when registering images with little overlapping (mosaics, or images with large scale differences), it may be necessary using a reduced or expanded set of reference stars, depending on a variety of working scenarios. In these cases, the automatic probing sequence usually works very well, so you normally should not need to change the default value of this parameter.
文件: 允许的最大恒星数量。在默认的自动模式下，若初次尝试配准图像失败，StarAlignment 会按预定义的恒星数量序列进行一系列尝试。这是推荐设置。要选择自动模式，请把此参数的值指定为零。增加参考星数量一般来说没有必要，通常只会拖慢图像配准过程而不会提升配准精度。但在配准重叠很少的图像（马赛克，或尺度差异很大的图像）时，依各种工作场景可能需要使用缩减或扩大的参考星集合。在这些情况下，自动探测序列通常效果很好，因此正常不需要更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: A two-dimensional projective transformation, or homography, is a line-preserving geometric transformation between two sets of points in the plane. Homographies can model translations, rotations, reflections, scale changes and shearing in any order.By default, StarAlignment computes homographies to model complex linear image registration transformations with the maximum accuracy. However, with only 3 degrees of freedom, rigid transformations can be more robust and faster, requiring fewer RANSAC iterations even when dealing with a high proportion of outliers in the initial set of putative star pair matches.Note that this option is relevant for all registration models, including linear and nonlinear models with arbitrary distortion correction using surface splines. In the latter case, a linear model is always necessary to build an initial registration transformation before modeling distortions.
文件: 二维投影变换，即单应变换，是平面上两组点之间的保线几何变换。单应变换可以以任意顺序对平移、旋转、镜像、尺度变化与切变建模。默认情况下，StarAlignment 会计算单应变换，以最高精度对复杂线性图像配准变换建模。不过刚性变换只有 3 个自由度，可以更稳健、更快，即便初始可能星对匹配中离群比例很高，也只需更少的 RANSAC 迭代。注意此选项对所有配准模型都相关，包括用表面样条做任意畸变校正的线性与非线性模型。后者情况下，总是需要一个线性模型来构建初始配准变换，然后再建模畸变。

FILE: When a variable-order polyharmonic RBF is selected, the function order can be selected from 2 to 6. High-order surface splines compute interpolation/regularization functions that are continuously differentiable up to the specified order and, hence, can more accurately model complex distortions. However, high-order splines, especially of orders above 4, are numerically more unstable and can lead to errors caused by ill-conditioned linear systems.The recommended options are:DDM thin plate splines (implicitly of second order) for distortion correction under normal conditions. This is the default option.3rd or 4th order DDM variable-order polyharmonic RBFs for correction of complex distortions with maximum accuracy.With the recursive surface splines registration model, this parameter is the order of the polyharmonic splines generated for all regions of the image. The default order 2 generates thin plate splines.
文件: 选择变阶多调和 RBF 时，函数阶数可在 2 到 6 之间选择。高阶表面样条计算的插值/正则化函数可连续微分到指定阶数，因而能更精确地建模复杂畸变。但高阶样条，尤其是 4 阶以上，数值上更不稳定，可能因线性系统病态而导致误差。推荐的选项是：常规条件下的畸变校正用 DDM 薄板样条（隐含二阶）。这是默认选项。校正复杂畸变并追求最高精度时，用三阶或四阶 DDM 变阶多调和径向基函数。使用递归表面样条配准模型时，此参数是为图像所有区域生成的多调和样条的阶数。默认阶数 2 生成薄板样条。

FILE: Once the intersection has been found, the star matching process is restricted to the intersection area. This greatly improves the performance of the RANSAC algorithm by reducing the fraction of outliers (false putative matches) in the initial set of star pair matches. Note that this works in the same way, and has the same features and advantages, as the restrict to previews option (see below). However, intersections are computed in a completely automatic and accurate way, without user intervention.The disabled option will disable intersection computation. Mosaic modes only will perform computation of intersection regions only when a mosaic construction mode has been selected (union/mosaic or separate mosaic), and always will force intersection computations in all working modes. Normally, this option is only necessary to build mosaics, because in these tasks the overlapped regions between mosaic frames are usually small.
文件: 一旦找到交集，星点匹配过程就限制在交集区域内。这通过减少初始星对匹配集合中的离群比例（错误可能匹配）大幅提升 RANSAC 算法的性能。注意它的工作方式、特性与优点都与「限制在预览」选项（见下）相同。不过交集是完全自动而精确计算的，无需用户干预。「禁用」选项会关闭交集计算。「仅马赛克模式」只在选择了马赛克构建模式（合并/马赛克或分离马赛克）时计算交集区域，而「总是」会在所有工作模式中强制计算交集。通常只有构建马赛克时才需要此选项，因为这类任务中马赛克帧之间的重叠区域通常很小。

FILE: When a DDM-RBF is selected, this parameter allows to specify the maximum number of control points (or reference stars) that will be used (after surface simplification) to generate the 2-D interpolating/approximating surface splines that will be used to model coordinate transformations for image registration. For DDM-RBF types, this parameter can be specified in the range from 1000 to 25000 control points. The default value is 4000 points, usually sufficient for most practical applications. Increase this parameter to achieve more accuracy at the expense of more computational work. DDM-RBF surface spline generation has O(n^2) time complexity.For standard RBF types, which require O(n^3) time for spline construction, this parameter is ignored and a maximum of 2100 control points is always imposed.This parameter is not used with the recursive surface splines registration model, which uses all star pair matches after outlier rejection.
文件: 选择 DDM-RBF 时，此参数可指定（在表面简化之后）用于生成二维插值/近似表面样条的最大控制点（或参考星）数量，这些样条用于对图像配准的坐标变换建模。对 DDM-RBF 类型，此参数可在 1000 到 25000 个控制点之间指定。默认值为 4000 点，对多数实际应用通常足够。提高此参数可获得更高精度，代价是更多计算量。DDM-RBF 表面样条生成的时间复杂度为 O(n^2)。对标准 RBF 类型（构建样条需要 O(n^3) 时间），此参数被忽略，且总是施加最多 2100 个控制点的限制。此参数不用于递归表面样条配准模型 —— 该模型在剔除离群值后使用所有星对匹配。

FILE: The AdaptiveStretch process computes a nonlinear curve to enhance existing brightness differences above the noise threshold parameter. Brightness differences smaller than the noise threshold will be diminished or not enhanced in the processed image. Decrease this parameter to apply a more aggressive nonlinear transformation. In general, you should fine tune this parameter along with contrast protection to find an optimal combination.
文件: AdaptiveStretch 进程会计算一条非线性曲线，以增强高于噪声阈值参数的已有亮度差异。小于噪声阈值的亮度差异会被削弱或不予增强。降低此参数会施加更激进的非线性变换。一般来说，你应把此参数与对比度保护一起微调，以找到最优组合。

FILE: MaskedStretch will use pixels read from this image to compute an initial mean background level. If you leave this field blank (or with its default <target image> value), the target image will be also the background reference image for the masked stretch process.You should specify a view that represents the true background of the image. In most cases this means that you must select a view whose pixels are strongly dominated by the sky background, as it is being represented on the target image. A typical example involves defining a small preview over a free sky area of the target image, and selecting it here as the background reference image.
文件: MaskedStretch 将使用从该图像读取的像素计算初始平均背景水平。若将本字段留空（或保持默认的 <target image> 值），则目标图像同时充当带蒙版拉伸过程的背景参考图像。你应指定一个能代表图像真实背景的视图。多数情况下这意味着必须选择一个像素以天空背景为主的视图，与目标图像上所呈现的一致。典型做法是在目标图像的无天体天区定义一个小的预览，并在此处选为背景参考图像。

FILE: Maximum number of curve points. The default value is 106 points. For 8-bit and 16-bit integer images, AdaptiveStretch can compute a maximum of 256 and 65536 curve points, respectively. For 32-bit and 64-bit floating point images, a maximum of 107 and 108 curve points can be calculated, respectively, but the default maximum of 106 is normally more than sufficient.Increasing this parameter can improve the result for very rich floating point and 32-bit integer images, usually resulting from deep HDR compositions. Keep in mind that large curves will increase computation times considerably, so they should only be used when actually required. In most cases, the default value of this parameter is quite appropriate.
文件: 最大曲线点数。默认值为 10^6 个点。对 8 位与 16 位整数图像，AdaptiveStretch 最多能计算 256 与 65536 个曲线点。对 32 位与 64 位浮点图像，最多可计算 10^7 与 10^8 个曲线点，但默认上限 10^6 通常已绰绰有余。提高此参数可改善非常丰富的浮点与 32 位整数图像（通常来自深度 HDR 合成）的结果。请记住，大曲线会显著增加计算时间，只在确实需要时才使用。多数情况下此参数的默认值相当合适。

FILE: In most cases, a moderate number of iterations between 50 and 100 will lead to a smooth result with excellent protection of bright image features. With too few iterations, the MS algorithm may create artifacts around the brightest objects. In general, the largest the difference between the initial and final mean background values, the more iterations are necessary to compute accurate protection masks. For this reason, HDR images usually require more iterations. The default value is 100 iterations, which are more than sufficient for most nonlinear deep-sky images. You can reduce this value to speed up the process during trial-error work. If you get dark halos around bright stars, this means that more iterations are necessary. The maximum allowed is 1000 iterations.
文件: 多数情况下 50 到 100 次的中等迭代次数可得到平滑结果，并对亮部图像特征提供极好的保护。迭代次数太少时，MS 算法可能在最亮天体周围生成伪影。一般来说，初始与最终平均背景值差异越大，计算精确保护蒙版所需的迭代次数就越多。因此 HDR 图像通常需要更多迭代。默认值为 100 次迭代，对多数非线性深空图像绰绰有余。试错期间可以降低此值以加快进程。若你在亮星周围得到暗色光晕，说明需要更多迭代。允许的最大值为 1000 次迭代。

FILE: Number of masked stretch iterations.In most cases, a moderate number of iterations between 50 and 100 will lead to a smooth result with excellent protection of bright image features. With too few iterations, the MS algorithm may create artifacts around the brightest objects. In general, the largest the difference between the initial and final mean background values, the more iterations are necessary to compute accurate protection masks. For this reason, HDR images usually require more iterations. The default value is 100 iterations, which are more than sufficient for most nonlinear deep-sky images. You can reduce this value to speed up the process during trial-error work. If you get dark halos around bright stars, this means that more iterations are necessary. The maximum allowed is 1000 iterations.
文件: 带蒙版拉伸的迭代次数。多数情况下 50 到 100 次的中等迭代次数可得到平滑结果，并对亮部图像特征提供极好的保护。迭代次数太少时，MS 算法可能在最亮天体周围生成伪影。一般来说，初始与最终平均背景值差异越大，计算精确保护蒙版所需的迭代次数就越多。因此 HDR 图像通常需要更多迭代。默认值为 100 次迭代，对多数非线性深空图像绰绰有余。试错期间可以降低此值以加快进程。若你在亮星周围得到暗色光晕，说明需要更多迭代。允许的最大值为 1000 次迭代。

FILE: When this option is enabled, MLDenoise generates internal cache structures to store intermediate process results. When the process is executed in the same view, and there are no changes to critical parameters that would invalidate existing cached data, the cache is used to accelerate execution by reusing previously calculated images and auxiliary objects. This option is enabled by default. You can turn it off to save memory or for verification purposes.
文件: 启用此选项时，MLDenoise 会生成内部缓存结构来存储中间处理结果。当在同一视图上执行进程、且关键参数没有变化因而不会使已有缓存数据失效时，会用缓存复用先前计算的图像与辅助对象来加速执行。此选项默认启用。你可以关闭它来节省内存或用于验证。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a morphological median filter that will be applied to smooth the noise reduction mask. A smoothed mask is more robust to small-scale local variations, which makes it more efficient for noise reduction. However, too large of a smoothness value will lead to an inaccurate mask that won't protect significant structures appropriately. Good values are often in the range from 1 to 4, depending on the dominant scale of the noise in the image. To disable smoothing of the mask, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 这是施加于降噪蒙版以使其平滑的形态学中值滤波器的半径（像素）。平滑后的蒙版对小尺度局部变化更稳健，因而降噪更高效。但平滑值过大会导致蒙版不准确，无法恰当保护显著结构。好的取值常在 1 到 4 之间，取决于图像中噪声的主导尺度。要禁用蒙版平滑，把此参数设为零。

FILE: When this option is enabled, inference runs in the full precision of the model's float32 weights, and the result matches CPU inference closely: on a linear luminance master, the maximum deviation from CPU inference is 1.8e-6 with this option and 1.6e-5 without it. The cost is moderate: about 25% more time on an NVIDIA Ampere GPU (39.9 s instead of 31.9 s for a 26-megapixel image).The precision is fixed when the inference session is created, so each setting keeps its own loaded model: the first execution after changing this option reloads the model.This option has no effect on CPU inference, which is always performed in full precision.
文件: 启用此选项时，推理以模型 float32 权重的完整精度运行，结果与 CPU 推理非常接近：在线性亮度主帧上，启用此选项时与 CPU 推理的最大偏差为 1.8e-6，未启用时为 1.6e-5。代价适中：在 NVIDIA Ampere GPU 上约多花 25% 时间（2600 万像素图像从 31.9 秒变为 39.9 秒）。精度在创建推理会话时固定，因此每种设置都保留自己已载入的模型：更改此选项后的首次执行会重新载入模型。此选项对 CPU 推理无效，CPU 推理总是以完整精度执行。

FILE: Our noise reduction neural networks have been trained on immense datasets covering a wide variety of noise and structure distributions and morphologies in deep-sky astronomical images. This extensive training enables the system to differentiate noise from significant structures in virtually any image where this process can be applied, making local supports and masks unnecessary in most cases. However, noise reduction can be a highly delicate and subjective task that requires high versatility. This local support feature lets you control the amount of applied noise reduction differently for each pixel in the target image as a function of illumination. This helps adapt the process to the user's preferences and taste in such a critical task as noise reduction.
文件: 我们的降噪神经网络在庞大的数据集上训练过，覆盖深空天文图像中种类繁多的噪声与结构分布及形态。这种广泛训练使系统几乎能在可应用本进程的任何图像中区分噪声与显著结构，多数情况下无需局部支撑与蒙版。不过降噪可能是高度精细且主观的任务，需要很强的适应性。此局部支撑功能让你可以按照明为图像每个像素设定不同的降噪量。这有助于在降噪这类关键任务中让进程贴合用户的偏好与品味。

FILE: By default, GPU inference runs in reduced precision, which is faster: on NVIDIA hardware the CUDA execution provider rounds the float32 inputs of convolutions and matrix products to ten mantissa bits (TensorFloat-32), and on Apple hardware Core ML is allowed to accumulate in low precision on the GPU.When this option is enabled, inference runs in the full precision of the model's float32 weights, and the result matches CPU inference closely: on a linear luminance master, the maximum deviation from CPU inference is 1.8e-6 with this option and 1.6e-5 without it. The cost is moderate: about 25% more time on an NVIDIA Ampere GPU (39.9 s instead of 31.9 s for a 26-megapixel image).The precision is fixed when the inference session is created, so each setting keeps its own loaded model: the first execution after changing this option reloads the model.This option has no effect on CPU inference, which is always performed in full precision.
文件: 默认情况下，GPU 推理以降低的精度运行，速度更快：在 NVIDIA 硬件上 CUDA 执行提供程序把卷积与矩阵乘法的 float32 输入舍入到十位尾数（TensorFloat-32），在 Apple 硬件上 Core ML 允许在 GPU 上以低精度累加。启用此选项时，推理以模型 float32 权重的完整精度运行，结果与 CPU 推理非常接近：在线性亮度主帧上，启用此选项时与 CPU 推理的最大偏差为 1.8e-6，未启用时为 1.6e-5。代价适中：在 NVIDIA Ampere GPU 上约多花 25% 时间（2600 万像素图像从 31.9 秒变为 39.9 秒）。精度在创建推理会话时固定，因此每种设置都保留自己已载入的模型：更改此选项后的首次执行会重新载入模型。此选项对 CPU 推理无效，CPU 推理总是以完整精度执行。

FILE: Enable this option to generate a mask where all structures are initially white. In this case, only the smoothness parameter will determine the final brightness of all structures (smaller structures will be dimmer when smoothed).When this option is disabled, structures have initial values proportional to their relevance in the multiscale pyramid. Structures that are supported by more wavelet layers will be brighter.
文件: 启用此选项可生成所有结构初始为白色的蒙版。这种情况下，只有平滑度参数决定所有结构的最终亮度（平滑后较小的结构会更暗）。禁用此选项时，结构的初始值与其在多尺度金字塔中的重要性成正比。由更多小波层支撑的结构会更亮。

FILE: Binarize structures instead of rescaling them.Enable this option to generate a mask where all structures are initially white. In this case, only the smoothness parameter will determine the final brightness of all structures (smaller structures will be dimmer when smoothed).When this option is disabled, structures have initial values proportional to their relevance in the multiscale pyramid. Structures that are supported by more wavelet layers will be brighter.
文件: 把结构二值化而不是重标定。启用此选项可生成所有结构初始为白色的蒙版。这种情况下，只有平滑度参数决定所有结构的最终亮度（平滑后较小的结构会更暗）。禁用此选项时，结构的初始值与其在多尺度金字塔中的重要性成正比。由更多小波层支撑的结构会更亮。

FILE: Defines the boundary between small and large structures in pixels. Features smaller than this scale are considered fine detail and will have their contrast preserved.Lower values (e.g., 8-128) protect only the finest details like stars and nebular filaments. Higher values (e.g., 512-1024) also protect larger structures like galaxy arms and extended nebulosity. The default value of 1024 pixels works well for most images.
文件: 定义小结构与大结构之间的分界（像素）。小于此尺度的特征被视为精细细节，其对比度会被保留。较低的值（例如 8-128）只保护最精细的细节，如恒星与星云丝状结构。较高的值（例如 512-1024）也保护更大的结构，如星系旋臂与延展星云。默认值 1024 像素对多数图像效果良好。

FILE: When enabled: Uses a robust estimate of the mean of ROI pixel values for background estimation. This is useful when you have a known area of pure background in your image that you want to use as the reference for the stretching process.When disabled: Uses a robust mean background estimator for the entire image. This automatic method works well for most images.Tip: Drag a preview selector onto this section to set ROI coordinates automatically.
文件: 启用时：用 ROI 像素均值的稳健估计做背景估计。当图像中有已知的纯背景区域想用作拉伸过程的参考时很有用。禁用时：用整幅图像的稳健平均背景估计器。这种自动方法对多数图像效果良好。提示：把预览选择器拖到此节上可自动设置 ROI 坐标。

FILE: When enabled, the real-time preview shows only the large-scale structures of the image. This visualization helps you choose the right scale value: structures visible in this preview will be treated as background, while structures that disappear will be protected as fine detail.Adjust the scale so that this preview does not contain any structures whose contrast you want to recover. Any detail visible here will not benefit from contrast recovery.
文件: 启用时，实时预览只显示图像的大尺度结构。这种可视化有助于你选择正确的尺度值：此预览中可见的结构会被当作背景，而消失的结构会被作为精细细节保护。请调整尺度，使此预览中不包含你想恢复对比度的结构。此处可见的任何细节都不会从对比度恢复中受益。

FILE: These parameters define a rectangular region containing representative background pixels.When enabled: Uses a robust estimate of the mean of ROI pixel values for background estimation. This is useful when you have a known area of pure background in your image that you want to use as the reference for the stretching process.When disabled: Uses a robust mean background estimator for the entire image. This automatic method works well for most images.Tip: Drag a preview selector onto this section to set ROI coordinates automatically.
文件: 这些参数定义包含代表性背景像素的矩形区域。启用时：用 ROI 像素均值的稳健估计做背景估计。当图像中有已知的纯背景区域想用作拉伸过程的参考时很有用。禁用时：用整幅图像的稳健平均背景估计器。这种自动方法对多数图像效果良好。提示：把预览选择器拖到此节上可自动设置 ROI 坐标。

FILE: Region of Interest (ROI) for reference background estimation.These parameters define a rectangular region containing representative background pixels.When enabled: Uses a robust estimate of the mean of ROI pixel values for background estimation. This is useful when you have a known area of pure background in your image that you want to use as the reference for the stretching process.When disabled: Uses a robust mean background estimator for the entire image. This automatic method works well for most images.Tip: Drag a preview selector onto this section to set ROI coordinates automatically.
文件: 用于参考背景估计的感兴趣区域（ROI）。这些参数定义包含代表性背景像素的矩形区域。启用时：用 ROI 像素均值的稳健估计做背景估计。当图像中有已知的纯背景区域想用作拉伸过程的参考时很有用。禁用时：用整幅图像的稳健平均背景估计器。这种自动方法对多数图像效果良好。提示：把预览选择器拖到此节上可自动设置 ROI 坐标。

FILE: Selects a linear scaling sequence. Multiscale layers will be generated at dimensional scales following the sequence 1 + d*j, j >= 0 (1,1+d,1+2d,1+3d,...), where d is the scaling distance specified with this control.One of the advantages of the multiscale median transform is that the scaling sequence is arbitrary, in contrast to the wavelet transform, where only the dyadic sequence is strictly valid.
文件: 选择线性缩放序列。多尺度层将按 1 + d*j（j >= 0）的序列（1、1+d、1+2d、1+3d、……）在维度尺度上生成，其中 d 是用此控件指定的缩放距离。多尺度中值变换的优点之一是缩放序列可以任意，而小波变换只有二进位序列是严格有效的。

FILE: Clear the internal cache of reference images and working data.MultiscaleGradientCorrection uses a cache of precomputed data to accelerate the process of testing scale factors and gradient generation parameters on the same image. By clearing this cache, memory will be released but the reference image and gradient model generation tasks will need to be redone completely the next time you execute the process.
文件: 清除参考图像与工作数据的内部缓存。MultiscaleGradientCorrection 使用预计算数据的缓存，以加速在同一图像上测试尺度因子与梯度生成参数的过程。清除此缓存会释放内存，但下次执行进程时需要完全重做参考图像与梯度模型生成任务。

FILE: All Changes visualizes all nonzero layer coefficients in the current layer. Output pixel values are proportional to the absolute values of the corresponding coefficients.Increasing Pixels visualizes positive layer coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to coefficient values.Decreasing Pixels visualizes negative layer coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to coefficient absolute values.
文件: 全部变化：显示当前层中所有非零层系数。输出像素值与对应系数的绝对值成正比。增加像素：显示正的层系数。输出像素值与系数值成正比。减少像素：显示负的层系数。输出像素值与系数的绝对值成正比。

FILE: Chrominance applies the transformation to the RGB components of a color target image, but restores the original CIE Y component after the transformation. This effectively applies the multiscale transformation to the chroma components without altering the luminance.RGB/K Applies the transformation to the three RGB components of a target color image, or to the gray component of a grayscale image. This is the default mode.
文件: 色度：对彩色目标图像的 RGB 分量施加变换，但在变换后恢复原有的 CIE Y 分量。这样实际上只对色度分量施加多尺度变换而不改变亮度。RGB/K：对目标彩色图像的三个 RGB 分量施加变换，或对灰度图像的灰度分量施加。这是默认模式。

FILE: All Changes visualizes all nonzero transform coefficients in the current layer. Output pixel values are proportional to the absolute values of the corresponding coefficients.Increasing Pixels visualizes positive transform coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to the coefficient values.Decreasing Pixels visualizes negative transform coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to the absolute values of the coefficients.
文件: 全部变化：显示当前层中所有非零变换系数。输出像素值与对应系数的绝对值成正比。增加像素：显示正的变换系数。输出像素值与系数值成正比。减少像素：显示负的变换系数。输出像素值与系数的绝对值成正比。

FILE: Each enabled target frame, which must have an astrometric solution and flux calibration metadata (see the SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration process), is corrected and written to a new XISF file with all of its metadata (see Output Files); the target frames are never modified. The reference is the MARS database (the selected files, or the default files when none is selected) or the reference image, given as a view or as a file. Gradient models are not shown.
文件: 每个启用的目标帧（必须具有天体测量解和通量校准元数据，参见 SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration 进程）都会被校正，并连同其全部元数据写入新的 XISF 文件（参见输出文件）；目标帧本身绝不会被修改。参考为 MARS 数据库（所选文件，若未选择则为默认文件）或参考图像（以视图或文件形式给出）。不显示梯度模型。

FILE: Increase threshold to remove more structures. Typically, a value around 3 or 4 MAD is appropriate for the first layer. Successive layers normally require smaller thresholds (the larger the layer scale, the smaller threshold is usually required), but the actual values depend on the image and its noise distribution. Too large of a threshold will remove significant structures. Try to adjust this parameter to the smallest value able to remove the noise as you wish on each layer.
文件: 增大阈值可去除更多结构。通常第一层取 3 至 4 MAD 左右较为合适。后续各层一般需要更小的阈值（层尺度越大，通常所需阈值越小），但实际取值取决于图像及其噪声分布。阈值过大会去除显著结构。请尝试把此参数调整到在各层上正好能如你所愿去除噪声的最小值。

FILE: This is a fallback, not a rigorous option. The gradient correction of each MARS master frame has been verified through a strict manual procedure, but a mosaic of adjacent master frames has not been verified, and its accuracy cannot be guaranteed. It is never used when a MARS master frame contains the target image, or when a reference image is used.The reference data must cover 98% of the target image; the gradient model is extrapolated on the rest, with a warning. Disabled by default.
文件: 这是备用方案，并非严格选项。每个 MARS 主帧的梯度校正均已通过严格的人工流程验证，但对相邻主帧拼接成的马赛克并未验证，其精度无法保证。当某个 MARS 主帧包含目标图像时，或使用参考图像时，绝不使用此选项。参考数据必须覆盖目标图像的 98%；其余部分将外推梯度模型，并给出警告。默认禁用。

FILE: The scale factor of each channel is optimal when no image structures survive in the gradient model. Two gradient models computed at a small and a large dimensional scale isolate the surviving structures in their difference, and the optimal scale factor is the one that minimizes its standard deviation. This analysis excludes the zero pixels of the target image. If the reference image has no structures correlated with the target image in a channel, the scale factor specified for that channel is used.
文件: 当梯度模型中不再残留图像结构时，各通道的缩放因子即为最优。分别在小尺度与大尺度上计算两个梯度模型，其差值可分离出残留结构，最优缩放因子就是使其标准差最小的那个。此分析排除目标图像的零值像素。若参考图像在某通道中没有与目标图像相关的结构，则使用为该通道指定的缩放因子。

FILE: Increase threshold to remove more structures. Typically, a value between 3 to 5 sigma is appropriate for the first layer. Successive layers normally require smaller thresholds (the larger the layer scale, the smaller threshold is usually required), but the actual values depend on the properties and distribution of the noise in the image. Too large of a threshold will damage significant structures. Try to adjust this parameter to the smallest value able to remove the noise as you wish on each layer.
文件: 增大阈值可去除更多结构。通常第一层取 3 至 5 sigma 较为合适。后续各层一般需要更小的阈值（层尺度越大，通常所需阈值越小），但实际取值取决于图像中噪声的性质与分布。阈值过大会损伤显著结构。请尝试把此参数调整到在各层上正好能如你所愿去除噪声的最小值。

FILE: The median-based HDR multiscale transform is not 'better' than the wavelet-based transform; it is just a different solution to the dynamic range compression problem, with quite different results and its own idiosyncrasies. The fact that they generate much less (if any) ringing artifacts make median transforms particularly interesting, especially to compress very large dynamic ranges. However, the implemented deringing routines are usually able to solve this problem quite efficiently for wavelet-based HDR transforms.
文件: 基于中值的 HDR 多尺度变换并不比基于小波的变换“更好”；它只是动态范围压缩问题的另一种解法，结果差异很大，并且有其自身的特性。中值变换产生的振铃伪影要少得多（甚至没有），这使其特别值得关注，尤其是在压缩极大的动态范围时。不过，对于基于小波的 HDR 变换，已实现的去环例程通常能够相当有效地解决这一问题。

FILE: This parameter lets you control how large-scale image structures are represented to calculate the gradient model. By decreasing the value of this parameter, the relative intensities of isolated large-scale structures will tend to be more similar. By increasing this parameter, the differences in relative structure intensities will tend to be larger. A model with larger relative intensity differences among image structures tends to perform a more aggressive gradient correction. The default structure separation value is 3.
文件: 此参数用于控制大尺度图像结构以何种方式表示，以便计算梯度模型。减小该参数的值，孤立大尺度结构的相对强度会趋于更接近。增大该参数的值，结构相对强度之间的差异会趋于更大。图像结构之间相对强度差异更大的模型，往往执行更激进的梯度校正。结构分离度的默认值为 3。

FILE: This is the standard deviation of a Gaussian filter that will be used to convolve the linear mask. A slightly smoothed mask is more robust to small-scale local variations, which makes it more efficient for noise reduction. However, too large of a smoothness value will lead to an inaccurate mask that won't protect significant structures appropriately. Good values are usually in the range from 1 to 3 sigma, depending on the dominant scale of the noise in the image. To disable smoothing of the mask set this parameter to zero.
文件: 这是将用于对线性蒙版做卷积的高斯滤波器的标准差。略微平滑的蒙版对小尺度局部变化更为稳健，从而更有利于降噪。但平滑度过大会导致蒙版不准确，无法恰当保护显著结构。合适的取值通常在 1 至 3 sigma 之间，取决于图像中噪声的主导尺度。若要禁用蒙版平滑，请将此参数设为零。

FILE: The starlet transform algorithm is only defined to use the dyadic scaling sequence 2j, so using a linear sequence produces an invalid transform. However, for small-scale wavelet layers (say up to scales of 8 pixels or so) the errors introduced by a linear sequence are usually negligible. The linear scaling sequence applied to large-scale wavelet layers will generate visible artifacts due to accumulated errors in the wavelet transform. The multiscale linear transform does not have these problems and supports arbitrary scaling sequences.
文件: 星点（starlet）变换算法仅定义使用二进的缩放序列 2^j，因此使用线性序列会产生无效的变换。不过，对于小尺度小波层（大致到 8 像素左右的尺度），线性序列引入的误差通常可以忽略。将线性缩放序列用于大尺度小波层时，会因小波变换中的误差累积而产生可见伪影。多尺度线性变换没有这些问题，并且支持任意缩放序列。

FILE: Compute optimal scale factors automatically.The scale factor of each channel is optimal when no image structures survive in the gradient model. Two gradient models computed at a small and a large dimensional scale isolate the surviving structures in their difference, and the optimal scale factor is the one that minimizes its standard deviation. This analysis excludes the zero pixels of the target image. If the reference image has no structures correlated with the target image in a channel, the scale factor specified for that channel is used.
文件: 自动计算最优缩放因子。当梯度模型中不再残留图像结构时，各通道的缩放因子即为最优。分别在小尺度与大尺度上计算两个梯度模型，其差值可分离出残留结构，最优缩放因子就是使其标准差最小的那个。此分析排除目标图像的零值像素。若参考图像在某通道中没有与目标图像相关的结构，则使用为该通道指定的缩放因子。

FILE: Luminance applies the transformation exclusively to the CIE Y component (in the CIE XYZ space) of a linear color target image.Chrominance applies the transformation to the RGB components of a color target image, but restores the original CIE Y component after the transformation. This effectively applies the multiscale transformation to the chroma components without altering the luminance.RGB/K Applies the transformation to the three RGB components of a target color image, or to the gray component of a grayscale image. This is the default mode.

FILE: Increase/decrease bias to increase/decrease the relative weight of a multiscale layer in the reconstructed image. FILE: These controls allow you to extend the effective dynamic range of the transformed image. Applying a multiscale transform with biased layers can result in some pixels having out-of-range values. By extending the output dynamic range, some out-of-range pixels can be accomodated in the resulting image without truncation. The price to pay for preserving data in this way is a loss of overall contrast in the processed image.

FILE: The k-sigma thresholding method can be used to attenuate or remove all coefficients below a prescribed value in all layers of the multiscale transform. This method assumes a Gaussian noise distribution and takes into account the relative weights of Gaussian noise in each layer. These weights are functions of the employed wavelet scaling function (for the starlet transform) or linear filters (for the multiscale linear transform), and have been hard-coded in the MultiscaleLinearTransform tool.In general, k-sigma thresholding should not be used for noise reduction purposes, since the implemented per-layer noise reduction routine is much more accurate and controllable. This procedure can be useful for auxiliary image processing tasks, such as mask generation or feature detection.
文件: k-sigma 阈值法可用于衰减或去除多尺度变换所有层中低于规定值的全部系数。该方法假定噪声服从高斯分布，并考虑高斯噪声在各层中的相对权重。这些权重是所采用的小波缩放函数（对星点变换）或线性滤波器（对多尺度线性变换）的函数，已在 MultiscaleLinearTransform 工具中硬编码。一般来说，k-sigma 阈值不应用于降噪目的，因为已实现的逐层降噪例程精度更高、更可控。此过程可用于辅助性的图像处理任务，例如蒙版生成或特征检测。

FILE: The multiscale linear transform is similar to the starlet transform, but uses multiple Gaussian filters of varying sizes applied by separable convolutions, instead of a single interlaced scaling function. It is less flexible than the starlet transform (mainly because it does not allow selecting a specific scaling function) and computationally more expensive, but has two advantages: it allows for arbitrary scaling sequences (while the starlet transform is strictly defined only for the dyadic sequence), and is more controllable at large dimensional scales (because the scaling filters are computed separately for each layer).Both transforms are particularly well adapted to the detection of smooth isotropic structures, which justifies their success in astronomical image processing.
文件: 多尺度线性变换与星点变换类似，但它使用多个不同尺寸的高斯滤波器以可分离卷积的方式施加，而不是单一的隔行缩放函数。它不如星点变换灵活（主要因为它不允许选择特定的缩放函数），计算开销也更大，但有两个优点：它支持任意的缩放序列（而星点变换严格来说只为二进序列定义），并且在大尺度上更可控（因为缩放滤波器是逐层单独计算的）。这两种变换都特别适合检测平滑的各向同性结构，这也正是它们在天文图像处理中大获成功的原因。

FILE: Defines a threshold in mean absolute deviation (MAD) units for removal of transform coefficients in the current layer. All layer coefficients with absolute values below this threshold will be multiplied by one minus the amount parameter (by default amount is one, so zero is the default multiplier) when the noise reduction feature is enabled.Increase threshold to remove more structures. Typically, a value around 3 or 4 MAD is appropriate for the first layer. Successive layers normally require smaller thresholds (the larger the layer scale, the smaller threshold is usually required), but the actual values depend on the image and its noise distribution. Too large of a threshold will remove significant structures. Try to adjust this parameter to the smallest value able to remove the noise as you wish on each layer.
文件: 以平均绝对偏差（MAD）为单位定义阈值，用于去除当前层中的变换系数。启用降噪功能时，所有绝对值低于此阈值的层系数都会乘以（1 减去强度参数）——默认强度为 1，因此默认乘数为零。增大阈值可去除更多结构。通常第一层取 3 至 4 MAD 左右较为合适。后续各层一般需要更小的阈值（层尺度越大，通常所需阈值越小），但实际取值取决于图像及其噪声分布。阈值过大会去除显著结构。请尝试把此参数调整到在各层上正好能如你所愿去除噪声的最小值。

FILE: Defines a threshold in sigma units for removal of transform coefficients in the current layer. All coefficients with absolute values below this threshold will be attenuated by a process known as soft thresholding when the noise reduction feature is enabled for a particular layer. The amount parameter defines the strength of this attenuation.Increase threshold to remove more structures. Typically, a value between 3 to 5 sigma is appropriate for the first layer. Successive layers normally require smaller thresholds (the larger the layer scale, the smaller threshold is usually required), but the actual values depend on the properties and distribution of the noise in the image. Too large of a threshold will damage significant structures. Try to adjust this parameter to the smallest value able to remove the noise as you wish on each layer.
文件: 以 sigma 为单位定义阈值，用于去除当前层中的变换系数。当某一层启用了降噪功能时，所有绝对值低于此阈值的系数都会通过所谓软阈值处理被衰减。强度参数定义这种衰减的力度。增大阈值可去除更多结构。通常第一层取 3 至 5 sigma 较为合适。后续各层一般需要更小的阈值（层尺度越大，通常所需阈值越小），但实际取值取决于图像中噪声的性质与分布。阈值过大会损伤显著结构。请尝试把此参数调整到在各层上正好能如你所愿去除噪声的最小值。

FILE: Selects a linear scaling sequence. Multiscale transform layers will be generated at dimensional scales following the sequence 1 + d*j, j >= 0 (1,1+d,1+2d,1+3d,...), where d is the scaling distance specified with this control. A linear sequence can provide more control over small-scale image structures, which can be particularly useful for lunar, planetary and daylight images.The starlet transform algorithm is only defined to use the dyadic scaling sequence 2j, so using a linear sequence produces an invalid transform. However, for small-scale wavelet layers (say up to scales of 8 pixels or so) the errors introduced by a linear sequence are usually negligible. The linear scaling sequence applied to large-scale wavelet layers will generate visible artifacts due to accumulated errors in the wavelet transform. The multiscale linear transform does not have these problems and supports arbitrary scaling sequences.
文件: 选择线性缩放序列。多尺度变换层将按序列 1 + d*j（j >= 0，即 1、1+d、1+2d、1+3d……）在相应的尺度上生成，其中 d 是用此控件指定的缩放距离。线性序列能对小尺度图像结构提供更多控制，这对月球、行星和日光图像特别有用。星点变换算法仅定义使用二进的缩放序列 2^j，因此使用线性序列会产生无效的变换。不过，对于小尺度小波层（大致到 8 像素左右的尺度），线性序列引入的误差通常可以忽略。将线性缩放序列用于大尺度小波层时，会因小波变换中的误差累积而产生可见伪影。多尺度线性变换没有这些问题，并且支持任意缩放序列。

FILE: The MMT has several advantages over the wavelet transform. One of them is the practical absence of ringing artifacts around jump discontinuities, such as stars and other bright features. One drawback is that the MMT is computationally much more expensive than the AWT. On the other hand, MMT-based HDR transforms are more sensitive to local features, and hence more difficult to be evaluated on partial previews.The median-based HDR multiscale transform is not 'better' than the wavelet-based transform; it is just a different solution to the dynamic range compression problem, with quite different results and its own idiosyncrasies. The fact that they generate much less (if any) ringing artifacts make median transforms particularly interesting, especially to compress very large dynamic ranges. However, the implemented deringing routines are usually able to solve this problem quite efficiently for wavelet-based HDR transforms.
文件: MMT 相比小波变换有几个优点。其中之一是在跳变不连续处（例如恒星和其他明亮特征）实际上不会出现振铃伪影。一个缺点是 MMT 的计算开销比 AWT 大得多。另一方面，基于 MMT 的 HDR 变换对局部特征更敏感，因此更难以在局部预览上评估。基于中值的 HDR 多尺度变换并不比基于小波的变换“更好”；它只是动态范围压缩问题的另一种解法，结果差异很大，并且有其自身的特性。中值变换产生的振铃伪影要少得多（甚至没有），这使其特别值得关注，尤其是在压缩极大的动态范围时。不过，对于基于小波的 HDR 变换，已实现的去环例程通常能够相当有效地解决这一问题。

FILE: Gradients are often stronger along the edges of an image. Correcting them would require a smaller gradient scale, but the rest of the image is better corrected with a simpler model (a larger scale), which better preserves the integrity of the objects. With edge correction, gradient models are also computed at half, a quarter and an eighth of the gradient scale, as many as the aggressiveness level, never smaller than 128 pixels. Each model replaces the previous one on a frame along the edges of the image, as wide as its scale, with a smooth transition (a Gaussian function with a standard deviation of half the scale). If the image has no-data regions (pixels with zero values), such as a mosaic, the frames also follow the edges of the data.The scale factors are the same for all scales. At the 128-pixel scale, two additional iterations of the multiscale transform are applied, to prevent artifacts around high-contrast structures.
文件: 梯度在图像边缘附近往往更强。校正这些梯度需要更小的梯度尺度，而图像其余部分用更简单的模型（更大的尺度）校正效果更好，能更好地保持天体的完整性。启用边缘校正后，还会按梯度尺度的二分之一、四分之一和八分之一计算梯度模型，数量与激进度等级相同，但从不小于 128 像素。每个模型沿图像边缘在其尺度对应的宽度范围内替换前一个模型，并采用平滑过渡（标准差为尺度一半的高斯函数）。如果图像存在无数据区域（值为零的像素），例如马赛克，这些边框也会沿着数据的边缘分布。所有尺度使用相同的缩放因子。在 128 像素尺度上，会额外施加两次多尺度变换迭代，以防止高对比度结构周围产生伪影。

FILE: This parameter acts as a threshold for the regularization process, preventing diffusion over edge features stronger than the threshold value. Smaller values are more aggressive to protect edges against blurring caused by the diffusion process. Larger values are more permissive and lead to smoother images, but may cause some detail loss. This is the most critical parameter of the TGVDenoise process.
文件: 此参数充当正则化过程的阈值，防止扩散越过强于该阈值的边缘特征。较小的值更激进，可保护边缘不被扩散过程模糊。较大的值更宽松，会得到更平滑的图像，但可能造成一些细节损失。这是 TGVDenoise 进程最关键的一个参数。

FILE: A local support image changes the rate of the diffusion process, creating a spatially dependent function. This allows to better preserve high SNR areas, or to protect specific image edges. For deep-sky astronomical images, a local support is advisable to achieve optimal results, especially for linear images. The support image should represent the SNR of the target image, where higher pixel values will provide stronger protection. By default, the support image (when enabled) is the intensity component (in the HSI color system) of the target image.
文件: 局部支撑图像会改变扩散过程的速率，形成随空间变化的函数。这样可以更好地保留高信噪比区域，或保护特定的图像边缘。对于深空天文图像，尤其是线性图像，建议使用局部支撑以获得最佳结果。支撑图像应表示目标图像的信噪比，其中像素值越高，提供的保护越强。默认情况下，支撑图像（启用时）是目标图像的强度分量（在 HSI 色彩体系中）。

FILE: TGVDenoise emulates a diffusion process, following a dynamic evolution scheme. Each iteration can be seen as a time sample, where the image reaches a new state. The process converges to an optimal solution when no significant diffusion can happen between neighbor pixels. This usually requires a large number of iterations. Convergence is evaluated by calculating the norm of the difference between two consecutive iteration steps. This is an estimate of global error, or mean square change. Usually, once this difference drops below 1/255, little or no changes can be perceived in the displayed image.
文件: TGVDenoise 模拟一个动态演化式的扩散过程。每次迭代可视为一个时间采样，图像在其中达到一个新状态。当相邻像素之间不再发生显著扩散时，过程收敛到最优解。这通常需要大量迭代。收敛性通过计算连续两次迭代之间差值的范数来评估。这是对全局误差（即均方变化）的估计。通常，一旦该差值降到 1/255 以下，显示图像中就几乎或完全察觉不到变化了。

FILE: TGVInpaint emulates a diffusion process, following a dynamic evolution scheme. Each iteration can be seen as a time sample, where the image reaches a new state. The process converges to an optimal solution when no significant diffusion can happen between neighbor pixels. This usually requires a large number of iterations. Convergence is evaluated by calculating the norm of the difference between two consecutive iteration steps. This is an estimate of global error, or mean square change. Usually, once this difference drops below 1/255, little or no changes can be perceived in the displayed image.
文件: TGVInpaint 模拟一个动态演化式的扩散过程。每次迭代可视为一个时间采样，图像在其中达到一个新状态。当相邻像素之间不再发生显著扩散时，过程收敛到最优解。这通常需要大量迭代。收敛性通过计算连续两次迭代之间差值的范数来评估。这是对全局误差（即均方变化）的估计。通常，一旦该差值降到 1/255 以下，显示图像中就几乎或完全察觉不到变化了。

FILE: When automatic convergence is enabled, the process will be stopped if either the difference between two successive iterations (see the iterations parameter) is smaller than the convergence parameter, or if the maximum number of iterations is reached; whichever happens first. If this parameter is disabled, the specified number of iterations will always be performed.Important — Be aware that when automatic convergence is enabled, the TGVDenoise process is not previewable. In other words, since convergence is specific to the data being processed, there is no guarantee that the result obtained on a preview be the same as the result obtained on its mother image with the same parameters. Depending on the image, the differences can be significant.
文件: 启用自动收敛后，只要出现以下任一情况，过程就会停止：连续两次迭代之间的差值（参见迭代次数参数）小于收敛参数，或达到最大迭代次数——以先发生者为准。若禁用此参数，则始终执行指定的迭代次数。重要——请注意，启用自动收敛时，TGVDenoise 进程无法预览。换言之，由于收敛是针对正在处理的数据而言的，无法保证在预览上以相同参数得到的结果与其母图像上的结果一致。视图像而定，差异可能相当大。

If this parameter is disabled, the specified number of iterations will always be performed.Important — Be aware that when automatic convergence is enabled, the TGVInpaint process is not previewable. In other words, since convergence is specific to the data being processed, there is no guarantee that the result obtained on a preview be the same as the result obtained on its mother image with the same parameters. Depending on the image, the differences can be significant.

FILE: If this option is enabled, the identifier change will generate an entry in the image's processing history as a new instance of the ImageIdentifier process.If this option is disabled, the identifier will be modified transparently, and the action won't be reflected in the image's processing history. However, the existing identifier(s) in previous history elements will be restored during undo/redo operations.
文件: 若启用此选项，标识符的更改会在图像的处理历史中生成一条记录，作为 ImageIdentifier 进程的一个新实例。若禁用此选项，标识符会被透明地修改，该操作不会反映在图像的处理历史中。不过，在撤销/重做操作期间，先前历史元素中已有的标识符会被恢复。

FILE: The byte shuffle algorithm reorganizes the data in a clever way that can greatly improve compression ratios, especially for data with high locality (or data containing similar values close together), such as most scientific and observational data. This option can be particularly efficient for compression of data structured as contiguous sequences of 16-bit, 32-bit and 64-bit numbers, such as most images processed with PixInsight.
文件: 字节混洗算法以一种巧妙的方式重新组织数据，可大幅提高压缩比，尤其适用于局部相关性强的数据（即相近数值彼此靠近的数据），例如大多数科学数据与观测数据。对于按 16 位、32 位和 64 位数值的连续序列组织的数据（例如大多数经 PixInsight 处理的图像），此选项尤为高效。

FILE: On macOS, .pxiproject folders are document packages (or bundles) that the operating system manages as single files within the graphical user interface. On Linux/Unix and Windows platforms, where the concept of package abstraction does not exist, .pxiproject folders are just regular folders. However, they still offer the important advantage that all project data is contained within a single filesystem item.PixInsight's File Explorer window manages bundled projects as document packages, in the macOS style, on all supported platforms.
文件: 在 macOS 上，.pxiproject 文件夹是文档包（或称 bundle），操作系统在图形界面中将其作为单个文件管理。在 Linux/Unix 和 Windows 平台上不存在包抽象这一概念，.pxiproject 文件夹只是普通文件夹。不过，它们仍具有一项重要优势：所有项目数据都包含在单个文件系统项内。PixInsight 的文件浏览器窗口在所有受支持的平台上，都以 macOS 风格将打包项目作为文档包管理。

FILE: Compute a cryptographic checksum for the .xosm project file and store it encrypted in a seal data file. When the project is loaded, PixInsight will decrypt the seal file to verify that the project file has not been modified since it was generated.Sealing is a basic mechanism to protect data integrity using highly secure cryptographic techniques (AES256 encryption with random hashing in the current versions of PixInsight). When you load a sealed project without warnings, you can be sure that no one or nothing has tampered with your data. To use this functionality, the compute file checksums option must also be enabled.
文件: 为 .xosm 项目文件计算加密校验和，并将其加密后存储到一个封印数据文件中。加载项目时，PixInsight 会解密该封印文件，以验证项目文件自生成以来未被修改。封印是一种使用高度安全的加密技术保护数据完整性的基本机制（在当前版本的 PixInsight 中为 AES256 加密配合随机哈希）。当你加载已封印的项目而没有收到警告时，你就可以确定没有任何人或任何事物篡改过你的数据。要使用此功能，还必须启用“计算文件校验和”选项。

FILE: The Script process allows JavaScript scripts to integrate smoothly with PixInsight's object-oriented architecture. For example, scripts can be part of a view's processing history, just as regular module-defined process instances. Scripts can be undone and redone, stored in ProcessContainer instances, and manipulated as process icons.A Script instance stores a reference to the executed script file (usually a file carrying the .js suffix). It also stores a cryptographic hash (currently a MD5 checksum) that can be used to authenticate executed script code, and to ensure that the same script code runs on successive executions.
文件: Script 进程使 JavaScript 脚本能够与 PixInsight 的面向对象架构顺畅集成。例如，脚本可以像普通的模块定义进程实例那样，成为某个视图处理历史的一部分。脚本可以撤销与重做，可以存储在 ProcessContainer 实例中，也可以作为进程图标来操作。Script 实例会保存对所执行脚本文件（通常是带 .js 后缀的文件）的引用。它还会保存一个加密哈希（目前为 MD5 校验和），可用于验证所执行的脚本代码，并确保在后续执行中运行的是同一份脚本代码。

FILE: Be aware that this task may require some time, which depends on the number of logical processor cores and the performance of the host machine. FILE: The perceptual intent maps all colors in the image space to the printer/paper space. With the perceptual intent, no out-of-gamut color is clipped, as happens with the colorimetric intents, but all colors can be altered, and the changes can be significant if the image space is much wider than the output space. In general, relative colorimetric is preferred, but perceptual can yield more vibrant results that may be desirable in some cases.Finally, the saturation intent tries to maximize color saturation in the printed result, at the cost of sacrifying color accuracy, if necessary. This intent can be a good option for synthetic graphics and illustrations, but not for reproduction of photographic images.
文件: 感知意图把图像空间中的所有颜色映射到打印机/纸张空间。使用感知意图时，不会有任何超出色域的颜色被裁剪（色度意图则会发生裁剪），但所有颜色都可能被改变；如果图像空间比输出空间宽得多，变化可能相当显著。一般来说相对色度意图更受青睐，但感知意图可以产生更鲜艳的结果，在某些情况下可能正是所需。最后，饱和度意图会尽量提高打印结果中的色彩饱和度，必要时不惜牺牲色彩准确性。此意图对合成图形和插图可能是好选择，但不适合用于照片图像的复制。

FILE: Script represents an execution of a JavaScript script. An instance of the Script process encapsulates a set of script parameters that have been exported by the running script. These parameters can later be imported by the same script during a subsequent execution. An instance of Script can be executed either on a view or in the global context.The Script process allows JavaScript scripts to integrate smoothly with PixInsight's object-oriented architecture. For example, scripts can be part of a view's processing history, just as regular module-defined process instances. Scripts can be undone and redone, stored in ProcessContainer instances, and manipulated as process icons.A Script instance stores a reference to the executed script file (usually a file carrying the .js suffix). It also stores a cryptographic hash (currently a MD5 checksum) that can be used to authenticate executed script code, and to ensure that the same script code runs on successive executions.
文件: Script 表示一次 JavaScript 脚本的执行。Script 进程的实例封装了由正在运行的脚本导出的一组脚本参数。这些参数之后可在该脚本的下一次执行中被导入。Script 实例既可以在某个视图上执行，也可以在全局上下文中执行。Script 进程使 JavaScript 脚本能够与 PixInsight 的面向对象架构顺畅集成。例如，脚本可以像普通的模块定义进程实例那样，成为某个视图处理历史的一部分。脚本可以撤销与重做，可以存储在 ProcessContainer 实例中，也可以作为进程图标来操作。Script 实例会保存对所执行脚本文件（通常是带 .js 后缀的文件）的引用。它还会保存一个加密哈希（目前为 MD5 校验和），可用于验证所执行的脚本代码，并确保在后续执行中运行的是同一份脚本代码。

FILE: ZLib is a lossless compression algorithm capable of very high compression ratios but comparatively slow, especially for compression or large blocks.LZ4 is an extremely fast lossless compression algorithm, but usually achieves significantly smaller compression ratios than zlib.LZ4-HC is the high-compression variant of LZ4. It achieves somewhat smaller compression ratios than zlib, but is somewhat faster for compression and as fast as LZ4 for decompression.Zstandard (or "zstd") is a fast lossless compression algorithm targeting real-time compression at zlib-level and better compression ratios. This is the default option for newly created projects since PixInsight core version 1.8.9-2.See also the byte shuffling option.Note: If compression settings are changed when rewriting an existing project, this will implicitly disable the incremental project writing feature.** Warning: The default Zstandard compression is not compatible with PixInsight core versions older than 1.8.9-2.
文件: ZLib 是一种无损压缩算法，可实现很高的压缩比，但相对较慢，尤其是压缩或处理大块数据时。LZ4 是一种极快的无损压缩算法，但通常其压缩比明显低于 zlib。LZ4-HC 是 LZ4 的高压缩变体。其压缩比略低于 zlib，但压缩速度稍快，解压速度与 LZ4 相当。Zstandard（或称“zstd”）是一种快速无损压缩算法，目标是在 zlib 级别的速度下实现实时压缩，并获得更好的压缩比。自 PixInsight 核心版本 1.8.9-2 起，这是新建项目的默认选项。另请参见字节混洗选项。注意：若在重写现有项目时更改压缩设置，将隐式禁用增量项目写入功能。** 警告：默认的 Zstandard 压缩与低于 1.8.9-2 的 PixInsight 核心版本不兼容。

FILE: Represents a star structuring element in a morphological transformation, such as the medfilt(), erosion() or dilation() generators.For example, a star structure of size 7 is defined as follows: . . . x . . . . x . x . x . . . x x x . . x x x x x x x . . x x x . . . x . x . x . . . . x . . .where existing elements are marked as 'x' and nonexisting elements are denoted as '.'.Invariant subexpression: always.
文件: 表示形态学变换中的星形结构元素，例如用于 medfilt()、erosion() 或 dilation() 生成器。例如，尺寸为 7 的星形结构定义如下：. . . x . . . . x . x . x . . . x x x . . x x x x x x x . . x x x . . . x . x . x . . . . x . . . 其中存在的元素标记为 'x'，不存在的元素记为 '.'。不变子表达式：始终。

FILE: Multiple conditional function (or inline switch function):Returns expr_1 if cond_1 evaluates to nonzero;otherwise, returns expr_2 if cond_2 evaluates to nonzero;...otherwise, returns expr_n if cond_n evaluates to nonzero;otherwise, if all cond_i evaluate to zero (1 ≤ i ≤ n), returns expr_default.Invariant subexpression: When all specified arguments are either immediate numeric values or invariant subexpressions.
文件: 多重条件函数（或称内联开关函数）：若 cond_1 求值为非零，则返回 expr_1；否则，若 cond_2 求值为非零，则返回 expr_2；……否则，若 cond_n 求值为非零，则返回 expr_n；否则，若所有 cond_i 均求值为零（1 ≤ i ≤ n），则返回 expr_default。不变子表达式：当所有指定参数均为立即数值或不变子表达式时。

FILE: Convolution of the specified image with a custom kernel filter.The arguments kij are filter kernel elements specified in row-major order. The minimum kernel size is 3×3, hence at least 9 elements must be defined. For the smallest 3×3 kernel we have the following filter configuration: k11 k12 k13 k21 k22 k23 k31 k32 k33Filter kernels must be square matrices with odd dimensions, so valid kernel sizes are 3×3, 5×5, 7×7, etc.
文件: 用自定义核滤波器对指定图像做卷积。参数 kij 是按行主序指定的滤波核元素。最小核尺寸为 3×3，因此至少必须定义 9 个元素。对于最小的 3×3 核，滤波配置如下：k11 k12 k13 k21 k22 k23 k31 k32 k33 滤波核必须为奇数维的方阵，因此有效的核尺寸为 3×3、5×5、7×7 等。

FILE: Unclipped rotation of an image by the specified angle in degrees.An unclipped rotation preserves the entire image without clipping any pixels. Unclipped rotations always rotate images with respect to their geometric centers. To accommodate all rotated pixels in the generated image, the unclipped rotated image can be smaller than the original one in PixelMath, except for the trivial cases of rotations by 0 and 180 degrees.
文件: 按指定角度（以度为单位）对图像做不裁剪旋转。不裁剪旋转会保留整幅图像，不裁剪任何像素。不裁剪旋转始终围绕图像的几何中心旋转。为把旋转后的所有像素都容纳进生成的图像，在 PixelMath 中，不裁剪旋转后的图像可能比原图更小，旋转 0 度和 180 度这类平凡情况除外。

FILE: Given two images X and Y, the expression: combine( Y, X, op_atan2() )will generate an image where each pixel will be equal to the arc tangent of y/x in radians, in the range [−π,+π], where y and x are, respectively, the corresponding pixels in the Y and X images.The signs of the arguments are used to determine the correct quadrant of the result. 文件: 给定两幅图像 X 与 Y，表达式 combine( Y, X, op_atan2() ) 会生成一幅图像，其中每个像素等于 y/x 的反正切（以弧度表示），范围为 [−π,+π]，其中 y 和 x 分别是 Y 与 X 图像中对应的像素。参数的正负号用于确定结果的正确象限。生成的图像为 64 位浮点格式。不变子表达式：始终。

FILE: Declination equatorial coordinate calculated for the specified image at (x,y) image coordinates. The returned value is expressed in degrees in the range [-90,+90].This function requires a valid astrometric solution available in the specified image.Note: Use of this function can lead to poor performance when executed on large images with spline-based astrometric solutions (for distortion correction) and slow machines with few processor cores.
文件: 计算指定图像在图像坐标 (x,y) 处的赤纬赤道坐标。返回值以度为单位，范围为 [-90,+90]。此函数要求指定图像具有有效的天体测量解。注意：在大型图像上使用基于样条的天体测量解（用于畸变校正），以及在处理器核心较少的慢速机器上执行时，此函数可能导致性能不佳。

FILE: Right ascension equatorial coordinate calculated for the specified image at (x,y) image coordinates. The returned value is expressed in degrees in the range [0,360).This function requires a valid astrometric solution available in the specified image.Note: Use of this function can lead to poor performance when executed on large images with spline-based astrometric solutions (for distortion correction) and slow machines with few processor cores.
文件: 计算指定图像在图像坐标 (x,y) 处的赤经赤道坐标。返回值以度为单位，范围为 [0,360)。此函数要求指定图像具有有效的天体测量解。注意：在大型图像上使用基于样条的天体测量解（用于畸变校正），以及在处理器核心较少的慢速机器上执行时，此函数可能导致性能不佳。

FILE: For local variance calculation, a Gaussian kernel helps to isolate pixel variations at smaller scales, compared with a flat kernel, since the normal distribution concentrates more energy around the center of the 2-D distribution. FILE: If this option is disabled, PixelMath expressions will be evaluated but their results will be discarded. No output will be generated, and hence PixelMath will behave as a no-op process: the target image won't be modified when the process is executed in a view context, and no new image will be created as a result of global execution. This working mode is useful when PixelMath is being used exclusively for evaluation of global variables as a side-effect of expression evaluation.

The generated image will be in 64-bit floating point format.Invariant subexpression: always.

FILE: If this option is disabled (default state), the final image will be truncated, if necessary, to fit in the normalized [0,1] range.You can disable both rescaling and truncation by creating a PixelMath process icon and editing its instance source code. If you set both 'rescale' and 'truncate' instance properties to false, the resulting image will be left intact upon PixelMath execution termination.Warning: Platform stability is not guaranteed if out-of-range pixel sample values propagate after process execution.

FILE: Enable code optimization to implement faster conditional functions and logical operators. Code optimization works by minimizing execution of unnecessary subexpressions, which can lead to a significant increase in the execution speed of iif() and iswitch() inline conditional functions, as well as logical operators (through short-circuit evaluation), among other critical PixelMath language constructs. This option is enabled by default, and should only be disabled by developers for verification and debugging purposes.

FILE: Enable this option to force PixelMath to use a single execution thread, irrespective of current global parallel execution settings. Single-threaded execution is necessary for some applications that are incompatible with multithreaded implementations. A good example is calculation of integral images. In an integral image, each pixel at coordinates {x,y} is the sum of all pixels at coordinates {i <= x, j <= y} in the source image. This task cannot be parallelized, and hence requires enabling this option to be implemented with PixelMath.
文件: 启用此选项可强制 PixelMath 使用单个执行线程，忽略当前的全局并行执行设置。对于某些与多线程实现不兼容的应用，单线程执行是必需的。一个典型的例子是积分图像的计算。在积分图像中，坐标 {x,y} 处的每个像素都是源图像中坐标 {i <= x, j <= y} 处所有像素之和。此任务无法并行化，因此用 PixelMath 实现时必须启用此选项。

FILE: If you select this option, the geometry, color space and data format of the output image can either be specified by this PixelMath instance (see the width, height, color space and sample format parameters below), or taken from the target image this PixelMath instance is executed on. In the former case, PixelMath can be executed in the global context because none of its parameters depend on an existing image. In the latter case, PixelMath can only be applied to an image.When PixelMath is executed globally, the working image has all of its pixel samples initially set to zero.
文件: 若选择此选项，输出图像的几何尺寸、色彩空间和数据格式既可以由本 PixelMath 实例指定（参见下方的宽度、高度、色彩空间和样本格式参数），也可以取自本 PixelMath 实例所作用的目标图像。在前一种情况下，PixelMath 可以在全局上下文中执行，因为它的所有参数都不依赖于已有图像。在后一种情况下，PixelMath 只能应用于图像。当 PixelMath 在全局执行时，工作图像的所有像素样本初始都被设为零。

The resulting image looks grainy and natural.A parameter value of zero will disable FBDD noise reduction. A value of one will apply the algorithm to the raw image. A value of two will apply an additional noise reduction step to the chroma components.
文件: FBDD 降噪迭代次数。Jacek Gozdz 的 FBDD 降噪算法在去除小尺度明亮伪影方面非常高效，例如欠曝原始数据中的热像素。以下引自作者网站（http://www.linuxphoto.org/html/fbdd.html）：它在去马赛克之前工作，之后可以接任何去马赛克方法。FBDD 能消除最显眼的脉冲噪声，同时保留 99% 的细节，并显著降低色度噪声——这有助于在去马赛克后使用不同的降噪技术取得良好效果。它不影响图像的对比度或饱和度，因此无需后处理。结果图像看起来颗粒感自然。参数值为零将禁用 FBDD 降噪。值为 1 时对原始图像应用该算法。值为 2 时对色度分量额外施加一步降噪。

FILE: This parameters specifies the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) of local midnight at the site of target subframe observation, rounded to the nearest hour from 0 to 23. FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a Gaussian convolution filter applied to the working image used for calculation of star positions during the star detection phase. FILE: When assigning drizzle and/or local normalization data files to input subframes, take into account full file paths stored in .xdrz and .xnml files. This allows you to measure images with duplicate file names on different directories. However, by enabling this option your data set gets tied to specific locations on the local filesystem. When this option is disabled (the default state), only file names are used to associate target images with .xdrz and .xnml files, which allows you to move your images freely throughout the filesystem, including the possibility to migrate them to different machines.Changes to this option will come into play the next time you associate .xdrz and/or .xnml files with input subframes. Existing file associations are not affected.
文件: 为输入子帧指定 drizzle 和/或局部归一化数据文件时，会考虑存储在 .xdrz 和 .xnml 文件中的完整文件路径。这样你就可以测量位于不同目录下的同名图像。不过，启用此选项会使你的数据集绑定到本地文件系统上的特定位置。禁用此选项时（默认状态），只用文件名把目标图像与 .xdrz 和 .xnml 文件关联，这样你可以在文件系统中自由移动图像，包括将它们迁移到不同的机器。此选项的更改会在下次把 .xdrz 和/或 .xnml 文件与输入子帧关联时生效。已有的文件关联不受影响。

FILE: The pedestal mode option specifies how to retrieve a (usually small) quantity that is subtracted from input images as the very first step before measurement. This quantity is known as pedestal, and must be expressed in the 16-bit unsigned integer range (from 0 to 65535). If present, a pedestal has been added by a previous calibration process to ensure positivity of the result.Literal value lets you specify a pedestal value that will be subtracted from all input frames. You usually don't need this option, except in very special cases.Default FITS keyword is the default mode. When this mode is selected, SubframeSelector will retrieve pedestal values from 'PEDESTAL' FITS keywords, when they are present in the input images.Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword to retrieve pedestal values, when the specified keyword is present in the input images.
文件: 基座模式选项指定如何获取一个（通常很小的）量，它在测量之前的第一步从输入图像中减去。该量称为基座，必须以 16 位无符号整数范围（0 至 65535）表示。如果存在基座，它是由先前的校准过程添加的，以确保结果为正。字面值：可指定一个将从所有输入帧中减去的基座值。通常不需要此选项，除非在非常特殊的情况下。默认 FITS 关键字：默认模式。选中此模式时，SubframeSelector 会从输入图像中的 'PEDESTAL' FITS 关键字（若存在）中获取基座值。自定义 FITS 关键字：可指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字的名称，当输入图像中存在该关键字时，从中获取基座值。

FILE: The default value is 8000 stars, which is more than reasonable in most cases. Set this parameter to zero to allow an unlimited number of PSF fits, that is, to attempt fitting all detected stars on each subframe.This parameter is intended to avoid fitting huge amounts of PSFs on wide-field images, where the number of detected stars can easily reach several tens of thousands, or even more than one hundred thousand in extreme cases. In such cases the measurement process can take a very long time to complete, but without any benefit in statistical terms, since fitting about 10,000 stars on each subframe is normally more than sufficient to acquire reliable FWHM and eccentricity measurements.When this parameter imposes a limit on the number of PSF fits, the subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.
文件: 默认值为 8000 颗星，这在多数情况下绰绰有余。将此参数设为零可允许不限数量的 PSF 拟合，即尝试对每个子帧上检测到的所有星点进行拟合。此参数旨在避免在广域图像上拟合海量 PSF——在广域图像中，检测到的星点数很容易达到数万，极端情况下甚至超过十万。此时测量过程可能耗时极长，却在统计上毫无收益，因为每个子帧拟合约 10000 颗恒星通常已足以获得可靠的 FWHM 和偏心率测量。当此参数对 PSF 拟合数量施加限制时，被测量的星点子集总是从检测到的星点集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。
