文件: 在检测到的星点集合上执行 PSF 拟合的最大数量。默认值为 8000 颗星，这在多数情况下绰绰有余。将此参数设为零可允许不限数量的 PSF 拟合，即尝试对每个子帧上检测到的所有星点进行拟合。此参数旨在避免在广域图像上拟合海量 PSF——在广域图像中，检测到的星点数很容易达到数万，极端情况下甚至超过十万。此时测量过程可能耗时极长，却在统计上毫无收益，因为每个子帧拟合约 10000 颗恒星通常已足以获得可靠的 FWHM 和偏心率测量。当此参数对 PSF 拟合数量施加限制时，被测量的星点子集总是从检测到的星点集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。

FILE: Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In SubframeSelector, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded, while output hints modify the way output image files are written.For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "compression-codec zlib+sh" output hint to write all output images (in XISF format) using zlib compression with byte shuffling. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints. For information on hints supported by a particular file format, see the corresponding implementation information given on the Format Explorer window.
文件: 格式提示可让你为特定进程所用的图像文件覆盖全局文件格式设置。在 SubframeSelector 中，输入提示改变某些特定格式输入图像的加载方式，输出提示则改变输出图像文件的写出方式。例如，你可以使用 "lower-range" 和 "upper-range" 输入提示来加载由其他不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 区间的应用所生成的浮点 FITS 和 TIFF 文件。类似地，你可以指定 "compression-codec zlib+sh" 输出提示，以使用 zlib 压缩加字节混洗写出所有输出图像（XISF 格式）。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式都支持若干输入和/或输出提示，你可以在提供格式提示访问权限的工具中，将它们用于不同目的。有关某一特定文件格式所支持提示的信息，请参见格式浏览器窗口中给出的相应实现信息。

FILE: Significance mode: number of layers of the multiscale median transform whose residual is the large-scale background. With n layers the background keeps the structures larger than about 2n pixels (257 pixels for the default of 8), along with gradients and vignetting, so they are removed from the measurement and not protected. Fewer layers follow the background more closely; more layers protect broad objects such as a galaxy's disk.
文件: 显著性模式：多尺度中值变换的层数，其残差即大尺度背景。取 n 层时，背景会保留大于约 2^n 像素的结构（默认 8 层时为 257 像素），以及梯度和暗角，因此它们会从测量中被去除而不受保护。层数越少，背景跟随得越紧密；层数越多，则越能保护宽广天体，例如星系盘。

FILE: Point source detection threshold, in sigma units of the matched filter adapted to the noise of the image. Lower values model fainter stars, and admit more noise peaks as stars: in white noise, about 40 false detections per megapixel at 4, 10 at 4.5 and almost none at 5. Higher values model only the more significant stars; the fainter ones are then treated as part of the diffuse component. Only point-like, isolated detections are modeled, whatever the threshold.
文件: 点源检测阈值，以适配图像噪声的匹配滤波器的 sigma 单位表示。较低的值会建模更暗的恒星，并把更多噪声峰当作恒星：在白噪声中，阈值为 4 时每百万像素约有 40 个虚警，4.5 时约 10 个，5 时几乎没有。较高的值只建模更显著的恒星；较暗的恒星随后被当作漫射分量的一部分。无论阈值如何，只建模点状的、孤立的检测项。

FILE: Significance mode: significance level where protection begins, in the normalized [0,1] range. The level is measured in sigma units of the noise of the smoothed luminance itself, so it does not depend on the structure scale: 0 is 1 sigma, 0.25 is about 3 sigma, 0.5 is 10 sigma and 1 is 100 sigma, on a logarithmic scale. Pixels at or below the level receive the full noise reduction; lower values pick up fainter nebulosity, higher values protect only the brighter structures.
文件: 显著性模式：保护开始处的显著性等级，位于归一化的 [0,1] 区间。该等级以平滑后亮度自身噪声的 sigma 单位衡量，因此不依赖于结构尺度：在对数尺度上，0 为 1 sigma，0.25 约为 3 sigma，0.5 为 10 sigma，1 为 100 sigma。处于或低于该等级的像素获得完全的降噪；较低的值能捕捉更暗的星云状结构，较高的值只保护较亮的结构。

FILE: Significance measures how far each pixel of the smoothed luminance stands above a large-scale background, in units of the noise, and protects structures between a threshold and a multiple of it on a logarithmic ramp. It is the mode for images whose structures are only a few percent above the sky, such as deep narrowband stacks: there the sky peak is so narrow that the brightness mask has no dynamic range left, and no clipping point separates the nebulae from the background.
文件: 显著性衡量平滑亮度的每个像素以噪声为单位高出大尺度背景多少，并在对数斜坡上保护介于某个阈值与其若干倍之间的结构。它适用于结构仅比天空亮百分之几的图像，例如窄带深空叠加：此类图像中天空峰太窄，亮度蒙版已无动态范围可言，也没有任何裁剪点能把星云与背景分开。

FILE: Model stars explicitly. Point sources are detected on the luminance with a matched filter adapted to the noise spectrum of the image, and each one is represented by PSF-shaped components whose amplitudes are solved together with the noise reduction, so the diffuse component never sees the stars. Faint stars keep their full amplitude at any strength, and the strength can be chosen for the background alone. Stars below the detection limit are treated as part of the diffuse component.
文件: 显式建模恒星。用适配图像噪声频谱的匹配滤波器在亮度上检测点源，每个点源用 PSF 形状的分量表示，其振幅与降噪一起求解，因此漫射分量永远不会“看到”恒星。暗星在任何强度下都保持完整振幅，强度可以只针对背景来选择。低于检测限的恒星被当作漫射分量的一部分。

FILE: The local support feature controls how the noise reduction is applied as a function of brightness through an inverted mask. Dark mask pixels protect high-signal image regions, and bright mask pixels allow more noise reduction in low-signal background areas. The mask is computed from the whole image, and modulates the amount of noise reduction for each pixel.Local support is a deep-sky feature: both mask modes are defined relative to a sky background, so the section is disabled when the Deep-Sky Image section is disabled.
文件: 局部支撑功能通过一个反相蒙版，控制降噪如何随亮度施加。蒙版中暗的像素保护高信号图像区域，蒙版中亮的像素允许在低信号背景区域施加更多降噪。蒙版由整幅图像计算，并对每个像素的降噪量进行调制。局部支撑是深空专用功能：两种蒙版模式都相对于天空背景定义，因此当“深空图像”区域被禁用时，此区域也会被禁用。

FILE: Noise reduction strength. The noise model is measured automatically from the image, including its variation with the signal level and its spatial correlation, so a given value produces a similar degree of noise reduction on different images. The scale is geometric: each 0.1 multiplies the strength by about 1.3, from one fourth of the default at 0 to four times the default at 1. Most images are best processed with values between 0.4 and 0.6; strongly correlated or heavily resampled data may need 0.7 or more. Images with fine texture everywhere, such as daylight landscapes, are usually best between 0.3 and 0.4.
文件: 降噪强度。噪声模型会从图像中自动测量，包括其随信号水平的变化及其空间相关性，因此给定数值在不同图像上会产生相近程度的降噪。该标度是几何式的：每 0.1 使强度乘以约 1.3，从 0 处的默认值的四分之一，到 1 处的默认值的四倍。多数图像用 0.4 至 0.6 之间的值处理效果最好；强相关或经过重度重采样的数据可能需要 0.7 或更高。处处都有细腻纹理的图像（例如日光风景）通常以 0.3 至 0.4 之间为佳。

FILE: Disable this section for images without stars: daylight photographs, lunar, planetary and solar images, scans, and any other general image. The process then works as a general-purpose noise reduction tool: the noise model is measured on the flattest parts of every brightness level, so fine texture does not inflate it; the noise reference is taken where the structure is, so a planetary disk on a dark background is processed in the units of its own noise; quantized data (8-bit JPEG) and images smoothed in the camera get a bounded noise model instead of a meaningless one. Local support is not applied: both of its mask modes are defined relative to a sky background, so the section is disabled; use a mask on the view for a local effect.
文件: 对于没有恒星的图像，请禁用此区域：日光照片、月球、行星与太阳图像、扫描件，以及任何其他通用图像。此时该进程可作为通用降噪工具使用：噪声模型在每个亮度等级最平坦的部分测量，因此细腻纹理会使其偏高；噪声参考取自结构所在处，因此暗背景上的行星盘会以其自身噪声的单位来处理；量化数据（8 位 JPEG）和在相机内被平滑的图像会得到有界的噪声模型，而不是无意义的模型。局部支撑不适用：它的两种蒙版模式都相对于天空背景定义，因此该区域被禁用；若要获得局部效果，请在视图上使用蒙版。

FILE: Remove the dark residual structures narrower than the PSF. In a deep-sky image no real structure can be narrower than the point spread function, so a dark pit one to three pixels across left by the noise reduction is noise. Each pixel more than 0.3 sigma of the noise below the trimmed mean of its neighborhood, sized from the measured PSF, is raised toward that mean: completely where the neighborhood is flat sky, by at most 0.5 sigma elsewhere, so the dark gaps between close stars keep their depth. Bright residuals are not touched, since at this amplitude they cannot be told from the faintest stars.This option assumes a deep-sky image: structure finer than the PSF is meaningful in planetary, lunar and daylight images, so it is not applied when the Deep-Sky Image section is disabled.
文件: 去除比 PSF 更窄的暗色残留结构。在深空图像中，任何真实结构都不会比点扩散函数更窄，因此降噪留下的一至三像素宽的暗坑属于噪声。若某像素比其邻域（尺寸取自实测 PSF）的修剪均值低 0.3 sigma 以上的噪声，则被朝该均值抬高：在邻域为平坦天空处完全抬高，在其他位置最多抬高 0.5 sigma，从而让靠近恒星之间的暗色缝隙保持原有深度。明亮残留不会被处理，因为在这个振幅上它们无法与最暗的恒星区分开。此选项假定是深空图像：在行星、月球和日光图像中，比 PSF 更细的结构是有意义的，因此当“深空图像”区域被禁用时不会应用此功能。

FILE: Brightness is the local support mask of MLDenoise, with the same parameters: the image is delinearized to a mean background level, clipped at a distance in robust sigma units from the median, rescaled, smoothed and inverted. It suits most images, where the structures to protect are many times brighter than the sky.Significance measures how far each pixel of the smoothed luminance stands above a large-scale background, in units of the noise, and protects structures between a threshold and a multiple of it on a logarithmic ramp. It is the mode for images whose structures are only a few percent above the sky, such as deep narrowband stacks: there the sky peak is so narrow that the brightness mask has no dynamic range left, and no clipping point separates the nebulae from the background.
文件: 亮度：MLDenoise 的局部支撑蒙版，参数相同：图像被去线性化到平均背景水平，按距中值的稳健 sigma 单位距离裁切，然后重标定、平滑并反相。它适用于多数图像，即需要保护的结构比天空亮许多倍的图像。显著性衡量平滑亮度的每个像素以噪声为单位高出大尺度背景多少，并在对数斜坡上保护介于某个阈值与其若干倍之间的结构。它适用于结构仅比天空亮百分之几的图像，例如窄带深空叠加：此类图像中天空峰太窄，亮度蒙版已无动态范围可言，也没有任何裁剪点能把星云与背景分开。

FILE: Number of scales of noise reduction. With one scale, the image is processed at full resolution only. Each additional scale adds a noise reduction pass on a version of the diffuse result reduced by a factor of 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 (scales 2 to 8), removing blotchy noise structures several pixels across that the full-resolution pass cannot separate from the signal. The corrections are propagated back to full resolution and, in deep-sky images, are not applied on stars.The second scale removes the fine mottle left by the full-resolution pass and is safe on any image. Deeper scales are recommended for images with large-scale noise, typical of one-shot color and DSLR data; on images without it they can smooth real structure of the same size. Each additional scale costs about a quarter of the previous one.
文件: 降噪的尺度数量。只有一个尺度时，图像仅在完整分辨率下处理。每增加一个尺度，就在漫射结果按 2、3、4、6、8、10、12 倍降采样（尺度 2 至 8）的版本上增加一遍降噪，去除完整分辨率那一遍无法与信号分离的、几像素大小的斑块状噪声结构。这些校正会被传播回完整分辨率；在深空图像中，它们不会施加在恒星上。第二个尺度会去除完整分辨率那一遍留下的细斑，对任何图像都是安全的。更深的尺度推荐用于存在大尺度噪声的图像（这类噪声在单次拍摄彩色和 DSLR 数据中很典型）；对于没有此类噪声的图像，它们可能把同样大小的真实结构一起平滑掉。每增加一个尺度，代价约为前一个的四分之一。

FILE: How the mask is built from the image.Brightness is the local support mask of MLDenoise, with the same parameters: the image is delinearized to a mean background level, clipped at a distance in robust sigma units from the median, rescaled, smoothed and inverted. It suits most images, where the structures to protect are many times brighter than the sky.Significance measures how far each pixel of the smoothed luminance stands above a large-scale background, in units of the noise, and protects structures between a threshold and a multiple of it on a logarithmic ramp. It is the mode for images whose structures are only a few percent above the sky, such as deep narrowband stacks: there the sky peak is so narrow that the brightness mask has no dynamic range left, and no clipping point separates the nebulae from the background.
文件: 蒙版如何由图像构建。亮度：MLDenoise 的局部支撑蒙版，参数相同：图像被去线性化到平均背景水平，按距中值的稳健 sigma 单位距离裁切，然后重标定、平滑并反相。它适用于多数图像，即需要保护的结构比天空亮许多倍的图像。显著性衡量平滑亮度的每个像素以噪声为单位高出大尺度背景多少，并在对数斜坡上保护介于某个阈值与其若干倍之间的结构。它适用于结构仅比天空亮百分之几的图像，例如窄带深空叠加：此类图像中天空峰太窄，亮度蒙版已无动态范围可言，也没有任何裁剪点能把星云与背景分开。

FILE: Cryptographic hashing algorithm for calculation of block checksums.This implementation supports the SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA3-256 and SHA3-512 algorithms. These algorithms compute checksums of 20, 32, 64, 32 and 64 bytes, respectively. SHA-1 is the recommended general-purpose algorithm, and the one supported by all XISF decoders that verify checksums.Checksums are verified when data blocks are accessed, providing data integrity protection.
文件: 用于计算块校验和的加密哈希算法。此实现支持 SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512、SHA3-256 和 SHA3-512 算法。这些算法分别计算 20、32、64、32 和 64 字节的校验和。SHA-1 是推荐的通用算法，也是所有验证校验和的 XISF 解码器所支持的算法。访问数据块时会验证校验和，从而提供数据完整性保护。

FILE: Size in bytes of the minimum space allocated to store a binary data block in an XISF file. All file blocks (including the XML file header) are stored using integer multiples of the block alignment size.If properly configured, block alignment can improve read performance at the expense of some wasted disk space. The default value is 4096 bytes. Set a block size of one byte to disable the XISF block alignment feature.Block alignment is automatically disabled for compressed files.
文件: XISF 文件中为存储一个二进制数据块所分配的最小空间的字节数。所有文件块（包括 XML 文件头）都以块对齐尺寸的整数倍存储。若配置得当，块对齐可以提升读取性能，代价是浪费一些磁盘空间。默认值为 4096 字节。将块尺寸设为一字节可禁用 XISF 块对齐功能。对于压缩文件，块对齐会自动禁用。

FILE: Fix data that do not conform to the XISF specification when reading and writing XISF files, such as the luminance coefficients of an RGB working space that do not agree with its chromaticity coordinates and the D50 reference white. Nonconforming values are replaced with conforming ones, or ignored when no conforming values exist.When this option is disabled, nonconforming data are read and written unchanged, and the generated XISF files may not conform to the XISF specification. This option is enabled by default.
文件: 在读写 XISF 文件时修正不符合 XISF 规范的数据，例如 RGB 工作空间的亮度系数与其色度坐标及 D50 参考白不一致的情况。不符合规范的值会被替换为符合规范的值；若不存在符合规范的值，则被忽略。禁用此选项时，不符合规范的数据会按原样读写，生成的 XISF 文件可能不符合 XISF 规范。此选项默认启用。

FILE: The byte shuffle algorithm reorganizes the data in a clever way that can greatly improve compression ratios, especially for data with high locality (or data containing similar values close together), such as most scientific and observational data. This option can be particularly efficient for compression of data structured as contiguous sequences of 16-bit, 32-bit and 64-bit numbers, such as most images processed with PixInsight. For 8-bit data, byte shuffling has obviously no effect on the compression ratio and hence is ignored.
文件: 字节混洗算法以一种巧妙的方式重新组织数据，可大幅提高压缩比，尤其适用于局部相关性强的数据（即相近数值彼此靠近的数据），例如大多数科学数据与观测数据。对于按 16 位、32 位和 64 位数值的连续序列组织的数据（例如大多数经 PixInsight 处理的图像），此选项尤为高效。对于 8 位数据，字节混洗显然对压缩比没有影响，因此会被忽略。

FILE: LZ4-HC is the high-compression variant of LZ4. It achieves somewhat smaller compression ratios than zlib, but is faster for compression and extremely fast for decompression.Zstandard (or "zstd") is a fast lossless compression algorithm targeting real-time compression at zlib-level and better compression ratios.You can use the compression level parameter to tune compression speed versus compression ratio, or leave the auto option checked to select the best tradeoff setting for each compression codec automatically. See also the byte shuffling option.
文件: LZ4-HC 是 LZ4 的高压缩变体。其压缩比略低于 zlib，但压缩更快，解压极快。Zstandard（或称“zstd”）是一种快速无损压缩算法，目标是在 zlib 级别的速度下实现实时压缩，并获得更好的压缩比。你可以使用压缩级别参数在压缩速度与压缩比之间权衡，或保持勾选自动选项，让每种压缩编解码器自动选取最佳折中设置。另请参见字节混洗选项。

FILE: Correct the gradients along the edges of the image at smaller scales.Gradients are often stronger along the edges of an image. Correcting them would require a smaller gradient scale, but the rest of the image is better corrected with a simpler model (a larger scale), which better preserves the integrity of the objects. With edge correction, gradient models are also computed at half, a quarter and an eighth of the gradient scale, as many as the aggressiveness level, never smaller than 128 pixels. Each model replaces the previous one on a frame along the edges of the image, as wide as its scale, with a smooth transition (a Gaussian function with a standard deviation of half the scale). If the image has no-data regions (pixels with zero values), such as a mosaic, the frames also follow the edges of the data.The scale factors are the same for all scales. At the 128-pixel scale, two additional iterations of the multiscale transform are applied, to prevent artifacts around high-contrast structures.
文件: 在较小尺度上校正图像边缘处的梯度。梯度在图像边缘处往往更强。要校正这些梯度需要更小的梯度尺度，但图像的其余部分用更简单的模型（更大的尺度）校正效果更好，能更好地保持目标的完整性。启用边缘校正后，梯度模型还会在梯度尺度的二分之一、四分之一和八分之一处计算，数量与激进程度等级相同，但不会小于 128 像素。每个模型都会在图像边缘处替换前一个模型，宽度与其尺度相当，并带有平滑过渡（高斯函数，标准差为尺度的一半）。如果图像存在无数据区域（值为零的像素），例如马赛克，则这些帧也会沿着数据的边缘进行。各尺度的缩放系数相同。在 128 像素尺度上，会额外应用两次多尺度变换迭代，以防止高对比度结构周围出现伪影。

FILE: The symbol will be declared as a global variable with the specified global operator and initial value.The 'op' global operator specification can be one of '+' and '*'. For example, 'n=global(+)' will declare a global additive variable n with a default zero initial value.Global variables can only play lvalue roles in expressions. In practice this means that they can only occur at the left hand of an assignment operator. For example, if a global variable n has been declared, then an expression such as 'x = $T + n' is illegal. Furthermore, global variables are always specialized for additive or multiplicative operations. For example, if n has been declared as additive with 'n=global(+)', then 'n *= $T' is illegal, but 'n -= $T < 0.01' is valid.If no explicit initial value is specified, additive global variables are initialized to zero and multiplicative global variables are initialized to one. The final values of all global variables are reported on the process console after PixelMath execution.
文件: 该符号将被声明为全局变量，并带有指定的全局运算符和初始值。全局运算符 `op` 的取值可以是 `+` 或 `*`。例如，`n=global(+)` 将声明一个全局加性变量 `n`，其默认初始值为零。全局变量在表达式中只能充当左值角色。实际上这意味着它们只能出现在赋值运算符的左侧。例如，如果已声明全局变量 `n`，那么像 `x = $T + n` 这样的表达式是非法的。此外，全局变量总是专门用于加性运算或乘性运算。例如，如果 `n` 已通过 `n=global(+)` 声明为加性变量，那么 `n *= $T` 是非法的，但 `n -= $T < 0.01` 是合法的。如果未指定明确的初始值，加性全局变量初始化为零，乘性全局变量初始化为一。所有全局变量的最终值会在 PixelMath 执行后报告到进程控制台。

FILE: A local variance map is a sensitive analysis tool to explore the distribution of pixel intensity variations at small scales. This allows for the implementation of subtle adaptive procedures with PixelMath. For example, the following expression: iif( lvar( $T, 7, krn_gauss() ) < t , medfilt( $T, 5, str_circular() ) , $T )applies a median filter selectively to pixels where the local variance is below a prescribed threshold t, which depends on the target image and must be found experimentally. For example, t=1e-8 can be a good starting value for a linear deep-sky image. The expression above implements a powerful noise reduction procedure. More sophisticated, adaptive noise filtering processes based on the same technique can be designed with iswitch() constructs.Local variance maps are always generated as 64-bit floating point images. This ensures that no truncation or roundoff errors will degrade their ability to represent subtle intensity variations, which is especially important for linear images.
文件: 局部方差映射是一种灵敏的分析工具，用于探究小尺度上像素强度变化的分布情况。借此可以在 PixelMath 中实现精细的自适应流程。例如，以下表达式：iif( lvar( $T, 7, krn_gauss() ) < t , medfilt( $T, 5, str_circular() ) , $T ) 只对局部方差低于给定阈值 t 的像素应用中值滤波，该阈值取决于目标图像，必须通过实验确定。例如，对于线性深空图像，t=1e-8 可以作为一个不错的起始值。上面的表达式实现了一种强大的降噪流程。基于相同技术、更复杂的自适应噪声滤波流程可以用 iswitch() 结构来设计。局部方差映射始终生成为 64 位浮点图像。这确保不会因截断或舍入误差削弱其表示细微强度变化的能力，这对线性图像尤为重要。

FILE: Select a pixel combination operation.Average combination provides the best signal-to-noise ratio in the integrated result.Median combination provides implicit robust rejection of outliers at the cost of a smaller SNR improvement (approximately a 20% less compared to average combination).Biweight location combination is a weighted Tukey's biweight location estimate of each pixel stack. It provides implicit robust rejection of outliers with practically the SNR improvement of average combination. Like the average, it applies the image weights, and can be used with or without pixel rejection. The deviation of each pixel is measured in units of the noise of its image. When the samples beyond the cutoffs carry a large fraction of the total weight of a pixel stack, the estimate blends progressively into the weighted average: such large groups of samples are signal, as in stars whose shapes vary between sessions, not outliers. The parameters of the biweight location are in the Pixel Rejection (3) section.
文件: 选择像素合并运算。平均值合并能在合并结果中提供最佳信噪比。中值合并以略小的信噪比提升（相比平均值合并约低 20%）为代价，隐含地对离群值进行稳健剔除。双权位置合并是对每个像素栈的加权图基（Tukey）双权位置估计。它隐含地对离群值进行稳健剔除，而信噪比提升实际上与平均值合并相当。与平均值一样，它会应用图像权重，并且可以配合或不配合像素剔除使用。每个像素的偏差以其所属图像的噪声为单位衡量。当超出截断值的样本在像素栈的总权重中占据很大比例时，该估计会逐步融入加权平均值：这样的大群样本属于信号，例如形状在不同拍摄时段之间发生变化的恒星，而不是离群值。双权位置的参数位于“像素剔除 (3)”部分。

FILE: Order statistic function:The kth order statistic of a set of two or more scalar arguments.The kth order statistic of the specified image.The order k is expected to be expressed in the [0,1] range, where 0 represents the first order statistic (or the minimum value of the sample) and 1 the last order statistic (or the maximum value of the sample). k=0.5 corresponds to the median value of the sample.In the second form, the optional x0, y0, w, and h parameters define a rectangular region of interest (ROI). These parameters are, respectively, the left coordinate, the top coordinate, the width and the height of the ROI, all of them expressed in integer pixel units. If a ROI is specified, the order statistic will be computed exclusively for pixel samples within the intersection between the ROI and the image bounds. If no ROI is specified, the order statistic will be computed for the entire image.Invariant subexpression: When the second argument is an image reference with optional scalar ROI coordinates (second form).
文件: 顺序统计量函数：一组两个或更多标量参数的第 k 顺序统计量。指定图像的第 k 顺序统计量。阶数 k 应当用 [0,1] 区间表示，其中 0 代表第一个顺序统计量（即样本的最小值），1 代表最后一个顺序统计量（即样本的最大值）。k=0.5 对应样本的中值。在第二种形式中，可选参数 x0、y0、w 和 h 定义矩形感兴趣区域（ROI）。这些参数分别是 ROI 的左坐标、上坐标、宽度和高度，全部以整数像素为单位表示。如果指定了 ROI，则只对 ROI 与图像边界交集范围内的像素样本计算顺序统计量。如果未指定 ROI，则对整个图像计算顺序统计量。不变子表达式：当第二个参数是图像引用并可带可选的标量 ROI 坐标时（第二种形式）。

FILE: Algorithm for compression of project data blocks.ZLib is a lossless compression algorithm capable of very high compression ratios but comparatively slow, especially for compression or large blocks.LZ4 is an extremely fast lossless compression algorithm, but usually achieves significantly smaller compression ratios than zlib.LZ4-HC is the high-compression variant of LZ4. It achieves somewhat smaller compression ratios than zlib, but is somewhat faster for compression and as fast as LZ4 for decompression.Zstandard (or "zstd") is a fast lossless compression algorithm targeting real-time compression at zlib-level and better compression ratios. This is the default option for newly created projects since PixInsight core version 1.8.9-2.See also the byte shuffling option.Note: If compression settings are changed when rewriting an existing project, this will implicitly disable the incremental project writing feature.** Warning: The default Zstandard compression is not compatible with PixInsight core versions older than 1.8.9-2.
文件: 用于压缩项目数据块的算法。ZLib 是一种无损压缩算法，压缩比很高，但相对较慢，尤其是压缩大块数据时。LZ4 是一种极快的无损压缩算法，但压缩比通常明显低于 zlib。LZ4-HC 是 LZ4 的高压缩变体。其压缩比比 zlib 略低，但压缩速度稍快，解压速度与 LZ4 相当。Zstandard（或 “zstd”）是一种快速无损压缩算法，目标是在 zlib 级别实现实时压缩并获得更好的压缩比。自 PixInsight 核心版本 1.8.9-2 起，这是新建项目的默认选项。另请参阅字节混洗选项。注意：如果在重写现有项目时更改压缩设置，将隐含地禁用增量项目写入功能。** 警告：默认的 Zstandard 压缩与 1.8.9-2 之前的 PixInsight 核心版本不兼容。

FILE: Global variable initialization.The symbol will be declared as a global variable with the specified global operator and initial value.The 'op' global operator specification can be one of '+' and '*'. For example, 'n=global(+)' will declare a global additive variable n with a default zero initial value.Global variables can only play lvalue roles in expressions. In practice this means that they can only occur at the left hand of an assignment operator. For example, if a global variable n has been declared, then an expression such as 'x = $T + n' is illegal. Furthermore, global variables are always specialized for additive or multiplicative operations. For example, if n has been declared as additive with 'n=global(+)', then 'n *= $T' is illegal, but 'n -= $T < 0.01' is valid.If no explicit initial value is specified, additive global variables are initialized to zero and multiplicative global variables are initialized to one. The final values of all global variables are reported on the process console after PixelMath execution.
文件: 全局变量初始化。该符号将被声明为全局变量，并带有指定的全局运算符和初始值。全局运算符 `op` 的取值可以是 `+` 或 `*`。例如，`n=global(+)` 将声明一个全局加性变量 `n`，其默认初始值为零。全局变量在表达式中只能充当左值角色。实际上这意味着它们只能出现在赋值运算符的左侧。例如，如果已声明全局变量 `n`，那么像 `x = $T + n` 这样的表达式是非法的。此外，全局变量总是专门用于加性运算或乘性运算。例如，如果 `n` 已通过 `n=global(+)` 声明为加性变量，那么 `n *= $T` 是非法的，但 `n -= $T < 0.01` 是合法的。如果未指定明确的初始值，加性全局变量初始化为零，乘性全局变量初始化为一。所有全局变量的最终值会在 PixelMath 执行后报告到进程控制台。

FILE: ProcessContainer is an ordered list of processes that can be freely edited and reused in multiple processing projects.When you execute a ProcessContainer instance, the individual processes that it contains are executed sequentially. To execute a ProcessContainer instance on a view, all of its pertaining processes must be able to be executed on that view. Similarly, to execute a ProcessContainer instance globally, all of its processes must validate execution in the global context.You can instantiate ProcessContainer, either directly from the Process Explorer window, or from the History Explorer window, which creates a new ProcessContainer instance as a copy of a View's existing processing history.On the Process Container interface, you can edit a ProcessContainer instance by adding, deleting, replacing, moving and enabling or disabling its individual processes. Since ProcessContainer is itself a process class, you can recursively add ProcessContainer instances to existing ProcessContainer instances, forming a tree-like structure.
文件: ProcessContainer 是一个有序的进程列表，可以自由编辑，并在多个处理项目中重复使用。执行 ProcessContainer 实例时，其中包含的各个进程会按顺序依次执行。要在某个视图上执行 ProcessContainer 实例，其所有相关进程都必须能够在该视图上执行。同样，要在全局执行 ProcessContainer 实例，其所有进程都必须在全局上下文中通过执行校验。可以直接从进程资源管理器窗口实例化 ProcessContainer，也可以从历史记录资源管理器窗口实例化，后者会以某个视图现有处理历史记录的副本形式创建一个新的 ProcessContainer 实例。在进程容器界面上，可以通过添加、删除、替换、移动以及启用或禁用各个进程来编辑 ProcessContainer 实例。由于 ProcessContainer 本身就是一个进程类，因此可以将 ProcessContainer 实例递归添加到已有的 ProcessContainer 实例中，形成树状结构。

FILE: Subframe approval expression, a boolean combination of constraints. A blank expression will approve all subframes. This is technically JavaScript, and although some characters are limited to prevent misuse, many things are possible such as Math.abs(FWHMSigma) or using // to comment the end of the line, etc. Please see the documentation for more information.A property can be one of:Altitude | Azimuth | Eccentricity | EccentricityMeanDev | FWHM | FWHMMeanDev | Index | MStar | Median | MedianMeanDev | NStar | Noise | NoiseRatio | PSFCount | PSFFlux | PSFFluxPower | PSFSignalWeight = PSFSignal | PSFSNR | PSFScale | PSFScaleSNR | PSFTotalMeanFlux | PSFTotalMeanPowerFlux | SNR = SNRWeight | StarResidual | StarResidualMeanDev | Stars | WeightEach property (excluding Index) also has a Median, Min, and Max version, e.g. FWHMMin, which are computed across all subframes.Each property (excluding Index) also has a Sigma version, e.g. PSFSignalSigma, where the value is represented in sigma units of the mean absolute deviation from the median.
文件: 子帧批准表达式，由约束条件构成的布尔组合。表达式为空时将批准所有子帧。这在技术上是 JavaScript，虽然部分字符受到限制以防误用，但仍可实现许多操作，例如 Math.abs(FWHMSigma)，或使用 // 注释掉行尾内容等。更多信息请参阅文档。属性可以是以下之一：Altitude | Azimuth | Eccentricity | EccentricityMeanDev | FWHM | FWHMMeanDev | Index | MStar | Median | MedianMeanDev | NStar | Noise | NoiseRatio | PSFCount | PSFFlux | PSFFluxPower | PSFSignalWeight = PSFSignal | PSFSNR | PSFScale | PSFScaleSNR | PSFTotalMeanFlux | PSFTotalMeanPowerFlux | SNR = SNRWeight | StarResidual | StarResidualMeanDev | Stars | Weight。除 Index 外，每个属性还都有 Median、Min 和 Max 版本，例如 FWHMMin，它们是在所有子帧上计算得到的。除 Index 外，每个属性还都有 Sigma 版本，例如 PSFSignalSigma，其值以平均绝对偏差相对中值的 sigma 单位表示。

FILE: Method used to identify abnormally high image weights.Per image tests each image weight individually. A weight is abnormal when it is greater than the upper quartile of the weights of the data set divided by the protection threshold parameter. With the default threshold of 0.1, weights greater than ten times the upper quartile are abnormal. This method can identify abnormal weights in up to one fourth of the data set, and never modifies normal weights. It also tolerates data sets where most images have much lower weights than the best ones, for example images acquired through clouds. This is the default method.Quantile limit is triggered when the median normalized weight is smaller than the protection threshold parameter. Then all weights greater than the quantile defined by the protection limit parameter are abnormal. This method always modifies a fixed fraction of the highest weights (5% by default), and cannot protect the integration when abnormal weights are more frequent. It is available for compatibility with previous versions.
文件: 用于识别异常高图像权重的方法。逐图像分别检验每个图像权重。当某个权重大于数据集权重的上四分位数除以保护阈值参数时，该权重即视为异常。在默认阈值 0.1 下，大于上四分位数十倍的权重属于异常。此方法最多可识别数据集中四分之一范围内的异常权重，且绝不会修改正常权重。它还能容忍大多数图像权重远低于最佳图像的数据集，例如透过云层拍摄的图像。这是默认方法。当中值归一化权重小于保护阈值参数时，会触发分位数限制。此时，所有大于保护限制参数所定义分位数的权重都属于异常。此方法总是修改固定比例的最高权重（默认 5%），当异常权重出现得更频繁时无法保护合并结果。提供此方法是为了兼容旧版本。

FILE: The maximum number of control points allowed for the generation of surface splines using DDM-RBF algorithms.When a DDM-RBF is selected, this parameter allows to specify the maximum number of control points (or reference stars) that will be used (after surface simplification) to generate the 2-D interpolating/approximating surface splines that will be used to model coordinate transformations for image registration. For DDM-RBF types, this parameter can be specified in the range from 1000 to 25000 control points. The default value is 4000 points, usually sufficient for most practical applications. Increase this parameter to achieve more accuracy at the expense of more computational work. DDM-RBF surface spline generation has O(n^2) time complexity.For standard RBF types, which require O(n^3) time for spline construction, this parameter is ignored and a maximum of 2100 control points is always imposed.This parameter is not used with the recursive surface splines registration model, which uses all star pair matches after outlier rejection.
文件: 使用 DDM-RBF 算法生成曲面样条时允许的最大控制点数量。选择 DDM-RBF 时，此参数可指定在曲面简化之后用于生成二维插值/逼近曲面样条的最大控制点（或参考星）数量，这些样条将用于建模图像配准的坐标变换。对于 DDM-RBF 类型，此参数可在 1000 到 25000 个控制点的范围内指定。默认值为 4000 个点，通常足以满足大多数实际应用。增大此参数可获得更高精度，代价是更多计算量。DDM-RBF 曲面样条生成的时间复杂度为 O(n^2)。对于标准 RBF 类型，样条构建需要 O(n^3) 时间，此参数会被忽略，并且始终强制最多使用 2100 个控制点。此参数不用于递归曲面样条配准模型，该模型在剔除离群值后使用所有星对匹配。

FILE: Subframe weighting expression, an arithmetic combination of properties. A blank expression will assign a zero weight to all subframes. This is technically JavaScript, and although some characters are limited to prevent misuse, many things are possible such as Math.abs(FWHMSigma) or using // to comment the end of the line, etc. Please see the documentation for more information.A property can be one of:Altitude | Azimuth | Eccentricity | EccentricityMeanDev | FWHM | FWHMMeanDev | Index | MStar | Median | MedianMeanDev | NStar | Noise | NoiseRatio | PSFCount | PSFFlux | PSFFluxPower | PSFSignalWeight = PSFSignal | PSFSNR | PSFScale | PSFScaleSNR | PSFTotalMeanFlux | PSFTotalMeanPowerFlux | SNR = SNRWeight | StarResidual | StarResidualMeanDev | StarsEach property (excluding Index) also has a Median, Min, and Max version, e.g. FWHMMin, which are computed across all subframes.Each property (excluding Index) also has a Sigma version, e.g. PSFSignalSigma, where the value is represented in sigma units of the mean absolute deviation from the median.
文件: 子帧加权表达式，由属性构成的算术组合。表达式为空时将为所有子帧赋予零权重。这在技术上是 JavaScript，虽然部分字符受到限制以防误用，但仍可实现许多操作，例如 Math.abs(FWHMSigma)，或使用 // 注释掉行尾内容等。更多信息请参阅文档。属性可以是以下之一：Altitude | Azimuth | Eccentricity | EccentricityMeanDev | FWHM | FWHMMeanDev | Index | MStar | Median | MedianMeanDev | NStar | Noise | NoiseRatio | PSFCount | PSFFlux | PSFFluxPower | PSFSignalWeight = PSFSignal | PSFSNR | PSFScale | PSFScaleSNR | PSFTotalMeanFlux | PSFTotalMeanPowerFlux | SNR = SNRWeight | StarResidual | StarResidualMeanDev | Stars。除 Index 外，每个属性还都有 Median、Min 和 Max 版本，例如 FWHMMin，它们是在所有子帧上计算得到的。除 Index 外，每个属性还都有 Sigma 版本，例如 PSFSignalSigma，其值以平均绝对偏差相对中值的 sigma 单位表示。

FILE: Use multiscale median transforms (MMT) instead of a trous wavelet transforms (AWT) to compute the HDR multiscale transform.The MMT has several advantages over the wavelet transform. One of them is the practical absence of ringing artifacts around jump discontinuities, such as stars and other bright features. One drawback is that the MMT is computationally much more expensive than the AWT. On the other hand, MMT-based HDR transforms are more sensitive to local features, and hence more difficult to be evaluated on partial previews.The median-based HDR multiscale transform is not 'better' than the wavelet-based transform; it is just a different solution to the dynamic range compression problem, with quite different results and its own idiosyncrasies. The fact that they generate much less (if any) ringing artifacts make median transforms particularly interesting, especially to compress very large dynamic ranges. However, the implemented deringing routines are usually able to solve this problem quite efficiently for wavelet-based HDR transforms.
文件: 使用多尺度中值变换（MMT）而非 à trous 小波变换（AWT）来计算 HDR 多尺度变换。相比小波变换，MMT 有几项优势。其中之一是在跳变不连续处（如恒星和其他明亮特征）实际上不会出现振铃伪影。缺点是 MMT 的计算开销远高于 AWT。另一方面，基于 MMT 的 HDR 变换对局部特征更敏感，因而不易在局部预览上评估。基于中值的 HDR 多尺度变换并不比基于小波的变换“更好”；它只是动态范围压缩问题的另一种解法，结果差异很大，也有其自身特点。它们产生的振铃伪影要少得多（甚至没有），这使中值变换特别有吸引力，尤其适合压缩极大的动态范围。不过，对于基于小波的 HDR 变换，已实现的去环例程通常能相当高效地解决这一问题。

FILE: Copy an existing astrometric solution and its associated metadata in the reference image to all registered images. PixInsight's native astrometric solutions consist of standardized XISF properties defining the parameters and data structures required to represent both linear and nonlinear solutions with arbitrary distortion corrections based on surface splines.This option only works in the Register/Match Images working mode if the reference image is either a disk file or a main view (not a preview). For target image windows, astrometric solutions are regenerated after propagating astrometric metadata.* Important: Inherited solutions can be less accurate than solutions computed directly on the registered images. The differences can be significant for solutions with distortion corrections if the applied image registration task does not model existing distortions accurately. For maximum accuracy (including mosaic generation), we recommend recomputing astrometric solutions on the registered images, using the inherited solution as a starting point.
文件: 将参考图像中已有的天体测量解决方案及其关联元数据复制到所有已配准图像。PixInsight 原生天体测量解决方案由标准化的 XISF 属性构成，这些属性定义了表示线性与非线性解决方案所需的参数和数据结构，并包含基于曲面样条的任意畸变校正。此选项仅在“配准/匹配图像”工作模式下、且参考图像为磁盘文件或主视图（非预览）时有效。对于目标图像窗口，会在传播天体测量元数据后重新生成天体测量解决方案。* 重要：继承而来的解决方案可能不如直接在已配准图像上计算的解决方案精确。如果所执行的图像配准任务未能准确建模现有畸变，那么对于带畸变校正的解决方案，差异可能很显著。为获得最高精度（包括马赛克生成），建议在已配准图像上重新计算天体测量解决方案，并将继承的解决方案用作起点。

FILE: The built-in local support feature provides full control over how the noise reduction process is applied as a function of brightness through an inverted mask. Dark mask pixels protect high-signal image regions, and bright mask pixels allow more noise reduction in low-signal background areas.Our noise reduction neural networks have been trained on immense datasets covering a wide variety of noise and structure distributions and morphologies in deep-sky astronomical images. This extensive training enables the system to differentiate noise from significant structures in virtually any image where this process can be applied, making local supports and masks unnecessary in most cases. However, noise reduction can be a highly delicate and subjective task that requires high versatility. This local support feature lets you control the amount of applied noise reduction differently for each pixel in the target image as a function of illumination. This helps adapt the process to the user's preferences and taste in such a critical task as noise reduction.
文件: 内置局部支撑功能通过反相蒙版，让您完全控制降噪流程随亮度变化的施加方式。暗的蒙版像素保护高信号图像区域，亮的蒙版像素允许在低信号背景区域施加更强的降噪。我们的降噪神经网络已在海量数据集上训练，这些数据集涵盖了深空天文图像中种类繁多的噪声与结构分布及形态。如此广泛的训练使系统能够在几乎所有可应用此流程的图像中区分噪声与重要结构，因此在大多数情况下无需局部支撑和蒙版。不过，降噪可能是一项极为精细且主观的任务，需要高度的灵活性。此局部支撑功能让您可以依据照明情况，对目标图像中每个像素施加不同强度的降噪。这有助于在降噪这样关键的任务中，使流程适应用户的偏好和口味。

FILE: Currently this option is only available on macOS. On Linux/FreeBSD and Windows, all screen output is always performed at the physical display resolution, so the state of this option is immaterial. On high-dpi Retina display modes, physical screen pixels are used for images represented at reduced zoom ratios 1:2 and lower. When this option is enabled in these modes, an image is represented at its full size on physical pixels when the zoom ratio is 1:2. This is because the ratio of physical to logical pixels is always 2 in Retina high-dpi modes.Enabling this option on macOS with capable hardware may slow down screen image renditions, since the volume of the generated pixel data is four times the volume required when working with logical pixels. Furthermore, when this option is enabled, certain optimizations that can yield faster screen renditions have to be disabled. If you experience slow screen performance working with big images, especially on slow machines, you can turn off this option to improve speed at the expense of representation quality.
文件: 目前此选项仅在 macOS 上可用。在 Linux/FreeBSD 和 Windows 上，所有屏幕输出始终以物理显示分辨率执行，因此此选项的状态无关紧要。在高 dpi Retina 显示模式下，对于以 1:2 及更低缩小比例表示的图像，使用物理屏幕像素。在这些模式下启用此选项后，当缩放比例为 1:2 时，图像将按完整尺寸以物理像素表示。这是因为在 Retina 高 dpi 模式下，物理像素与逻辑像素之比始终为 2。在 macOS 上于支持的硬件启用此选项可能会拖慢屏幕图像渲染，因为生成的像素数据量是使用逻辑像素时的四倍。此外，启用此选项后，某些本可加快屏幕渲染的优化必须被禁用。如果在处理大图像时遇到屏幕性能缓慢，尤其是在较慢的机器上，可以关闭此选项以提升速度，代价是表示质量下降。

文件: 合并 XML 滤镜数据库。从指定的输入文件（XSPD 格式）加载新的滤镜定义，并与现有定义合并。新滤镜将被添加，已存在的滤镜将用导入的数据更新。导入 CSV 滤镜定义。扫描指定的输入目录，查找 CSV 格式（扩展名为 .csv）的有效滤镜定义，并用其替换当前滤镜集。合并 CSV 滤镜定义。扫描指定的输入目录，查找 CSV 格式的有效滤镜定义，并与现有定义合并。新滤镜将被添加，已存在的滤镜将用导入的数据更新。导出 XML 滤镜数据库。将当前滤镜定义以 XSPD 格式写入指定的输出文件。导出 CSV 滤镜定义。将当前滤镜定义作为单独的 CSV 文件（扩展名为 .csv）写入指定的输出目录。与默认滤镜合并。将当前滤镜定义与出厂默认滤镜集合并。设置默认滤镜。将当前滤镜定义重置为出厂默认滤镜集。

FILE: Mount controller telescope. Use the device currently selected in the Indigo Mount Controller interface.Mount controller or active telescope. Use the Indigo Mount Controller device if available, or the ACTIVE_DEVICES/ACTIVE_TELESCOPE device otherwise. This is the default option.When a telescope device is available, it is used to retrieve its current EOD (epoch of date) coordinates, just before starting each light frame exposure. These are apparent coordinates, which are reduced to mean positions referred to the mean equinox and equator of J2000.0 (ICRS) by an accurate inverse transformation, including corrections for precession, nutation and stellar aberration. The computed coordinates are directly comparable to standard catalog positions, irrespective of the date of acquisition. Once these coordinates are computed for each acquired image, they are stored as standard XISF properties (Observation:Center:RA and Observation:Center:Dec). For compatibility with legacy applications, the same coordinates replace the OBJCTRA and OBJCTDEC FITS keywords provided by the Indigo server.
文件: 赤道仪控制器望远镜。使用 Indigo 赤道仪控制器界面中当前选定的设备。赤道仪控制器或活动望远镜。若可用则使用 Indigo 赤道仪控制器设备，否则使用 ACTIVE_DEVICES/ACTIVE_TELESCOPE 设备。这是默认选项。当有可用的望远镜设备时，会在每次开始曝光光帧之前用它获取当前的 EOD（当日历元）坐标。这些是视坐标，通过精确的逆变换（包含岁差、章动和恒星像差校正）归算为参考 J2000.0（ICRS）平春分点和平赤道的平位置。无论拍摄日期为何，计算出的坐标都可直接与标准星表位置比较。为每幅采集图像计算出这些坐标后，会将其存储为标准 XISF 属性（Observation:Center:RA 和 Observation:Center:Dec）。为兼容旧式应用，相同坐标会替换 Indigo 服务器提供的 OBJCTRA 和 OBJCTDEC FITS 关键字。

FILE: Enable the features that assume a deep-sky image: stars on a sky background, and no real structure narrower than the point spread function. They are the explicit point-source model, the exclusion of stars from the multiscale corrections, the sub-PSF pit fill and the repair of dead-pixel clusters; the noise model also takes the sky as its reference.Disable this section for images without stars: daylight photographs, lunar, planetary and solar images, scans, and any other general image. The process then works as a general-purpose noise reduction tool: the noise model is measured on the flattest parts of every brightness level, so fine texture does not inflate it; the noise reference is taken where the structure is, so a planetary disk on a dark background is processed in the units of its own noise; quantized data (8-bit JPEG) and images smoothed in the camera get a bounded noise model instead of a meaningless one. Local support is not applied: both of its mask modes are defined relative to a sky background, so the section is disabled; use a mask on the view for a local effect.
文件: 启用那些假定图像为深空图像的特征：恒星位于天空背景上，且不存在比点扩散函数更窄的真实结构。这些特征包括显式点源模型、在多尺度校正中排除恒星、亚 PSF 凹坑填充以及坏像素簇修复；噪声模型也以天空为参考。对于没有恒星的图像，请禁用此部分：日光照片、月球、行星和太阳图像、扫描件以及任何其他通用图像。此时流程作为通用降噪工具运行：噪声模型在每个亮度级别最平坦的部分测量，因此细微纹理不会使其膨胀；噪声参考取自存在结构的位置，因此暗背景上的行星圆盘会以其自身噪声的单位进行处理；量化数据（8 位 JPEG）和在相机中已被平滑的图像会得到有界噪声模型，而不是毫无意义的模型。局部支撑不会被应用：其两种蒙版模式都相对于天空背景定义，因此此部分被禁用；如需局部效果，请在视图上使用蒙版。

FILE: The absolute colorimetric intent also replaces out-of-gamut colors by their nearest matches in the output color space, but it doesn't try to match the white points. If the white points in the image and target color spaces don't match, you'll get a color cast in the highlights. However, since this intent doesn't alter any in-gamut colors, it is the best option in terms of numeric color accuracy.The perceptual intent maps all colors in the image space to the target space. With the perceptual intent, no out-of-gamut color is clipped, as happens with the colorimetric intents, but all colors can be altered, and the changes can be significant if the image space is much wider than the output space. In general, relative colorimetric is preferred, but perceptual can yield more vibrant results that may be desirable in some cases.Finally, the saturation intent tries to maximize color saturation in the output, at the cost of sacrifying color accuracy, when necessary. This intent can be a good option for synthetic graphics and illustrations, but not for reproduction of photographic images.
文件: 绝对色度意图同样会用输出色彩空间中最接近的颜色替换色域外颜色，但它不会尝试匹配白点。如果图像与目标色彩空间的白点不匹配，高光部分会出现偏色。不过，由于此意图不改变任何色域内颜色，就数值色彩精度而言，它是最佳选项。感知意图会将图像空间中的所有颜色映射到目标空间。使用感知意图时，不会像色度意图那样裁剪任何色域外颜色，但所有颜色都可能被改变；如果图像空间比输出空间宽得多，这些改变可能相当显著。一般来说首选相对色度意图，但感知意图可以产生更鲜艳的结果，在某些情况下可能正是所需的。最后，饱和度意图会尝试在输出中最大化色彩饱和度，必要时以牺牲色彩精度为代价。此意图对于合成图形和插画可能是很好的选项，但不适合照片类图像的复制。

FILE: A file name template can be any valid text suitable to specify file names on the target filesystem, and may include one or more template specifiers. Template specifiers are replaced automatically with selected tokens when new frames are acquired. Supported template specifiers are the following:<table border="1" cellspacing="1" cellpadding="4">Template specifierWill be replaced by%fFrame type (light, flat, dark, bias).%bCCD binning with the format HxV, where H and V are, respectively, the horizontal and vertical binning factors.%eExposure time in seconds.%FFilter name%TCCD temperature in degrees Celsius.%tAcquisition date and time in the UTC time scale, ISO 8601 format.%dAcquisition date in the UTC time scale, yyyy-mm-dd format.%nThe frame number starting from one, with three digits and left-padded with zeros.%uA universally unique identifier (UUID) in canonical form (36 characters).For example, the default template %f_B%b_E%e_%n would produce the following file name:LIGHT_B2x2_E300.00_002.fitsfor the second light frame of a series with exposure time of 300 seconds at binning 2x2.
文件: 文件名模板可以是任何适合在目标文件系统上指定文件名的有效文本，并且可以包含一个或多个模板说明符。采集到新帧时，模板说明符会自动替换为选定的标记。支持的模板说明符如下：<table border="1" cellspacing="1" cellpadding="4">模板说明符将被替换为%f帧类型（light、flat、dark、bias）。%bCCD 合并，格式为 HxV，其中 H 和 V 分别是水平和垂直合并系数。%e曝光时间，以秒为单位。%F滤镜名称%TCCD 温度，以摄氏度为单位。%t采集日期和时间，采用 UTC 时标，ISO 8601 格式。%d采集日期，采用 UTC 时标，yyyy-mm-dd 格式。%n帧编号，从 1 开始，三位数字，左侧补零。%u规范形式的通用唯一标识符（UUID，36 个字符）。例如，对于一系列以 2x2 合并、曝光时间 300 秒拍摄的图像中的第二张光帧，默认模板 %f_B%b_E%e_%n 会生成以下文件名：LIGHT_B2x2_E300.00_002.fits

FILE: See the family of krn_xxx() symbolic functions for the set of available local variance kernels.A local variance map is a sensitive analysis tool to explore the distribution of pixel intensity variations at small scales. This allows for the implementation of subtle adaptive procedures with PixelMath. For example, the following expression: iif( lvar( $T, 7, krn_gauss() ) < t , medfilt( $T, 5, str_circular() ) , $T )applies a median filter selectively to pixels where the local variance is below a prescribed threshold t, which depends on the target image and must be found experimentally. For example, t=1e-8 can be a good starting value for a linear deep-sky image. The expression above implements a powerful noise reduction procedure. More sophisticated, adaptive noise filtering processes based on the same technique can be designed with iswitch() constructs.Local variance maps are always generated as 64-bit floating point images. This ensures that no truncation or roundoff errors will degrade their ability to represent subtle intensity variations, which is especially important for linear images.
文件: 关于可用的局部方差核集合，请参阅 krn_xxx() 符号函数族。局部方差映射是一种灵敏的分析工具，用于探究小尺度上像素强度变化的分布情况。借此可以在 PixelMath 中实现精细的自适应流程。例如，以下表达式：iif( lvar( $T, 7, krn_gauss() ) < t , medfilt( $T, 5, str_circular() ) , $T ) 只对局部方差低于给定阈值 t 的像素应用中值滤波，该阈值取决于目标图像，必须通过实验确定。例如，对于线性深空图像，t=1e-8 可以作为一个不错的起始值。上面的表达式实现了一种强大的降噪流程。基于相同技术、更复杂的自适应噪声滤波流程可以用 iswitch() 结构来设计。局部方差映射始终生成为 64 位浮点图像。这确保不会因截断或舍入误差削弱其表示细微强度变化的能力，这对线性图像尤为重要。

FILE: The absolute colorimetric intent also replaces out-of-gamut colors by their nearest matches in the output color space, but it doesn't try to match the white points. If the white points in the image and printer/paper spaces don't match, you'll get a color cast in the highlights. However, since this intent doesn't alter any in-gamut colors, it is the best option in terms of numeric color accuracy.The perceptual intent maps all colors in the image space to the printer/paper space. With the perceptual intent, no out-of-gamut color is clipped, as happens with the colorimetric intents, but all colors can be altered, and the changes can be significant if the image space is much wider than the output space. In general, relative colorimetric is preferred, but perceptual can yield more vibrant results that may be desirable in some cases.Finally, the saturation intent tries to maximize color saturation in the printed result, at the cost of sacrifying color accuracy, if necessary. This intent can be a good option for synthetic graphics and illustrations, but not for reproduction of photographic images.
文件: 绝对色度意图同样会用输出色彩空间中最接近的颜色替换色域外颜色，但它不会尝试匹配白点。如果图像与打印机/纸张色彩空间的白点不匹配，高光部分会出现偏色。不过，由于此意图不改变任何色域内颜色，就数值色彩精度而言，它是最佳选项。感知意图会将图像空间中的所有颜色映射到打印机/纸张空间。使用感知意图时，不会像色度意图那样裁剪任何色域外颜色，但所有颜色都可能被改变；如果图像空间比输出空间宽得多，这些改变可能相当显著。一般来说首选相对色度意图，但感知意图可以产生更鲜艳的结果，在某些情况下可能正是所需的。最后，饱和度意图会尝试在打印结果中最大化色彩饱和度，必要时以牺牲色彩精度为代价。此意图对于合成图形和插画可能是很好的选项，但不适合照片类图像的复制。

FILE: When this option is selected and is applicable, StarAlignment uses a special FFT-based algorithm to precompute the intersection region between the reference and target images.Once the intersection has been found, the star matching process is restricted to the intersection area. This greatly improves the performance of the RANSAC algorithm by reducing the fraction of outliers (false putative matches) in the initial set of star pair matches. Note that this works in the same way, and has the same features and advantages, as the restrict to previews option (see below). However, intersections are computed in a completely automatic and accurate way, without user intervention.The disabled option will disable intersection computation. Mosaic modes only will perform computation of intersection regions only when a mosaic construction mode has been selected (union/mosaic or separate mosaic), and always will force intersection computations in all working modes. Normally, this option is only necessary to build mosaics, because in these tasks the overlapped regions between mosaic frames are usually small.
文件: 选中此选项且条件适用时，StarAlignment 会使用一种基于 FFT 的特殊算法预先计算参考图像与目标图像之间的交集区域。找到交集后，星点匹配过程被限制在交集区域内。这通过降低初始星对匹配集合中离群值（错误的拟匹配）的比例，显著提升 RANSAC 算法的性能。请注意，它的工作方式以及所具有的特性和优势与“限制到预览”选项相同（见下文）。不过，交集是以完全自动且精确的方式计算的，无需用户干预。“禁用”将关闭交集计算。“仅马赛克”只在选择了马赛克构建模式（合并/马赛克或分离马赛克）时计算交集区域，并且始终会在所有工作模式下强制进行交集计算。通常只有在构建马赛克时才需要此选项，因为在这类任务中，马赛克帧之间的重叠区域往往很小。

FILE: Internally, the peak response property of the star detection algorithm is expressed in kurtosis units. For each detected structure, kurtosis is evaluated from all significant pixels with values greater than the estimated mean local background. Peak response is the minimum value of kurtosis necessary to trigger star detection.To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum peak response, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.If you decrease this parameter, stars will need to have stronger (or more prominent) peaks to be detected. This is useful to prevent detection of saturated stars, as well as small nonstellar features. By increasing this parameter, the star detection algorithm will be more sensitive to peakedness, and hence more tolerant with relatively flat image features. The default value is 0.5. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.
文件: 在内部，星点检测算法的峰值响应属性以峰度为单位表示。对于每个检测到的结构，峰度由所有取值大于估算局部背景均值的显著像素评估得出。峰值响应是触发星点检测所需的最小峰度值。为使此界面与内部实现解耦，该参数被归一化到 [0,1] 区间，其中 0 和 1 分别代表最小和最大峰值响应。这种抽象让我们可以在不破坏依赖它的工具和流程的前提下更换星点检测引擎。如果降低此参数，恒星需要具有更强（或更突出）的峰才能被检测到。这有助于防止检测到饱和恒星以及微小的非恒星特征。提高此参数后，星点检测算法对峰态更敏感，因而对相对平坦的图像特征更宽容。默认值为 0.5。通常情况下，在正常工作条件下无需更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: Some data sets require the addition of small positive values (typically about 100 DN) to calibrated light frames in order to prevent truncation of negative pixel sample values after calibration. These small pedestals can be subtracted from source integration pixels to refer all input data to the same zero point consistently.In general, this option should only be enabled for integration of calibrated light frames with PEDESTAL keywords when a global normalization method (such as additive with scaling) is used for pixel rejection and/or integration output.This option should always be disabled if local normalization is used, since subtracting pedestals invalidates local normalization functions. Local normalization already compensates for differing additive components among integrated frames.This option should also be disabled for integration of raw bias and dark frames, since in these cases existing PEDESTAL keywords should be preserved in the generated master bias and dark frames. These pedestals will be subtracted automatically by the ImageCalibration process for calibration of flat and light frames.
文件: 某些数据集需要在已校准的光帧上加入小的正值（通常约 100 DN），以防止校准后负像素样本值被截断。可以从源合并像素中减去这些小基座，从而将所有输入数据一致地归算到同一零点。一般来说，只有当使用全局归一化方法（例如带缩放的加性归一化）进行像素剔除和/或合并输出时，才应针对带 PEDESTAL 关键字的已校准光帧合并启用此选项。如果使用局部归一化，则始终应禁用此选项，因为减去基座会使局部归一化函数失效。局部归一化本身已经补偿了各合并帧之间不同的加性分量。叠加原始偏置帧和暗场帧时也应禁用此选项，因为在这些情况下，现有的 PEDESTAL 关键字应保留在生成的主 偏置帧和主 暗场帧中。这些基座将在校准平场帧和光帧时由 ImageCalibration 流程自动减去。

FILE: The Isotropic Undecimated Wavelet Transform, also known as starlet transform and à trous (with holes) wavelet transform, is a computationally efficient, versatile wavelet transform widely used in astronomy. It uses a positive low-pass filter as a wavelet scaling function, applied by interlaced convolutions following a dyadic sequence.The multiscale linear transform is similar to the starlet transform, but uses multiple Gaussian filters of varying sizes applied by separable convolutions, instead of a single interlaced scaling function. It is less flexible than the starlet transform (mainly because it does not allow selecting a specific scaling function) and computationally more expensive, but has two advantages: it allows for arbitrary scaling sequences (while the starlet transform is strictly defined only for the dyadic sequence), and is more controllable at large dimensional scales (because the scaling filters are computed separately for each layer).Both transforms are particularly well adapted to the detection of smooth isotropic structures, which justifies their success in astronomical image processing.
文件: 各向同性非抽取小波变换，也称为 starlet 变换和 à trous（带孔）小波变换，是一种计算高效、用途广泛的小波变换，在天文学中被广泛使用。它使用正的低通滤波器作为小波尺度函数，按二进序列通过交错卷积施加。多尺度线性变换与 starlet 变换类似，但使用多个不同尺寸的高斯滤波器通过可分离卷积施加，而不是单一的交替尺度函数。它不如 starlet 变换灵活（主要因为它不允许选择特定的尺度函数），计算开销也更高，但有两个优点：它允许任意的尺度序列（而 starlet 变换严格来说只针对二进序列定义），并且在大尺寸尺度上更可控（因为缩放滤波器是为每一层单独计算的）。这两种变换都特别适合检测平滑的各向同性结构，这也解释了它们在天文图像处理中为何广受欢迎。

FILE: This is the size of the working integration stack structure. In general, the larger this parameter, the better the performance, especially on multiprocessor/multicore systems.The best performance is achieved when the whole set of integrated pixels can be loaded at once in the integration stack. For this to happen, the following conditions must be true:Buffer size must be large enough as to allow loading an input file in 32-bit floating point format completely with a single file read operation.Stack size must be larger than or equal to W*H*(12*N + 4), where W and H are the image width and height in pixels, respectively, and N is the number of integrated images. For linear fit clipping rejection, replace 4 with 8 in the above equation.Note that this may require a large amount of RAM available for relatively large image sets. As an example, the default stack size of 1024 (1 GiB) is sufficient to integrate 20 2048x2048 monochrome images optimally with the default buffer size of 16 MiB. With a stack size of 4 GiB and a buffer size of 64 MiB you could integrate 20 4Kx4K monochrome images with optimum performance.
文件: 这是工作合并堆栈结构的大小。一般来说，此参数越大性能越好，在多处理器/多核系统上尤其明显。当整组待合并像素能够一次性载入合并堆栈时，性能最佳。为此必须满足以下条件：缓冲区大小必须足够大，以便通过单次文件读取操作完整载入一个 32 位浮点格式的输入文件。堆栈大小必须大于或等于 W*H*(12*N + 4)，其中 W 和 H 分别是图像宽度和高度（以像素为单位），N 是待合并图像的数量。对于线性拟合裁剪剔除，请将上式中的 4 替换为 8。请注意，对于相对较大的图像集，这可能需要大量可用内存。举例来说，默认堆栈大小 1024（1 GiB）配合默认缓冲区大小 16 MiB，足以最佳地合并 20 幅 2048x2048 单色图像。使用 4 GiB 的堆栈大小和 64 MiB 的缓冲区大小，则可以最佳性能合并 20 幅 4Kx4K 单色图像。

FILE: Bilinear interpolation can be useful to register low SNR linear images, in the rare cases where Lanczos and bicubic spline interpolation generates too strong oscillations between noisy pixels that can't be avoided completely with the clamping feature. Bilinear interpolation has no ringing artifacts, but it generates strong aliasing patterns on noisy areas and provides less accurate results than Lanczos and bicubic spline.Cubic filter interpolations, such as Mitchell-Netravali, Catmull-Rom spline and cubic B-spline, provide higher smoothness and subsampling accuracy that can be necessary when the registration transformation involves relatively strong size reductions.Nearest neighbor is the simplest possible pixel interpolation method. It always produces the worst results, especially in terms of registration accuracy (no subpixel registration is possible), and discontinuities due to the simplistic interpolation scheme. However, in absence of scaling and rotation nearest neighbor preserves the original noise distribution in the registered images, a property that can be useful in some image analysis applications.
文件: 在罕见情况下，Lanczos 和双三次样条插值会在噪声像素之间产生过强的振荡，即使使用钳制功能也无法完全避免，此时双线性插值可用于配准低信噪比的线性图像。双线性插值不会产生振铃伪影，但会在噪声区域产生强烈的混叠图案，且结果精度低于 Lanczos 和双三次样条。三次滤波器插值，例如 Mitchell-Netravali、Catmull-Rom 样条和三次 B 样条，能提供更高的平滑度和子采样精度，当配准变换涉及相对较强的尺寸缩小时可能是必需的。最近邻是最简单的像素插值方法。它总是产生最差的结果，尤其是在配准精度方面（无法实现亚像素配准），而且由于插值方案过于简单会产生不连续性。不过，在没有缩放和旋转的情况下，最近邻会保留已配准图像中原有的噪声分布，这一特性在某些图像分析应用中可能有用。

FILE: When this option is selected, StarAlignment will restrict the star matching process to the rectangular areas defined by all existing previews in reference and target images. If there are no previews defined in one of the images, the whole image will be used for star matching, ignoring this parameter. Obviously, this option only works for views, not for disk image files.This option can be useful for mosaic construction in extremely difficult cases, when automatic intersection computation (see above) fails. In general, this only happens for images with minimal overlapping. To use this option, you must define previews covering (roughly) the overlapped areas between the reference and target images, then execute StarAlignment on the target image with this option enabled. In this way StarAlignment will limit the star matching process to the areas covered by the previews, which greatly improves the performance of the RANSAC algorithm by reducing the fraction of outliers (false putative matches) in the initial set of star pair matches. With the help of this feature, one can build mosaics of any practical size and complexity.
文件: 选中此选项后，StarAlignment 会将星点匹配过程限制在参考图像和目标图像中所有现有预览所定义的矩形区域内。如果其中一幅图像未定义预览，则会忽略此参数，改用整幅图像进行星点匹配。显然，此选项仅适用于视图，不适用于磁盘图像文件。在自动交集计算（见上文）失败的极端困难情况下，此选项可用于构建马赛克。一般来说，这种情况只发生在重叠极少的图像上。要使用此选项，必须定义大致覆盖参考图像与目标图像之间重叠区域的预览，然后在启用此选项的情况下对目标图像执行 StarAlignment。这样 StarAlignment 会把星点匹配过程限制在预览覆盖的区域内，通过降低初始星对匹配集合中离群值（错误的拟匹配）的比例，显著提升 RANSAC 算法的性能。借助此功能，可以构建任何实际尺寸和复杂度的马赛克。

FILE: A two-dimensional rigid transformation, or Euclidean transformation, preserves the Euclidean distance between every pair of transformed points. Rigid transformations may include rotations, translations and reflections in any order.A two-dimensional projective transformation, or homography, is a line-preserving geometric transformation between two sets of points in the plane. Homographies can model translations, rotations, reflections, scale changes and shearing in any order.By default, StarAlignment computes homographies to model complex linear image registration transformations with the maximum accuracy. However, with only 3 degrees of freedom, rigid transformations can be more robust and faster, requiring fewer RANSAC iterations even when dealing with a high proportion of outliers in the initial set of putative star pair matches.Note that this option is relevant for all registration models, including linear and nonlinear models with arbitrary distortion correction using surface splines. In the latter case, a linear model is always necessary to build an initial registration transformation before modeling distortions.
文件: 二维刚性变换，或称欧氏变换，保持每对变换后点之间的欧氏距离不变。刚性变换可以按任意顺序包含旋转、平移和反射。二维射影变换，或称单应性，是平面中两组点之间保持直线的几何变换。单应性可以按任意顺序建模平移、旋转、反射、尺度变化和错切。默认情况下，StarAlignment 会计算单应性，以最高精度建模复杂的线性图像配准变换。不过，刚性变换只有 3 个自由度，因此更稳健、更快，即使初始拟星对匹配集合中离群值比例很高，所需的 RANSAC 迭代次数也更少。请注意，此选项与所有配准模型相关，包括使用曲面样条进行任意畸变校正的线性和非线性模型。在非线性模型中，始终需要先用线性模型建立初始配准变换，然后再建模畸变。

FILE: The average signal strength option attempts to derive relative exposures directly from statistical properties of the data. This option is less robust and may not work if some images have additive illumination variations, such as sky gradients.The Standard properties option uses the image weights stored in the PCL:ImageWeight XISF property of each image, as written by the ImageAnalysis process. The property is a vector of per-channel weights; a vector with a single component applies its weight to all channels, for example to the three nominal channels of an RGB color image. Images without this property are integrated with unit weight, and a warning message is written to the console.If you select the FITS keyword option, please specify the name of a FITS keyword to retrieve image weights. The specified keyword must be present in all input images and its value must be of numeric type and positive.If you select the CSV weights file option, you must select a plain text file in CSV format with full file paths of integrated images and their corresponding per-channel image weights. See the CSV weights file parameter for more information.
文件: 平均信号强度选项会尝试直接从数据的统计特性推导相对曝光量。此选项稳健性较差，如果某些图像存在加性照明变化（例如天空梯度），可能无法正常工作。标准属性选项使用存储在各图像 PCL:ImageWeight XISF 属性中的图像权重，该属性由 ImageAnalysis 流程写入。该属性是一个逐通道权重向量；只有一个分量的向量会将其权重应用到所有通道，例如 RGB 彩色图像的三个标称通道。没有此属性的图像会以单位权重参与合并，同时控制台会输出一条警告消息。如果选择 FITS 关键字选项，请指定用于获取图像权重的 FITS 关键字名称。指定的关键字必须存在于所有输入图像中，其值必须为数值类型且为正。如果选择 CSV 权重文件选项，必须选择一个 CSV 格式的纯文本文件，其中包含待合并图像的完整文件路径及其对应的逐通道图像权重。更多信息请参阅 CSV 权重文件参数。

FILE: Render images using physical screen pixels on Retina displays working in high-dpi modes.Currently this option is only available on macOS. On Linux/FreeBSD and Windows, all screen output is always performed at the physical display resolution, so the state of this option is immaterial. On high-dpi Retina display modes, physical screen pixels are used for images represented at reduced zoom ratios 1:2 and lower. When this option is enabled in these modes, an image is represented at its full size on physical pixels when the zoom ratio is 1:2. This is because the ratio of physical to logical pixels is always 2 in Retina high-dpi modes.Enabling this option on macOS with capable hardware may slow down screen image renditions, since the volume of the generated pixel data is four times the volume required when working with logical pixels. Furthermore, when this option is enabled, certain optimizations that can yield faster screen renditions have to be disabled. If you experience slow screen performance working with big images, especially on slow machines, you can turn off this option to improve speed at the expense of representation quality.
文件: 在处于高 dpi 模式的 Retina 显示器上，使用物理屏幕像素渲染图像。目前此选项仅在 macOS 上可用。在 Linux/FreeBSD 和 Windows 上，所有屏幕输出始终以物理显示分辨率执行，因此此选项的状态无关紧要。在高 dpi Retina 显示模式下，对于以 1:2 及更低缩小比例表示的图像，使用物理屏幕像素。在这些模式下启用此选项后，当缩放比例为 1:2 时，图像将按完整尺寸以物理像素表示。这是因为在 Retina 高 dpi 模式下，物理像素与逻辑像素之比始终为 2。在 macOS 上于支持的硬件启用此选项可能会拖慢屏幕图像渲染，因为生成的像素数据量是使用逻辑像素时的四倍。此外，启用此选项后，某些本可加快屏幕渲染的优化必须被禁用。如果在处理大图像时遇到屏幕性能缓慢，尤其是在较慢的机器上，可以关闭此选项以提升速度，代价是表示质量下降。

FILE: Multiscale analysis algorithmThe Isotropic Undecimated Wavelet Transform, also known as starlet transform and à trous (with holes) wavelet transform, is a computationally efficient, versatile wavelet transform widely used in astronomy. It uses a positive low-pass filter as a wavelet scaling function, applied by interlaced convolutions following a dyadic sequence.The multiscale linear transform is similar to the starlet transform, but uses multiple Gaussian filters of varying sizes applied by separable convolutions, instead of a single interlaced scaling function. It is less flexible than the starlet transform (mainly because it does not allow selecting a specific scaling function) and computationally more expensive, but has two advantages: it allows for arbitrary scaling sequences (while the starlet transform is strictly defined only for the dyadic sequence), and is more controllable at large dimensional scales (because the scaling filters are computed separately for each layer).Both transforms are particularly well adapted to the detection of smooth isotropic structures, which justifies their success in astronomical image processing.
文件: 多尺度分析算法。各向同性非抽取小波变换，也称为 starlet 变换和 à trous（带孔）小波变换，是一种计算高效、用途广泛的小波变换，在天文学中被广泛使用。它使用正的低通滤波器作为小波尺度函数，按二进序列通过交错卷积施加。多尺度线性变换与 starlet 变换类似，但使用多个不同尺寸的高斯滤波器通过可分离卷积施加，而不是单一的交替尺度函数。它不如 starlet 变换灵活（主要因为它不允许选择特定的尺度函数），计算开销也更高，但有两个优点：它允许任意的尺度序列（而 starlet 变换严格来说只针对二进序列定义），并且在大尺寸尺度上更可控（因为缩放滤波器是为每一层单独计算的）。这两种变换都特别适合检测平滑的各向同性结构，这也解释了它们在天文图像处理中为何广受欢迎。

FILE: When enabled, the PixInsight core application will try to detect high-dpi monitors automatically, and will compute appropriate scaling factors for all GUI elements and resources. For automatic DPI-based scaling, the reference is a 27-inch monitor at QHD resolution (2560x1440 physical display pixels, or 109 dpi). This pixel density corresponds to a scaling factor of 1.0.Keep in mind that automatic display characterization is not always feasible or accurate. For example, some X11 desktop managers don't support high-dpi monitors adequately, especially with multiple monitors working at different resolutions. Virtualized operating systems can also have problems for automatic detection of monitor dimensions. In these cases, you can disable this option to specify the correct scaling factor manually (see the UI scaling factor parameter below).Core UI scaling parameters are only fetched upon application startup. Changes to this parameter will take place the next time PixInsight is executed.* Warning * Specifying wrong UI scaling settings may yield an unusable core application. DO NOT change this parameter if you are not sure of what you are doing.
文件: 启用后，PixInsight 核心应用会尝试自动检测高 dpi 显示器，并为所有 GUI 元素和资源计算合适的缩放系数。自动基于 DPI 的缩放以 27 英寸 QHD 分辨率显示器（2560x1440 物理显示像素，即 109 dpi）为基准。该像素密度对应缩放系数 1.0。请记住，自动显示特性识别并不总是可行或准确。例如，某些 X11 桌面管理器不能充分支持高 dpi 显示器，尤其是在多台显示器以不同分辨率工作的情况下。虚拟化操作系统在自动检测显示器尺寸时也可能出现问题。在这些情况下，可以禁用此选项，手动指定正确的缩放系数（见下面的“界面缩放系数”参数）。核心界面缩放参数仅在应用启动时读取。对此参数的更改将在下次执行 PixInsight 时生效。* 警告 * 指定错误的界面缩放设置可能导致核心应用无法使用。如果不确定自己在做什么，请勿更改此参数。

FILE: Peak sensitivity of the star detection device.Internally, the peak response property of the star detection algorithm is expressed in kurtosis units. For each detected structure, kurtosis is evaluated from all significant pixels with values greater than the estimated mean local background. Peak response is the minimum value of kurtosis necessary to trigger star detection.To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum peak response, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.If you decrease this parameter, stars will need to have stronger (or more prominent) peaks to be detected. This is useful to prevent detection of saturated stars, as well as small nonstellar features. By increasing this parameter, the star detection algorithm will be more sensitive to peakedness, and hence more tolerant with relatively flat image features. The default value is 0.5. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.
文件: 星点检测设备的峰值灵敏度。在内部，星点检测算法的峰值响应属性以峰度为单位表示。对于每个检测到的结构，峰度由所有取值大于估算局部背景均值的显著像素评估得出。峰值响应是触发星点检测所需的最小峰度值。为使此界面与内部实现解耦，该参数被归一化到 [0,1] 区间，其中 0 和 1 分别代表最小和最大峰值响应。这种抽象让我们可以在不破坏依赖它的工具和流程的前提下更换星点检测引擎。如果降低此参数，恒星需要具有更强（或更突出）的峰才能被检测到。这有助于防止检测到饱和恒星以及微小的非恒星特征。提高此参数后，星点检测算法对峰态更敏感，因而对相对平坦的图像特征更宽容。默认值为 0.5。通常情况下，在正常工作条件下无需更改此参数的默认值。

FILE: The absolute colorimetric intent also replaces out-of-gamut colors by their nearest matches in the output color space, but it doesn't try to match white points. If the white points in the image and output device spaces don't match, you'll get a color cast in the highlights. However, since this intent doesn't alter any in-gamut colors, it is the best option in terms of numeric color accuracy.The perceptual intent maps all colors in the image space to the output device space. This is the default option for monitors. With the perceptual intent, no out-of-gamut color is clipped, as happens with colorimetric intents, but all colors can be altered, and the changes can be significant if the image space is much wider than the output space. In general, relative colorimetric is preferred for printed media, but perceptual can yield more vibrant results that may be desirable in some cases.Finally, the saturation intent tries to maximize color saturation in the represented image, at the cost of sacrifying color accuracy, if necessary. This intent can be a good option for synthetic graphics and illustrations, but not for reproduction of photographic images.
文件: 绝对色度意图同样会用输出色彩空间中最接近的颜色替换色域外颜色，但它不会尝试匹配白点。如果图像与输出设备空间的白点不匹配，高光部分会出现偏色。不过，由于此意图不改变任何色域内颜色，就数值色彩精度而言，它是最佳选项。感知意图会将图像空间中的所有颜色映射到输出设备空间。这是显示器的默认选项。使用感知意图时，不会像色度意图那样裁剪任何色域外颜色，但所有颜色都可能被改变；如果图像空间比输出空间宽得多，这些改变可能相当显著。一般来说，印刷介质首选相对色度意图，但感知意图可以产生更鲜艳的结果，在某些情况下可能正是所需的。最后，饱和度意图会尝试在所表示的图像中最大化色彩饱和度，必要时以牺牲色彩精度为代价。此意图对于合成图形和插画可能是很好的选项，但不适合照片类图像的复制。

文件: 将星点匹配限制到预览区域。选中此选项后，StarAlignment 会将星点匹配过程限制在参考图像和目标图像中所有现有预览所定义的矩形区域内。如果其中一幅图像未定义预览，则会忽略此参数，改用整幅图像进行星点匹配。显然，此选项仅适用于视图，不适用于磁盘图像文件。在自动交集计算（见上文）失败的极端困难情况下，此选项可用于构建马赛克。一般来说，这种情况只发生在重叠极少的图像上。要使用此选项，必须定义大致覆盖参考图像与目标图像之间重叠区域的预览，然后在启用此选项的情况下对目标图像执行 StarAlignment。这样 StarAlignment 会把星点匹配过程限制在预览覆盖的区域内，通过降低初始星对匹配集合中离群值（错误的拟匹配）的比例，显著提升 RANSAC 算法的性能。借助此功能，可以构建任何实际尺寸和复杂度的马赛克。

FILE: Subtract PEDESTAL keyword values, if present in input images.Some data sets require the addition of small positive values (typically about 100 DN) to calibrated light frames in order to prevent truncation of negative pixel sample values after calibration. These small pedestals can be subtracted from source integration pixels to refer all input data to the same zero point consistently.In general, this option should only be enabled for integration of calibrated light frames with PEDESTAL keywords when a global normalization method (such as additive with scaling) is used for pixel rejection and/or integration output.This option should always be disabled if local normalization is used, since subtracting pedestals invalidates local normalization functions. Local normalization already compensates for differing additive components among integrated frames.This option should also be disabled for integration of raw bias and dark frames, since in these cases existing PEDESTAL keywords should be preserved in the generated master bias and dark frames. These pedestals will be subtracted automatically by the ImageCalibration process for calibration of flat and light frames.
文件: 若输入图像中存在 PEDESTAL 关键字值，则将其减去。某些数据集需要在已校准的光帧上加入小的正值（通常约 100 DN），以防止校准后负像素样本值被截断。可以从源合并像素中减去这些小基座，从而将所有输入数据一致地归算到同一零点。一般来说，只有当使用全局归一化方法（例如带缩放的加性归一化）进行像素剔除和/或合并输出时，才应针对带 PEDESTAL 关键字的已校准光帧合并启用此选项。如果使用局部归一化，则始终应禁用此选项，因为减去基座会使局部归一化函数失效。局部归一化本身已经补偿了各合并帧之间不同的加性分量。叠加原始偏置帧和暗场帧时也应禁用此选项，因为在这些情况下，现有的 PEDESTAL 关键字应保留在生成的主 偏置帧和主 暗场帧中。这些基座将在校准平场帧和光帧时由 ImageCalibration 流程自动减去。

FILE: Compute the intersection region between the reference and target images.When this option is selected and is applicable, StarAlignment uses a special FFT-based algorithm to precompute the intersection region between the reference and target images.Once the intersection has been found, the star matching process is restricted to the intersection area. This greatly improves the performance of the RANSAC algorithm by reducing the fraction of outliers (false putative matches) in the initial set of star pair matches. Note that this works in the same way, and has the same features and advantages, as the restrict to previews option (see below). However, intersections are computed in a completely automatic and accurate way, without user intervention.The disabled option will disable intersection computation. Mosaic modes only will perform computation of intersection regions only when a mosaic construction mode has been selected (union/mosaic or separate mosaic), and always will force intersection computations in all working modes. Normally, this option is only necessary to build mosaics, because in these tasks the overlapped regions between mosaic frames are usually small.
文件: 计算参考图像与目标图像之间的交集区域。选中此选项且条件适用时，StarAlignment 会使用一种基于 FFT 的特殊算法预先计算参考图像与目标图像之间的交集区域。找到交集后，星点匹配过程被限制在交集区域内。这通过降低初始星对匹配集合中离群值（错误的拟匹配）的比例，显著提升 RANSAC 算法的性能。请注意，它的工作方式以及所具有的特性和优势与“限制到预览”选项相同（见下文）。不过，交集是以完全自动且精确的方式计算的，无需用户干预。“禁用”将关闭交集计算。“仅马赛克”只在选择了马赛克构建模式（合并/马赛克或分离马赛克）时计算交集区域，并且始终会在所有工作模式下强制进行交集计算。通常只有在构建马赛克时才需要此选项，因为在这类任务中，马赛克帧之间的重叠区域往往很小。

FILE: Local variance map of the specified image with odd window size d ≥ 3 pixels and kernel function k.See the family of krn_xxx() symbolic functions for the set of available local variance kernels.A local variance map is a sensitive analysis tool to explore the distribution of pixel intensity variations at small scales. This allows for the implementation of subtle adaptive procedures with PixelMath. For example, the following expression: iif( lvar( $T, 7, krn_gauss() ) < t , medfilt( $T, 5, str_circular() ) , $T )applies a median filter selectively to pixels where the local variance is below a prescribed threshold t, which depends on the target image and must be found experimentally. For example, t=1e-8 can be a good starting value for a linear deep-sky image. The expression above implements a powerful noise reduction procedure. More sophisticated, adaptive noise filtering processes based on the same technique can be designed with iswitch() constructs.Local variance maps are always generated as 64-bit floating point images. This ensures that no truncation or roundoff errors will degrade their ability to represent subtle intensity variations, which is especially important for linear images.
文件: 指定图像的局部方差映射，使用奇数窗口尺寸 d ≥ 3 像素和核函数 k。关于可用的局部方差核集合，请参阅 krn_xxx() 符号函数族。局部方差映射是一种灵敏的分析工具，用于探究小尺度上像素强度变化的分布情况。借此可以在 PixelMath 中实现精细的自适应流程。例如，以下表达式：iif( lvar( $T, 7, krn_gauss() ) < t , medfilt( $T, 5, str_circular() ) , $T ) 只对局部方差低于给定阈值 t 的像素应用中值滤波，该阈值取决于目标图像，必须通过实验确定。例如，对于线性深空图像，t=1e-8 可以作为一个不错的起始值。上面的表达式实现了一种强大的降噪流程。基于相同技术、更复杂的自适应噪声滤波流程可以用 iswitch() 结构来设计。局部方差映射始终生成为 64 位浮点图像。这确保不会因截断或舍入误差削弱其表示细微强度变化的能力，这对线性图像尤为重要。

Loads new filter definitions from the specified input file (XSPD format) and merges them with existing ones. New filters will be added and already existing ones will be updated with imported data.Import CSV filter definitions. Scans the specified input directory for valid filter definitions in CSV format (with .csv extension), which will replace the current filter set.Merge CSV filter definitions. Scans the specified input directory for valid filter definitions in CSV format and merges them with existing ones. New filters will be added and already existing ones will be updated with imported data.Export XML filters database. Writes the current filter definitions to the specified output file in XSPD format.Export CSV filter definitions. Writes current filter definitions as individual CSV files (with .csv extension) on the specified output directory.Merge with default filters.
