FILE: Linear fit clipping fits each pixel stack to a straigtht line. The linear fit is optimized in the twofold sense of minimizing average absolute deviation and maximizing inliers. This rejection algorithm is more robust than sigma clipping for large sets of images, especially in presence of additive sky gradients of varying intensity and spatial distribution. For the best performance, use this algorithm for large sets of at least 15 images. Five images is the minimum required.The Generalized Extreme Studentized Deviate (ESD) rejection algorithm is an implementation of the method described by Bernard Rosner in his 1983 paper Percentage Points for a Generalized ESD Many-Outlier procedure, adapted to the image integration task. The ESD algorithm assumes that each pixel stack, in the absence of outliers, follows an approximately normal (Gaussian) distribution. It aims at avoiding masking, a serious issue that occurs when an outlier goes undetected because its value is similar to another outlier. The performance of this algorithm is excellent for data sets of 15 or more images, although good results can also be obtained for reduced sets of 8-10 frames. The minimum required is 3 images.Robust Chauvenet Rejection (RCR) is based on the algorithms described in Maples, M. P., Reichart, D. E. et al., Robust Chauvenet Outlier Rejection, Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, 2018, 238, A2, 1-49. Our implementation applies three successive stages of rejection with decreasingly robust/increasingly precise measures of central tendency and sample deviation, rejecting a single pixel at each iteration for maximum stability. This is a single-parameter pixel rejection algorithm introduced since version 1.8.9 of PixInsight.Percentile clipping rejection is excellent to integrate reduced sets of images, such as 3 to 6 images. This is a single-pass algorithm that rejects pixels outside a fixed range of values relative to the median of each pixel stack.Averaged iterative sigma clipping is intended for sets of 10 or more images. This algorithm tries to derive the gain of an ideal CCD detector from existing pixel data, assuming zero readout noise, then uses a Poisson noise model to perform rejection. For large sets of images however, sigma clipping tends to be superior.The min/max method can be used to ensure rejection of extreme values. FILE: The SNR method uses statistical scale estimators and multiscale noise evaluation techniques to compute SNR estimates. If no XISF properties are available, the estimates are obtained from a set of custom FITS keywords, if they are present in the images. If the data being integrated has been correctly calibrated (and demosaiced when applicable) with our preprocessing tools, these properties and keywords should always be included in each input frame. Otherwise ImageIntegration will have to compute these estimates from the data being integrated, which is a potentially wrong procedure because input frames have been interpolated during the image demosaicing (when applicable) and registration tasks, destroying the original statistics of the raw data. Appropriate warning messages will be shown in these cases.Exposure times will be retrieved from standard EXPTIME and EXPOSURE FITS keywords (in that order).The average signal strength option attempts to derive relative exposures directly from statistical properties of the data. FILE: Winsorized sigma clipping is similar to the normal sigma clipping algorithm, but uses a special iterative procedure based on Huber's method of robust estimation of parameters through Winsorization. This algorithm can yield superior rejection of outliers with better preservation of significant data for large sets of images.Linear fit clipping fits each pixel stack to a straigtht line. The linear fit is optimized in the twofold sense of minimizing average absolute deviation and maximizing inliers. This rejection algorithm is more robust than sigma clipping for large sets of images, especially in presence of additive sky gradients of varying intensity and spatial distribution. For the best performance, use this algorithm for large sets of at least 15 images. Five images is the minimum required.The Generalized Extreme Studentized Deviate (ESD) rejection algorithm is an implementation of the method described by Bernard Rosner in his 1983 paper Percentage Points for a Generalized ESD Many-Outlier procedure, adapted to the image integration task. The ESD algorithm assumes that each pixel stack, in the absence of outliers, follows an approximately normal (Gaussian) distribution. It aims at avoiding masking, a serious issue that occurs when an outlier goes undetected because its value is similar to another outlier. The performance of this algorithm is excellent for data sets of 15 or more images, although good results can also be obtained for reduced sets of 8-10 frames. The minimum required is 3 images.Robust Chauvenet Rejection (RCR) is based on the algorithms described in Maples, M. P., Reichart, D. E. et al., Robust Chauvenet Outlier Rejection, Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, 2018, 238, A2, 1-49. Our implementation applies three successive stages of rejection with decreasingly robust/increasingly precise measures of central tendency and sample deviation, rejecting a single pixel at each iteration for maximum stability. This is a single-parameter pixel rejection algorithm introduced since version 1.8.9 of PixInsight.Percentile clipping rejection is excellent to integrate reduced sets of images, such as 3 to 6 images. This is a single-pass algorithm that rejects pixels outside a fixed range of values relative to the median of each pixel stack.Averaged iterative sigma clipping is intended for sets of 10 or more images. This algorithm tries to derive the gain of an ideal CCD detector from existing pixel data, assuming zero readout noise, then uses a Poisson noise model to perform rejection. For large sets of images however, sigma clipping tends to be superior.The min/max method can be used to ensure rejection of extreme values. Min/max performs an unconditional rejection of a fixed number of pixels from each stack, without any statistical basis. Rejection methods based on robust statistics, such as percentile, Winsorized sigma clipping, linear fitting and averaged sigma clipping are in general preferable.

E. et al., Robust Chauvenet Outlier Rejection, Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, 2018, 238, A2, 1-49. P., Reichart, D. E. 等人发表于 Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, 2018, 238, A2, 1-49 的论文 Robust Chauvenet Outlier Rejection 中描述的算法。我们的实现会连续应用三个剔除阶段，其中中心趋势和样本偏差的度量依次降低稳健性、提高精确性，每次迭代只剔除一个像素以获得最大稳定性。这是自 PixInsight 1.8.9 版本起引入的单参数像素剔除算法。百分位裁剪剔除非常适合合并规模较小的图像集，例如 3 到 6 幅图像。这是一种单遍算法，会剔除相对于每个像素栈中值落在固定取值范围之外的像素。平均迭代 sigma 裁剪适用于 10 幅或更多图像的集合。此算法尝试在假定读出噪声为零的前提下从现有像素数据推导理想 CCD 探测器的增益，然后使用泊松噪声模型执行剔除。不过对于大型图像集，sigma 裁剪往往更优。最小值/最大值方法可用于确保剔除极端值。最小值/最大值会对每个栈无条件剔除固定数量的像素，没有任何统计依据。一般来说，基于稳健统计的剔除方法更可取，例如百分位、Winsor 化 sigma 裁剪、线性拟合和平均 sigma 裁剪。

FILE: The PSF Signal Weight (PSFSW) and PSF SNR algorithms are based on robust estimates of total and mean flux computed by PSF photometry, as well as noise estimates computed using multiscale analysis techniques. These methods are robust and accurate. PSFSW is a comprehensive image quality estimator, able to capture a wide variety of image quality metrics including signal-to-noise ratio, source dimensions and background gradients. PSF SNR is a good choice to generate image weights based on signal-to-noise ratio exclusively. The PSF Signal Weight method is currently the default option.The PSF Scale SNR (PSFSSNR) method uses relative scale estimates computed by the LocalNormalization tool and stored in local normalization data files (XNML format, .xnml extension), along with multiscale noise estimates, to compute image weights exclusively based on relative signal-to-noise ratios. This method is excellent to maximize SNR in the integrated image. PSFSSNR requires .xnml files correctly associated with all input images to retrieve relative scale estimates, and all .xnml files should be generated with the same normalization reference image.The SNR method uses statistical scale estimators and multiscale noise evaluation techniques to compute SNR estimates. These estimates are applied to minimize mean squared error in the integrated result, which in theory transforms the average combination process into a maximum likelihood estimator of deterministic signal. This method can lead to optimal results in terms of SNR maximization, but has potential robustness problems that can also generate wrong results, so it must be used with care by analyzing the data prior to integration, for example with the ImageAnalysis tool.Noise estimates and scaling factors, as well as PSF flux estimates and other auxiliary weighting terms, are obtained either from cached data, when available, of from XISF properties. If no XISF properties are available, the estimates are obtained from a set of custom FITS keywords, if they are present in the images. If the data being integrated has been correctly calibrated (and demosaiced when applicable) with our preprocessing tools, these properties and keywords should always be included in each input frame. Otherwise ImageIntegration will have to compute these estimates from the data being integrated, which is a potentially wrong procedure because input frames have been interpolated during the image demosaicing (when applicable) and registration tasks, destroying the original statistics of the raw data. Appropriate warning messages will be shown in these cases.Exposure times will be retrieved from standard EXPTIME and EXPOSURE FITS keywords (in that order).The average signal strength option attempts to derive relative exposures directly from statistical properties of the data. This option is less robust and may not work if some images have additive illumination variations, such as sky gradients.The Standard properties option uses the image weights stored in the PCL:ImageWeight XISF property of each image, as written by the ImageAnalysis process. The property is a vector of per-channel weights; a vector with a single component applies its weight to all channels, for example to the three nominal channels of an RGB color image. Images without this property are integrated with unit weight, and a warning message is written to the console.If you select the FITS keyword option, please specify the name of a FITS keyword to retrieve image weights. The specified keyword must be present in all input images and its value must be of numeric type and positive.If you select the CSV weights file option, you must select a plain text file in CSV format with full file paths of integrated images and their corresponding per-channel image weights. See the CSV weights file parameter for more information.
文件: PSF 信号权重（PSFSW）和 PSF SNR 算法基于 PSF 测光所计算的总通量和平均通量的稳健估计，以及使用多尺度分析技术计算的噪声估计。这些方法稳健且准确。PSFSW 是一个综合性的图像质量估计器，能够捕捉信噪比、源尺寸和背景梯度等多种图像质量指标。PSF SNR 是基于信噪比专门生成图像权重的良好选择。PSF 信号权重方法目前是默认选项。PSF 尺度 SNR（PSFSSNR）方法使用由 LocalNormalization 工具计算并存储在局部归一化数据文件（XNML 格式，扩展名 .xnml）中的相对尺度估计，以及多尺度噪声估计，完全基于相对信噪比来计算图像权重。此方法非常适合在合并图像中最大化 SNR。PSFSSNR 需要与所有输入图像正确关联的 .xnml 文件来获取相对尺度估计，且所有 .xnml 文件都应使用同一幅归一化参考图像生成。SNR 方法使用统计尺度估计器和多尺度噪声评估技术来计算 SNR 估计值。这些估计值用于最小化合并结果中的均方误差，理论上可将平均值合并过程转变为确定性信号的最大似然估计器。此方法在 SNR 最大化方面可能得到最优结果，但存在潜在的稳健性问题，也可能产生错误结果，因此使用时必须谨慎，应在合并前分析数据，例如使用 ImageAnalysis 工具。噪声估计与缩放系数，以及 PSF 通量估计和其他辅助加权项，可从缓存数据（如有）或 XISF 属性获取。如果没有可用的 XISF 属性，则从一组自定义 FITS 关键字获取（前提是图像中存在这些关键字）。如果待合并数据已用我们的预处理工具正确校准（并在适用时完成去马赛克），这些属性和关键字应始终包含在每个输入帧中。否则 ImageIntegration 将不得不从待合并数据中计算这些估计值，这可能是错误的做法，因为输入帧在图像去马赛克（适用时）和配准任务中已被插值，原始数据的统计特性已被破坏。在这些情况下会显示相应的警告消息。曝光时间将从标准 FITS 关键字 EXPTIME 和 EXPOSURE 中获取（按此顺序）。平均信号强度选项会尝试直接从数据的统计特性推导相对曝光量。此选项稳健性较差，如果某些图像存在加性照明变化（例如天空梯度），可能无法正常工作。标准属性选项使用存储在各图像 PCL:ImageWeight XISF 属性中的图像权重，该属性由 ImageAnalysis 流程写入。该属性是一个逐通道权重向量；只有一个分量的向量会将其权重应用到所有通道，例如 RGB 彩色图像的三个标称通道。没有此属性的图像会以单位权重参与合并，同时控制台会输出一条警告消息。如果选择 FITS 关键字选项，请指定用于获取图像权重的 FITS 关键字名称。指定的关键字必须存在于所有输入图像中，其值必须为数值类型且为正。如果选择 CSV 权重文件选项，必须选择一个 CSV 格式的纯文本文件，其中包含待合并图像的完整文件路径及其对应的逐通道图像权重。更多信息请参阅 CSV 权重文件参数。

FILE: When this option is enabled, rotation angles are shown in the [-90°,+90°] range. When this option is disabled, rotation angles are shown in the [0°,180°) range. Signed angles are useful to prevent ambiguities introduced by small rotations around zero degrees. These 'oscillatory' rotations occur frequently due to uncertainty in fitting rotation angles for nearly circular stars. For example, imagine a set of PSF fits where we have two subsets with rotations around zero and 180 degrees. If we compute average PSF parameters, the resulting average rotation would be around 90 degrees. This may be incorrect if both subsets are actually due to dispersion caused by fitting uncertainty, in which case the correct average rotation would be a value close to zero degrees. This option is enabled by default, so rotation angles are represented as signed quantities in the (-90°,+90°] range.
文件: 启用此选项时，旋转角以 [-90°,+90°] 范围显示；禁用时以 [0°,180°) 范围显示。有符号角度可避免围绕零度的小旋转带来的歧义。由于近圆恒星拟合旋转角的不确定性，这种"振荡式"旋转十分常见。例如：两组 PSF 拟合分别围绕 0 度和 180 度旋转，若计算平均 PSF 参数，得到的平均旋转约为 90 度。若两组的差异其实源于拟合误差的离散，这就不正确——此时正确的平均旋转应接近 0 度。此选项默认启用，因此旋转角默认以 (-90°,+90°] 范围内的有符号量表示。

FILE: Normalization scale. LocalNormalization implements a multiscale normalization algorithm. This parameter is the size in pixels of the sampling scale for local image normalization. The larger this parameter, the less locally adaptive the local normalization function will be. Smaller values tend to reproduce variations among small-scale structures in the reference image. Larger values tend to reproduce variations among large-scale structures. To better understand the role of this parameter, suppose we applied the algorithm at the scale of one pixel. The result would be an exact copy of the reference image. On the other hand, if we applied the algorithm at a scale similar to the size of the whole image, the result would be a global normalization: a single linear function would be applied for normalization of the entire target image. The default scale is 1024 pixels, which is quite appropriate for most deep-sky images. Suitable scales are generally in the range from 256 to 1024 pixels, depending on the dimensions of the image and the complexity of the gradients. Although in theory the value of this parameter could be set arbitrarily, for performance and accuracy reasons the current implementation is limited to a set of prescribed scales in the range from 32 to 8192 pixels.
文件: 归一化尺度。LocalNormalization 实现多尺度归一化算法。此参数是局部图像归一化采样尺度的像素大小。参数越大，局部归一化函数的局部自适应性越弱；较小值倾向于再现参考图像中小尺度结构间的变化，较大值倾向于再现大尺度结构间的变化。为更好理解此参数的作用：若在单像素尺度应用算法，结果将是参考图像的精确副本；若在接近整图尺寸的尺度应用，结果则是全局归一化——整个目标图像只用一个线性函数归一化。默认尺度 1024 像素，对大多数深空图像相当合适；合适尺度一般在 256–1024 像素之间，取决于图像尺寸和渐变复杂度。理论上此参数可任意设置，但出于性能与精度考虑，当前实现限制在 32–8192 像素的一组预设尺度内。

This script uses various models to calculate an optimal subexposure length. The read noise limited models find the exposure at which the cost of readout noise is low enough to be insignificant relative to the sky noise. The Anstey model finds the exposure at which low strength target signals can be differentiated from background noise without being affected by quantization and truncation. With a dark background level an very long exposure is required before the background noise overcomes the readout noise. In this case it probably makes more sense to use the Anstey model.

Usage - Select your camera and provide a background image. In most cases simply using a preview frame containing only background will be sufficient.

若梯度图中出现较大的峰或谷，请阅读帮助章节：教程：样本剔除与梯度图。

此控件指定平滑度的对数值。数值越大，平滑越强。

FILE:
Enables fast image quality measurements and the generation of weights assigned to integrated frames.

Resolution favors images with stars that have a higher spatial flux concentration. This criterion assigns higher weights to images with higher signal and sharpener stars, and penalizes images poorly guided, defocused, or covered by clouds or affected by worse atmospheric transparency conditions.

PSF SNR promotes images with higher SNR, measured in terms of the ratio between the star flux and the noise of the area surrounding each measured star.
文件:
启用快速的图像质量测量，并生成分配给各积分帧的权重。

分辨率偏向恒星空间通量集中度更高的图像。该准则给信号更强、星点更锐利的图像更高权重，并惩罚跟踪不良、失焦、被云遮挡或受更差大气透明度影响的图像。

PSF 信噪比提升信噪比更高的图像的权重，以每颗被测恒星的通量与其周围区域噪声之比来度量。

FILE:
Generate the method noise of the denoising process as a new image window. Method noise is the noise guessed by the denoising method, defined as the difference between the noisy input and the denoised output. Method noise should track hypothesis noise statistics, and is strongly signal dependent due to the presence of Poisson noise.

The standard deviation of the method noise image is written to the process console as the Method noise value in DN units.
文件:
把降噪过程的“方法噪声”生成为新图像窗口。方法噪声是降噪方法所推测出的噪声，定义为含噪输入与降噪输出之差。方法噪声应跟随假设的噪声统计特性，并且由于泊松噪声的存在而与信号强度高度相关。

方法噪声图像的标准差会以 方法噪声 值的形式写入进程控制台，单位为 DN。

Otherwise, the NSG ImageIntegration settings will be initialized from the specified template (An ImageIntegration process icon). Only the settings needed by NSG are replaced.

FILE:
Low clipping pixel sample value in the [0,1] range.

All pixels with values smaller than or equal to the value of this parameter will be replaced with statistically plausible estimates, computed from nearby image regions.

Rejection of very low pixels is necessary to prevent generation of large-scale artifacts around large dark structures, such as black borders generated by image registration. Under normal conditions you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter (4.5×10-5). Increase it in the unlikely case that you detect dark artifacts around black borders—which, at any rate, will always denote a defective image calibration that you should fix before normalization.
文件:
[0,1] 范围内的低端裁剪像素样本值。

所有小于或等于此参数值的像素都将被替换为根据邻近图像区域计算出的统计合理估计值。

剔除极低值像素是必要的，可防止在大型暗结构周围产生大尺度伪影，例如图像配准产生的黑色边框。正常情况下无需更改此参数的默认值（4.5×10-5）。若您发现黑色边框周围出现暗伪影（这无论如何都表明图像校准有缺陷，应在归一化之前修正），可增大此值。

FILE:
On the reference side of the join the difference in noise between the two images are blended together (Blend and Average modes). This blend region extends from the join (bright green line); a dark green line indicates where it ends.

This control determines how large this blend area is. For example:

  • 100% The entire reference side of the join is used.
  • 90% A 10% margin is used to avoid blending pixels at the edge of an image.
文件:
在接缝的参考侧，两幅图像之间的噪声差异会被混合（Blend 与 Average 模式）。该混合区域从接缝（亮绿线）开始延伸；深绿线表示其结束位置。

此控件决定该混合区域的大小。例如：

  • 100% 使用接缝参考侧的全部区域。
  • 90% 留出 10% 边距，以避免混合图像边缘处的像素。

FILE:
Only stars within this distance of the target are comparison stars. The distance is in units of the diagonal of the field of the reference image: 0.5 covers the whole image with the target at its center. Comparison stars close to the target share its atmosphere and its position on the detector, so their magnitudes suffer the same differential extinction and flat field errors.

When enabled, the comparison stars are marked on the reference image, with the circle of this radius.
文件:
只有与目标距离在此范围内的恒星才会成为比较星。距离以参考图像视场对角线的单位计：0.5 表示以目标为中心覆盖整幅图像。靠近目标的比较星与目标共享同一大气路径和探测器上的位置，因此其星等受相同的较差消光与平场误差影响。

启用后，比较星会在参考图像上以此半径的圆圈标出。

FILE:
Positions the join relative to the centre of the overlap region. The join path is indicated by a bright green line.

On the reference side of this line, the difference in noise between the two images are blended together (Blend and Average modes).

On the target side of the line, the detailed correction over the overlap region is tapered to the smoother correction applied to the rest of the target image.

Try to keep the join line within the sample grid area ('Show sample grid' check box) and avoid bright stars, image corners and contrasty areas.
文件:
设置接缝相对于重叠区域中心的位置。接缝路径以亮绿线标示。

在该线的参考侧，两幅图像之间的噪声差异会被混合（Blend 与 Average 模式）。

在该线的目标侧，重叠区域上的精细校正会逐渐过渡到应用于目标图像其余部分的更平滑校正。

尽量把接缝线保持在样本网格区域内（“显示样本网格”复选框），并避开亮星、图像四角与高对比区域。

FILE:
Resets the VizieR catalog cache.

The script uses a special cache to store VizieR catalog query results. This saves considerable time by avoiding unnecessary network transfers. However, sometimes a query fails because of a temporary problem, but still returns a result that the script cannot recognize as invalid. In these cases this action resets the internal cache, so that new queries can be sent to the VizieR server to retrieve valid data.
文件:
重置 VizieR 星表缓存。

脚本使用专用缓存来存储 VizieR 星表查询结果。这通过避免不必要的网络传输节省大量时间。但有时查询会因临时问题而失败，却仍返回脚本无法识别为无效的结果。此时此操作会重置内部缓存，以便向 VizieR 服务器发送新的查询以获取有效数据。

FILE:
Return to the whole image after working on a preview region.

Shift+drag on the preview marks out a rectangle and shows just that part at full resolution - fast to work on, and you see true detail instead of a reduced rendering. Your adjustments are global, so they apply to the whole image; this button brings the whole image back and re-renders it with everything you set.

Mask regions keep their real positions on the image either way.
文件:
在预览区域上工作后返回整幅图像。

在预览上按住 Shift 拖动可框出矩形，并以全分辨率只显示该部分 —— 处理快速，而且您看到的是真实细节而不是降采样渲染。您的调整是全局的，因此会作用于整幅图像；此按钮恢复整幅图像，并用您设置的全部调整重新渲染。

无论哪种方式，蒙版区域都保持其在图像上的真实位置。

FILE: The output pedestal is a small quantity expressed in the 16-bit unsigned integer range (from 0 to 65535). It is added at the end of the calibration process and its purpose is to prevent negative values that can occur sometimes as a result of overscan and bias subtraction. Under normal conditions, you should need no pedestal to calibrate science frames because mean sky background levels should be sufficiently high as to avoid negative values. The default value is zero.
文件: 输出基座是一个以 16 位无符号整数范围（0 至 65535）表示的小量。它在校准过程结束时加入，目的是防止过扫描与偏置减法有时产生的负值。正常情况下校准科学帧不需要基座，因为平均天空背景水平应足够高以避免负值。默认值为零。

FILE:
The CSV output of AperturePhotometry: its header, its table of images and its data table, written with the separate files layout as name-header.csv, name-images.csv and name-data.csv. Selecting any of them fills in the other two. A file written with the single file layout holds the three tables: select it as the header, and leave the other two empty.

The data table can have one row per star or one row per measurement.
文件:
AperturePhotometry 的 CSV 输出：其表头、图像表格与数据表格，按分离文件布局分别写为 name-header.csv、name-images.csv 与 name-data.csv。选择其中任一项即可自动填入其余两项。按单文件布局写出的文件包含这三个表格：把它选为表头，其余两项留空。

数据表可以每颗恒星一行，也可以每次测量一行。

FILE:
The Strehl ratio at the observation wavelength, defined as the ratio of the peak aberrated image exposure from a point source compared to the maximum obtainable exposure using an ideal optical system with the same aperture diameter, obstruction diameter, and focal length limited only by diffraction over the system's aperture.

The Strehl ratio indicates the degree of image quality in the presence of wavefront aberrations. The conventional maximum acceptable level of wavefront aberrations, the diffraction-limited level, is set at 0.8.
文件:
观测波长下的斯特列尔比，定义为点源在含像差系统中成像的峰值曝光，与同等孔径直径、遮挡直径和焦距、仅受衍射限制的理想光学系统所能达到的最大曝光之比。

斯特列尔比表示存在波前像差时的成像质量。波前像差的常规可接受上限，即衍射极限水平，设定为 0.8。

FILE: The algorithm isolates column or row structures from large-scale image structures, which are computed using multiscale transforms. This parameter defines a size in pixels to separate small-scale and large-scale structures, using a dyadic sequence. Thus, the default value of 9 means that all structures at the scale of 28 pixels (256) and larger will be removed from the image, keeping in the resulting small-scale component image the structures with sizes from 1 to 128 pixels.
文件: 该算法把列或行结构从大尺度图像结构中分离出来，后者通过多尺度变换计算。此参数以像素为单位定义分隔小尺度与大尺度结构的尺寸，采用二进序列。因此默认值 9 意味着 28 像素（256）及以上的所有结构都将从图像中移除，结果小尺度分量图像中保留 1 至 128 像素的结构。

FILE:
The exposure measurement tool measures the exposure parameters of the selected frame view. The frame must be bias-subtracted and not otherwise processed. Frames from color filter array detectors must not be demosaiced.

1. Set the telescope, detector, and filter parameters in the Parameters tab.

2. Select an intra-focal or extra-focal frame view and click the Measure button. The frame must be bias-subtracted and not otherwise processed. Frames from color filter array detectors must not be demosaiced.

3. The measured defocus distance, defocused image diameter, and median defocused image exposure are displayed.
文件:
曝光测量工具测量所选帧视图的曝光参数。该帧必须已减去偏置，且未经其他处理。来自彩色滤镜阵列探测器的帧不得去马赛克。

1. 在“参数”选项卡中设置望远镜、探测器与滤镜参数。

2. 选择一个焦内或焦外帧视图，点击“测量”按钮。该帧必须已减去偏置，且未经其他处理。来自彩色滤镜阵列探测器的帧不得去马赛克。

3. 将显示测得的离焦距离、离焦图像直径以及离焦图像曝光中位数。

FILE: The filters of the red, green and blue channels of the selected color images. Color images ignore the filters stated in their metadata: their channels are R, G and B unless other filters are assigned to them here, as the channels of a color camera behind a dual-band filter are Ha, OIII and OIII. The color images of each set of channel filters are composed into a mosaic of their own, named after the filters (RGB, HOO).
文件: 所选彩色图像红、绿、蓝通道的滤镜。彩色图像会忽略其元数据中声明的滤镜：其通道为 R、G、B，除非在此为其指定了其他滤镜，例如双窄带滤镜后彩色相机的通道为 Ha、OIII、OIII。每一组通道滤镜对应的彩色图像会合成各自的马赛克，并以滤镜命名（RGB、HOO）。

FILE:
The maximum number of frames used to integrate the Local Normalization reference frame.

The number of integrated best frames is 1/3 of the total frames up to a maximum given by this value.

Higher values may include more frames, lowering the noise and increasing the SNR in the reference frame. Lower values reduce the possibility of including bad frames that could affect the normalization results.

Normally, you don't have to change this parameter, unless you need to include more frames to gaurantee enough SNR in the reference frame, like the case when light frames have a very short exposure time or the subject is very faint, or you need to reduce the risk of including bad frames due to the presence of a lot of bad-quality frames in the data.
文件:
用于叠加局部归一化参考帧的最大帧数。

参与叠加的最佳帧数为总帧数的 1/3，最多不超过此值。

较大的值可包含更多帧，降低参考帧噪声并提高信噪比。较小的值可减少纳入劣质帧而影响归一化结果的可能。

通常无需更改此参数，除非需要包含更多帧以保证参考帧有足够信噪比，例如单帧曝光时间很短或目标极暗时；或者需要降低因数据中存在大量劣质帧而纳入劣质帧的风险。

FILE:
The names of this filter in the metadata of your images, as the XISF Instrument:Filter:Name property or the FILTER keyword state them. Separate several names with commas.

Names are compared whole and without regard to letter case, spaces, hyphens, underscores, dots, brackets or parentheses: H-alpha, H alpha and Halpha are the same name, and so are [OIII], O-III and OIII. A name with additional words, such as Baader Ha 7nm, needs an alias of its own.
文件:
此滤镜在您图像元数据中的名称，即 XISF Instrument:Filter:Name 属性或 FILTER 关键字所写的内容。多个名称用逗号分隔。

名称按整体比较，且不区分大小写、空格、连字符、下划线、点、方括号或圆括号：H-alpha、H alpha 与 Halpha 视为同一名称，[OIII]、O-III 与 OIII 亦然。带额外词语的名称（如 Baader Ha 7nm）需要单独设置别名。

FILE:
The normalization of the frames before their composition into a mosaic.

Global equalizes the location (Tukey's biweight) and the scale (the square root of the biweight midvariance) of each frame to those of the anchor image.

Global and photometric then corrects the scale of each frame from the stars it shares with the frames it overlaps: the signals of the stars are measured by hybrid PSF/aperture photometry and matched through the astrometric solutions, the ratio of each pair is the mean over its common stars after a robust Chauvenet rejection of outliers, and the corrections of all the frames are solved at once relative to the anchor. Frames without overlaps keep the global normalization.
文件:
各帧在合成马赛克之前的归一化方式。

全局把每帧的位置（Tukey 双权重）与尺度（双权重中位方差的平方根）调整到锚定图像的水平。

全局与测光随后依据每帧与其重叠帧共有的恒星校正其尺度：恒星信号用混合 PSF/孔径测光测量，并通过天体测量解配对；每一对的比值是其共有恒星上的均值（经稳健的 Chauvenet 离群剔除）；所有帧的校正相对锚定图像一次性求解。无重叠的帧保持全局归一化。

FILE:
The pixel rejection method used to exclude outliers from the set of pixels that are to be combined.

No rejection. No pixel rejection will be performed.

Scale rejection. Pixels whose distance from the pixel set location exceeds a prescribed value in pixel set scale units are rejected. The location and scale measures are defined by the median and the Rousseeuw/Croux Sn scale parameter. The scale rejection method requires a set of 5 or more frames.
文件:
用于从待合并像素集中排除离群值的像素剔除方法。

不剔除。不执行像素剔除。

尺度剔除。与像素集位置的偏离超过规定值（以像素集尺度单位计）的像素将被剔除。位置与尺度量度由中位数与 Rousseeuw/Croux Sn 尺度参数定义。尺度剔除方法需要 5 帧或更多帧。

FILE: The reduction of the working images used to evaluate the rotation, scale and translation of the images: 1:1 is the full resolution, 1:2 a 2x2 binning, and so on. Images are never reduced below 1024 pixels in their largest dimension. The evaluation of the rotation, scale and translation is a global measurement that needs the large structures of the images, and its cost grows quadratically with the working size; smaller reductions give a larger margin of significance on difficult images at a higher computational cost. The accuracy of the registration does not depend on the reduction: the refinement works at full resolution.
文件: 用于评估图像旋转、缩放与平移的工作图像降采样：1:1 为全分辨率，1:2 为 2x2 合并，以此类推。图像最大边长不会被降到 1024 像素以下。旋转、缩放与平移的评估是全局测量，需要图像的大尺度结构，其计算代价随工作尺寸平方增长；较小的降采样在困难图像上能提供更大的显著性余量，但计算代价更高。配准精度不取决于降采样：细化始终在全分辨率下进行。

FILE: The reduction of the working images where features are detected and matched: 1:1 is the full resolution, 1:2 a 2x2 binning, and so on. Images are never reduced below 1024 pixels in their largest dimension. Features are detected at the scale of the working images, so the reduction sets the smallest structures that can be features, and the cost of the detection. The accuracy of the registration does not depend on it: the control points are measured at full resolution.
文件: 在其中检测与匹配特征的工作图像降采样：1:1 为全分辨率，1:2 为 2x2 合并，以此类推。图像最大边长不会被降到 1024 像素以下。特征在工作图像的尺度上检测，因此降采样决定了能成为特征的最小结构以及检测的代价。配准精度不取决于它：控制点在全分辨率下测量。

FILE:
The stars measured by the photometric normalization: in each channel of each frame, the stars with any pixel above this limit are not measured. Saturated stars, and stars near saturation, where the response of the sensor is no longer linear, would bias the ratios of the frames toward one.

With Relative checked (the default), the limit is this fraction of the saturation level of each image: the largest peak among its detected stars, which flat calibration and the scaling of the data can place well below one. Otherwise it is an absolute pixel value in the [0,1] range. The default is 0.70: stars below 70% of the saturation point.
文件:
测光归一化所测量的恒星：在每帧的每个通道中，只要有任一像素高于此限值的恒星都不参与测量。饱和恒星以及接近饱和（传感器响应不再线性）的恒星会使帧间比值偏向 1。

勾选相对（默认）时，限值为各图像饱和水平的这一比例：该值为其检出恒星中的最大峰值，平场校准与数据缩放可能使其远低于 1。否则该值为 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素值。默认 0.70：即低于饱和点 70% 的恒星。

FILE: This file specifies the entire or partial rows or columns to be corrected. It can be created whether with the LinearDefectDetection script or with the CosmeticCorrection tool. By disabling the Correct entire image option and specifying a file path here you'll only correct these specific columns or rows. Alternatively, you can check the Correct entire image option and, at the same time, specify a defects file. This can be useful to correct entire columns or rows in the image, correcting also partial columns or rows in the same script execution.
文件: 此文件指定要校正的整行/整列或局部行/列。它可以用 LinearDefectDetection 脚本或 CosmeticCorrection 工具创建。关闭 Correct entire image 选项并在此指定文件路径，即可只校正这些特定的列或行。或者，勾选 Correct entire image 选项并同时指定缺陷文件 —— 这在同一次脚本执行中既校正整列/整行、又校正局部列/行时很有用。

FILE:
This parameter defines the script's execution mode:

  • Align images against reference performs a regular image registration task to match each target image to the selected reference image.
  • Undistort images reprojects each target image on a linear astrometric solution with the same center coordinates and image scale as the original solution. This working mode can be applied to perform a geometric normalization by removing arbitrary distortions modeled by our spline-based astrometric solutions.
文件:
此参数定义脚本的执行模式：

  • 按参考图像对齐图像执行常规图像配准任务，把每幅目标图像匹配到所选参考图像。

FILE: Controls how tightly focused the stretch is around Symmetry point (SP) by changing the form of the transform iteself. For concentrated stretches (such as initial stretches on linear images) a large +ve b factor should be employed to focus a stretch within a histogram peak while de-focusing the stretch away from the histogram peak (such as bright stars). For adjustment of non-linear images, lower or -ve b (and/or lower D) parameters should be employed to distribute contrast and brightness more evenly. Large positive values of 'b' can be thought of as a histogram widener, ie spreading the histogram wider about the focus point, SP. By contrast, lower and -ve values of b tend to shift the histogram to a brighter (or dimmer) position without affecting its width too greatly. As a general rule, the level of b employed will decrease as a stretch sequence nears completion, although larger +ve b values (with small D) can still be employed for precise placement of additional contrast.
文件: 控制拉伸围绕 Symmetry point (SP) 聚焦的紧密程度，其方式是改变变换本身的形式。对于集中型拉伸（例如对线性图像做的初次拉伸），应采用较大的正 b 值，使拉伸聚焦在直方图峰值之内，同时在远离直方图峰值处（如亮星）降低聚焦。调整非线性图像时，应采用较小或为负的 b（和/或较小的 D）参数，使对比度与亮度分布得更加均匀。可将较大的正 b 值理解为直方图展宽器，即把直方图围绕焦点 SP 展得更宽。相反，较小及为负的 b 值倾向于把直方图整体平移到更亮（或更暗）的位置，而不太影响其宽度。一般规律是，随着拉伸序列接近完成，所用的 b 会逐渐减小；不过仍可使用较大的正 b 值（配合较小的 D）来精确放置额外的对比度。

FILE: Sets the focus point around which the stretch is applied - contrast will be distributed symmetrically about SP. While 'b' provides the degree of focus of the stretch, SP determines where that focus is applied. SP should generally be placed within a histogram peak so that the stretch will widen and lower the peak by adding the most contrast in the stretch at that point. Pixel values will move away from the SP location. This parameter must be greater than or equal to Shadow prot. point (LP) and less than or equal to Highlight prot. point (HP). Note this parameter is specified by reference to the target image pixel values.
文件: 设置拉伸所围绕的焦点——对比度将围绕 SP 对称分布。'b' 提供拉伸的聚焦程度，而 SP 决定聚焦施加在何处。SP 通常应置于直方图峰值之内，使拉伸在该处加入最多对比度，从而拓宽并压低峰值。像素值将离开 SP 所在位置。此参数必须大于或等于 Shadow prot. point (LP)，且小于或等于 Highlight prot. point (HP)。注意此参数以目标图像的像素值为参考。

FILE: Sets a value below which the stretch is modified to preserve contrast in the shadows/lowlights. This is done by performing a linear stretch of the data below the 'LP' level by reserving contrast from the rest of the image. Moving the LP level towards the current setting of SP changes both the scope (range) and the amount of this contrast reservation, the net effect is to push the overal stretch to higher brightness levels while keeping the contrast and definition in the background. The amount of contrast reserved for the lowlights is such that the continuity of the stretch is preserved. This parameter must be greater than or equal to 0 and not greater than Symmetry point (SP). Note this parameter is specified by reference to the target image pixel values.
文件: 设置一个下限值，低于该值时拉伸会被调整，以保留阴影/暗部的对比度。做法是对 'LP' 电平以下的数据执行线性拉伸，其对比度取自图像的其余部分。把 LP 电平移向当前 SP 设定，会同时改变该对比度保留的范围与数量，净效果是把整体拉伸推向更高的亮度水平，同时保持背景的对比度与层次。为暗部保留的对比度会确保拉伸的连续性不被破坏。此参数必须大于或等于 0，且不大于 Symmetry point (SP)。注意此参数以目标图像的像素值为参考。

FILE: Sets a value above which the stretch is modified to preserve contrast in the highlights/stars. This is done by performing a linear stretch of the data above the 'HP' level by reserving contrast from the rest of the image. Moving the HP level towards the current setting of SP increases both the scope (range) and the amount of this contrast reservation, the net effect is to push the overal stretch to lower brightness levels while keeping the contrast and definition in the highlights. The amount of contrast reserved for the highlights is such that the continuity of the stretch is preserved. This parameter must be less than or equal to 1 and not less than Symmetry point (SP). Note this parameter is specified by reference to the target image pixel values.
文件: 设置一个上限值，高于该值时拉伸会被调整，以保留高光/星点的对比度。做法是对 'HP' 电平以上的数据执行线性拉伸，其对比度取自图像的其余部分。把 HP 电平移向当前 SP 设定，会同时增大该对比度保留的范围与数量，净效果是把整体拉伸推向更低的亮度水平，同时保持高光的对比度与层次。为高光保留的对比度会确保拉伸的连续性不被破坏。此参数必须小于或等于 1，且不小于 Symmetry point (SP)。注意此参数以目标图像的像素值为参考。

FILE: Sets the clipping level for linear stretch of the image. Updating this parameter will automatically update Black point (BP) in such a way that LCP is the maximum fraction of pixels clipped in any channel and set to zero in the linear stretch. Note that any pixel with values less than the black-point input will be clipped and the data lost. Contrast gained by performing the linear stretch will be evenly distributed over the image, which will be dimmed. Pixels with values less than the blackpoint will appear black and have 0 value.
文件: 设置图像线性拉伸的截断电平。更新此参数会自动更新 Black point (BP)，使 LCP 等于线性拉伸中任一通道被截断并置零的像素所占的最大比例。注意任何数值低于黑点输入的像素都会被截断，数据随之丢失。线性拉伸获得的对比度将均匀分布到整幅图像上，图像会变暗。数值低于黑点的像素显示为黑色，值为 0。

FILE: Sets the upper clipping level for linear stretch of the image. Updating this parameter will automatically update White point (WP) in such a way that HCP is the maximum fraction of pixels clipped in any channel and set to 1.0 in the linear stretch. Note that any pixel with value greater than the white-point input will be clipped and the data lost. Contrast gained by performing the linear stretch will be evenly distributed over the image, which will be brightened. Pixels with values greater than the white-point will appear white and have a value of 1.0.
文件: 设置图像线性拉伸的上限截断电平。更新此参数会自动更新 White point (WP)，使 HCP 等于线性拉伸中任一通道被截断并置为 1.0 的像素所占的最大比例。注意任何数值高于白点输入的像素都会被截断，数据随之丢失。线性拉伸获得的对比度将均匀分布到整幅图像上，图像会变亮。数值高于白点的像素显示为白色，值为 1.0。

FILE: Enable Lunar/Planetary mode when processing lunar or planetary images with a large amount of empty background around the subject. Reminder: when processing images containing no stars, be sure to set the PSF Diameter to the approximate stellar FWHM that the same imaging system would produce if imaging stars.
文件: 处理月球或行星图像、且主体周围有大片空白背景时，启用月球/行星模式。提醒：处理不含星点的图像时，务必将 PSF 直径设为同一成像系统拍摄星点时大约会得到的恒星 FWHM。

FILE: Removes reflections from the image. Note that this can inadvertently remove features that look very similar to reflections, such as small planetary nebulae. Don't enable this if your image does not have reflections, and always inspect the results carefully. Use masking to protect areas that should not be affected.
文件: 去除图像中的反射光斑。注意这可能误删与反射外观相似的结构，例如小型行星状星云。若图像中并无反射，请勿启用；并务必仔细检查结果。可用蒙版保护不应受影响的区域。

FILE:
Amount to adjust star halos.

Positive values produce brighter halos with larger extents, giving stars a softer appearance. Negative values reduce halo brightness and extent, giving stars a sharper appearance.

Since the color of stars with saturated (clipped) cores is visible only in their halos, reducing the diameter of stars while also increasing their halos can help retain or emphasize star color.
文件:
调整星晕的量。

正值使星晕更亮、范围更大，星点外观更柔和；负值降低星晕亮度与范围，星点外观更锐利。

由于核心饱和（截断）的星点，其颜色只能从星晕中看出，因此在缩小星点直径的同时增大星晕，有助于保留或强调星点颜色。

FILE:
Only performs image correction, with no further sharpening.

BlurXTerminator can correct for limited amounts of motion blur (guiding errors), astigmatism, primary and secondary coma, unequal FWHM in color channels, chromatic aberration (color fringing), and asymmetric star halos. Correction is always performed, but better results can sometimes be obtained by performing correction only on an image as a separate step, prior to any further sharpening.
文件:
仅执行图像校正，不做进一步锐化。

BlurXTerminator 可校正有限量的运动模糊（导星误差）、像散、初级与次级彗差、各色彩通道 FWHM 不一致、色差（彩色镶边）以及不对称星晕。校正始终会执行，但有时把校正作为独立步骤、在任何进一步锐化之前单独处理一张图像，效果会更好。

FILE:
The amount to sharpen nonstellar image features.

Technically, BlurXTerminator will attempt to reduce the size of the PSF of nonstellar image features by up to the full diameter specified. In other words, setting this to 1.00 means to attempt to reduce the PSF to zero size, an ideal point-source PSF — the maximum possible amount of sharpening. The actual amount of sharpening achieved will be limited by the recoverable detail present in the image at fine pixel scales.
文件:
锐化非星点图像特征的程度。

从技术上说，BlurXTerminator 会尝试把非星点特征的 PSF 尺寸最多缩小所指定的整个直径。也就是说，设为 1.00 表示尝试把 PSF 缩到零尺寸，即理想的点源 PSF — 这是可能达到的最大锐化量。实际达到的锐化程度，受限于图像在精细像素尺度上可恢复的细节。

FILE:
Determines the nonstellar PSF automatically from the stars in the image. Stars must be present in all parts of the image for this to be accurate. If stars are not present, BlurXTerminator may attempt to adaptively determine the PSF from nonstellar image features. This can still work well on many images in a qualitative sense, but smooth features that happen to have a naturally blurry appearance may become over-sharpened.

Some images, particularly those taken at long focal lengths, may have areas with few stars. BlurXTerminator may over-sharpen the non-stellar features in these areas if the Automatic option is selected. In these cases, more accurate results can be obtained by switching to manual mode and setting the nonstellar PSF diameter to the known FWHM of stars in the image as a reasonable starting point.
文件:
根据图像中的星点自动确定非星点 PSF。要保证准确，图像各部位都必须有星点。若缺少星点，BlurXTerminator 可能会尝试从非星点特征自适应地推断 PSF。这在很多图像上定性效果尚可，但那些本身外观就自然模糊的平滑结构可能被过度锐化。

某些图像，尤其是长焦距拍摄的，可能有些区域星点稀少。若选择了「自动」选项，BlurXTerminator 可能把这类区域的非星点特征过度锐化。这种情况下，改为手动模式并把非星点 PSF 直径设为图像中已知的星点 FWHM 作为合理起点，可获得更准确的结果。

FILE:
Generates an "unscreened" stars-only image.

Unscreening is the inverse operation to the commonly-used "screen" blending operation. If a starless image will receive additional processing after star removal, unscreened stars can be "re-screened" onto this image with much better results than simply adding the stars-only image back to it.

Unscreening is not recommended for linear (unstretched) images.

With this setting unchecked, the stars-only image will be the simple arithmetic difference between the original and starless images, i.e., original - starless.

Stars can be re-screened onto a starless image using PixInsight's PixelMath:

~((~starless)*(~stars)),

where "starless" and "stars" are the names of the respective images. Photoshop's Screen blending mode performs the same operation.
文件:
生成"反滤色"的纯星点图像。

反滤色是常用"滤色"混合操作的逆运算。若去星后的无星图像还要继续处理，把反滤色的星点"重新滤色"合成到该图像上，效果远好于直接加回纯星点图像。

线性（未拉伸）图像不建议使用反滤色。

不勾选此项时，纯星点图像就是原始图像与无星图像的简单算术差，即 original - starless。

可用 PixInsight 的 PixelMath 把星点重新滤色合成到无星图像上：

~((~starless)*(~stars)),

其中 "starless" 与 "stars" 是相应图像的名称。Photoshop 的「滤色」混合模式执行同样的操作。

FILE:
Generates an "unscreened" stars image.

Unscreening is the inverse operation to the commonly-used "screen" blending operation. If a processed (feature-removed) image will receive additional processing, an unscreened stars image can be "re-screened" onto this image with much better results than simply adding the stars image back to it.

Unscreening is not recommended for linear (unstretched) images.

With this setting unchecked, the stars image will be the simple arithmetic difference between the original and processed images, i.e., original - processed.

The stars image can be re-screened onto a processed image using PixInsight's PixelMath:

~((~processed)*(~stars)),

where "processed" and "stars" are the names of the respective images. Photoshop's Screen blending mode performs the same operation.
文件:
生成"反滤色"的星点图像。

反滤色是常用"滤色"混合操作的逆运算。若已处理（去除过特征）的图像还要继续处理，把反滤色的星点图像"重新滤色"合成到该图像上，效果远好于直接加回星点图像。

线性（未拉伸）图像不建议使用反滤色。

不勾选此项时，星点图像就是原始图像与处理后图像的简单算术差，即 original - processed。

可用 PixInsight 的 PixelMath 把星点图像重新滤色合成到处理后图像上：

~((~processed)*(~stars)),

其中 "processed" 与 "stars" 是相应图像的名称。Photoshop 的「滤色」混合模式执行同样的操作。

that defines a keyword name and its associated value. This sequence can be contained in file names or full paths. When this option is enabled, the keyword values found in full paths or file names are used, ignoring the values possibly stored in FITS headers.

重叠区域很大时可增大此项。样本数量越多，曲面样条的理论最高分辨率越高。但小的未合并样本噪声更大，需要更多平滑。默认值通常是个不错的折中。

Hue - shifts each colour toward its neighbours without changing how bright or saturated it is. Saturation - makes that colour more or less vivid; at -100 it goes fully neutral. Luminance - brightens or darkens only the pixels of that colour, keeping the hue.

色相——把每种颜色向相邻色相偏移，不改变其亮度或饱和度。饱和度——使该颜色更鲜艳或更暗淡；取 -100 时完全变为中性。亮度——仅使该颜色的像素变亮或变暗，保持色相不变。

FILE: For a linear solution the two are the same thing. Raise it until the number of matched stars stops growing.

FILE:
This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels will be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can prevent a valid image registration.

To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件:
这是星点检测器在结构检测阶段之前所施加的中值滤波半径（像素）。中值滤波去除热像素非常有效。热像素会被误判为星点，若大量存在可能使图像配准失败。

要禁用热像素去除，请把此参数设为零。

FILE:
Choose a reference image with a small and simple gradient that's not too badly affected by satellite trails.

The images are sorted by NWEIGHT. To make the comparisons fair and meaningful, the target images are corrected for both scale and offset to the reference image. The same stretch is then applied to all images. The gradients are not removed.
文件:
请选择梯度小而简单、且受卫星轨迹影响不太严重的参考图像。

图像按 NWEIGHT 排序。为使比较公平有意义，目标图像都相对参考图像做了比例与偏移校正，随后对所有图像施加相同的拉伸。梯度不会被去除。

FILE:
If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects.

In general, sources with several local maxima pose difficulties for the determination of accurate star positions and PSF parameters, although this is usually a minor problem for scale evaluation. For this reason this parameter is enabled by default.
文件:
启用此参数后，无法分离的复合源可作为单个目标自由检出。

一般而言，具有多个局部极值的源会给精确定位星点位置和 PSF 参数带来困难，尽管这对比例尺评估通常只是小问题。因此此参数默认启用。

FILE:
If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects. This can be necessary in special cases where extreme high noise levels and/or distortion of stellar images caused by optical aberrations limit the number of detectable sources excessively, preventing image registration.

The default state is disabled.
文件:
启用此参数后，无法分离的复合源可作为单个目标自由检出。在极端高噪声与/或光学像差导致恒星像畸变、使可检测源数量过少而无法配准的特殊情况下，这可能确有必要。

默认状态为禁用。

此选项显示重叠区域。绿线（叠加模式）显示马赛克接缝的路径。绿矩形（混合或平均模式）显示接缝区域。

绿线/绿矩形靠参考一侧的区域将由参考像素替换。绿线/绿矩形的另一侧则逐渐过渡到更平滑的目标图像校正。

FILE: When this option is enabled, a valid astrometric solution is inherited if it exists in the L (lightness) source image. If a valid solution does not exist in the L image, or if the L image is disabled, the process looks for a valid astrometric solution in one of the other enabled source images. FILE:
The smaller the value the more localized is the gradient evaluation, as a drawback if this step is too small the cost variation could be too small to produce a significant gradient.

The default works well in the aveage case, you may need to increase this value for a large set of images where a small change in a weight of a single image produce a too small variation.
文件:
值越小，梯度评估越局部化；但若步长过小，代价变化可能太小而无法产生显著梯度。

默认值在一般情况下即可。若图像集很大，且单幅图像权重的微小变化引起的差异过小，可能需要增大此值。

FILE:
Positive values produce brighter halos with larger extents, giving stars a softer appearance. Negative values reduce halo brightness and extent, giving stars a sharper appearance.

Since the color of stars with saturated (clipped) cores is visible only in their halos, reducing the diameter of stars while also increasing their halos can help retain or emphasize star color.
文件:
正值使星晕更亮、范围更大，星点外观更柔和；负值降低星晕亮度与范围，星点外观更锐利。

由于核心饱和（截断）的星点，其颜色只能从星晕中看出，因此在缩小星点直径的同时增大星晕，有助于保留或强调星点颜色。

FILE:
No rejection. No pixel rejection will be performed.

Scale rejection. Pixels whose distance from the pixel set location exceeds a prescribed value in pixel set scale units are rejected. The location and scale measures are defined by the median and the Rousseeuw/Croux Sn scale parameter. The scale rejection method requires a set of 5 or more frames.

不剔除。不执行任何像素剔除。

尺度剔除。与像素集位置的距离超过指定像素集尺度单位倍数的像素会被剔除。位置与尺度度量由中位数和 Rousseeuw/Croux Sn 尺度参数定义。尺度剔除法需要 5 帧以上。

FILE:
Samples are binned to improve performance if the number of samples exceed the specified limit.

The area of each binned sample represents the number of samples it was created from.

Each binned sample's center is calculated from the center of mass of the samples it was created from.

To see which of the unbinned samples were rejected due to stars, use 'Sample grid'.
文件:
若样本数超过指定上限，则对样本进行合并以提高性能。

每个合并样本的中心由其来源样本的质心计算得出。

要查看哪些未合并样本因星点被剔除，请使用「样本网格」。

Gaps indicate 'almost black' areas. It is essential that these areas are removed. Quit this script and use PixelMath to remove them. For example, if the 'almost black' area has a peak value of 0.0003, the required PixelMath expression is:

iif($T < 0.0004 ? 0 : $T)
文件:
该线应贴合图像的非零轮廓。请检查线与图像之间是否有空隙。

空隙表示「几乎全黑」区域，必须去除。请退出本脚本并用 PixelMath 去除。例如「几乎全黑」区域峰值为 0.0003 时，所需表达式为：

iif($T < 0.0004 ? 0 : $T)

Mask regions keep their real positions on the image either way.

在预览上按住 Shift 拖动可框出一个矩形，仅以全分辨率显示该部分——处理快，且看到的是真实细节而非降采样渲染。你的调整是全局的，会作用于整幅图像；此按钮恢复整幅图像，并用你设定的全部参数重新渲染。

Create a process icon to run without opening the dialog.

There are several reasons we reject based on sky conditions. Light pollution usually includes gradients, which may become difficult to remove. High levels of light pollution also tend to reveal flat field errors.

If the only problem with an image is its lower SNR, then it will still improve the final integrated image SNR. This works because NSG uses a very accurate 'SNR squared' weight algorithm.
文件:
基于天空条件剔除有几个原因。光污染通常伴随梯度，可能难以去除。严重的光污染还容易暴露平场误差。

若某幅图像唯一的问题是 SNR 较低，它仍会改善最终叠加图像的 SNR。这是因为 NSG 使用了非常精确的「SNR 平方」权重算法。

FILE: The standard StarAlignment process provides many more options and parameters to control how distortion corrections are calculated and applied. A surface spline is constructed from the generated samples to model the relative gradient between the reference and target images.

用生成的样本构建曲面样条，以建模参考图像与目标图像之间的相对梯度。

FILE: The script uses a special cache to store VizieR catalog query results. This saves considerable time by avoiding unnecessary network transfers. However, sometimes a query fails because of a temporary problem, but still returns a result that the script cannot recognize as invalid. In these cases this action resets the internal cache, so that new queries can be sent to the VizieR server to retrieve valid data.
文件: 本脚本使用专用缓存存储 VizieR 星表查询结果，可避免不必要的网络传输，大幅节省时间。但有时查询因临时问题失败，却仍返回了脚本无法识别为无效的结果。遇到这种情况，此操作会重置内部缓存，以便向 VizieR 服务器发送新查询获取有效数据。

FILE:

The color of the variable star is its catalog color index with one band, and its measured color with two bands. Without a color for the variable star, or with one outside that range, no color term is applied to any star.

PSF SNR promotes images with higher SNR, measured in terms of the ratio between the star flux and the noise of the area surrounding each measured star.

A detection image measures the stars of the detection image, fitting their PSFs on every image where they are expected. A star whose fit fails is measured at its expected position with the PSF of the image. This is how a long series of noisy frames, such as those of an exoplanet transit, is measured, and what a light curve needs.

A photometric catalog needs celestial coordinates on every image: an astrometric solution, or else a solved detection image.

This parameter can be used in three ways:

* Automatic mode. A zero value enables an adaptive algorithm to find an optimal minimum structure size using statistical analysis techniques. This is the default option.

* Disabled. A value of one turns off minimum structure size rejection since no detectable star can be represented by less than one pixel.

* Literal value. A value > 1 forces using the specified minimum structure size in square pixels.

此参数有三种用法：

* 禁用。取值为一时关闭最小结构尺寸剔除，因为任何可检测的星点都不可能小于一个像素。

Star matches are rejected if the difference in star flux is larger than expected. The algorithm first calculates the average scale difference, and then rejects matches if their brightness ratio is greater than (expected ratio * tolerance) or smaller than (expected ratio / tolerance)

1.0 implies the star flux ratio must exactly match the expected ratio.

2.0 implies that the ratio can be double or half the expected ratio.

You usually don't need to modify this parameter.
文件:
若星点通量差异超出预期，则剔除该星点匹配。算法先计算平均比例差异，然后在亮度比大于（期望比 × 容差）或小于（期望比 / 容差）时剔除该匹配。

取 1.0 表示星点通量比必须与期望比值完全一致。

取 2.0 表示该比值可为期望值的两倍或一半。

通常无需修改此参数。

Unscreening is not recommended for linear (unstretched) images.

With this setting unchecked, the stars-only image will be the simple arithmetic difference between the original and starless images, i.e., original - starless.

Stars can be re-screened onto a starless image using PixInsight's PixelMath:

~((~starless)*(~stars)),

where "starless" and "stars" are the names of the respective images. Photoshop's Screen blending mode performs the same operation.

FILE: If you decrease this parameter, stars will need to have stronger (or more prominent) peaks to be detected. This is useful to prevent detection of saturated stars, as well as small nonstellar features. By increasing this parameter, the star detection algorithm will be more sensitive to peakedness, and hence more tolerant with relatively flat image features. The default value is 0.5. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.

Global + per image, the default, adds to the global surface a smoothing surface spline fitted on each image to the differences between the zero points and the global surface, for the gradients that change, such as those of the differential extinction or of passing clouds.

A local model fitted to fewer than 100 stars is reported: multiplicative gradients are unstable, and so are models of them made from few stars.

The global models need the positions of the stars on the images, which AperturePhotometry writes to its data tables.

用少于 100 颗星拟合的局部模型会被报告：乘性梯度本身不稳定，用少量星点建立的模型同样不稳定。

全局模型需要星点在图像上的位置，这由 AperturePhotometry 写入其数据表。

An annulus takes it from a ring around the star. The ring follows the size of each star rather than a fixed radius.

In both cases, other stars are rejected first, and the level is a robust estimate of what remains.

Stabilized median takes it by adaptive median stabilization: the median of a square centered on the star, starting at its sampling region and grown a pixel at a time until the median stops decreasing. The star occupies a shrinking fraction of the square, so the median falls to the level of the background and stays there.

环带从星点周围的环中取得。该环跟随每颗星的大小，而非固定半径。

Stars are matched using the solution being analyzed, so this tolerance has to exceed the residual of that solution, not the distortion being measured. For a solution with a distortion model the residual is a fraction of a pixel and the default is ample.

Its residual is the whole uncorrected distortion, so a tolerance smaller than the displacement of the outer regions will fail to match the very stars that carry the most distortion, and the field will be measured only where it is already small. Raise it until the number of matched stars stops growing.

A photometric catalog measures the stars found on each image that it identifies within its magnitude limits, and gives them catalog magnitudes, which a zero point can be calibrated against.

A detection image measures the stars of the detection image, fitting their PSFs on every image where they are expected. A star whose fit fails is measured at its expected position with the PSF of the image. This is how a long series of noisy frames, such as those of an exoplanet transit, is measured, and what a light curve needs.

A photometric catalog needs celestial coordinates on every image: an astrometric solution, or else a solved detection image.

The displayed weight is adjusted for exposure time. These exposure scaled weights represent the sky conditions. We want to reject images that were badly affected by light pollution or clouds, but we don't want to reject images just because they had a shorter exposure.

There are several reasons we reject based on sky conditions. Light pollution usually includes gradients, which may become difficult to remove. High levels of light pollution also tend to reveal flat field errors.

If the only problem with an image is its lower SNR, then it will still improve the final integrated image SNR. This works because NSG uses a very accurate 'SNR squared' weight algorithm.

An automatic circular aperture is computed for each image from the robust mean FWHM of its stars, with the diameter given below, and is the same for every star of the image. It follows the seeing from one image to the next, and needs no radius to be chosen for each instrument or night. This is the default.

In both cases the flux is the sum of the actual pixels over the region, above the local background. The fitted function is never integrated in place of the data.

When a variable-order polyharmonic RBF is selected, the function order can be selected from 2 to 6. High-order surface splines compute interpolation/regularization functions that are continuously differentiable up to the specified order and, hence, can more accurately model complex distortions. However, high-order splines, especially of orders above 4, are numerically more unstable and can lead to errors caused by ill-conditioned linear systems.

The recommended options are:

  • DDM thin plate splines (implicitly of second order) for distortion correction under normal conditions. This is the default option.
  • 3rd or 4th order DDM variable-order polyharmonic RBFs for correction of complex distortions with maximum accuracy.

Gradients are often stronger along the edges of an image, where they need a smaller gradient scale than the rest of the image. The gradient models are also computed at half, a quarter and an eighth of the gradient scale, as many as the aggressiveness (never below 128 pixels); each model replaces the previous one on a frame along the edges as wide as its scale, with a smooth transition. On a mosaic, the frames follow the edges of its coverage. The rest of the image is not changed. The scale factors are the same for all scales.

The gradient correction of the frames never uses it: in a mosaic, the edges of a frame are mostly seams, where smaller scales would model as gradients the bright structures that the seams cross.

Disabled by default. The default aggressiveness is 2.

The main drawback of the Lanczos and bicubic spline interpolation algorithms is generation of strong undershoot (ringing) artifacts. This is caused by negative lobes of the interpolation functions falling over high-contrast edges and isolated bright pixels. This usually happens with linear data, such as raw CCD and DSLR images, and rarely with nonlinear or stretched images.

In the current PixInsight/PCL implementations of these algorithms we have included a clamping mechanism that prevents negative interpolated values and ringing artifacts for most images. This parameter represents a threshold value to trigger interpolation clamping. A lower threshold leads to a more aggressive deringing effect; however, too low of a clamping threshold can degrade interpolation performance, especially in terms of aliasing and detail preservation.

Global fits a single surface fixed to the detector to the zero points of all the images: errors of the flat field and vignetting, which follow the detector through dithering and meridian flips. It adds almost no noise, but it cannot follow gradients that change from image to image.

Global + per image, the default, adds to the global surface a smoothing surface spline fitted on each image to the differences between the zero points and the global surface, for the gradients that change, such as those of the differential extinction or of passing clouds.

A local model fitted to fewer than 100 stars is reported: multiplicative gradients are unstable, and so are models of them made from few stars.

The global models need the positions of the stars on the images, which AperturePhotometry writes to its data tables.

全局 + 逐图像（默认）在全局曲面上为每幅图像增加一个平滑曲面样条，拟合零点与全局曲面之间的差异，用于跟随会变化的梯度，例如差分消光或过云引起的梯度。

用少于 100 颗星拟合的局部模型会被报告：乘性梯度本就不稳定，用少量星点建立的此类模型同样如此。

全局模型需要星点在图像上的位置，AperturePhotometry 会把它们写入其数据表。

Internally, the sensitivity of the star detection algorithm is expressed in signal-to-noise ratio units with respect to the evaluated dispersion of local background pixels for each detected structure. Given a source with estimated brightness s, local background b and local background dispersion n, sensitivity is the minimum value of (s - b)/n necessary to trigger star detection.

To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum sensitivity, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.

Increase this parameter to favor detection of fainter stars. Decrease it to restrict detection to brighter stars. The default value is 0.5.

为将此接口与内部实现隔离，此参数被归一化到 [0,1] 区间，其中 0 与 1 分别表示最小与最大灵敏度。这种抽象允许我们在不破坏依赖工具与进程的情况下更换星点检测引擎。

This parameter can be used to prevent the detection of small and bright image artifacts wrongly as stars. This can be useful to work with uncalibrated or poorly calibrated data, especially demosaiced CFA frames where uncorrected hot pixels have generated large bright artifacts that cannot be removed with a median filter (i.e., the Hot pixel removal parameter), or for rejection of cosmic rays.

This parameter can be used in three ways:

* Automatic mode. A zero value enables an adaptive algorithm to find an optimal minimum structure size using statistical analysis techniques. This is the default option.

* Disabled. A value of one turns off minimum structure size rejection since no detectable star can be represented by less than one pixel.

* Literal value. A value > 1 forces using the specified minimum structure size in square pixels.

A two-dimensional projective transformation, or homography, is a line-preserving geometric transformation between two sets of points in the plane. Homographies can model translations, rotations, reflections, scale changes and shearing in any order.

By default, StarAlignment computes homographies to model complex linear image registration transformations with the maximum accuracy. However, with only 3 degrees of freedom, rigid transformations can be more robust and faster, requiring fewer RANSAC iterations even when dealing with a high proportion of outliers in the initial set of putative star pair matches.

Note that this option is relevant for all registration models, including linear and nonlinear models with arbitrary distortion correction using surface splines. In the latter case, a linear model is always necessary to build an initial registration transformation before modeling distortions.

默认情况下，StarAlignment 计算单应变换，以最高精度建模复杂的线性图像配准变换。然而刚性变换只有 3 个自由度，可以更稳健、更快，即使在初始假定星对匹配集中离群比例很高时也需要更少的 RANSAC 迭代。

注意此选项对所有配准模型都适用，包括使用曲面样条的任意畸变校正的线性与非线性模型。在后一种情况下，建模畸变之前总需要一个线性模型来建立初始配准变换。

When this option is enabled, a PSF Signal Weight, PSF SNR or SNR measurement is abnormal when it is greater than the upper quartile of its group divided by the protection threshold parameter. Abnormally weighted frames receive the median weight of their group, unless the reject abnormally weighted frames option is enabled. They are never used as reference frames for registration or local normalization. The integration applies the same protection to each channel of color images.

Abnormal weights are identified in up to one fourth of the frames of a group. Groups where most frames have much lower weights than the best ones, for example frames acquired through clouds, are protected correctly. However, this option assumes that the best frames of a group have similar weights. Disable it to integrate frames whose weights are expected to differ greatly, for example frames of very different exposure times grouped together.

When distortion correction is enabled, two-dimensional surface splines will be used with second-order polyharmonic radial basis functions (also known as thin plates) to compute a distortion model and interpolate source pixel coordinates. Surface splines provide extremely adaptable registration models for registering images affected by differential distortions. Differential distortions arise frequently in the registration of significantly displaced or rotated frames, as usually happens when some frames have been acquired with the field rotated due to a meridian flip.

The standard StarAlignment process provides many more options and parameters to control how distortion corrections are calculated and applied. Although the limited control provided in the WBPP script is more than sufficient in most practical cases, in really complex cases, you may need to turn off image registration in this script and perform the registration task manually after calibration/demosaicing.

When this option is applied, a special FFT-based algorithm is used to precompute the intersection region between the reference star field and the set of detected stars in the target image during the initial alignment task. Once the intersection has been found, the initial star matching process is restricted to the intersection area. This greatly improves the performance of the RANSAC algorithm by reducing the fraction of outliers (false putative matches) in the initial set of star pair matches. This feature is recommended for images with elongated geometries, especially when the aspect ratio (the quotient between the longest and shortest sides of the image) is approximately greater than two, as well as for problematic images with abnormally scarce detectable stars.

The Never option will turn off intersection computation. Automatic will calculate intersection regions only when the image's aspect ratio is greater than 2:1. Always will force intersection computations in all cases.

Second-order polyharmonic radial basis functions, also known as thin plate splines, allow for generating extremely adaptable numerical models for images affected by strong field distortions. However, in cases of extremely complex arbitrary distortions, higher-order functions can be necessary to model them accurately.

When a variable-order polyharmonic RBF is selected, the function order can be selected from 2 to 6. High-order surface splines compute interpolation/regularization functions that are continuously differentiable up to the specified order and, hence, can more accurately model complex distortions. However, high-order splines, especially of orders above 4, are numerically more unstable and can lead to errors caused by ill-conditioned linear systems.

The recommended options are:

  • DDM thin plate splines (implicitly of second order) for distortion correction under normal conditions. This is the default option.
  • 3rd order DDM variable-order polyharmonic or 4th order variable-order polyharmonic RBFs for correction

Lanczos is, in general, the best interpolation algorithm for image registration of linear images when no large scale changes are required. Lanczos has excellent detail preservation and subpixel registration performance with minimal generation of aliasing effects. Its main drawback is generation of undershoot (ringing) artifacts, but this problem can be fixed in most cases with the implemented clamping mechanism (see the clamping threshold parameter below).

Bicubic spline is an excellent interpolation algorithm in terms of accuracy and execution speed. As Lanczos interpolation, bicubic spline generates ringing artifacts, but the implemented clamping mechanism can usually fix most of them. The main problem with bicubic spline is generation of aliasing effects, such as moire patterns, which can be problematic with noisy images, especially on sky background areas. This is one of the reasons why Lanczos is in general the preferred option.

Second-order polyharmonic radial basis functions, also known as thin plate splines, allow for generating extremely adaptable numerical models for images affected by strong field distortions. However, in cases of extremely complex arbitrary distortions, higher-order functions can be necessary to model them accurately.

When a variable-order polyharmonic RBF is selected, the function order can be selected from 2 to 6. High-order surface splines compute interpolation/regularization functions that are continuously differentiable up to the specified order and, hence, can more accurately model complex distortions. However, high-order splines, especially of orders above 4, are numerically more unstable and can lead to errors caused by ill-conditioned linear systems.

The recommended options are:

  • DDM thin plate splines (implicitly of second order) for distortion correction under normal conditions. This is the default option.
  • 3rd or 4th order DDM variable-order polyharmonic RBFs for correction of complex distortions with maximum accuracy.

Linear fit clipping fits each pixel stack to a straight line. The linear fit is optimized in the twofold sense of minimizing average absolute deviation and maximizing inliers. This rejection algorithm is more robust than sigma clipping for large sets of images, especially in presence of additive sky gradients of varying intensity and spatial distribution. For the best performance, use this algorithm for large sets of at least 15 images. Five images is the minimum required.

The Generalized Extreme Studentized Deviate (ESD) rejection algorithm is an implementation of the method described by Bernard Rosner in his 1983 paper Percentage Points for a Generalized ESD Many-Outlier procedure, adapted to the image integration task. The ESD algorithm assumes that each pixel stack, in absence of outliers, follows an approximately normal (Gaussian) distribution. It aims at avoiding masking, a serious issue that occurs when an outlier goes undetected because its value is similar to another outlier. The performance of this algorithm is excellent for data sets of 15 or more

Internally, the peak response property of the star detection algorithm is expressed in kurtosis units. For each detected structure, kurtosis is evaluated from all significant pixels with values greater than the estimated mean local background. Peak response is the minimum value of kurtosis necessary to trigger star detection.

To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum peak response, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.

If you decrease this parameter, stars will need to have stronger (or more prominent) peaks to be detected. This is useful to prevent detection of saturated stars, as well as small nonstellar features. By increasing this parameter, the star detection algorithm will be more sensitive to peakedness, and hence more tolerant with relatively flat image features. The default value is 0.5. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.

在内部，星点检测算法的峰值响应属性以峰度单位表示。对每个被检测结构，峰度由所有数值大于估计局部背景均值的显著像素评估。峰值响应就是触发星点检测所需峰度的最小值。

为将此接口与内部实现隔离，此参数被归一化到 [0,1] 区间，其中 0 与 1 分别表示最小与最大峰值响应。这种抽象允许我们在不破坏依赖工具与进程的情况下更换星点检测引擎。

减小此参数时，星点需要具有更强（或更突出）的峰值才会被检测到。这有助于防止检测到饱和星点以及小的非星点特征。增大此参数时，星点检测算法对峰度更敏感，因而对相对平坦的图像特征更宽容。默认值为 0.5。一般情况下，正常工作条件下无需改动此默认值。

A two-dimensional rigid transformation, or Euclidean transformation, preserves the Euclidean distance between every pair of transformed points. Rigid transformations may include rotations, translations and reflections in any order.

A two-dimensional projective transformation, or homography, is a line-preserving geometric transformation between two sets of points in the plane. Homographies can model translations, rotations, reflections, scale changes and shearing in any order.

By default, StarAlignment computes homographies to model complex linear image registration transformations with the maximum accuracy. However, with only 3 degrees of freedom, rigid transformations can be more robust and faster, requiring fewer RANSAC iterations even when dealing with a high proportion of outliers in the initial set of putative star pair matches.

Note that this option is relevant for all registration models, including linear and nonlinear models with arbitrary distortion correction using surface splines. In the latter case, a linear model is always necessary to build an initial registration transformation before modeling distortions.

二维刚性变换，或称欧氏变换，保持每对变换后点之间的欧氏距离。刚性变换可按任意顺序包含旋转、平移与反射。

二维射影变换，或称单应变换，是平面内两组点之间保持直线的几何变换。单应变换可按任意顺序建模平移、旋转、反射、缩放与剪切。

默认情况下，StarAlignment 计算单应变换，以最高精度建模复杂的线性图像配准变换。然而刚性变换只有 3 个自由度，可以更稳健、更快，即使在初始假定星对匹配集中离群比例很高时也需要更少的 RANSAC 迭代。

注意此选项对所有配准模型都适用，包括使用曲面样条的任意畸变校正的线性与非线性模型。在后一种情况下，建模畸变之前总需要一个线性模型来建立初始配准变换。

For generation of astrometric solutions in the International Celestial Reference System (ICRS), the observation location is only used to compute diurnal parallax corrections, which are very small for distant objects and hence can be neglected in most practical applications.

For astrometric solutions in the Geocentric Celestial Reference System (GCRS), the geodetic coordinates of the observer are used to compute diurnal aberration and parallax corrections. Diurnal aberration is caused by the velocity of the observer on or near the surface of the rotating Earth. The effect of diurnal aberration is relatively small (a maximum of about 0.32 arcseconds for an observer at the Equator), but not negligible for astrometric solutions in the GCRS.

Besides generation of astrometric solutions in different coordinate reference systems, the position of the observer is necessary to find and annotate solar system bodies accurately in astrometrically solved images.

All of the corrections and procedures described above require accurate geodetic coordinates of the observation location: longitude and latitude in degrees and height in meters, as specified in the controls below.

A recursive surface spline subdivides the image with a quadtree and generates a surface spline for each region and its neighborhood, blending them as a partition of unity into a surface that is continuous up to the second derivative. This allows the solution to use all the matched stars, tens or hundreds of thousands of them, in a fraction of a second, with no limit on the number of control points. The radial basis function and the maximum spline points parameters are not used in this mode; the smoothing factor and the spline order are. When surface simplifiers are enabled, the simplifier's outlier rejection is applied to the control points before the splines are generated, with the specified rejection fraction.

Astrometric solutions are serialized with the standard set of XISF AstrometricSolution properties, which describe the distortion model itself, so the core application restores the solution exactly when the image is loaded, without regeneration. This applies to every solution generated by this version of ImageSolver, with or without this option. Previous versions of PixInsight do not recognize this format and load such images without an astrometric solution.

This option is disabled by default.

递归曲面样条用四叉树细分图像，为每个区域及其邻域生成曲面样条，并以单位分解把它们混合成可连续微分至二阶导数的曲面。这使解能够使用全部匹配星点（数万到数十万颗），在几分之一秒内完成，且控制点数量没有限制。此模式下不使用径向基函数与最大样条点数参数；使用平滑因子与样条阶数。启用曲面简化器时，在生成样条之前会先按指定的剔除比例对控制点施加简化器的离群剔除。

此选项默认禁用。

Image weights are relative to the best frame of each group. A frame with an abnormally high weight, usually caused by spurious data or wrong metadata, makes the rest of the frames look bad. This can lead to rejecting valuable data, even entire data sets, through the minimum weight parameter.

When this option is enabled, a PSF Signal Weight, PSF SNR or SNR measurement is abnormal when it is greater than the upper quartile of its group divided by the protection threshold parameter. Abnormally weighted frames receive the median weight of their group, unless the reject abnormally weighted frames option is enabled. They are never used as reference frames for registration or local normalization. The integration applies the same protection to each channel of color images.

Abnormal weights are identified in up to one fourth of the frames of a group. Groups where most frames have much lower weights than the best ones, for example frames acquired through clouds, are protected correctly. However, this option assumes that the best frames of a group have similar weights. Disable it to integrate frames whose weights are expected to differ greatly, for example frames of very different exposure times grouped together.

If distortion correction is disabled, a linear transformation (either a projective transformation or homography or a rigid transformation, will be used to compute source pixel coordinates. This is appropriate for general image registration tasks with significant overlapping between registered images without differential distortion. This is the default option.

When distortion correction is enabled, two-dimensional surface splines will be used with second-order polyharmonic radial basis functions (also known as thin plates) to compute a distortion model and interpolate source pixel coordinates. Surface splines provide extremely adaptable registration models for registering images affected by differential distortions. Differential distortions arise frequently in the registration of significantly displaced or rotated frames, as usually happens when some frames have been acquired with the field rotated due to a meridian flip.

The standard StarAlignment process provides many more options and parameters to control how distortion corrections are calculated and applied. Although the limited control provided in the WBPP script is more than sufficient in most practical cases, in really complex cases, you may need to turn off image registration in this script and perform the registration task manually after calibration/demosaicing.

If distortion correction is disabled, a linear transformation (either a projective transformation or homography or a rigid transformation, will be used to compute source pixel coordinates. This is appropriate for general image registration tasks with significant overlapping between registered images without differential distortion. This is the default option.

When distortion correction is enabled, two-dimensional surface splines will be used with second-order polyharmonic radial basis functions (also known as thin plates) to compute a distortion model and interpolate source pixel coordinates. Surface splines provide extremely adaptable registration models for registering images affected by differential distortions. Differential distortions arise frequently in the registration of significantly displaced or rotated frames, as usually happens when some frames have been acquired with the field rotated due to a meridian flip.

The standard StarAlignment process provides many more options and parameters to control how distortion corrections are calculated and applied. Although the limited control provided in the WBPP script is more than sufficient in most practical cases, in really complex cases, you may need to turn off image registration in this script and perform the registration task manually after calibration/demosaicing.
