The default automatic mode will select the following interpolation algorithms as a function of the rescaling involved in the registration geometrical transformation:

  • Cubic B-spline filter interpolation when the scaling factor is under 0.25 approximately.
  • Mitchell-Netravali filter interpolation for scaling factors between 0.6 and 0.25 approx.
  • Lanczos-3 interpolation in the rest of cases: from moderate size reductions to no rescaling or rescaling up.

Lanczos is, in general, the best interpolation algorithm for image registration of linear images when no large scale changes are required. Lanczos has excellent detail preservation and subpixel registration performance with minimal generation of aliasing effects. Its main drawback is generation of undershoot (ringing) artifacts, but this problem can be fixed in most cases with the implemented clamping mechanism (see the clamping threshold parameter below).

Bicubic spline is an excellent interpolation algorithm in terms of accuracy and execution speed. As Lanczos interpolation, bicubic spline generates ringing artifacts, but the implemented clamping mechanism can usually fix most of them. The main problem with bicubic spline is generation of aliasing effects, such as moire patterns, which can be problematic with noisy images, especially on sky background areas. This is one of the reasons why Lanczos is in general the preferred option.

FILE: Upper bound of the set of background reference pixels, measured in sigma units from the the median of the background reference for each nominal channel. 文件: 背景参考像素集合的上界，以各标称通道背景参考中值的 sigma 为单位。大于或等于此上界的背景参考像素在计算平均背景电平时被剔除。

FILE: Specifies the percentage of the brightest detected stars that will be used to create the star mask.
文件: 指定用于生成星点蒙版的最亮检测星点百分比。

FILE:

文件:
0% 生成不含星点的实心蒙版。
100% 生成包含所有检测星点的蒙版。

FILE: Runs the integration of the current best frames to generate a local normalization reference image candidate.
文件: 叠加当前最佳帧以生成局部归一化参考图像候选。

FILE: The integration is performed applying the additive+scaling global output normalization.
文件: 叠加采用「加法+缩放」的全局输出归一化。

文件: 本节决定用哪些采样来建立重叠区域的相对梯度模型，从而决定应用于重叠区域的梯度校正。

FILE: Auto white balance - one click. Finds the neutral (grey) areas of the subject automatically, balances the colour to remove a cast, and sets Temp / Tint to match.
文件: 自动白平衡——一键完成。自动找出主体的中性（灰色）区域，平衡色彩去除偏色，并设定 Temp / Tint。

FILE: If this option is enabled, the PIDoc compiler will generate output documentation files in HTML 5 or XHTML format, integrated with the specified PIDoc target system. 文件: 启用此选项时，PIDoc 编译器会生成与指定 PIDoc 目标系统集成的 HTML 5 或 XHTML 格式输出文档；否则只编译源文件而不生成输出。禁用此选项可用于语法校验。

FILE: This section generates samples used to model the relative gradient between the reference and target images.
文件: 本节生成用于建立参考与目标图像之间相对梯度模型的采样。

FILE: The image is divided up into a grid of sample squares. A sample's value is the median of the pixels it contains.
文件: 图像被划分为采样方格网格，采样值为其所含像素的中值。

FILE: The vertical axis represents the difference between the two images, the horizontal axis the join's X-Coordinate (horizontal join) or Y-Coordinate (vertical join).
文件: 纵轴表示两幅图像之差，横轴为拼接线的 X 坐标（水平拼接）或 Y 坐标（垂直拼接）。

FILE: The log file to analyze. WBPP and FBPP write their log files to the logs subdirectory of their output directories, one file for each execution, named after the time of the execution (for example, 20261025114640.log).
文件: 要分析的日志文件。WBPP 与 FBPP 把日志写到输出目录的 logs 子目录，每次执行一个文件，按执行时间命名（例如 20261025114640.log）。

文件: 新建实例。拖到工作区可创建保存当前设置的进程图标。

文件: 脚本会解算一组图像文件，并发处理，每线程一个文件。

文件: 通常无需设定结果文件，它会自动保存在 NSG 设置中。

文件: 报告与光变曲线的日期，取每次曝光中点：UTC 日期时间（AAVSO 报告的 EXCEL 格式）、儒略日（UTC）、日心儒略日（UTC）或质心儒略日（TDB）。

FILE: The smoothness of the curve fitted to the light curve, from 0 to 1. At 0.5, the default, the curve has the bandwidth that predicts the measurements best. Toward 1 it shows only the variations that the data prove beyond doubt; toward 0, shorter and fainter variations, and more of the noise.
文件: 光变曲线拟合曲线的平滑度，范围 0 到 1。默认 0.5 时曲线带宽对测量值的预测最佳；趋近 1 只显示数据确凿无疑的变化，趋近 0 则显示更短更弱的变化以及更多噪声。

FILE: Leave out of the ensemble the stars that disagree with the rest: their mean offset between catalog and instrumental magnitudes is too far from those of the other stars, or their offsets scatter too much from image to image. Saturated and blended stars, variable stars and wrong catalog magnitudes are caught this way.
文件: 把与其余恒星不一致的星排除出集合：其星表星等与仪器星等之间的平均偏移偏离其他星过远，或偏移在各图像间散布过大。饱和星、重叠星、变星及错误的星表星等都可由此检出。

FILE: A value is abnormal when it deviates from the median of its group by more than this number of robust standard deviations (1.4826 times the median absolute deviation), and by a difference of practical significance (for example, 20% of the median FWHM of the group).
文件: 当某值偏离本组中位数超过此数量的稳健标准差（1.4826 倍中值绝对偏差），且差值具有实际意义（例如本组中位 FWHM 的 20%）时，判为异常。

FILE: Number all tables by default. If this option is enabled, all tables will be numbered unless the \ able[unnumbered] parameter is specified. 文件: 默认为所有表格编号。启用时，除非指定 \ able[unnumbered] 参数，所有表格都会编号；禁用时，只有带 \ able[numbered] 参数的表格编号。也可在 PIDoc 源码中用 \pragma 命令参数控制默认表格编号。

FILE: Some catalogs say which of their magnitudes are reliable. Stars whose magnitude in the band of the observation is not validated are left out of the ensemble unless this option is enabled.
文件: 有些星表会标明其哪些星等可靠。若未启用此选项，观测波段星等未经确认的恒星会被排除出集合。

FILE: Reuse the renditions of equations from previous compilations. Every rendered equation is stored in a cache, identified by its LaTeX source code and its size, and an unchanged equation is never rendered again, which makes recompiling a document with many equations much faster. The cache is shared by all documents and all running instances of PixInsight.
文件: 复用以前编译中已渲染的公式。每个渲染过的公式按 LaTeX 源码与尺寸存入缓存，未改动的公式不再重新渲染，使含大量公式的文档重新编译快得多。缓存由所有文档及所有运行中的 PixInsight 实例共享。

FILE: Number all figures by default. If this option is enabled, all figures will be numbered unless the \figure[unnumbered] parameter is specified. If this option is disabled, only figures with the \figure[numbered] parameter will be numbered. Note that you can also control default figure numbering from PIDoc source code using \pragma command parameters.
文件: 默认为所有插图编号。启用时，除非指定 \figure[unnumbered] 参数，所有插图都会编号；禁用时，只有带 \figure[numbered] 参数的插图编号。也可在 PIDoc 源码中用 \pragma 命令参数控制默认插图编号。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels will be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can prevent a valid image registration.
文件: 这是星点检测器在结构检测阶段前所应用中值滤波器的半径（像素）。中值滤波对去除热像素非常有效；热像素会被误判为星点，数量较多时可能导致图像对齐失败。

FILE: Number of cells along the largest dimension of the image. The distortion is sampled at the center of each cell.
文件: 图像最大维度上的单元格数，畸变在每个单元格中心采样。

FILE: Edit the region of interest over the image shown in the preview: drag outside the region to draw a new one, inside it to move it, and on an edge or a corner to resize it. While this option is checked, the image is panned with the middle mouse button. Available while the preview shows an image.
文件: 在预览所示图像上编辑感兴趣区域：在区域外拖动可画新区域，区域内拖动可移动，在边或角上拖动可缩放。勾选此项时可用鼠标中键平移图像，仅在预览显示图像时可用。

FILE: Number all equations by default. If this option is enabled, all equations will be numbered unless the \equation[unnumbered] parameter is specified. If this option is disabled, only equations with the \equation[numbered] parameter will be numbered. Note that you can also control default equation numbering from PIDoc source code using \pragma command parameters.
文件: 默认为所有公式编号。启用时，除非指定 \equation[unnumbered] 参数，所有公式都会编号；禁用时，只有带 \equation[numbered] 参数的公式编号。也可在 PIDoc 源码中用 \pragma 命令参数控制默认公式编号。

FILE: Probability of making a type 1 error (false positive) in the generalized ESD rejection algorithm.
文件: 广义 ESD 剔除算法中犯第一类错误（假阳性）的概率。

FILE: The projection of the sky of the mosaic in mosaic frames mode. 文件: 马赛克帧模式下的天区投影。不勾选时按视场范围选择合适的投影：10 度以内用日晷投影，90 度以内用墨卡托，180 度以内用球极平面，更大范围用 Hammer-Aitoff。勾选时使用所选投影；高级可设定投影原点。

FILE: Scaling factor used to draw text elements on the annotated image.
文件: 在标注图像上绘制文字元素所用的缩放系数。

文件: 把当前蒙版——亮度蒙版（亮/暗、目标/保护、深度、强度）与任何选区区域组合——按图像全分辨率渲染为新的灰度图像窗口。可把它作为真实蒙版用于其他进程、保存，或仅用于检查。

FILE: The line should follow the non-zero outline of the image. Check for gaps between this line and the image.
文件: 该线应贴合图像的非零轮廓，请检查线与图像之间是否有空隙。

文件: 白平衡取色器——一键中和偏色。点击此按钮，再点击预览中应为中性灰或白的一点，R/G/B 通道会缩放使其直方图在该点对齐（真正的逐通道白平衡，类似 Lightroom 的吸管）。再次点击按钮可取消。

文件: 处理后保留并显示加权复合宽带图像。复合图按回归系数 k 缩放，使其恒星通量与窄带图像一致。若想对任一图像应用不同或不受支持的去星进程，此功能很有用，图像命名为 composite_bb_<nb>。

FILE: This suffix is appended to the name of each image file without a valid astrometric solution to form the name of the output XISF file with the computed linear solution, which is written to the output directory, or to the directory of the image file when no output directory has been specified.
文件: 此后缀追加到每个没有有效天文解算的图像文件名后，构成含所计算线性解的输出 XISF 文件名，写入输出目录；未指定输出目录时写入该图像文件所在目录。

FILE: The number of bits of the analog to digital converter of the camera, which relates the pixel values to its ADU for the gain: the full range of the data is 2bits - 1 ADU.
文件: 相机模数转换器的位数，用于按增益把像素值对应到 ADU：数据全范围为 2bits - 1 ADU。

FILE: Choose a reference image with a small and simple gradient that's not too badly affected by satellite trails.
文件: 请选择梯度小而简单、且不太受卫星轨迹影响的参考图像。

FILE: The minimum relative flux of an image, in percent, for the image to be part of the analysis. The relative flux of an image is the total flux of the comparison stars on it, in percent of its median over the images of its band: the values the light curve shows as the total flux. Images under the minimum, such as those taken through clouds, are left out of the selection of the comparison stars, of the light curve and of the report.
文件: 图像参与分析所需的最小相对通量（百分比）。图像的相对通量为其上比较星的总通量，占本波段各图像中位数的百分比，即光变曲线显示的总通量。低于最小值的图像（如透过云层拍摄）会被排除出比较星选择、光变曲线与报告。

FILE: The learning rate represents the scale factor applied to the cost function's gradient to determine the amplitude of the solution increment at each iteration.
文件: 学习率表示作用于代价函数梯度的缩放因子，用于确定每次迭代解算增量的幅度。

FILE: Each time the gradient is computed the next weights are computed by performing a descendant step along the gradient direction, the bigger the learning rate the faster the increment.
文件: 每次计算梯度后，沿梯度方向执行一步下降来得到下一组权重；学习率越大，增量越快。

FILE: When this option is selected, any FITS keyword can be overridden by using the smart naming syntax.
文件: 选择此项时，任何 FITS 关键字都可用智能命名语法覆盖。

文件: 限制用于生成曲面样条的采样数。若采样数超过此限制，会把它们合并（分箱）成超级采样。

FILE: A larger number of samples increases the theoretical maximum resolution of the surface spline. However, small unbinned samples are noisier and require more smoothing. The default value is usually a good compromise.
文件: 采样数越多，曲面样条的理论最大分辨率越高；但小的未分箱采样噪声更大、需要更多平滑。默认值通常是良好折中。

FILE: Hosted scriptlets are those that are installed with the PMUI script. These will only be added to, amended or removed as a result of a PMUI script update package.
文件: 托管脚本片段是随 PMUI 脚本一起安装的那些，只会因 PMUI 脚本更新包而添加、修改或移除。

FILE: Feature scriptlets are those that have been added by the user. The feature scriptlets can be added or removed as desired by the user. This enables a list of favourite scriptlets to be maintained for ease of use.
文件: 功能脚本片段是用户自行添加的那些，用户可按需增删，从而维护一份常用脚本片段列表方便使用。

FILE: If checked, these default parameters are used regardless of the metadata stored in the images, and they are trusted as the initial values of the solution: in the automatic blind solver mode, the blind solver is only used if the initial alignment fails with them.

文件: 输出 XISF 文件的写入目录：对每个没有有效天文解算的图像文件，写一个含所计算线性解的文件。留空时每个输出写到其图像文件所在目录。

FILE: Output files never replace other files of the list, nor each other, as files with the same name from different directories would: a numeric suffix (_1, _2, ...) is added to their names, in the order of the list.
文件: 输出文件绝不会替换列表中的其他文件或彼此（不同目录的同名文件本会如此）：会按列表顺序在名称后加数字后缀（_1、_2 ...）。

文件: 编辑「平滑度」参数并查看将应用于目标图像其余部分（即重叠区域之外）的梯度。

文件: 数据点表示靠近拼接线路径的采样。

FILE: Ensure to include a significant number of stars in your image or preview area when the formula uses stars-based terms FWHM, Eccentricity, PSFSignal, PSFCount, PSFFlux, PSFFluxPower, Stars and StarResidual. All these terms are zero in absence of stars.
文件: 当公式使用基于星点的项 FWHM、Eccentricity、PSFSignal、PSFCount、PSFFlux、PSFFluxPower、Stars 与 StarResidual 时，请确保图像或预览区域中包含足够多的星点；没有星点时这些项全为零。

FILE: The terms MStar and NStar estimators require a working image larger than 512 pixels, if your images or preview size are smaller then the values of these estimators is zero.
文件: MStar 与 NStar 估计量要求工作图像大于 512 像素，图像或预览更小时这些估计量的值为零。

FILE: Representations of small objects can be enlarged artificially to make them more visible in the annotated image. This parameter is the radius in pixels of the largest elliptical annotations to which these artificial enlargement factors will be applied. Enlargement functions are logarithmic to achieve a smooth zooming effect without visible discontinuities.
文件: 可人为放大小天体的表示，使其在标注图像中更醒目。此参数为应用该人为放大系数的最大椭圆标注半径（像素）。放大函数采用对数形式，以获得平滑的缩放效果而不出现可见跳变。

FILE: This is the amount of variation in the image weight used to compute the partial derivative of the cost function along the i-th component.
文件: 这是用于计算代价函数沿第 i 个分量偏导数的图像权重变化量。

FILE: The smaller the value the more localized is the gradient evaluation, as a drawback if this step is too small the cost variation could be too small to produce a significant gradient.
文件: 数值越小，梯度评估越局部；缺点是步长太小时代价变化可能过小，无法产生显著梯度。

FILE: Increase if the overlap area is very large. A larger number of samples increases the theoretical maximum resolution of the surface spline. However, small unbinned samples are noisier and require more smoothing. The default value is usually a good compromise.
文件: 重叠区域非常大时可增大。采样数越多，曲面样条的理论最大分辨率越高；但小的未分箱采样噪声更大、需要更多平滑。默认值通常是良好折中。

FILE: Increase if the overlap region is very large. A larger number of samples increases the theoretical maximum resolution of the surface spline. However, small unbinned samples are noisier and require more smoothing. The default value is usually a good compromise.
文件: 重叠区域非常大时可增大。采样数越多，曲面样条的理论最大分辨率越高；但小的未分箱采样噪声更大、需要更多平滑。默认值通常是良好折中。

FILE: The minimum threshold for rejection of outlier star pair matches in local sparsity units. Local sparsity is evaluated within a region around each star pair as the ratio of catalog sources to stars acquired for surface spline generation on the target image.
文件: 以局部稀疏度为单位，剔除异常星点对匹配的最小阈值。局部稀疏度在每个星点对周围的区域内，按目标图像上星表源数与用于生成曲面样条的星点数之比评估。

FILE: Displays the binned samples used to construct the surface spline that models the relative gradient between the reference and target images.
文件: 显示用于构建参考与目标图像之间相对梯度模型曲面样条的分箱采样。

FILE: Samples are binned to improve performance if the number of samples exceed the specified limit.
文件: 采样数超过指定限制时会做分箱以提升性能。

FILE: The area of each binned sample represents the number of samples it was created from.
文件: 每个分箱采样的面积表示它由多少个采样合成。

FILE: Each binned sample's center is calculated from the center of mass of the samples it was created from.
文件: 每个分箱采样的中心由构成它的采样的质心计算。

FILE: The automatic detection of a master file is performed by searching for the word master in the FITS header IMAGETYP value; if not found then the full file path is scanned, including the drive name, folders, file name and extension, looking for the word master (case insensitive).
文件: 主文件的自动检测通过在 FITS 头 IMAGETYP 值中查找单词 master 完成；若未找到，则扫描完整文件路径（含盘符、文件夹、文件名与扩展名）查找单词 master（不区分大小写）。

FILE: On the target side of the join path, the detailed correction over the overlap region is tapered to the smoother correction applied to the rest of the target image.
文件: 在拼接路径的目标侧，重叠区域的精细校正渐隐过渡到应用于目标图像其余部分的较平滑校正。

FILE: Blend and Average modes: On the reference side of the join path, up until the dark green line, the difference in noise between the two images are blended together.
文件: 混合与平均模式：在拼接路径的参考侧、直到深绿色线为止，两幅图像的噪声差异被混合在一起。

FILE: Apply a label placement optimization algorithm to remove overlappings and conflicts among graphics elements in the annotation, with a minimum distance maximization local optimization criterion. When this option is selected, label text positions specified for each selected layer will be used as a first default option, but the algorithm will move labels as necessary to fulfill its optimization goals.
文件: 应用标签布局优化算法，按最小距离最大化的局部优化准则，消除标注中图形元素之间的重叠与冲突。选择此项时，各所选图层指定的标签文字位置作为首选默认，但算法会按需移动标签以达成优化目标。

FILE: The 'Overlay' mode is ideal if the reference and target images have a similar signal to noise ratio.
文件: 参考图像与目标图像信噪比相近时，「叠加」模式最为理想。

FILE: Reference pixels are drawn on top of target pixels on the reference side of the join.
文件: 在拼接的参考侧，参考像素绘制在目标像素之上。

FILE: On the other side of the join, the detailed correction over the overlap is tapered down to the smoother correction applied to the rest of the target image.
文件: 在拼接的另一侧，重叠区的精细校正渐隐过渡到应用于目标图像其余部分的较平滑校正。

FILE: If this option is enabled, positions calculated for planets, asteroids and comets will be topocentric, that is, will be referred to the location of the observer with respect to the center of the Earth, as defined by the following geodetic longitude, latitude, and height parameters.
文件: 启用此选项时，行星、小行星与彗星的位置按地面观测者计算，即以观测者相对地心的位置为参考，由下列大地经度、纬度与高度参数定义。

FILE: Measure only the stars inside a rectangle: the field around a variable star or an exoplanet host and its comparison stars, or the part of the field free from the aberrations of the corners. Measuring a few hundred stars instead of tens of thousands makes a long series far faster. The images are still registered with all their stars.
文件: 只测量一个矩形内的星点：变星或系外行星宿主及其比较星周围的视场，或不受边角像差影响的那部分视场。测量几百颗星而非数万颗，能让长序列快得多；图像仍用其全部星点对齐。

FILE: Displacement that the continuous magnitude rescales to one, in the reporting units.
文件: 连续幅值重标定为 1 所对应的位移，以报告单位计。

FILE: Zero means automatic: the largest peak among the fields of the run, so that the maps of one run are comparable with each other — a difference field ten times smaller than the distortion then looks ten times darker, instead of just as bright because it was rescaled to its own peak.
文件: 为零表示自动：取本次运行各场中的最大峰值，使同一运行的各图可相互比较 — 比畸变小十倍的差分场看起来就暗十倍，而不会因按自身峰值重标定而显得同样亮。

FILE: Provides edit sliders for all 'Sample Generation' section parameters.
文件: 提供「采样生成」区所有参数的编辑滑块。

FILE:
Samples are rejected if they:

  • Contain one or more zero pixels in either image.
  • Are too close to a star included in the 'Limit stars %' range.
The surviving samples are drawn as squares. The stars used to reject samples are indicated by circles.
文件:
采样在以下情况被剔除：

  • 在任一图像中含一个或多个零像素。
  • 过于靠近「限制星点 %」范围内的星点。
保留的采样画为方形，用于剔除采样的星点以圆圈表示。

FILE: If this parameter is disabled, multiple sources that are too close to be separated as individual structures, such as double and multiple stars, won't be detected for relative scale evaluation.
文件: 禁用此参数时，过近而无法分离为单个结构的多重源（如双星、聚星）不会被检测用于相对比例评估。

FILE: If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects.
文件: 启用时，不可分离的多重源可作为单个对象自由检测。

FILE: The type of radial basis function (RBF) used to model geometric transformations with two-dimensional surface splines.
文件: 用于以二维曲面样条建模几何变换的径向基函数（RBF）类型。

FILE: This represents the numer of time the learning rate gets halved because of an overshoot occurred.
文件: 表示因发生超调而把学习率减半的次数。

FILE: An overshoot occurs when the cost function gets increased after a gradient descendant step, this occurs when the increment step is too big.When this condition is detected, the optimizer iteratively reduces the learning rate and attempts to find a stable increment by halving the increment size, until the maximum number of halves is reached.
文件: 沿梯度下降一步后代价函数反而增大即为超调，通常因增量步长过大。检测到该情况时，优化器迭代减小学习率，通过把增量减半来寻找稳定增量，直到达到最大减半次数。

FILE: Model how the zero point varies across the field of each image, and correct the magnitudes of all the stars for it, the variable star included. Errors of the flat field, vignetting, differential extinction across a wide field, passing clouds and an obstructing dome make the zero point vary across the field. The models are fitted to all the good stars of the field, whatever the limits of distance and color, without the 20% bluest and the 20% reddest of them.
文件: 建模每幅图像视场内零点的变化，并据此校正所有星点（含变星）的星等。平场误差、暗角、宽视场的差分消光、飘过的云与遮挡的圆顶都会让零点在视场内变化。模型拟合到视场中所有良好的星点，不受距离与颜色限制，但排除最蓝的 20% 与最红的 20%。

FILE: The overlap region is divided up into a grid of sample squares. A sample's value is the median of the pixels it contains.
文件: 重叠区域被划分为采样方格网格，采样值为其所含像素的中值。

FILE: Identify an object of interest—a variable star, an exoplanet host, a blazar—and report it first, under its name, for every image. The object is located on the detection image, which must have an astrometric solution: the star nearest to the given coordinates within the search radius, whose fitted position replaces them. Not finding it is an error.
文件: 识别一个关注天体——变星、系外行星宿主、耀变体——并在每幅图像的结果中以它的名称列在最前。该天体在检测图像上定位，检测图像必须有天文解算：取搜索半径内距给定坐标最近的星，并用其拟合位置替代给定坐标；找不到即为错误。

FILE: When this option is enabled, topocentric places take into account polar motion corrections to compute the geocentric position and velocity of the observer. This involves calculation of CIP coordinates with respect to the ITRS, as well as access to a database of CIP/ITRS positions which is part of the core PixInsight distribution.
文件: 启用此选项时，地面观测者位置会考虑极移改正以计算观测者的地心位置与速度。这涉及计算 CIP 相对 ITRS 的坐标，并访问作为 PixInsight 核心发行版一部分的 CIP/ITRS 位置数据库。

FILE: If this option is checked, the image registration process will use triangle similarity instead of polygonal descriptors for the star matching routine.
文件: 勾选此项时，图像对齐进程在星点匹配例程中使用三角形相似而非多边形描述符。

FILE: Star flux tolerance is used to prevent invalid target to reference star matches. Smaller values reject more matches.
文件: 星点通量容差用于防止目标星与参考星的错误匹配，数值越小剔除的匹配越多。

FILE: Star matches are rejected if the difference in star flux is larger than expected. The algorithm first calculates the average scale difference, and then rejects matches if their brightness ratio is greater than (expected ratio * tolerance) or smaller than (expected ratio / tolerance)
文件: 若星点通量差异超出预期，该匹配会被剔除。算法先计算平均比例差，然后剔除亮度比大于（预期比 × 容差）或小于（预期比 / 容差）的匹配

FILE: 1.0 implies the star flux ratio must exactly match the expected ratio.
文件: 1.0 表示星点通量比必须与预期比完全一致。

FILE: 2.0 implies that the ratio can be double or half the expected ratio.
文件: 2.0 表示该比可为预期比的两倍或一半。

FILE: Estimate the gain of the camera, for the photon noise term of the uncertainty, from the sky background of the images: the variance of the background grows with its level, and the level of the sky changes over a series. The gain is estimated over a grid across the field, and every star is given the gain at its position: after flat fielding, the gain of a vignetted corner is lower than at the center.
文件: 为不确定度的光子噪声项，根据图像天空背景估计相机增益：背景方差随其电平增长，而一个序列中天空电平会变化。增益在横跨视场的网格上估计，每颗星采用其所在位置的增益；平场校正后，暗角处的增益低于中心。

FILE: The Blend and Average modes can produce artifacts around stars. This occurs if target and reference stars have different profiles, or slightly different positions. In these cases, the Average algorithm can result in bloated or 'double' stars. The Blend algorithm can produce speckles around these stars.
文件: 混合与平均模式可能在星点周围产生伪影，原因是目标星与参考星轮廓不同或位置略有偏差。此时平均算法可能产生膨胀或「双」星，混合算法可能在这些星周围产生斑点。

FILE: This control specifies the percentage of outlier pixels that these algorithms should ignore. The higher the value, the less likely these artifacts become. However, if the value is too high, the join will not blend as effectively.
文件: 此控件指定这些算法应忽略的离群像素百分比。数值越高，伪影越不易出现；但过高会使拼接融合效果变差。

FILE: Add an elliptical region to the mask. Click this, then drag on the preview to draw an ellipse. Hold Alt for a perfect circle from the center, or hold Ctrl mid-drag to rotate the ellipse - so it can be sized and angled in one go. Click again for each extra region - the mask is the union of them all.
文件: 向蒙版添加一个椭圆区域。点击此按钮后在预览上拖动画出椭圆；按住 Alt 可从中心画正圆，拖动中按住 Ctrl 可旋转椭圆——一次即可确定大小与角度。再点一次可添加更多区域，蒙版为它们全部区域的并集。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a Gaussian convolution filter applied to the working image used for calculation of star positions during the star detection phase. Use it only for very low SNR images, where the star detector cannot find reliable stars with default parameters.
文件: 这是星点检测阶段中用于计算星点位置的工作图像所应用高斯卷积滤波器的半径（像素）。仅用于极低信噪比图像——默认参数下星点检测器无法找到可靠星点时。

FILE: Be aware that noise reduction will modify star profiles and hence the way star positions are calculated, resulting in a less accurate image registration. Under extreme low-SNR conditions, however, this is probably better than working with the actual data anyway.
文件: 注意降噪会改变星点轮廓，从而改变星点位置的计算方式，导致图像对齐精度下降。不过在极低信噪比条件下，这大概仍优于直接使用原始数据。

FILE: ICRS (International Celestial Reference System). The image solver will use astrometric positions computed from catalog star coordinates and properties. This includes space motion (proper motions, parallax and radial velocity, when available) and gravitational deflection of light.
文件: ICRS（国际天球参考系统）。图像解算器使用由星表星点坐标与属性计算的天体测量位置，包含空间运动（可用时的自行、视差与视向速度）及光线引力偏折。

FILE: ICRS (International Celestial Reference System). The image solver will use astrometric positions computed from catalog star coordinates and properties. This includes space motion (proper motions, parallax, and radial velocity, when available) and gravitational deflection of light.
文件: ICRS（国际天球参考系统）。图像解算器使用由星表星点坐标与属性计算的天体测量位置，包含空间运动（可用时的自行、视差与视向速度）及光线引力偏折。

FILE: Use this mode to dissolve the target image into the reference. This is particularly useful if the two images have very different signal to noise ratios.
文件: 用此模式把目标图像溶入参考图像，两图信噪比差异很大时尤其有用。

FILE: On the reference side of the join, between the two green lines, pixels are randomly chosen from the reference and target images. The contribution from the target image is tapered from 0% at the reference side to 100% at the target side.
文件: 在拼接的参考侧、两条绿线之间，像素从参考与目标图像中随机选取；目标图像的贡献从参考侧的 0% 渐增到目标侧的 100%。

FILE: Use the 'Join' button to view and adjust the size and position of this Join Region.
文件: 用「拼接」按钮查看并调整此拼接区域的大小与位置。

FILE: When this option is enabled, multiple PSF models, including Gaussian and several Moffat functions, will be fitted for each star. The function that best matches the actual image data will be selected. This optimizes PSF fitting adaptively to find the most accurate centroid coordinates for each detected source, but at the cost of a much higher computation time. When this option is disabled only Gaussian PSFs will be fitted.
文件: 启用此选项时，会为每颗星拟合多种 PSF 模型（含高斯与若干 Moffat 函数），并选择与真实图像数据最匹配者。这能自适应优化 PSF 拟合，为每个检测源找到最精确的质心坐标，代价是计算时间大幅增加。禁用时只拟合高斯 PSF。

FILE: Transmission graph: Plots (Transmission)/(Maximum transmission) for date ordered images.
文件: 透过率图：按日期排序绘制（透过率）/（最大透过率）。

FILE: Weight graph: Plots (Weight/time)/(Maximum weight/time). The weights are divided by exposure time so that, for example, points plotted for a 5 minute and 10 minute exposure taken in identical conditions will be displayed with the same value.
文件: 权重图：绘制（权重/时间）/（最大权重/时间）。权重除以曝光时间，因此相同条件下 5 分钟与 10 分钟曝光的点会显示为相同数值。

FILE:
• Green X: Reference image.
  • Blue X: Rejected due to transmission.
  • Red X: Rejected due to weight.

If the reference image is not included in the target list, it is displayed as image zero.
文件:
• 绿色 X：参考图像。
  • 蓝色 X：因透过率被剔除。
  • 红色 X：因权重被剔除。

若参考图像不在目标列表中，显示为第 0 幅图像。

FILE: Factor in sigma units applied to calculate the maximum threshold for rejection of outlier star pair matches. Iterative surface spline generation is controlled by an adaptive, two-dimensional outlier rejection algorithm that detects pair matches with the potential to degrade the evolution of splines while modeling arbitrary distortions.
文件: 以 sigma 为单位的因子，用于计算剔除异常星点对匹配的最大阈值。迭代曲面样条生成由自适应二维离群剔除算法控制，该算法在建模任意畸变时检测出可能劣化样条演化的点对匹配。

FILE: Detect further groups of consistent matches after the main one, such as the layers at different distances of a scene with parallax, and grow the distortion model from all of them. The distortion model interpolates its control points instead of smoothing them, so the boundaries between layers remain sharp; the smoothness parameter is not used. Use it for terrestrial and nightscape images acquired from different positions, where a foreground object and the background are related by distinct transformations.
文件: 在主要一致匹配组之外继续检测其他组，例如有视差场景不同距离上的层，并用全部组扩展畸变模型。该畸变模型对控制点做插值而非平滑，因此层与层之间的边界保持锐利，不使用平滑度参数。适用于从不同位置拍摄的地面与夜景图像，其中前景与背景由不同变换关联。

FILE: Take for seam stars only the stars that stand out from the structures around them. The bright compact features of an extended object composed from several frames, such as craters and peaks on the Moon or lights and details of a landscape, are detected and fitted as stars, but each one taken from a single frame would show the outline of its region. With this option they are blended as the rest of the image, and the regions of the stars stay away from the edges of the frames.
文件: 只把从周围结构中凸显出来的星点作为接缝星。由多帧合成的延展天体上的亮而紧凑的特征（月面环形山与山峰、地景灯光与细节）会被当作星点检测并拟合，但若每颗只取自单帧，就会显出其区域的轮廓。启用此选项后它们与图像其余部分一样被混合，星点区域远离各帧边缘。

FILE: When no reference image of the MARS databases contains a frame or a mosaic, compose a reference from the MARS images that cover parts of it: a mosaic of MARS master frames, converted to common flux units, with their background levels equalized in their overlaps. Wide-field mosaics larger than a MARS image cannot be corrected otherwise.
文件: 当 MARS 数据库中没有参考图像包含某帧或某幅马赛克时，用覆盖其各部分的 MARS 图像拼出参考：由 MARS 主帧组成的马赛克，转换为统一通量单位，并在重叠区均衡背景电平。大于单幅 MARS 图像的宽视场马赛克无法用别的方式校正。

FILE: This is a fallback, not a rigorous option. The gradient correction of each MARS master frame has been verified through a strict manual procedure, but a mosaic of adjacent master frames has not been verified, and its accuracy cannot be guaranteed. It is never used when a MARS master frame contains the image.
文件: 这是兜底方案，不是严格选项。每张 MARS 主帧的梯度校正都经严格人工流程验证，但相邻主帧拼成的马赛克未经验证，精度无法保证。若某张 MARS 主帧包含该图像，则绝不会使用此方案。

FILE: Displays the generated samples, the stars used to reject samples, and the location of the join between the reference and target images. Provides edit sliders for all 'Sample Generation' section parameters.
文件: 显示生成的采样、用于剔除采样的星点，以及参考与目标图像之间拼接的位置。提供「采样生成」区所有参数的编辑滑块。

FILE:
Samples are rejected if they:

  • Contain too many zero pixels in either image.
  • Are too close to a star included in the 'Limit stars %' range.
The surviving samples are drawn as squares. The stars used to reject samples are indicated by circles.
文件:
采样在以下情况被剔除：

  • 在任一图像中含过多零像素。
  • 过于靠近「限制星点 %」范围内的星点。
保留的采样画为方形，用于剔除采样的星点以圆圈表示。

FILE: If this parameter is disabled, a local maxima map will be generated to identify and prevent detection of multiple sources that are too close to be separated as individual structures, such as double and multiple stars. In general, sources with several local maxima pose difficulties for the determination of accurate star positions.
文件: 禁用此参数时，会生成局部极大值图，用于识别并阻止检测过近而无法分离为单个结构的多重源（如双星、聚星）。一般来说，含多个局部极大值的源难以确定精确的星点位置。

FILE: If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects. This can be necessary in special cases where extreme high noise levels and/or distortion of stellar images caused by optical aberrations limit the number of detectable sources excessively, preventing image registration.
文件: 启用时，不可分离的多重源可作为单个对象自由检测。在极高噪声和/或光学像差造成的星像畸变使可检测源数量过少、以致无法对齐图像的特殊情形下，这样做可能是必需的。

FILE: The displayed weight is adjusted for exposure time. These exposure scaled weights represent the sky conditions. We want to reject images that were badly affected by light pollution or clouds, but we don't want to reject images just because they had a shorter exposure.
文件: 显示的权重已按曝光时间调整，这些按时长缩放的权重代表天空条件。我们希望剔除受光污染或云严重影响变差，不希望仅因曝光较短就剔除图像。

FILE: There are several reasons we reject based on sky conditions. Light pollution usually includes gradients, which may become difficult to remove. High levels of light pollution also tend to reveal flat field errors.
文件: 按天空条件剔除有多重理由：光污染通常伴随梯度，可能难以去除；高水平光污染还容易暴露平场误差。

FILE: The filter of the selected grayscale images. The frames of each filter are composed into a mosaic of their own, and all the mosaics have the same geometry, so that they can be combined.
文件: 所选灰度图像的滤镜。每个滤镜的帧各自合成一幅马赛克，且所有马赛克几何相同，以便合成。

FILE: From metadata: the filter the image states, as the XISF Instrument:Filter:Name property or the FILTER keyword, which stands for a filter when it is one of its aliases (see Preferences), or else the filter its file name gives, by the file name patterns of the preferences. Any other filter: assigned to the image, whatever its metadata states, for images whose metadata are wrong or missing.
文件: 来自元数据：图像所声明的滤镜，即 XISF Instrument:Filter:Name 属性或 FILTER 关键字；若为某滤镜的别名之一（见偏好设置）则代表该滤镜，否则按偏好设置的文件名模式由文件名给出。任何其他滤镜：为元数据错误或缺失的图像直接指定给图像的滤镜，无论其元数据如何声明。

FILE: Maximum distance in pixels between a detected star and a catalog star for them to be considered the same object.
文件: 检测星点与星表星之间被视为同一天体的最大距离（像素）。

FILE: Stars are matched using the solution being analyzed, so this tolerance has to exceed the residual of that solution, not the distortion being measured. For a solution with a distortion model the residual is a fraction of a pixel and the default is ample.
文件: 星点用正在分析的那个解来匹配，因此此容差必须超过该解的残差，而非正在测量的畸变。对含畸变模型的解，残差只有几分之一个像素，默认值足够宽裕。

FILE: Demosaiced/interpolated images can be generated as combined RGB color images, as separate RGB channels stored as monochrome images, or applying both options at the same time.
文件: 去马赛克/插值后的图像可生成为合成 RGB 彩色图像、作为灰度图像分别存放的 RGB 通道，或同时采用两种方式。

FILE:
Generation of single RGB color images is the default option.
Separate RGB channel images can be useful for correction of non-isotropic channel misalignments such as those caused by chromatic aberration and atmospheric dispersion, by computing image registration transformations with distortion correction among all color components of a data set. This procedure is compatible with normal image integrations as well as drizzle integrations.
文件:
默认生成单幅 RGB 彩色图像。
分离的 RGB 通道图像可用于校正非各向同性的通道错位（如色差与大气色散所致），方法是在数据集所有颜色分量之间计算带畸变校正的图像对齐变换。此流程与普通图像叠加及 Drizzle 叠加均兼容。

FILE: A CSV output has three parts: a header with the title, the observer, the reference image (the detection image, or else the first image) and, when an object of interest is defined, the object and the observation of it; a table of images, with the observation time of each image (UTC, JD and BJD TDB), its exposure, the location of the observer, the numbers of detected and matched stars, the zero point, the airmass and the filter; and the data table.
文件: CSV 输出由三部分组成：文件头（标题、观测者、参考图像——检测图像或第一幅图像——以及定义关注天体时的天体与其观测）、图像表（每幅图像的观测时间 UTC、JD 与 BJD TDB，曝光、观测者位置、检测与匹配星点数、零点、大气质量与滤镜），以及数据表。

FILE: This parameter can be used to prevent detection of small and bright image artifacts as stars. This can be useful to work with uncalibrated or wrongly calibrated data, especially demosaiced CFA frames where hot pixels have generated large bright artifacts that cannot be removed with a median filter (i.e., the Hot pixel removal parameter).
文件: 此参数可防止把小而亮的图像伪影检测为星点，适用于未校准或校准有误的数据，尤其是去马赛克 CFA 帧中热像素生成了无法用中值滤波（即热像素去除参数）消除的大块亮伪影。

FILE: Use this mode to seamlessly blend the two sides of the join. This is particularly useful if the two images have very different signal to noise ratios.
文件: 用此模式无缝融合拼接线两侧，两图信噪比差异很大时尤其有用。

FILE: On the reference side of the join, between the two green lines, the pixels are a weighted average of the reference and target pixels. The weights taper across the join region, from 100% target at the target side to 100% reference at the reference side. At the centre, each provides a 50% contribution, which improves the signal to noise ratio (which may or may not be desirable).
文件: 在拼接的参考侧、两条绿线之间，像素为参考与目标像素的加权平均；权重在拼接区域内渐变，从目标侧的 100% 目标到参考侧的 100% 参考。中央处各占 50%，可提高信噪比（这可能未必是你想要的）。

FILE: The blind solver finds the center coordinates and scale of the image from the detected stars alone, without initial approximations, with the astrometric index file configured in the preferences of the Gaia process.
文件: 盲解算器仅从检测到的星点求出图像中心坐标与比例尺，无需初始近似值，使用 Gaia 进程偏好设置中配置的星表索引文件。

FILE: Automatic: The blind solver is used when the image provides no valid center coordinates or image scale and you have not entered them in this dialog, and when the initial alignment fails with the available initial values. Values remembered from previous executions are not trusted in this mode.
文件: 自动：当图像没有有效中心坐标或图像比例尺、且你未在本对话框中输入，或用现有初始值做初始对齐失败时，启用盲解算。此模式下不信任上次运行记住的数值。

FILE: Always: The initial center coordinates and image scale are ignored, and the image is always solved blindly.
文件: 始终：忽略初始中心坐标与图像比例尺，总是对图像做盲解算。

FILE: Disabled: The blind solver is never used. The initial center coordinates and image scale are required.
文件: 禁用：从不使用盲解算，必须提供初始中心坐标与图像比例尺。

FILE: The sampling region takes the local background from a square around the region the PSF was fitted over, twice as wide, outside the star. That region was found by adaptive median stabilization, so it reaches the background of each star.
文件: 采样区域从 PSF 拟合区域周围、宽度为其两倍、位于星点之外的方形取局部背景。该区域由自适应中值稳定化找出，因此能到达每颗星的 background。

FILE: An annulus takes it from a ring around the star. The ring follows the size of each star rather than a fixed radius.
文件: 圆环从星点周围的环取背景，环随每颗星的尺寸变化而非固定半径。

FILE: In both cases, other stars are rejected first, and the level is a robust estimate of what remains.
文件: 两种情况下都会先剔除其他星点，电平为剩余像素的稳健估计。

FILE: This script will evaluate the performance of your machine for execution of intermediate and advanced image processing tasks with PixInsight. This process has been carefully designed to provide you with reliable estimates of quality for your actual user experience on the PixInsight platform. These estimates have been standardized so that they are directly comparable to other benchmark results obtained with different hardware and/or PixInsight versions.
文件: 本脚本将评估你的机器用 PixInsight 执行中级与高级图像处理任务的性能。此流程经精心设计，为你在 PixInsight 平台上的实际体验提供可靠的质量估计；这些估计已标准化，可直接与不同硬件和/或不同 PixInsight 版本得到的其他基准结果比较。

FILE: The PixInsight benchmark is a community-driven project. By submitting your benchmark results, you help us build a comprehensive database of benchmark data. This is an invaluable resource, both for us to improve our software and for other users to make hardware-related decisions. Benchmark submission is optional and a completely anonymous process.
文件: PixInsight 基准测试是社区驱动项目。提交基准测试结果可帮助我们建立全面的基准数据库，这既是我们改进软件的宝贵资源，也有助于其他用户做硬件相关决策。结果提交是可选且完全匿名的。

FILE: Assign an event script, invoked while the pipeline runs.
文件: 指定一个在流程运行期间调用的事件脚本。

FILE: The script observes the execution, it does not decide what it contains: use the Pipeline builder for that. It is called at the beginning and at the end of the run, and around every tracked operation, and it may stop the run by calling env.requestInterruption().
文件: 该脚本只观察执行过程，不决定流程内容——那由流程构建器负责。它在运行开始与结束时、以及每个受跟踪操作的周围被调用，并可通过调用 env.requestInterruption() 中止运行。

FILE:
function onPipelineStart( env, state ) { ... }
function onOperationStart( env, state ) { ... }
function onOperationDone( env, state ) { ... }
function onPipelineEnd( env, state ) { ... }
文件:
function onPipelineStart( env, state ) { ... }
function onOperationStart( env, state ) { ... }
function onOperationDone( env, state ) { ... }
function onPipelineEnd( env, state ) { ... }

FILE: env describes the event, state is yours to keep data across events. A script that fails is reported and the run carries on.
文件: env 描述事件，state 由你用来在事件之间保留数据。脚本失败会被报告，运行继续。

FILE: Assign a pipeline builder script to customize the WBPP pipeline.
文件: 指定一个流程构建器脚本以自定义 WBPP 流程。

FILE: The pipeline builder, if assigned, is responsible for building the pipeline for the light frames only. WBPP remains responsible for the bias, dark and flat frames, and the generation of the corresponding master files.
文件: 若已指定，构建器只负责为亮场构建流程；偏置、暗场、平场及相应主帧的生成仍由 WBPP 负责。

FILE: To keep the standard processing and just add your own steps, build the default pipeline first and then append to it:
文件: 若想保留标准处理并追加自己的步骤，可先构建默认流程再追加：

engine.pipelineManager.buildPipelineForLight();
engine.operationQueue.addOperationBlock( myStep );

FILE: In case of error, the default pipeline will be used as a fallback. A builder that completes without adding any operation is not an error, so no fallback applies: the light frames are simply left unprocessed.
文件: 出错时回退到默认流程。构建器执行完成但未添加任何操作不算错误，因此不触发回退：亮场只是保持未处理。

FILE: While ticked, LR Tools, Curves, Noise Reduction, Sharpening and Wavelet Sharpening change the mask itself and the preview shows it in grayscale (white = full effect, black = none). Raise Contrast or Whites to harden it, pull Blacks to cut the background out, use the curve to shape the transition, Clarity or Texture to follow the detail, Noise Reduction to smooth it.
文件: 勾选期间，局部调整工具、曲线、降噪、锐化与小波锐化修改的是蒙版本身，预览以灰度显示（白 = 完全生效，黑 = 不生效）。提高对比度或白色可使其变硬，压低黑色可切掉背景，用曲线塑造过渡，用清晰度或纹理跟随细节，用降噪使其平滑。

FILE: Untick to go back to editing the image - the sliders jump back to the image's own values, and the refined mask keeps working: every tool now acts through it. Colour tools (white balance, saturation, Selective Color, HSL, SCNR, colour noise) are disabled while editing the mask, because a mask has no colour.
文件: 取消勾选即回到编辑图像——滑块会跳回图像自身的数值，而精修后的蒙版继续生效：每个工具现在都透过它起作用。编辑蒙版期间色彩工具（白平衡、饱和度、可选颜色、HSL、SCNR、色彩噪声）会禁用，因为蒙版没有颜色。

FILE: Internally, star distortion is evaluated in units of coverage of a square region circumscribed to each detected structure. The coverage of a perfectly circular star is π/4 (about 0.8). Lower values denote elongated or irregular sources.
文件: 内部以每个检测结构外接正方形区域的覆盖率单位来评估星点畸变：完美圆形星点的覆盖率为 π/4（约 0.8），数值越低表示源越拉长或不规则。

FILE: To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum distortion, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.
文件: 为把界面与内部实现隔离，此参数归一化到 [0,1] 范围，0 与 1 分别表示最小与最大畸变。这一抽象让我们能更换星点检测引擎而不破坏依赖它的工具与进程。

FILE: Detection on each image measures every star found on each image, numbered as they are measured. Nothing links a star of one image with the same star on another.
文件: 逐图像检测测量每幅图像上找到的每颗星，按测量顺序编号，一幅图像上的星与另一幅上的同一颗星之间没有任何关联。

FILE: A photometric catalog measures the stars found on each image that it identifies within its magnitude limits, and gives them catalog magnitudes, which a zero point can be calibrated against.
文件: 测光星表测量每幅图像上在其星等限内被识别出的星，赋予星表星等，用于校准零点。

FILE: A detection image measures the stars of the detection image, fitting their PSFs on every image where they are expected. A star whose fit fails is measured at its expected position with the PSF of the image. This is how a long series of noisy frames, such as those of an exoplanet transit, is measured, and what a light curve needs.
文件: 检测图像测量检测图像的星点，在预期出现它们的每幅图像上拟合其 PSF；拟合失败的星按该图像的 PSF 在其预期位置测量。系外行星凌星等长序列低噪帧正是这样测量的，光变曲线也正需要它。

FILE: When checked, the local normalization reference frame for each group will remain the same as the one selected or generated in the previous execution.
文件: 勾选后，各组的局部归一化参考帧保持与上次执行所选或所生成的相同。

FILE: Keeping the reference frame from the previous execution is beneficial when adding new light frames to an existing WBPP group to increase the total integration time. By ensuring the same reference frame is used for each group, WBPP can utilize the previously cached files that are still on disk, avoiding the need to select or generate the local normalization reference again. This way, only the new files will be measured and normalized, preventing the need to reprocess the entire dataset.
文件: 向已有 WBPP 分组追加新亮场以增加总叠加时间时，沿用上次的参考帧很有好处：确保各组使用同一参考帧后，WBPP 可利用磁盘上仍存在的缓存文件，无需再次选择或生成局部归一化参考。这样只测量并归一化新文件，避免重处理整个数据集。

FILE:
• Vectors — an arrow per lattice cell over the deformed lattice. This is the only form that shows the direction of the distortion.
  • Grayscale — the magnitude as a continuous tone, rescaled to [0,1]. The result is a one channel, 32-bit floating point image with no legend drawn on it: a measurable data product, which can be compared with, and subtracted from, any other map rescaled with the same white point.
  • Vectors over grayscale — the arrows over the continuous magnitude, as a picture.

A field taken from the solution model is rendered from a lattice much finer than the one used for the arrows, because it can be evaluated anywhere at no cost. A measured field is rendered at the resolution at which it was measured, and looks coarser: that difference is real.
文件:
• 矢量 — 在变形网格上每个单元格画一个箭头，这是唯一能显示畸变方向的形式。
  • 灰度 — 把幅值作为连续色调重缩放到 [0,1]。结果为单通道 32 位浮点图像，不绘制图例：是可测量的数据产品，可与任何以相同白点重缩放的图比较或相减。
  • 灰度上叠加矢量 — 把箭头画在连续幅值之上，作为一张图。

取自解模型的场从比箭头所用网格细得多的网格渲染，因为它在任意处求值都无代价；测量场按其测量分辨率渲染，看起来更粗——这种差别是真实的。

FILE: Model how the zero point of each image depends on the color of the stars, with a straight line fitted to their zero points corrected for gradients against their catalog color index, and correct the magnitudes of all the stars for it, the variable star included, at its own color. Filters that differ from the standard bands, the spectral sensitivity of the camera and the extinction of the atmosphere make stars of different colors give different zero points.
文件: 建模每幅图像的零点如何随星点颜色变化：把经梯度校正的零点对其星表色指数拟合一条直线，并据此按其自身颜色校正所有星点（含变星）的星等。与标准波段不同的滤镜、相机的光谱响应以及大气消光，都会让不同颜色的星给出不同零点。

FILE: The line is fitted to all the stars of the field with a color index, and applies within the range of colors of the stars the robust fits keep: comparison stars outside it are excluded.
文件: 直线拟合到视场中所有有色指数的星，且只在稳健拟合保留的星的颜色范围内适用：范围外的比较星被排除。

FILE: When checked, the registration reference frame for each group will remain the same as the one selected in the previous execution.
文件: 勾选后，各组的对齐参考帧保持与上次执行所选的相同。

FILE: Keeping the reference frame from the previous execution is beneficial when adding new light frames to an existing WBPP group to increase the total integration time. By ensuring the same reference frame is used for each group, WBPP can utilize the previously cached files that are still on disk, avoiding the need to measure and align them again. This way, only the new files will be measured and registered, preventing the need to reprocess the entire dataset.
文件: 向已有 WBPP 分组追加新亮场以增加总叠加时间时，沿用上次的参考帧很有好处：确保各组使用同一参考帧后，WBPP 可利用磁盘上仍存在的缓存文件，无需再次测量和对齐。这样只测量并对齐新文件，避免重处理整个数据集。

FILE: CSV, one row per star has a row for each star, with its catalog magnitudes in every band of the catalog and its median signal-to-noise ratio, and four columns for each image: flux, signal-to-noise ratio and the position of the star on the image. It is the layout of a light curve, which the PhotometricAnalysis script turns into magnitudes with the comparison stars it selects; the observation times are in the table of images. Cells are left empty when the star was not measured on an image. Stars are matched across images by their identifiers, so this layout needs a detection image or a catalog when there is more than one image: stars detected on each image independently are numbered on each image.
文件: CSV，每星一行为每颗星一行，含其在星表各波段的星等与中值信噪比，以及每幅图像四列：通量、信噪比与星点在图像上的位置。这是光变曲线的布局，PhotometricAnalysis 脚本用所选比较星把它转为星等；观测时间在图像表中。星点在某幅图像未被测量时单元格留空。星点按标识符在各图像间匹配，因此多于一幅图像时此布局需要检测图像或星表：逐幅独立检测的星在各图像上分别编号。

FILE: A table of orthogonal Zernike aberration polynomial coefficients in nm RMS, the fraction of wavefront error variance explained (FVE) by the coefficients, and the cumulative fraction of wavefront error variance explained (CVE) by the coefficients.
文件: 正交泽尼克像差多项式系数表（nm RMS）、各系数解释的波前误差方差比例（FVE）及累计比例（CVE）。

FILE: The table shows the coefficients of a least squares fit of a system of 18 circular or annular Zernike aberration polynomials Z5, Z6, ..., and Z22 to the estimated wavefront. Circular polynomials are used for unobstructed telescopes, and annular polynomials are used for obstructed telescopes. The residual RMS error not explained by the least squares fit is given in the residual aberration row.
文件: 表中为把 18 个圆形或环形泽尼克像差多项式 Z5、Z6 … Z22 组成的系统对估计波前做最小二乘拟合的系数。无遮挡望远镜用圆形多项式，有遮挡望远镜用环形多项式；最小二乘未解释的残差 RMS 误差在残差像差行给出。

FILE: Zernike polynomials are labeled ZS (n, m), where S is Noll's sequential index, n is the polynomial order, and m is the angular frequency. The estimated wavefront is orthogonal to polynomials Z1, Z2, Z3,
文件: 泽尼克多项式记作 ZS (n, m)，其中 S 为 Noll 序号，n 为多项式阶数，m 为角频率。估计波前与多项式 Z1、Z2、Z3，

FILE: Gaia DR3 Synthetic Photometry provides Johnson-Cousins U, B, V, R, I and SDSS u, g, r, i, z magnitudes synthesized from the Gaia BP/RP spectra and standardized to those systems, for stars down to G = 17.65. Only stars within the validated range of each band are used. The local version computes them from the spectra of the Gaia DR3/SP databases of the Gaia process, with the Gaia G, BP and RP magnitudes; it is the default when those databases are installed. Its U and u magnitudes are less accurate than those of the published catalog, which the VizieR version queries online.
文件: Gaia DR3 合成测光提供由 Gaia BP/RP 光谱合成并标准化到 Johnson-Cousins U、B、V、R、I 与 SDSS u、g、r、i、z 系统的星等，最暗到 G = 17.65，只使用各波段已确认范围内的星。本地版本由 Gaia 进程的 Gaia DR3/SP 数据库光谱及 Gaia G、BP、RP 星等计算，装有这些数据库时为默认；其 U 与 u 星等不如在线 VizieR 版本查询的已发布星表精确。

FILE: Gaia DR3 provides the broadband Gaia G, BP and RP magnitudes, which suit images taken without a standard photometric filter, for stars down to G = 21.
文件: Gaia DR3提供宽带 Gaia G、BP、RP 星等，适合未用标准测光滤镜拍摄的图像，最暗到 G = 21。

FILE: Defines the coordinate origin and orientation convention assumed by the WBPP script for input FITS files.
文件: 定义 WBPP 脚本对输入 FITS 文件假定的坐标原点与取向约定。

FILE: Global Pref.: Adopt the convention specified by global FITS format preferences.
文件: 全局偏好：采用全局 FITS 格式偏好设置中指定的约定。

FILE: top-down: All input FITS files follow the top-down coordinate convention. The coordinate origin is at the top left corner of the image, and vertical coordinates grow from top to bottom. This is the convention used by most amateur camera control applications.
文件: 自上而下：所有输入 FITS 文件遵循 top-down 坐标约定，原点在图像左上角，垂直坐标自上向下增长，多数业余相机控制软件采用此约定。

FILE: bottom-up: All input FITS files follow the bottom-up coordinate convention. The coordinate origin is at the bottom left corner of the image, and vertical coordinates grow from bottom to top.
文件: 自下而上：所有输入 FITS 文件遵循 bottom-up 坐标约定，原点在图像左下角，垂直坐标自下向上增长。

FILE: Internally, the sensitivity of the star detection algorithm is expressed in signal-to-noise ratio units with respect to the evaluated dispersion of local background pixels for each detected structure. Given a source with estimated brightness s, local background b and local background dispersion n, sensitivity is the minimum value of (s - b)/n necessary to trigger star detection.
文件: 内部以相对每个检测结构局部背景像素评估散布的信噪比单位表示检测算法灵敏度。设某源估计亮度为 s、局部背景为 b、局部背景散布为 n，则灵敏度是触发星点检测所需的 (s - b)/n 最小值。

FILE: To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum sensitivity, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.
文件: 为把界面与内部实现隔离，此参数归一化到 [0,1] 范围，0 与 1 分别表示最小与最大灵敏度。这一抽象让我们能更换星点检测引擎而不破坏依赖它的工具与进程。

FILE: With the default <Auto> option, the WBPP script does not impose any restrictions on the maximum number of stars used by the StarAlignment process for image registration. This means that the 2000 brightest stars will be used for each image by default. If you want to speed up the image registration process you can specify a smaller amount for this parameter, say 500 stars for example, which can be sufficient to achieve an accurate alignment for similar images without differential distortions.
文件: 默认 <自动> 选项下，WBPP 脚本不对 StarAlignment 进程用于对齐的星点数施加限制，即每幅图像默认使用最亮的 2000 颗星。若想加快对齐，可指定较小值，例如 500 颗，对无差分畸变的相似图像足以获得精确对齐。

FILE: Correct the gradients of the frames before their registration, with MultiscaleGradientCorrection and the MARS database at the selected gradient scale, for frames whose gradients have not been corrected yet. The scale factors of MARS are fitted automatically.
文件: 在对齐之前，用 MultiscaleGradientCorrection 与所选梯度尺度下的 MARS 数据库，校正尚未校正梯度的帧；MARS 的比例因子自动拟合。

FILE: The frames without flux calibration metadata are calibrated with SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration and the flux calibration preferences of their filters (see Preferences, at the bottom of the dialog). The corrections are applied to temporary copies: the images of the list are not modified.
文件: 没有通量校准元数据的帧用 SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration 及其滤镜的通量校准偏好校准（见对话框底部的「偏好设置」）。校正作用于临时副本，列表中的图像不被修改。

FILE: The main drawback of the Lanczos and bicubic spline interpolation algorithms is generation of strong undershoot (ringing) artifacts. This is caused by negative lobes of the interpolation functions falling over high-contrast edges and isolated bright pixels. This usually happens with linear data, such as raw CCD and DSLR images, and rarely with nonlinear or stretched images.
文件: Lanczos 与双三次样条插值的主要缺点是产生强烈的下冲（振铃）伪影，原因是插值函数的负瓣落在高对比边缘与孤立亮像素上。这通常发生在 CCD/单反原始图像等线性数据上，非线性或已拉伸图像很少出现。

FILE: Create a custom metric by combining frame quality variables with JavaScript expressions.
文件: 用 JavaScript 表达式组合帧质量变量，创建自定义指标。

FILE:
• FWHM – Full Width at Half Maximum (pixels)
  • Eccentricity – Star eccentricity (0 = circular)
  • SNR – Signal-to-Noise Ratio
  • PSFSignalWeight – PSF Signal Weight image quality estimator
  • Median – Median pixel value
  • Stars – Number of detected stars

JavaScript Functions & Operators:
文件:
• FWHM – 半高全宽（像素）
  • Eccentricity – 星点偏心率（0 = 圆形）
  • SNR – 信噪比
  • PSFSignalWeight – PSF 信号权重图像质量估计量
  • Median – 像素中值
  • Stars – 检测到的星点数

JavaScript 函数与运算符：

• 算术：+ - * / %
  • 幂：Math.pow(x, n)
  • 平方根：Math.sqrt(x)
  • 对数：Math.log(x)、Math.log10(x)
  • 三角：Math.sin(x)、Math.cos(x) 等
  • 最小/最大：Math.min(a, b)、Math.max(a, b)

FILE: The maximum number of control points allowed for the generation of surface splines using DDM-RBF algorithms.
文件: 用 DDM-RBF 算法生成曲面样条所允许的最大控制点数。

FILE: When a DDM-RBF is selected, this parameter allows to specify the maximum number of control points (or reference stars) that will be used (after surface simplification) to generate the 2-D interpolating/approximating surface splines that will be used to model coordinate transformations in the astrometric solution. For DDM-RBF types, this parameter can be specified in the range from 1000 to 25000 control points. The default value is 4000 points, usually sufficient for most practical applications. Increase this parameter to achieve more accuracy in the solution at the expense of more computational work. DDM-RBF surface spline generation has O(n^2) time complexity.
文件: 选择 DDM-RBF 时，此参数指定（曲面简化后）用于生成二维插值/近似曲面样条、以建模天文解算中坐标变换的最大控制点数（或参考星数）。DDM-RBF 类型可取 1000 到 25000，默认值 4000，通常足以应付多数实际应用。增大可提高解的精度，代价是计算量增加；DDM-RBF 曲面样条生成为 O(n^2) 复杂度。

FILE: When a DDM-RBF is selected, this parameter allows to specify the maximum number of control points (or reference stars) that will be used (after surface simplification) to generate the 2-D interpolating/approximating surface splines that will be used to model coordinate transformations in the astrometric solution. For DDM-RBF types, this parameter can be specified in the range from 1000 to 50000 control points. The default value is 4000 points, usually sufficient for most practical applications. Increase this parameter to achieve more accuracy in the solution at the expense of more computational work. DDM-RBF surface spline generation has O(n^2) time complexity.
文件: 选择 DDM-RBF 时，此参数指定（曲面简化后）用于生成二维插值/近似曲面样条、以建模天文解算中坐标变换的最大控制点数（或参考星数）。DDM-RBF 类型可取 1000 到 50000，默认值 4000，通常足以应付多数实际应用。增大可提高解的精度，代价是计算量增加；DDM-RBF 曲面样条生成为 O(n^2) 复杂度。

FILE: Correct the gradients along the edges of the mosaics at smaller scales, in their gradient correction with MARS (the edge correction of MultiscaleGradientCorrection).
文件: 在用 MARS 做梯度校正时（MultiscaleGradientCorrection 的边缘校正），以更小尺度校正马赛克边缘沿线的梯度。

FILE: Gradients are often stronger along the edges of an image, where they need a smaller gradient scale than the rest of the image. The gradient models are also computed at half, a quarter and an eighth of the gradient scale, as many as the aggressiveness (never below 128 pixels); each model replaces the previous one on a frame along the edges as wide as its scale, with a smooth transition. On a mosaic, the frames follow the edges of its coverage. The rest of the image is not changed. The scale factors are the same for all scales.
文件: 图像边缘处梯度往往更强，需要比图像其余部分更小的梯度尺度。梯度模型还按梯度尺度的二分之一、四分之一与八分之一计算，层数与激进程度相同（绝不低于 128 像素）；每个模型在沿边缘、宽度等于其尺度的条带内以平滑过渡替换前一个。在马赛克上，帧沿其覆盖范围的边缘走；图像其余部分不变，各尺度使用相同比例因子。

FILE: The gradient correction of the frames never uses it: in a mosaic, the edges of a frame are mostly seams, where smaller scales would model as gradients the bright structures that the seams cross.
文件: 对帧的梯度校正从不使用它：在马赛克中帧的边缘多为接缝，更小尺度会把接缝穿过亮结构误建模为梯度。

FILE: This parameter can be used to prevent the detection of small and bright image artifacts wrongly as stars. This can be useful to work with uncalibrated or poorly calibrated data, especially demosaiced CFA frames where uncorrected hot pixels have generated large bright artifacts that cannot be removed with a median filter (i.e., the Hot pixel removal parameter), or for rejection of cosmic rays.
文件: 此参数可防止把小而亮的图像伪影误检为星点，适用于未校准或校准不佳的数据，尤其是去马赛克 CFA 帧中未校正热像素生成了无法用中值滤波（即热像素去除参数）消除的大块亮伪影，也可用于剔除宇宙线。

FILE: * Automatic mode. A zero value enables an adaptive algorithm to find an optimal minimum structure size using statistical analysis techniques. This is the default option.
文件: * 自动模式。为零时启用自适应算法，用统计分析找出最优最小结构尺寸，这是默认选项。

FILE: * Disabled. A value of one turns off minimum structure size rejection since no detectable star can be represented by less than one pixel.
文件: * 禁用。设为 1 时关闭最小结构尺寸剔除，因为没有可检测星点会小于一个像素。

FILE: Model the local distortions that the global transformation cannot represent with recursive point surface splines of the refined control points: the registered images are resampled with the global transformation plus the splines. Useful for wide fields, images acquired with different instruments, and images across a meridian flip. Requires the full resolution refinement.
文件: 用精化控制点的递归点曲面样条，建模全局变换无法表示的局部畸变：已对齐图像按全局变换加样条重采样。适用于宽视场、不同仪器拍摄的图像，以及跨中天翻转的图像。需要启用全分辨率精化。

FILE: The distortion model grows iteratively from the global transformation: the features of both images are matched with their positions predicted by the current model, pairs of anomalous local sparsity are rejected, and the model is fitted again, so it reaches regions of strongly varying distortion. The refinement measures the control points at the pairs of the final model.
文件: 畸变模型由全局变换迭代生长：把两幅图像的特征与当前模型预测的位置匹配，剔除局部稀疏度异常的点对并重新拟合模型，从而覆盖畸变剧烈变化的区域；精化在最终模型的点对处测量控制点。

FILE: This parameter specifies the maximum number of control points allowed for the generation of surface splines using DDM-RBF algorithms.
文件: 此参数指定用 DDM-RBF 算法生成曲面样条所允许的最大控制点数。

FILE: When the distortion correction option is selected, this parameter allows specifying the maximum number of control points (or reference stars) that will be used (after surface simplification) to generate the 2-D interpolating/approximating surface splines that model coordinate transformations for image registration. Thanks to PixInsight's efficient DDM-RBF implementation, this parameter can be specified from 1000 to 25000 control points. The default value is 4000 points, which is sufficient for the vast majority of practical applications.
文件: 选择畸变校正选项时，此参数指定（曲面简化后）用于生成二维插值/近似曲面样条、以建模图像对齐坐标变换的最大控制点数（或参考星数）。得益于 PixInsight 高效的 DDM-RBF 实现，可取 1000 到 25000，默认值 4000 足以应付绝大多数实际应用。

FILE: Per image fits a smoothing surface spline to the zero points of each image: it follows any smooth gradient, fixed or changing, at the cost of some noise.
文件: 逐图像对每幅图像的零点拟合平滑曲面样条：能跟随任何固定或变化的平滑梯度，代价是引入一些噪声。

FILE: Global fits a single surface fixed to the detector to the zero points of all the images: errors of the flat field and vignetting, which follow the detector through dithering and meridian flips. It adds almost no noise, but it cannot follow gradients that change from image to image.
文件: 全局对所有图像的零点拟合固定于探测器的单一曲面：对应平场误差与暗角，它们会随抖动与中天翻转跟着探测器走。它几乎不增加噪声，但无法跟随逐幅变化的梯度。

FILE: Global + per image, the default, adds to the global surface a smoothing surface spline fitted on each image to the differences between the zero points and the global surface, for the gradients that change, such as those of the differential extinction or of passing clouds.
文件: 全局 + 逐图像（默认）在全局曲面之外，再对每幅图像的零点与全局曲面之差拟合平滑曲面样条，用于差分消光或飘云等变化的梯度。

FILE: A local model fitted to fewer than 100 stars is reported: multiplicative gradients are unstable, and so are models of them made from few stars.
文件: 拟合星点少于 100 颗的局部模型会被报告：乘性梯度不稳定，用少量星点建立的模型同样不稳定。

FILE: Some image acquisition applications store apparent or 'of the date' coordinates in image metadata without providing the necessary metadata items for our knowledge. If the initial alignment task fails and this option is enabled, a second attempt will be initiated, assuming that the center coordinates are apparent.
文件: 有些图像采集软件把视（「历元当天」）坐标存入元数据，却没有提供我们判定所需的元数据项。若初始对齐失败且启用此选项，会假定中心坐标为视坐标再发起第二次尝试。

FILE: This feature is helpful for relatively narrow-field images with wrong apparent center coordinates in their metadata. The difference between ICRS/astrometric and apparent coordinates may cause the center coordinates to lie outside image boundaries. In these cases, the initial alignment task cannot succeed, and the plate-solving process will fail.
文件: 此功能对元数据中视中心坐标有误的较窄视场图像很有帮助：ICRS/天体测量坐标与视坐标之差可能使中心坐标落到图像边界之外，此时初始对齐无法成功，解算也会失败。

FILE: In cases where this feature allows us to solve the image, a warning message will be written to the console. If you see many such warnings in your logs, please contact the developers of your image acquisition software to let them know about this error. They should fix it by including the necessary metadata to identify apparent coordinates:
文件: 若靠此功能解算成功，控制台会写出一条警告。若日志中大量出现此类警告，请联系图像采集软件开发者告知该错误；他们应补上用于标识视坐标的必要元数据：

XISF 属性：Observation:CelestialReferenceSystem = "True"
FITS 关键字：RADESYS = "GAPPT"

FILE: If this field is left blank (or with its default "<integrate...>" value), the compiler output will be integrated with the running PixInsight platform. Note that this requires full read/write access permissions on the 'doc' subdirectory of the running PixInsight distribution. Such permissions are not available if you are running a normally installed application, since default installations use system protected directories (e.g., /opt on FreeBSD and Linux, or /Applications on macOS). This option requires you to manually change permissions for the 'doc' installation subdirectory, or to run a local installation of PixInsight on Linux or FreeBSD.
文件: 此栏留空（或保持默认 <integrate...> 值）时，编译器输出会与正在运行的 PixInsight 平台集成。注意这需要对运行中 PixInsight 发行版的 doc 子目录拥有完整读写权限；若运行的是常规安装程序则无法获得该权限，因为默认安装使用系统保护目录（如 FreeBSD/Linux 的 /opt、macOS 的 /Applications）。此选项要求你手动修改 doc 安装子目录的权限，或在 Linux/FreeBSD 上运行本地安装的 PixInsight。

FILE: Correct the gradients of each mosaic once composed, with MultiscaleGradientCorrection and the MARS database at a large gradient scale. Small residual gradients of the frames accumulate errors in the normalization of their overlaps, especially in wide-field mosaics: this global correction removes them.
文件: 马赛克合成后，用 MultiscaleGradientCorrection 与较大梯度尺度下的 MARS 数据库校正每幅马赛克的梯度。帧的微小残余梯度会在重叠区归一化中累积误差，宽视场马赛克尤甚，此全局校正可将其消除。

FILE: Each mosaic is flux calibrated with SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration, and its calibration is stored with it; the scale factors of MARS are fitted automatically. A MARS image must contain the whole mosaic, unless MARS reference mosaics are allowed (a fallback; see below). Before the composition, every flux calibrated frame is checked for MARS reference data, so that a frame without them stops the process early.
文件: 每幅马赛克用 SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration 做通量校准，校准结果与它一起保存；MARS 比例因子自动拟合。一张 MARS 图像必须包含整幅马赛克，除非允许 MARS 参考马赛克（兜底方案，见下）。合成前会检查每幅已通量校准的帧是否有 MARS 参考数据，没有则提前中止流程。

FILE: Automatic: the gradient scale nearest to a quarter of the smaller side of the mosaic, from 2048 to 8192 pixels.
文件: 自动：取最接近马赛克短边四分之一的梯度尺度，范围 2048 到 8192 像素。

FILE: Compute the intersection region between the catalog reference field and the target image in the initial alignment task.
文件: 在初始对齐任务中计算星表参考场与目标图像的交集区域。

FILE: When this option is applied, a special FFT-based algorithm is used to precompute the intersection region between the reference star field and the set of detected stars in the target image during the initial alignment task. Once the intersection has been found, the initial star matching process is restricted to the intersection area. This greatly improves the performance of the RANSAC algorithm by reducing the fraction of outliers (false putative matches) in the initial set of star pair matches. This feature is recommended for images with elongated geometries, especially when the aspect ratio (the quotient between the longest and shortest sides of the image) is approximately greater than two, as well as for problematic images with abnormally scarce detectable stars.
文件: 应用此选项时，会在初始对齐期间用基于 FFT 的专用算法预计算参考星场与目标图像检测星点集合的交集区域；找到交集后，初始星点匹配被限制在该区域内。这通过降低初始星点对匹配集合中离群（错误候选匹配）的比例，大幅提升 RANSAC 算法性能。推荐用于细长几何形状的图像，尤其是长宽比（最长边与最短边之比）约大于 2 时，也适用于可检测星点异常稀少的问题图像。

FILE: Derivative order of continuity of variable-order two-dimensional surface splines.
文件: 变阶二维曲面样条的连续可微阶数。

FILE: Second-order polyharmonic radial basis functions, also known as thin plate splines, allow for generating extremely adaptable numerical models for images affected by strong field distortions. However, in cases of extremely complex arbitrary distortions, higher-order functions can be necessary to model them accurately.
文件: 二阶多重调和径向基函数（也称薄板样条）能为受强视场畸变影响的图像生成适应性极强的数值模型；但对极其复杂的任意畸变，可能需要更高阶函数才能精确建模。

FILE: When a variable-order polyharmonic RBF is selected, the function order can be selected from 2 to 6. High-order surface splines compute interpolation/regularization functions that are continuously differentiable up to the specified order and, hence, can more accurately model complex distortions. However, high-order splines, especially of orders above 4, are numerically more unstable and can lead to errors caused by ill-conditioned linear systems.
文件: 选择变阶多重调和 RBF 时，函数阶数可取 2 到 6。高阶曲面样条计算的插值/正则化函数可连续可微到指定阶数，因而能更精确建模复杂畸变；但高阶样条（尤其 4 阶以上）数值上更不稳定，可能因病态线性方程组而产生误差。

FILE:
• DDM thin plate splines (implicitly of second order) for distortion correction under normal conditions. This is the default option.
  • 3rd order DDM variable-order polyharmonic or 4th order variable-order polyharmonic RBFs for correction
文件:
• 正常条件下的畸变校正用 DDM 薄板样条（隐含二阶），这是默认选项。
  • 3 阶 DDM 变阶多重调和或 4 阶变阶多重调和 RBF 用于复杂畸变的校正

FILE: The region of the fitted PSF measures each star over the elliptical region of its own point spread function, extended by the growth factor. The region adapts to every star: to the seeing, to the position in the field, and to the focus of each frame, so the same fraction of the light of every star is measured. Each region carries the error of its own fit, which a time series measured differentially cannot cancel.
文件: 拟合 PSF 区域在每颗星自身点扩散函数的椭圆区域（按增长因子扩展）内测量它。区域会适应每颗星——视宁度、视场位置与每帧的焦点，因此每颗星测量的都是相同比例的光。每个区域带有自身拟合的误差，差分测量的时间序列无法将其抵消。

FILE: A circular aperture measures over a circle of a fixed radius in pixels, the classical way. It is reproducible by other software and independent of the fit, and the same for every star, which is what the differential photometry of a time series needs.
文件: 圆形孔径在固定像素半径的圆内测量，是经典方式；可被其他软件复现、不依赖拟合、且对每颗星相同，正是时间序列差分测光所需要的。

FILE: An automatic circular aperture is computed for each image from the robust mean FWHM of its stars, with the diameter given below, and is the same for every star of the image. It follows the seeing from one image to the next, and needs no radius to be chosen for each instrument or night. This is the default.
文件: 自动圆形孔径按每幅图像星点的稳健平均 FWHM 计算，直径由下方给定，对该图像所有星点相同。它随视宁度逐幅变化，无需为每台仪器或每个夜晚选定半径，这是默认选项。

FILE: Internally, the peak response property of the star detection algorithm is expressed in kurtosis units. For each detected structure, kurtosis is evaluated from all significant pixels with values greater than the estimated mean local background. Peak response is the minimum value of kurtosis necessary to trigger star detection.
文件: 内部以峰度单位表示检测算法的峰值响应属性：对每个检测结构，用所有大于估计平均局部背景的显著像素评估峰度；峰值响应即触发星点检测所需的最小峰度值。

FILE: To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum peak response, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.
文件: 为把界面与内部实现隔离，此参数归一化到 [0,1] 范围，0 与 1 分别表示最小与最大峰值响应。这一抽象让我们能更换星点检测引擎而不破坏依赖它的工具与进程。

FILE:
• DDM thin plate splines (implicitly of second order) for distortion correction under normal conditions. This is the default option.
  • 3rd or 4th order DDM variable-order polyharmonic RBFs for correction of complex distortions with maximum accuracy.
文件:

Lanczos is, in general, the best interpolation algorithm for image registration of linear images when no large scale changes are required. Lanczos has excellent detail preservation and subpixel registration performance with minimal generation of aliasing effects. Its main drawback is generation of undershoot (ringing) artifacts, but this problem can be fixed in most cases with the implemented clamping mechanism (see the clamping threshold parameter below).

FILE:
The type of positions to be calculated.

True: Positions of the object calculated without accounting for light-travel time. These coordinates are only useful for calculation verification purposes.

Geometric: Includes light-travel time corrections for solar system bodies, space motion corrections for stars (parallax, radial velocity and proper motions).

Astrometric: Like geometric positions, plus correction for relativistic deflection of light due to solar gravitation, when applicable.

Proper: Like astrometric positions, plus corrections for the aberration of light, including relativistic terms.

Apparent: Like proper positions, plus corrections for frame bias, precession and nutation. The origin of right ascension is the true equinox of date.

Intermediate: Like proper positions, plus corrections for frame bias, precession and nutation. The origin of right ascension is the Celestial Intermediate Origin (CIO).
文件:
要计算的位置类型。

True: 不考虑光行时计算的天体位置。这些坐标仅用于验算。

Geometric: 包含太阳系天体的光行时修正，以及恒星的空间运动修正（视差、视向速度和自行）。

Astrometric: 在几何位置基础上，再在适用时加入太阳引力引起的光线相对论偏折修正。

Proper: 在天体测量位置基础上，再加入光行差修正，含相对论项。

Apparent: 在固有位置基础上，再加入坐标框架偏置、岁差和章动修正。赤经原点为当日真春分点。

Intermediate: 在固有位置基础上，再加入坐标框架偏置、岁差和章动修正。赤经原点为天球中间原点 (CIO)。

Automatic: the largest size that keeps the previews of a run (the images and the mosaic) within an eighth of the available physical memory, between 4 and 64 megapixels each. Fit the view: twice the size of the view, which it fits exactly at 1:2. 1:1 to 1:8: fixed reductions, within the limits of a bitmap (32767 pixels per side and four times the automatic size).

A change renders the source images again when they are shown; the outputs of a run keep the resolution they were rendered with during the run.
文件:

更改后，源图像在显示时会重新渲染；一次运行的输出保持其运行期间所用的分辨率。

FILE:
Image matching: the target images are registered with respect to the reference image and adopt its geometry: the registered images have the dimensions of the reference, and every pixel of a registered image corresponds to the same pixel of the reference.

Mosaic frames: there is no reference image. All the images are registered pairwise, their transformations are combined into the global geometry of the mosaic, where the anchor image defines the orientation and scale (the image that minimizes the stretching of the others on its plane: the first image of the list for frames related by translations, the central image for the sweep of a rotating camera), and each image is generated as a separate frame on a canvas with the dimensions of the whole mosaic. The regions of a frame not covered by its image are zero. The frames can also be composed into a mosaic by multiscale blending; see the Mosaic options.

图像匹配: 目标图像相对参考图像配准并采用其几何形状：配准图像具有参考图像的尺寸，且配准图像的每个像素对应参考图像的同一像素。

马赛克帧: 没有参考图像。所有图像两两配准，其变换合并为马赛克的全局几何，其中锚定图像决定取向与尺度（即在其平面上使其他图像拉伸最小的图像：对仅存在平移关系的帧取列表第一幅，对旋转相机的扫描取中央那幅），每幅图像在其画布上生成为独立的一帧，画布尺寸为整个马赛克尺寸。帧内未被其图像覆盖的区域为零。这些帧也可通过多尺度混合合成为马赛克；参见“马赛克”选项。

FILE:
Choose the anchor image of the mosaic automatically. The anchor defines the orientation and scale of the mosaic: the other images are projected on its plane. The automatic anchor is the image that minimizes the stretching of the other images on its plane (for frames related by translations, such as those of a lunar mosaic, the first image of the list; for the sweep of a rotating camera, the central image) and, with the same stretching, the one that gives the smallest canvas.

When disabled, the first checked image of the list is the anchor; use the Up and Down buttons to order the list.
文件:
自动选择马赛克的锚定图像。锚定图像决定马赛克的取向与尺度：其他图像投影到其平面上。自动锚定会选择在其平面上使其他图像拉伸最小的图像（对仅存在平移关系的帧，例如月面马赛克，取列表第一幅；对旋转相机的扫描，取中央那幅），拉伸相同时则取画布最小的那幅。

禁用时，列表中第一幅勾选的图像即为锚定；可用上移、下移按钮调整列表顺序。

FILE:
Register every pair of images of the mosaic.

When disabled, the pairs are tried by their distance in the order of capture (the natural order of the file names), and two images already connected through reliable registrations are only registered when their predicted placement may overlap. This is several times faster, and no overlap is missed because of the order of the images. Enable this option for difficult data, such as frames of repetitive structures where a false registration could be as strong as a genuine one.
文件:
对马赛克的每一对图像都执行配准。

禁用时，按拍摄顺序（文件名的自然顺序）依距离尝试配对，已通过可靠配准连通的两幅图像只在预测摆放可能重叠时才配准。这样快数倍，而且不会因图像顺序而漏掉重叠。对困难数据请启用此选项，例如存在重复结构的帧，此时错误配准可能与真实配准同样强。

FILE:
In image matching mode, copy the astrometric solution of the reference image, if it has one, and its associated metadata to the registered images. PixInsight's native astrometric solutions consist of standardized XISF properties defining the parameters and data structures required to represent both linear and nonlinear solutions with arbitrary distortion corrections based on surface splines.

When this option is disabled, the registered images have no astrometric solution: a solution of a target image no longer applies to the image once it has been registered, and is removed. Mosaic frames never have an astrometric solution: the MosaicByCoordinates script is the tool for mosaics based on astrometric solutions.

* Important: Inherited solutions are almost always less accurate than solutions computed directly on the registered images. The differences can be significant for solutions with distortion corrections. The rigorous procedure is to recompute the astrometric solutions of the registered images, using the inherited solution as a starting point. For this reason this option is disabled by default.
文件:
在图像匹配模式下，把参考图像的天文测量解（若有）及其关联元数据复制给配准图像。PixInsight 原生天文测量解由标准化的 XISF 属性构成，定义了用任意表面样条畸变校正来表示线性与非线性解所需的参数和数据结构。

禁用此项时，配准图像没有天文测量解：目标图像的解在图像配准后不再适用，会被移除。马赛克帧永远没有天文测量解：基于天文测量解的马赛克应以 MosaicByCoordinates 脚本为工具。

* 重要: 继承的解几乎总是不如直接在配准图像上计算的解精确。对带畸变校正的解，差异可能很明显。严谨的做法是以继承的解为初值，重新计算配准图像的天文测量解。因此本选项默认禁用。

FILE:
In image matching mode, integrate the reference image and the registered images into one image with the geometry of the reference: a new product of the registration, written as <reference>_integration.xisf in the output directory, or generated as a new image window when the reference is a view. It has the metadata of the reference, and its astrometric solution as the registered images have it.

Each image is normalized to the reference with its location (median) and its scale relative to the reference (see Weights), and each pixel is integrated from the images that cover it. No pixel rejection is applied: the ImageIntegration process is the tool for the integration of calibrated frames with rejection of outliers.
文件:
在图像匹配模式下，把参考图像与配准图像叠加为一幅具有参考图像几何形状的图像：这是配准的新产物，以 <reference>_integration.xisf 写入输出目录，或在参考为视图时生成为新的图像窗口。它带有参考图像的元数据，以及配准图像所具有的天文测量解。

每幅图像按其位置（中位数）和相对参考的尺度（见权重）归一化到参考，每个像素由覆盖它的各图像叠加而成。不进行任何像素剔除：校准帧的叠加并剔除异常值，应使用 ImageIntegration 进程。

FILE: Compose the registered frames into a mosaic image: a multiscale blend where each canvas pixel belongs to the frame whose own border is farthest, fine details blend over a few pixels around the seams and large-scale differences over hundreds of pixels. The mosaic is written next to the registered frames for disk files, named after the anchor image, or generated as a new image window for views.
文件: 把配准后的帧合成为马赛克图像：多尺度混合，画布上每个像素归属于自身边界最远的帧，精细细节在接缝周围几像素内混合，大尺度差异在数百像素范围内混合。对磁盘文件，马赛克与配准帧一同写出，以锚定图像命名；对视图，则生成为新的图像窗口。

FILE: At the two finest scales, inside the seam bands, take each background pixel from one frame selected at random with the probability given by its weight, instead of averaging the frames: the noise and texture statistics are preserved across the seams, since an average of two textures is smoother than either of them. The pixels above the background of a frame (stars, nebulae, bright structures) are taken from the frame that owns them in the partition.
文件: 在最细的两个尺度上，接缝带内的每个背景像素按权重给出的概率从随机选中的一帧取得，而不是对各帧取平均：这样噪声与纹理统计可跨接缝保持一致，因为两种纹理的平均比其中任何一种都更平滑。高于某帧背景的像素（星点、星云、明亮结构）则从划分中拥有它的那一帧取得。

Estimate the memory and the disk space that the task will need before generating anything, and stop with an error if they exceed the physical memory available on this machine or the free space of the output directory. The estimate is reported on the console in any case, with a warning when it exceeds half of the available resources.

Disable it to proceed at your own risk on a machine whose capabilities are not reported correctly, such as one with compressed memory or with storage of deferred allocation.
