FILE: This is the maximum dispersion allowed for background sample pixels. By decreasing this value, background samples will reject more outlier pixels with respect to the median of each sample box. This is useful to make background samples immune to noise and small-scale bright structures, such as relatively small stars.
文件: 这是背景样本像素允许的最大离散度。减小该值会使背景样本剔除更多相对各样本框中位数的离群像素，有助于让背景样本不受噪声和相对较小的恒星等小尺度亮结构的影响。

FILE: This is the maximum dispersion allowed for background samples, with respect to the median of the target image. By decreasing this value, ABE will be more restrictive to select background samples that differ too much from the mean background of the whole image. This is useful to avoid inclusion of large-scale structures, such as extended nebular regions, in the generated background model.
文件: 这是背景样本相对目标图像中位数允许的最大离散度。减小该值会使 ABE 更严格地排除与整幅图像平均背景差异过大的背景样本，有助于避免把弥散星云区等大尺度结构纳入生成的背景模型。

FILE: This is the maximum distance in pixels for the mouse cursor to trigger an action when it is clicked close to a sensitive point. For example, this is used to change cursor shapes when you place the mouse near preview rectangle edges.
文件: 这是鼠标在敏感点附近单击时触发动作的最大距离（像素）。例如，当鼠标靠近预览矩形边缘时，用它来改变光标形状。

FILE: This is the maximum number of recently opened files that PixInsight can remember for quick access from the File > Open Recent menu.
文件: 这是 PixInsight 为「文件 > 打开最近」菜单保留的最近打开文件最大数量。

FILE: This is the midtones balance parameter of a histogram transformation that will be applied to the working local support image. Use it to fine tune protection on moderately bright areas.
文件: 这是施加于工作局部支撑图像的直方图变换的中间调平衡参数。用它微调中等亮度区域的保护。

FILE: This is the minimum rotation angle in degrees for the mouse wheel to trigger a zoom in/out action. The default value is 15 degrees.
文件: 鼠标滚轮触发放大/缩小所需的最小旋转角度（度）。默认值为 15 度。

FILE: This is the name of a FITS keyword that will be used to retrieve image weights, if the FITS keyword option has been selected as the weighting criterion.
文件: 当加权依据选择「FITS 关键字」时，此处为用于读取图像权重的 FITS 关键字名称。

FILE: This is the name of a FITS keyword that will be used to retrieve input pedestals, if the Custom FITS keyword option has been selected as pedestal mode.
文件: 当基座模式选择「自定义 FITS 关键字」时，此处为用于读取输入基座的 FITS 关键字名称。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a Gaussian convolution filter applied for noise reduction. Noise reduction is disabled by default; it is only necessary for images suffering from severe noise, especially images with clipped histograms and similar artifacts. Increasing this parameter should not be necessary for well calibrated images.
文件: 这是用于降噪的高斯卷积滤波半径（像素）。降噪默认禁用，只有噪声严重的图像才需要，尤其是直方图被削顶及类似伪影的图像。校准良好的图像通常无需增大此参数。

FILE: This is the radius in pixels of a morphological median filter that will be applied to smooth the noise reduction mask. A smoothed mask is more robust to small-scale local variations, which makes it more efficient for noise reduction. However, too large of a smoothness value will lead to an inaccurate mask that won't protect significant structures appropriately. Good values are often in the range from 1 to 4, depending on the dominant scale of the noise in the image. To disable smoothing of the mask, set this parameter to zero.
文件: 这是施加于降噪蒙版以使其平滑的形态学中值滤波器的半径（像素）。平滑后的蒙版对小尺度局部变化更稳健，因而降噪更高效。但平滑值过大会导致蒙版不准确，无法恰当保护显著结构。好的取值常在 1 到 4 之间，取决于图像中噪声的主导尺度。要禁用蒙版平滑，把此参数设为零。
这是第二个参数。

FILE: This is the shadows clipping point parameter of a histogram transformation that will be applied to the working local support image. Increase it to decrease protection on dark areas.
文件: 这是施加于工作局部支撑图像的直方图变换的暗部截断点参数。增大它可降低暗区的保护。

FILE: This is the standard deviation of a Gaussian filter that will be used to convolve the linear mask. A slightly smoothed mask is more robust to small-scale local variations, which makes it more efficient for noise reduction. However, too large of a smoothness value will lead to an inaccurate mask that won't protect significant structures appropriately. Good values are usually in the range from 1 to 3 sigma, depending on the dominant scale of the noise in the image. To disable smoothing of the mask set this parameter to zero.
文件: 这是将用于对线性蒙版做卷积的高斯滤波器的标准差。略微平滑的蒙版对小尺度局部变化更为稳健，从而更有利于降噪。但平滑度过大会导致蒙版不准确，无法恰当保护显著结构。合适的取值通常在 1 至 3 sigma 之间，取决于图像中噪声的主导尺度。若要禁用蒙版平滑，请将此参数设为零。
这是第三个参数。

FILE: This is the time elapsed (in milliseconds) before the Process Console window is shown when a process is executed and the console is hidden. Set this value to zero to disable the delayed console feature. Note that this setting has no effect if the console has been floated as a top-level window; it only affects to the console when it is docked as an AutoHide window.
文件: 这是进程执行且控制台处于隐藏状态时，进程控制台窗口显示之前的等待时间（毫秒）。把此值设为零即关闭延迟显示控制台功能。注意：若控制台已浮动为顶层窗口，此设置无效；它只影响控制台作为自动隐藏窗口停靠时的情况。

FILE: This is the vertical position of the computed star barycenter for the currently selected alignment reference in the source image.
文件: 当前所选对齐参考在源图像中计算所得星点重心的纵坐标。

FILE: This option allows you to apply a multiscale transformation in a colorimetrically-defined color space that you can control with RGB working space parameters.
文件: 该选项允许在以色度学定义的色彩空间中应用多尺度变换，该空间可用 RGB 工作空间参数控制。

FILE: This option can be used to inspect how FastIntegration weighted the frames during its execution.
文件: 该选项可用于查看 FastIntegration 在执行时对各帧施加的权重。

FILE: This option can be useful for mosaic construction in extremely difficult cases, when automatic intersection computation (see above) fails. In general, this only happens for images with minimal overlapping. To use this option, you must define previews covering (roughly) the overlapped areas between the reference and target images, then execute StarAlignment on the target image with this option enabled. In this way StarAlignment will limit the star matching process to the areas covered by the previews, which greatly improves the performance of the RANSAC algorithm by reducing the fraction of outliers (false putative matches) in the initial set of star pair matches. With the help of this feature, one can build mosaics of any practical size and complexity.
文件: 在自动交集计算（见上）失败的极端困难情况下，此选项对构建马赛克很有用。一般来说这只会发生在重叠极少的图像上。要使用此选项，你必须定义大致覆盖参考图像与目标图像重叠区域的预览，然后对此目标图像启用此选项执行 StarAlignment。这样 StarAlignment 会把星点匹配过程限制在预览覆盖的区域内，通过减少初始星对匹配集合中的离群比例（错误可能匹配）大幅提升 RANSAC 算法的性能。借助此功能，可以构建任意实际尺寸与复杂度的马赛克。

FILE: This option can be useful to preserve shadow detail.
文件: 该选项有助于保留阴影细节。

FILE: This option can improve screen rendering performance at the expense of accuracy. It can be useful on slow machines with large monitors, but is not recommended under normal conditions, unless you really need to speed up screen representations.
文件: 此选项可提升屏幕渲染性能，代价是精度下降。它在配有大尺寸显示器的较慢机器上可能有用，但正常情况下不推荐使用，除非确实需要加快屏幕显示速度。

FILE: This option creates a grayscale image from the CFA matrix as is. No interpolation is done and the output is a monochrome image reproducing the CFA pattern, as stored in the device.
文件: 此选项按 CFA 矩阵原样生成灰度图像。不做任何插值，输出是重现设备中存储的 CFA 排列的单色图像。

FILE: This option creates an RGB color image from the CFA matrix as is. No interpolation is done and each pixel is either red, green or blue, as defined by the CFA pattern.
文件: 此选项按 CFA 矩阵原样生成 RGB 彩色图像。不做任何插值，每个像素按 CFA 排列定义为红、绿或蓝。

FILE: This option enables a distortion correction algorithm based on 2-D surface splines, also known as thin plates. This option should always be selected when the target image suffers from significant distortions, or if it deviates significantly from an ideal projected image, which usually happens in images taken with focal lengths shorter than 400 mm.
文件: 此选项启用基于二维曲面样条（又称薄板样条）的畸变校正算法。当目标图像存在明显畸变，或明显偏离理想投影图像时应始终选中此选项——这在焦距短于 400 mm 拍摄的图像中很常见。

FILE: This option generates a demosaiced RGB color image with half the dimensions of the original raw frame. It is the fastest option available (twice as fast as bilinear) and is useful to load quick image previews.
文件: 此选项生成去马赛克的 RGB 彩色图像，尺寸为原始帧的一半。它是最快的选项（比双线性快一倍），适合快速加载图像预览。

FILE: This option has no effect on CPU inference, which is always performed in full precision.
文件: 该选项对 CPU 推理没有影响，CPU 推理始终以全精度执行。

FILE: This option is enabled by default, as automatic exposure evaluation is a very fast and robust process that should never fail under normal conditions. Note that the automatic exposure evaluation routine does not depend on existing image metadata, as FITS headers or EXIF data (which are simply ignored by this tool). The computed relative exposures depend exclusively on actual pixel values and their statistical properties.
文件: 此选项默认启用，因为自动曝光评估是非常快速而稳健的过程，正常工作条件下绝不应失败。注意自动曝光评估例程不依赖已有图像元数据，例如 FITS 头或 EXIF 数据（本工具会直接忽略它们）。所计算的相对曝光完全取决于实际像素值及其统计特性。

FILE: This option is enabled by default, but you may disable it for the only purpose of increasing the execution speed at the cost of rejecting more frames when the fast alignment method does not respect the given tolerance.
文件: 此选项默认启用；你也可以禁用它，唯一目的是提升执行速度，代价是在快速对齐方法不满足给定容差时会剔除更多帧。

FILE: This option is enabled by default. Disabling it is not recommended under normal working conditions.
文件: 该选项默认启用。常规使用中不建议关闭。

FILE: This option is ignored for frames acquired with X-Trans sensors.
文件: 对 X-Trans 传感器采集的帧忽略该选项。

FILE: This option is only applicable to execution on views, and is always ignored when LocalNormalization is executed in the global context (that is, as a batch procedure).
文件: 此选项仅适用于在视图上执行；当 LocalNormalization 在全局上下文中执行（即作为批处理流程）时始终被忽略。

FILE: This option is only applicable to wallpapers generated from SVG files. Raster graphics are always rendered directly without manipulation, besides the necessary scaling to fill the primary screen.
文件: 此选项仅适用于由 SVG 文件生成的壁纸。栅格图形一律直接渲染、不做处理，只进行填充主屏幕所需的缩放。

FILE: This option is useful to avoid duplicating already available objects in newly generated XEPH files.
文件: 该选项可避免在新生成的 XEPH 文件中重复已有的天体。

FILE: This option is useful to compare the results of different integration procedures. For example, by comparing SNR and PSF Signal Weight estimates you can know which image normalization and weighting criteria lead to the best results in terms of image quality.
文件: 此选项便于比较不同叠加流程的结果。例如对比 SNR 与 PSF 信号权重估计，就能知道哪种图像归一化与加权标准在图像质量上效果最好。

FILE: This option should also be disabled for integration of raw bias and dark frames, since in these cases existing PEDESTAL keywords should be preserved in the generated master bias and dark frames. These pedestals will be subtracted automatically by the ImageCalibration process for calibration of flat and light frames.
文件: 叠加原始偏置帧与暗帧时也应禁用此选项，因为这些情况下生成的 主偏置帧与主暗场帧中应保留已有的 PEDESTAL 关键字。这些基座会在 ImageCalibration 校准平场与亮帧时被自动扣除。

FILE: This option should be disabled under normal working conditions. It can be useful in special cases to limit local normalization to correction of additive gradients exclusively. However, without its multiplicative component the normalization function will be less accurate in general.
文件: 正常工作条件下应禁用此选项。在特殊情况下可用它把局部归一化限制为仅校正加性梯度。但没有乘性分量时，归一化函数整体上精度会下降。

FILE: This option should be enabled for normal use. If you disable it, the integrated image won't be generated at the end of the process. You can disable this option to save a relatively modest amount of computation time and resources while you are trying out rejection parameters. To evaluate the quality of pixel rejection, you normally are only interested in rejection pixel counts and/or rejection maps.
文件: 正常使用时应启用此选项。若禁用它，进程结束时不会生成叠加图像。在试调剔除参数时，可以禁用此选项以节省相对有限的运算时间与资源。要评估像素剔除质量，你通常只关心剔除像素计数和/或剔除图。

FILE: This option should normally be disabled when the normalization reference image is of good quality and does not have significant outliers.
文件: 当归一化参考图像质量良好且没有明显离群值时，通常应关闭该选项。

FILE: This parameter acts as a threshold for the regularization process, preventing diffusion over edge features stronger than the threshold value. Smaller values are more aggressive to protect edges against blurring caused by the diffusion process, so the Inpaint process may be very slow. Larger values are more permissive and lead to smoother images, but may cause some detail loss.
文件: 此参数充当正则化过程的阈值，阻止在强于阈值的边缘特征上扩散。取值越小，对边缘的保护越激进，抵抗扩散造成的模糊，但 Inpaint 进程可能非常慢；取值越大越宽松，图像更平滑，但可能丢失部分细节。

FILE: This parameter acts as a threshold for the regularization process, preventing diffusion over edge features stronger than the threshold value. Smaller values are more aggressive to protect edges against blurring caused by the diffusion process. Larger values are more permissive and lead to smoother images, but may cause some detail loss. This is the most critical parameter of the TGVDenoise process.
文件: 此参数充当正则化过程的阈值，防止扩散越过强于该阈值的边缘特征。较小的值更激进，可保护边缘不被扩散过程模糊。较大的值更宽松，会得到更平滑的图像，但可能造成一些细节损失。这是 TGVDenoise 进程最关键的一个参数。

FILE: This parameter allows limiting star detection to a subset of the brightest sources in the image adaptively. By requiring relatively high SNR levels in the evaluated sources, the accuracy and robustness of the scale evaluation process can be largely improved. The default value is 40, which is quite appropriate in most cases.
文件: 此参数可将恒星检测自适应地限制在图像中最亮的一部分源上。通过在参与评估的源上要求较高的信噪比，可显著提升尺度评估过程的精度与稳健性。默认值为 40，在多数情况下相当合适。

FILE: This parameter allows limiting star detection to a subset of the brightest sources in the image adaptively. By requiring relatively high SNR levels in the evaluated sources, the accuracy and robustness of the signal evaluation process can be largely improved. The default value is 40, which is quite appropriate in most cases.
文件: 此参数可将恒星检测自适应地限制在图像中最亮的一部分源上。通过在参与评估的源上要求较高的信噪比，可显著提升信号评估的精度与稳健性。默认值为 40，在多数情况下相当合适。

FILE: This parameter and the value of the FITS keyword DATE-OBS (if available) are used to identify sequences of subframe observations that occurred during the same night for data presentation purposes.
文件: 此参数与 FITS 关键字 DATE-OBS 的值（若存在）用于识别同一夜内发生的子帧观测序列，以便呈现数据。

FILE: This parameter controls the degree of deringing applied to large-scale ringing artifacts, such as those generated around bright and large diffuse objects. Try to find the smallest value that fixes ringing. Too large of an amount value will lead to overcorrection, generating bright deringing artifacts in the output image.
文件: 此参数控制对大尺度振铃伪影（例如明亮的大面积弥散天体周围产生的那些）施加的去环程度。请尽量选取能消除振铃的最小值。amount 取值过大会导致过度校正，在输出图像中产生亮的去环伪影。

FILE: This parameter controls the degree of deringing applied to small-scale ringing artifacts, such as those generated around stars. Try to find the smallest value that fixes ringing. Too large of an amount value will lead to overcorrection, generating bright deringing artifacts in the output image.
文件: 此参数控制对小尺度振铃伪影（例如恒星周围产生的那些）施加的去环程度。请尽量选取能消除振铃的最小值。amount 取值过大会导致过度校正，在输出图像中产生亮的去环伪影。

FILE: This parameter controls the shape of the applied large-scale hyperbolic function. Decrease to brighten the image.
文件: 该参数控制所用大尺度双曲函数的形状。减小可提亮图像。

FILE: This parameter controls the strength of the diffusion process that smoothens the image. Large values are more aggressive. Small values tend to give results more similar to the original image, and preserve more texture in the image.
文件: 此参数控制平滑图像的扩散过程强度。取值越大越激进，取值越小结果越接近原图、保留更多纹理。

FILE: This parameter controls the strength of the diffusion process that smoothens the image. Large values are more aggressive. Small values tend to give results more similar to the original image. The default value has been optimized as a starting point to process nonlinear (stretched) images.
文件: 此参数控制平滑图像的扩散过程强度。取值越大越激进，取值越小结果越接近原图。默认值已按处理非线性（已拉伸）图像做了优化，可作为起点。

FILE: This parameter defines a threshold in sigma units above the median of a high-pass filtered master dark frame. Pixels above this threshold are considered hot pixels and tagged for cosmetic correction during the image calibration task. Decrease the value of this parameter to select more potential hot pixels. The default value is 10 sigma.
文件: 该参数以 sigma 单位定义了高通滤波后 主暗场帧中值以上的阈值。高于该阈值的像素被视为热像素，在图像校准任务中被标记用于外观校正。减小该参数值可选入更多潜在热像素。默认值为 10 sigma。

FILE: This parameter defines a threshold in sigma units below the median of a high-pass filtered master dark frame. Pixels below this threshold are considered cold pixels and tagged for cosmetic correction during the image calibration task. Decrease the value of this parameter to select more potential cold pixels. The default value is 5 sigma.
文件: 该参数以 sigma 单位定义了高通滤波后 主暗场帧中值以下的阈值。低于该阈值的像素被视为冷像素，在图像校准任务中被标记用于外观校正。减小该参数值可选入更多潜在冷像素。默认值为 5 sigma。

FILE: This parameter determines the scale of the generated chart as projected on the celestial sphere. We recommend to enable the automatic chart resolution option, which will calculate an optimal value automatically, based on the field of view of the target image.
文件: 此参数决定生成的图表投影到天球上的比例。建议启用「自动图表分辨率」选项，它将基于目标图像的视场自动计算最佳值。

FILE: This parameter determines the size in pixels of the initial search box used to detect valid alignment references on the source image. Increase it to favor detection of larger structures. Decrease to facilitate finding relatively small features; for example to deal with dense star fields.
文件: 此参数决定在源图像上检测有效对齐参考时初始搜索框的边长（像素）。增大它有利于检测较大的结构，减小它便于找到相对较小的特征，例如应对密集星场。

FILE: This parameter determines the size in pixels of the initial search box used to detect valid alignment references on the target image. Increase it to favor detection of larger structures. Decrease to facilitate finding relatively small features; for example to deal with dense star fields.
文件: 此参数决定在目标图像上检测有效对齐参考时初始搜索框的边长（像素）。增大它有利于检测较大的结构，减小它便于找到相对较小的特征，例如应对密集星场。

FILE: This parameter is disabled by default. Under normal conditions, it should always be turned off for the flux calibration task since sources with several local maxima pose difficulties in determining accurate star positions and, more importantly, tend to degrade the quality of PSF photometry.
文件: 此参数默认禁用。正常情况下通量校准任务应始终关闭它，因为含多个局部极大值的源会给恒星位置的精确测定带来困难，更重要的是会降低 PSF 测光质量。

FILE: This parameter is expressed in sigma units, with respect to the estimated mean background value. Higher tolerance values will allow for more permissive background estimations. Increasing this value favors inclusion of more pixels in the background model, but at the risk of including also pixels that don't pertain to the true background of the image. Decreasing tolerance will cause a more restrictive pixel rejection; however, too low tolerance values lead to poorly sampled background models.
文件: 此参数以 sigma 为单位，相对于估计的平均背景值。容差越大，背景估计越宽松。提高此值有利于把更多像素纳入背景模型，但风险是把并不属于图像真实背景的像素也包含进来。降低容差会带来更严格的像素剔除；但容差过低会导致背景模型的采样不足。

FILE: This parameter is ignored for the multiscale linear transform.
文件: 多尺度线性变换会忽略该参数。

FILE: This parameter is not used with the recursive surface splines registration model, which always uses polyharmonic splines of the specified spline order.
文件: 递归曲面样条配准模型不使用该参数，它始终使用指定阶数的多调和样条。

FILE: This parameter is not used with the recursive surface splines registration model, which uses all star pair matches after outlier rejection.
文件: 递归曲面样条配准模型不使用该参数，它会使用离群值剔除后的所有星对匹配。

FILE: This parameter is only used by the IAS15 integrator.
文件: 该参数仅由 IAS15 积分器使用。

FILE: This parameter is only used when the use scale differences option is enabled. The value of this parameter is the maximum allowed difference in scale between two descriptors formed with putative star pair matches. This improves robustness of the star matching algorithm, especially in presence of a large number of outliers (false putative star pair matches), but also imposes an upper limit on the difference in scale between two registered images. Using scale differences can be very helpful to build mosaics with little overlapping.

两次曝光之间的等待时间（秒）。

FILE: We recommend to enable the automatic limit magnitude option, which will calculate an optimal value automatically, based on the field of view of the target image and the chart resolution.
文件: 建议启用「自动极限星等」选项，它将基于目标图像的视场和图表分辨率自动计算最佳值。

FILE: When scale mode has been set to custom FITS keyword, this is the name of a FITS header keyword whose value is the image scale in arcseconds per pixel.
文件: 当比例模式设为「自定义 FITS 关键字」时，此处为 FITS 头关键字的名称，其取值即图像比例（角秒/像素）。

FILE: When scale mode has been set to literal value, this is the image scale in arcseconds per pixel.
文件: 当比例模式设为「字面值」时，此处为图像比例（角秒/像素）。

FILE: When Gaussian and variable shape drizzle kernel functions are used, this parameter defines the number of discrete function values computed to approximate the double integral of the kernel surface function. More function evaluations improve the accuracy of numerical integration at the cost of more computational work. The default value of this parameter is 16, meaning that 16*16=256 function values are computed to integrate drizzle kernel functions.
文件: 使用高斯与可变形状 drizzle 核函数时，此参数定义用于近似核表面函数二重积分的离散函数值数量。更多函数求值能提升数值积分的精度，代价是更多计算量。此参数默认值为 16，意味着用 16*16=256 个函数值来积分 drizzle 核函数。

FILE: When PixelMath is executed globally, the working image has all of its pixel samples initially set to zero.
文件: 当 PixelMath 全局执行时，工作图像的所有像素样本初始值均为零。

FILE: When a distortion model is used, the registration model will always use thin plate splines, irrespective of the registration model parameter.
文件: 使用畸变模型时，无论配准模型参数如何设置，配准模型始终采用薄板样条。

FILE: When a telescope device is available, it is used to retrieve its current EOD (epoch of date) coordinates, just before starting each light frame exposure. These are apparent coordinates, which are reduced to mean positions referred to the mean equinox and equator of J2000.0 (ICRS) by an accurate inverse transformation, including corrections for precession, nutation and stellar aberration. The computed coordinates are directly comparable to standard catalog positions, irrespective of the date of acquisition. Once these coordinates are computed for each acquired image, they are stored as standard XISF properties (Observation:Center:RA and Observation:Center:Dec). For compatibility with legacy applications, the same coordinates replace the OBJCTRA and OBJCTDEC FITS keywords provided by the Indigo server.
文件: 有可用望远镜设备时，会在每次开始亮帧曝光之前用它获取当前的 EOD（当日历元）坐标。这些是视坐标，会通过精确的逆变换（包括岁差、章动与恒星视差改正）归算为参照 J2000.0 平春分点与平赤道的平位置（ICRS）。所计算的坐标可直接与标准星表位置比较，与采集日期无关。对每张采集图像计算完这些坐标后，会把它们存为标准 XISF 属性（Observation:Center:RA 与 Observation:Center:Dec）。为与旧版程序兼容，同样的坐标会替换 Indigo 服务器提供的 OBJCTRA 与 OBJCTDEC FITS 关键字。

FILE: When automatic convergence is enabled, the TGVDenoise process will be stopped when the difference between two successive iterations becomes smaller than this value. See the information given for the iterations and automatic convergence parameters.
文件: 启用自动收敛时，当相邻两次迭代之差小于此值，TGVDenoise 进程即停止。详见迭代次数与自动收敛参数的说明。

FILE: When automatic convergence is enabled, the TGVInpaint process will be stopped when the difference between two successive iterations becomes smaller than this value. See the information given for the iterations and automatic convergence parameters.
文件: 启用自动收敛时，当相邻两次迭代之差小于此值，TGVInpaint 进程即停止。详见迭代次数与自动收敛参数的说明。

FILE: When automatic image identifier generation is enabled, override existing image identifiers in image metadata. If this option is disabled, existing identifiers will be used instead of newly generated ones based on the identifier template.
文件: 启用自动生成图像标识符时，覆盖图像元数据中已有的标识符。若禁用此选项，则使用已有标识符，而不用基于标识符模板新生成的标识符。

FILE: When changes to process parameters affect measurements, the file cache will not use older items.
文件: 当处理参数改动影响到测量结果时，文件缓存不会使用较旧的缓存项。
勾选表示赤纬为负（南半球）。
勾选表示纬度为负（南半球）。
勾选表示经度为负（西经）。

FILE: When checked, magnitude and phase components are computed instead of the real and imaginary components.
文件: 勾选后计算幅度与相位分量，而不是实部与虚部分量。

FILE: When drizzle data files (.xdrz) are added and a subtraction operand image is selected, a new, unaligned drizzle-integrable image will be written (either a stars-only or a comet-only image), along with new .xdrz files.
文件: 当加入 drizzle 数据文件（.xdrz）并选定相减操作数图像后，会写出一个新的、未对齐的可 drizzle 积分图像（仅恒星或仅彗星的图像），并同时生成新的 .xdrz 文件。

FILE: When enabled, PixInsight will use a native menu bar on macOS. When disabled, a multiplatform menu bar will be used. This option only works on macOS; it is ignored on X11 (FreeBSD, Linux) and Windows platforms. Changing this option requires a restart of the PixInsight core application to take effect.
文件: 启用后，PixInsight 在 macOS 上使用原生菜单栏；禁用则使用跨平台菜单栏。此选项仅在 macOS 上有效，在 X11（FreeBSD、Linux）与 Windows 平台上被忽略。改动此选项需重启 PixInsight 核心程序才能生效。

FILE: When enabled, docked AutoHide windows can be shown by just hovering the mouse cursor over vertical selector tabs for about 0.4 seconds. This is the default state. When this option is disabled, you must click on a selector tab to open the corresponding AutoHide window.
文件: 启用后，只需把鼠标悬停在纵向选择标签上约 0.4 秒即可显示停靠的自动隐藏窗口。这是默认状态。禁用此选项时，必须单击选择标签才能打开对应的自动隐藏窗口。

FILE: When enabled, the color saturation enhancement is masked by the image lightness. Brighter areas receive more saturation enhancement, while darker areas retain their original color saturation. This helps prevent oversaturation of faint background regions while allowing stronger enhancement of brighter features.
文件: 启用后，色彩饱和度增强会被图像明度所遮蔽：较亮区域获得更多饱和度增强，较暗区域保持原有色彩饱和度。这有助于防止暗弱背景区域过度饱和，同时允许较亮特征获得更强增强。

FILE: When enabled, the fitting rectangle must define a nonempty subset of the input images. When the fitting region is disabled (the default option), the whole image is used to compute linear fitting functions.
文件: 启用时，拟合矩形必须定义输入图像的一个非空子集。禁用拟合区域时（默认选项），用整幅图像计算线性拟合函数。

FILE: When enabled, the right ascension coordinate will be shown expressed in hours, minutes, and seconds. When disabled, the right ascension will be expressed in degrees, arcminutes and arcseconds.
文件: 启用后，赤经坐标以时、分、秒显示；禁用时以度、角分、角秒显示。

FILE: When enabled, the search operation will generate an output plain text file including available data for all sources fulfilling the specified search criteria.
文件: 启用后，搜索操作将生成纯文本输出文件，包含满足搜索条件的所有天体的可用数据。

FILE: When nonzero, this parameter causes the distortion correction algorithm to use approximating instead of interpolating surface splines (thin plates). Approximating surface splines are robust to outliers in the distortion correction model, including uncertainty in star detection, moving asteroids and other varying image features that can be accidentally interpreted and matched as stars.
文件: 取非零值时，此参数会让畸变校正算法使用逼近型（而非插值型）曲面样条（薄板样条）。逼近型曲面样条对畸变校正模型中的离群值更稳健，包括恒星检测的不确定性、移动的小行星，以及其他可能被误识别并误匹配为恒星的变化图像特征。

FILE: When one of the Generate text output or Generate binary output options is enabled, the search process will write its output data to the specified file.
文件: 启用「生成文本输出」或「生成二进制输出」之一时，检索过程会把输出数据写入指定的文件。

FILE: When opening image files, load astrometric solutions automatically from existing image properties and WCS FITS header keywords (XISF and FITS formats only).
文件: 打开图像文件时，自动从图像现有属性与 WCS FITS 头关键字载入天体测量解（仅 XISF 与 FITS 格式）。

FILE: When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for flux measurement. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.
文件: 选择“自动”选项时，会为每个源拟合一系列不同的 PSF，取函数值与采样像素值之间绝对差最小的拟合用于通量测量。这一特殊自动模式目前测试以下函数：beta 形状参数为 2.5、4、6 和 10 的 Moffat 函数。

FILE: When the Generate text output option is enabled, the search process will write its output data to the specified file in a plain text format.
文件: 启用「生成文本输出」选项后，检索过程会把输出数据以纯文本格式写入指定的文件。

FILE: When the Simplified Model option is enabled, this parameter defines the degree of two-dimensional interpolation polynomials used to compute a simplified gradient model during the initial preprocessing task. This simplified model will be subtracted from the image before applying the rest of the multiscale gradient modeling and correction algorithm. High-degree models are more adaptive to local variations and potentially more accurate but can lead to overcorrection or oscillations. The default value is one, which corresponds to a linear simplified model.
文件: 启用「简化模型」选项时，此参数定义在初始预处理任务中用于计算简化梯度模型的二维插值多项式的阶数。在施加其余多尺度梯度建模与校正算法之前，会先从此图像中减去该简化模型。高阶模型对局部变化适应性更强、可能更准确，但也可能导致过度校正或振荡。默认值为一，对应线性的简化模型。

FILE: When the generate bitmap file option is enabled, close the output image window after the PNG file has been written. This option can be useful for automation of FindingChart execution on sets of images using ImageContainer or scripts.
文件: 启用「生成位图文件」选项时，PNG 文件写入后关闭输出图像窗口。此选项有助于使用图像容器或脚本对成批图像自动化执行寻星图。

FILE: When the rescale result option is enabled, this is the lower bound of the output rescaling range.
文件: 启用「重缩放结果」选项时，此处为输出重缩放区间的下限。

FILE: When the rescale result option is enabled, this is the upper bound of the output rescaling range.
文件: 启用「重缩放结果」选项时，此处为输出重缩放区间的上限。

FILE: When the alignment reference is inverted (see the reference inversion parameter), background pixels are those above the computed sigma.
文件: 当对齐参考被反转时（参见参考反转参数），背景像素是指数值高于所计算 sigma 的像素。

FILE: When the input drizzle files include image weighting data, use them. Image weights are generated by the ImageIntegration tool, which you should have used with the generate drizzle data option enabled after StarAlignment and before the DrizzleIntegration tool. If this option is disabled, existing image weighting data will be ignored and hence all input images will contribute equally to the output integrated image. In general, image weights based on robust image quality and SNR estimators, such as PSF Signal Weight, PSF SNR and PSF Scale SNR, should always be used to achieve an optimal integrated image.
文件: 当输入 drizzle 文件包含图像加权数据时，使用它们。图像权重由 ImageIntegration 工具生成 —— 你应在 StarAlignment 之后、DrizzleIntegration 工具之前启用「生成 drizzle 数据」选项运行它。若禁用此选项，已有图像加权数据会被忽略，因而所有输入图像对输出叠加图像的贡献均等。一般来说，基于稳健图像质量与 SNR 估计器（例如 PSF Signal Weight、PSF SNR 与 PSF Scale SNR）的图像权重应始终被使用，以获得最优的叠加图像。

FILE: When the input drizzle files include pixel rejection data, use them. Pixel rejection data are generated by the ImageIntegration tool, which you should have used with the generate drizzle data option enabled after StarAlignment and before the DrizzleIntegration tool. If this option is disabled, existing pixel rejection data will be ignored and hence no pixel rejection will be performed to generate the output integrated image.
文件: 当输入 drizzle 文件包含像素剔除数据时，使用它们。像素剔除数据由 ImageIntegration 工具生成 —— 你应在 StarAlignment 之后、DrizzleIntegration 工具之前启用「生成 drizzle 数据」选项运行它。若禁用此选项，已有像素剔除数据会被忽略，因而不会对生成输出叠加图像执行任何像素剔除。

FILE: When the model comparison feature is enabled, ABE generates a 16-bit image that you can use to quickly evaluate the suitability of the computed background model. The comparison image is a copy of the target image to which the model is applied by subtraction. This parameter is a multiplying factor applied to exaggerate the irregularities in the resulting comparison image.
文件: 启用模型比较功能时，ABE 会生成一幅 16 位图像，可用于快速评估所计算背景模型的适用性。比较图像是目标图像的副本，并按减除方式应用了该模型。本参数是一个放大倍数，用于夸大比较图像中的不规则性。

FILE: When this happens, the best option for integration of light or science frames is a linear rescaling, which preserves all of the integrated data. However, in some cases altering all pixel values is not admissible, so a rescaling operation is not applicable. In such cases truncation is the only option available to preserve the correct illumination profile in the integrated result.
文件: 出现这种情况时，叠加亮帧或科学帧的最佳选择是线性重新缩放，它能保留全部被叠加数据。但在某些情况下不允许改动所有像素值，重新缩放便不适用。此时截断是唯一可用的选项，能保住叠加结果中正确的照度分布。

FILE: When this happens, the best option for integration of light or science frames is a linear rescaling, which preserves all of the integrated data. However, in some cases altering all pixel values is not admissible, so a rescaling operation is not applicable. This is the case for integration of flat frames, where truncation is the only option available to preserve the correct illumination profile in the integrated master flat frame.
文件: 出现这种情况时，亮帧或科学帧叠加的最佳选择是线性重标定，它能保留全部叠加数据。不过在某些情况下不允许改动所有像素值，因而重标定操作不适用。平场帧叠加就是这种情况：要保留叠加后主平场中正确的照明轮廓，截断是唯一可用的选项。

FILE: When this option is disabled, 16-bit integer arithmetics will be used for 8-bit and 16-bit integer images. Floating point will always be used for the rest of images, irrespective of the state of this option, in order to preserve numerical accuracy. This option is enabled by default
文件: 禁用此选项时，8 位与 16 位整数图像将使用 16 位整数运算。其余类型的图像无论该选项状态如何，一律使用浮点运算，以保证数值精度。此选项默认启用。

FILE: When this option is disabled, structures have initial values proportional to their relevance in the multiscale pyramid. Structures that are supported by more wavelet layers will be brighter.
文件: 禁用此选项时，结构的初始值与其在多尺度金字塔中的重要性成正比。由更多小波层支撑的结构会更亮。

FILE: When this option is enabled and the master flat frame is a single-channel image mosaiced with a Color Filter Array (CFA), such as a Bayer or X-Trans filter pattern, three separate master flat scaling factors are computed for the red, green and blue CFA components, respectively. When this option is disabled, a single scaling factor is computed for the whole master flat frame, ignoring CFA components.
文件: 启用该选项且 主平场帧是用 CFA（如 Bayer 或 X-Trans 滤镜排列）马赛克的单通道图像时，会分别为红、绿、蓝 CFA 分量计算三个独立的 主平场 缩放因子。禁用该选项时，忽略 CFA 分量，为整个 主平场帧计算单个缩放因子。

FILE: When this option is enabled, MLDenoise generates internal cache structures to store intermediate process results. When the process is executed in the same view, and there are no changes to critical parameters that would invalidate existing cached data, the cache is used to accelerate execution by reusing previously calculated images and auxiliary objects. This option is enabled by default. You can turn it off to save memory or for verification purposes.
文件: 启用此选项时，MLDenoise 会生成内部缓存结构来存储中间处理结果。当在同一视图上执行进程、且关键参数没有变化因而不会使已有缓存数据失效时，会用缓存复用先前计算的图像与辅助对象来加速执行。此选项默认启用。你可以关闭它来节省内存或用于验证。

FILE: When this option is enabled, PCC will select an optimal limit magnitude for catalog search operations based on the field of view and center coordinates of the target image. Enabling this option is recommended under normal working conditions.
文件: 启用此选项时，PCC 会根据目标图像的视场和中心坐标，为星表检索操作选择最优的极限星等。正常使用条件下建议启用此选项。

FILE: When this option is enabled, PhotometricColorCalibration will select an optimal limit magnitude for plate solving based on the field of view and center coordinates of the target image. Enabling this option is recommended under normal working conditions.
文件: 启用此选项后，PhotometricColorCalibration 会根据目标图像的视场与中心坐标，为解板选择最优的极限星等。正常工作条件下建议启用。

FILE: When this option is enabled, PixInsight gathers process and script execution statistics automatically. This includes, among other items, the total number of times a process or featured script has been executed, the date and time of the last execution, and the total execution time. This option must be enabled for the Recently Used and Most Used tree items to be shown on Process Explorer. This option is enabled by default.
文件: 启用此选项后，PixInsight 会自动收集进程与脚本的执行统计。其中包括进程或特色脚本被执行的总次数、最后执行的日期与时间以及总执行时间等。要「进程资源管理器」显示「最近使用」与「最常使用」树项，必须启用此选项。此选项默认启用。

FILE: When this option is enabled, PixInsight gathers process launch statistics automatically. A process is launched when one of its associated interfaces is opened. Launch statistics include, among other items, the total number of times a process has been launched and the date and time of the last launch. This option must be enabled for the Recently Used and Most Used tree items to be shown on Process Explorer. This option is enabled by default.
文件: 启用此选项后，PixInsight 会自动收集进程启动统计。当某个进程的任一关联界面被打开时，即视为该进程被启动。启动统计包括进程被启动的总次数与最后启动的日期和时间等。要「进程资源管理器」显示「最近使用」与「最常使用」树项，必须启用此选项。此选项默认启用。

FILE: When this option is enabled, SPCC will select an optimal limit magnitude for catalog search operations based on the field of view and center coordinates of the target image. Enabling this option is recommended under normal working conditions.
文件: 启用此选项时，SPCC 会根据目标图像的视场和中心坐标，为星表检索操作选择最优的极限星等。正常使用条件下建议启用此选项。

FILE: When this option is enabled, XML settings files will be generated without superfluous whitespace and newline characters, making the XML source code significantly smaller and marginally more efficient for encoding/decoding operations. With minification disabled, XML tags will be separated with newline characters and indented with spaces, making the source code readable and easily editable for maintenance purposes.
文件: 启用此选项后，生成的 XML 设置文件会去掉多余的空格与换行字符，使 XML 源码显著更小，编码/解码操作效率略有提升。禁用压缩时，XML 标签之间以换行分隔并用空格缩进，源码便于阅读和编辑维护。

FILE: When this option is enabled, all scale estimates are consistent with the standard deviation of a normal distribution.
文件: 启用该选项后，所有比例估计都与正态分布的标准差口径一致。

FILE: When this option is enabled, and the identifier template is valid, automatic identifier generation takes precedence over other options for image identifier generation, such as Use file names as image identifiers.
文件: 启用此选项且标识符模板有效时，自动生成标识符优先于其他图像标识符生成方式，例如“以文件名作为图像标识符”。

FILE: When this option is enabled, highlights will be left unclipped resulting in various shades of pink. With this option disabled, highlights will be clipped automatically to solid white.
文件: 启用此选项时，高光不做截断，会呈现各种深浅的粉色。禁用此选项时，高光被自动截断为纯白。

FILE: When this option is enabled, large text and binary settings properties are serialized with compression applied in XML settings files. The Zstandard compression codec is used for these tasks in current versions of PixInsight.
文件: 启用此选项后，较大的文本与二进制设置属性在 XML 设置文件中会以压缩方式序列化。当前版本的 PixInsight 使用 Zstandard 压缩编解码器完成这些任务。

FILE: When this option is enabled, menu bar items will be written in uppercase characters (FILE, EDIT, ...). When disabled, only the first letter of each menu bar item will be uppercase (File, Edit, ...), following more traditional UI criteria. Note that this option does not apply to native menu bars on macOS. Changing this option requires an application restart to take effect.
文件: 启用此选项后，菜单栏各项会用大写字母书写（FILE、EDIT……）；禁用则只首字母大写（File、Edit……），更符合传统界面习惯。注意此选项不作用于 macOS 的原生菜单栏。改动此选项需重启程序才能生效。

FILE: When this option is enabled, no black point correction is applied to raw images to remove darkness level pedestals. This option must be enabled to load all raw images referred to a fixed zero black point value.
文件: 启用此选项时，不对原始图像施加黑点校正以去除暗电平基座。加载所有以固定零黑点为基准的原始图像时必须启用此选项。

FILE: When this option is enabled, the PixInsight core application generates a visible alert when a running process completes its execution. On Windows and most X11 (UNIX/Linux) desktops, an alert causes the application icon to flash intermittently on the task bar. On macOS, an alert causes the application icon to start bouncing on the dock. This option is disabled by default.
文件: 启用此选项后，正在运行的进程执行完毕时，PixInsight 核心程序会发出可见提示。在 Windows 和多数 X11（UNIX/Linux）桌面上，提示表现为任务栏上程序图标间歇闪烁；在 macOS 上表现为程序坞中图标开始跳动。此选项默认禁用。

FILE: When this option is enabled, the process will select an optimal limit magnitude for catalog search operations based on the field of view and center coordinates of the target image. Enabling this option is recommended under normal working conditions.
文件: 启用此选项后，进程会根据目标图像的视场与中心坐标，为星表搜索操作选择最优的极限星等。正常工作条件下建议启用。

FILE:
A rendering intent is a method to map out-of-gamut colors to the color space of the output device being used, such as a monitor or a printer/paper combination. Device gamuts are characterized by the color profiles associated with each device involved in a color management transformation.

The relative colorimetric rendering intent is the default option for printers and proofing devices. It matches the white point in the image color space to the white point in the output device color space, which means that pure white is not printed at all (no ink), but represented by the white of the paper. Out-of-gamut colors are replaced by the nearest in-gamut colors. Relative colorimetric is in general the best balanced option for the sake of color accuracy in both the numerical and perceptual senses.

The absolute colorimetric intent also replaces out-of-gamut colors by their nearest matches in the output color space, but it doesn't try to match white points. If the white points in the image and output device spaces don't match, you'll get a color cast in the highlights. However, since this intent doesn't alter any in-gamut colors, it is the best option in terms of numeric color accuracy.

The perceptual intent maps all colors in the image space to the output device space. This is the default option for monitors. With the perceptual intent, no out-of-gamut color is clipped, as happens with colorimetric intents, but all colors can be altered, and the changes can be significant if the image space is much wider than the output space. In general, relative colorimetric is preferred for printed media, but perceptual can yield more vibrant results that may be desirable in some cases.

Finally, the saturation intent tries to maximize color saturation in the represented image, at the cost of sacrifying color accuracy, if necessary. This intent can be a good option for synthetic graphics and illustrations, but not for reproduction of photographic images.
文件:
再现意图是一种把超出色域的颜色映射到所用输出设备（例如显示器或打印机/纸张组合）色彩空间的方法。设备色域由与色彩管理变换中每个设备相关联的色彩配置文件来表征。

相对比色再现意图是打印机与打样设备的默认选项。它把图像色彩空间中的白点匹配到输出设备色彩空间中的白点，这意味着纯白完全不会被印刷（无油墨），而由纸张的白度来表现。超出色域的颜色会被替换为色域内最接近的颜色。就数值与感知两种意义上的色彩准确性而言，相对比色总体上是平衡最好的选项。

绝对比色意图也把超出色域的颜色替换为输出色彩空间中与之最接近的匹配，但它不尝试匹配白点。若图像与输出设备空间的白点不一致，高光部分会出现偏色。不过，由于该意图不改变任何在色域内的颜色，就数值色彩准确性而言它是最佳选择。

感知意图把图像空间中的所有颜色映射到输出设备空间。这是显示器的默认选项。使用感知意图时，不会有超出色域的颜色被裁剪（如比色意图那样），但所有颜色都可能被改变，若图像空间远大于输出空间，改变可能相当显著。一般来说，印刷介质更倾向于相对比色，但感知意图可产生更鲜艳的效果，某些情况下可能正是所需。

最后，饱和度意图力求最大化所表示图像的色彩饱和度，必要时以牺牲色彩准确性为代价。该意图适用于合成图形与插画，但不适用于照片类图像的再现。

When enabled, the PixInsight core application will try to detect high-dpi monitors automatically, and will compute appropriate scaling factors for all GUI elements and resources. For automatic DPI-based scaling, the reference is a 27-inch monitor at QHD resolution (2560x1440 physical display pixels, or 109 dpi). This pixel density corresponds to a scaling factor of 1.0.

Keep in mind that automatic display characterization is not always feasible or accurate. For example, some X11 desktop managers don't support high-dpi monitors adequately, especially with multiple monitors working at different resolutions. Virtualized operating systems can also have problems for automatic detection of monitor dimensions. In these cases, you can disable this option to specify the correct scaling factor manually (see the UI scaling factor parameter below).

Core UI scaling parameters are only fetched upon application startup. Changes to this parameter will take place the next time PixInsight is executed.

The order would be Yes and No for a question such as Save the modified image?. This is the default behavior of message boxes in PixInsight since core version 1.8.9-2. The Yes/No and No/Yes options force the specified button orders.

FILE:
The proxy host that will be used for core network operations. This can be specified either as a host name or as a dotted numerical IP address. A numerical IPv6 address must be written within square brackets. To specify the port number (strongly recommended), append :<port> to the host name. The proxy host may be prefixed with <scheme>:// to specify the type of proxy to be used. If no scheme is specified, http:// will be assumed by default. Finally, the host can include an embedded user/password specification, but be aware that passwords specified this way won't be stored securely and will be visible as plain text on this interface.

To disable the use of a proxy server, leave this parameter empty as it is by default.

* Note * This option only applies to core network operations, such as files downloaded with the File > Open Location menu item, the open command, and the update system, among others. It does not apply to the integrated web browser component.

FILE:
This is the list of directories (or folders) where PixInsight generates temporary swap files.

Each directory in this list must be a full path specification to an existing directory. With two or more swap directories, PixInsight uses concurrent execution threads to perform parallel disk I/O operations when reading and writing swap files. Parallel swap file access can provide significant performance improvements, especially working with very large images that require gigabytes of swap disk storage.

* Important * The swap storage routines have been optimized for parallel I/O operations on fast SSD disks and virtual RAM drives. If you use one of these drives for swap file storage, the best performance will be achieved when the same physical or virtual device (or a directory on it) is specified multiple times in this list. The optimal number of concurrent threads for a SSD or RAM disk often lies between 4 and 32, but the best value must be determined experimentally in each case through benchmarks.

* Warning * If you use rotational hard disks (HDD) for swap file storage with PixInsight (which is not recommended), do not specify two or more swap directories that are supported by the same physical device. Parallel I/O operations performed on the same rotational disk may cause severe performance degradation. However, if you have several of these devices, you can specify a directory on each of them to achieve an important performance improvement.

* Warning * Ensure that there is enough free space on the storage device(s) that support these directories on the local filesystem. Insufficient swap disk space may compromise system stability. For normal CCD or DSLR imaging production, a minimum of 100 GB is strongly recommended.

* Important * Many critical operations depend on fast sequential access to very large files on the PixInsight platform. For this reason, a highly fragmented filesystem may degrade performance. Under MS Windows (both FAT and NTFS filesystems), it is very important to avoid heavy disk fragmentation by running the defrag utility (or equivalent) on a regular basis. Under UNIX/Linux and macOS, there are no fragmentation problems because the native filesystems on these platforms prevent fragmentation automatically.
文件:
这是 PixInsight 生成临时交换文件的目录（或文件夹）列表。

本列表中的每个目录都必须是现有目录的完整路径。使用两个或更多交换目录时，PixInsight 会使用并发执行线程在读写交换文件时执行并行磁盘 I/O 操作。并行交换文件访问可显著提升性能，尤其是在处理需要数 GB 交换磁盘存储的超大图像时。

* 重要 * 交换存储例程已针对快速 SSD 磁盘与虚拟内存盘上的并行 I/O 操作进行优化。若使用这类磁盘存放交换文件，在本列表中多次指定同一物理或虚拟设备（或其上的某个目录）可获得最佳性能。SSD 或内存盘的最佳并发线程数通常介于 4 到 32 之间，但每种情况下的最佳值都需通过基准测试实测确定。

* 警告 * 若使用机械硬盘（HDD）为 PixInsight 存放交换文件（不推荐），请勿指定两个或更多由同一物理设备承载的交换目录。在同一机械磁盘上执行并行 I/O 操作可能导致性能严重下降。不过，若你有多个此类设备，可在每个设备上指定一个目录，从而获得显著的性能提升。

* 警告 * 请确保本地文件系统上承载这些目录的存储设备有足够可用空间。交换磁盘空间不足可能危及系统稳定性。对于常规 CCD 或单反成像流程，强烈建议至少 100 GB。

* 重要 * PixInsight 平台上的许多关键操作都依赖对超大文件的快速顺序访问。因此，高度碎片化的文件系统可能降低性能。在 MS Windows（FAT 与 NTFS 文件系统）下，务必定期运行 defrag 实用程序（或等效工具）以避免严重的磁盘碎片。在 UNIX/Linux 与 macOS 下不存在碎片问题，因为这些平台的本地文件系统会自动防止碎片。

If this option is disabled, only the secure HTTPS and FTPS protocols will be allowed.

FILE:
Mask rendering modes define how masked pixels are represented on bitmap renditions of images. The traditional mode used by PixInsight has always been Multiply, which simply multiplies each pixel of a screen rendition by its mask image counterpart.

Since PixInsight version 1.5.5, an additional set of overlay mask rendering modes is available, providing more accurate representations in several user-selectable colors. A new Replace mode has also been implemented to facilitate blinking comparisons between images and masks.

自 PixInsight 1.5.5 版起，提供了一组额外的叠加蒙版渲染模式，可用若干用户可选的颜色提供更准确的表示。还实现了新的替换模式，便于在图像与蒙版之间做闪烁比对。

Pressing the Shift key always exchanges these modes. For example, if this option is enabled, zooming with the Shift key pressed will zoom at the center of the viewport, and vice-versa, if this option is disabled the Shift key will force zooming at cursor coordinates.

按下 Shift 键始终会交换这两种模式。例如，若启用此选项，按住 Shift 键缩放将在视口中心处缩放；反之，若禁用此选项，Shift 键将强制在光标坐标处缩放。

FILE:
Use 24-bit lookup tables (LUT) to apply screen transfer functions (STF) by default, instead of 16-bit LUTs. Linear HDR images usually require larger LUTs to discretize nonlinear STFs without posterization, especially on dark areas, where the STF applies more aggressive transformations.

For most linear images and all stretched (nonlinear) images, 16-bit LUTs are normally sufficient. Enable the 24-bit LUT feature for deep linear data that cause posterization artifacts on screen renditions, such as HDR compositions. Note that you can enable or disable this feature on a per view basis; this setting refers to the default state for newly created images.
文件:
默认使用 24 位查找表（LUT）而非 16 位 LUT 来施加屏幕传递函数（STF）。线性 HDR 图像通常需要更大的 LUT，以便在没有色调分离的情况下离散化非线性 STF，尤其是在暗部区域，STF 在那里施加更激进的变换。

对大多数线性图像与所有已拉伸（非线性）图像而言，16 位 LUT 通常已足够。对于会在屏幕渲染中产生色调分离伪影的深层线性数据（例如 HDR 合成），请启用 24 位 LUT 功能。注意可按视图分别启用或禁用此功能；此设置指的是新建图像的默认状态。

FILE:
Render images using physical screen pixels on Retina displays working in high-dpi modes.

Currently this option is only available on macOS. On Linux/FreeBSD and Windows, all screen output is always performed at the physical display resolution, so the state of this option is immaterial. On high-dpi Retina display modes, physical screen pixels are used for images represented at reduced zoom ratios 1:2 and lower. When this option is enabled in these modes, an image is represented at its full size on physical pixels when the zoom ratio is 1:2. This is because the ratio of physical to logical pixels is always 2 in Retina high-dpi modes.

Enabling this option on macOS with capable hardware may slow down screen image renditions, since the volume of the generated pixel data is four times the volume required when working with logical pixels. Furthermore, when this option is enabled, certain optimizations that can yield faster screen renditions have to be disabled. If you experience slow screen performance working with big images, especially on slow machines, you can turn off this option to improve speed at the expense of representation quality.
文件:
在处于高 DPI 模式的 Retina 显示器上使用物理屏幕像素渲染图像。

目前此选项仅在 macOS 上可用。在 Linux/FreeBSD 与 Windows 上，所有屏幕输出始终按物理显示分辨率进行，因此此选项的状态无关紧要。在高 DPI Retina 显示模式下，对于以 1:2 及更低缩放比表示的图像会使用物理屏幕像素。在这些模式下启用此选项时，当缩放比为 1:2，图像将按完整尺寸在物理像素上表示。这是因为在 Retina 高 DPI 模式下物理像素与逻辑像素之比始终为 2。

在 macOS 上对支持的硬件启用此选项可能降低屏幕图像渲染速度，因为生成的像素数据量是使用逻辑像素时的四倍。此外，启用此选项时必须禁用某些可加快屏幕渲染的优化。若在处理大图像时（尤其是在慢速机器上）遇到屏幕性能迟缓，可关闭此选项以提升速度，代价是表示质量下降。

FILE:
For images loaded from local or remote files, use file names to build image identifiers. Illegal identifier characters in file names (such as white spaces) are automatically replaced with underscores.

Automatic image identifiers generated from templates take precedence over this option. When both automatic identifiers and this option are disabled, image identifiers are retrieved from XISF files, if available. When no identifier is available, the default image prefix is used to generate unique image identifiers.

Since core version 1.9.3 Lockhart, this option is disabled by default and its use is discouraged. Meaningful identifiers should be automatically generated from existing metadata using templates, or the default identifiers defined by our standard tools and preprocessing scripts should be used. When no identifiers are available, you should define them manually. Identifiers are embedded as image properties in XISF files and loaded automatically when the images are opened.

对于从本地或远程文件载入的图像，使用文件名构造图像标识符。文件名中的非法标识符字符（例如空格）会被自动替换为下划线。

由模板自动生成的图像标识符优先于此选项。当自动标识符与此选项同时禁用时，会从 XISF 文件中获取图像标识符（若可用）。当没有可用标识符时，使用默认图像前缀生成唯一图像标识符。

自核心 1.9.3 Lockhart 版起，此选项默认禁用且不鼓励使用。有意义的标识符应使用模板从已有元数据自动生成，或使用我们的标准工具与预处理脚本所定义的默认标识符。当没有可用标识符时，应手动定义。标识符作为图像属性嵌入 XISF 文件，并在打开图像时自动载入。

FILE:
Allow setting the CPU affinity of running threads. This is a global flag that affects threads created by the core application as well as all external modules.

The affinity of a thread defines the set of logical processors on which the thread is eligible to run. Thread affinity allows to improve execution speed by restricting each thread to run on a separate processor. This prevents the performance cost caused by the cache invalidation that occurs when a process ceases to execute on a processor and then restarts execution on a different one.

Note The state of this setting is only fetched upon application startup. Changes to this setting require a restart of the PixInsight core application to take effect.

Note Currently this option only works on Linux and Windows platforms. It does not work on macOS and FreeBSD. Support for all platforms will be implemented in a future version of PixInsight.
文件:
允许设置运行中线程的 CPU 亲和性。这是一个全局标志，会影响核心应用创建的线程以及所有外部模块的线程。

线程的亲和性定义了该线程可在哪些逻辑处理器上运行。线程亲和性可通过把每个线程限制在单独的处理器上运行来提升执行速度。这避免了进程在某个处理器上停止执行、随后又在另一个处理器上恢复执行时因缓存失效而产生的性能开销。

注意 此设置的状态仅在应用启动时读取。修改此设置需要重启 PixInsight 核心应用才能生效。

注意 此选项目前仅在 Linux 与 Windows 平台有效，在 macOS 与 FreeBSD 上无效。未来版本将实现对全部平台的支持。

FILE:

FILE:
This is the maximum number of threads allowed for concurrent file reading operations. Tasks that perform heavy file I/O operations, such as ImageCalibration, ImageIntegration or StarAlignment for example, can work more efficiently on solid-state drives (SSD) when parallel file access is allowed.

The default value of 8 threads is usually a good starting point for most SSD units. The optimal value depends on specific hardware and software conditions and should be found through benchmarks. It is usually in the range from 4 to 32 threads.

For rotational hard disk drives (HDD) parallel file I/O operations may incur in severe performance penalties. If you are using one of these obsolete devices with PixInsight (which is not recommended) you normally should set this parameter to its minimum value of one thread.
文件:
这是允许用于并发文件读取操作的最大线程数。执行大量文件 I/O 的任务（例如 ImageCalibration、ImageIntegration 或 StarAlignment）在允许并行文件访问时，在固态硬盘（SSD）上可以更高效地工作。

默认的 8 线程对大多数 SSD 通常是良好的起点。最佳值取决于具体的硬件与软件条件，应通过基准测试确定，通常位于 4 到 32 线程之间。

对于机械硬盘（HDD），并行文件 I/O 操作可能造成严重的性能损失。若你在使用这类过时设备运行 PixInsight（不推荐），通常应把此参数设为其最小值一个线程。

This is the maximum number of threads allowed for concurrent file writing operations. Tasks that perform heavy file I/O operations, such as ImageCalibration, ImageIntegration or StarAlignment for example, can work more efficiently on solid-state drives (SSD) when parallel file access is allowed.

The default value of 8 threads is usually a good starting point for most SSD units. The optimal value depends on specific hardware and software conditions and should be found through benchmarks. It is usually in the range from 4 to 32 threads.

For rotational hard disk drives (HDD) parallel file I/O operations may incur in severe performance penalties. If you are using one of these obsolete devices with PixInsight (which is not recommended) you normally should set this parameter to its minimum value of one thread.
文件:
这是允许用于并发文件写入操作的最大线程数。执行大量文件 I/O 的任务（例如 ImageCalibration、ImageIntegration 或 StarAlignment）在允许并行文件访问时，在固态硬盘（SSD）上可以更高效地工作。

默认的 8 线程对大多数 SSD 通常是良好的起点。最佳值取决于具体的硬件与软件条件，应通过基准测试确定，通常位于 4 到 32 线程之间。

对于机械硬盘（HDD），并行文件 I/O 操作可能造成严重的性能损失。若你在使用这类过时设备运行 PixInsight（不推荐），通常应把此参数设为其最小值一个线程。

FILE:
This is the maximum number of processors (physical and logical) that PixInsight is allowed to use. Selecting just one processor will effectively disable parallel processing globally.

* Warning * Reducing the maximum number of allowed processors too much will degrade processing and interface performance dramatically. Change this value only if you are sure of what you are doing.
文件:
这是 PixInsight 允许使用的最大处理器数量（物理与逻辑）。只选择一个处理器将实际上在全局禁用并行处理。

* 警告 * 把允许的最大处理器数量压得过低会严重降低处理与界面性能。只有在确定自己在做什么时才修改此值。

FILE:
This is the maximum thread priority allowed for threads created by external modules. Time critical will enable modules to create real-time priority threads, which are seldomly used, but sometimes necessary to carry out performance-critical operations. Lowest priority will force all installed modules to use very low-priority threads, which may strongly impact processing performance.

The default value of this parameter is platform-dependent. Currently, it is Time-Critical on Linux and macOS and Normal on Windows.

* Warning * Forcing low thread priorities will degrade processing performance. You should only change this value if you know what you are doing.
文件:
这是允许外部模块创建的线程使用的最大线程优先级。时间关键将允许模块创建实时优先级线程，这类线程很少使用，但有时对执行性能关键操作是必要的。最低优先级将强制所有已安装模块使用极低优先级线程，这可能严重影响处理性能。

此参数的默认值取决于平台。目前，在 Linux 与 macOS 上为时间关键，在 Windows 上为普通。

* 警告 * 强制使用低线程优先级会降低处理性能。只有在清楚自己在做什么时才应修改此值。

FILE:
Maximum number of text lines that can be stored by the process console. When the number of text lines in the console exceeds from this limit, old lines are removed from the beginning of the console before writing new ones. This greatly improves efficiency of console text output, especially during long batch processes, and also improves normal processes after a long time without clearing the console.

Specify a value of zero to disable this limit and allow an unlimited number of text lines in the console. The default value is 1000 lines.
文件:
处理控制台可保存的最大文本行数。当控制台中的文本行数超过此限制时，会在写入新行之前从控制台开头移除旧行。这大大提高了控制台文本输出的效率，尤其是在长时间批处理过程中，也能改善长时间未清空控制台后的常规处理表现。

将此值设为 0 可禁用此限制，允许控制台中文本行数不受限制。默认值为 1000 行。

FILE:
This is the time interval in seconds between PSM auto-save events. Set it to zero to disable the PSM AutoSave feature.

* Warning * Ensure that you have a good reason to disable PSM AutoSave, or to enter a large interval here, because PSM AutoSave has virtually zero impact on performance and can save your work in the event of a system crash.
文件:
这是 PSM 自动保存事件之间的时间间隔（秒）。设为 0 可禁用 PSM 自动保存功能。

* 警告 * 请确保你有充分理由禁用 PSM 自动保存，或在此输入较长的间隔，因为 PSM 自动保存对性能几乎零影响，且能在系统崩溃时挽救你的工作。

FILE:
Perform an initialization of the GPU compute runtime upon application startup. This includes scanning for all CUDA-capable GPU devices available, device selection based on performance criteria, and an initial device warm up kernel execution.

This option is only operational on Linux and Windows. It is always ignored on FreeBSD and macOS, where GPU acceleration is not available.

Note: GPU acceleration still not available - coming soon... stay tuned!
文件:
在应用启动时对 GPU 计算运行时进行初始化。这包括扫描所有可用的 CUDA 兼容 GPU 设备、依据性能指标选择设备，以及执行一次初始的设备预热内核。

此选项仅在 Linux 与 Windows 上有效。在 FreeBSD 与 macOS 上始终被忽略，因为那里不提供 GPU 加速。

FILE:
Associate existing local normalization data files with drizzle input images.

Local normalization data files carry the .xnml suffix. Normally you should select .xnml files generated by the LocalNormalization tool for the same files that you are integrating.
文件:
把已有的局部归一化数据文件与 drizzle 输入图像相关联。

局部归一化数据文件的后缀为 .xnml。通常应选择 LocalNormalization 工具为你正在积分的同一批文件所生成的 .xnml 文件。

FILE:
Add existing drizzle data files to the list of input data files.

Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz suffix. Normally you should select .xdrz files generated by the StarAlignment and ImageIntegration tools for the images that you want to integrate with DrizzleIntegration.
文件:
把已有的 drizzle 数据文件添加到输入数据文件列表中。

Drizzle 数据文件的扩展名为 .xdrz。通常应选择 StarAlignment 与 ImageIntegration 工具为你想用 DrizzleIntegration 积分的图像所生成的 .xdrz 文件。

FILE:
Remove all local normalization data files currently associated with drizzle input images.

This removes just file associations, not the actual local normalization data files.
文件:
移除当前与 drizzle 输入图像关联的所有局部归一化数据文件。

这仅移除文件关联，而不是实际的局部归一化数据文件。

FILE:
Toggle the enabled/disabled state of currently selected input data files.

Disabled input files will be ignored during the drizzle integration process.
文件:
切换当前选中输入数据文件的启用/禁用状态。

已禁用的输入文件将在 drizzle 积分过程中被忽略。

FILE:
When assigning local normalization data files to drizzle input images, take into account full file paths stored in .xdrz and .xnml files. This allows you to integrate images with duplicate file names on different directories. However, by enabling this option your data set gets tied to specific locations on the local filesystem. When this option is disabled (the default state), only file names are used to associate .xdrz and .xnml files, which allows you to move your images freely throughout the filesystem, including the possibility to migrate them to different machines.

Changes to this option will come into play the next time you associate .xnml files with drizzle input images. Existing file associations are not affected.
文件:
把局部归一化数据文件指派给 drizzle 输入图像时，是否考虑 .xdrz 与 .xnml 文件中存储的完整文件路径。这可让你积分位于不同目录、文件重名的图像。不过，启用此选项会使你的数据集绑定到本地文件系统上的特定位置。禁用此选项（默认状态）时，仅使用文件名把 .xdrz 与 .xnml 文件关联，从而允许你在文件系统中自由移动图像，包括把它们迁移到不同机器。

对此选项的修改将在下次把 .xnml 文件与 drizzle 输入图像关联时生效。已有的文件关联不受影响。

FILE:
Override the directories of input image files.

If this field is left blank, input images will be loaded from the directories specified in their corresponding drizzle data files. This is the default behavior.

If an existing directory is specified, it will override the directories specified in all input drizzle data files. This is useful when one is going to execute an instance of DrizzleIntegration that has been generated on a different machine or filesystem; for example, if you borrow a process icon from a friend, quite likely the same images will be stored on different locations of your hard disk.
文件:
覆盖输入图像文件的目录。

若此字段留空，输入图像将从其对应 drizzle 数据文件中指定的目录载入。这是默认行为。

若指定了已存在的目录，它将覆盖所有输入 drizzle 数据文件中指定的目录。当要执行一个在另一台机器或文件系统上生成的 DrizzleIntegration 实例时，这很有用；例如，若你从朋友那里借来一个处理图标，很可能同一批图像存放在你硬盘的不同位置。

FILE:
Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In DrizzleIntegration, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded during the integration process. There are no output hints in DrizzleIntegration since this process does not write images to disk files.

For example, you can use the "raw cfa" hints to force the RAW format to load pure raw images without applying any demosaicing, interpolation, white balance, or black point correction. You can also specify the "lower-range" and "upper-range" hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件:
格式提示允许你为特定过程使用的图像文件覆盖全局文件格式设置。在 DrizzleIntegration 中，输入提示会改变某些特定格式的输入图像在积分过程中的载入方式。DrizzleIntegration 没有输出提示，因为该过程不向磁盘文件写入图像。

例如，你可以使用 "raw cfa" 提示强制 RAW 格式载入纯原始图像，而不施加任何去马赛克、插值、白平衡或黑点校正。你也可以指定 "lower-range" 与 "upper-range" 提示，以载入由其他不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的应用生成的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式支持若干输入和/或输出提示，你可以在提供格式提示访问的工具中按不同目的使用它们。

FILE:
Drizzle drop kernel function. This parameter defines the shape of an input drop as a two-dimensional surface function. Square and circular kernels are applied by computing the area of the intersection between each drop and the projected output pixel. Gaussian and variable shape kernels are applied by computing the double integral of the surface function over the intersection between the drop and the projected output pixel on the XY plane. Square kernels are used by default.

Gaussian and variable shape drizzle kernels (the latter providing finer control on function profiles) can be used to improve resolution of the integrated image. However, these functions tend to require much more and much better dithered data than the standard square and circular kernels to achieve optimal results.
文件:
Drizzle 落点核函数。此参数把输入落点的形状定义为二维曲面函数。方形与圆形核通过计算每个落点与投影输出像素之间交集的面积来施加。高斯核与可变形状核通过计算曲面函数在落点与投影输出像素于 XY 平面上交集处的二重积分来施加。默认使用方形核。

高斯核与可变形状 drizzle 核（后者可对函数轮廓提供更精细控制）可用于改善积分图像的分辨率。不过，相比标准方形与圆形核，这些函数达到最佳效果往往需要多得多且质量好得多的抖动数据。

FILE:
CFA (Color Filter Array) pattern used for CFA drizzle, when the enable CFA drizzle option (see above) is checked.

Select the default Auto option to retrieve CFA patterns automatically from input .xdrz files, or select one of the supported CFA patterns to force it, overriding the information that may be provided by .xdrz files.
文件:
勾选启用 CFA drizzle 选项（见上文）时，用于 CFA drizzle 的 CFA（彩色滤镜阵列）模式。

选择默认的自动选项以从输入 .xdrz 文件自动获取 CFA 模式，或选择某个受支持的 CFA 模式以强制指定，覆盖 .xdrz 文件可能提供的信息。

FILE:
Perform a drizzle integration process to generate an RGB color image from monochrome raw frames mosaiced with color filter arrays (CFA). This process is also known as Bayer drizzle, although this implementation also supports XTrans CFA frames, besides Bayer patterns.

If the default Auto option is selected for the CFA pattern parameter (see below), DrizzleIntegration will retrieve CFA patterns from input .xdrz files. These patterns are gathered by the Debayer process and generated in .xdrz files by image registration processes such as StarAlignment or CometAlignment.

If one of the supported CFA patterns is selected, such as RGGB, BGGR, etc, the process will assume the selected pattern even if it overrides data provided by .xdrz files (warning messages will be shown in such cases).
文件:
执行 drizzle 积分过程，从用彩色滤镜阵列（CFA）马赛克的单色原始帧生成 RGB 彩色图像。此过程也称为拜耳 drizzle，不过本实现除拜耳模式外还支持 XTrans CFA 帧。

若 CFA 模式参数选择默认的自动选项（见下文），DrizzleIntegration 将从输入 .xdrz 文件中获取 CFA 模式。这些模式由 Debayer 过程收集，并由 StarAlignment 或 CometAlignment 等图像配准过程生成到 .xdrz 文件中。

若选择了某个受支持的 CFA 模式（如 RGGB、BGGR 等），过程将采用所选模式，即使它会覆盖 .xdrz 文件提供的数据（此情况下会显示警告消息）。

FILE:
If the output integrated image has saturated pixel samples out of the nominal [0,1] range, truncate them instead of rescaling the whole image.

No out-of-range values should occur after integration of a well-calibrated data set under normal conditions. However, sometimes saturated pixels may lead to out-of-range values after output normalization, depending on the frame selected as integration reference.

When this happens, the best option for integration of light or science frames is a linear rescaling, which preserves all of the integrated data. However, in some cases altering all pixel values is not admissible, so a rescaling operation is not applicable. In such cases truncation is the only option available to preserve the correct illumination profile in the integrated result.
文件:
若输出积分图像存在超出标称 [0,1] 范围的饱和像素样本，则对其截断，而不是重缩放整幅图像。

在正常条件下对良好校准的数据集积分后不应出现超出范围的值。不过，有时饱和像素可能在输出归一化后导致超出范围的值，具体取决于选为积分参考的帧。

出现这种情况时，对亮帧或科学帧进行积分的最佳选择是线性重缩放，它可保留全部积分数据。不过，某些情况下改变所有像素值是不可接受的，因此重缩放操作不适用。此类情况下，截断是唯一可用来在积分结果中保持正确照明剖面的选项。

FILE:
A region of interest (ROI) defines a rectangular subset of the image to perform the drizzle integration task. This is useful because the task's execution time (and also its memory space consumption) grows quadratically with the dimensions of the output integrated image. By defining a small ROI one can speed up the process significantly, which can be very helpful to test the drizzle process repeatedly.

Note that the coordinates and dimensions of the ROI are expressed in input reference pixels, not in output pixels. You can define ROI coordinates on an integrated image generated by the ImageIntegration tool, or on a registered image created by StarAlignment, for example by defining a preview and clicking the from preview button below.
文件:
感兴趣区域（ROI）定义用于执行 drizzle 积分任务的图像矩形子集。这很有用，因为任务的执行时间（以及内存占用）随输出积分图像尺寸呈二次增长。定义较小的 ROI 可显著加快过程，这对反复测试 drizzle 过程非常有帮助。

注意 ROI 的坐标与尺寸以输入参考像素表示，而不是输出像素。你可以在由 ImageIntegration 工具生成的积分图像上定义 ROI 坐标，也可以在由 StarAlignment 创建的已配准图像上定义，例如通过定义预览并点击下方从预览按钮。

FILE:
The HDR composition process performs a masked combination of each successive pair of images, in decreasing order of relative exposure. For each pair of combined images, the binarizing threshold defines the regions of the long-exposure image that will be replaced with pixels from the short-exposure image.

Too high of a binarizing threshold may prevent appropriate repairing of saturated regions with the corresponding pixels from unsaturated images. A too low threshold may cause the opposite effect, leading to a result with insufficient contributions of large exposures.
文件:
HDR 合成过程按相对曝光递减顺序，对每对相邻图像执行蒙版组合。对每对合成图像，二值化阈值定义了长曝光图像中将被短曝光图像像素替换的区域。

二值化阈值过高可能妨碍用未饱和图像中的对应像素恰当修复饱和区域。阈值过低可能造成相反效果，导致结果中大曝光区域的贡献不足。

FILE:
Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In HDRComposition, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded during the integration process. There are no output hints in HDRComposition since this process does not write images to disk files.

For example, you can use the "raw" hint to force the DSLR_RAW format to load pure raw images without applying any deBayering, interpolation, white balance or black point correction. You can also specify the "lower-range" and "upper-range" hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件:
格式提示允许你为特定过程使用的图像文件覆盖全局文件格式设置。在 HDRComposition 中，输入提示会改变某些特定格式的输入图像在积分过程中的载入方式。HDRComposition 没有输出提示，因为该过程不向磁盘文件写入图像。

例如，你可以使用 "raw" 提示强制 DSLR_RAW 格式载入纯原始图像，而不施加任何去拜耳、插值、白平衡或黑点校正。你也可以指定 "lower-range" 与 "upper-range" 提示，以载入由其他不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的应用生成的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式支持若干输入和/或输出提示，你可以在提供格式提示访问的工具中按不同目的使用它们。

FILE:
Toggle the enabled/disabled state of currently selected input images.

Disabled input images will be ignored during the HDR composition process.
文件:
切换当前选中输入图像的启用/禁用状态。

已禁用的输入图像将在 HDR 合成过程中被忽略。

FILE:
If this option is enabled, HDRComposition will sort its input images automatically by their computed relative exposures. If this option is disabled, the list of input images must be sorted by decreasing exposure order (the most exposed image at the top of the list). If the images are not correctly sorted by decreasing exposure, the HDR composition process will either fail or yield an erroneous result.

This option is enabled by default, as automatic exposure evaluation is a very fast and robust process that should never fail under normal conditions. Note that the automatic exposure evaluation routine does not depend on existing image metadata, as FITS headers or EXIF data (which are simply ignored by this tool). The computed relative exposures depend exclusively on actual pixel values and their statistical properties.
文件:
若启用此选项，HDRComposition 将按计算出的相对曝光自动对其输入图像排序。若禁用此选项，输入图像列表必须按曝光递减顺序排列（曝光最多的图像位于列表顶部）。若图像未按曝光递减正确排序，HDR 合成过程将失败或产生错误结果。

此选项默认启用，因为自动曝光评估是一个非常快速且稳健的过程，在正常条件下绝不应失败。注意自动曝光评估例程不依赖已有的图像元数据，例如 FITS 头或 EXIF 数据（本工具会直接忽略它们）。计算出的相对曝光完全取决于实际像素值及其统计特性。

FILE:
Number of large-scale multiscale layers replaced in source images at each HDR combination step.

By setting this parameter to an integer greater than zero, the HDR combination process will tend to ignore large-scale structures in short-exposure images. Along with mask growth, this parameter can be particularly useful to fix bloomings and other small-scale, high-contrast bright artifacts.
文件:
每个 HDR 合成步骤中在源图像里被替换的大尺度多尺度图层数。

通过把此参数设为大于零的整数，HDR 合成过程将倾向于忽略短曝光图像中的大尺度结构。配合蒙版增长，此参数对修复溢出（blooming）及其他小尺度高对比亮伪影特别有用。

FILE:
HDR combination masks can be expanded by applying a special dilation filter.

Mask growth can be useful to repair highly saturated areas, especially when these areas are surrounded by artifacts. For example, this option is particularly useful to fix bloomings, as they are often surrounded by dark artifacts.
文件:
HDR 合成蒙版可通过施加特殊的膨胀滤波器来扩张。

蒙版增长可用于修复高度饱和区域，尤其是当这些区域被伪影环绕时。例如，此选项对修复溢出（blooming）特别有用，因为它们常被暗伪影环绕。

FILE:
Defines the amount of low-pass filtering applied to smooth the edges of HDR combination masks.

Low-pass filtering is necessary to avoid artifacts caused by hard transitions on the regions where successive images are combined.
文件:
定义用于平滑 HDR 合成蒙版边缘的低通滤波量。

低通滤波是必要的，可避免在相邻图像被组合的区域出现硬过渡所造成的伪影。

FILE:
If this option is selected, HDRComposition will generate a 64-bit floating point result image. Otherwise the HDR composition result will be generated as a 32-bit floating point image.

A 32-bit floating point image is sufficient to represent HDR compositions of small or moderate size. Keep in mind that a 32-bit image provides room for a maximum of about 107 discrete sample values, or approximately 153 times the range of a 16-bit image. Very large HDR images may easily exceed that limit and hence require a 64-bit floating point result, which provides a huge space of 1015 discrete values.

Note that the words 'small' and 'large' here don't refer to the number of images in an HDR composition, but to the length of the required numeric range to represent the whole set of tonal values in the final HDR result.
文件:
若选中此选项，HDRComposition 将生成 64 位浮点结果图像。否则 HDR 合成结果将生成为 32 位浮点图像。

32 位浮点图像足以表示小型或中等规模的 HDR 合成。请记住，32 位图像最多可提供约 107 个离散样本值，约为 16 位图像范围的 153 倍。特大的 HDR 图像很容易超出该限制，因此需要 64 位浮点结果，它提供 1015 个离散值的巨大空间。

注意此处的“小”与“大”并非指 HDR 合成中的图像数量，而是指表示最终 HDR 结果中整套色调值所需的数值范围长度。

FILE:
HDRComposition performs a linear fit to match the tonal ranges of each pair of combined images. Linear fitting can be restricted to a user-defined rectangular region of interest, which has two main advantages: (1) linear fitting is a relatively expensive process and restricting it to a smaller region improves performance, and (2) by restricting the region of pixels used to compute linear fitting functions, accuracy can be improved in case there are small flat fielding errors (nonuniform illumination) near the edges of the images, which is a frequent problem.

When enabled, the fitting rectangle must define a nonempty subset of the input images. When the fitting region is disabled (the default option), the whole image is used to compute linear fitting functions.
文件:
HDRComposition 会做线性拟合，以匹配每对合成图像的色调范围。线性拟合可限制在用户定义的矩形感兴趣区域内，这有两个主要优点：(1) 线性拟合是相对耗时的过程，限制在较小区域可提升性能；(2) 通过限制用于计算线性拟合函数的像素区域，在图像边缘附近存在小的平场误差（照明不均匀）时可提高准确性，而这是常见问题。

启用时，拟合矩形必须定义输入图像的非空子集。拟合区域被禁用（默认选项）时，使用整幅图像计算线性拟合函数。

FILE:
Make the currently selected file on the list the reference image.

The reference image is the first one in the list of images to integrate. Its statistical properties will be taken as the basis to calculate normalization parameters and relative combination weights for the rest of integrated images.
文件:
把列表中当前选中的文件设为参考图像。

参考图像是待积分图像列表中的第一幅。其统计特性将被作为计算其余待积分图像归一化参数与相对组合权重的基础。

FILE:
Toggle the enabled/disabled state of currently selected input images.

Disabled input images will be ignored during the integration process.
文件:
切换当前选中输入图像的启用/禁用状态。

已禁用的输入图像将在积分过程中被忽略。

FILE:
When assigning drizzle and/or local normalization data files to target images, take into account full file paths stored in .xdrz and .xnml files. This allows you to integrate images with duplicate file names on different directories. However, by enabling this option your data set gets tied to specific locations on the local filesystem. When this option is disabled (the default state), only file names are used to associate target images with .xdrz and .xnml files, which allows you to move your images freely throughout the filesystem, including the possibility to migrate them to different machines.

Changes to this option will come into play the next time you associate .xdrz and/or .xnml files with target images. Existing file associations are not affected.
