把 drizzle 和/或局部归一化数据文件指派给目标图像时，是否考虑 .xdrz 与 .xnml 文件中存储的完整文件路径。这可让你积分位于不同目录、文件重名的图像。不过，启用此选项会使你的数据集绑定到本地文件系统上的特定位置。禁用此选项（默认状态）时，仅使用文件名把目标图像与 .xdrz 和 .xnml 文件关联，从而允许你在文件系统中自由移动图像，包括把它们迁移到不同机器。

对此选项的修改将在下次把 .xdrz 和/或 .xnml 文件与目标图像关联时生效。已有的文件关联不受影响。

FILE:
Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In ImageIntegration, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded during the integration process. There are no output hints in ImageIntegration since this process does not write images to disk files.

For example, you can use the "raw cfa" hints to force the RAW format to load pure raw images without applying any demosaicing, interpolation, white balance, or black point correction. You can also specify the "lower-range" and "upper-range" hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件:
格式提示允许你为特定过程使用的图像文件覆盖全局文件格式设置。在 ImageIntegration 中，输入提示会改变某些特定格式的输入图像在积分过程中的载入方式。ImageIntegration 没有输出提示，因为该过程不向磁盘文件写入图像。

例如，你可以使用 "raw cfa" 提示强制 RAW 格式载入纯原始图像，而不施加任何去马赛克、插值、白平衡或黑点校正。你也可以指定 "lower-range" 与 "upper-range" 提示，以载入由其他不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的应用生成的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式支持若干输入和/或输出提示，你可以在提供格式提示访问的工具中按不同目的使用它们。

FILE:
Associate existing local normalization data files with input images.

Local normalization data files carry the .xnml suffix. Normally you should select .xnml files generated by the LocalNormalization tool for the same files that you are integrating.
文件:
把已有的局部归一化数据文件与输入图像相关联。

局部归一化数据文件的后缀为 .xnml。通常应选择 LocalNormalization 工具为你正在积分的同一批文件所生成的 .xnml 文件。

FILE:
Remove all local normalization data files currently associated with input images.

This removes just file associations, not the actual local normalization data files.
文件:
移除当前与输入图像关联的所有局部归一化数据文件。

这仅移除文件关联，而不是实际的局部归一化数据文件。

FILE:
Associate existing drizzle data files with input images.

Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz suffix. Normally you should select .xdrz files generated by the StarAlignment tool for the same files that you are integrating.
文件:
把已有的 drizzle 数据文件与输入图像相关联。

Drizzle 数据文件的扩展名为 .xdrz。通常应选择 StarAlignment 工具为你正在积分的同一批文件所生成的 .xdrz 文件。

FILE:
Image weighting method.

The PSF Signal Weight (PSFSW) and PSF SNR algorithms are based on robust estimates of total and mean flux computed by PSF photometry, as well as noise estimates computed using multiscale analysis techniques. These methods are robust and accurate. PSFSW is a comprehensive image quality estimator, able to capture a wide variety of image quality metrics including signal-to-noise ratio, source dimensions and background gradients. PSF SNR is a good choice to generate image weights based on signal-to-noise ratio exclusively. The PSF Signal Weight method is currently the default option.

The PSF Scale SNR (PSFSSNR) method uses relative scale estimates computed by the LocalNormalization tool and stored in local normalization data files (XNML format, .xnml extension), along with multiscale noise estimates, to compute image weights exclusively based on relative signal-to-noise ratios. This method is excellent to maximize SNR in the integrated image. PSFSSNR requires .xnml files correctly associated with all input images to retrieve relative scale estimates, and all .xnml files should be generated with the same normalization reference image.

The SNR method uses statistical scale estimators and multiscale noise evaluation techniques to compute SNR estimates. These estimates are applied to minimize mean squared error in the integrated result, which in theory transforms the average combination process into a maximum likelihood estimator of deterministic signal. This method can lead to optimal results in terms of SNR maximization, but has potential robustness problems that can also generate wrong results, so it must be used with care by analyzing the data prior to integration, for example with the SubframeSelector tool.

Noise estimates and scaling factors, as well as PSF flux estimates and other auxiliary weighting terms, are obtained either from cached data, when available, of from XISF properties. If no XISF properties are available, the estimates are obtained from a set of custom FITS keywords, if they are present in the images. If the data being integrated has been correctly calibrated (and demosaiced when applicable) with our preprocessing tools, these properties and keywords should always be included in each input frame. Otherwise ImageIntegration will have to compute these estimates from the data being integrated, which is a potentially wrong procedure because input frames have been interpolated during the image demosaicing (when applicable) and registration tasks, destroying the original statistics of the raw data. Appropriate warning messages will be shown in these cases.

Exposure times will be retrieved from standard EXPTIME and EXPOSURE FITS keywords (in that order).

The average signal strength option attempts to derive relative exposures directly from statistical properties of the data. This option is less robust and may not work if some images have additive illumination variations, such as sky gradients.

If you select the FITS keyword option, please specify the name of a FITS keyword to retrieve image weights. The specified keyword must be present in all input images and its value must be of numeric type and positive.

If you select the CSV weights file option, you must select a plain text file in CSV format with full file paths of integrated images and their corresponding per-channel image weights. See the CSV weights file parameter for more information.
文件:
图像加权方法。

PSF Signal Weight（PSFSW）与 PSF SNR 算法基于由 PSF 测光计算的总光通量与平均光通量的稳健估计，以及使用多尺度分析技术计算的噪声估计。这些方法稳健且准确。PSFSW 是一种综合的图像质量估计器，能够捕捉包括信噪比、源尺寸与背景梯度在内的多种图像质量指标。若想完全基于信噪比生成图像权重，PSF SNR 是良好选择。PSF Signal Weight 方法目前是默认选项。

PSF Scale SNR（PSFSSNR）方法使用由 LocalNormalization 工具计算并存储在局部归一化数据文件（XNML 格式，扩展名 .xnml）中的相对尺度估计，配合多尺度噪声估计，完全基于相对信噪比计算图像权重。此方法非常适合最大化积分图像中的 SNR。PSFSSNR 需要与所有输入图像正确关联的 .xnml 文件以获取相对尺度估计，且所有 .xnml 文件都应使用同一归一化参考图像生成。

SNR 方法使用统计尺度估计器与多尺度噪声评估技术来计算 SNR 估计。这些估计用于最小化积分结果的均方误差，理论上可把平均合成过程转变为确定性信号的最大似然估计器。此方法在 SNR 最大化方面可达到最优结果，但存在潜在的稳健性问题，也可能产生错误结果，因此必须谨慎使用——在积分前先分析数据，例如使用 SubframeSelector 工具。

噪声估计与缩放因子，以及 PSF 光通量估计与其他辅助加权项，可从缓存数据（若可用）或 XISF 属性中获取。若无可用 XISF 属性，则从一组自定义 FITS 关键字中获取估计值（若图像中存在）。若待积分数据已用我们的预处理工具正确校准（并在适用时去马赛克），则每幅输入帧中应始终包含这些属性与关键字。否则 ImageIntegration 将不得不从待积分数据中计算这些估计值，而这是一种可能错误的做法，因为输入帧在图像去马赛克（若适用）与配准任务中已遭插值，破坏了原始数据的统计特性。这些情况下会显示相应的警告消息。

曝光时间将从标准 EXPTIME 与 EXPOSURE FITS 关键字中获取（按此顺序）。

平均信号强度选项尝试直接从数据的统计特性推导相对曝光。此选项稳健性较差，若某些图像存在加性照明变化（如天空梯度）可能失效。

若选择 FITS 关键字选项，请指定用于获取图像权重的 FITS 关键字名称。所指定的关键字必须存在于所有输入图像中，其取值必须为数值型且为正。

若选择 CSV 权重文件选项，你必须选择一个 CSV 格式的纯文本文件，其中包含待积分图像的完整文件路径及其对应的逐通道图像权重。详情参见 CSV 权重文件参数。

FILE:
Select a pixel combination operation.

Average combination provides the best signal-to-noise ratio in the integrated result.

Median combination provides implicit robust rejection of outliers at the cost of a smaller SNR improvement (approximately a 20% less compared to average combination).
文件:
选择像素组合运算。

平均合成在积分结果中提供最佳信噪比。

中值合成以较小的信噪比提升（相比平均合成约低 20%）为代价，提供对离群值的隐式稳健剔除。

FILE:
Image normalization for combination.

If one of these options is selected, ImageIntegration will normalize and scale all the input images before combining them to generate the output image. Note that these normalization and scaling operations are independent from the similar operations performed before pixel rejection.

Normalization matches mean background values. This can be done either as an additive or as a multiplicative process. In general, both ways lead to very similar results, but multiplicative normalization should be used to integrate images that are to be further combined or applied by multiplication or division, such as flat fields.

Scaling matches dispersion. This works as a sort of automatic weighting to combine the input images, and tends to improve the SNR of the result, especially for images with different overall illumination.

Local normalization applies per-pixel linear normalization functions previously calculated and stored in XNML files (.xnml file name suffix) by the LocalNormalization process. To apply this option, existing XNML files must be associated with input integration files. This option should normally be used when local normalization is also used for pixel rejection.

The default option is additive normalization with scaling.
文件:
用于组合的图像归一化。

若选中这些选项之一，ImageIntegration 会在组合生成输出图像之前对所有输入图像做归一化与缩放。注意这些归一化与缩放操作与像素剔除前执行的类似操作相互独立。

归一化匹配平均背景值。这既可以加性方式也可以乘性方式完成。一般来说两种方式的结果非常接近，但对将要进一步组合或以乘法/除法施加的图像（例如平场）进行积分时，应使用乘性归一化。

缩放匹配离散度。它起到一种自动加权的作用来组合输入图像，往往能改善结果的 SNR，尤其对整体照明不同的图像有效。

局部归一化施加此前由 LocalNormalization 过程计算并存储在 XNML 文件（后缀 .xnml）中的逐像素线性归一化函数。要应用此选项，已有 XNML 文件必须与输入积分文件相关联。通常在像素剔除也使用局部归一化时才使用此选项。

默认选项是加性归一化并缩放。

FILE:
Generate an XML drizzle data file for each integrated image.

Drizzle data files contain geometrical projection parameters, pixel rejection maps, statistical data and metadata for the DrizzleIntegration tool. StarAlignment creates drizzle files with projection data, and the ImageIntegration tool appends rejection and statistical data to the same files. Drizzle files carry the .xdrz file suffix.
文件:
为每幅积分图像生成 XML 格式的 drizzle 数据文件。

Drizzle 数据文件包含供 DrizzleIntegration 工具使用的几何投影参数、像素剔除图、统计数据与元数据。StarAlignment 创建带投影数据的 drizzle 文件，ImageIntegration 工具则向同一批文件追加剔除与统计数据。Drizzle 文件的扩展名为 .xdrz。

FILE:
Subtract PEDESTAL keyword values, if present in input images.

Some data sets require the addition of small positive values (typically about 100 DN) to calibrated light frames in order to prevent truncation of negative pixel sample values after calibration. These small pedestals can be subtracted from source integration pixels to refer all input data to the same zero point consistently.

In general, this option should only be enabled for integration of calibrated light frames with PEDESTAL keywords when a global normalization method (such as additive with scaling) is used for pixel rejection and/or integration output.

This option should always be disabled if local normalization is used, since subtracting pedestals invalidates local normalization functions. Local normalization already compensates for differing additive components among integrated frames.

This option should also be disabled for integration of raw bias and dark frames, since in these cases existing PEDESTAL keywords should be preserved in the generated master bias and dark frames. These pedestals will be subtracted automatically by the ImageCalibration process for calibration of flat and light frames.
文件:
若输入图像中存在 PEDESTAL 关键字，则减去其值。

某些数据集需要向已校准亮帧加入小的正值（通常约 100 DN），以防止校准后负像素样本值被截断。这些小的基座可从源积分像素中减去，从而把所有输入数据一致地归到同一零点。

一般来说，只有在积分带 PEDESTAL 关键字的已校准亮帧、并且使用全局归一化方法（例如加性并缩放）进行像素剔除和/或积分输出时，才应启用此选项。

若使用局部归一化，则此选项应始终禁用，因为减去基座会使局部归一化函数失效。局部归一化已经补偿了待积分帧之间不同的加性成分。

对原始偏置与暗帧的积分也应禁用此选项，因为这些情况下已有的 PEDESTAL 关键字应保留在所生成的 master bias 与 master dark 帧中。这些基座将由 ImageCalibration 过程在校准平场与亮帧时自动减去。

FILE:
If the output integrated image has saturated pixel samples out of the nominal [0,1] range, truncate them instead of rescaling the whole image.

No out-of-range values should occur after integration of a well-calibrated data set under normal conditions. However, sometimes saturated pixels may lead to out-of-range values after output normalization, depending on the frame selected as integration reference.

When this happens, the best option for integration of light or science frames is a linear rescaling, which preserves all of the integrated data. However, in some cases altering all pixel values is not admissible, so a rescaling operation is not applicable. This is the case for integration of flat frames, where truncation is the only option available to preserve the correct illumination profile in the integrated master flat frame.
文件:
若输出积分图像存在超出标称 [0,1] 范围的饱和像素样本，则对其截断，而不是重缩放整幅图像。

在正常条件下对良好校准的数据集积分后不应出现超出范围的值。不过，有时饱和像素可能在输出归一化后导致超出范围的值，具体取决于选为积分参考的帧。

出现这种情况时，对亮帧或科学帧进行积分的最佳选择是线性重缩放，它可保留全部积分数据。不过，某些情况下改变所有像素值不可接受，因此重缩放不适用。积分平场帧就是这种情况，此时截断是唯一可用来在生成的 master flat 中保持正确照明剖面的选项。

FILE:
Custom FITS keyword to retrieve image weights.

This is the name of a FITS keyword that will be used to retrieve image weights, if the FITS keyword option has been selected as the weighting criterion.
文件:
用于获取图像权重的自定义 FITS 关键字。

当选择 FITS 关键字选项作为加权准则时，此为将用于获取图像权重的 FITS 关键字名称。

FILE:
The full path to an existing local plain text file in CSV format containing image weights, when the CSV weights file option has been selected as the weighting criterion.

In each line of a CSV weights file, the first field must be the full path to an image being integrated, followed by per-channel image weights specified as floating point real numbers.
文件:
当选择 CSV 权重文件选项作为加权准则时，此为包含图像权重的现有本地 CSV 格式纯文本文件的完整路径。

在 CSV 权重文件的每一行中，第一个字段必须是待积分图像的完整路径，其后为以浮点实数指定的逐通道图像权重。

FILE:
Generate the result of the integration process as a new image window.

This option should be enabled for normal use. If you disable it, the integrated image won't be generated at the end of the process. You can disable this option to save a relatively modest amount of computation time and resources while you are trying out rejection parameters. To evaluate the quality of pixel rejection, you normally are only interested in rejection pixel counts and/or rejection maps.
文件:
把积分过程的结果生成为新的图像窗口。

正常使用时应启用此选项。若禁用，过程结束时不会生成积分图像。在试调剔除参数期间，可禁用此选项以节省相当一部分计算时间与资源。要评估像素剔除质量，通常你只关心剔除像素计数和/或剔除图。

FILE: When the weight overshoot protection feature is enabled, this is the normalized mean weight that triggers it to prevent contamination of the integrated result by spurious data associated with abnormally high weights. The higher this parameter, the more permissive the integration will be to allow incorrectly weighted data.
文件: 启用权重过冲保护功能时，此为触发该保护的归一化平均权重，用于防止与异常高权重相关的虚假数据污染积分结果。此参数越高，积分对不正确的加权数据就越宽容。

FILE: This parameter defines a quantile (in the [0,1] range) to acquire the maximum allowed image weight in the data set. All weights greater than the value determined by this quantile will be replaced with either the robust mean weight or zero if the remove abnormally weighted images option is enabled. This effectively protects the integration process from degradation caused by incorrect metadata or quality and noise estimates.
文件: 此参数定义一个分位数（位于 [0,1] 范围），用于获取数据集中允许的最大图像权重。所有大于该分位数所确定值的权重，都会被替换为稳健平均权重；若启用移除异常加权图像选项，则替换为零。这可有效保护积分过程，避免因不正确的元数据或质量与噪声估计而导致结果劣化。

FILE:
Use the largest possible buffer and stack sizes, calculated automatically from the amount of physical memory currently available to PixInsight.

Usually this is the best option to optimize image integration performance, but be aware that for large data sets and low-memory machines (relative to the total size of the data) the process may use too many system resources. If you want finer control on system resources usage, disable this option and tweak the values of the buffer size and stack size parameters.
文件:
使用尽可能大的缓冲与栈大小，它们会依据当前可供 PixInsight 使用的物理内存量自动计算。

通常这是优化图像积分性能的最佳选项，但请注意对于大数据集与（相对于数据总量而言）内存较少的机器，过程可能占用过多系统资源。若想更精细地控制系统资源占用，请禁用此选项并调节 缓冲大小 与 栈大小 参数。

FILE:
This parameter defines the size of the working buffers used to read pixel rows. There is an independent buffer per input image. A reasonably large buffer size will improve performance by minimizing disk reading operations. The default value of 16 MiB is usually quite appropriate.

Decrease this parameter if you experience out-of-memory errors during integration. This may be necessary for integration of large image sets on systems with low memory resources. The minimum value is zero, which will use a single row of pixels per input image.
文件:
此参数定义用于读取像素行的工作缓冲大小。每幅输入图像有独立缓冲区。适当大的缓冲大小可通过最小化磁盘读取操作来提升性能。默认值 16 MiB 通常相当合适。

若积分过程中出现内存不足错误，请减小此参数。在内存资源较少的系统上积分大幅图像集合时可能需要这样做。最小值为零，此时每幅输入图像每次只使用一行像素。

FILE:
By default, ImageIntegration generates and uses a dynamic cache of working image parameters, including pixel statistics and normalization data. This cache greatly improves performance when the same images are being integrated several times, for example to find optimal pixel rejection parameters.

Disable this option if for some reason you don't want to use the cache. This will force recalculation of all statistical data required for normalization, which involves loading all integrated image files from disk.

The file cache can also be persistent across PixInsight core application executions. The persistent cache and its options can be controlled with the ImageIntegration Preferences dialog.
文件:
默认情况下，ImageIntegration 会生成并使用工作图像参数的动态缓存，包括像素统计与归一化数据。当同一批图像被多次积分时（例如为寻找最佳像素剔除参数），此缓存可大幅提升性能。

若因某种原因不想使用缓存，请禁用此选项。这会强制重新计算归一化所需的全部统计数据，涉及从磁盘载入所有待积分图像文件。

文件缓存还可以在 PixInsight 核心应用的多次执行之间持久保留。持久缓存及其选项可通过 ImageIntegration 偏好设置对话框控制。

FILE:
Minimum normalized weight required for integration.

Images with normalized weights below the value of this parameter will be excluded for integration. The default value is 0.005, which represents a 0.5% of the maximum weight in the integrated data set. To disable this automatic image exclusion feature, set this parameter to zero.

积分所需的最小归一化权重。

归一化权重低于此参数值的图像将被排除在积分之外。默认值为 0.005，即积分数据集中最大权重的 0.5%。要禁用此自动图像排除功能，请把此参数设为零。

FILE:
When this parameter is enabled and the mean normalized weight is smaller than the protection threshold parameter, normalized weights larger than the quantile determined by the protection limit parameter will be replaced either with the robust mean weight, or zero if the remove abnormally weighted images option is enabled.

This is useful when there are abnormally high weights in a data set that are not real, that is, that don't correspond to better data according to measurable properties of the raw data. In general, this may occur when the dataset includes erroneous images or when the metadata does not provide reliable estimates of image quality and/or noise. For example, this may occur when integrating incongruent datasets, where some weights must be evaluated for registered/interpolated frames due to partially missing or invalid metadata. Another case is when the data set includes incorrect images, such as wrongly registered frames or frames from different fields.

If the integrated data set has been reviewed to ensure the validity of images and metadata, this feature is not necessary. However, when the necessary checks cannot be implemented, or data validity cannot be guaranteed, using this feature can achieve acceptable results by automatically removing the influence of spurious data and metadata.

当此参数启用且平均归一化权重小于保护阈值参数时，大于保护限值参数所确定分位数的归一化权重将被替换为稳健平均权重；若启用移除异常加权图像选项，则替换为零。

当数据集中存在异常高但并非真实的权重时（即按原始数据的可测量属性并不对应更好数据的权重），此功能很有用。一般来说，这可能发生在数据集包含错误图像，或元数据无法提供可靠的图像质量/噪声估计时。例如，在积分不一致的数据集时可能发生——由于元数据部分缺失或无效，某些权重必须针对已配准/插值帧来评估。另一种情况是数据集包含不正确的图像，例如配准错误的帧或来自不同视场的帧。

若已审查过积分数据集以确保图像与元数据有效，则不需要此功能。不过，当无法实施必要检查，或数据有效性无法保证时，使用此功能可通过自动消除虚假数据与元数据的影响来获得可接受的结果。

FILE:
This is the size of the working integration stack structure. In general, the larger this parameter, the better the performance, especially on multiprocessor/multicore systems.

The best performance is achieved when the whole set of integrated pixels can be loaded at once in the integration stack. For this to happen, the following conditions must be true:

  • Buffer size must be large enough as to allow loading an input file in 32-bit floating point format completely with a single file read operation.
  • Stack size must be larger than or equal to W*H*(12*N + 4), where W and H are the image width and height in pixels, respectively, and N is the number of integrated images. For linear fit clipping rejection, replace 4 with 8 in the above equation.

Note that this may require a large amount of RAM available for relatively large image sets. As an example, the default stack size of 1024 (1 GiB) is sufficient to integrate 20 2048x2048 monochrome images optimally with the default buffer size of 16 MiB. With a stack size of 4 GiB and a buffer size of 64 MiB you could integrate 20 4Kx4K monochrome images with optimum performance.

FILE:
Pixel rejection algorithm

The iterative sigma clipping algorithm is usually a good option to integrate more than 10 or 15 images. Keep in mind that for sigma clipping to work, the standard deviation must be a good estimator of dispersion, which requires a sufficient number of pixels per stack (the more images the better).

Winsorized sigma clipping is similar to the normal sigma clipping algorithm, but uses a special iterative procedure based on Huber's method of robust estimation of parameters through Winsorization. This algorithm can yield superior rejection of outliers with better preservation of significant data for large sets of images.

Linear fit clipping fits each pixel stack to a straigtht line. The linear fit is optimized in the twofold sense of minimizing average absolute deviation and maximizing inliers. This rejection algorithm is more robust than sigma clipping for large sets of images, especially in presence of additive sky gradients of varying intensity and spatial distribution. For the best performance, use this algorithm for large sets of at least 15 images. Five images is the minimum required.

The Generalized Extreme Studentized Deviate (ESD) rejection algorithm is an implementation of the method described by Bernard Rosner in his 1983 paper Percentage Points for a Generalized ESD Many-Outlier procedure, adapted to the image integration task. The ESD algorithm assumes that each pixel stack, in the absence of outliers, follows an approximately normal (Gaussian) distribution. It aims at avoiding masking, a serious issue that occurs when an outlier goes undetected because its value is similar to another outlier. The performance of this algorithm is excellent for data sets of 15 or more images, although good results can also be obtained for reduced sets of 8-10 frames. The minimum required is 3 images.

Robust Chauvenet Rejection (RCR) is based on the algorithms described in Maples, M. P., Reichart, D. E. et al., Robust Chauvenet Outlier Rejection, Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, 2018, 238, A2, 1-49. Our implementation applies three successive stages of rejection with decreasingly robust/increasingly precise measures of central tendency and sample deviation, rejecting a single pixel at each iteration for maximum stability. This is a single-parameter pixel rejection algorithm introduced since version 1.8.9 of PixInsight.

Percentile clipping rejection is excellent to integrate reduced sets of images, such as 3 to 6 images. This is a single-pass algorithm that rejects pixels outside a fixed range of values relative to the median of each pixel stack.

Averaged iterative sigma clipping is intended for sets of 10 or more images. This algorithm tries to derive the gain of an ideal CCD detector from existing pixel data, assuming zero readout noise, then uses a Poisson noise model to perform rejection. For large sets of images however, sigma clipping tends to be superior.

The min/max method can be used to ensure rejection of extreme values. Min/max performs an unconditional rejection of a fixed number of pixels from each stack, without any statistical basis. Rejection methods based on robust statistics, such as percentile, Winsorized sigma clipping, linear fitting and averaged sigma clipping are in general preferable.
文件:
像素剔除算法

迭代 sigma 裁剪算法通常是积分 10 或 15 幅以上图像的良好选择。请记住，sigma 裁剪要有效，标准差必须是离散度的良好估计，这要求每个栈有足够多的像素（图像越多越好）。

Winsor 化 sigma 裁剪与常规 sigma 裁剪算法类似，但使用一种基于 Huber 借助Winsor 化进行参数稳健估计方法的特殊迭代过程。对于大幅图像集合，该算法可以在更好地保留重要数据的同时，提供更优的离群值剔除效果。

线性拟合裁剪把每个像素栈拟合为一条直线。该线性拟合在双重意义上优化：最小化平均绝对偏差并最大化内点。对于大幅图像集合，此剔除算法比 sigma 裁剪更稳健，尤其是在存在强度与空间分布各异的加性天空梯度时。为获得最佳效果，请对至少 15 幅图像的大集合使用此算法。最少需要 5 幅图像。

广义极端学生化偏离（ESD）剔除算法是对 Bernard Rosner 在其 1983 年论文Percentage Points for a Generalized ESD Many-Outlier procedure 中所述方法的实现，并针对图像积分任务做了适配。ESD 算法假定在没有离群值的情况下，每个像素栈近似服从正态（高斯）分布。它旨在避免遮蔽——即某离群值因与另一离群值数值相近而未被检出所导致的严重问题。对于 15 幅以上的图像数据集，该算法表现优异，对 8-10 帧的较小集合也能取得良好结果。最少需要 3 幅图像。

稳健 Chauvenet 剔除（RCR）基于 Maples, M. P., Reichart, D. E. 等人在Robust Chauvenet Outlier Rejection（Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, 2018, 238, A2, 1-49）中描述的算法。我们的实现依次施加三个阶段，采用稳健性递减、精度递增的集中趋势与样本偏差度量，每次迭代只剔除一个像素以获得最大稳定性。这是自 PixInsight 1.8.9 版起引入的单参数像素剔除算法。

百分位裁剪剔除非常适合积分较小的图像集合，例如 3 到 6 幅图像。这是一种单遍算法，会剔除相对于每个像素栈中值落在固定取值范围之外的像素。

平均迭代 sigma 裁剪适用于 10 幅以上的图像集合。该算法尝试在假定读出噪声为零的前提下，从已有像素数据推导理想 CCD 探测器的增益，然后使用泊松噪声模型执行剔除。不过对于大幅图像集合，sigma 裁剪往往更优。

可使用最小/最大方法确保剔除极端值。最小/最大对每个栈无条件剔除固定数量的像素，没有任何统计依据。基于稳健统计的剔除方法（例如百分位、Winsor 化 sigma 裁剪、线性拟合与平均 sigma 裁剪）通常更可取。

FILE:
Image normalization for pixel rejection.

Normalization is essential to perform a correct pixel rejection, since it ensures that the data from all integrated images are compatible in terms of their statistical distribution (mean background values and dispersion).

Scale + zero offset matches mean background values and dispersion. This involves multiplicative and additive transformations. This is the default rejection normalization method that should be used to integrate calibrated images.

Equalize fluxes simply matches the main histogram peaks of all images prior to pixel rejection. This is done by multiplication with the ratio of the reference median to the median of each integrated image. This is the method of choice to integrate sky flat fields, since in this case trying to match dispersion does not make sense, due to the irregular illumination distribution. For the same reason, this type of rejection normalization can also be useful to integrate uncalibrated images, or images suffering from strong gradients.

Local normalization applies per-pixel linear normalization functions previously calculated and stored in XNML files (.xnml file name suffix), e.g. by the LocalNormalization process. To apply this option, existing XNML files must be associated with input integration files. Local normalization is the most accurate and robust option for rejection normalization of data sets with large variations, such as those caused by varying acquisition conditions, strong gradients with different orientations and intensities, or data acquired with different instruments. In that cases, global normalization techniques based on statistical properties of the whole image may be unable to make the data statistically compatible with the required locality, leading to inaccurate pixel rejection.
文件:
用于像素剔除的图像归一化。

归一化对正确的像素剔除至关重要，因为它确保所有待积分图像的数据在其统计分布（平均背景值与离散度）上相互兼容。

缩放 + 零偏移匹配平均背景值与离散度。这涉及乘性与加性变换。这是默认的剔除归一化方法，应用于积分已校准的图像。

均衡光通量只是在对所有图像做像素剔除之前匹配它们的主直方图峰值。做法是把每幅待积分图像的中值乘以参考中值与该中值之比。这是积分天光平场时的首选方法，因为在这种情况下由于照明分布不规则，试图匹配离散度没有意义。同理，这种剔除归一化方式对积分未校准图像或受强梯度影响的图像也有用。

局部归一化施加此前计算并存储在 XNML 文件（后缀 .xnml）中的逐像素线性归一化函数（例如由 LocalNormalization 过程生成）。要应用此选项，已有 XNML 文件必须与输入积分文件相关联。对于变化较大的数据集（例如由变化的采集条件、方向与强度各异的强梯度造成，或用不同仪器采集的数据），局部归一化是最准确、最稳健的剔除归一化选项。在这些情况下，基于整幅图像统计特性的全局归一化技术可能无法使数据在所需局部性上达到统计一致，从而导致像素剔除不准确。

FILE:
Expected maximum fraction of outliers for the generalized ESD rejection algorithm.

For example, a value of 0.2 applied to a stack of 10 pixels means that the ESD algorithm will be limited to detecting a maximum of two outlier pixels; in other words, only 0, 1, or 2 outliers will be detectable in that case. The default value is 0.3, which allows the algorithm to detect up to a 30% of outlier pixels in each pixel stack.
文件:
广义 ESD 剔除算法预期的离群值最大占比。

例如，对 10 个像素的栈施加 0.2 的值，意味着 ESD 算法最多只能检测出两个离群像素；换言之，此情形下只能检测出 0、1 或 2 个离群值。默认值为 0.3，允许算法在每个像素栈中检测出最多 30% 的离群像素。

FILE:
Significance level of the outlier detection hypothesis test. This is the probability of making a Type I error (false positive) in the generalized ESD rejection algorithm.

For example, a significance level of 0.01 means that a 1% chance of being wrong when rejecting the null hypothesis (that there are no outliers in a pixel stack) is acceptable. The default value is 0.05 (5% significance level).

Increasing this parameter tends to cause the ESD algorithm to reject more pixels in each stack. Increasing this parameter has an effect similar to reducing the threshold of a sigma-clipping algorithm, although the underlying mechanisms are very different.
文件:
离群值检测假设检验的显著性水平。这是在广义 ESD 剔除算法中犯第一类错误（假阳性）的概率。

例如，显著性水平 0.01 意味着在拒绝原假设（即像素栈中不存在离群值）时，可以接受 1% 的出错概率。默认值为 0.05（5% 显著性水平）。

增大此参数往往会使 ESD 算法在每个栈中剔除更多像素。增大此参数的效果类似于减小 sigma 裁剪算法的阈值，尽管底层机制差异很大。

FILE:
Limit for the modified Chauvenet rejection criterion.

The larger the value of this parameter, the more pixels will be rejected by the Robust Chauvenet Rejection algorithm.

The original Chauvenet rejection criterion is N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5, where N is the number of measurements and P() represents the probability of x being more than z standard deviations from the mean. This parameter modifies the rejection criterion by replacing 0.5 with an arbitrary limit in the [0,1] range, in order to make the algorithm controllable. The default value is 0.1, which usually works well with most deep-sky images. Note that a single limit parameter is applied for rejection of both low and high pixels, since the implemented iterative rejection method is symmetrical.
文件:
修改后 Chauvenet 剔除准则的限值。

此参数值越大，稳健 Chauvenet 剔除算法剔除的像素越多。

原始 Chauvenet 剔除准则为 N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5，其中 N 为测量次数，P() 表示 x 偏离均值超过 z 个标准差的概率。此参数通过把 0.5 替换为 [0,1] 范围内的任意限值来修改剔除准则，以使算法可控。默认值为 0.1，对大多数深空图像通常效果良好。注意对低像素与高像素剔除施加同一个限值参数，因为所实现的迭代剔除方法是对称的。

FILE:
Cutoff point for the Winsorized sigma clipping rejection algorithm, in sigma units.

All pixel samples with absolute differences from the median larger than this parameter will be set equal to the median of the pixel stack in the first rejection iteration. This replaces extreme outliers, such as cosmics, hot and cold pixels, with plausible values instead of their nearest neighbors.
文件:
Winsor 化 sigma 裁剪剔除算法的截止点，以 sigma 为单位。

与像素栈中值绝对差大于此参数的所有像素样本，在第一轮剔除迭代中会被设为该像素栈的中值。这样可把极端离群值（例如宇宙线、热像素与冷像素）替换为合理值，而不是其最近邻。

FILE:
Large-scale pixel rejection uses multiscale analysis techniques to detect structures of rejected pixels. These structures are grown to cover borderline regions where high uncertainty may lead to insufficient rejection by statistical pixel rejection algorithms.

This feature is very efficient to improve rejection of plane and satellite trails and flashes. With large-scale high pixel rejection enabled, you can be sure these artifacts will be correctly rejected without needing to reduce clipping factors, which in turn allows for more accurate rejection with inclusion of more signal in the integrated result. Large-scale low rejection may be useful to remove dust motes and other relatively large dark artifacts.
文件:
大尺度像素剔除使用多尺度分析技术来检测被剔除像素构成的结构。这些结构会被扩张以覆盖边缘区域，那里不确定性较高，可能导致统计像素剔除算法剔除不足。

此功能对改善对飞机与卫星轨迹以及闪光的剔除非常有效。启用大尺度高像素剔除后，你可以确信这些伪影会被正确剔除，而无需降低裁剪因子，从而允许在积分结果中纳入更多信号的同时实现更准确的剔除。大尺度低像素剔除可用于去除灰尘颗粒及其他相对较大的暗伪影。

FILE:
Point spread function type used for PSF fitting and photometry.

In all cases elliptical functions are fitted to detected star structures, and PSF sampling regions are defined adaptively using a median stabilization algorithm.

When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for flux measurement. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.
文件:
用于 PSF 拟合与测光的点扩散函数类型。

所有情况下都会对检测到的恒星结构拟合椭圆函数，并使用中值稳定算法自适应地定义 PSF 采样区域。

选择 自动选项时，会为每个源拟合一系列不同的 PSF，并采用使函数值与采样像素值之间绝对差最小的拟合来测量光通量。目前在此特殊自动模式下测试以下函数：beta 形状参数等于 2.5、4、6 与 10 的 Moffat 函数。

FILE:
Generate noise, SNR and PSF Signal Weight estimates for the final integrated image.

When this option is enabled, the selected noise evaluation algorithm (MRS by default) will be used to compute the standard deviation of the noise in the integrated result. These estimates are typically to within 1% accuracy. Besides noise estimates, a final report will be generated with per-channel robust descriptive statistics, SNR and PSF Signal Weight estimates.

This option is useful to compare the results of different integration procedures. For example, by comparing SNR and PSF Signal Weight estimates you can know which image normalization and weighting criteria lead to the best results in terms of image quality.
文件:
为最终积分图像生成噪声、SNR 与 PSF Signal Weight 估计。

启用此选项时，将使用所选的噪声评估算法（默认为 MRS）计算积分结果中的噪声标准差。这些估计通常准确到 1% 以内。除噪声估计外，还会生成一份最终报告，包含逐通道稳健描述性统计、SNR 与 PSF Signal Weight 估计。

此选项可用于比较不同积分流程的结果。例如，通过比较 SNR 与 PSF Signal Weight 估计，你可以知道哪些图像归一化与加权准则在图像质量方面带来最佳结果。

FILE:
Noise evaluation algorithm. This option selects an algorithm for automatic estimation of the standard deviation of the noise in the integrated image, as well as for input images when noise estimates metadata is not available.

The multiresolution support (MRS) noise estimation routine implements the iterative algorithm described by Jean-Luc Starck and Fionn Murtagh in their paper Automatic Noise Estimation from the Multiresolution Support (Publications of the Royal Astronomical Society of the Pacific, vol. 110, pp. 193-199). In our implementation, the standard deviation of the noise is evaluated on the first four wavelet layers, assuming a Gaussian noise distribution. MRS is a remarkably accurate and robust algorithm and the default option for noise evaluation.

The iterative k-sigma clipping algorithm can be used as a last-resort option in cases where the MRS algorithm does not converge systematically. This can happen on images with no detectable small-scale noise, but should never happen with integrated images under normal working conditions.

The N* robust noise estimator extracts a subset of residual pixels by comparison with a large-scale model of the local background of the image, generated with the multiscale median transform (MMT). Since the MMT is remarkably efficient at isolating image structures, it can be used to detect pixels that cannot contribute to significant structures. N* is an accurate and robust, alternative estimator of the standard deviation of the noise that does not assume or require any particular statistical distribution in the analyzed data.
文件:
噪声评估算法。此选项选择一个算法，用于自动估计积分图像中的噪声标准差，以及在噪声估计元数据不可用时估计输入图像的噪声标准差。

多分辨率支撑（MRS）噪声估计例程实现了 Jean-Luc Starck 与 Fionn Murtagh 在其论文Automatic Noise Estimation from the Multiresolution Support（Publications of the Royal Astronomical Society of the Pacific, vol. 110, pp. 193-199）中描述的迭代算法。在我们的实现中，在假定高斯噪声分布的前提下，于前四个小波层上评估噪声标准差。MRS 是一种极为准确、稳健的算法，也是噪声评估的默认选项。

在 MRS 算法无法系统性收敛的情况下，可使用迭代 k-sigma 裁剪算法作为最后手段。这可能发生在没有可检测小尺度噪声的图像上，但在正常工作条件下的积分图像中绝不应该发生。

N* 稳健噪声估计器通过与用多尺度中值变换（MMT）生成的图像局部背景大尺度模型比较，提取一部分残差像素。由于 MMT 在分离图像结构方面极为高效，可用它检测无法构成显著结构的像素。N* 是一种准确且稳健的噪声标准差替代估计器，不假定也不要求所分析数据服从任何特定统计分布。

FILE:
Symbols directive.

The symbols directive allows you to define a list of one or more symbols directly from executed PixelMath expressions. When the symbols directive is present it overrides the current contents of the symbols process parameter, that is, the contents of the Symbols section will be ignored if this directive is present in the expression(s). For documentation on PixelMath symbols, their roles and initialization syntax, see the process documentation and the Symbol Definition section on this Expression Editor dialog.

Multiple symbol definitions can be specified as a comma (,) separated list. The symbols directive must end with an expression separator (;).

Directives must be specified before any executable expression and cannot be mixed with executable expressions. In practice this means that directives can only be included at the begining of a PixelMath set of expressions.
文件:
symbols 指令。

symbols 指令允许你直接通过已执行的 PixelMath 表达式定义一个或多个符号列表。当存在 symbols 指令时，它会覆盖 symbols 处理参数的当前内容，也就是说，只要表达式中含有该指令，“符号”区块的内容就会被忽略。关于 PixelMath 符号的说明、其作用及初始化语法，请参见处理过程文档以及本“表达式编辑器”对话框中的“符号定义”一节。

可以逗号（,）分隔列表的形式指定多个符号定义。symbols 指令必须以表达式分隔符（;）结尾。

指令必须写在任何可执行表达式之前，且不得与可执行表达式混用。实际上这意味着指令只能放在一组 PixelMath 表达式的开头。

FILE:
Pragma directive.

The pragma directive allows you to modify PixelMath process parameters directly from executed expressions. Each argument of a pragma directive overrides the current value of a working PixelMath parameter. The supported arguments are currently the following:

rescale
Enable the rescale result option.

no-rescale
Disable the rescale result option.

truncate
Enable the truncate result option.

no-truncate
Disable the truncate result option.
** Warning ** Platform stability is not guaranteed if out-of-range pixel sample values propagate after PixelMath execution.

64_bit
Enable the use 64-bit working images option.

no-64_bit
Disable the use 64-bit working images option.

single_thread
Enable the single threaded option.

no-single_thread
Disable the single threaded option.

optimize
Enable the code optimization option.

no-optimize
Disable the code optimization option.

cache
Enable the cache generated images option.

no-cache
Disable the cache generated images option.

single_expr
Enable the use a single RGB/K expression option.

no-single_expr
Disable the use a single RGB/K expression option.

new_image
Enable the create new image option.

no-new_image
Disable the create new image option.

alpha
Enable the alpha channel option.

no-alpha
Disable the alpha channel option.

Multiple arguments can be specified as a comma (,) separated list. The pragma directive must end with an expression separator (;).

Directives must be specified before any executable expression and cannot be mixed with executable expressions. In practice this means that directives can only be included at the begining of a PixelMath set of expressions.

FILE:
Active image.

The $A (or $active) metasymbol represents the active image in the current workspace, that is, the image in the main view that has the keyboard focus when the instance of PixelMath is executed.

$A can always be used, in both the view and global execution contexts. If there is no active image in the current workspace, a runtime error will occur if $A is used.
文件:
活动图像。

$A（或 $active）元符号代表当前工作区中的活动图像，即执行该 PixelMath 实例时主视图中拥有键盘焦点的图像。

在视图与全局两种执行上下文中，$A 都可以使用。若当前工作区没有活动图像，使用 $A 会引发运行时错误。

FILE:
Target mask image.

The $M (or $mask) metasymbol represents the mask image currently selected for the target image, when PixelMath is being executed in a view context.

$M is illegal when PixelMath is being executed as a global process, for the same reason $T is also illegal in this case: no target image exists for execution in the global context.
文件:
目标蒙版图像。

$M（或 $mask）元符号代表在视图上下文中执行 PixelMath 时，为目标图像当前选定的蒙版图像。

当 PixelMath 作为全局过程执行时，$M 是非法的；原因与 $T 在此情形下同样非法相同：全局上下文执行时不存在目标图像。

FILE:
Target image.

The $T (or $target) metasymbol represents the target image when PixelMath is being executed in a view context.

$T is illegal when PixelMath is executed as a global process, i.e. when a new image is being generated instead of replacing an existing one, since in these cases no target image exists.
文件:
目标图像。

$T（或 $target）元符号代表在视图上下文中执行 PixelMath 时的目标图像。

当 PixelMath 作为全局过程执行时（即生成新图像而非替换已有图像），$T 是非法的，因为这种情况下不存在目标图像。

FILE:
Global variable initialization.

The symbol will be declared as a global variable with the specified global operator and initial value.

The 'op' global operator specification can be one of '+' and '*'. For example, 'n=global(+)' will declare a global additive variable n with a default zero initial value.

Global variables can only play lvalue roles in expressions. In practice this means that they can only occur at the left hand of an assignment operator. For example, if a global variable n has been declared, then an expression such as 'x = $T + n' is illegal. Furthermore, global variables are always specialized for additive or multiplicative operations. For example, if n has been declared as additive with 'n=global(+)', then 'n *= $T' is illegal, but 'n -= $T < 0.01' is valid.

If no explicit initial value is specified, additive global variables are initialized to zero and multiplicative global variables are initialized to one. The final values of all global variables are reported on the process console after PixelMath execution.
文件:
全局变量初始化。

该符号将被声明为具有指定全局运算符与初始值的全局变量。

'op' 全局运算符可指定为 '+' 或 '*' 之一。例如 'n=global(+)' 将声明一个默认初值为零的全局加性变量 n。

全局变量在表达式中只能充当左值。实际上这意味着它们只能出现在赋值运算符的左侧。例如，若已声明全局变量 n，则形如 'x = $T + n' 的表达式是非法的。此外，全局变量总是被特化为加性或乘性运算。例如，若 n 被声明为加性（'n=global(+)'），则 'n *= $T' 非法，而 'n -= $T < 0.01' 合法。

若未指定显式初始值，加性全局变量初始化为零，乘性全局变量初始化为一。PixelMath 执行后，所有全局变量的最终值都会在处理控制台上报告。

FILE:
Line comment.

Comments are ignored by the PixelMath compiler. They can be used to document PixelMath source code, providing human-readable information on the purpose of a PixelMath expression and its implementation.

A line comment consists of the token '//' and all the subsequent text up to either the end of the current line, or to the end of the source code, whichever happens first.

行注释由记号 '//' 及其后直至当前行结尾或源代码结尾（以先到者为准）的全部文本组成。

FILE:
Block comment.

Comments are ignored by the PixelMath compiler. They can be used to document PixelMath source code, providing human-readable information on the purpose of a PixelMath expression and its implementation.

A block comment consists of the pair of tokens '/*' and '*/' and any text in between. Unlike line comments, block comments can span across multiple text lines.

块注释由 '/*' 与 '*/' 一对记号及其中间的任意文本组成。与行注释不同，块注释可以跨越多行文本。

FILE:
Arithmetic mean function:

  1. Arithmetic mean of a set of two or more arguments.
  2. Arithmetic mean of the specified image.

In the second form, the optional x0, y0, w, and h parameters define a rectangular region of interest (ROI). These parameters are, respectively, the left coordinate, the top coordinate, the width and the height of the ROI, all of them expressed in integer pixel units. If a ROI is specified, the arithmetic mean will be computed exclusively for pixel samples within the intersection between the ROI and the image bounds. If no ROI is specified, the arithmetic mean will be computed for the entire image.

Invariant subexpression: When the first argument is an image reference with optional scalar ROI coordinates (second form).

  1. ADEV of a set of two or more arguments.
  2. ADEV of the specified image.

In the second form, the optional x0, y0, w, and h parameters define a rectangular region of interest (ROI). These parameters are, respectively, the left coordinate, the top coordinate, the width and the height of the ROI, all of them expressed in integer pixel units. FILE:
Norm, or the sum of values:

  1. Norm of a set of two or more arguments.
  2. Norm of the pixel samples in the specified image.

In the second form, the optional x0, y0, w, and h parameters define a rectangular region of interest (ROI). These parameters are, respectively, the left coordinate, the top coordinate, the width and the height of the ROI, all of them expressed in integer pixel units. If a ROI is specified, the norm will be computed exclusively for pixel samples within the intersection between the ROI and the image bounds. If no ROI is specified, the norm will be computed for the entire image.

Invariant subexpression: When the first argument is an image reference with optional scalar ROI coordinates (second form).

FILE:

  1. The kth order statistic of a set of three or more scalar arguments.
  2. The kth order statistic of the specified image.

The order k is expected to be expressed in the [0,1] range, where 0 represents the first order statistic (or the minimum value of the sample) and 1 the last order statistic (or the maximum value of the sample). k=0.5 corresponds to the median value of the sample.

In the second form, the optional x0, y0, w, and h parameters define a rectangular region of interest (ROI). These parameters are, respectively, the left coordinate, the top coordinate, the width and the height of the ROI, all of them expressed in integer pixel units. If a ROI is specified, the order statistic will be computed exclusively for pixel samples within the intersection between the ROI and the image bounds. If no ROI is specified, the order statistic will be computed for the entire image.

Invariant subexpression: When the second argument is an image reference with optional scalar ROI coordinates (second form).

FILE:
Normal (Gaussian) random deviate with zero mean and unit standard deviation.

A typical application of this function to add normal distributed noise to the target image is:

$T + k*mdev( $T )*gauss()

where the median absolute deviation from the median (MAD), multiplied by an optional amplitude parameter k, defines the standard deviation of additive noise adaptively.

其中中位数绝对偏差（MAD）乘以一个可选的幅度参数 k，自适应地定义加性噪声的标准差。

FILE:
Right ascension equatorial coordinate calculated for the specified image at (x,y) image coordinates. The returned value is expressed in degrees and not constrained to a valid range of right ascensions.

This function is useful for interpolation schemes where discontinuities caused by zero crossings in right ascension, i.e. abrupt changes from 360 to 0 degrees, are not admissible numerically. Right ascensions returned by this function can be larger than 360 degrees or less than zero, ensuring smooth transitions.

This function requires a valid astrometric solution available in the specified image.

Note: Use of this function can lead to poor performance when executed on large images with spline-based astrometric solutions (for distortion correction) and slow machines with few processor cores.

See the family of krn_xxx() symbolic functions for the set of available local variance kernels.

A local variance map is a sensitive analysis tool to explore the distribution of pixel intensity variations at small scales. This allows for the implementation of subtle adaptive procedures with PixelMath. For example, the following expression:

iif( lvar( $T, 7, krn_gauss() ) < t
, medfilt( $T, 5, str_circular() )
, $T )

applies a median filter selectively to pixels where the local variance is below a prescribed threshold t, which depends on the target image and must be found experimentally. More sophisticated, adaptive noise filtering processes based on the same technique can be designed with iswitch() constructs.

Local variance maps are always generated as 64-bit floating point images. This ensures that no truncation or roundoff errors will degrade their ability to represent subtle intensity variations, which is especially important for linear images.

Preserve generated images before and after PixelMath execution. This option is useful to speed up calculations when PixelMath expressions using generators are being executed repeatedly (for example, on a preview to fine tune expressions by trial/error work). Note that this uses memory resources, which may become significant, especially after many executions of PixelMath expressions with varying generator function parameters.

If this option is disabled, existing generated images will be destroyed before and after PixelMath execution, so they'll have to be recalculated in successive executions of the same expressions.
文件:
在 PixelMath 执行前后保留生成的图像。当使用生成器的 PixelMath 表达式被反复执行时（例如在预览图上反复试错以微调表达式），此选项可加快计算。注意这会占用内存资源，在多次以不同生成器函数参数执行 PixelMath 表达式之后，内存占用可能相当可观。

若禁用此项，已有生成图像会在 PixelMath 执行前后被销毁，因此在反复执行同一表达式时需重新计算。

FILE:
When this option is selected, PixelMath expressions will be evaluated and their results will generate output pixels, either in a newly created image (if the create new image option is selected), or to replace the target image (if replace target image is selected). This is the normal PixelMath working mode.

If this option is disabled, PixelMath expressions will be evaluated but their results will be discarded. No output will be generated, and hence PixelMath will behave as a no-op process: the target image won't be modified when the process is executed in a view context, and no new image will be created as a result of global execution. This working mode is useful when PixelMath is being used exclusively for evaluation of global variables as a side-effect of expression evaluation.
文件:
选中此项时，PixelMath 表达式会被求值，并以其结果生成输出像素：若选中 create new image 选项则生成新图像，若选中 replace target image 则替换目标图像。这是 PixelMath 的常规工作模式。

若禁用此项，PixelMath 表达式仍会被求值，但结果会被丢弃，不会产生任何输出。因此 PixelMath 相当于一个空操作过程：在视图上下文中执行时目标图像不会被修改，全局执行时也不会创建新图像。当 PixelMath 仅用于在表达式求值过程中顺带计算全局变量时，此工作模式很有用。

When this option is selected, PixelMath will rescale the final resulting image to the specified output range (see the lower range and upper range parameters below).

If this option is disabled (default state), the final image will be truncated, if necessary, to fit in the normalized [0,1] range.

You can disable both rescaling and truncation by creating a PixelMath process icon and editing its instance source code. If you set both 'rescale' and 'truncate' instance properties to false, the resulting image will be left intact upon PixelMath execution termination.

Warning: Platform stability is not guaranteed if out-of-range pixel sample values propagate after process execution.

FILE: Enable this option to force PixelMath to use a single execution thread, irrespective of current global parallel execution settings. Single-threaded execution is necessary for some applications that are incompatible with multithreaded implementations. A good example is calculation of integral images. In an integral image, each pixel at coordinates {x,y} is the sum of all pixels at coordinates {i <= x, j <= y} in the source image. This task cannot be parallelized, and hence requires enabling this option to be implemented with PixelMath.
文件: 启用此选项可强制 PixelMath 使用单执行线程，忽略当前全局并行执行设置。对于某些与多线程实现不兼容的算法，单线程执行是必需的。一个典型例子是积分图像的计算。在积分图像中，坐标为 {x,y} 的每个像素等于源图像中所有坐标满足 {i <= x, j <= y} 的像素之和。该任务无法并行化，因此必须启用此选项才能用 PixelMath 实现。

If you select this option, the geometry, color space and data format of the output image can either be specified by this PixelMath instance (see the width, height, color space and sample format parameters below), or taken from the target image this PixelMath instance is executed on. In the former case, PixelMath can be executed in the global context because none of its parameters depend on an existing image. In the latter case, PixelMath can only be applied to an image.

When PixelMath is executed globally, the working image has all of its pixel samples initially set to zero.

FILE:
Defect map image

DefectMap uses a defect map image to find defective pixels. In a defect map, black (zero) pixels correspond to bad or defective pixels. Bad pixels will be replaced with new values computed from neighbor pixels.

When using convolution replacement operations (Gaussian, mean), non-zero pixel values represent the pixel weights that will be used for convolution. Morphological replacement operations (minimum, maximum, median) use binarized (0/1) map values.
文件:
缺陷图图像

DefectMap 使用缺陷图图像来查找缺陷像素。在缺陷图中，黑色（零）像素对应坏像素或有缺陷的像素。坏像素将被替换为依据相邻像素计算出的新值。

使用卷积替换运算（高斯、均值）时，非零像素值表示将用于卷积的像素权重。形态学替换运算（最小值、最大值、中值）使用二值化（0/1）映射值。

FILE:
Bad pixel replacement operation

Specify the convolution or morphological operation used to replace bad pixels with new pixels computed from neighbor values. Mean and Gaussian will be applied by convolution; minimum, maximum and median will be applied as morphological operators.
文件:
坏像素替换操作

指定用相邻像素值计算新像素来替换坏像素所使用的卷积或形态学运算。均值与高斯将通过卷积施加；最小值、最大值与中值将作为形态学算子施加。

FILE:
Structural element

Specify the shape of a structural element used to apply a convolution or morphological transformation for bad pixel replacement. The structural element defines which neighbor pixels will be used to compute replacement values.
文件:
结构元素

指定用于施加卷积或形态学变换以替换坏像素的结构元素形状。结构元素定义将使用哪些相邻像素来计算替换值。

Select the CFA pattern of the camera (such as a DSLR or OSC camera) used to acquire the calibration master and target frames.

The Auto option uses view properties that can be available in the master and target frame files. Under normal working conditions, these properties are either generated automatically by the RAW format support module and stored in XISF files, or available as FITS header keywords in the case of raw OSC frames.

For non-CFA data acquired with monochrome CCD or CMOS cameras, the Auto option is the correct selection because in these cases the process will detect no CFA pattern automatically.

For images acquired with X-Trans sensors this parameter is ignored and CFA patterns are always extracted from existing image properties.
文件:
选择用于采集校准 master 帧与目标帧的相机的 CFA 模式（例如单反或 OSC 相机）。

自动选项使用 master 帧与目标帧文件中可能存在的视图属性。正常条件下，这些属性要么由 RAW 格式支持模块自动生成并存储在 XISF 文件中，要么在原始 OSC 帧的情况下作为 FITS 头关键字存在。

对于用单色 CCD 或 CMOS 相机采集的非 CFA 数据，自动选项是正确选择，因为在这些情况下过程会自动检测不到任何 CFA 模式。

对于用 X-Trans 传感器采集的图像，此参数会被忽略，CFA 模式始终从已有图像属性中提取。

FILE:
Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In ImageCalibration, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats (target frames and master calibration frames) are read, while output hints modify the way output calibrated images are written.

For example, you can use the "raw cfa" input hints to force the RAW format to load pure raw CFA frames without applying any demosaicing, interpolation, white balance, or black point correction. Similarly, you can use the "up-bottom" input hint to load raw images from FITS files with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件:
格式提示允许你为特定过程使用的图像文件覆盖全局文件格式设置。在 ImageCalibration 中，输入提示改变某些特定格式输入图像（目标帧与 master 校准帧）的读取方式，输出提示则修改输出已校准图像的写入方式。

例如，你可以使用 "raw cfa" 输入提示强制 RAW 格式载入纯原始 CFA 帧，而不施加任何去马赛克、插值、白平衡或黑点校正。同理，你可以使用 "up-bottom" 输入提示从坐标原点位于左上角的 FITS 文件载入原始图像。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式支持若干输入和/或输出提示，你可以在提供格式提示访问的工具中按不同目的使用它们。

FILE:
This is the directory (or folder) where all output files will be written.

If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the calibration process will fail.
文件:
这是所有输出文件将被写入的目录（或文件夹）。

若此字段留空，输出文件将被写入与其对应目标文件相同的目录。此时请确保源目录可写，否则校准过程将失败。

FILE:
This parameter defines how to calculate and apply output pedestals.

Literal value allows you to specify a pedestal value in 16-bit data number units (DN) with the output pedestal parameter.

Automatic will apply an automatically calculated pedestal value to frames that have negative, zero or insignificant (to machine epsilon) minimum pixel values after calibration. Automatic pedestals can be used to ensure positivity of the calibrated image with minimal truncation.

See also the auto pedestal limit and output pedestal parameters for more information.
文件:
此参数定义如何计算并施加输出基座。

字面值允许你用输出基座参数以 16 位数据值单位（DN）指定基座值。

自动会为校准后最小像素值为负、为零或可忽略（至机器精度）的帧施加自动计算的基座值。自动基座可用于在最小截断的情况下确保已校准图像为正。

更多信息请另见自动基座限值与输出基座参数。

FILE:
If this option is selected, ImageCalibration will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.

Enable this option at your own risk.
文件:
若选中此选项，ImageCalibration 将覆盖与生成输出文件同名的现有文件。这可能很危险，因为被覆盖文件的原始内容将丢失。

启用此选项风险自负。

FILE:
Maximum fraction of negative or insignificant calibrated pixels allowed in automatic pedestal generation mode.

This parameter represents a fraction of the total image pixels in the [0,1] range. When the image has more than this fraction of negative or insignificant pixel values after calibration and the output pedestal mode is set to automatic, the process will generate an additive pedestal to ensure that no more than this fraction of negative or insignificant pixels will be present in the calibrated image.

The default value is 0.0001, which represents a 0.01% of the total pixels.
文件:
自动基座生成模式下允许的负值或可忽略已校准像素的最大占比。

此参数表示位于 [0,1] 范围内的总图像像素占比。当图像校准后负值或可忽略像素值超过此占比，且输出基座模式设为自动时，过程将生成加性基座，以确保已校准图像中出现的负值或可忽略像素不超过此占比。

默认值为 0.0001，即总像素的 0.01%。

FILE:
Compute standardized estimates of the signal present in target calibration frames.

Our current implementation uses PSF photometry to generate robust and accurate measures of total and mean flux from detected and fitted sources. These estimates, along with estimates of the standard deviation of the noise, can be used for image grading and weighting with the SubframeSelector and ImageIntegration processes.

The signal evaluation result will be stored as a set of custom, per-channel XISF properties and FITS header keywords that other processes and scripts can use for specialized image analysis purposes.

This option should always be enabled for calibration of deep-sky, non-CFA raw light frames. For CFA data, signal and noise evaluation should be performed by the Debayer process, and hence this option should be disabled in ImageCalibration
文件:
计算目标校准帧中信号的标准化估计。

我们当前的实现使用 PSF 测光，从检测到并拟合的源中生成稳健且准确的总光通量与平均光通量度量。这些估计以及噪声标准差估计可用于 SubframeSelector 与 ImageIntegration 过程的图像评级与加权。

信号评估结果将作为一组自定义的逐通道 XISF 属性与 FITS 头关键字存储，供其他过程与脚本用于专门的图像分析目的。

校准深空非 CFA 原始亮帧时应始终启用此选项。对于 CFA 数据，信号与噪声评估应由 Debayer 过程执行，因此在 ImageCalibration 中应禁用此选项

FILE:
The saturation threshold parameter can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image.

The relative saturation threshold option is disabled by default.
文件: 饱和阈值参数既可作为归一化 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素样本值施加，也可作为相对于被测图像最大像素样本值的值施加。

FILE:
Saturation threshold in the [0,1] range.

Detected stars with one or more pixels with values above this threshold will be excluded for signal evaluation. This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).

The default saturation threshold is 1.0. For signal evaluation, the implemented star detection and outlier rejection routines are normally able to avoid contamination from saturated sources, so the default value of this parameter should not be changed under normal conditions.
文件:
位于 [0,1] 范围的饱和阈值。

检测到的恒星若有一个或多个像素取值高于此阈值，将被排除在信号评估之外。此参数以 [0,1] 范围表示。它既可作为绝对像素样本值施加，也可作为相对于被测图像最大像素样本值的值施加（见相对饱和阈值参数）。

默认饱和阈值为 1.0。对于信号评估，所实现的恒星检测与离群值剔除例程通常能够避免饱和源的污染，因此正常条件下不应修改此参数的默认值。

FILE:
The maximum number of stars that can be measured to compute PSF flux estimates.

PSF photometry will be performed for no more than the specified number of stars. The subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.

The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for calibration of wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of signal estimation.
文件:
可测得用于计算 PSF 光通量估计的恒星最大数量。

PSF 测光执行的恒星数量不超过所指定数目。被测恒星的子集始终从检测到的恒星集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。

默认值给出 24K 颗恒星这一宽松限制。限制测光样本数可提升广域帧校准的性能，那里检测到的恒星数量可能非常大。不过，过度减少被测源集合会损害信号估计的准确性。

FILE:
Compute per-channel estimates of the standard deviation of the noise and noise scaling factors for each target image, using a multiscale algorithm (MRS noise estimator by default). Noise estimates will be stored as a set of custom XISF properties and FITS header keywords in the output files.

These estimates can be used later by several processes and scripts for specialized image analysis purposes, most notably by SubframeSelector and ImageIntegration for image grading and weighting.

This option should always be enabled for calibration of non-CFA raw light frames. For CFA data, signal and noise evaluation should be performed by the Debayer process, and hence this option should be disabled in ImageCalibration in such case.
文件:
使用多尺度算法（默认 MRS 噪声估计器）为每幅目标图像计算逐通道的噪声标准差估计与噪声缩放因子。噪声估计将作为一组自定义 XISF 属性与 FITS 头关键字存储在输出文件中。

这些估计随后可被若干过程与脚本用于专门的图像分析目的，最主要是被 SubframeSelector 与 ImageIntegration 用于图像评级与加权。

校准非 CFA 原始亮帧时应始终启用此选项。对于 CFA 数据，信号与噪声评估应由 Debayer 过程执行，因此这种情况下在 ImageCalibration 中应禁用此选项。

FILE:
Noise evaluation algorithm. This option selects an algorithm for automatic estimation of the standard deviation of the noise in the calibrated images.

The multiresolution support (MRS) noise estimation routine implements the iterative algorithm described by Jean-Luc Starck and Fionn Murtagh in their paper Automatic Noise Estimation from the Multiresolution Support (Publications of the Royal Astronomical Society of the Pacific, vol. 110, pp. 193-199). In our implementation, the standard deviation of the noise is evaluated on the first four wavelet layers, assuming a Gaussian noise distribution. MRS is a remarkably accurate and robust algorithm and the default option for noise evaluation.

The iterative k-sigma clipping algorithm can be used as a last-resort option in cases where the MRS algorithm does not converge systematically. This can happen on images with no detectable small-scale noise, but should never happen with uncalibrated data under normal working conditions.

The N* robust noise estimator extracts a subset of residual pixels by comparison with a large-scale model of the local background of the image, generated with the multiscale median transform (MMT). Since the MMT is remarkably efficient at isolating image structures, it can be used to detect pixels that cannot contribute to significant structures. N* is an accurate and robust, alternative estimator of the standard deviation of the noise that does not assume or require any particular statistical distribution in the analyzed data.
文件:
噪声评估算法。此选项选择一个算法，用于自动估计已校准图像中的噪声标准差。

多分辨率支撑（MRS）噪声估计例程实现了 Jean-Luc Starck 与 Fionn Murtagh 在其论文Automatic Noise Estimation from the Multiresolution Support（Publications of the Royal Astronomical Society of the Pacific, vol. 110, pp. 193-199）中描述的迭代算法。在我们的实现中，在假定高斯噪声分布的前提下，于前四个小波层上评估噪声标准差。MRS 是一种极为准确、稳健的算法，也是噪声评估的默认选项。

在 MRS 算法无法系统性收敛的情况下，可使用迭代 k-sigma 裁剪算法作为最后手段。这可能发生在没有可检测小尺度噪声的图像上，但在正常工作条件下的未校准数据中绝不应该发生。

N* 稳健噪声估计器通过与用多尺度中值变换（MMT）生成的图像局部背景大尺度模型比较，提取一部分残差像素。由于 MMT 在分离图像结构方面极为高效，可用它检测无法构成显著结构的像素。N* 是一种准确且稳健的噪声标准差替代估计器，不假定也不要求所分析数据服从任何特定统计分布。

FILE:
Custom FITS keyword to retrieve pedestal values in 16-bit DN.

This is the name of a FITS keyword that will be used to retrieve input pedestals, if the Custom FITS keyword option has been selected as pedestal mode.
文件:
用于以 16 位 DN 获取基座值的自定义 FITS 关键字。

当选择自定义 FITS 关键字选项作为基座模式时，此为将用于获取输入基座的 FITS 关键字名称。

FILE:
The pedestal mode option specifies how to retrieve a (usually small) quantity that is subtracted from input images as the very first calibration step. This quantity is known as pedestal, and must be expressed in the 16-bit unsigned integer range (from 0 to 65535). If present, a pedestal has been added by a previous calibration process to ensure positivity of the result. For example, you might have specified an output pedestal (see the corresponding parameter above) to enforce positivity of previously calibrated master bias, dark and flat frames.

Literal value lets you specify a pedestal value that will be subtracted from all target and master calibration frames. You usually don't need this option, except in very special cases.

Default FITS keyword is the default mode. When this mode is selected, ImageCalibration will retrieve pedestal values from 'PEDESTAL' FITS keywords, when they are present in the input images. Note that ImageCalibration writes PEDESTAL keywords to calibrated images when a nonzero output pedestal is specified.

Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword to retrieve pedestal values, when the specified keyword is present in the input images.
文件:
基座模式选项指定如何获取一个（通常很小的）量，它作为校准的第一个步骤从输入图像中减去。这个量称为基座，必须以 16 位无符号整数范围（0 到 65535）表示。若存在，基座是由此前的校准过程加入的，以确保结果为正。例如，你可能指定过输出基座（见上文对应参数）来强制此前已校准的 master bias、dark 与 flat 帧为正。

字面值让你指定一个将从所有目标帧与 master 校准帧中减去的基座值。除极特殊情形外，通常不需要此选项。

默认 FITS 关键字是默认模式。选择此模式时，ImageCalibration 将从 'PEDESTAL' FITS 关键字获取基座值，前提是输入图像中存在这些关键字。注意当指定了非零输出基座时，ImageCalibration 会向已校准图像写入 PEDESTAL 关键字。

自定义 FITS 关键字允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字名称以获取基座值，前提是输入图像中存在所指定的关键字。

FILE:
Select this option to apply dark frame optimization.

The dark frame optimization routine computes a dark scaling factor to minimize the noise induced by dark subtraction. Optimization is carried out separately for each target frame, including the master flat frame, if selected. Dark frame optimization has been implemented using robust linear minimization of variance.
文件:
选中此选项以施加暗帧优化。

暗帧优化例程计算一个暗缩放因子，以最小化暗减除所引入的噪声。优化对每个目标帧分别进行，包括（若选中）master flat 帧。暗帧优化使用方差的稳健线性最小化实现。

FILE:
Normalization reference image.

Local normalization functions will be calculated for each target image with respect to the reference image, which will be acquired either from an image view, or from an existing disk file.

Important: For execution in the global context (batch procedure), if the reference image refers to a disk file that will be part of an image integration task, it must also be included in the target images list. Otherwise no .xnml file and/or normalized image will be generated for the reference image.
文件:
归一化参考图像。

将针对参考图像为每幅目标图像计算局部归一化函数，参考图像可从图像视图获取，也可从已有磁盘文件获取。

重要：在全局上下文（批处理）中执行时，若参考图像指向将成为某次图像积分任务一部分的磁盘文件，它也必须包含在目标图像列表中。否则不会为参考图像生成 .xnml 文件和/或归一化图像。

FILE:
Compute only the offset component of the local normalization function, and set the scale component constant equal to one.

This option should be disabled under normal working conditions. It can be useful in special cases to limit local normalization to correction of additive gradients exclusively. However, without its multiplicative component the normalization function will be less accurate in general.
文件:
只计算局部归一化函数的偏移分量，并把尺度分量设为常数 1。

正常条件下应禁用此选项。特殊情况下可用于把局部归一化限制为仅改正加性梯度。不过，缺少乘性分量会使归一化函数总体上不够准确。

FILE:
This parameter defines when to apply the local normalization functions to generate normalized images. This includes newly created image files for global execution, as well as modifying the target image for view execution.

This option is set to view execution only by default because local normalization functions, stored in .xnml files, can be used by the ImageIntegration and DrizzleIntegration processes for normalization in the pixel rejection and/or integration output tasks. This means that the normalization functions can be applied internally by these processes, so writing normalized images to disk files is generally not necessary. In addition, the ImageIntegration and DrizzleIntegration processes apply normalization functions internally without any truncation or rescaling of the data, so the entire data set is always integrated without any loss or artificial alteration when local normalization files are used.

For view execution, however, inspecting the transformed image is often necessary for testing purposes. Generation of normalized image files during batch execution can also be useful in very difficult cases, for example when the data set includes strong and large artifacts, such as big plane trails. In these cases you may want to inspect locally normalized images manually with analysis tools such as Blink. Normalized images may also be necessary for applications of local normalization different from integration of astronomical images.
文件:
此参数定义何时施加局部归一化函数以生成归一化图像。这包括全局执行时新建图像文件，以及视图执行时修改目标图像。

此选项默认设为仅在视图执行，因为存储在 .xnml 文件中的局部归一化函数可被 ImageIntegration 与 DrizzleIntegration 过程用于像素剔除和/或积分输出任务中的归一化。这意味着归一化函数可由这些过程在内部施加，因此通常不必把归一化图像写入磁盘文件。此外，ImageIntegration 与 DrizzleIntegration 过程在内部施加归一化函数时不对数据做任何截断或重缩放，因此使用局部归一化文件时整个数据集始终被完整积分，无任何损失或人为改动。

不过在视图执行时，检查变换后的图像对测试往往很有必要。在批处理执行期间生成归一化图像文件在非常困难的情形下也有用，例如数据集包含强烈而巨大的伪影（如大型飞机轨迹）时。这些情况下你可能想用 Blink 等分析工具手动检查局部归一化后的图像。对于不同于天文图像积分的局部归一化应用，归一化图像也可能是必需的。

FILE:
High clipping pixel sample value in the [0,1] range.

All pixels with values greater than or equal to the value of this parameter will be replaced with statistically plausible estimates, computed from nearby image regions.

Rejection of saturated pixels is necessary to prevent generation of large-scale artifacts around large saturated structures, such as bright stars, in local background models. Under normal conditions you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter (0.85). Decrease it in the unlikely case that you detect dark artifacts around large saturated objects.
文件:
位于 [0,1] 范围的高裁剪像素样本值。

所有取值大于或等于此参数值的像素，都将被替换为依据附近图像区域计算出的统计上合理的估计值。

剔除饱和像素是必要的，可防止在局部背景模型中于大型饱和结构（如亮星）周围生成大尺度伪影。正常条件下你不需要修改此参数的默认值（0.85）。若万一检测到大型饱和对象周围出现暗伪影，请减小该值。

FILE:
Compute global location parameters to be applied after local normalization.

For some applications it may be desirable matching the global statistical parameter of location (or central tendency) of the reference image after local normalization. In such cases this option can be enabled to compute the required global normalization parameters, which will be included in generated .xnml files and applied to output normalized images, as appropriate.
文件:
计算将在局部归一化之后施加的全局位置参数。

某些应用可能需要在局部归一化后匹配参考图像的全局位置（或集中趋势）统计参数。此类情况下可启用此选项来计算所需的全局归一化参数，它们将被包含在生成的 .xnml 文件中，并视情况施加到输出归一化图像上。

FILE:
Generate floating point images with the computed local background models for the reference and target images. This option is only applicable to execution on views, and is always ignored when LocalNormalization is executed in the global context (that is, as a batch procedure).

Analysis of local backgrounds can be important for testing purposes, especially in difficult cases, for example to know how complex gradients are being evaluated, or to judge the quality of outlier rejection.
文件:
生成包含参考图像与目标图像所计算局部背景模型的浮点图像。此选项仅适用于在视图上执行，在全局上下文（即批处理）中执行 LocalNormalization 时始终被忽略。

局部分析对测试很有价值，尤其在困难情形下，例如了解复杂梯度是如何被评估的，或判断离群值剔除的质量。

FILE:
The implemented local normalization algorithms are sensitive to differences between the reference and target images caused by spurious image features, such as hot pixels, plane and satellite trails, cosmic rays, etc.

Under normal working conditions, this option should be enabled to detect and reject outlier image structures prior to calculation of local normalization functions.
文件:
所实现的局部归一化算法对参考图像与目标图像之间由虚假图像特征（如热像素、飞机与卫星轨迹、宇宙线等）造成的差异很敏感。

正常条件下应启用此选项，以便在计算局部归一化函数之前检测并剔除离群图像结构。

FILE:
Size of the hot pixel removal filter.

This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied for robust outlier rejection. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels, cold pixels, and similar small-scale outlier image structures that can contaminate the local normalization functions, degrading their accuracy, or even introducing artifacts in extreme cases.

To disable hot pixel removal (not recommended), set this parameter to zero. The default value is two pixels.
文件:
热像素去除滤波器的大小。

这是为稳健离群值剔除而施加的中值滤波器的半径（像素）。中值滤波器去除热像素、冷像素及类似小尺度离群图像结构极为高效，这些结构会污染局部归一化函数、降低其准确性，极端情况下甚至引入伪影。

要禁用热像素去除（不推荐），请把此参数设为零。默认值为两个像素。

FILE:
Compute first order local scale corrections.

If this option is enabled, LocalNormalization will model local scale variations, i.e. multiplicative gradients that cannot be corrected with a single global scale factor.

Warning: The implementation of this feature is still experimental.
文件:
计算一阶局部尺度改正。

若启用此选项，LocalNormalization 将对局部尺度变化建模，即无法用单一全局缩放因子改正的乘性梯度。

警告：此功能的实现仍属实验性质。

FILE:
Generate floating point images with the computed local scale correction models for the normalization function. These model images are rescaled linearly to the [0,1] range.

This option is only applicable to execution on views, and is always ignored when LocalNormalization is executed in the global context (that is, as a batch procedure).
文件:
生成包含为归一化函数计算的局部尺度改正模型的浮点图像。这些模型图像会被线性重缩放到 [0,1] 范围。

此选项仅适用于在视图上执行，在全局上下文（即批处理）中执行 LocalNormalization 时始终被忽略。

FILE:
Saturation threshold in the [0,1] range.

Detected stars with one or more pixels with values above this threshold will be excluded for relative scale evaluation. Similarly, when the multiscale analysis method of scale evaluation is selected, significant structure pixels above this value will also be excluded.

This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).

The default saturation threshold is 0.75. For relative scale evaluation this parameter is crucial in order to prevent contamination of the statistical sample of flux ratios by sources with saturated or nonlinear data. Changing the default value should not be necessary under normal conditions.
文件:
位于 [0,1] 范围的饱和阈值。

检测到的恒星若有一个或多个像素取值高于此阈值，将被排除在相对尺度评估之外。同理，当选择多尺度分析的尺度评估方法时，高于此值的重要结构像素也会被排除。

此参数以 [0,1] 范围表示。它既可作为归一化 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素样本值施加，也可作为相对于被测图像最大像素样本值的值施加（见相对饱和阈值参数）。

默认饱和阈值为 0.75。对于相对尺度评估，此参数至关重要，可防止饱和或非线性数据的源污染光通量比的统计样本。正常条件下不需要修改默认值。

FILE:
Perform outlier rejection for the normalization reference image.

If this option is enabled, the target image (either the target view or the first target file available) will be used to perform rejection of outlier pixels on the reference image. This is only necessary when the reference image can contain relatively large outlier structures, such as big plane trails.

This option should normally be disabled when the normalization reference image is of good quality and does not have significant outliers.
文件:
对归一化参考图像执行离群值剔除。

若启用此选项，将使用目标图像（目标视图或第一个可用目标文件）对参考图像执行离群像素剔除。仅当参考图像可能包含相对较大的离群结构（如大型飞机轨迹）时才需要这样做。

当归一化参考图像质量良好且没有显著离群值时，通常应禁用此选项。

FILE:
Generate unsigned 8-bit images where nonzero pixel samples correspond to rejected samples in the reference and target images. This option is only applicable to execution on views, and is always ignored when LocalNormalization is executed in the global context (that is, as a batch procedure).

Rejection maps are useful for testing purposes, especially in very difficult cases where the images have large outliers such as plane trails.
文件:
生成无符号 8 位图像，其中非零像素样本对应参考图像与目标图像中被剔除的样本。此选项仅适用于在视图上执行，在全局上下文（即批处理）中执行 LocalNormalization 时始终被忽略。

剔除图对测试很有用，尤其是在图像存在大型离群值（如飞机轨迹）的非常困难情形下。

FILE:
In this version of the LocalNormalization process we have implemented two different methods for evaluation of the global relative scale of the reference image with respect to each normalization target image: PSF flux evaluation and multiscale analysis.

The PSF flux evaluation method detects stars in the images and fits a point spread function model to each detected source. The fitted PSF parameters are then used to guide evaluation of the total flux of each source, and the fluxes of matched pairs of stars in both images are used to compute a robust and precise scale factor. This method is usually the best choice for normalization of deep-sky astronomical images where stars can be detected efficiently.

The multiscale analysis method uses wavelet transforms and morphological operations to isolate significant image structures. The pixels gathered on the intersection between significant structures of the reference and target images are then evaluated statistically to estimate the scale factor.
文件:
在此版本的 LocalNormalization 过程中，我们实现了两种不同方法来评估参考图像相对于各归一化目标图像的全局相对尺度：PSF 光通量评估与多尺度分析。

PSF 光通量评估方法在图像中检测恒星，并为每个检测到的源拟合点扩散函数模型。然后用拟合出的 PSF 参数来引导评估每个源的总光通量，并用两幅图像中成对恒星的比光通量计算稳健且精确的缩放因子。对于能高效检测恒星的深空天文图像，此方法通常是归一化的最佳选择。

多尺度分析方法使用小波变换与形态学运算来分离显著图像结构。然后在参考图像与目标图像的显著结构交集处收集的像素上进行统计评估，以估计缩放因子。

FILE:
The maximum number of stars that can be measured to compute mean scale estimates.

PSF photometry will be performed for no more than the specified number of stars. The subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.

The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for normalization of wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of scale evaluation.
文件:
可测得用于计算平均尺度估计的恒星最大数量。

PSF 测光执行的恒星数量不超过所指定数目。被测恒星的子集始终从检测到的恒星集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。

默认值给出 24K 颗恒星这一宽松限制。限制测光样本数可提升广域帧归一化的性能，那里检测到的恒星数量可能非常大。不过，过度减少被测源集合会损害尺度评估的准确性。

FILE:
Limit for the modified Chauvenet rejection criterion.

A modified Robust Chauvenet Rejection (RCR) routine is used internally by this implementation for rejection of outlier relative scale samples. The larger the value of this parameter, the more samples will be rejected by the RCR algorithm.

The original Chauvenet rejection criterion is N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5, where N is the number of measurements and P() represents the probability of x being more than z standard deviations from the mean. This parameter modifies the rejection criterion by replacing 0.5 with an arbitrary limit in the [0,1] range, in order to make the algorithm controllable. The default rejection limit is 0.3.
文件:
修改后 Chauvenet 剔除准则的限值。

本实现内部使用一种修改版的稳健 Chauvenet 剔除（RCR）例程来剔除离群相对尺度样本。此参数值越大，RCR 算法剔除的样本越多。

原始 Chauvenet 剔除准则为 N*P(x > |z|) < 0.5，其中 N 为测量次数，P() 表示 x 偏离均值超过 z 个标准差的概率。此参数通过把 0.5 替换为 [0,1] 范围内的任意限值来修改剔除准则，以使算法可控。默认剔除限值为 0.3。

FILE:
Star detector: Size of the hot pixel removal filter.

This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels will be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can prevent a valid signal evaluation.

To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件:
恒星检测器：热像素去除滤波器的大小。

这是恒星检测器在结构检测阶段之前施加的中值滤波器的半径（像素）。中值滤波器去除热像素极为高效。热像素会被识别为假恒星，若大量存在会妨碍有效的信号评估。

要禁用热像素去除，请把此参数设为零。

FILE:
Minimum signal-to-noise ratio of a detectable star.

Given a source with estimated brightness s, local background b and local background dispersion n, SNR is evaluated as (s – b)/n. Stars with measured SNR below the value of this parameter won't be used for relative scale evaluation.

This parameter allows limiting star detection to a subset of the brightest sources in the image adaptively. By requiring relatively high SNR levels in the evaluated sources, the accuracy and robustness of the scale evaluation process can be largely improved. The default value is 40, which is quite appropriate in most cases.
文件:
可检测恒星的最低信噪比。

对估计亮度为 s、局部背景为 b、局部背景离散度为 n 的源，SNR 按 (s – b)/n 评估。测得 SNR 低于此参数值的恒星不会用于相对尺度评估。

此参数允许自适应地把恒星检测限制在图像中最亮源的一个子集。通过在所评估的源中要求较高的 SNR 水平，可大幅改善尺度评估过程的准确性与稳健性。默认值为 40，在大多数情况下相当合适。
