If this option is selected, LocalNormalization will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.

Enable this option at your own risk.
文件:
若选中此选项，LocalNormalization 将覆盖与生成输出文件同名的现有文件。这可能很危险，因为被覆盖文件的原始内容将丢失。

启用此选项风险自负。

FILE:
Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In LocalNormalization, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats (reference and target image files) are loaded, while output hints modify the way output normalized image files are written.

For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "up-bottom" input hint to load input images from FITS files with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件:
格式提示允许你为特定过程使用的图像文件覆盖全局文件格式设置。在 LocalNormalization 中，输入提示改变某些特定格式输入图像（参考图像与目标图像文件）的载入方式，输出提示则修改输出归一化图像文件的写入方式。

例如，你可以使用 "lower-range" 与 "upper-range" 输入提示载入由其他不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的应用生成的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。同理，你可以指定 "up-bottom" 输入提示，从坐标原点位于左上角的 FITS 文件载入输入图像。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式支持若干输入和/或输出提示，你可以在提供格式提示访问的工具中按不同目的使用它们。

FILE:
This is the directory (or folder) where all output files will be written. This includes .xnml data files and, if the corresponding option has been enabled, normalized image files.

If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the normalization process will fail.
文件:
这是所有输出文件将被写入的目录（或文件夹）。这包括 .xnml 数据文件，以及在启用相应选项时的归一化图像文件。

若此字段留空，输出文件将被写入与其对应目标文件相同的目录。此时请确保源目录可写，否则归一化过程将失败。

FILE:
Growing factor for expansion/contraction of the PSF flux measurement region for each source, in units of the Full Width at Tenth Maximum (FWTM).

A value of 1.0 means that flux will be measured exclusively from pixels within the elliptical region defined at one tenth of the fitted PSF maximum. Increasing this parameter can inprove accuracy of PSF flux measurements for undersampled images, where PSF fitting uncertainty is relatively large. Decreasing it can be beneficial in some cases working with very noisy data to restrict flux evaluation to star cores. The default value is 1.75.
文件:
用于扩张/收缩每个源的 PSF 光通量测量区域的增长因子，以十分之一最大全宽（FWTM）为单位。

值 1.0 意味着仅从在拟合 PSF 最大值十分之一处所定义的椭圆区域内的像素测量光通量。增大此参数可提高采样不足图像中 PSF 光通量测量的准确性，那里 PSF 拟合不确定性相对较大。减小它有时有利于在噪声很大的数据上把光通量评估限制在星核区域内。默认值为 1.75。

FILE:
If this parameter is disabled, multiple sources too close to be separated as individual structures, such as double and multiple stars, won't be detected for signal evaluation.

If this parameter is enabled, non-separable multiple sources will be freely detectable as single objects.

This parameter is disabled by default. Under normal conditions, it should always be turned off for the flux calibration task since sources with several local maxima pose difficulties in determining accurate star positions and, more importantly, tend to degrade the quality of PSF photometry.
文件:
若禁用此参数，靠得太近而无法作为独立结构分离的多个源（如双星与聚星）将不会被检测用于信号评估。

若启用此参数，不可分离的多个源可以作为单个对象自由检测。

此参数默认禁用。正常条件下应始终为光通量校准任务关闭它，因为具有多个局部极大值的源会给确定准确星位带来困难，更重要的是往往会降低 PSF 测光的质量。

FILE:
DynamicAlignment cannot select a target image automatically because there are more than two images open.

Make sure the DynamicAlignment interface is open, then select the source and target alignment images manually by clicking on them. With both images selected, you'll be able to launch and edit DynamicAlignment instances.
文件:
由于已打开两幅以上图像，DynamicAlignment 无法自动选择目标图像。

请确保 DynamicAlignment 界面已打开，然后通过点击手动选择源与目标对齐图像。两幅图像都选定后，你就能启动并编辑 DynamicAlignment 实例。

FILE:
DynamicAlignment was unable to select a source image automatically.

Make sure the DynamicAlignment interface is open, then select the source and target alignment images manually by clicking on them. With both images selected, you'll be able to launch and edit DynamicAlignment instances.
文件:
DynamicAlignment 无法自动选择源图像。

请确保 DynamicAlignment 界面已打开，然后通过点击手动选择源与目标对齐图像。两幅图像都选定后，你就能启动并编辑 DynamicAlignment 实例。

FILE:
Registration reference image.

A copy of the target image will be transformed (translated, scaled, rotated, warped and distorted), as necessary to achieve pixel-by-pixel alignment with respect to the source image. Note that neither source nor target images will be modified in any way by DynamicAlignment.
文件:
配准参考图像。

目标图像的一份副本将被变换（平移、缩放、旋转、扭曲与畸变），以按需实现相对于源图像的逐像素对齐。注意 DynamicAlignment 不会以任何方式修改源图像或目标图像。

FILE:
Initial search radius, source image.

This parameter determines the size in pixels of the initial search box used to detect valid alignment references on the source image. Increase it to favor detection of larger structures. Decrease to facilitate finding relatively small features; for example to deal with dense star fields.
文件:
初始搜索半径，源图像。

此参数确定用于在源图像上检测有效对齐参考的初始搜索框的像素尺寸。增大它以利于检测较大结构；减小它以便于找到相对较小的特征，例如处理密集星场时。

FILE:
Initial search radius, target image.

This parameter determines the size in pixels of the initial search box used to detect valid alignment references on the target image. Increase it to favor detection of larger structures. Decrease to facilitate finding relatively small features; for example to deal with dense star fields.
文件:
初始搜索半径，目标图像。

此参数确定用于在目标图像上检测有效对齐参考的初始搜索框的像素尺寸。增大它以利于检测较大结构；减小它以便于找到相对较小的特征，例如处理密集星场时。

FILE:
Registration target image.

A copy of the target image will be transformed (translated, scaled, rotated, warped and distorted), as necessary to achieve pixel-by-pixel alignment with respect to the source image. Note that neither source nor target images will be modified in any way by DynamicAlignment.
文件:
配准目标图像。

目标图像的一份副本将被变换（平移、缩放、旋转、扭曲与畸变），以按需实现相对于源图像的逐像素对齐。注意 DynamicAlignment 不会以任何方式修改源图像或目标图像。

FILE:
Identifier of the registered image.

The result of DynamicAlignment execution is a newly created, registered image; here you can specify a valid view identifier that will be assigned to its main view. If this parameter is left blank, DynamicAlignment will automatically assign an identifier consisting of the target image's identifier plus a predefined suffix (by default, the appended suffix is _registered).
文件:
已配准图像的标识符。

DynamicAlignment 执行的结果是一幅新建的已配准图像；此处你可以指定将赋给其主视图的有效视图标识符。若此参数留空，DynamicAlignment 会自动分配一个由目标图像标识符加预定义后缀构成的标识符（默认追加后缀为 _registered）。

FILE:
Invert the current alignment reference.

Normal (noninverted) DA references look for bright stars over a dark background. An inverted reference behaves just the opposite way: dark star over a bright background. By inverting references you can select arbitrary image structures, not only stars, as alignment features. For example, you can select dark alignment features on lunar and planetary images using this option.
文件:
反转当前对齐参考。

常规（非反转）的 DA 参考在暗背景上寻找亮星。反转参考则正好相反：亮背景上的暗星。通过反转参考，你可以选择任意图像结构（不仅限恒星）作为对齐特征。例如，用此选项可以在月球与行星图像上选择暗的对齐特征。

FILE:
Source star position, X-axis.

This is the horizontal position of the computed star barycenter for the currently selected alignment reference in the source image.
文件:
源恒星位置，X 轴。

这是源图像中当前选中对齐参考所计算星点质心的水平位置。

FILE:
Source star radius.

Half-size of the currently selected alignment reference in the source image. This value is computed automatically by DynamicAlignment's star detection/modeling algorithm.
文件:
源恒星半径。

源图像中当前选中对齐参考的半尺寸。此值由 DynamicAlignment 的恒星检测/建模算法自动计算。

FILE:
Error in the last predicted target position, X-axis.

Difference in pixels between the horizontal coordinates of the computed and predicted star barycenter in the target image. When two or more alignment references are defined, DynamicAlignment predicts target star positions for each newly selected star. Coordinate prediction is performed building an image registration model on the fly, based on all existing alignment references except the new one. You can use prediction errors to evaluate the quality of the image registration model being defined.

To force a new prediction of coordinates for any existing reference, just select and move it slightly with the mouse. In this way the alignment reference will be recalculated, along with its predicted coordinates.
文件:
最后一次预测目标位置的误差，X 轴。

目标图像中计算得到的与预测的星点质心水平坐标之间的差（像素）。当定义了两个或更多对齐参考时，DynamicAlignment 会为每个新选定的恒星预测目标位置。坐标预测基于除新参考之外的所有已有对齐参考即时建立图像配准模型来完成。你可以用预测误差来评估正在定义的图像配准模型的质量。

要强制为任何已有参考重新预测坐标，只需选中它并用鼠标稍微移动。这样对齐参考将连同其预测坐标一起被重新计算。

FILE:
Source star position, Y-axis.

This is the vertical position of the computed star barycenter for the currently selected alignment reference in the source image.
文件:
源恒星位置，Y 轴。

这是源图像中当前选中对齐参考所计算星点质心的垂直位置。

FILE:
Differential star position (target-source), Y-axis.

This is the difference in pixels between the vertical coordinates of the target and source positions for the current reference. It measures the vertical displacement of the target image with respect to the source image for the current alignment reference.
文件:
恒星的差分位置（目标-源），Y 轴。

这是当前参考的目标位置与源位置垂直坐标之间的差（像素）。它衡量在当前对齐参考下目标图像相对于源图像的垂直位移。

FILE:
Differential star position (target-source), X-axis.

This is the difference in pixels between the horizontal coordinates of the target and source positions for the current reference. It measures the horizontal displacement of the target image with respect to the source image for the current alignment reference.
文件:
恒星的差分位置（目标-源），X 轴。

这是当前参考的目标位置与源位置水平坐标之间的差（像素）。它衡量在当前对齐参考下目标图像相对于源图像的水平位移。

FILE:
Error in the last predicted target position, Y-axis.

Difference in pixels between the vertical coordinates of the computed and predicted star barycenter in the target image. When two or more alignment references are defined, DynamicAlignment predicts target star positions for each newly selected star. Coordinate prediction is performed building an image registration model on the fly, based on all existing alignment references except the new one. You can use prediction errors to evaluate the quality of the image registration model being defined.

To force a new prediction of coordinates for any existing reference, just select and move it slightly with the mouse. In this way the alignment reference will be recalculated, including its predicted coordinates.
文件:
最后一次预测目标位置的误差，Y 轴。

目标图像中计算得到的与预测的星点质心垂直坐标之间的差（像素）。当定义了两个或更多对齐参考时，DynamicAlignment 会为每个新选定的恒星预测目标位置。坐标预测基于除新参考之外的所有已有对齐参考即时建立图像配准模型来完成。你可以用预测误差来评估正在定义的图像配准模型的质量。

要强制为任何已有参考重新预测坐标，只需选中它并用鼠标稍微移动。这样对齐参考将被重新计算，包括其预测坐标。

FILE:
Target star radius.

Half-size of the currently selected alignment reference in the target image. This value is computed automatically by DynamicAlignment's star detection/modeling algorithm.
文件:
目标恒星半径。

目标图像中当前选中对齐参考的半尺寸。此值由 DynamicAlignment 的恒星检测/建模算法自动计算。

FILE:
Automatically search alignment features.

When this option is enabled, DynamicAlignment finds valid alignment image features automatically when new alignment references are created (e.g., by clicking with the mouse), or when existing references are moved. (e.g., by clicking a reference and dragging it). This is the default mode, which is intended to find stars and similar small features automatically.

With this option disabled, you have the freedom to place alignment references at arbitrary locations on the source and target images. Simply place an alignment reference and move it manually where you want to set an alignment point.
文件:
自动搜索对齐特征。

启用此选项时，DynamicAlignment 会在创建新的对齐参考（例如用鼠标点击）或移动已有参考（例如点击并拖动参考）时自动寻找有效的对齐图像特征。这是默认模式，旨在自动寻找恒星及类似的小特征。

禁用此选项时，你可以自由地把对齐参考置于源图像与目标图像的任意位置。只需放置一个对齐参考，并手动把它移到你想设置对齐点的位置。

FILE:
Threshold value for rejection of background pixels.

This is a limiting value, expressed in sigma units, below which image pixels will be considered as part of the sky background. For each selected alignment reference, DynamicAlignment calculates the dispersion—also known as sigma—of the set of pixels inside the reference search box (see the search radii parameters above). All pixels whose values are smaller than the computed sigma are considered as belonging to the sky background, and hence are rejected to gather pixels belonging to the reference star.

When the alignment reference is inverted (see the reference inversion parameter), background pixels are those above the computed sigma.
文件:
用于剔除背景像素的阈值。

这是一个限值，以 sigma 为单位，低于它的图像像素将被视为天空背景的一部分。对每个选定的对齐参考，DynamicAlignment 会计算参考搜索框内（见上方搜索半径参数）像素集合的离散度，也称sigma。所有取值小于所计算 sigma 的像素被视为属于天空背景，因此被排除，以便只收集属于参考恒星的像素。

当对齐参考被反转时（见参考反转参数），背景像素是高于所计算 sigma 的像素。

FILE:
Local path of a distortion model file.

A distortion model file is a sequence of {x,y,dx,dy} nodes in standard CSV format. Each node defines a local distortion vector, where {x,y} are the image coordinates of the vector's origin, and {dx,dy} are the corresponding distortion components in pixels (e.g., if dx=dy=0, no distortion exists at x,y coordinates).

If defined, the distortion model will be applied to the coordinates of all detected stars prior to star matching. This allows for accurate registration of images subject to differential geometrical distortions, as happens with dithered wide field images and mosaics.

When a distortion model is used, the registration model will always use thin plate splines, irrespective of the registration model parameter.
文件:
畸变模型文件的本地路径。

畸变模型文件是按标准 CSV 格式排列的 {x,y,dx,dy} 节点序列。每个节点定义一个局部畸变向量，其中 {x,y} 是该向量原点的图像坐标，{dx,dy} 是对应的畸变分量（像素，例如若 dx=dy=0 则 x,y 坐标处无畸变）。

若已定义，畸变模型将在星点匹配之前施加到所有检测到的恒星坐标上。这可对受差分几何畸变影响的图像实现准确配准，例如抖动广域图像与马赛克。

当使用畸变模型时，配准模型将始终使用薄板样条，无论配准模型参数如何设置。

FILE:
Registration reference image.

Registered images will be transformed (translated, scaled and rotated) to align them with respect to the reference image. The reference image will not be modified during the registration process.
文件:
配准参考图像。

已配准图像将被变换（平移、缩放与旋转），以相对于参考图像对齐。参考图像在配准过程中不会被修改。

FILE:
The maximum number of control points allowed for the generation of surface splines using DDM-RBF algorithms.

When a DDM-RBF is selected, this parameter allows to specify the maximum number of control points (or reference stars) that will be used (after surface simplification) to generate the 2-D interpolating/approximating surface splines that will be used to model coordinate transformations for image registration. For DDM-RBF types, this parameter can be specified in the range from 1000 to 25000 control points. The default value is 4000 points, usually sufficient for most practical applications. Increase this parameter to achieve more accuracy at the expense of more computational work. DDM-RBF surface spline generation has O(n^2) time complexity.

For standard RBF types, which require O(n^3) time for spline construction, this parameter is ignored and a maximum of 2100 control points is always imposed.

This parameter is not used with the recursive surface splines registration model, which uses all star pair matches after outlier rejection.
文件:
使用 DDM-RBF 算法生成曲面样条时允许的控制点最大数量。

选择 DDM-RBF 时，此参数允许指定（曲面简化后）将用于生成二维插值/逼近曲面样条的控制点（或参考恒星）最大数量，这些样条将用于建模图像配准的坐标变换。对 DDM-RBF 类型，此参数可在 1000 到 25000 个控制点范围内指定。默认值 4000 点，对大多数实际应用通常足够。增大此参数可获得更高精度，代价是更多计算量。DDM-RBF 曲面样条生成的时间复杂度为 O(n^2)。

对于需要 O(n^3) 时间构造样条的标准 RBF 类型，此参数会被忽略，且始终强制最多 2100 个控制点。

此参数不用于递归曲面样条配准模型，后者在离群值剔除后使用所有星对匹配。

FILE:
Derivative order of continuity of variable-order two-dimensional surface splines.

Second-order polyharmonic radial basis functions, also known as thin plate splines, allow for generating extremely adaptable numerical models for images affected by strong field distortions. However, in cases of extremely complex arbitrary distortions, higher-order functions can be necessary to model them accurately.

When a variable-order polyharmonic RBF is selected, the function order can be selected from 2 to 6. High-order surface splines compute interpolation/regularization functions that are continuously differentiable up to the specified order and, hence, can more accurately model complex distortions. However, high-order splines, especially of orders above 4, are numerically more unstable and can lead to errors caused by ill-conditioned linear systems.

The recommended options are:

  • DDM thin plate splines (implicitly of second order) for distortion correction under normal conditions. This is the default option.
  • 3rd or 4th order DDM variable-order polyharmonic RBFs for correction of complex distortions with maximum accuracy.

With the recursive surface splines registration model, this parameter is the order of the polyharmonic splines generated for all regions of the image. The default order 2 generates thin plate splines.
文件:
变阶二维曲面样条的连续性导数阶数。

二阶多调和径向基函数，也称为薄板样条，可为受强视场畸变影响的图像生成极具适应性的数值模型。不过，对于极其复杂的任意畸变，可能需要更高阶函数才能准确建模。

选择变阶多调和 RBF 时，函数阶数可在 2 到 6 之间选择。高阶曲面样条计算出的插值/正则化函数可连续微分至指定阶，因此能更准确地建模复杂畸变。不过高阶样条（尤其 4 阶以上）在数值上更不稳定，可能因线性系统病态而导致错误。

推荐的选项是：

对递归曲面样条配准模型，此参数是为图像所有区域生成的多调和样条的阶数。默认阶数 2 生成薄板样条。

FILE:
Working mode.

Batch image registration tasks (i.e., automatic registration of a set of disk files) can only work in the register/match and transformation matrices modes.

Structure Detection, Structure Map, Detected Stars, Putative Star Matches and Matched Stars are StarAlignment's control modes. In these modes, StarAlignment does not perform an actual image registration task; instead, it generates auxiliary images that can be used to evaluate the suitability and performance of a set of StarAlignment parameters.

In Transformation Matrices mode, StarAlignment calculates the transformation matrix for each registered image, but no actual image registration is applied. A transformation matrix corresponds to a homographic projection (eight parameters) to register a target image over the reference image. If this mode is selected, the PCL:AlignmentMatrix property will be generated on target image windows and output image files. This is particularly useful for image analysis processes that require registered data but don't tolerate the degradation introduced by pixel interpolation, such as photometry tasks.

In Register/Union - Mosaic mode, StarAlignment will create a new image including both the reference and target images. The target image will be registered to match the reference image by superposition, and the reference image will not be interpolated (just copied in place). This forms a two-frame mosaic over a black canvas with the smallest possible dimensions to include the reference and registered target images completely.

The Register/Union - Separate mode is similar to the register/union mosaic mode, but each mosaic frame generates a separate image with the canvas size of the whole mosaic. Separate mosaic frames can then be composed into a single mosaic by means of a maximum combination (e.g., with PixelMath's max function).
文件:
工作模式。

批量图像配准任务（即对一组磁盘文件的自动配准）只能在配准/匹配与变换矩阵模式下工作。

结构检测、结构图、检测到的恒星、假定星点匹配与已匹配恒星是 StarAlignment 的控制模式。在这些模式下 StarAlignment 不执行实际的图像配准任务，而是生成辅助图像，用于评估一组 StarAlignment 参数的适用性与表现。

在变换矩阵模式下，StarAlignment 计算每幅待配准图像的变换矩阵，但不施加实际图像配准。变换矩阵对应一个单应投影（八个参数），用于把目标图像配准到参考图像上。若选择此模式，将在目标图像窗口与输出图像文件上生成 PCL:AlignmentMatrix 属性。这对需要已配准数据但不能容忍像素插值所引入劣化的图像分析过程特别有用，例如测光任务。

在配准/并集 - 马赛克模式下，StarAlignment 将创建包含参考图像与目标图像的新图像。目标图像将被配准以通过叠加匹配参考图像，而参考图像不会被插值（仅原位复制）。这在黑色画布上形成一个两帧马赛克，画布尺寸为使参考图像与已配准目标图像完全纳入所需的最小尺寸。

配准/并集 - 分离模式与配准/并集马赛克模式类似，但每个马赛克帧生成一幅独立图像，画布尺寸为整个马赛克的尺寸。之后可通过最大值组合（例如用 PixelMath 的 max 函数）把分离的马赛克帧合成为单一马赛克。

FILE:
The type of radial basis function (RBF) used to model geometric transformations with arbitrary local distortion correction using two-dimensional surface splines.

DDM (Domain Decomposition Method) RBF interpolation/approximation algorithms require O(n^2) time for spline construction, in contrast to standard implementations, which have O(n^3) time complexity. This makes the DDM-RBF algorithms capable of handling large-scale problems with tens of thousands of data points, while standard algorithms are limited to less than about 3000 points with current hardware. The default option is DDM Thin Plate Spline.

This parameter is not used with the recursive surface splines registration model, which always uses polyharmonic splines of the specified spline order.
文件:
用于以二维曲面样条建模带任意局部畸变改正的几何变换的径向基函数（RBF）类型。

DDM（区域分解法）RBF 插值/逼近算法构造样条需要 O(n^2) 时间，而标准实现的时间复杂度为 O(n^3)。这使 DDM-RBF 算法能够处理含数万个数据点的大规模问题，而标准算法在当前硬件下只能处理约 3000 个点以内。默认选项为 DDM 薄板样条。

此参数不用于递归曲面样条配准模型，后者始终使用指定样条阶数的多调和样条。

FILE:
Generate a registration mask for each registered image.

A registration mask is an 8-bit grayscale image whose pixels are white only where the registered image contains pixels from the corresponding target image; black anywhere else. These masks are very useful to apply selective corrections to registered pixels, especially in mosaic images.
文件:
为每幅已配准图像生成配准蒙版。

配准蒙版是一幅 8 位灰度图像，仅当已配准图像包含来自对应目标图像的像素处为白色，其他位置为黑色。这些蒙版对已配准像素施加选择性改正非常有用，尤其是在马赛克图像中。

FILE:
When this option is enabled, and one of the two-dimensional surface splines or recursive surface splines registration models is selected, a distortion map image will be generated for each registered target image. A distortion map is a graphical representation of the difference in pixels between the applied registration model and a linear model based on a projective or rigid transformation, or in other words, a representation of local distortion measured on the image at regular intervals in both coordinates.

In distortion maps, each distortion measurement is represented as a mark consisting of a circle and a line. Circles correspond to alignment positions calculated with a linear transformation, and lines point to the corresponding positions given by the spline-based transformation. Without distortions, all marks should be circles without visible lines.
文件:
启用此选项且选择了二维曲面样条或递归曲面样条之一配准模型时，将为每幅已配准目标图像生成一张畸变图。畸变图是所施加配准模型与基于投影或刚性变换的线性模型之间像素差的图形表示，换言之，是以规则间隔在两个坐标方向上测量到的图像局部畸变的表示。

在畸变图中，每个畸变测量表示为一个由圆与线构成的标记。圆对应以线性变换计算的对齐位置，线指向基于样条变换给出的对应位置。若无畸变，所有标记都应是看不到线的圆。

FILE:
Copy an existing astrometric solution and its associated metadata in the reference image to all registered images. PixInsight's native astrometric solutions consist of standardized XISF properties defining the parameters and data structures required to represent both linear and nonlinear solutions with arbitrary distortion corrections based on surface splines.

This option only works in the Register/Match Images working mode if the reference image is either a disk file or a main view (not a preview). For target image windows, astrometric solutions are regenerated after propagating astrometric metadata.

* Important: Inherited solutions can be less accurate than solutions computed directly on the registered images. The differences can be significant for solutions with distortion corrections if the applied image registration task does not model existing distortions accurately. For maximum accuracy (including mosaic generation), we recommend recomputing astrometric solutions on the registered images, using the inherited solution as a starting point.
文件:
把参考图像中已有的天文测量解及其关联元数据复制到所有已配准图像。PixInsight 原生天文测量解由标准化 XISF 属性组成，定义表示线性与非线性解所需的参数与数据结构，并支持基于曲面样条的任意畸变改正。

此选项仅在参考图像为磁盘文件或主视图（而非预览）时，在“配准/匹配图像”工作模式下有效。对目标图像窗口，天文测量解会在传播天文测量元数据后重新生成。

* 重要：继承的天文测量解可能不如在已配准图像上直接计算的解准确。若所施加的图像配准任务未能准确建模已有畸变，则带畸变改正的解差异可能相当显著。为获得最高精度（包括制作马赛克），我们建议在已配准图像上重新计算天文测量解，并把继承的解作为起点。

FILE:
Generate a drizzle data file for each registered image.

Drizzle data files contain geometrical projection parameters, pixel rejection and statistical data for the DrizzleIntegration tool. StarAlignment creates drizzle data files with CFA pattern information (when available) and projection data, and the ImageIntegration tool appends rejection and statistical data to the same files. Drizzle data files carry the .xdrz file suffix.

Drizzle data files are written in XDRZ format version 1.1, which stores surface spline distortion models, for both the two-dimensional surface splines and recursive surface splines registration models, as compressed binary data. Version 1.1 files cannot be read by previous versions of PixInsight.
文件:
为每幅已配准图像生成 drizzle 数据文件。

Drizzle 数据文件包含供 DrizzleIntegration 工具使用的几何投影参数、像素剔除与统计数据。StarAlignment 创建带 CFA 模式信息（若可用）与投影数据的 drizzle 数据文件，ImageIntegration 工具则向同一批文件追加剔除与统计数据。Drizzle 数据文件的后缀为 .xdrz。

Drizzle 数据文件以 XDRZ 格式 1.1 版写入，把二维曲面样条与递归曲面样条两种配准模型的曲面样条畸变模型存为压缩二进制数据。旧版 PixInsight 无法读取 1.1 版文件。

FILE:
Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In StarAlignment, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats (reference and target image files) are loaded, while output hints modify the way output registered image files are written.

For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "up-bottom" input hint to load input images from FITS files with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints.
文件:
格式提示允许你为特定过程使用的图像文件覆盖全局文件格式设置。在 StarAlignment 中，输入提示改变某些特定格式输入图像（参考图像与目标图像文件）的载入方式，输出提示则修改输出已配准图像文件的写入方式。

例如，你可以使用 "lower-range" 与 "upper-range" 输入提示载入由其他不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的应用生成的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。同理，你可以指定 "up-bottom" 输入提示，从坐标原点位于左上角的 FITS 文件载入输入图像。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式支持若干输入和/或输出提示，你可以在提供格式提示访问的工具中按不同目的使用它们。

FILE:
This is the directory (or folder) where all output files will be written.

If this field is left blank, output files will be written to the same directories as their corresponding target files. In this case, make sure that source directories are writable, or the registration process will fail.
文件:
这是所有输出文件将被写入的目录（或文件夹）。

若此字段留空，输出文件将被写入与其对应目标文件相同的目录。此时请确保源目录可写，否则配准过程将失败。

FILE:
If this option is selected, StarAlignment will overwrite existing files with the same names as generated output files. This can be dangerous because the original contents of overwritten files will be lost.

Enable this option at your own risk.
文件:
若选中此选项，StarAlignment 将覆盖与生成输出文件同名的现有文件。这可能很危险，因为被覆盖文件的原始内容将丢失。

启用此选项风险自负。

FILE:
Maximum number of stars allowed.

In the default automatic mode, StarAlignment will perform a series of tries using a predefined sequence of star counts if the initial attempt to register the images fails. This is the recommended setting. To select the automatic mode, specify zero as the value of this parameter.

Increasing the amount of reference stars is in general not necessary, and it usually just slows down the image registration process with no improvement in registration accuracy. However, when registering images with little overlapping (mosaics, or images with large scale differences), it may be necessary using a reduced or expanded set of reference stars, depending on a variety of working scenarios. In these cases, the automatic probing sequence usually works very well, so you normally should not need to change the default value of this parameter.
文件:
允许的恒星最大数量。

在默认的自动模式下，若初次尝试配准图像失败，StarAlignment 将使用预定义的恒星数量序列进行一系列尝试。这是推荐的设置。要选择自动模式，请把此参数值指定为零。

一般来说增加参考恒星数量并不必要，且通常只会拖慢图像配准过程，而配准准确性没有提升。不过，在配准重叠很少的图像（马赛克，或尺度差异很大的图像）时，视不同工作情形可能需要使用减少或扩张的参考恒星集合。这些情况下自动探测序列通常效果很好，因此通常不需要修改此参数的默认值。

FILE:
Invert the image prior to star detection.

Select this option to register negative images (dark stars over a bright background).
文件:
在恒星检测之前反转图像。

选中此选项以配准负像（亮背景上的暗星）。

FILE:
Use brightness relations between alignment stars.

Select this option to take into account brightness relations between stars for comparisons performed by the star matching algorithm. This feature further improves the robustness of the star matching algorithm and hence can be helpful in difficult cases. In seldom cases however, trying to match brightness relations may cause problems to register images acquired through different filters; e.g. individual channels of an RGB image.
文件:
使用对齐恒星之间的亮度关系。

选中此选项以考虑恒星之间的亮度关系，供星点匹配算法进行比较。此特性进一步提高星点匹配算法的稳健性，因此在困难情形下可能有帮助。不过在少数情况下，试图匹配亮度关系可能给配准通过不同滤镜采集的图像带来问题；例如 RGB 图像的各个通道。

FILE:
Restrict star matching to preview areas.

When this option is selected, StarAlignment will restrict the star matching process to the rectangular areas defined by all existing previews in reference and target images. If there are no previews defined in one of the images, the whole image will be used for star matching, ignoring this parameter. Obviously, this option only works for views, not for disk image files.

This option can be useful for mosaic construction in extremely difficult cases, when automatic intersection computation (see above) fails. In general, this only happens for images with minimal overlapping. To use this option, you must define previews covering (roughly) the overlapped areas between the reference and target images, then execute StarAlignment on the target image with this option enabled. In this way StarAlignment will limit the star matching process to the areas covered by the previews, which greatly improves the performance of the RANSAC algorithm by reducing the fraction of outliers (false putative matches) in the initial set of star pair matches. With the help of this feature, one can build mosaics of any practical size and complexity.
文件:
把星点匹配限制在预览区域内。

选中此选项时，StarAlignment 将把星点匹配过程限制在参考图像与目标图像中所有已有预览所定义的矩形区域内。若其中一幅图像没有定义预览，则整幅图像将用于星点匹配，忽略此参数。显然此选项仅对视图有效，不适用于磁盘图像文件。

在极其困难、自动交集计算（见上文）失败的情形下，此选项可用于构建马赛克。一般来说这仅发生在重叠极少的图像上。要使用此选项，你必须定义覆盖参考图像与目标图像之间（大致）重叠区域的预览，然后在启用此选项的情况下对目标图像执行 StarAlignment。这样 StarAlignment 会把星点匹配过程限制在预览覆盖的区域内，通过降低初始星对匹配集合中离群值（虚假假定匹配）的比例大幅提升 RANSAC 算法的性能。借助此功能，可以构建任意实际尺寸与复杂度的马赛克。

FILE:
Tolerance of the star matching algorithm, in terms of the maximum allowed difference in descriptor scale.

This parameter is only used when the use scale differences option is enabled. The value of this parameter is the maximum allowed difference in scale between two descriptors formed with putative star pair matches. This improves robustness of the star matching algorithm, especially in presence of a large number of outliers (false putative star pair matches), but also imposes an upper limit on the difference in scale between two registered images. Using scale differences can be very helpful to build mosaics with little overlapping.
文件:
星点匹配算法的容差，以描述符尺度允许的最大差异表示。

此参数仅在启用使用尺度差异选项时使用。此参数的值是由假定星对匹配构成的两个描述符之间允许的最大尺度差异。这提高星点匹配算法的稳健性，尤其是在存在大量离群值（虚假假定星对匹配）时，但也给两幅待配准图像之间的尺度差异设了上限。使用尺度差异对构建重叠很少的马赛克非常有帮助。

FILE:
Use scale differences between star matching descriptors.

Select this option to take into account differences in scale (size) between the descriptors used to match pairs of stars. You must also define a scale tolerance when this option is enabled (see the scale tolerance parameter below). When scale differences are taken into account, the star matching algorithm is able to find more true star pair matches in presence of a large number of false putative matches. This feature is useful to improve registration of images with little overlapping, as often happens when building mosaics. However, take into account that enabling this option will prevent registration of images with scale differences larger than the value of the scale tolerance parameter.
文件:
使用星点匹配描述符之间的尺度差异。

选中此选项以考虑用于匹配星对的描述符之间的尺度（大小）差异。启用此选项时你还必须定义尺度容差（见下方尺度容差参数）。考虑尺度差异时，星点匹配算法能在大量虚假假定匹配存在的情况下找到更多真实星对匹配。此特性有助于改善重叠很少图像的配准，这在构建马赛克时经常出现。不过请注意，启用此选项将阻止配准尺度差异大于尺度容差参数值的图像。

FILE:
Compute the intersection region between the reference and target images.

When this option is selected and is applicable, StarAlignment uses a special FFT-based algorithm to precompute the intersection region between the reference and target images.

Once the intersection has been found, the star matching process is restricted to the intersection area. This greatly improves the performance of the RANSAC algorithm by reducing the fraction of outliers (false putative matches) in the initial set of star pair matches. Note that this works in the same way, and has the same features and advantages, as the restrict to previews option (see below). However, intersections are computed in a completely automatic and accurate way, without user intervention.

The disabled option will disable intersection computation. Mosaic modes only will perform computation of intersection regions only when a mosaic construction mode has been selected (union/mosaic or separate mosaic), and always will force intersection computations in all working modes. Normally, this option is only necessary to build mosaics, because in these tasks the overlapped regions between mosaic frames are usually small.

FILE:
Pixel interpolation algorithm

The default automatic mode will select the following interpolation algorithms as a function of the rescaling involved in the registration geometrical transformation:

  • Cubic B-spline filter interpolation when the scaling factor is under 0.25 approximately.
  • Mitchell-Netravali filter interpolation for scaling factors between 0.6 and 0.25 approx.
  • Lanczos-3 interpolation in the rest of cases: from moderate size reductions to no rescaling or rescaling up.

Lanczos is, in general, the best interpolation algorithm for image registration of linear images when no large scale changes are required. Lanczos has excellent detail preservation and subpixel registration performance with minimal generation of aliasing effects. Its main drawback is generation of undershoot (ringing) artifacts, but this problem can be fixed in most cases with the implemented clamping mechanism (see the clamping threshold parameter below).

Bicubic spline is an excellent interpolation algorithm in terms of accuracy and execution speed. As Lanczos interpolation, bicubic spline generates ringing artifacts, but the implemented clamping mechanism can usually fix most of them. The main problem with bicubic spline is generation of aliasing effects, such as moire patterns, which can be problematic with noisy images, especially on sky background areas. This is one of the reasons why Lanczos is in general the preferred option.

Bilinear interpolation can be useful to register low SNR linear images, in the rare cases where Lanczos and bicubic spline interpolation generates too strong oscillations between noisy pixels that can't be avoided completely with the clamping feature. Bilinear interpolation has no ringing artifacts, but it generates strong aliasing patterns on noisy areas and provides less accurate results than Lanczos and bicubic spline.

Cubic filter interpolations, such as Mitchell-Netravali, Catmull-Rom spline and cubic B-spline, provide higher smoothness and subsampling accuracy that can be necessary when the registration transformation involves relatively strong size reductions.

Nearest neighbor is the simplest possible pixel interpolation method. It always produces the worst results, especially in terms of registration accuracy (no subpixel registration is possible), and discontinuities due to the simplistic interpolation scheme. However, in absence of scaling and rotation nearest neighbor preserves the original noise distribution in the registered images, a property that can be useful in some image analysis applications.
文件:
像素插值算法

默认自动模式将依据配准几何变换所涉及的缩放，选择以下插值算法：

Lanczos 通常是在不需要大尺度变化时对线性图像进行图像配准的最佳插值算法。Lanczos 在细节保留与亚像素配准方面表现优异，且混叠效应生成极少。其主要缺点是产生下冲（振铃）伪影，但在大多数情况下可用所实现的钳制机制修正此问题（见下方钳制阈值参数）。

双三次样条在准确性与执行速度方面都是极佳的插值算法。与 Lanczos 插值一样，双三次样条会产生振铃伪影，但所实现的钳制机制通常能修正其中大部分。双三次样条的主要问题是会产生混叠效应（如摩尔纹），这在噪声图像上可能成为问题，尤其是天空背景区域。这也是 Lanczos 通常更受青睐的原因之一。

双线性插值可用于配准低 SNR 的线性图像——在罕见的、Lanczos 与双三次样条插值在噪声像素之间产生过强振荡且钳制功能无法完全避免的情形下。双线性插值没有振铃伪影，但会在噪声区域产生强烈的混叠图案，且结果不如 Lanczos 与双三次样条准确。

三次滤波插值，例如 Mitchell-Netravali、Catmull-Rom 样条与三次 B 样条，提供更高的平滑度与子采样精度，当配准变换涉及相对较强的尺寸缩小时可能是必需的。

最近邻是最简单的像素插值方法。它总是产生最差的结果，尤其是在配准准确性方面（无法进行亚像素配准），并且由于插值方案过于简单会产生不连续。不过，在不涉及缩放与旋转时，最近邻会保留已配准图像的原始噪声分布，这一特性在某些图像分析应用中可能有用。

FILE:
A rendering intent is a method to map existing out-of-gamut colors in the image color space to the color space of the target ICC profile.

The relative colorimetric rendering intent matches the white point in the image color space to the white point in the target color space. For example, if the target ICC profile characterizes a printing device, this means that pure white will not be printed at all (no ink), but will be represented by the white of the paper. Out-of-gamut colors are replaced by the nearest in-gamut colors. Relative colorimetric is in general the best balanced option for the sake of color accuracy in both the numerical and perceptual senses.

The absolute colorimetric intent also replaces out-of-gamut colors by their nearest matches in the output color space, but it doesn't try to match the white points. If the white points in the image and target color spaces don't match, you'll get a color cast in the highlights. However, since this intent doesn't alter any in-gamut colors, it is the best option in terms of numeric color accuracy.

The perceptual intent maps all colors in the image space to the target space. With the perceptual intent, no out-of-gamut color is clipped, as happens with the colorimetric intents, but all colors can be altered, and the changes can be significant if the image space is much wider than the output space. In general, relative colorimetric is preferred, but perceptual can yield more vibrant results that may be desirable in some cases.

Finally, the saturation intent tries to maximize color saturation in the output, at the cost of sacrifying color accuracy, when necessary. This intent can be a good option for synthetic graphics and illustrations, but not for reproduction of photographic images.
文件:
再现意图是一种把图像色彩空间中已有的超出色域的颜色映射到目标 ICC 配置文件色彩空间的方法。

相对比色再现意图把图像色彩空间中的白点匹配到目标色彩空间中的白点。例如，若目标 ICC 配置文件描述的是印刷设备，这意味着纯白完全不会被印刷（无油墨），而由纸张的白度来表现。超出色域的颜色会被替换为色域内最接近的颜色。就数值与感知两种意义上的色彩准确性而言，相对比色总体上是平衡最好的选项。

绝对比色意图也把超出色域的颜色替换为目标色彩空间中与之最接近的匹配，但它不尝试匹配白点。若图像与目标色彩空间中的白点不一致，高光部分会出现偏色。不过，由于该意图不改变任何在色域内的颜色，就数值色彩准确性而言它是最佳选择。

感知意图把图像空间中的所有颜色映射到目标空间。使用感知意图时，不会有超出色域的颜色被裁剪（如比色意图那样），但所有颜色都可能被改变，若图像空间远大于输出空间，改变可能相当显著。一般来说更倾向于相对比色，但感知意图可产生更鲜艳的结果，某些情况下可能正是所需。

最后，饱和度意图力求最大化输出中的色彩饱和度，必要时以牺牲色彩准确性为代价。该意图适用于合成图形与插画，但不适用于照片类图像的再现。

Specify how to handle out-of-range results after the inverse Fourier transform.

When the DFT components are modified (for example, to implement a filtering procedure in the frequency domain), sample values outside the normalized [0,1] range can be generated in the resulting image after the inverse Fourier transform. You can handle these out-of-range values in three ways:

Don't care will leave out-of-range values unmodified. In this mode, the resulting image may contain invalid pixel values. Do not use this mode unless you know what you are doing.

Truncate will truncate any out-of-range values to the [0,1] range. In this mode the original dynamics of the image are preserved. This is the default working mode.

Rescale will rescale the resulting image to the [0,1] range only if there are out-of-range values. In this mode all the output data are preserved, but the dynamics of the original image may change after the inverse Fourier transform.

重缩放仅在存在超出范围的值时，把结果图像重缩放到 [0,1] 范围。此模式下所有输出数据都被保留，但原图像的动态范围在逆傅里叶变换后可能改变。

FILE:
Model generation scale.

GradientCorrection implements a multiscale gradient modeling algorithm. This parameter controls the relative scale at which the gradient model will be generated. Higher parameter values generate smooth models best suited to represent large-scale brightness variations. Lower values allow for the generation of more complex gradients representing more local variations. The default value is 5.0.
文件:
模型生成尺度。

GradientCorrection 实现多尺度梯度建模算法。此参数控制生成梯度模型的相对尺度。参数值越高生成的模型越平滑，最适合表示大尺度亮度变化；值越低则可生成更复杂的梯度，表示更多局部变化。默认值为 5.0。

FILE:
Model smoothness.

Along with the model generation scale, this parameter provides fine control on the degree of smoothness of local variations represented in the computed gradient model. The default value is 0.4.
文件:

与模型生成尺度一起，此参数可精细控制所计算梯度模型中局部变化的平滑程度。默认值为 0.4。

FILE:
When this section is enabled, a simplified gradient model will be computed during the initial preprocessing task. This simplified model will be subtracted from the image before applying the rest of the multiscale gradient modeling and correction algorithm. The complexity of this simplified model can be controlled with the Model degree parameter.

This feature can be helpful when dealing with very bright and complex gradients, where the gradients may have similar or even higher values than the objects of interest in the image. In these cases, an initial simplification can often improve the performance of the gradient modeling and correction algorithm, making it more efficient and controllable. However, this feature can be counterproductive for images with large and bright objects, where it can lead to overcorrection. This option is turned off by default.
文件:
启用此节时，将在初始预处理任务中计算一个简化梯度模型。该简化模型将在施加其余多尺度梯度建模与改正算法之前从图像中减去。此简化模型的复杂度可用模型阶数参数控制。

当处理非常明亮且复杂的梯度时，此特性可能有帮助——这类梯度的数值可能与感兴趣目标相当甚至更高。在这些情况下，初始简化往往能改善梯度建模与改正算法的表现，使其更高效、更可控。不过，对于包含大型明亮目标的图像，此特性可能适得其反，导致过度改正。此选项默认关闭。

FILE:
Simplified model degree.

When the Simplified Model option is enabled, this parameter defines the degree of two-dimensional interpolation polynomials used to compute a simplified gradient model during the initial preprocessing task. This simplified model will be subtracted from the image before applying the rest of the multiscale gradient modeling and correction algorithm. High-degree models are more adaptive to local variations and potentially more accurate but can lead to overcorrection or oscillations. The default value is one, which corresponds to a linear simplified model.
文件:
简化模型阶数。

启用简化模型选项时，此参数定义在初始预处理任务中用于计算简化梯度模型的二维插值多项式阶数。该简化模型将在施加其余多尺度梯度建模与改正算法之前从图像中减去。高阶模型对局部变化更适应、可能更准确，但可能导致过度改正或振荡。默认值为 1，对应线性简化模型。

FILE:
Gather structures by aggregation instead of superposition.

FILE:
Binarize structures instead of rescaling them.

Enable this option to generate a mask where all structures are initially white. In this case, only the smoothness parameter will determine the final brightness of all structures (smaller structures will be dimmer when smoothed).

When this option is disabled, structures have initial values proportional to their relevance in the multiscale pyramid. Structures that are supported by more wavelet layers will be brighter.

FILE: This parameter controls the point from which normalization starts in the dimmer regions of the image. This is an interpolation between the minimum and median image values. So a Shadow point of 0 will apply the normalization for all pixel intensity values, ie it starts at the minimum image value. A value of 1 will do the same but starts the normalization from the median image value. Values between 0 and 1 will interpolate between these points. This feature helps allow fainter signals to be normalized but this can introduce more noise.

When automatic convergence is enabled, the process will be stopped if either the difference between two successive iterations (see the iterations parameter) is smaller than the convergence parameter, or if the maximum number of iterations is reached; whichever happens first. If this parameter is disabled, the specified number of iterations will always be performed.

Important — Be aware that when automatic convergence is enabled, the TGVDenoise process is not previewable. In other words, since convergence is specific to the data being processed, there is no guarantee that the result obtained on a preview be the same as the result obtained on its mother image with the same parameters. Depending on the image, the differences can be significant.

FILE:
Declination equatorial coordinate of the center of the search region.

You can write an explicit declination coordinate as a space-separated list of degrees, arcminutes and arcseconds. The arcminutes and arcseconds items are optional, and you can specify a fractional part for the last item. A plus or minus sign character is optional before the first degrees item, and obviously necessary for Southern declinations. Alternatively, you can search for object coordinates online by clicking the Search Coordinates button.

搜索区域中心的赤纬坐标。

你可以把显式赤纬坐标写为空格分隔的度、角分、角秒列表。角分与角秒项可选，且可对最后一项指定小数部分。第一项度之前可有可无正负号，南赤纬显然必需。也可以通过点击搜索坐标按钮在线搜索天体坐标。

The (arc)minutes and (arc)seconds items are optional, and you can specify a fractional part for the last item. Alternatively, you can search for object coordinates online by clicking the Search Coordinates button.

See the process documentation for information on the format used by APASS output binary files.

FILE:
The format of generated output text files.

CSV will generate standard comma-separated files (CSV format).

Tabular formats can be selected to write coordinates either as scalars in degrees, or using compound angular representations where right ascension is represented as separate hours, minutes and seconds, and declination as degrees, arcminutes and arcseconds.

In all cases output text files can contain optional headers, which you can control with the Text headers option below.

可选择表格格式，把坐标写为以度为单位的标量，或使用复合角度表示：赤经表示为独立的时、分、秒，赤纬表示为度、角分、角秒。

所有情形下输出文本文件都可含可选表头，你可用下方文本表头选项控制。

When the Generate text output option is enabled, the search process will write its output data to the specified file in a plain text format.
文件:
输出文件路径。

启用生成文本输出选项时，搜索过程会把输出数据以纯文本格式写入指定文件。

FILE:
This is the length in pixels of a background sample box.

Too large sample boxes can be inadequate to reproduce local background variations. Too small sample boxes can be too dependent on small-scale variations, such as noise and stars.
文件:
这是背景样本框的长度（像素）。

样本框过大可能无法复现局部背景变化；样本框过小则可能过于依赖小尺度变化，如噪声与恒星。

FILE:
This is the distance in pixels between two adjacent background sample boxes.

This parameter is useful to control the density of generated sample boxes. A relatively sparse sample distribution can be helpful to make the background model less dependent on strong local variations. The number of samples can also have a strong repercussion over computation times.
文件:
这是两个相邻背景样本框之间的像素距离。

此参数用于控制生成样本框的密度。相对稀疏的样本分布有助于使背景模型较少依赖强烈的局部变化。样本数量也会显著影响计算时间。

FILE:
Tolerance of global sample rejection, in sigma units.

This is the maximum dispersion allowed for background samples, with respect to the median of the target image. By decreasing this value, ABE will be more restrictive to select background samples that differ too much from the mean background of the whole image. This is useful to avoid inclusion of large-scale structures, such as extended nebular regions, in the generated background model.
文件:
全局样本剔除容差，以 sigma 为单位。

这是背景样本允许的最大离散度，相对于目标图像的中值。减小此值会使 ABE 更严格地剔除与全图平均背景差异过大的背景样本。这有助于避免把大尺度结构（如大面积星云区域）纳入生成的背景模型。

FILE:
Shadows relaxation factor.

This parameter multiplies the deviation parameter when used to evaluate dispersion of dark pixels (i.e., pixels below the global median of the target image). This allows to include more dark pixels in the generated background model, while more restrictive criteria are used to reject bright pixels.
文件:
暗部松弛因子。

此参数在用于评估暗像素（即低于目标图像全局中值的像素）离散度时，会乘以偏差参数。这允许在生成的背景模型中纳入更多暗像素，同时用更严格准则剔除亮像素。

FILE:
Tolerance of local sample rejection, in sigma units.

This is the maximum dispersion allowed for background sample pixels. By decreasing this value, background samples will reject more outlier pixels with respect to the median of each sample box. This is useful to make background samples immune to noise and small-scale bright structures, such as relatively small stars.
文件:
局部样本剔除容差，以 sigma 为单位。

If this option is selected, ABE will draw all background sample boxes on a newly-created 16-bit image, which we call sample boxes image. A sample boxes image is very useful to adjust ABE parameters by controlling the regions of the image that are being used to sample the background.

In a sample boxes image, each sample box is drawn with a pixel value proportional to the inverse of the corresponding sampled background value.
文件:
选中此选项后，ABE 会把所有背景样本框绘制在一幅新建的 16 位图像上，我们称之为样本框图像。样本框图像对于通过控制用于采样背景的图像区域来调整 ABE 参数非常有用。

在样本框图像中，每个样本框绘制时的像素值与对应采样背景值成反比。

FILE:
Degree of the interpolation polynomials.

ABE uses a linear least squares fitting procedure to compute a set of 2-D polynomials that interpolate the background model. Higher degrees may be necessary to reproduce local background variations, especially in presence of wildly varying sky gradients, but they can also lead to oscillations. In general, the default value (4th degree) is appropriate in most cases. If necessary, this parameter must be adjusted by careful trial-error work.
文件:
插值多项式的阶数。

ABE 使用线性最小二乘拟合过程，计算一组二维多项式来插值背景模型。要复现局部背景变化可能需要更高阶数，尤其在天空梯度剧烈变化时，但高阶也可能导致振荡。一般而言，默认值（4 阶）在多数情况下合适。若有必要，须通过仔细的试错调整此参数。

FILE:
This specifies a downsampling ratio for generation of the background model image. For example, a downsampling value of 2 means that the model will be created with one half the sizes of the target image.

Background models are by definition extremely smooth functions. For this reason, a background model can usually be generated with downsampling ratios between 2 and 8 without problems, depending on the variations of the sampled background. A downsampled model greatly reduces the required calculation times for background model interpolation.
文件:
这指定背景模型图像生成的下采样比例。例如下采样值为 2 表示模型将以目标图像一半的尺寸创建。

按定义，背景模型是极其平滑的函数。因此通常可用 2 至 8 的下采样比例生成背景模型而不出问题，具体取决于所采样背景的变化。下采样模型可大幅缩短背景模型插值所需的计算时间。

FILE:
Normalize the background of the corrected image.

If this option is selected, the initial median value of the image will be applied after background model correction. If the background model is subtracted, then the median will be added; if the background model is applied by division, the resulting image will be multiplied by the median. This tends to recover the initial color balance of the background in the corrected image.

If this option is not selected (as by default), the above median normalization will not be applied and —if the background model is accurate— the resulting corrected image will tend to have a neutral background.
文件:
归一化校正后图像的背景。

选中此选项后，会在背景模型校正之后施加图像的初始中值。若背景模型是减去的，则加上中值；若背景模型以除法施加，则结果图像乘以中值。这有助于在校正后图像中恢复背景的初始色彩平衡。

若未选中此选项（默认），则不施加上述中值归一化——若背景模型准确——校正后图像会趋于中性背景。

Fixed sample value

Enable this option to force a constant value for the current DBE sample. The fixed value will be taken as the median of the sample pixel values for each channel of the image.
文件:
固定样本值

启用此选项可为当前 DBE 样本强制一个常数值。该固定值取图像每个通道样本像素值的中值。

FILE:
Smoothing factor for 2-D surface spline generation.

Controls the adaptability of the 2-D surface modeling algorithm used to build the background model. With a smoothness value of 0, a pure interpolating surface spline will be used, which will reproduce the values of all DBE samples exactly at their locations. Moderate smoothness values are usually desirable; excessive smoothness can lead to erroneous modelization.
文件:
二维曲面样条生成的平滑因子。

控制用于构建背景模型的二维曲面建模算法的适应性。平滑度为 0 时使用纯插值曲面样条，会在样本位置精确复现所有 DBE 样本的值。适中平滑度通常是理想的；过度平滑会导致错误建模。

FILE:
Ignore all sample weights

By selecting this option, all statistical sample weights will be ignored (actually, all of them will be considered as having a value of one, regardless of their actual values). This can be useful in difficult or unusual cases, where DBE's automatic pixel rejection algorithms may fail due to too wild gradients. In such cases, you can manually define a (usually quite reduced) set of samples on strategic locations and tell the background modeling routines that you know what you're doing — if you select this option, they will trust you.
文件:
忽略所有样本权重

选中此选项可忽略所有统计样本权重（实际上全部视为 1，不论其实际值）。这在困难或异常情形下有用——DBE 的自动像素剔除算法可能因梯度过分剧烈而失败。此类情况下，你可以在关键位置手动定义一组（通常相当少）样本，并告诉背景建模例程你知道自己在做什么 —— 若你选中此选项，它们就会信任你。

FILE:
Tolerance of the pixel rejection algorithm.

This parameter is expressed in sigma units, with respect to the estimated mean background value. Higher tolerance values will allow for more permissive background estimations. Increasing this value favors inclusion of more pixels in the background model, but at the risk of including also pixels that don't pertain to the true background of the image. Decreasing tolerance will cause a more restrictive pixel rejection; however, too low tolerance values lead to poorly sampled background models.
文件:
像素剔除算法的容差。

此参数以 sigma 为单位，相对于估计的平均背景值。更高的容差值允许更宽松的背景估计。增大此值有利于把更多像素纳入背景模型，但风险是也会纳入不属于图像真实背景的像素。减小容差会使像素剔除更严格；不过容差过低会导致背景模型采样不足。

FILE:
Relaxation factor for rejection of dark background pixels.

Increasing this parameter allows for the inclusion of more dark pixels in the generated background model, while more restrictive criteria can be applied to reject bright pixels (as specified by the tolerance parameter). This helps to achieve a better sky background modelization without inclusion of relatively bright and large objects, as extended nebulas.
文件:
剔除暗背景像素的松弛因子。

增大此参数可在生成的背景模型中纳入更多暗像素，同时对亮像素施加更严格的剔除准则（由容差参数指定）。这有助于更好地对天空背景建模，而不纳入较亮的大尺度天体，如大面积星云。

FILE:
Minimum fraction of nonrejected pixels in a valid DBE sample.

No sample with less than the specified fraction of background pixels will be generated. Set to zero to take into account all samples regardless of their calculated representativeness of the background.
文件:
有效 DBE 样本中未被剔除像素的最小比例。

背景像素比例低于指定值的样本不会被生成。设为零则考虑所有样本，不论其计算出的背景代表性如何。

FILE:
Derivative order of continuity for the 2-D surface spline generator.

Higher continuity orders can yield more accurate models (accuracy here means adaptability to local variations). However, higher orders also may lead to instabilities and rippling effects. The recommended value is 2; you usually should not need to change this parameter.
文件:
二维曲面样条生成器的连续性导数阶数。

更高连续性阶数可产生更精确的模型（这里的精确指对局部变化的适应性）。但高阶也可能导致不稳定与波纹效应。推荐值为 2；通常不需要改动此参数。

FILE:
Minimum statistical weight for generated DBE samples.

This parameter only applies to automatically generated DBE samples. No samples will be generated with statistical weights below the specified value.
文件:
生成的 DBE 样本的最小统计权重。

此参数仅适用于自动生成的 DBE 样本。统计权重低于指定值的样本不会被生成。

BackgroundNeutralization will use pixels read from this image to compute an initial mean background level for each color channel. If you leave this field blank (or with its default <target image> value), the target image will be also the background reference image during the neutralization process.

You should specify a view that represents the true background of the image. In most cases this means that you must select a view whose pixels are strongly dominated by the sky background, as it is being represented on the target image. A typical example involves defining a small preview over a free sky area of the target image, and selecting it here as the background reference image.
文件:
BackgroundNeutralization 将读取此图像中的像素，为每个颜色通道计算初始平均背景水平。若此字段留空（或保持默认的 <target image> 值），则目标图像在去中性化过程中同时充当背景参考图像。

你应指定一个代表图像真实背景的视图。大多数情况下这意味着必须选择这样一个视图：其像素被天空背景强烈主导，正如其在目标图像中所表现的那样。典型做法是在目标图像的自由天空区域上定义一个小预览，并在此处把它选为背景参考图像。

FILE:
Select a background neutralization mode.

In target background mode, BackgroundNeutralization will force the target image to have the specified mean background value (see the target background parameter below) for the three RGB channels. In this mode, any resulting out-of-range values after neutralization will be truncated. There can be some (usually negligible) data clipping, but only additive transformations are applied to the data.

In rescale mode, the target image will always be rescaled after neutralization. In this mode there are no data clippings, and the neutralized image maximizes dynamic range usage. However, in this mode you have no control over the resulting mean background value, and the rescaling operation is a multiplicative transformation that redistributes all pixel values throughout the available dynamic range.

The rescale as needed mode is similar to rescale, but the target image is only rescaled if there are out-of-range-values after neutralization. This is the default mode.

In truncate mode all resulting out-of-range pixels after neutralization will be truncated, which usually results in severely clipped data. This mode is useful to perform a background subtraction to a working image used for an intermediate analysis or processing step.
文件:
选择背景中性化模式。

在目标背景模式下，BackgroundNeutralization 会强制目标图像的三个 RGB 通道具有指定的平均背景值（见下方目标背景参数）。此模式下，去中性化后产生的任何超范围值都将被截断。可能有少量（通常可忽略的）数据截断，但对数据只施加加性变换。

在重缩放模式下，目标图像在去中性化后总会被重缩放。此模式无数据截断，去中性化后的图像能最大化利用动态范围。但此模式下你无法控制结果的平均背景值，且重缩放是乘性变换，会把所有像素值重新分布到可用动态范围内。

按需重缩放模式与重缩放类似，但仅在去中性化后存在超范围值时才重缩放目标图像。这是默认模式。

在截断模式下，去中性化后所有超范围像素都将被截断，通常会导致数据被严重削顶。此模式适合对工作表图像做背景扣除，用于中间分析或处理步骤。

Hot (blue) references, such as B and A stars, tend to induce a red color cast. Cold (red) references, such as K and M stars, tend to cause a blue color cast.

This happens when local APASS databases are not available, or if the APASS database server process has not been properly configured. In such cases this option allows you to select the best VizieR mirror server, which usually is the closest one to your location.

FILE:
Minimum size of a detectable star structure in square pixels.

This parameter can be used to prevent the detection of small and bright image artifacts wrongly as stars, when such artifacts cannot be removed with a median filter (i.e., the Hot pixel removal parameter), or for rejection of cosmic rays.

This parameter can be used in three ways:

* Automatic mode. A zero value enables an adaptive algorithm to find an optimal minimum structure size using statistical analysis techniques. This is the default option.

* Disabled. A value of one turns off minimum structure size rejection since no detectable star can be represented by less than one pixel.

* Literal value. A value > 1 forces using the specified minimum structure size in square pixels.
文件:
可检测恒星结构的最小尺寸，以平方像素为单位。

当小型明亮的图像伪影无法用中值滤波（即热像素去除参数）去除时，此参数可防止把它们误判为恒星，也可用于剔除宇宙射线。

此参数有三种用法：

* 自动模式。取 0 值时启用自适应算法，用统计分析方法寻找最优最小结构尺寸。这是默认选项。

* 禁用。取 1 值时关闭最小结构尺寸剔除，因为任何可检测的恒星都不可能由少于一个像素表示。

* 字面值。取 > 1 的值时强制使用指定的最小结构尺寸（以平方像素为单位）。

Saturation threshold in the [0,1] range.

Detected stars with one or more pixels with values above this threshold will be excluded for signal evaluation.

This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can be applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).

The default saturation threshold is 0.75. For signal evaluation this parameter plays an imortant role to prevent contamination of the statistical sample of flux ratios by sources with saturated or nonlinear data. Changing the default value should not be necessary under normal conditions.

FILE:
Minimum signal-to-noise ratio of a detectable star.

Given a source with estimated brightness s, local background b and local background dispersion n, SNR is evaluated as (s – b)/n. Stars with measured SNR below the value of this parameter won't be used for signal evaluation.

This parameter allows limiting star detection to a subset of the brightest sources in the image adaptively. By requiring relatively high SNR levels in the evaluated sources, the accuracy and robustness of the signal evaluation process can be largely improved. The default value is 40, which is quite appropriate in most cases.

可检测恒星的最低信噪比。

此参数可自适应地把恒星检测限制在图像中最亮源的一个子集。通过要求被评估的源具有相对较高的 SNR，可大幅提升信号评估过程的准确性与稳健性。默认值为 40，在大多数情况下相当合适。

In all cases elliptical functions are fitted to detected star structures, and PSF sampling regions are defined adaptively using a median stabilization algorithm.

When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for scale estimation. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.

FILE:
Pixel interpolation algorithm

Lanczos is, in general, the best interpolation algorithm for image registration of linear images when no large scale changes are required. Lanczos has excellent detail preservation and subpixel registration performance with minimal generation of aliasing effects. Its main drawback is generation of undershooting (ringing) artifacts, but this problem can be fixed in most cases with the implemented clamping mechanism (see the clamping threshold parameter below).

Bicubic spline is an excellent interpolation algorithm in terms of accuracy and execution speed. As Lanczos interpolation, bicubic spline generates ringing artifacts, but the implemented clamping mechanism can usually fix most of them. The main problem with bicubic spline is generation of aliasing effects, such as moire patterns, which can be problematic with noisy images, especially on sky background areas. This is one of the reasons why Lanczos is in general the preferred option.

Bilinear interpolation can be useful to register low SNR linear images, in the rare cases where Lanczos and bicubic spline interpolation generates too strong oscillations between noisy pixels that can't be avoided completely with the clamping feature. Bilinear interpolation has no ringing artifacts, but it generates strong aliasing patterns on noisy areas and provides less accurate results than Lanczos and bicubic spline.

Cubic filter interpolations, such as Mitchell-Netravali, Catmull-Rom spline and cubic B-spline, provide higher smoothness and subsampling accuracy that can be necessary when the registration transformation involves relatively strong size reductions.

Nearest neighbor is the simplest possible pixel interpolation method. It always produces the worst results, especially in terms of registration accuracy (no subpixel registration is possible), and discontinuities due to the simplistic interpolation scheme. However, in absence of scaling and rotation nearest neighbor preserves the original noise distribution in the registered images, a property that can be useful in some image analysis applications.
文件:
像素插值算法

Lanczos 在不需要大尺度变化时，通常是线性图像配准的最佳插值算法。Lanczos 细节保真度与亚像素配准性能极佳，混叠效应产生最少。其主要缺点是产生下冲（振铃）伪影，但多数情况下可用所实现的钳位机制修复（见下方钳位阈值参数）。

双三次样条在准确性与执行速度方面都是极佳的插值算法。与 Lanczos 插值一样，双三次样条会产生振铃伪影，但所实现的钳制机制通常能修正其中大部分。双三次样条的主要问题是会产生混叠效应（如摩尔纹），这在噪声图像上可能成为问题，尤其是天空背景区域。这也是 Lanczos 通常更受青睐的原因之一。

双线性插值可用于配准低 SNR 的线性图像——在罕见的、Lanczos 与双三次样条插值在噪声像素之间产生过强振荡且钳制功能无法完全避免的情形下。双线性插值没有振铃伪影，但会在噪声区域产生强烈的混叠图案，且结果不如 Lanczos 与双三次样条准确。

三次滤波插值，例如 Mitchell-Netravali、Catmull-Rom 样条与三次 B 样条，提供更高的平滑度与子采样精度，当配准变换涉及相对较强的尺寸缩小时可能是必需的。

最近邻是最简单的像素插值方法。它总是产生最差的结果，尤其是在配准准确性方面（无法进行亚像素配准），并且由于插值方案过于简单会产生不连续。不过，在不涉及缩放与旋转时，最近邻会保留已配准图像的原始噪声分布，这一特性在某些图像分析应用中可能有用。

FILE:
Clamping threshold for the bicubic spline and Lanczos interpolation algorithms.

The main drawback of the Lanczos and bicubic spline interpolation algorithms is generation of strong undershooting (ringing) artifacts. This is caused by negative lobes of the interpolation functions falling over high-contrast edges and isolated bright pixels. This usually happens with linear data, such as raw CCD and DSLR images, and rarely with nonlinear or stretched images.

In the current PixInsight/PCL implementations of these algorithms we have included a clamping mechanism that prevents negative interpolated values and ringing artifacts for most images. This parameter represents a threshold value to trigger interpolation clamping. A lower threshold leads to a more aggressive deringing effect; however, too low of a clamping threshold can degrade interpolation performance, especially in terms of aliasing and detail preservation.
文件:
双三次样条与 Lanczos 插值算法的钳位阈值。

Lanczos 与双三次样条插值算法的主要缺点是产生强烈的下冲（振铃）伪影。原因在于插值函数的负瓣落在高对比边缘与孤立亮像素上。这通常发生于线性数据，如原始 CCD 与单反图像，很少发生于非线性或已拉伸图像。

在这些算法的当前 PixInsight/PCL 实现中，我们加入了钳位机制，可防止多数图像出现负插值值与振铃伪影。此参数是触发插值钳位的阈值。较低的阈值带来更激进的去环效果；不过钳位阈值过低会降低插值性能，尤其在混叠与细节保真方面。

FILE:
Selects a linear scaling sequence. Wavelet layers will be generated at dimensional scales following the sequence 1 + d*j, j >= 0 (1,1+d,1+2d,1+3d,...), where d is the scaling distance specified with this control.

The a trous wavelet transform algorithm is only defined to use the dyadic scaling sequence 2j, so using a linear sequence produces an invalid transform. However, for small-scale layers (say up to scales of 8 pixels or so) the errors introduced by a linear sequence are usually negligible. A linear sequence can provide more control over small-scale image structures, which can be useful for lunar, planetary and daylight images. The linear scaling sequence applied to large-scale layers will generate visible artifacts due to accumulated errors in the wavelet transform.
文件:
选择线性缩放序列。小波层将按 1 + d*j，j >= 0 的序列（1,1+d,1+2d,1+3d,...）在相应尺寸尺度上生成，其中 d 是用此控件指定的缩放距离。

带孔小波变换算法只对二进缩放序列 2j 有定义，因此使用线性序列会产生无效变换。不过对小尺度层（大致到 8 像素尺度左右），线性序列引入的误差通常可忽略。线性序列可对小尺度图像结构提供更多控制，对月球、行星与日光图像有用。把线性缩放序列应用于大尺度层，会因小波变换中的误差累积而产生可见伪影。

FILE:
Increase/decrease bias to increase/decrease the relative weight of a wavelet layer in the reconstructed image. A zero bias value does not change the relative weight of a wavelet layer.

The bias parameter defines a multiplicative factor applied to a whole wavelet layer. Increase the bias parameter to enhance all the structures supported by a specific layer. Note that this includes the whole layer contents, that is both significant structures and noise. Typically bias can be increased at scales from 2 to 4 pixels for local contrast enhancement purposes (aka sharpening).
文件:
增大/减小偏置可增大/减小某个小波层在重建图像中的相对权重。偏置取 0 不改变小波层的相对权重。

偏置参数定义施加于整个小波层的乘性因子。增大偏置可增强某一特定层所承载的全部结构。注意这既包括重要结构也包括噪声。通常可在 2 至 4 像素尺度上增大偏置以增强局部对比（即锐化）。

FILE:
Defines a threshold in sigma units for removal of wavelet coefficients in the current layer. All wavelet coefficients with absolute values below this threshold will be attenuated by a process known as soft thresholding when the noise reduction feature is enabled for a particular wavelet layer. The amount parameter defines the strength of this attenuation.

Increase threshold to remove more structures. Typically, a value around 3 sigma is appropriate for the first wavelet layer. Successive layers normally require smaller thresholds (the larger the layer scale, the smaller threshold is usually required), but the actual values depend on the properties and distribution of the noise in the image. Too large of a threshold will damage significant structures. Try to adjust this parameter to the smallest value able to remove the noise as you wish on each wavelet layer.
文件:
定义以 sigma 为单位的阈值，用于去除当前层的小波系数。当某一小波层启用降噪时，所有绝对值低于此阈值的系数都会通过称为软阈值的过程被衰减。量参数定义该衰减强度。

增大阈值可去除更多结构。对第一小波层通常取约 3 sigma 较为合适。后续各层通常需要更小阈值（层尺度越大，所需阈值通常越小），但实际取值取决于图像中噪声的性质与分布。阈值过大会损伤重要结构。请尽量把此参数调到在该小波层刚好能按需去除噪声的最小值。

FILE:

文件:
降噪迭代次数

通过把量参数设为小于 1 的值并采用两次或更多迭代，降噪过程可以更可控。多次迭代也可用于施加更强的降噪效果。

FILE:
The k-sigma thresholding method can be used to attenuate or remove all wavelet coefficients below a prescribed value in all layers of the wavelet transform. This method assumes a Gaussian noise distribution and takes into account the relative weights of Gaussian noise in each wavelet layer. These weights are functions of the employed wavelet scaling function and have been hard-coded in the ATrousWaveletTransform tool.

In general, k-sigma thresholding should not be used for noise reduction purposes, since the implemented per-layer noise reduction routine is much more accurate and controllable. This procedure can be useful for auxiliary image processing tasks, such as mask generation or feature detection.
文件:
k-sigma 阈值法可用于衰减或去除小波变换各层中低于规定值的所有小波系数。此方法假定噪声服从高斯分布，并计入各小波层中高斯噪声的相对权重。这些权重是所用小波缩放函数的函数，已硬编码在 ATrousWaveletTransform 工具中。

一般而言，k-sigma 阈值不宜用于降噪目的，因为所实现的逐层降噪例程更精确、更可控。此过程可用于辅助性图像处理任务，如生成蒙版或特征检测。

Large-scale function applied to the wavelet residual layer:

No function disables the large-scale transfer function. This is the default option.

Hyperbolic applies a hyperbolic function to the residual wavelet layer. This has a similar effect to the classical digital development processing (DDP) technique; however, this multiscale implementation is much better than the classical DDP because the transformation is applied just where it is needed: on the large-scale illumination profile, without affecting the rest of image structures. FILE:
Shape of the filter function.

This parameter controls the kurtosis of the filter function distribution. When shape = 2 the filter distribution is Gaussian (also known as normal distribution). When shape < 2 the distribution is leptokurtic, leading to a peaked filter that can be used, for example, to approximate the shape of a diffraction pattern. When shape > 2 the distribution is platykurtic and the filter has a comparatively flat profile, resembling a truncated (or saturated) PSF.
文件:

此参数控制滤波器函数分布的峰度。形状 = 2 时滤波器分布为高斯（也称正态分布）。形状 < 2 时分布为尖峰态，得到尖锐的滤波器，例如可用于逼近衍射图样的形状。形状 > 2 时分布为平峰态，滤波器轮廓相对平坦，类似截断（或饱和）的 PSF。

FILE:
Rescale out-of-range values for normalization of images after convolution with a high-pass filter.

A high-pass filter has negative coefficients. As a result, some pixels in the convolved image may have negative values. Saturated pixels (values above one) can also result, depending on the filter coefficients. The standard behavior is to truncate out-of-range pixel values to the [0,1] range, which preserves the dynamics of the convolved image, so high-pass rescaling is disabled by default. When high-pass rescaling is enabled, the resulting image is normalized (that is, rescaled to [0,1] only if there are out-of-range values) and hence all the data after convolution are preserved at the cost of reducing the overall contrast of the image.
文件:
对与高通滤波器卷积后的图像做归一化时，重缩放超范围值。

高通滤波器的系数含负值。因此卷积后图像中某些像素可能为负值。视滤波器系数而定，也可能出现饱和像素（值大于一）。标准行为是把超范围像素值截断到 [0,1] 范围，这保留了卷积后图像的动态范围，因此高通重缩放默认禁用。启用高通重缩放后，结果图像会被归一化（即仅在存在超范围值时重缩放到 [0,1]），因此卷积后的所有数据都被保留，代价是图像整体对比度降低。

Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In Debayer, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded, while output hints modify the way output demosaiced image files are written.

For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Saturation threshold in the [0,1] range.

Detected stars with one or more pixels with values above this threshold will be excluded for signal evaluation. This parameter is expressed in the [0,1] range. It can applied either as an absolute pixel sample value in the normalized [0,1] range, or as a value relative to the maximum pixel sample value of the measured image (see the Relative saturation threshold parameter).

The default saturation threshold is 1.0. For signal evaluation, the implemented star detection and outlier rejection routines are normally able to avoid contamination from saturated sources, so the default value of this parameter should not be changed under normal conditions.
文件:
位于 [0,1] 范围的饱和阈值。

检测到的恒星若有任一像素值高于此阈值，将被排除在信号评估之外。此参数以 [0,1] 范围表示。它既可作为归一化 [0,1] 范围内的绝对像素样本值施加，也可作为相对于被测图像最大像素样本值的值（见相对饱和阈值参数）。

默认饱和阈值为 1.0。对于信号评估，所实现的恒星检测与离群值剔除例程通常能够避免饱和源的污染，因此正常条件下不应修改此参数的默认值。

FILE:
Size of the hot pixel removal filter.

This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. If not removed, hot pixels will be identified as stars, and if present in large amounts, can prevent a valid signal evaluation.

To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件:
热像素去除滤波器的大小。

这是恒星检测器在结构检测阶段之前施加的中值滤波器半径（像素）。中值滤波器去除热像素非常有效。若不去除，热像素会被判为恒星，若数量很多会妨碍有效的信号评估。

要禁用热像素去除，请把此参数设为零。

FILE:
Point spread function type used for PSF fitting and photometry.

In all cases elliptical functions are fitted to detected star structures, and PSF sampling regions are defined adaptively using a median stabilization algorithm.

When the Auto option is selected, a series of different PSFs will be fitted for each source, and the fit that leads to the least absolute difference among function values and sampled pixel values will be used for flux measurement. Currently the following functions are tested in this special automatic mode: Moffat functions with beta shape parameters equal to 2.5, 4, 6 and 10.

The rest of options select a fixed PSF type for all detected sources, which improves execution times at the cost of a less adaptive, and hence potentially less accurate, signal estimation process.
文件:
用于 PSF 拟合与测光的点扩散函数类型。

所有情况下都会对检测到的恒星结构拟合椭圆函数，并使用中值稳定算法自适应地定义 PSF 采样区域。

选择 自动选项时，会为每个源拟合一系列不同的 PSF，并采用使函数值与采样像素值之间绝对差最小的拟合来测量光通量。目前在此特殊自动模式下测试以下函数：beta 形状参数等于 2.5、4、6 与 10 的 Moffat 函数。

其余选项为所有检测到的源指定固定 PSF 类型，这可缩短执行时间，代价是信号估计过程适应性较差、因而可能精度较低。

FILE:
Size of the noise reduction filter.

This is the radius in pixels of a Gaussian convolution filter applied to the working image used for star detection. Use it only for very low SNR images, where the star detector cannot find reliable stars with its default parameters.

To disable noise reduction, set this parameter to zero.
文件:
降噪滤波器的尺寸。

这是施加于恒星检测所用工作表图像的高斯卷积滤波器的半径（像素）。仅对信噪比极低的图像使用，因为此时恒星检测器用默认参数找不到可靠恒星。

把此参数设为零即可关闭降噪。

FILE:
Compute per-channel estimates of the standard deviation of the noise and noise scaling factors for each target image, using a selected multiscale algorithm (MRS noise estimator by default). Noise estimates will be stored as a set of custom XISF properties and FITS header keywords in the output files.

These estimates can be used later by several processes and scripts for specialized image analysis purposes, most notably by SubframeSelector and ImageIntegration for image grading and weighting. Noise estimates will always be computed from uninterpolated, raw calibrated data.

This option should always be enabled under normal working conditions.
文件:
对每幅目标图像，用所选多尺度算法（默认 MRS 噪声估计器）逐通道计算噪声标准差与噪声缩放因子的估计值。噪声估计将以一组自定义 XISF 属性与 FITS 头关键字存入输出文件。

这些估计值之后可被若干过程与脚本用于专门的图像分析目的，其中最主要是被 SubframeSelector 与 ImageIntegration 用于图像分级与加权。噪声估计始终从未插值的、原始校准数据计算。

正常条件下应始终启用此选项。

FILE:
The maximum number of stars that can be measured to compute mean signal estimates.

PSF photometry will be performed for no more than the specified number of stars. The subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.

The default value imposes a generous limit of 24K stars. Limiting the number of photometric samples can improve performance for wide-field frames, where the number of detected stars can be very large. However, reducing the set of measured sources too much will damage the accuracy of signal estimation.
文件:
为计算平均信号估计而可测量的最大恒星数量。

PSF 测光执行的恒星数量不超过所指定数目。被测恒星的子集始终从检测到的恒星集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。

默认值给出 24K 颗恒星的宽松上限。限制测光样本数量可提升广域帧的性能，因为这类图像中可检测恒星数量可能极大。但把实测源集合削减过多会损害信号估计的准确性。

FILE:
Noise evaluation algorithm. This option selects an algorithm for automatic estimation of the standard deviation of the noise in the calibrated images.

The multiresolution support (MRS) noise estimation routine implements the iterative algorithm described by Jean-Luc Starck and Fionn Murtagh in their paper Automatic Noise Estimation from the Multiresolution Support (Publications of the Royal Astronomical Society of the Pacific, vol. 110, pp. 193-199). In our implementation, the standard deviation of the noise is evaluated on the first four wavelet layers, assuming a Gaussian noise distribution. MRS is a remarkably accurate and robust algorithm and the default option for noise evaluation.

The iterative k-sigma clipping algorithm can be used as a last-resort option in cases where the MRS algorithm does not converge systematically. This can happen on images with no detectable small-scale noise; for example, images that have been smoothed as a result of bilinear demosaicing interpolation.

The N* robust noise estimator extracts a subset of residual pixels by comparison with a large-scale model of the local background of the image, generated with the multiscale median transform (MMT). Since the MMT is remarkably efficient at isolating image structures, it can be used to detect pixels that cannot contribute to significant structures. N* is an accurate and robust, alternative estimator of the standard deviation of the noise that does not assume or require any particular statistical distribution in the analyzed data.
文件:
噪声评估算法。此选项选择一个算法，用于自动估计已校准图像中的噪声标准差。

多分辨率支撑（MRS）噪声估计例程实现了 Jean-Luc Starck 与 Fionn Murtagh 在论文Automatic Noise Estimation from the Multiresolution Support（Publications of the Royal Astronomical Society of the Pacific, vol. 110, pp. 193-199）中描述的迭代算法。在我们的实现中，噪声标准差在前四个小波层上评估，假定噪声服从高斯分布。MRS 是一种极其精确、稳健的算法，也是噪声评估的默认选项。

在 MRS 算法无法系统性收敛的情形下，迭代 k-sigma 削顶算法可作为最后手段。这会发生于没有可检测小尺度噪声的图像上，例如因双线性去马赛克插值而变得平滑的图像。

N* 稳健噪声估计器通过与该图像局部背景大尺度模型（用多尺度中值变换 MMT 生成）比较，提取残差像素的一个子集。由于 MMT 在分离图像结构方面极其高效，可用来检测无法构成重要结构的像素。N* 是一种精确、稳健的噪声标准差替代估计器，不假定也不要求被分析数据服从任何特定统计分布。

FILE:
Standard deviation of the parametric PSF function.

By increasing this parameter the PSF will be larger, and hence the deconvolution process will act at larger dimensional scales.
文件: 参数化 PSF 函数的标准差。

FILE:
Overall shape of the PSF function.

This parameter controls the kurtosis of the PSF function distribution. When shape = 2 the function distribution is Gaussian (also known as normal distribution). When shape < 2 the distribution is leptokurtic, leading to a peaked PSF that can be used, for example, to approximate the shape of a diffraction pattern. When shape > 2 the distribution is platykurtic and the PSF has a comparatively flat profile.
文件:
PSF 函数的整体形状。

此参数控制 PSF 函数分布的峰度。形状 = 2 时函数分布为高斯（也称正态分布）。形状 < 2 时分布为尖峰态，得到尖锐的 PSF，例如可用于逼近衍射图样的形状。形状 > 2 时分布为平峰态，PSF 轮廓相对平坦。

FILE:
Specify the identifier of an existing view to be used as the deringing support image. Must be a grayscale image with the same dimensions as the target image.

The deringing support is optional; if you don't specify it, the global deringing algorithm will be applied uniformly to the whole image. The deringing support allows you to use a star mask to drive a local deringing algorithm that can enhance protection of stars and other high-contrast, small-scale image structures.
文件:
指定作为去环支撑图像的现有视图标识符。必须是灰度图像，且与目标图像尺寸相同。

去环支撑是可选的；若不指定，全局去环算法将均匀施加于全图。去环支撑让你能用星点蒙版驱动局部去环算法，从而更好地保护恒星与其他高对比小尺度图像结构。

FILE:
Local deringing regularization strength.

This value will multiply the deringing support image (internally only; the support image is not modified at all). In this way you can modulate the local deringing effect.
文件:
局部去环正则化强度。

此值将乘以去环支撑图像（仅在内部；支撑图像完全不被修改）。这样你可以调制局部去环效果。

FILE:
Number of regularization wavelet scales

Increase to apply noise reduction to larger image structures.
文件:
正则化小波尺度数

增大以为更大的图像结构施加降噪。

FILE:
Regularization thresholds in sigma units

Larger thresholds will apply noise reduction to more structures at each wavelet scale.
文件:
正则化阈值，以 sigma 为单位

更大的阈值会在每个小波尺度上为更多结构施加降噪。

FILE:
Automatic convergence limit in differential sigma units

Set to zero to perform the specified maximum number of iterations.
文件:
自动收敛上限，以微分 sigma 为单位

设为零则执行指定的最大迭代次数。
