EphemerisGenerator can be used to integrate orbital motion for a single object, with initial conditions defined manually, or for a set of objects with parameters and initial conditions acquired from a database.

In the single object case, you specify the initial conditions as either six state vectors (position and velocity vectors), or equivalently, as a set of osculating orbital elements (semimajor axis, eccentricity, inclination, etc). In both cases the initial conditions must be valid at the specified epoch.

For integration of orbits for objects defined in a database, you can specify a local database file in several standard plain text formats; see the database file parameter for more information.

对椭圆与（近）抛物线轨道，此参数必须 > 0；对双曲轨道，必须 < 0。

Name of the object. For example, an asteroid name such as 'Astraea' for 5 Astraea, the designation of an unnumbered minor planet such as '2006 QH181', or a comet name such as '1/P Halley'.

FILE:
A comma-separated list of search tokens or regular expressions that will be used to select a subset of database objects for numerical integration and ephemeris generation.

Each item in the comma-separated list will be interpreted either as a regular expression (ECMAScript format, case-insensitive) if the Regular expressions option is selected, or as a literal search token otherwise.

Regular Expressions

Regular expressions will be applied to object identifiers and names. Only those objects with identifiers or names that match one of the regular expressions will be included in the search result.

For example, to select a list of objects given by their asteroid numbers from an asteroid database (such as Lowell's astorb.dat for example), the following list could be used:

10,40,41,127

This would select the following asteroids: 10 Hygiea, 40 Harmonia, 41 Daphne, 127 Johanna. The following list would produce exactly the same result:

10,Harmonia,41,127

since regular expressions are matched against object identifiers and names. Expression matching is case-insensitive, so 'harmonia' would also work in this case.

The following regular expression will select the asteroids with numbers from 100 to 195:

1[0-9][0-5]

This one will select unnamed asteroids whose designations start with '2020 ':

2020\s.+

For a good online tutorial on regular expressions, check regexone.com.

Search Ranges

When the Regular expressions option is disabled, search tokens can specify identifier ranges with the form:

n1->n2

where n1 and n2 are two integer numbers. Only the set of asteroids with numbers within the range [n1,n2] will be selected. For example:

125->500,1000->1500

will select the numbered asteroids from 125 to 500 and from 1000 to 1500.

Literal Search Tokens

When the Regular expressions option is disabled and a search token does not specify a search range, it will be interpreted as a case-insensitive substring that will be searched for literally in object identifiers and names. For example, the following search tokens:

shoemaker-levy 9

would select all fragments of comet D/1993 F2 Shoemaker-Levy 9 (21 objects).

FILE:
The numerical integration algorithm.

IAS15 is a 15th-order implicit integrator based on Gauss-Radau quadrature with adaptive time stepping (H. Rein and D. S. Spiegel, MNRAS 446, 1424 (2015)). It keeps the truncation error of the scheme well below floating point round-off, and makes round-off errors unbiased through compensated summation, so that the accumulated error follows Brouwer's law over very long integrations. It handles close encounters, highly eccentric orbits, and velocity-dependent forces such as relativistic and non-gravitational perturbations. This is the default and recommended option.

Bulirsch-Stoer is the adaptive Bulirsch-Stoer extrapolation method with dense output implemented by the Boost.Odeint library, controlled by absolute and relative tolerances derived from the floating point precision of the integration. This was the only integrator available in previous versions of this tool.
文件:
数值积分算法。

IAS15 是基于 Gauss-Radau 求积、带自适应时间步长的 15 阶隐式积分器（H. Rein 与 D. S. Spiegel, MNRAS 446, 1424 (2015)）。它使算法的截断误差远低于浮点舍入误差，并通过补偿求和使舍入误差无偏，从而在极长积分中累积误差遵循 Brouwer 定律。它能处理近距交会、高偏心率轨道，以及依赖速度的力，如相对论与非引力摄动。这是默认且推荐的选项。

Bulirsch-Stoer 是由 Boost.Odeint 库实现、带稠密输出的自适应 Bulirsch-Stoer 外推法，其绝对与相对容差由积分的浮点精度导出。这是本工具早前版本中唯一可用的积分器。

FILE:
The XEPH file providing fundamental solar system ephemerides.

If this field is left blank (or with its default <core default> value), the default core fundamental ephemerides file will be used.
文件:
提供太阳系基本星历的 XEPH 文件。

若此字段留空（或保持默认的 <core default> 值），将使用默认的核心基本星历文件。

FILE:
Dimensionless precision parameter of the IAS15 integrator (εb in Rein and Spiegel (2015)). It bounds the relative contribution of the last term in the series expansion of the acceleration within each integration step, from which the adaptive step size is derived. The default value of 10-9 ensures machine precision after each step and keeps the truncation error of the scheme negligible with respect to round-off errors over very long integrations. Larger values yield longer steps and faster integrations at the expense of accuracy. Smaller values are rarely useful, since random round-off errors dominate the total error.

For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "up-bottom" input hint to load input images from FITS files with the coordinate origin at the top-left corner. FILE:
Star detection sensitivity.

Internally, the sensitivity of the star detection algorithm is expressed in signal-to-noise ratio units with respect to the evaluated dispersion of local background pixels for each detected structure. Given a source with estimated brightness s, local background b and local background dispersion n, sensitivity is the minimum value of (s - b)/n necessary to trigger star detection.

To isolate this interface from the internal implementation, this parameter is normalized to the [0,1] range, where 0 and 1 represent minimum and maximum sensitivity, respectively. This abstraction allows us to change the star detection engine without breaking dependent tools and processes.

Increase this parameter to favor detection of fainter stars. Decrease it to restrict detection to brighter stars. The default value is 0.5. In general, you shouldn't need to change the default value of this parameter under normal working conditions.
文件:
恒星检测灵敏度。

内部而言，恒星检测算法的灵敏度以信噪比单位表示，相对于每个被检测结构的局部背景像素评估离散度。对于估计亮度为 s、局部背景为 b、局部背景离散度为 n 的源，灵敏度是触发恒星检测所需的 (s - b)/n 最小值。

为使此界面与内部实现解耦，此参数归一化到 [0,1] 范围，0 与 1 分别代表最小与最大灵敏度。这种抽象让我们可以更换恒星检测引擎而不破坏依赖它的工具与过程。

增大此参数有利于检测更暗的恒星；减小则把检测限制在较亮的恒星。默认值为 0.5。正常条件下一般不需要改动此参数的默认值。

FILE:
Maximum number of stars allowed.

In the default automatic mode, FastIntegration will perform a series of tries using a predefined sequence of star counts if the initial attempt to register the images fails. This is the recommended setting. To select the automatic mode, specify zero as the value of this parameter.

Increasing the amount of reference stars is in general not necessary, and it usually just slows down the image registration process with no improvement in registration accuracy. However, when registering images with little overlapping (mosaics, or images with large scale differences), it may be necessary using a reduced or expanded set of reference stars, depending on a variety of working scenarios. In these cases, the automatic probing sequence usually works very well, so you normally should not need to change the default value of this parameter.

在默认自动模式下，若初次尝试配准图像失败，FastIntegration 会按预定义的恒星数量序列做一系列尝试。这是推荐设置。要选择自动模式，请把此参数设为零。

一般来说增加参考恒星数量并不必要，且通常只会拖慢图像配准过程，而配准准确性没有提升。不过，在配准重叠很少的图像（马赛克，或尺度差异很大的图像）时，视不同工作情形可能需要使用减少或扩张的参考恒星集合。这些情况下自动探测序列通常效果很好，因此通常不需要修改此参数的默认值。

FILE:
Use full alignment as a fallback alignment method when the fast alignment fails.

Enabling the full alignment is fundamental if a discontinuity in the framing is expected in one or more points of the sequence. When the first frame with a significantly different framing has to be aligned, fast integration will fail because the reference stars will not be found in a neigborhood of their expected location; in this case the full alignment may generate a new reference solution that can be propagated to the subsequent frames.

The full alignment is also used as a fallback attempt to align a frame using more stars than the ones used by the fast alignment in case the tolerance is not met.

This option is enabled by default, but you may disable it for the only purpose of increasing the execution speed at the cost of rejecting more frames when the fast alignment method does not respect the given tolerance.
文件:
快速对齐失败时，使用完整对齐作为回退对齐方法。

若预期序列中某处出现取景断裂，启用完整对齐至关重要。当必须对齐第一帧取景显著不同的图像时，快速积分会失败，因为在其预期位置邻域内找不到参考星；此时完整对齐可能生成新的参考解，并传播到后续帧。

完整对齐也用作回退尝试：当容差未满足时，用比快速对齐更多的恒星来对齐一帧。

此选项默认启用；但你可以仅在需要提速时禁用它，代价是当快速对齐方法不满足给定容差时会剔除更多帧。

FILE:
Type of geometrical descriptor used by the star matching algorithm.

Triangle similarity uses triangles formed with detected stars and matches them by triangle similarity. These descriptors are invariant to translation, rotation and uniform scaling, so they can be used to register two images related by an affine transformation. In addition, triangle similarity is invariant to reflection, so these descriptors can be used to register images related also by specular transformations: horizontal and vertical mirroring, along with affine transformations.

Polygon descriptors (triangles, quadrilaterals, etc.) generate polygons of the specified number of sides with detected stars. Each polygon is described in a local coordinate system defined by its two most distant points, and the rest of points (from one to six) form a hash code with their local coordinates. Polygon descriptors are invariant to translation, rotation and scaling, and can account for relatively large amounts of local distortion, including projective transformations. One disadvantage of polygon descriptors is that they cannot be used to register images related by specular transformations.

Polygon descriptors such as quadrilaterals (also known as "quads") and pentagons are more flexible and robust than triangle similarity. Their lack of support for specular transformations is of little practical importance. However, polygons are more computationally intensive and require more memory. Triangle similarity works reliably for normal image registration tasks of similar images, but more complex tasks such as registration of dissimilar images, registration under large scale differences, arbitrary distortions and mosaics, usually require more robust descriptors like quads, pentagons, or hexagons. Pentagon descriptors are used by default.
文件:
恒星匹配算法所用的几何描述子类型。

三角形相似用检测到的恒星构成三角形，并按三角形相似性匹配。这类描述子对平移、旋转与均匀缩放不变，因此可用于配准由仿射变换关联的两幅图像。此外，三角形相似对反射不变，因此这些描述子也可用于配准还涉及镜像变换（水平与垂直镜像）及仿射变换的图像。

多边形描述子（三角形、四边形等）用检测到的恒星生成指定边数的多边形。每个多边形在其两个最远点定义的局部坐标系中描述，其余点（1 至 6 个）用其局部坐标构成哈希码。多边形描述子对平移、旋转与缩放不变，且能容忍相对较大的局部畸变，包括投影变换。多边形描述子的一个缺点是无法用于配准由镜像变换关联的图像。

四边形（又称“quads”）与五边形等多边形描述子比三角形相似更灵活、更稳健。它们不支持镜像变换，这在实践中影响很小。但多边形计算量更大、内存需求更高。对相似图像的常规配准任务，三角形相似工作可靠；但更复杂的任务，如不同图像的配准、大尺度差异下的配准、任意畸变与马赛克，通常需要四边形、五边形或六边形等更稳健的描述子。默认使用五边形描述子。

FILE:
The maximum number of iterations performed while searching a star.

Each time a reference star is not found in the current searching area a new iteration is performed, extending the search area by a fixed amount to increase the chances of finding the reference star.
This parameter determines the maximum number of iterations performed before considering a reference star as not found.
文件:
搜索恒星时执行的最大迭代次数。

每当在当前搜索区域内未找到参考星，就执行一次新迭代，把搜索区域按固定量扩大，以提高找到参考星的机会。
此参数决定在认定参考星未找到之前执行的最大迭代次数。

FILE:
The size in pixels of the reference star's search region.

Each reference star's position is expected to be slightly shifted in each frame. As a first attempt, a reference star is searched within a region surrounding a location where it was found in one of the prevoius frames.

Increase this parameter to make the search operations more robust against strong tracking drifts. Decrease this parameter to slightly gain speed if the tracking has no significant drift.
文件:
参考星搜索区域的尺寸（像素）。

每颗参考星的位置在各帧中都预期会有轻微偏移。作为首次尝试，会在前几帧中找到该参考星的位置周围区域内搜索。

增大此参数可使搜索操作对强跟踪漂移更稳健；若跟踪没有显著漂移，减小此参数可略微提速。

FILE:
This parameter sets the criteria for accepting a star as a reference by considering neighboring stars within its search box.

A reference star must be significantly brighter than any star within its search area. This parameter defines the maximum allowable flux ratio between any star in the search box and the flux of the reference star at its center. To qualify as a reference star, the flux of any other star must be lower than that of the reference star, as specified by this ratio.

Decrease this value to prefer reference stars with fewer fainter neighboring stars, down to zero if you require a reference star with no neighboring stars in its search box. Increase this value to be more lenient and allow the presence of more fainter stars in the search box.

A value of zero is appropriate for fields that are not overly crowded. Increase this value if the starfield is densely populated, and you must include more reference stars.
文件:
此参数设定接受某颗恒星作为参考的准则，方式是考察其搜索框内的邻近恒星。

参考星必须显著亮于其搜索区域内的任何恒星。此参数定义搜索框内任何恒星与中心处参考星通量之间允许的最大通量比。要成为参考星，其他任何恒星的通量都必须低于参考星，如此比值所规定。

减小此值可优先选择周围暗星较少的参考星，直到取零——若你要求参考星的搜索框内没有任何邻近恒星。增大此值则更宽松，允许搜索框内存在更多暗星。

取零值适用于不太拥挤的视场。若星场密集且必须纳入更多参考星，请增大此值。

FILE:
When the precise alignment is enabled, you manually select a star in the reference frame that will be accurately aligned.

Enabling precise alignment guarantees that a specific image region will be registered at the sub-pixel level. When the alignment solution is found on each frame, a final sub-pixel translation will be applied to match the centroids of the selected star and the corresponding star on the aligned image.

This approach effectively improves the details in the surroundings of a specific area of the master light. Use this option if you have a relatively small target in the image you want to enhance, like a small planetary nebula or a galaxy.

If the goal is to have a good alignment across the entire frame, then the precise alignment should remain disabled.
文件:
启用精确对齐后，你在参考帧中手动选取一颗将被精确对齐的恒星。

启用精确对齐可确保特定图像区域在亚像素级别完成配准。当在每帧上求得对齐解后，会施加最终的亚像素平移，使所选恒星的质心与对齐图像上对应恒星的质心匹配。

这种方法能有效改善 Master Light 中特定区域周围的细节。若你想增强的图像中有相对较小的目标（如小行星状星云或星系），请使用此选项。

若目标是全画面良好对齐，则应保持精确对齐禁用。

FILE:
Pixel interpolation algorithm

The automatic mode will select the following interpolation algorithms as a function of the rescaling involved in the registration geometrical transformation:

  • Cubic B-spline filter interpolation when the scaling factor is under 0.25 approximately.
  • Mitchell-Netravali filter interpolation for scaling factors between 0.6 and 0.25 approx.
  • Lanczos-3 interpolation in the rest of cases: from moderate size reductions to no rescaling or rescaling up.

Lanczos is, in general, the best interpolation algorithm for image registration of linear images when no large scale changes are required. Lanczos has excellent detail preservation and subpixel registration performance with minimal generation of aliasing effects. Its main drawback is generation of undershoot (ringing) artifacts, but this problem can be fixed in most cases with the implemented clamping mechanism (see the clamping threshold parameter below).

Bicubic spline is an excellent interpolation algorithm in terms of accuracy and execution speed. As Lanczos interpolation, bicubic spline generates ringing artifacts, but the implemented clamping mechanism can usually fix most of them. The main problem with bicubic spline is generation of aliasing effects, such as moire patterns, which can be problematic with noisy images, especially on sky background areas.

Bilinear interpolation can be useful to register low SNR linear images, in the rare cases where Lanczos and bicubic spline interpolation generates too strong oscillations between noisy pixels that can't be avoided completely with the clamping feature. Bilinear interpolation has no ringing artifacts, but it generates strong aliasing patterns on noisy areas and provides less accurate results than Lanczos and bicubic spline.

Cubic filter interpolations, such as Mitchell-Netravali, Catmull-Rom spline and cubic B-spline, provide higher smoothness and subsampling accuracy that can be necessary when the registration transformation involves relatively strong size reductions.

Nearest neighbor is the simplest possible pixel interpolation method. It always produces the worst results, especially in terms of registration accuracy (no subpixel registration is possible), and discontinuities due to the simplistic interpolation scheme. However, in absence of scaling and rotation nearest neighbor preserves the original noise distribution in the registered images, a property that can be necessary in some image analysis applications.
文件:
像素插值算法

自动模式将根据配准几何变换所涉及的重新缩放，选择以下插值算法：

Lanczos 通常是在不需要大尺度变化时对线性图像进行图像配准的最佳插值算法。Lanczos 在细节保留与亚像素配准方面表现优异，且混叠效应生成极少。其主要缺点是产生下冲（振铃）伪影，但在大多数情况下可用所实现的钳制机制修正此问题（见下方钳制阈值参数）。

双三次样条在精度与执行速度方面都是极佳的插值算法。与 Lanczos 插值一样，双三次样条会产生振铃伪影，但所实现的钳位机制通常能修复大部分。双三次样条的主要问题是产生混叠效应，如摩尔纹，这在噪声图像上可能造成困扰，尤其在天空背景区域。

双线性插值可用于配准低 SNR 的线性图像——在罕见的、Lanczos 与双三次样条插值在噪声像素之间产生过强振荡且钳制功能无法完全避免的情形下。双线性插值没有振铃伪影，但会在噪声区域产生强烈的混叠图案，且结果不如 Lanczos 与双三次样条准确。

三次滤波插值，例如 Mitchell-Netravali、Catmull-Rom 样条与三次 B 样条，提供更高的平滑度与子采样精度，当配准变换涉及相对较强的尺寸缩小时可能是必需的。

最近邻是最简单的像素插值方法。它总是产生最差的结果，尤其在配准精度方面（无法做亚像素配准），以及因插值方案过于简单而造成的不连续。不过，在不涉及缩放与旋转时，最近邻能保留配准图像中的原始噪声分布，这一特性在某些图像分析应用中可能是必需的。

FILE:
Pixel Rejection algorithm

The iterative sigma clipping algorithm is usually a good option to integrate more than 10 or 15 images. Keep in mind that for sigma clipping to work, the standard deviation must be a good estimator of dispersion, which requires a sufficient number of pixels per stack (the more images the better).

Winsorized sigma clipping is similar to the normal sigma clipping algorithm, but uses a special iterative procedure based on Huber's method of robust estimation of parameters through Winsorization. This algorithm can yield superior rejection of outliers with better preservation of significant data for large sets of images.
文件:
像素剔除算法

迭代 sigma 裁剪算法通常是积分 10 或 15 幅以上图像的良好选择。请记住，sigma 裁剪要有效，标准差必须是离散度的良好估计，这要求每个栈有足够多的像素（图像越多越好）。

Winsor 化 sigma 裁剪与常规 sigma 裁剪算法类似，但使用一种基于 Huber 借助Winsor 化进行参数稳健估计方法的特殊迭代过程。对于大幅图像集合，该算法可以在更好地保留重要数据的同时，提供更优的离群值剔除效果。

FILE:
Weighting algorithm

The PSF SNR algorithm is a good option for achieving a higher SNR in the final image. This algorithm maximizes the PSF-SNR, estimated as the ratio between the star's flux and the square of the noise measured in the star's local background.

The Resolution algorithm is a good option to achieve finer details in the final image. This algorithm maximizes the ratio between the star's flux and its size, a trade-off between maximizing the signal and minimizing the area over which the signal is distributed.
文件:
加权算法

PSF SNR 算法是在最终图像中获得更高 SNR 的好选择。该算法最大化 PSF 信噪比，其估计方式为恒星通量与恒星局部背景中所测噪声平方之比。

分辨率算法是在最终图像中获得更精细细节的好选择。该算法最大化恒星通量与其尺寸之比，即在最大化信号与最小化信号分布面积之间的折中。

FILE:
Generate a CSV plain text file containing the weights assigned to each frame.

This option can be used to inspect how FastIntegration weighted the frames during its execution.
文件:
生成一个 CSV 纯文本文件，含每帧被赋予的权重。

此选项可用于检查 FastIntegration 执行期间如何对各帧加权。

FILE:
Number of working threads

This parameter allows limiting the number of processors used during FastIntegration execution.

If this value is zero, the number of working threads is limited only by the maximum number of processors allowed as defined in global preferences. If the global settings don't impose a specific limit, then the number of working threads will equal the number of physical processors available.

If this value is greater than zero, the maximum number of processors to use is still limited as per global settings.
文件:
工作线程数

此参数允许限制 FastIntegration 执行期间使用的处理器数。

若此值为零，工作线程数仅受全局偏好设置中允许的最大处理器数限制。若全局设置未施加特定限制，则工作线程数等于可用物理处理器数。

若此值大于零，最大可用处理器数仍按全局设置受限。

FILE:
The maximum number of frames to read in advance while the current batch is in progress.

Tune this parameter to balance the parallelization of I/O operations with respect to CPU worker threads. Increasing this value may increase the disk throughput at the cost of more RAM memory required.
文件:
当前批处理进行中提前读取的最大帧数。

调整此参数可平衡 I/O 操作与 CPU 工作线程的并行度。增大此值可能提升磁盘吞吐量，代价是需要更多内存。

FILE:
The number of frames to be integrated on each batch.

The integration process is organized in batches; each integration batch is performed when enough frames have been registered.
文件:
每批要积分的帧数。

积分过程按批组织；每批在已配准足够帧时执行。

FILE:
This parameter specifies how the transformation is to be applied to colour images.
Colour Images
The transformation can be applied to one of the R, G or B channels alone, or to all three. It can also be applied to the CIE Lightness channel or the Saturation. The final Colour option will stretch all three RGB channels by the same factor calculated by reference to the weighted average of the RGB values. This reflects the approach used in the standard arcsinh process.
Greyscale Images
This parameter, along with all the other colour option parameters, is ignored when the process is applied to a greyscale image.
文件:
此参数指定变换如何施加于彩色图像。
彩色图像
变换可单独施加于 R、G 或 B 其中之一，也可施加于三者。它也可施加于 CIE 亮度通道或饱和度。最后的「彩色」选项会按参考 RGB 值加权平均值算出的同一因子拉伸三个 RGB 通道，这反映了标准 arcsinh 过程所用的方式。
灰度图像
当过程施加于灰度图像时，此参数以及其他所有颜色选项参数均被忽略。

FILE: This parameter specifies what to do when undertaking a colour stretch if any channels relating to a specific pixel stretch to a value greater than 1. Clip: will simply clip all channels greater than 1 for that pixel back to 1. Rescale: will scale all three channels for that pixel down by the ratio 1/max(R,G,B). RGBBlend will blend in sufficient of an RGB stretch into that pixel to ensure all channels are not greater than 1.
文件: 此参数指定进行彩色拉伸时，若与某像素相关的任何通道拉伸后值大于 1 该如何处理。Clip：简单地把该像素所有大于 1 的通道剪回 1。Rescale：把该像素三个通道均按 1/max(R,G,B) 的比率下调。RGBBlend 会向该像素混入足够的 RGB 拉伸量，以确保所有通道不大于 1。

FILE: When using the colour stretch method this parameter will blend a proportion of a standard RGB stretch. This will mute the colour saturation for a strong initial data stretch. A value of 1 will not add any RGB stretch, a value of 0 is equivalent to a normal RGB stretch.
文件: 使用彩色拉伸方法时，此参数会混入一定比例的标准 RGB 拉伸。这会削弱强初始数据拉伸下的颜色饱和度。取 1 不加入任何 RGB 拉伸，取 0 等价于正常的 RGB 拉伸。

FILE: Check here to use coefficients from the RGB working space of the active image to derive the RGB weighted average for a colour stretch. If unchecked then equal weighted coefficients will be used.
文件: 勾选此项以使用活动图像 RGB 工作空间的系数来计算彩色拉伸的 RGB 加权平均值。若未勾选，则使用等权系数。

FILE: Specifies the transformation equations to use. In most cases this will be the Generalised Hyperbolic Stretch equations designed for this module. Other options include the midtone transfer function used in the Histogram Transformation process, and the arcsinh and power law functions. To each of these the module brings additional functionality. Alternatively a linear stretch can be selected.
文件: 指定要使用的变换方程。多数情况下即为此模块设计的广义双曲拉伸方程。其他选项包括直方图变换过程所用的中间调传递函数，以及 arcsinh 与幂律函数。模块为其中每一项都带来了额外功能。也可以选择线性拉伸。

FILE: Controls how tightly focused the stretch is around the Symetry point by changing the form of the transform itself. For concentrated stretches (such as initial stretches on linear images) a large +ve b factor should be employed to focus a stretch within a histogram peak while de-focusing the stretch away from the histogram peak (such as bright stars). For adjustment of non-linear images, lower or -ve b (and/or lower D) parameters should be employed to distribute contrast and brightness more evenly. Large positive values of 'b' can be thought of as a histogram widener, ie spreading the histogram wider about the focus point, SP. By contrast, lower and -ve values of b tend to shift the histogram to a brighter (or dimmer) position without affecting its width too greatly. As a general rule, the level of b employed will decrease as a stretch sequence nears completion, although larger +ve b values (with small D) can still be employed for precise placement of additional contrast.
文件: 通过改变变换本身的形式，控制拉伸围绕对称点的聚焦紧密程度。对于集中式拉伸（如线性图像的初始拉伸），应采用较大的正 b 因子，使拉伸聚焦在直方图峰内，同时在远离直方图峰处（如亮星）失焦。调整非线性图像时，应采用较低或负的 b（和/或较低的 D）参数，使对比度与亮度分布更均匀。较大的正 b 值可视为直方图加宽器，即把直方图围绕焦点 SP 展宽。相反，较低与负的 b 值倾向于把直方图移到更亮（或更暗）的位置，而不太影响其宽度。一般规则：随着拉伸序列接近完成，所用的 b 水平会降低，不过仍可用较大的正 b 值（配合较小的 D）来精确放置额外的对比度。

FILE: Sets the focus point around which the stretch is applied - contrast will be distributed symmetrically about SP. While 'b' provides the degree of focus of the stretch, SP determines where that focus is applied. SP should generally be placed within a histogram peak so that the stretch will widen and lower the peak by adding the most contrast in the stretch at that point. Pixel values will move away from the SP location. This parameter must be greater than or equal to the Shadow protection parameter and less than or equal to the Highlight protection parameter.
文件: 设置施加拉伸所围绕的焦点 —— 对比度将围绕 SP 对称分布。b 提供拉伸的聚焦程度，SP 则决定该聚焦施加在何处。SP 一般应放在直方图峰内，这样拉伸会在该点加入最多对比度，从而使峰加宽并降低。像素值将远离 SP 位置移动。此参数必须大于或等于暗部保护参数，且小于或等于高光保护参数。

FILE: Sets a value below which the stretch is modified to preserve contrast in the shadows/lowlights. This is done by performing a linear stretch of the data below the 'LP' level by reserving contrast from the rest of the image. Moving the LP level towards the current setting of SP changes both the scope (range) and the amount of this contrast reservation, the net effect is to push the overal stretch to higher brightness levels while keeping the contrast and definition in the background. The amount of contrast reserved for the lowlights is such that the continuity of the stretch is preserved. This parameter must be greater than or equal to 0 and not greater than the Symmetry point.
文件: 设置一个值，低于此值的拉伸会被修改，以保留阴影/暗部中的对比度。做法是对低于“LP”水平的数据做线性拉伸，从图像其余部分预留出对比度。把 LP 水平移向当前 SP 设置，会同时改变这一对比度预留的范围与数量，净效果是把整体拉伸推向更高亮度水平，同时保持背景的对比度与细节定义。为暗部预留的对比度量以保持拉伸的连续性为准。此参数必须大于或等于 0，且不大于对称点。

FILE: Sets a value above which the stretch is modified to preserve contrast in the highlights/stars. This is done by performing a linear stretch of the data above the 'HP' level by reserving contrast from the rest of the image. Moving the HP level towards the current setting of SP increases both the scope (range) and the amount of this contrast reservation, the net effect is to push the overal stretch to lower brightness levels while keeping the contrast and definition in the highlights. The amount of contrast reserved for the highlights is such that the continuity of the stretch is preserved. This parameter must be less than or equal to 1 and not less than the Symmetry point.
文件: 设置一个值，高于此值的拉伸会被修改，以保留高光/恒星中的对比度。做法是对高于“HP”水平的数据做线性拉伸，从图像其余部分预留出对比度。把 HP 水平移向当前 SP 设置，会同时增大这一对比度预留的范围与数量，净效果是把整体拉伸推向更低亮度水平，同时保持高光的对比度与细节定义。为高光预留的对比度量以保持拉伸的连续性为准。此参数必须小于或等于 1，且不小于对称点。

FILE: Sets the Blackpoint for a linear stretch of the image. Note that any pixel with values less than the Blackpoint input will be clipped and the data lost. Contrast gained by performing the linear stretch will be evenly distributed over the image, which will be dimmed. Pixels with values less than the Blackpoint will appear black and have 0 value. Updating this parameter will automatically update the low clipping proportion. Setting this parameter to a value less than 0 will extend the dynamic range at the low end.
文件: 设置图像线性拉伸的黑点。注意任何值小于所输入黑点的像素都将被削顶、数据丢失。执行线性拉伸获得的对比度将均匀分布到整幅图像上，图像会变暗。值小于黑点的像素将呈黑色、值为 0。更新此参数会自动更新低削顶比例。把此参数设为小于 0 的值可延伸低端动态范围。

FILE: Sets the clipping level for linear stretch of the image. Updating this parameter will automatically update the Blackpoint parameter in such a way that LCP is the maximum fraction of pixels clipped in any channel and set to zero in the linear stretch. Note that any pixel with values less than the Blackpoint input will be clipped and the data lost. Contrast gained by performing the linear stretch will be evenly distributed over the image, which will be dimmed. Pixels with values less than the Blackpoint will appear black and have 0 value.
文件: 设置图像线性拉伸的削顶水平。更新此参数会自动更新黑点参数，使得 LCP 成为任意通道中被削顶像素的最大比例，并在线性拉伸中设为 0。注意任何值小于所输入黑点的像素都将被削顶、数据丢失。执行线性拉伸获得的对比度将均匀分布到整幅图像上，图像会变暗。值小于黑点的像素将呈黑色、值为 0。

FILE: Sets the Whitepoint for a linear stretch of the image. Note that any pixel with value greater than the Whitepoint input will be clipped and the data lost. Contrast gained by performing the linear stretch will be evenly distributed over the image, which will be brightened. Pixels with values greater than the Whitepoint will appear white and have a value of 1.0. Updating this parameter will automatically update the high clipping proportion. Setting this parameter to a value greater than 1 will extend the dynamic range at the high end.

In general, elliptical functions are preferable because they provide more information about the true shapes and orientations of the fitted PSFs. Sometimes, however, circular functions may be preferable. For example, strongly undersampled images usually don't provide enough data to fit elliptical functions reliably. Uncertainty due to high noise levels also affect complex function fittings adversely. In such cases a circular function can provide more robust results.

Elliptical PSF functions are fitted by default.

Since variable shape PSF models are nonstandard and relatively experimental, they are not included in automatic optimal fits by default.

选择自动 PSF 模型时，是否纳入可变形状函数以搜索最优 PSF 拟合。若禁用此选项，选中自动时只使用高斯与 Moffat 函数。

在许多情况下，可变形状模型函数能在最小化每个选定天体的拟合点扩散函数与源图像像素样本之间绝对偏差方面达到最优 PSF 拟合。由于可变形状 PSF 模型是非标准的、且相对实验性，默认不纳入自动最优拟合。

FILE:
When this option is enabled, rotation angles are shown in the [-90°,+90°] range. When this option is disabled, rotation angles are shown in the [0°,180°) range.

Signed angles are useful to prevent ambiguities introduced by small rotations around zero degrees. These 'oscillatory' rotations occur frequently due to uncertainty in fitting rotation angles for nearly circular stars. For example, imagine a set of PSF fits where we have two subsets with rotations around zero and 180 degrees. If we compute average PSF parameters, the resulting average rotation would be around 90 degrees. This may be incorrect if both subsets are actually due to dispersion caused by fitting uncertainty, in which case the correct average rotation would be a value close to zero degrees.

This option is enabled by default, so rotation angles are represented as signed quantities in the (-90°,+90°] range.
文件:
启用此选项时，旋转角以 [-90°,+90°] 范围显示。禁用时以 [0°,180°) 范围显示。

有符号角度有助于避免零度附近的小旋转引入的歧义。这些“振荡式”旋转经常发生，原因是对近圆形恒星的拟合旋转角存在不确定度。例如，假设有一组 PSF 拟合，其中两个子集的旋转角分别在 0 度与 180 度附近。若计算平均 PSF 参数，得到的平均旋转会接近 90 度。若两者实际上都源于拟合不确定度造成的离散，这可能是错误的 —— 此时正确的平均旋转应接近 0 度。

此选项默认启用，因此旋转角以 (-90°,+90°] 范围内的有符号量表示。

FILE:
Compute optimal sampling dimensions adaptively for each fitted star.

Each star is fitted to a PSF function inside a rectangular sampling region. If the sampling region is too small, the local background cannot be determined accurately, and hence the PSF fit will be less accurate. If the sampling region is too large, pixels from nearby objects can contaminate the sample, and computation times grow unnecessarily. The automatic aperture feature of DynamicPSF implements a robust algorithm to find the smallest sampling region necessary to minimize uncertainty in the evaluation of the local background.

This option is enabled by default. Disabling it is not recommended under normal working conditions.
文件:
为每颗被拟合的恒星自适应计算最优采样尺寸。

每颗恒星都在一个矩形采样区域内拟合 PSF 函数。若采样区域过小，无法准确确定局部背景，因而 PSF 拟合精度下降；若采样区域过大，邻近天体的像素会污染样本，且计算时间无谓增长。DynamicPSF 的自动孔径功能实现了稳健算法，可找出使局部背景评估不确定度最小的最小采样区域。

此选项默认启用。正常条件下不建议禁用它。

FILE:
Threshold value for rejection of background pixels, in sigma units.

This value is used by the object detection routine to classify sampled pixels into two disjoint sets: pixels belonging to the local background, and pixels belonging to the object being detected. A smaller threshold value makes the star detection routine less sensitive. This can be useful to avoid detection of very faint objects. On the other hand, a higher threshold allows you to isolate very small and faint objects, which may or may not be desirable, depending on what you want to do.

The default value of one sigma is normally appropriate in most cases.

此值被天体检测例程用于把采样像素分成两个不相交的集合：属于局部背景的像素，与属于被检测天体的像素。较小的阈值使恒星检测例程灵敏度降低，这有助于避免检测到极暗天体。反之更高的阈值可分离极小极暗的天体，这取决于你想做什么，可能想要也可能不想要。

一 sigma 的默认值通常适用于多数情况。

FILE:
Maximum number of curve points. The default value is 106 points. For 8-bit and 16-bit integer images, AdaptiveStretch can compute a maximum of 256 and 65536 curve points, respectively. For 32-bit and 64-bit floating point images, a maximum of 107 and 108 curve points can be calculated, respectively, but the default maximum of 106 is normally more than sufficient.

Increasing this parameter can improve the result for very rich floating point and 32-bit integer images, usually resulting from deep HDR compositions. Keep in mind that large curves will increase computation times considerably, so they should only be used when actually required. In most cases, the default value of this parameter is quite appropriate.

曲线点的最大数量。默认值为 106 点。对 8 位与 16 位整数图像，AdaptiveStretch 分别最多可计算 256 与 65536 个曲线点。对 32 位与 64 位浮点图像，分别最多可计算 107 与 108 个曲线点，但默认上限 106 通常已绰绰有余。

增大此参数可改善极丰富的浮点与 32 位整数图像（通常来自高动态范围合成）的结果。请记住大曲线会显著增加计算时间，因此只有确实需要时才应使用。多数情况下此参数的默认值相当合适。

FILE:
MaskedStretch will use pixels read from this image to compute an initial mean background level. If you leave this field blank (or with its default <target image> value), the target image will be also the background reference image for the masked stretch process.

You should specify a view that represents the true background of the image. In most cases this means that you must select a view whose pixels are strongly dominated by the sky background, as it is being represented on the target image. A typical example involves defining a small preview over a free sky area of the target image, and selecting it here as the background reference image.

MaskedStretch 将读取此图像中的像素以计算初始平均背景水平。若此字段留空（或保持默认的 <target image> 值），则目标图像在蒙版拉伸过程中同时充当背景参考图像。

你应指定一个代表图像真实背景的视图。大多数情况下这意味着必须选择这样一个视图：其像素被天空背景强烈主导，正如其在目标图像中所表现的那样。典型做法是在目标图像的自由天空区域上定义一个小预览，并在此处把它选为背景参考图像。

FILE:
Number of masked stretch iterations.

In most cases, a moderate number of iterations between 50 and 100 will lead to a smooth result with excellent protection of bright image features. With too few iterations, the MS algorithm may create artifacts around the brightest objects. In general, the largest the difference between the initial and final mean background values, the more iterations are necessary to compute accurate protection masks. For this reason, HDR images usually require more iterations. The default value is 100 iterations, which are more than sufficient for most nonlinear deep-sky images. You can reduce this value to speed up the process during trial-error work. If you get dark halos around bright stars, this means that more iterations are necessary. The maximum allowed is 1000 iterations.
文件:
蒙版拉伸迭代次数。

多数情况下 50 至 100 次的中等迭代数可得到平滑结果，并对明亮图像特征提供极佳保护。迭代过少时 MS 算法可能在最亮天体周围产生伪影。一般而言，初始与最终平均背景值差异越大，计算精确保护蒙版所需迭代越多。因此 HDR 图像通常需要更多迭代。默认值为 100 次迭代，对多数非线性深空图像绰绰有余。试错时可减小此值以加速。若你在亮星周围出现暗晕，说明需要更多迭代。最多允许 1000 次迭代。

FILE:
Type of the mask used to protect the highlights of color images.

Two options are available: the intensity (I) component of the HSI color ordering system, and the value (V) component of HSV.

For grayscale images the mask is always generated from a duplicate of the image at each iteration, and hence this parameter is not used.
文件:
用于保护彩色图像高光的蒙版类型。

有两种可选：HSI 颜色排序系统的强度（I）分量，与 HSV 的明度（V）分量。

对灰度图像，蒙版始终在每次迭代时由图像副本生成，因此此参数不使用。

FILE:
Rescale the CIE Y component.

The CIE Y component (relative luminance) is extracted, rescaled, and then reinserted in the target RGB image.

Important &mdash The CIE Y component is a linear combination of the R, G and B sample values for each pixel. However, if the target image is linear, a linear RGB working space should be used (gamma=1) to preserve linearity.
文件:
重缩放 CIE Y 分量。

提取 CIE Y 分量（相对明度），重缩放后再插入目标 RGB 图像。

重要 &mdash CIE Y 分量是每像素 R、G、B 样本值的线性组合。不过若目标图像是线性的，应使用线性 RGB 工作空间（gamma=1）以保持线性。

FILE:
Rescale the CIE L* component.

The CIE L* component (lightness) is extracted, rescaled, and then reinserted in the target RGB image.

Important &mdash If the target image is linear, this rescaling operation will break linearity, as CIE L* is a nonlinear function of the R, G and B sample values for each pixel.
文件:
重缩放 CIE L* 分量。

提取 CIE L* 分量（亮度），重缩放后再插入目标 RGB 图像。

重要 &mdash 若目标图像是线性的，此重缩放会破坏线性，因为 CIE L* 是每像素 R、G、B 样本值的非线性函数。

FILE:
Rescale each nominal channel separately.

In this mode a different rescaling range is used for each nominal channel, which can modify color balance.
文件:
分别重缩放每个标称通道。

此模式下每个标称通道使用不同的重缩放范围，这可能会改变色彩平衡。

FILE:
Auto Stretch

Ctrl+Click to open the STF AutoStretch Parameters dialog.

Shift+Click to apply boosted AutoStretch functions.
文件:
自动拉伸

Ctrl+点击打开 STF 自动拉伸参数对话框。

Shift+点击应用增强型自动拉伸函数。

FILE:
Strength of the denoising effect. Each output pixel is a linear blend between the original and the denoised result: (1 − amount)×original + amount×denoised.

1.00 applies the full denoise; 0.00 leaves the image unchanged; intermediate values keep part of the original noise. The default value is 0.90.
文件:
降噪效果的强度。 每个输出像素是原始与降噪结果之间的线性混合：(1 − amount)×original + amount×denoised。

1.00 施加完整降噪；0.00 使图像不变；中间值保留部分原始噪声。默认值为 0.90。

FILE:
By default, GPU inference runs in reduced precision, which is faster: on NVIDIA hardware the CUDA execution provider rounds the float32 inputs of convolutions and matrix products to ten mantissa bits (TensorFloat-32), and on Apple hardware Core ML is allowed to accumulate in low precision on the GPU.

When this option is enabled, inference runs in the full precision of the model's float32 weights, and the result matches CPU inference closely: on a linear luminance master, the maximum deviation from CPU inference is 1.8e-6 with this option and 1.6e-5 without it. The cost is moderate: about 25% more time on an NVIDIA Ampere GPU (39.9 s instead of 31.9 s for a 26-megapixel image).

The precision is fixed when the inference session is created, so each setting keeps its own loaded model: the first execution after changing this option reloads the model.

This option has no effect on CPU inference, which is always performed in full precision.
文件:
默认情况下 GPU 推理以降低的精度运行，速度更快：在 NVIDIA 硬件上，CUDA 执行提供程序把卷积与矩阵乘法的 float32 输入舍入到十位尾数（TensorFloat-32）；在 Apple 硬件上，允许 Core ML 在 GPU 上以低精度累加。

启用此选项时推理以模型 float32 权重的完整精度运行，结果与 CPU 推理非常接近：在线性亮度 master 上，启用此选项时与 CPU 推理的最大偏差为 1.8e-6，不启用时为 1.6e-5。代价适中：在 NVIDIA Ampere GPU 上约多 25% 时间（26 百万像素图像为 39.9 秒而非 31.9 秒）。

精度在推理会话创建时固定，因此每个设置各自保留已载入的模型：更改此选项后的首次执行会重新载入模型。

此选项对 CPU 推理无效，CPU 推理始终以完整精度执行。

FILE:
The built-in local support feature provides full control over how the noise reduction process is applied as a function of brightness through an inverted mask. Dark mask pixels protect high-signal image regions, and bright mask pixels allow more noise reduction in low-signal background areas.

Our noise reduction neural networks have been trained on immense datasets covering a wide variety of noise and structure distributions and morphologies in deep-sky astronomical images. This extensive training enables the system to differentiate noise from significant structures in virtually any image where this process can be applied, making local supports and masks unnecessary in most cases. However, noise reduction can be a highly delicate and subjective task that requires high versatility. This local support feature lets you control the amount of applied noise reduction differently for each pixel in the target image as a function of illumination. This helps adapt the process to the user's preferences and taste in such a critical task as noise reduction.
文件:
内置局部支撑功能通过反向蒙版，让你完全控制降噪过程如何随亮度施加。暗蒙版像素保护高信号图像区域，亮蒙版像素允许在低信号背景区域施加更多降噪。

我们的降噪神经网络在海量数据集上训练，覆盖深空天文图像中各种噪声与结构分布及形态。这种广泛训练使系统能在几乎所有可应用此过程的图像中区分噪声与重要结构，多数情况下使局部支撑与蒙版变得不必要。不过降噪可能是极其细致、主观的任务，需要高度灵活性。此局部支撑功能让你针对每幅图像分别控制所施加的降噪量

FILE:
Low clipping point parameter for mask generation, expressed in sigma units.

This value is expressed as a distance in robust sigma units from the image's median. Negative values locate the mask clipping point to the left of the main histogram peak. Positive values tend to clip the bulk of the background pixels, which is more aggressive at reducing noise in sky background regions.
文件:
蒙版生成的低削顶点参数，以 sigma 为单位。

此值表示为距图像中值的稳健 sigma 单位距离。负值把蒙版削顶点定在主直方图峰左侧。正值倾向于削掉大部分背景像素，在减少天空背景区域噪声方面更激进。

FILE:
Normalized mean background level.

The noise reduction mask will be delinearized to achieve the specified mean background level in the [0,1] range. Higher values increase protection in the highlights. Lower values allow more noise reduction over bright image structures. The default value is 0.25.
文件:
归一化平均背景水平。

降噪蒙版将被去线性化，以在 [0,1] 范围内达到指定平均背景水平。更高的值增强高光保护；更低的值允许在明亮图像结构上施加更多降噪。默认值为 0.25。

FILE:
Region of Interest (ROI) for reference background estimation.

These parameters define a rectangular region containing representative background pixels.

When enabled: Uses a robust estimate of the mean of ROI pixel values for background estimation. This is useful when you have a known area of pure background in your image that you want to use as the reference for the stretching process.

When disabled: Uses a robust mean background estimator for the entire image. This automatic method works well for most images.

Tip: Drag a preview selector onto this section to set ROI coordinates automatically.
文件:
用于参考背景估计的感兴趣区域（ROI）。

这些参数定义一个含代表性背景像素的矩形区域。

启用时： 使用 ROI 像素值均值的稳健估计做背景估计。当你图像中有一块已知的纯背景区域、想把它用作拉伸过程的参考时，这很有用。

禁用时： 对整幅图像使用稳健平均背景估计器。这种自动方法对多数图像都适用。

提示： 把预览选择器拖到此区域可自动设置 ROI 坐标。

FILE:
Defines the boundary between small and large structures in pixels. Features smaller than this scale are considered fine detail and will have their contrast preserved.

Lower values (e.g., 8-128) protect only the finest details like stars and nebular filaments. Higher values (e.g., 512-1024) also protect larger structures like galaxy arms and extended nebulosity. The default value of 1024 pixels works well for most images.
文件:
定义小尺度与大结构之间的边界（像素）。小于此尺度的特征被视为精细细节，其对比度将被保留。

更低的值（如 8-128）只保护最精细的细节，如恒星与星云细丝。更高的值（如 512-1024）还保护更大的结构，如星系旋臂与大面积星云。默认值 1024 像素对多数图像管用。

FILE:
Controls the overall strength of the multiscale contrast recovery transformation.

At 1.0 (default), the transformation is fully applied. At values less than one, the effect is diminished proportionally. This parameter provides fine control over contrast recovery at the selected scale.
文件:
控制多尺度对比度恢复变换的整体强度。

取 1.0（默认值）时变换完全施加；取值小于 1 时效果按比例减弱。此参数可对所选尺度上的对比度恢复做精细控制。

FILE:
When enabled, the real-time preview shows only the large-scale structures of the image. This visualization helps you choose the right scale value: structures visible in this preview will be treated as background, while structures that disappear will be protected as fine detail.

Adjust the scale so that this preview does not contain any structures whose contrast you want to recover. Any detail visible here will not benefit from contrast recovery.
文件:
启用时，实时预览只显示图像的大尺度结构。这种可视化有助于你选对尺度值：此预览中可见的结构将被当作背景，而消失的结构将作为精细细节被保护。

调整尺度，使此预览不含任何你想恢复对比度的结构。此处可见的任何细节都不会从对比度恢复中受益。

FILE:
Wavelet scaling function. This parameter is unavailable for median-based transforms.

Peaked/small scaling functions (such as linear interpolation) work better to isolate small-scale structures.

Smooth/large scaling functions (such as cubic B-spline) work better to isolate larger scales.
文件:
小波缩放函数。此参数对基于中值的变换不可用。

尖锐/小型缩放函数（如线性插值）更擅长分离小尺度结构。

平滑/大型缩放函数（如三次 B 样条）更擅长分离更大尺度。

FILE:
Enable inverted HDRMT iterations.

This option can be useful to preserve shadow detail.
文件:
启用反向 HDRMT 迭代。

此选项可用于保留阴影细节。

FILE:
Defines (indirectly) an exponential factor that will be applied to boost the dynamic range compression.

Increase this parameter to increase the amount of dynamic range compression applied with a given set of parameters. This gives you finer control over the final result.
文件:
间接定义用于增强动态范围压缩的指数因子。

增大此参数可增加在给定参数组合下所施加的动态范围压缩量。这让你能更精细地控制最终结果。

FILE:
Use multiscale median transforms (MMT) instead of a trous wavelet transforms (AWT) to compute the HDR multiscale transform.

The MMT has several advantages over the wavelet transform. One of them is the practical absence of ringing artifacts around jump discontinuities, such as stars and other bright features. One drawback is that the MMT is computationally much more expensive than the AWT. On the other hand, MMT-based HDR transforms are more sensitive to local features, and hence more difficult to be evaluated on partial previews.

The median-based HDR multiscale transform is not 'better' than the wavelet-based transform; it is just a different solution to the dynamic range compression problem, with quite different results and its own idiosyncrasies. The fact that they generate much less (if any) ringing artifacts make median transforms particularly interesting, especially to compress very large dynamic ranges. However, the implemented deringing routines are usually able to solve this problem quite efficiently for wavelet-based HDR transforms.
文件:
使用多尺度中值变换（MMT）而非带孔小波变换（AWT）计算 HDR 多尺度变换。

MMT 相对小波变换有几个优点，其中之一是跳变不连续处（如恒星与其他亮特征）周围实际上不会产生振铃伪影。缺点是 MMT 计算量远大于 AWT。另一方面，基于 MMT 的 HDR 变换对局部特征更敏感，因而更难在局部预览上评估。

基于中值的 HDR 多尺度变换并不比基于小波的变换“更好”；它只是动态范围压缩问题的另一种解法，结果差异很大，也有自身的特性。它产生的振铃伪影少得多（甚至没有），这使中值变换特别有吸引力，尤其在压缩极大动态范围时。不过，所实现的去环例程通常能为基于小波的 HDR 变换相当有效地解决这一问题。

FILE:
Apply HDRMT only to the HSI I component (intensity) of color images.

Enabling this option usually results in a significant increase in color saturation. However, it must be used with care, as it can cause severe loss of relevant color information, especially in images with large dynamic ranges, such as HDR combinations.
文件:
仅把 HDRMT 应用于彩色图像的 HSI I 分量（强度）。

启用此选项通常会使颜色饱和度显著提高。但须谨慎使用，因为它可能导致相关颜色信息严重丢失，尤其在动态范围很大的图像（如 HDR 合成）中。

FILE:
Apply HDRMT only to the CIE L* component (lightness) of color images.

This option allows you to apply a multiscale transformation in a colorimetrically-defined color space that you can control with RGB working space parameters.
文件:
仅把 HDRMT 应用于彩色图像的 CIE L* 分量（亮度）。

此选项允许你在可由 RGB 工作空间参数控制的色度学定义色彩空间中施加多尺度变换。

FILE:
Use a lightness mask to protect dark background regions.

In general, dynamic range compression is mostly needed on the brightest image structures. Protecting the sky background in deep-sky images prevents visible ringing artifacts with wavelet-based transforms.
文件:
使用亮度蒙版保护暗背景区域。

一般而言，动态范围压缩主要用于最亮的图像结构。在深空图像中保护天空背景，可避免基于小波的变换产生可见的振铃伪影。

FILE:
Controls the overall strength of the HDR multiscale transform.

At 1.0 (default), the HDR transform is fully applied. At values less than one, the effect is diminished proportionally. This parameter provides fine control over the dynamic range compression with the selected process parameters.
文件:
控制 HDR 多尺度变换的整体强度。

取 1.0（默认值）时 HDR 变换完全施加；取值小于 1 时效果按比例减弱。此参数可用所选过程参数对动态范围压缩做精细控制。

FILE:
Deringing amount, small-scale structures

This parameter controls the degree of deringing applied to small-scale ringing artifacts, such as those generated around stars. Try to find the smallest value that fixes ringing. Too large of an amount value will lead to overcorrection, generating bright deringing artifacts in the output image.
文件:
去环量，小尺度结构

此参数控制对小尺度振铃伪影（如恒星周围产生的振铃）施加的去环程度。请尽量找出刚好能修复振铃的最小值。量值过大会导致过度校正，在输出图像中产生明亮的去环伪影。

FILE:
Deringing amount, large-scale structures

This parameter controls the degree of deringing applied to large-scale ringing artifacts, such as those generated around bright and large diffuse objects. Try to find the smallest value that fixes ringing. Too large of an amount value will lead to overcorrection, generating bright deringing artifacts in the output image.
文件:
去环量，大尺度结构

此参数控制对大尺度振铃伪影（如明亮大型弥散天体周围产生的振铃）施加的去环程度。请尽量找出刚好能修复振铃的最小值。量值过大会导致过度校正，在输出图像中产生明亮的去环伪影。

FILE:
Generate a new image window for each deringing map image. In a deringing map, pixel values are proportional to the amount of ringing detected in the processed image.

New image windows will be created for the small-scale and large-scale deringing maps, if the corresponding amount parameters are nonzero.
文件:
为每幅去环图生成新图像窗口。在去环图中，像素值与所处理图像中检测到的振铃量成正比。

若相应量参数非零，将为小尺度与大尺度去环图创建新图像窗口。

FILE:
Select the default set of MARS database files.

The default MARS database files can be defined using the MultiscaleGradientCorrection Preferences dialog.
文件:
选择默认的 MARS 数据库文件集。

可在 MultiscaleGradientCorrection 偏好设置对话框中定义默认 MARS 数据库文件。

FILE:
Toggle the enabled/disabled state of currently selected MARS database files.

Disabled files will be ignored during the gradient correction process.
文件:
切换当前所选 MARS 数据库文件的启用/禁用状态。

已禁用的文件将在梯度校正过程中被忽略。

FILE:
Clear the internal cache of reference images and working data.

MultiscaleGradientCorrection uses a cache of precomputed data to accelerate the process of testing scale factors and gradient generation parameters on the same image. By clearing this cache, memory will be released but the reference image and gradient model generation tasks will need to be redone completely the next time you execute the process.
文件:
清除参考图像与工作数据的内部缓存。

MultiscaleGradientCorrection 使用预计算数据缓存，以加速在同一图像上测试尺度因子与梯度生成参数的过程。清除此缓存会释放内存，但下次执行该过程时需完全重做参考图像与梯度模型生成任务。

FILE:
Degree of intensity separation applied to represent isolated large-scale image structures.

This parameter lets you control how large-scale image structures are represented to calculate the gradient model. By decreasing the value of this parameter, the relative intensities of isolated large-scale structures will tend to be more similar. By increasing this parameter, the differences in relative structure intensities will tend to be larger. A model with larger relative intensity differences among image structures tends to perform a more aggressive gradient correction. The default structure separation value is 3.
文件:
为表示孤立的大尺度图像结构而施加的强度分离程度。

此参数控制大尺度图像结构如何被表示，以计算梯度模型。减小此参数，孤立大尺度结构的相对强度会更趋于相近；增大此参数，结构相对强度的差异会更大。结构间相对强度差异更大的模型往往执行更激进的梯度校正。默认结构分离值为 3。

FILE:
Generate a floating point image with the computed gradient model for the target image.

Analysis of gradient models can be important for testing purposes, especially in difficult cases, to know how complex gradients are being evaluated and corrected.
文件:
为计算出的梯度模型生成浮点图像。

分析梯度模型对测试很有价值，尤其在困难情形下，可了解复杂梯度是如何被评估与校正的。

FILE:
Scale factor adjustment parameters.

These parameters allow for the fine adjustment of per-channel flux calibration scale factors. Under ideal working conditions, the universal scale factors calculated by the SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration process (SPFC), based on stellar photometry and Gaia mean spectra, are highly accurate and don't require any further adjustment. However, under less-than-ideal conditions, a slight manual adjustment may be necessary to compensate for scaling errors caused by excessive angular resolution differences, inaccurate filter characterization, or lack of data linearity (e.g., with color images interpolated from CFA data, such as images acquired with DSLR and OSC cameras), among other issues.
文件:
尺度因子调整参数。

这些参数用于微调逐通道通量标定尺度因子。在理想工作条件下，由 SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration 过程（SPFC）基于恒星测光与 Gaia 平均光谱计算出的通用尺度因子非常准确，无需进一步调整。但在不太理想的情况下，可能需要轻微手动调整，以补偿角分辨率差异过大、滤波器特性表征不准或数据非线性（例如由 CFA 数据插值而来的彩色图像，如单反与 OSC 相机拍摄的图像）等原因造成的尺度误差。

FILE:
Wavelet scaling function for the starlet transform.

Peaked/small scaling functions (such as linear interpolation) work better to isolate small-scale structures.

Smooth/large scaling functions (such as cubic B-spline) work better to isolate larger scales.

This parameter is ignored for the multiscale linear transform.
文件:
星点变换的小波缩放函数。

尖锐/小型缩放函数（如线性插值）更擅长分离小尺度结构。

平滑/大型缩放函数（如三次 B 样条）更擅长分离更大尺度。

此参数对多尺度线性变换无效。

FILE:
Multiscale analysis algorithm

The Isotropic Undecimated Wavelet Transform, also known as starlet transform and à trous (with holes) wavelet transform, is a computationally efficient, versatile wavelet transform widely used in astronomy. It uses a positive low-pass filter as a wavelet scaling function, applied by interlaced convolutions following a dyadic sequence.

The multiscale linear transform is similar to the starlet transform, but uses multiple Gaussian filters of varying sizes applied by separable convolutions, instead of a single interlaced scaling function. It is less flexible than the starlet transform (mainly because it does not allow selecting a specific scaling function) and computationally more expensive, but has two advantages: it allows for arbitrary scaling sequences (while the starlet transform is strictly defined only for the dyadic sequence), and is more controllable at large dimensional scales (because the scaling filters are computed separately for each layer).

Both transforms are particularly well adapted to the detection of smooth isotropic structures, which justifies their success in astronomical image processing.
文件:
多尺度分析算法

各向同性非抽取小波变换，又称星点（starlet）变换与à trous（带孔）小波变换，是一种计算高效、用途广泛的小波变换，在天文学中广泛使用。它使用正低通滤波器作为小波缩放函数，按二进序列以交错卷积方式施加。

多尺度线性变换与星点变换类似，但使用多个不同尺寸的高斯滤波器以可分离卷积方式施加，而不用单一交错缩放函数。它比星点变换灵活性差（主要是不允许选择特定缩放函数）、计算量更大，但有两个优点：允许任意缩放序列（星点变换严格来说只对二进序列有定义）；在大尺寸尺度上更可控（因为缩放滤波器对每层单独计算）。

这两种变换都特别适合检测平滑的各向同性结构，这正是它们在天文图像处理中大获成功的原因。

FILE:
Selects a linear scaling sequence. Multiscale transform layers will be generated at dimensional scales following the sequence 1 + d*j, j >= 0 (1,1+d,1+2d,1+3d,...), where d is the scaling distance specified with this control. A linear sequence can provide more control over small-scale image structures, which can be particularly useful for lunar, planetary and daylight images.

The starlet transform algorithm is only defined to use the dyadic scaling sequence 2j, so using a linear sequence produces an invalid transform. However, for small-scale wavelet layers (say up to scales of 8 pixels or so) the errors introduced by a linear sequence are usually negligible. The linear scaling sequence applied to large-scale wavelet layers will generate visible artifacts due to accumulated errors in the wavelet transform. The multiscale linear transform does not have these problems and supports arbitrary scaling sequences.
文件:
选择线性缩放序列。多尺度变换层将按 1 + d*j，j >= 0 的序列（1,1+d,1+2d,1+3d,...）生成，其中 d 是此控件指定的缩放距离。线性序列可对小尺度图像结构提供更多控制，对月球、行星与日光图像尤其有用。

星点变换算法只对二进缩放序列 2j 有定义，因此使用线性序列会产生无效变换。不过对于小尺度小波层（大致到 8 像素尺度左右），线性序列引入的误差通常可以忽略。把线性缩放序列应用于大尺度小波层，会因小波变换中的误差累积而产生可见伪影。多尺度线性变换没有这些问题，支持任意缩放序列。

FILE:
Increase/decrease bias to increase/decrease the relative weight of a multiscale layer in the reconstructed image. A zero bias value does not change the relative weight of a layer.

The bias parameter defines a multiplicative factor applied to a whole layer. Increase the bias parameter to enhance all the structures supported by a specific layer. Note that this includes the whole layer contents, that is, both significant structures and the noise. Typically the bias can be increased at scales from 2 to 4 pixels for local contrast enhancement purposes (aka sharpening).
文件:
增大/减小偏置可增大/减小某个多尺度层在重建图像中的相对权重。偏置取 0 不改变层的相对权重。

偏置参数定义施加于整层的乘性因子。增大偏置可增强某一层所承载的全部结构。注意这包括整层内容，即重要结构与噪声。通常可在 2 至 4 像素的尺度上增大偏置以增强局部对比（即锐化）。

FILE:
Use a linear mask as a local support for noise reduction of linear images.

Linear masks can be very efficient for noise reduction of linear images with a strong correlation between signal-to-noise ratio and illumination. This condition holds for most raw astronomical images, especially for raw deep-sky images.
文件:
使用线性蒙版作为线性图像降噪的局部支撑。

对于信噪比与照明强度强相关的线性图像，线性蒙版在降噪上非常有效。大多数原始天文图像都满足这一条件，尤其是深空原始图像。

FILE:
Defines a threshold in sigma units for removal of transform coefficients in the current layer. All coefficients with absolute values below this threshold will be attenuated by a process known as soft thresholding when the noise reduction feature is enabled for a particular layer. The amount parameter defines the strength of this attenuation.

Increase threshold to remove more structures. Typically, a value between 3 to 5 sigma is appropriate for the first layer. Successive layers normally require smaller thresholds (the larger the layer scale, the smaller threshold is usually required), but the actual values depend on the properties and distribution of the noise in the image. Too large of a threshold will damage significant structures. Try to adjust this parameter to the smallest value able to remove the noise as you wish on each layer.
文件:
定义以 sigma 为单位的阈值，用于剔除当前层的变换系数。当某层启用降噪功能时，所有绝对值低于此阈值的系数都会通过称为软阈值的过程被衰减。量参数定义该衰减的强度。

增大阈值可去除更多结构。对第一层通常取 3 至 5 sigma 较为合适。后续各层通常需要更小阈值（层尺度越大，所需阈值通常越小），但实际取值取决于图像中噪声的性质与分布。阈值过大会损伤重要结构。请尽量把此参数调到在该层刚好能按需去除噪声的最小值。

FILE:
The k-sigma thresholding method can be used to attenuate or remove all coefficients below a prescribed value in all layers of the multiscale transform. This method assumes a Gaussian noise distribution and takes into account the relative weights of Gaussian noise in each layer. These weights are functions of the employed wavelet scaling function (for the starlet transform) or linear filters (for the multiscale linear transform), and have been hard-coded in the MultiscaleLinearTransform tool.

In general, k-sigma thresholding should not be used for noise reduction purposes, since the implemented per-layer noise reduction routine is much more accurate and controllable. This procedure can be useful for auxiliary image processing tasks, such as mask generation or feature detection.
文件:
k-sigma 阈值法可用于衰减或去除多尺度变换各层中低于规定值的所有系数。此方法假定噪声服从高斯分布，并计入各层中高斯噪声的相对权重。这些权重是所用小波缩放函数（对星点变换）或线性滤波器（对多尺度线性变换）的函数，已硬编码在 MultiscaleLinearTransform 工具中。

一般而言，k-sigma 阈值不宜用于降噪目的，因为所实现的逐层降噪例程更精确、更可控。此过程可用于辅助性图像处理任务，如生成蒙版或特征检测。

FILE:
Large-scale function applied to the transform's residual layer:

No function disables the large-scale transfer function. This is the default option.

Hyperbolic applies a hyperbolic function to the residual layer. This has a similar effect to the classical digital development processing (DDP) technique; however, this multiscale implementation is much better than the classical DDP because the transformation is applied just where it is needed: on the large-scale illumination profile, without affecting the rest of image structures. The curve break point parameter must be used to control the shape of the applied hyperbolic curve.

Base-10 Logarithm and natural Logarithm apply these functions to the large-scale residual layer.
文件:
应用于变换残差层的大尺度函数：

无函数禁用大尺度传递函数。这是默认选项。

双曲把双曲函数应用于残差层。效果与经典的数字显影处理（DDP）技术相似；不过本多尺度实现比经典 DDP 好得多，因为变换只施加在需要之处：大尺度照明轮廓上，不影响其余图像结构。必须用曲线转折点参数控制所施加双曲曲线的形状。

常用对数与自然对数把这两个函数应用于大尺度残差层。

FILE:
Selects the target image component(s):

Lightness applies the transformation exclusively to the CIE L* component (in the CIE L*a*b* space) of a nonlinear (stretched) color target image.

Luminance applies the transformation exclusively to the CIE Y component (in the CIE XYZ space) of a linear color target image.

Chrominance applies the transformation to the RGB components of a color target image, but restores the original CIE Y component after the transformation. This effectively applies the multiscale transformation to the chroma components without altering the luminance.

RGB/K Applies the transformation to the three RGB components of a target color image, or to the gray component of a grayscale image. This is the default mode.
文件:
选择目标图像分量：

亮度把变换专门应用于非线性（已拉伸）彩色目标图像的 CIE L* 分量（在 CIE L*a*b* 空间中）。

明度把变换专门应用于线性彩色目标图像的 CIE Y 分量（在 CIE XYZ 空间中）。

色度把变换应用于彩色目标图像的 RGB 分量，但在变换后恢复原始 CIE Y 分量。这样可有效地对色度分量施加多尺度变换，而不改变亮度。

RGB/K 把变换应用于目标彩色图像的三个 RGB 分量，或灰度图像的灰度分量。这是默认模式。

FILE:
Layer preview modes allow you to inspect the contents of individual multiscale transform layers. This is useful to analyze the image structures supported by each layer:

No layer preview is the normal transformation mode. In this mode no layer preview is obtained and the current transformation is effectively applied to the target image.

All Changes visualizes all nonzero transform coefficients in the current layer. Output pixel values are proportional to the absolute values of the corresponding coefficients.

Increasing Pixels visualizes positive transform coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to the coefficient values.

Decreasing Pixels visualizes negative transform coefficients. Output pixel values are proportional to the absolute values of the coefficients.
文件:
层预览模式可让你检查单个多尺度变换层的内容。这有助于分析各层所承载的图像结构：

无层预览是常规变换模式。此模式下不获取层预览，当前变换实际作用于目标图像。

全部变化可视化当前层中所有非零变换系数。输出像素值与对应系数的绝对值成正比。

递增像素可视化正的变换系数。输出像素值与系数值成正比。

递减像素可视化负的变换系数。输出像素值与系数的绝对值成正比。

FILE:
Multiscale analysis algorithm

The median-wavelet transform merges the multiscale median and wavelet transforms in a single high-level operation. Wavelets are used to represent nonsignificant structures, such as the noise and smooth regions, while median filtering is used to represent strong significant structures. This hybrid transform aims at providing an optimal representation of the image by combining the strongest points of both techniques: wavelets are good to support smooth structures with weak variations, while the median transform is better at isolating significant, high-contrast structures.

多尺度分析算法

中值-小波变换把多尺度中值变换与小波变换合并为单个高层操作。小波用于表示非重要结构，如噪声与平滑区域；中值滤波用于表示强重要结构。这种混合变换旨在通过结合两种技术的最强项，为图像提供最优表示：小波擅长承载变化平缓的平滑结构，中值变换更擅长分离重要的高对比结构。

Increase/decrease bias to increase/decrease the relative weight of a transform layer in the reconstructed image. A zero bias value does not change the relative weight of a layer.

The bias parameter defines a multiplicative factor applied to a whole transform layer. Increase the bias parameter to enhance all the structures supported by a specific layer. Note that this includes the whole layer contents, that is both significant structures and noise. Typically bias can be increased at scales from 2 to 4 pixels for local contrast enhancement purposes (aka sharpening).

增大/减小偏置可增大/减小某个变换层在重建图像中的相对权重。偏置取 0 不改变层的相对权重。

偏置参数定义施加于整个变换层的乘性因子。增大偏置可增强某一特定层所承载的全部结构。注意这既包括重要结构也包括噪声。通常可在 2 至 4 像素尺度上增大偏置以增强局部对比（即锐化）。

FILE:
Defines a threshold in mean absolute deviation (MAD) units for removal of transform coefficients in the current layer. All layer coefficients with absolute values below this threshold will be multiplied by one minus the amount parameter (by default amount is one, so zero is the default multiplier) when the noise reduction feature is enabled.

Increase threshold to remove more structures. Typically, a value around 3 or 4 MAD is appropriate for the first layer. Successive layers normally require smaller thresholds (the larger the layer scale, the smaller threshold is usually required), but the actual values depend on the image and its noise distribution. Too large of a threshold will remove significant structures. Try to adjust this parameter to the smallest value able to remove the noise as you wish on each layer.
文件:
定义以平均绝对偏差（MAD）为单位的阈值，用于剔除当前层的变换系数。启用降噪功能时，所有绝对值低于此阈值的层系数都会乘以 1 减去量参数（默认为 1，故默认乘数为 0）。

增大阈值可去除更多结构。对第一层通常取约 3 或 4 MAD 较为合适。后续各层通常需要更小的阈值（层尺度越大，所需阈值通常越小），但实际取值取决于图像及其噪声分布。阈值过大会去除重要结构。请尽量把此参数调到在该层刚好能按需去除噪声的最小值。

FILE:
Selects a linear scaling sequence. Multiscale layers will be generated at dimensional scales following the sequence 1 + d*j, j >= 0 (1,1+d,1+2d,1+3d,...), where d is the scaling distance specified with this control.

One of the advantages of the multiscale median transform is that the scaling sequence is arbitrary, in contrast to the wavelet transform, where only the dyadic sequence is strictly valid.
文件:
选择线性缩放序列。多尺度层将按 1 + d*j，j >= 0 的序列（1,1+d,1+2d,1+3d,...）在相应尺寸尺度上生成，其中 d 是用此控件指定的缩放距离。

多尺度中值变换的优点之一是缩放序列可任意选取，而小波变换严格来说只有二进序列有效。

Defines a noise value in MAD units for the local adaptive noise reduction algorithm (LANR).

When this parameter is greater than zero, a LANR routine is applied before noise thresholding to the current transform layer. This is useful to remove outlier noise structures that can be very difficult to select by thresholding without damaging significant structures. Increase this parameter when you see isolated, high-contrast, relatively small structures that survive after finding an otherwise good noise threshold value. As happens with the threshold parameter, the less is the better: always try to find the smallest adaptive noise parameter that can remove the unwanted noise structures.
文件:
为局部自适应降噪算法（LANR）定义以 MAD 为单位的噪声值。

此参数大于零时，会在噪声阈值处理之前对当前变换层施加 LANR 例程。这有助于去除离群噪声结构，这类结构很难在不过度损伤重要结构的情况下通过阈值去除。当你看到孤立的、高对比的、相对较小的结构在找到其他方面良好的噪声阈值后仍然残留时，请增大此参数。与阈值参数一样，越小越好：始终尽量找出能去除不需要噪声结构的最小自适应噪声参数。

Ignore existing focal length metadata, and either force a user-defined value or do not generate any metadata for focal length in decoded images.

Raw frames acquired with digital cameras through telescopes usually don't include valid metadata for focal length and aperture. This is because a telescope, as opposed to a standard camera lens, does not normally provide any means to inform the camera body about these parameters. For example, a typical raw frame acquired through a telescope provides a default '50 mm' focal length metadata item, which is obviously wrong.

FILE:
FBDD noise reduction iterations.

Jacek Gozdz's FBDD noise reduction algorithm is very efficient at removing small-scale bright artifacts, such as hot pixels in underexposed raw data. Quoted from the author's website (http://www.linuxphoto.org/html/fbdd.html):

It works before demosaicing and can be followed by any demosaicing method. FBDD eliminates the most visible impulse noise leaving 99% of the details intact and significantly reduces chroma noise - this helps getting good results using different denoising techniques applied after demosaicing. It doesn't affect contrast or saturation of the image therefore no post processing is requied. The resulting image looks grainy and natural.

A parameter value of zero will disable FBDD noise reduction. A value of one will apply the algorithm to the raw image. A value of two will apply an additional noise reduction step to the chroma components.
文件:
FBDD 降噪迭代次数。

Jacek Gozdz 的 FBDD 降噪算法在去除小尺度亮伪影（如曝光不足原始数据中的热像素）方面非常高效。引自作者网站（http://www.linuxphoto.org/html/fbdd.html）：

它在去马赛克之前工作，之后可接任何去马赛克方法。FBDD 消除最显眼的脉冲噪声，同时保留 99% 的细节，并显著减少色度噪声 —— 这有助于在去马赛克后使用不同降噪技术时取得好效果。它不影响图像的对比度或饱和度，因此无需后处理。结果图像看起来有颗粒感且自然。

参数取零将禁用 FBDD 降噪。取一将把算法施加于原始图像。取二将对色度分量施加额外的降噪步骤。

When assigning drizzle and/or local normalization data files to input subframes, take into account full file paths stored in .xdrz and .xnml files. This allows you to measure images with duplicate file names on different directories. However, by enabling this option your data set gets tied to specific locations on the local filesystem. When this option is disabled (the default state), only file names are used to associate target images with .xdrz and .xnml files, which allows you to move your images freely throughout the filesystem, including the possibility to migrate them to different machines.

Changes to this option will come into play the next time you associate .xdrz and/or .xnml files with input subframes. Existing file associations are not affected.

FILE:
Size of the noise reduction filter.

This is the radius in pixels of a Gaussian convolution filter applied to the working image used for calculation of star positions during the star detection phase. Use it only for very low SNR images, where the star detector cannot find reliable stars with default parameters.

Be aware that noise reduction will modify star profiles and hence the way star positions are calculated, resulting in a less accurate PSF fitting. Under extreme low-SNR conditions, however, this is probably better than working with the actual data anyway.

To disable noise reduction, set this parameter to zero.
文件:
降噪滤波器的尺寸。

这是施加于恒星检测阶段计算恒星位置所用工作表图像的高斯卷积滤波器半径（像素）。仅对信噪比极低的图像使用，因为此时恒星检测器用默认参数找不到可靠恒星。

注意：降噪会改变恒星轮廓，从而改变恒星位置的计算方式，导致 PSF 拟合精度下降。不过在信噪比极低的条件下，这大概仍比直接处理原始数据要好。

把此参数设为零即可关闭降噪。

FILE:
Size of the hot pixel removal filter.

This is the radius in pixels of a median filter applied by the star detector before the structure detection phase. A median filter is very efficient to remove hot pixels. Hot pixels will be identified as false stars, and if present in large amounts, can lead to wrong PSF parameters.

To disable hot pixel removal, set this parameter to zero.
文件:
热像素去除滤波器的大小。

这是恒星检测器在结构检测阶段之前施加的中值滤波器半径（像素）。中值滤波器去除热像素非常有效。热像素会被误判为恒星，若数量很多会导致 PSF 参数错误。

要禁用热像素去除，请把此参数设为零。

FILE:
The maximum number of PSF fits that will be performed on the set of detected stars.

The default value is 8000 stars, which is more than reasonable in most cases. Set this parameter to zero to allow an unlimited number of PSF fits, that is, to attempt fitting all detected stars on each subframe.

This parameter is intended to avoid fitting huge amounts of PSFs on wide-field images, where the number of detected stars can easily reach several tens of thousands, or even more than one hundred thousand in extreme cases. In such cases the measurement process can take a very long time to complete, but without any benefit in statistical terms, since fitting about 10,000 stars on each subframe is normally more than sufficient to acquire reliable FWHM and eccentricity measurements.

When this parameter imposes a limit on the number of PSF fits, the subset of measured stars will always start at the beginning of the set of detected stars, sorted by brightness in descending order.
文件:
对检测到的恒星集合执行 PSF 拟合的最大次数。

默认值为 8000 颗恒星，多数情况下绰绰有余。把此参数设为零可允许无限次 PSF 拟合，即尝试拟合每个子帧上所有检测到的恒星。

此参数旨在避免在广域图像上拟合海量 PSF —— 这类图像中可检测恒星数轻易达到数万，极端情形下甚至超过十万。此类情形下测量过程可能耗时极长，但在统计上毫无收益，因为每个子帧拟合约 10,000 颗恒星通常已足以获得可靠的 FWHM 与偏心率测量。

当此参数限制 PSF 拟合次数时，被测量的恒星子集总是从检测到的恒星集合开头开始，按亮度降序排列。

FILE:
Format hints allow you to override global file format settings for image files used by specific processes. In SubframeSelector, input hints change the way input images of some particular file formats are loaded, while output hints modify the way output image files are written.

For example, you can use the "lower-range" and "upper-range" input hints to load floating point FITS and TIFF files generated by other applications that don't use PixInsight's normalized [0,1] range. Similarly, you can specify the "compression-codec zlib+sh" output hint to write all output images (in XISF format) using zlib compression with byte shuffling. Most standard file format modules support hints; each format supports a number of input and/or output hints that you can use for different purposes with tools that give you access to format hints. For information on hints supported by a particular file format, see the corresponding implementation information given on the Format Explorer window.
文件:
格式提示允许你为特定过程使用的图像文件覆盖全局文件格式设置。在 SubframeSelector 中，输入提示改变某些特定格式输入图像的载入方式，输出提示则修改输出图像文件的写入方式。

例如，你可以使用 "lower-range" 与 "upper-range" 输入提示，载入由其他不使用 PixInsight 归一化 [0,1] 范围的应用生成的浮点 FITS 与 TIFF 文件。同理，你可以指定 "compression-codec zlib+sh" 输出提示，用带字节混洗的 zlib 压缩写出所有输出图像（XISF 格式）。大多数标准文件格式模块都支持提示；每种格式支持若干输入和/或输出提示，你可以在提供格式提示访问的工具中按不同目的使用。关于某一文件格式支持的提示信息，请见 Format Explorer 窗口中给出的相应实现信息。

FILE:
The pedestal mode option specifies how to retrieve a (usually small) quantity that is subtracted from input images as the very first step before measurement. This quantity is known as pedestal, and must be expressed in the 16-bit unsigned integer range (from 0 to 65535). If present, a pedestal has been added by a previous calibration process to ensure positivity of the result.

Literal value lets you specify a pedestal value that will be subtracted from all input frames. You usually don't need this option, except in very special cases.

Default FITS keyword is the default mode. When this mode is selected, SubframeSelector will retrieve pedestal values from 'PEDESTAL' FITS keywords, when they are present in the input images.

Custom FITS keyword allows you to specify the name of a custom FITS keyword to retrieve pedestal values, when the specified keyword is present in the input images.
文件:
基座模式选项指定如何获取一个（通常很小的）量，在测量前作为第一步从输入图像中减去。这个量称为基座，必须以 16 位无符号整数范围（0 至 65535）表示。若存在，基座是由先前校准过程添加的，以确保结果为正。

字面值允许你指定一个基座值，从所有输入帧中减去。通常不需要此选项，除非非常特殊的情形。

默认 FITS 关键字是默认模式。选中此模式时，SubframeSelector 会在输入图像中存在 'PEDESTAL' FITS 关键字时从中读取基座值。

自定义 FITS 关键字允许你指定一个自定义 FITS 关键字名称以获取基座值，前提是输入图像中存在所指定的关键字。

FILE:
Subframe weighting expression, an arithmetic combination of properties. A blank expression will assign a zero weight to all subframes. This is technically JavaScript, and although some characters are limited to prevent misuse, many things are possible such as Math.abs(FWHMSigma) or using // to comment the end of the line, etc. Please see the documentation for more information.

A property can be one of:

Altitude | Azimuth | Eccentricity | EccentricityMeanDev | FWHM | FWHMMeanDev | Index | MStar | Median | MedianMeanDev | NStar | Noise | NoiseRatio | PSFCount | PSFFlux | PSFFluxPower | PSFSignalWeight = PSFSignal | PSFSNR | PSFScale | PSFScaleSNR | PSFTotalMeanFlux | PSFTotalMeanPowerFlux | SNR = SNRWeight | StarResidual | StarResidualMeanDev | Stars

Each property (excluding Index) also has a Median, Min, and Max version, e.g. FWHMMin, which are computed across all subframes.

Each property (excluding Index) also has a Sigma version, e.g. PSFSignalSigma, where the value is represented in sigma units of the mean absolute deviation from the median.
文件:
子帧加权表达式，属性的算术组合。空白表达式将给所有子帧赋予零权重。这在技术上就是 JavaScript，虽然为防误用限制了部分字符，但可以做很多事情，例如 Math.abs(FWHMSigma) 或用 // 注释行尾等。详见文档。

属性可以是以下之一：

Altitude | Azimuth | Eccentricity | EccentricityMeanDev | FWHM | FWHMMeanDev | Index | MStar | Median | MedianMeanDev | NStar | Noise | NoiseRatio | PSFCount | PSFFlux | PSFFluxPower | PSFSignalWeight = PSFSignal | PSFSNR | PSFScale | PSFScaleSNR | PSFTotalMeanFlux | PSFTotalMeanPowerFlux | SNR = SNRWeight | StarResidual | StarResidualMeanDev | Stars

每个属性（Index 除外）还有 Median、Min 与 Max 版本，例如 FWHMMin，它们跨所有子帧计算。

每个属性（Index 除外）还有 Sigma 版本，例如 PSFSignalSigma，其值以相对中值的平均绝对偏差的 sigma 单位表示。

FILE:
Algorithm for compression of XISF data blocks.

ZLib is a lossless compression algorithm capable of very high compression ratios, but comparatively slow, especially for compression or large blocks.

LZ4 is an extremely fast lossless compression algorithm, but usually achieves significantly smaller compression ratios than zlib.

LZ4-HC is the high-compression variant of LZ4. It achieves somewhat smaller compression ratios than zlib, but is faster for compression and extremely fast for decompression.

Zstandard (or "zstd") is a fast lossless compression algorithm targeting real-time compression at zlib-level and better compression ratios.

You can use the compression level parameter to tune compression speed versus compression ratio, or leave the auto option checked to select the best tradeoff setting for each compression codec automatically. See also the byte shuffling option.
文件:
XISF 数据块的压缩算法。

ZLib 是一种无损压缩算法，压缩率可非常高，但相对较慢，尤其在压缩或大块数据时。

LZ4 是一种极快的无损压缩算法，但压缩率通常明显低于 zlib。

LZ4-HC 是 LZ4 的高压缩变体。它的压缩率比 zlib 略低，但压缩更快、解压极快。

Zstandard（或 "zstd"）是一种快速无损压缩算法，目标是在 zlib 级别实现实时压缩，并具有更好或更高的压缩率。

你可以用压缩级别参数调节压缩速度与压缩率之间的取舍，或保持自动选项选中，让每种压缩编解码器自动选用最佳折中设置。另见字节混洗选项。

FILE:
Cryptographic hashing algorithm for calculation of block checksums.

This implementation supports the SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 algorithms. These algorithms compute checksums of 20, 32 and 64 bytes, respectively.

Checksums are verified when data blocks are accessed, providing data integrity protection.
文件:
用于计算块校验和的密码学哈希算法。

本实现支持 SHA-1、SHA-256 与 SHA-512 算法。这些算法分别计算 20、32 与 64 字节的校验和。

访问数据块时会校验校验和，提供数据完整性保护。

The default value is 3072 bytes. This is coherent with the default block alignment size of 4096 bytes, since base64 encoding requires 4/3 of the original data size (4096 = 3072*4/3).
文件:

默认值为 3072 字节。这与 4096 字节的默认块对齐尺寸一致，因为 base64 编码需要原数据尺寸的 4/3（4096 = 3072*4/3）。

FILE:
Size in bytes of the minimum space allocated to store a binary data block in an XISF file. All file blocks (including the XML file header) are stored using integer multiples of the block alignment size.

If properly configured, block alignment can improve read performance at the expense of some wasted disk space. The default value is 4096 bytes. Set a block size of one byte to disable the XISF block alignment feature.

Block alignment is automatically disabled for compressed files.
文件:
XISF 文件中存储一个二进制数据块所分配的最小空间（字节）。所有文件块（包括 XML 文件头）都以块对齐尺寸的整数倍存储。

若配置得当，块对齐可提升读取性能，代价是浪费一些磁盘空间。默认值为 4096 字节。把块大小设为一个字节可禁用 XISF 块对齐功能。

对压缩文件，块对齐会自动禁用。
